16Kooro Manasɛ kpoo nɛra baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa ɛɛ dɛ warɛ taeh, asɛ ba chale ɛɛ palɛ Jerusalam fɔɡbaahna bwa. O berɔ ɡel Juda harɛ tena jo voɡa toma ta, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ.
17Kooro Manasɛ waa waa ɛa bwa, ne wechɔɡa waa ɛa te, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. 18Kooro Manasɛ sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa du daa koodem la jwɛh, ba dɛ yera Kooro Usa Daa. O bibaa Amɔn baa chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Amɔn
19Kooro Amɔn aa di kora la, dɛ o di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene anɛ. O nya sɔne Mɛsolɛmɛt, Mɛsolɛmɛt mɛɛ sɔne Harus dɛ le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jotba. 20Kooro Amɔn ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Manasɛ aa ɛa la. 21O teŋɛ o mɛɛ we-ɛɛla la bwa ta. O tomɛ voɡa o mɛɛ aa toma la dɛɛ ɡuŋa. 22O berɛ habɔɔ kpo Korowii o naawa aa toma la, dɛ vɛh Korowii waa ta teŋa.
23Kooro Amɔn nomonome la bini bane vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa, dɛ kpoo o koodem. 24Asɛ Juda harɛ nɛra kpoo nɛra baa vɔrɔwe Kooro Amɔn vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo la. Dɛ kpɔ o bibaa Josia chiɡ o naa ta, o di kora.
25Waa bwa Kooro Amɔn aa ɛa la te, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. 26Ba huɡo Kooro Amɔn bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa du daa o do Usa, asɛ o bibaa Josia chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 KORANAR 22
Content:
Juda Kooro Josia
1Juda Kooro Josia aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene anuatoro. O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ. O nya sɔne Jedida dɛ le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Boskat. O nya la mɛɛ sɔne Adaya. 2O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, o teŋɛ waa o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa ta. O teŋɛ Korowii waa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
Korowii Mmara Tɔn nae wa
3Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro ta la, o tomɛ o koodem karake baa dɛ yerɔ Safan Korowii Dea. O mɛɛ sɔne Asalia, o nabaa sɔne Mɛsolam. O ŋɔ Safan be ŋɔ, 4“La Sɔfonomoa Hilkia be, ásɛ o lɛ suuɡa nɛra aa dɛ ba a ne Korowii Dea la le nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi doonyoone ta la be cheɡ. 5Ŋɔ ó kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea la kwaara ta la nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea la kem. 6Kapenta tena ne mamaala ne nɛra baa dɛ sɛh bwea, dɛ́ ɡel ba kpɔ suuɡa la ane yawɛ daa ne bwea baa sɛah, dɛ́ kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la. 7Nɛra suuɡa la aa lɔ ba be la dɛ di kasinteŋ ba toma ta, anomanta, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ bá bu nkontaa bɛlbwa.”
8Sɔfo nomoa Hilkia ŋɔ koodem karake Safan waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil la be ŋɔ, “N na Korowii Mmara Tɔn waa nyoɡra la Korowii Dea.” Asɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ Safan o kure. 9Ate, Safan berɛ kaa Kooro Josia be, dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he nomonome la kpɔ suuɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛɛ ne tom-ɛɛra la nɔn ta.” 10Safan berɛ ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, sɔfo Hilkia kpɔ tɔn bɛl tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ Safan kure waa aa lɔ o bini baɡle kooro.
11Kooro la aa no Mmara Tɔn la bini waa la, o laa o laala waa doa la kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu. 12Buɡ la ta, Kooro do sɔfo Hilkia ne Safan bibaa Ahikam, ne Mikaya bibaa Akbɔ, ne Safan waa ɛ karake dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ o bonɔɔ Asaya be ŋɔ, 13“Hé la ka bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛ n ne nɛra baa ka Israel ne Juda, tɔn nɔ baa ɡaaɡa dɛ ka nao nɔ wa. Korowii baah di n ne Juda harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ taeh, dɛkalkɛ ya naawa ta waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ ta teŋɛ.”
14Anee sɔfo Hilkia ne Ahikam ne Akbɔ ne Safan, dɛ Asaya la Korowii keame bɛl waa ɛ haah baa yerɔ Hulda be, dɛ ka bɔɔ le o be. Dɛ Korowii keame Hulda soɡe Jerusalam bampera bofale. O jaaree Tikva bibaa Salum, asɛ o nabaa sɔne Haahas. Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea batakaarere ta.
15Korowii keame Hulda ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka ŋɔ Kooro Josia waa tomɛ heyaa la be ŋɔ, 16Korowii ŋɔ o dɛ ba Jerusalam nɛra deŋne tɛra, ɡɛ waa baa chwera do Juda kooro tɔn bini aa dɛ baɡle la, 17dɛkalkɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ, dɛ ka fuh konsɔɔhsoma voɡa ta, dɛɛ muɡli n baah voɡa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa ne. N baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ bonɔ kohonaa, aa wola sɔɔh bwa. 18Hé ŋɔ Juda kooro waa tomɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka bɔɔ le Korowii be la be ŋɔ, waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola, waa waa noa dɛ le tɔn la bini laanee nɔ, 19‘Haa kure tɔn la, dɛ no Jerusalam nɛra deŋnetɛra, ne ba taahna waa he loo ku he kɛɛ he batakaare haa doa, dɛ ba he te ne harɛ dɛɛ wi nomanta, n no he wii haa wia la bwa. 20Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta ka pu he naawa. Haa deŋnetɛra kohona men Korowii aa dɛ ba a ne bala ba ta Jerusalam ta laanee na.’ ”
Asɛ toroma la ka ŋɔ waa la Kooro Josia be.

Title: 2 KORANAR 23
Content:
Kooro Josia chɔɡ voɡtoroma
1Asɛ Kooro Josia yerɛ Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme. 2O ne Juda baala ne Jerusalam tena, ne sɔfore ne Korowii keamere, le bechale nɛɛ ba kaa nomonjena bwa nɛɛ ba la Korowii Dea. Asɛ o ɡel ba kure Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn waa nyoɡra ba nao Korowii Dea la, asɛ ba bwa no. 3Kooro Josia cheɡɛ o koochebɔr pila bɛl jwɛh, o ne Korowii berɛ kwaa fɔwɛ fɔo ŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa bola ne o Mmarare ta o bambile ne o liire bwa ne, ɡɛ tɔn la bini fɔo waa la aa dɛ baɡle la. Asɛ nɛra la bwa baɡɛ nyoa kɛŋɔ baa dɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo la taa.
4Kooro Josia ɡelɔ Sɔfonomoa Hilkia ne sɔfore baa ja o nɛ, ne nɛra baa dɛ che Korowii Dea la doonyoa la laa kwaa baa ɛa tɛ voɡ Baal, ne voɡ Asera ne kwaa aa lɔ nyundua a do Korowii Dea la laa pa le. Kooro la fuah bwɛjen la dahare Kedrɔn fɛlembɔjen jwɛh, dɛ pa a tɔɔ la kaa Bɛtel. 5O ir kerekpoŋra Juda koranar aa cheɡ ba baa fuh konsɔɔhsoma deŋɡarere aa lɔ Juda harɛ ne bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam bwa ta, dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Baal ne wee ne korobie ne weweela, dɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa. 6Dɛ fuɡri voɡ Asera dajaŋa le Korowii Dea, dɛ kpɔ le Jerusalam dahare, dɛ ka fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta o ɛ mohooh ken, dɛ pa ka ta nɛra ŋwama ta. 7Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba kuuɡi voɡ Asera dea baala aa lɔ a bini dɛɛ bɔ jwamane ba mao o do Korowii Dea la bɔr la. Dɛ belaa haahna so, dɛ sɔh laala tɛ nɛra ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Asera voɡ.
8Kooro la ɡelɔ ba ka kpɔ sɔfore baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta ba Jerusalam, dɛ kuuɡi voɡare baa dɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta, le Geba kaa Beɛseeba. O ɡelɔ ba chɔɡ voɡa aa lɔ doonyoo la ta, doonyoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Josua Doonyoa la ɡal bɔr. Dɛ ɡɛ Josua la ɛ bwɛjen la nomonjen. 9Kerekpoŋra baa dɛ ɛ toma voɡare ta la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe dɛ́ ɛ saraha Korowii saraha kon waa lɔ Jerusalam la ta. Kɛ dɛ ba ne ba bala baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea won paanoo iisi aa wola toole a ta dii.
10Kooro Josia ɡelɔ nɛra la Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen ta, dɛ ka paɡre kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta baa yerɔ Tɔfɛt la. Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nɛra bɛ won kpɔ ba bibaala kɛɛ ba bihaahna ɛ sarahare dɛ́ fuuh ba dɛɛ tɛ voɡ Molɛk kpa. 11O berɔ laa jaɡre ane baa mwɛɛ bune ane soo siwi ɛa Juda harɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ wee la le Korowii Dea la doonyoa. Dɛ Juda koranaree fa ɛa dɛ kpɔ tɛ voɡa. O ɡelɔ ba fuh kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ la. Dɛ ba kpɔa ka bɛne dea nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Netan Mɛlɛk bela o fa aa soɡa bini.
12O ɡelɔ ba paɡre Juda koranar kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Kooro Ahas abrɔsane doa, ne ane Kooro Manasɛ ɡe aa kwaara a do Korowii Dea dembaahna anɛ ta. Dɛ paɡra a do mohooh ken ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta. 13Kooro Josia chɔɡ saraha kwaa Kooro Solomɔn aa maa cheɡ Jerusalam wee leebɔr, ne Ɔlevere Bwejen weekaŋle harɛbɔr baa tomɛ voɡhaah Astɔrɛt, Sidon tena aa dɛ tomɛ, dɛ Moab tena voɡ Kemɔs, dɛ Amɔn tena voɡ Molɛk a bwa aa ɛ kii kwaa la. 14Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ kuuɡi voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta, dɛ pa nɛra hoɡa bil a buɡ ta.
15O berɔ ɡel ba paɡre kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tomɛ voɡa a ta, Nɛbat bie Kooro Jɛroboam aa ɛa Bɛtel la. Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ Israel tena ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, hale Kooro Josia paɡre kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta, dɛ fuh bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa a ɛ mohooh kɛŋɔ bomboɡ ken, dɛ fuh voɡ Asera dajaŋ ɡe. 16Kooro Josia nyiŋo, dɛ na ŋwama ane deŋɡare bɛl ta. Asɛ o ɡel ba huɡri hoɡa la, dɛ fuah kon voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta la ta. Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaoh, asɛ waa Korowii keame la fa aa tɔ sie bol ba tɔpejen bɛl dii, ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Jɛroboam aa cheɡɛ saraha kon jwɛh la ɛ kasinteŋ.
17Kooro Josia ŋɔ, “Ume ŋwamee ka lɔ le nɔɔ?”
Asɛ nɛra baa lɔ bwɛjen Bɛtel ta la ŋɔ, “Korowii keame waa le Juda, dɛ ba bol waa haa ɛ saraha kon nɔ ta la ŋwamee.”
18Kooro Josia ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ŋwam la, nomɛlbwa bɛ o hoɡa la huɡri.” Asɛ ba ta o ne Korowii keame waa le Samaria la hoɡa huɡre.
19Gɛ waa ɛ Bɛtel la, Kooro Josia paɡre kwaa baa dɛ ɛ voɡa sarahare a ta aa lɔ Samaria bwɛɛre ta, dɛ kpɔ doŋa kaah, Israel koranar aa maa dɛ kpɔ ir Korowii bandia kohona la. 20Kooro Josia kpoo kerekpoŋra baa soɡe voɡa la ta bwa, dɛ fuh nɛra hoɡa saraha kwaa la ta, dɛ laa berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
Kooro Josia Galekaa Tɔpejen Dii
21Kooro Josia do harɛ la ta bwa nɛra ŋɔ, “Hé di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn bini la.” 22Dɛ Israel koranar kɛɛ Juda koranar bɛlbwa ta Galekaa Tɔpejen bɛlbwa waa do ken dii bwa, le ɡɛ saŋ koranar aa wola toole, asɛ sitɔɔla yon tɔ Israel tena sie dɛɛ nyiŋi ba waa bini la. 23Kɛ a bwa habɔɔ la, Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa ba di ɡɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen nɔ Jerusalam.
Kooro Josia wefala ane ɡe ja
24Waa aa jaa laanee kɛŋɔ, Kooro Josia le nɛra baa dɛ yerɛ lala, ne tɛɛɡa tena ne deremi voɡa, dɛ voɡa baa ɛa cheɡ, dɛ kii kwaa waa naa Juda harɛ ta ne Jerusalam bwa ne. Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ tɔn waa nyoɡre Korowii Dea sɔfo Hilkia ka nao la waa won ɛ kasinteŋ. 25Kooro bɛlbwa ta do kɛ Kooro Josia, dɛ nyin Korowii o bambile bwa, o hweera dɛ o bokpeɡa bwa ne, ɡɛ waa aa lɔ Mosis Mmara la bini bwa aa dɛ baɡle la.
26Kɛ ane a bwa, Korowii bandichɔɡe waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta tena nɛɛ la, dɛ o ta sɔɔhnɛ, Kooro Manasɛ waa waa ɛa dɛ kpɔ ir o bandia la wa. 27Korowii ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ le Juda harɛ nɛra ɡe nee, ɡɛ maa le Israel harɛ nɛra ne la. Dɛ́ vɛh bwɛjen Jerusalam tena maa lee ba cheɡ tɛ n te, ne Dea nɔ maa ŋɔa baa tom mɛ o bini nɔ ta.”
Kooro Josia kora dii jaɡa
28Wobɛlbwa Kooro Josia aa ɛa la bwa, ba chwera do saŋ la Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
29Gɛ saŋ Kooro Josia aa di kora la, Ijipt harɛ ta Kooro Neko kpɔ o laa tena ba Yufretis Moo ta ba cha Asiiria koojen. Kooro Josia kpɔ o laa tena ka pu Kooro Neko yo, asɛ Kooro Neko kpoo bwɛjen Meɡido. 30Kooro Josia bonɔɔna kpɔ o chɔɔ la do torɔɡo bini, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka huɡo o ɡbaɡba lalbɔɔ bini. Juda harɛ tena lawɛ Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoahas, dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, o chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehoahas
31Kooro Jehoahas di bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro. Dɛ o nya sɔne Hamutal, o ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Jeremia, o le bwɛjen Lebna ta. 32Kooro Jehoahas teŋɛ o naawa wechɔɡa baa ɛa ta dɛ ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ. 33Ijipt Kooro baa dɛ yerɔ Neko yo Kooro Jehoahas, dɛ lawɔ bwɛjen Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ ta, dɛ vɔrɔwo jɔɡrɔre ne, asɛ o kora dii jaɡɛ bela. Dɛ ɛɡre Juda tena lɛ toɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ. 34Ijipt Kooro Neko kpɔ Kooro Josia bibaa Eliakim chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, o di kora Juda harɛ. Kooro Neko charɛ Eliakim sɔn la dɛ pao Jehoiakim. Dɛ kpɔ Kooro Jehoahas kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, asɛ o ka sewɛ bela. 35Kooro Jehoiakim bɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm Ijipt Kooro Neko aa ɛɡ ba dɛɛ lɛ la. Gɛ nomɛlbwa aa dɔa taa Kooro Jehoiakim nyiŋi dɛ lɛ suuɡa la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ó won bɔ toɔ la ɡɛ Kooro Neko aa dɛ nyin la.
Juda Kooro Jehoiakim
36Kooro Jehoiakim di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ. Dɛ o nya sɔne Sebida, o ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Pɛdaya, o le Ruma. 37Kooro Jehoiakim ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o naawa fa aa ɛa la.

Title: 2 KORANAR 24
Content:
1Kooro Jehoiakim kora dii saŋ, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena dɛ ka lɛ Juda harɛ dɔɔh, asɛ Kooro Jehoiakim do o lɔɡa bene atoro dɛɛ tomɔ. Kɛ o berɔ le Kooro Nebukadnesa habɔɔ. 2Korowii tomɛ laa tena le Babelɔn ne Siiria ne Moab, dɛ Amɔn harɛre ta ŋɔ bá ba yo Kooro Jehoiakim dɛ́ chɔɡ Juda harɛ, ɡɛ o fa aa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔna keamere nɛɛ dɛ bol ŋɔ wɛɛ ɛo la. 3Gɛ waa nɔ ɛo ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa wɛɛ ɛo dɛ́ doŋ ba le o sie, Juda tena wechɔɡa Kooro Manasɛ aa ɛa la wa 4ne nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa ɛɛ o kpoo ba warɛ Jerusalam la wa. Dɛ Korowii aa nyin kɛ ó kpɔ kɛo.
5Wobɛlbwa Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ bwa, ba chwera do Juda Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. 6Kooro Jehoiakim sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ o bibaa Jehoiachin ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
7Ijipt kooro ne o laa tena ta wone le o harɛ la ta kpa. Dɛ Babelɔn kooro lɛ harɛ Ijipt kooro fa aa dɔa la. O leɔ le Yufretis Moo ta ba kaa Ijipt weekaŋle nyunduabɔr jwɛh ta.
Juda Kooro Jehoiachin
8Kooro Jehoiachin di bene fi dɛ anuatoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro. O nya sɔne Nehusta, o mɛɛ ɡe sɔne Ɛl Netan, o le Jerusalam. 9Kooro Jehoiachin ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, ɡɛ o mɛɛ aa ɛa la.
10O kora dii saŋee Babelɔn Kooro kpɔ o laa tena ba Jerusalam, dɛ ba chɔ baro dɛ yoo ba. 11Gɛ saŋ Kooro Nebukadnesa laa tena aa chɔa bar Jerusalam la o ɡbabir ɡe la bela, 12asɛ Juda harɛ Kooro Jehoiachin ne o nya ne o bonɔɔna ne o nomonome, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ koodem bwa sɛh, dɛ kpɔ ba te do Kooro Nebukadnesa lɔɡa.
Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene anuatoro taa o ba lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta. 13Kooro Nebukadnesa ne Babelɔn tena la kaa jo Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini ne koodem, dɛ pa suuɡaswɛm kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔa cheɡ bela. Dɛ ɡɛɛ Korowii fa bol ŋɔ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛɛ ɛo. 14Kooro Nebukadnesa larawe Jerusalam nomonome ne laa tena bwa, ne nɛra baa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh ne loɡra bwa kaa. Dɛ ba lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fi, ba ta nomɛlbwa ɡelɛ, nemenɛ nɛra baa nyaa kohona, dɛ do bela ɡbosoo.
15O kpɔ Kooro Jehoiachin ne o nya ne o haahna, ne nɛra baa lɔ koodem dɛ harɛ la ta nomonome, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta. 16Babelɔn kooro ɡelɔ ba kpɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa banuanɛ ba bwa aa kpeɡa dɛ́ won yo laa, ne nɛra kaɡboŋ baa jemɛ kwaa sɛɛh ne kwaa loɡa, dɛ kpɔ ba kaa bojaŋ Babelɔn harɛ ta. 17Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa cheɡ Kooro Jehoiachin mɛɛ nime baa dɛ yerɔ Matania kooro, o so Kooro Jehoiachin buɡ ta, dɛ ɛ Juda harɛ kooro. Dɛ beɡre Matania sɔn Sedekia.
Juda Kooro Sedekia
18Kooro Sedekia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ di kora. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ. O nya sɔne Hamutal, Jeremia bihaahnee o le Lebna. 19Kooro Sedekia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa la. 20Korowii baah di Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ nɛra nɛɛ kohona, anomanta, o doŋ ba le o sie. Kooro Sedekia baa ɛ Babelɔn kooro deŋnekpeɡ.

Title: 2 KORANAR 25
Content:
Jerusalam paɡra wa
1Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene anuanaarɛ, korobie fi tɔpera fi ta la, Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena bwa kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka yoo ba. Ba baŋre ba tɛnte deene bwɛɛ la dahare, dɛ ma kwaa sawɛ bwɛjen la danjwɛɛ baa che a ta teeh jo o bini. 2Ba teŋɔ tɔ bwɛɛ la tena do, ka tel Kooro Sedekia aa di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta. 3A ɡɛ benanyoa la korobinaarɛ tɔpenuanaarɛ ta, dɛ lɔr o nyoa aa do kpeɡri kohona chole bwɛjen Jerusalam, kondikwaa toole nɛra di. 4Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la. Kooro Sedekia ne Jerusalam laa tena kpɔ doonyoa bɛl waa chɔ danjwɛɛre anɛ baah ta, ba kpɔ bela dɛɛ kaa kooro bodɛɛɡe waa du daa ta, dɛ le kpɔ sie chaɡɛ kaa Jɔɔdan Fɛlembɔjen ta jwaana, 5kɛ Babelɔn laa tena la ti Kooro Sedekia, dɛ ka lawɔ Jeriko harɛ waa chɔa kaa ta, asɛ o laa tena bwa chwa ɡelo. 6Ba lawɔ kaa bwɛjen Ribla ka tɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa o ka bol o waa dɛ pao bolchɔɡe. 7Ba kpoo Kooro Sedekia bibaala o siwi ta, dɛ foromi o ɡe sibie, dɛ doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn.
Korowii Dea chɔɡa wa
8Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuanaarɛ, korobie anue tɔpera anuanɛ ta la, o laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan la Jerusalam. 9O kaa fuh Korowii Dea ne koodem, dɛ Jerusalam deremi bwa. O fuh nomonjena dedɛɛɡe te bɛlbwa, 10asɛ Babelɔn laa tena Nebusaradan aa chɔ ba nyoa la kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la. 11Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ nɛra baa ka bwɛjen la ta, ne tom-ɛɛra, dɛ banɔ la baa le Kooro Sedekia habɔɔ, dɛ ka teŋɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa nɛɛ la bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta. 12Kɛ o ɡel nyaara baa lɔ Juda harɛ la bane ŋɔ baa ɛ toma daa kooni ne kooni aa lɔ bela la ta.
13Babelɔn laa tena la kuuɡi ayaawa pilare ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa a do Korowii Dea, dɛ ayaawa loɡ baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo la, dɛ kpɔ a bwa kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta. 14Dɛ berɛ pa viine ne soofire ne kwaa baa pa tɔɔ dɛɛ do a bini, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ menɛ kandea ŋwɛɛra, ne loɡa baa kpɔa dɛɛ chaɡɛ kwaa baa dɛ kpoo chale, ne loɡa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a bini, dɛ ayaawa kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea bwa kaa. 15Laa sitɔɔ la kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ buh nii, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ la, komɛlbwa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm tenten ne suuɡapoŋ ɛa te, ba kaa a bwa ne.
16Ayaawa aa lɔ pilare anɛ la ta, ne kwaa aa dɔ nakpale baa taɡa, ne loɡbajen baa dɛ yerɔ Mpo Kooro Solomɔn ɛa cheɡ Korowii Dea la, a kan kohona kɛŋɔ ba won maɡɛ a tɔɡre. 17Pilare anɛ la le dɔŋa, bɛlbwa jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua lɔ naɡale fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, asɛ ayaawa baa kpɔa ɛ a tɔɡre la, ɡe jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɛɛ ɛ naɡale anaarɛ ne tama. Asɛ ba kpɔ ayaawa ɛ kafola a do ɡuleɡule kɛŋɔ, daa nɔna ane baa dɛ yera pɔmeɡranet ken, dawɛ pila la bɛlbwa doa dɛ bar.
Juda tena lawa dɛ́ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta
18Laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan lawɛ Sɔfonomoa Seraya ne o dɔŋ Sefania o ɡe aa dɛ chao, dɛ nomonome batoro bane baa dɛ daah doonyoa la laa ta kaa. 19Ba bini banɔ la baa ka bwɛjen la bini la, o lawɛ nomoa waa chɔ laa tena nyoa, ne nɛra banue baa dɛ ja kooro la. Dɛ lawɛ laa nomoa la nɛn waa dɛ chao dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ laa tena fifraanumɛl baa jaa dɛ do bwɛɛ la bini. 20Babelɔn laa sitɔɔ Nebusaradan kpɔ ba bwa kaa bwɛjen Ribla ka tɛ Babelɔn koojen. 21Ribla waa lɔ Hamat harɛ taa Babelɔn kooro ɡel ba kpoo ba bela.
Gɛɛ a do ba lawɛ Juda tena le ba harɛ ta, dɛ kaa ba ne bojaŋ harɛfale ta.
Gedalia ɛ Juda harɛ nomoa
22Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa le Ahikam bibaa Gedalia ŋɔ wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa ka Juda harɛ la nɛ. Ahikam ɡe mɛɛ Safan. 23Juda laa nomonome la bwa ne ba laa tena baa wola ban lawɛ kaa la aa noa kɛŋɔ Babelɔn kooro le Gedalia o ɛ ba harɛ nomoa la, ba la o be Mispa. Banee Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, ne Karea bibaa Johanan, ne Tanhumet bibaa Seraya, o ɛ Nɛtɔfa te. Dɛ Jaasania, waa ɛ Maaka te bɛl bie, dɛ ba bala. 24Belaa Gedalia ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡ ba ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ Babelɔn nomonome nɔ ɔma, hé so bonɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Babelɔn kooro, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.”
25Korobie anuanɛ ta la, Nɛtanea bibaa Ismael, waa ɛ koobie, iro dɛ lawɛ baala fi ja o nɛɛ ba la Gedalia be Mispa, dɛ ka kpoo o ne Juda ne Babelɔn tena baa lɔ bela. Ismael nabaa sɔne Elisama. 26Aa ba ɡɛ la, Juda tena nyaara ne kpeɡnɛra bwa, dɛ ba laa nomonome la chwao kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ Babelɔn tena.
Ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea
27Baa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanɛ la, ɡɛ saŋee Babelɔn Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak di kora. O tɛ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ ɡel ba le Kooro Jehoiachin dea korobie fi dɛ anɛ, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ ta. 28Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak bol wobodɛɛɡa tɛ Kooro Jehoiachin, dɛ tɛo jirima ɡwaa koranar baa ja o nɛɛ ba laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta Babelɔn bela la bwa. 29Anomanta, Kooro Jehoiachin dɔ ŋwɛnɛ dɛ laa laala waa doa ba doo dea la foo bil, dɛ kpɔ anfala do, asɛ o ne Babelɔn kooro pɛ nɔn dɛɛ di kwa o soɡa bini bwa. 30Kooro Jehoiachin soɡa bini bwa la, dɛ Babelɔn Kooro Evil Mɛrɔdak dɛ tɛo suuɡa waa kpɔ yawɛ kwaa aa hiaoh.

Title: 1 WEBENA TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Webena Baa Chwera Bil Tɔn Loɡle nɔ dɛ baɡle Israel harɛ webena baa chwera, dɛ kpɔa ja anɔ la aa lɔ Korowii Tɔn bini la ta, asɛ yaa kura la wa. Ba chwerɛ Israel tena naanar waa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ do nyuune 1—9, ne Korowii Dea tom-ɛɛra ne laa tena dɛ sitɔɔla waa do nyuune 23—27. Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle Kooro Devid waa kohona, ne ɡɛ waa nyin laala cheɡ tɛ o bibaa Solomɔn, ó do Korowii Dea bela baa dɛɛ tomɔ.

Title: 1 WEBENA 1
Content:
Le Adam ba Abraham bere saŋ
1Ya naa Adam aa ira la, o lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Sɛt. Sɛt ir dɛ lolɛ Enɔs, Enɔs ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Kenan. 2Kenan lolɛ Mahalalel, asɛ Mahalalel ɡe lolɛ Jarɛd. 3Jarɛd ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Enɔk, Enɔk lolɛ Mɛtusala. Asɛ o ɡe lolɛ Lamɛk, Lamɛk ɡe lolɛ Nowa.
4Bibaala batoroo Nowa lolɛ.
Banee Sɛm ne Ham dɛ Jafɛt.
5Jafɛt bii waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ,
Goma ne Maɡɔɡ ne Madai ne Javan ne Tubal ne Mɛsɛk dɛ Tiras. Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar.
6Goma naanaree,
Askenas ne Rifat dɛ Toɡama.
7Javan naanaree,
Elaisa ne Speen ne Saepros dɛ Roods tena.
8Ham bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ,
Kus ne Misraim ne Put dɛ Keenan. Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar.
9Kus naanaree,
Seba ne Havila ne Sabta ne Raama dɛ Sabtɛka tena.
Raama ɡe naanaree,
Seeba ne Dedan tena.
10Kus bibaa bɛl ɡee Nimrod.
Onee waa baa kpeɡ la, o ɛ banyoo dɛ do kpeɡri kohona harɛ nɔ ta la.
11Lud ne Anam ne Lɛhab dɛ Naftu tena nabaalee Misraim,
12ne Patrus ne Kaslu dɛ Kaftɔ tena. Ba binii Filisti tena le.
13Keenan ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la,
o lolɛ o bibaa waa tɔ sie, dɛ pa o sɔn Sidon, asɛ a habɔɔ o berɛ lolɛ Hiti. Ba sɔna nɔɔ ba kpɔ pa ba naanar, 14ne Jebus ne Amɔre dɛ Girɡasi tena, 15ne Hivi ne Aaki dɛ Sen tena, 16ne Aavad ne Semari dɛ Hamat tena.
17Sɛm bibaala waa lol ba laanee teŋa nɔ,
Elam ne Assur ne Aafaksad ne Lud dɛ Aram.
Aram ɡe aa ira la, o bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Us ne Hul ne Geta dɛ Mɛsɛk.
18Aafaksadee lolɛ Seela,
asɛ Seela ɡe lolɛ Iba.
19Iba ɡe aa baa kpeɡ la, o lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Bɛl sɔne Pɛlɛɡ, dɛkalkɛ o saŋ taa nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bini peɡri la. Dɛ o nime ɡe sɔne Joktan.
20Joktan naanaree,
Almodad ne Sɛlɛf ne Hasamavɛt dɛ Jera tena, 21ne Hadoram ne Usal dɛ Dikla tena, 22ne Obal ne Abemɛl dɛ Seeba tena, 23ne Ofir ne Havila dɛ Jobab tena.
24Kenii Sɛm ne o naanar dɛ kpoŋe ka le Abram nɛɛ waa do, Sɛm ne Aafaksad dɛ Seela,
25ne Iba ne Pɛlɛɡ dɛ Reu, 26ne Sɛrɔɡ ne Neehɔ ne Tɛɛra, 27dɛ Abram, baa bera baa yerɔ Abraham la.
Abraham naanar
28Abraham bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Aesek ne Ismael.
29Ismael bibaala waa lol ba la, kenii ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ,
Nɛbayɔt ne Keda ne Adbeel dɛ Mibsam, 30ne Misma ne Duma ne Masa ne Hadad dɛ Tema 31ne Jetur ne Nafis dɛ Kedema.
32Abraham berɔ kpɔ sɛno baa yerɔ Ketura.
O ne on lolɛ Simran ne Joksan ne Medan ne Midian ne Esbak dɛ Suwa.
Joksan ɡe bibaalaa,
Seeba ne Dedan.
33Midian bibaalaa,
Efa ne Efar ne Hanɔk ne Abida dɛ Ɛldaa. Ketura naanaree banɔ bwa.
34Abraham lolɛ Aesek.
Aesek ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Esɔ ne Jekɔb.
Esɔ naanar
35Esɔ ɡe aa ira la, bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Elifas ne Ruwɛl ne Jeyus ne Jalam dɛ Kora.
36Elifas naanaree,
Teman ne Omar ne Sefo ne Gatam, ne Kenas ne Timna dɛ Amalɛk tena.
37Ruwɛl naanaree,
Nahat ne Sɛra ne Samaa dɛ Misa tena.
Nɛra baa tɔ sie ka so Edom harɛ ta
38Sɛɛ ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Lotan ne Sobal ne Sibeon dɛ Ana, ne Dison ne Esa dɛ Disan.
39Lotan ɡe bibaalaa nɔ,
Hɔr ne Homam. Dɛ Lotan nimambie sɔne Timna.
40Sobal ɡe bibaalaa nɔ,
Alvan ne Manahat ne Ebal ne Sɛfo dɛ Onam.
Sibeon ɡe bibaalaa nɔ,
Aeya ne Ana.
41Ana bibaa waa lolɔ sɔne
Dison.
Dison ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ bibaala nɔ,
Hɛmdan ne Ɛsban ne Itran dɛ Keran.
42Asɛ Esa ɡe bibaalaa nɔ,
Bilhan ne Saavan dɛ Akan.
Disan ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ bibaala nɔ,
Us ne Aran.
Edom koronar
43Koranar baa tɔ sie di Edom kora, mɔɔ Israel te bɛlbwa ɡe ba di la sɔnaa teŋa nɔ,
Beɔ bibaa Bɛla di kora Edom. Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Dinhaba.
44Kooro Bɛla aa baa sewɛ la,
Sɛra bibaa Jobab waa le bwɛjen Bosra baa so o buɡ ta.
45Kooro Jobab ɡe aa baa sewɛ
la, Husam waa le Teman harɛ taa baa di kora.
46Asɛ Kooro Husam ɡe aa
baa sewɛ la, Bɛdad bibaa Hadad ɡee baa chiɡ o naa ta di kora. Onee fa yo Midian tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ Moab harɛ ta la. O bwɛjen sɔne Avit.
47Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ,
asɛ Samla waa le bwɛjen Masrɛka ba di kora.
48Kooro Samla ɡe aa baa sewɛ
la, Swaul waa le Rɛhɔbɔt waa chɔa bɛne nee laanee baa di kora.
49Kooro Swaul ɡe baa sewɛ, asɛ
Akbɔ bibaa Baal Hanan ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
50Kooro Baal Hanan ɡe aa baa
sewɛ la, Hadad ɡe ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora. Dɛ o bwɛjen sɔne Pau. O haah ɡe sɔne Mɛhetabɛl, o ɛ Matrɛd bihaah. Matrɛd ɡe nya sɔne Mɛsahab. 51Kooro Hadad ɡe baa sewɛ.
Edom tena koranaree nɔ,
Timna ne Alva dɛ Jetɛt, 52ne Oholibama ne Ɛla dɛ Penɔn, 53ne Kenas ne Teman dɛ Mibsar, 54ne Maɡdiel dɛ Iram.

Title: 1 WEBENA 2
Content:
Bibaala Jekɔb aa lol ba
1Bibaala Jekɔb aa lol ba laanee nɔ.
Rubin ne Simeon ne Lewi ne Juda ne Isaaka dɛ Sebulon, 2ne Dan ne Josef ne Bɛnjamen ne Naftale ne Gad dɛ Aasa.
3Juda ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee nɔ.
Ɛr ne Onan dɛ Seela. A ɡɛ bibaala batoro nɔ, o ne o haah Sua waa ɛ Keenan te laanee lol ba. Dɛ Ɛr waa ɛ Juda biloɡle la ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, anomanta, Korowii kpoo. 4Juda bibaa haah waa ɛ o helahaah sɔne Taama, o ne o lolɛ Pɛrɛs ne Sɛra. Juda bibaala waa lol ba bwa lɔ banue.
5Pɛrɛs lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Hɛsrɔn ne Hamul.
6Sɛra ɡe lolɛ bibaala banue.
Banee, Simri ne Etan ne Heman ne Kalkol dɛ Daada.
7Kaami ɡe lolɛ bibaa,
o sɔne Akan. Onee kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii berɛ o kwa, dɛ ba waa ne ba tɛ Israel tena la.
8Etan ɡe lolɛ bibaa beŋkpoŋ, o sɔne Asaria.
Kooro Devid luɡe nɛra
9Bibaala batoroo Hɛsrɔn lolɛ.
Banee, Jeramiil ne Ram dɛ Kaleb.
10Ram iro dɛ lolɛ
Aminadab, Aminadab ɡe lolɛ Naasɔn, o ɛ Juda tena sitɔɔla bini bɛl. 11Naasɔn iro dɛ lolɛ Salmon, Salmon lolɛ Boas, 12Boas lolɛ Ɔbɛd, Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jese.
13Jese lolɛ o biloɡle baa yerɔ
Eliab, nɛɛte sɔne Abinadab, toorote ɡe Simia, 14Nɛtanɛl teŋɛ naarɛ, Radai teŋɛ nue, 15Osem teŋɛ numɛl, Devid teŋɛ nuanɛ. 16Ba nimambihaahnaa, Seruya ne Abiɡel. Seruya bibaala batoro waa lol ba sɔne Abisae ne Joab dɛ Asahɛl. 17Abiɡel lolɛ Amasa, o mɛɛ baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Jɛta, o ɛ Ismael naa.
Hɛsrɔn naanar
18Hɛsrɔn bibaa Kaleb mo
haahna banɛ, bɛl sɔne Asuba, bɛl ɡe Jɛreɔt. Asuba lolɛ bibaala batoro, banee, Jɛsa ne Sobab dɛ Aadɔn. 19A habɔɔ, Asuba baa sewɛ, asɛ Kaleb ka mo Efrat dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Hur. 20Hur ɡe iro dɛ lolɛ Uri, Uri ɡe lolɛ Besalɛl.
21A habɔɔ, Hɛsrɔn aa dɔ bene
fifraanumɛl la, o mo Makir bihaah waa ɛ Gelead nimambie. Ba lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Seɡub, 22asɛ Seɡub ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Jɛɛ. Dɛ Jɛɛ dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjena fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ta Gelead harɛ ta. 23Kɛ Gesur ne Aram harɛre tena yo bwɛɛre fifraanumɛl. Havɔt Jɛɛ ne Kenat, dɛ bwɛɛre aa baro cheme bwa ɡe jao. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ baa soɡe bela bwa ɛ Gelead mɛɛ Makir naanar.
24Hɛsrɔn aa sewɛ Kaleb Efrata
habɔɔ la, Hɛsrɔn haah Abija lolɛ Asur waa vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ baa dɛ yerɔ Tekoa.
Jeramiil naanar
25Hɛsrɔn binomoa Jeramiil bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Ram, o ɛ biloɡle, ne Buna ne Oren ne Osem dɛ Ahija. 26Dɛ Jeramiil dɔ haah bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Atara, o bibaa sɔne Onam.
27Jeramiil binomoa Ram bibaala waa lol ba laanee nɔ,
Maas ne Jamin dɛ Eka.
28Onam ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Samai ne Jada.
Asɛ Samai ɡe bibaala banɛ waa lol ba laanee,
Nadab ne Abisur.
29Dɛ Abisur haah sɔne Abihel, o ne o lolɛ Aban ne Molid.
30Nadab ɡe bibaalaa,
Sɛlɛd ne Apaem. Kɛ Sɛlɛd te ta bii dɔe, dɛ sewɛ.
31Apaem ɡe bibaa sɔne Isi,
o ɡe aa ira la, o lolɛ Sɛsan. Asɛ Sɛsan ɡe lolɛ Alae.
32Jada waa ɛ Samai nime ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Jɛta ne Jonatan. Jɛta te ta bii lolɛ dɛ sewɛ.
33Jonatan lolɛ bibaala,
banee, Pɛlet ne Sasa.
Jeramiil naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa.
34Sɛsan ta bibaala lolɛ, bihaahna ɡboo.
Dɛ o dɔ Ijipt bonɔɔ bɛl baa yerɔ Jarha. 35O lawɛ o bihaah la bɛl tɛ o bonɔɔ Jarha o mo, dɛ lolɛ bibaa baa yerɔ Atai.
36Atai lolɛ Netan,
Netan lolɛ Sabad,
37Sabad lolɛ Eflal,
Eflal ɡe lolɛ Ɔbɛd,
38Ɔbɛd lolɛ Jehu,
Jehu ɡe lolɛ Asaria.
39Asaria lolɛ Hɛlɛs,
Hɛlɛs ɡe lolɛ Eleasa.
40Eleasa lolɛ Sismai,
asɛ Sismai lolɛ Salum.
41Salum lolɛ Jekamia,
Jekamia ɡe lolɛ Elisama.
Kaleb naanar bane ɡe
42Jeramiil nime Kaleb bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Mesa waa ɛ o binomoa, onee lolɛ Sif, asɛ Sif ɡe lolɛ Maresa waa ɛ Hɛbrɔn tena nabaa.
43Hɛbrɔn ɡe bibaala waa lol ba laanee.
Kora ne Tapua ne Rekem dɛ Sema. 44Sema ɡee lolɛ Raham, Raham ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Jɔɔkeam, Rekem ɡe lolɛ Samai. 45Samai bibaa waa lolɔ sɔne Mayɔn, asɛ Mayɔn ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Bɛt Sor.
46Kaleb sɛno baa dɛ yerɔ Efa la
bibaalaa, Haaran ne Mosa dɛ Gasɛs. Haaran ɡe lolɛ Gasɛs.
47Jadai ɡe lolɛ bibaala banumɛl, banee,
Rɛɡɛm ne Jotam ne Gɛsan ne Pɛlɛt ne Efa dɛ Saaf.
48Kaleb dɔ sɛno bɛl baa yerɔ
Maaka. O lolɛ bibaala banɛ, Sebar dɛ Tirihana. 49Maaka berɔ lolɛ Saaf waa vɔrɔwe Madmana, ne o bibaa Sɛva o ɡe aa vɔrɔwe Makbɛna ne Gibia. Dɛ Kaleb bihaah sɔne Aksa. 50Gɛɛ Kaleb naanar waa do.
Kaleb binomoaa Hur, o ne o haah Efrataa lolɔ.
Hur ɡe bibaa sɔne Sobal, onee vɔrɔwe Kiriat Jearim, 51o binɛɛte sɔne Salma, onee vɔrɔwe Bɛtlɛham. Bitoorote ɡe sɔne Harɛf, o ɡee vɔrɔwe Bɛt Gada.
52Sobal waa vɔrɔwe Kiriat Jearim la naanaree,
Harowɛ tena ne Manahat tena pera, 53ne Kiriat Jearim deene ane kɛŋɔ, Itri ne Put ne Sumat dɛ Misra tena. Ba binii Sora tena ne Ɛstaol tena le.
54Salma naanaree,
Bɛtlɛham ne Nɛtɔfa ne Atrɔt Bɛt Joab, ne Manahat tena pera baa ɛ Sor tena, 55ne deene nɛra baa dɔ waa chwera dɛ bil wejema soɡe Jabɛs. Banee Tira ne Simeat dɛ Suka tena. Banɔɔ Ken tena baa le Haamat dɛ ɛ Rekab mɛɛ dea luɡe nɛra.

Title: 1 WEBENA 3
Content:
Kooro Devid bibaala
1Kooro Devid bibaala waa lol ba Hɛbrɔn laanee teŋa nɔ.
Binomoa sɔne Amnɔn, o nyaa Ahinoam, o le Jesreel,
nɛɛtee Daneɛl, o nyaa Abiɡel, waa le Kaamɛl,
2toorote ɡe Absalɔm, o nyaa Maaka. Gesur Kooro Talmai bihaahnee,
naarɛte ɡee Adonija, o nyaa Haɡit,
3Sɛfatea teŋɛ, o nyaa Abital, asɛ Itriam teŋɛ, o nya sɔne Eɡla.
4Kooro Devid aa di kora Hɛbrɔn bene anuanɛ korobie anumɛl la, a ɡɛ bibaala banumɛl nɔɔ o lolɛ.
O soɡe Jerusalam bene fifraatoro dɛ atoro dɛ di kora. 5Bibaala baa lola tɛo Jerusalam laanee, Samoa ne Sobab ne Netan dɛ Solomɔn. O ne o haah Batsiiba waa ɛ Ameɛl bihaah la bibaalaa banaarɛ nɔ. 6Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banuanaarɛ bane ɡe. Banee, Ibha ne Elisua dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt, 7ne Nɔɡa ne Nɛfɛɡ dɛ Jafia, 8ne Elisama ne Eliada dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt. 9A ɡɛ bibaala nɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Kooro Devid ne haahna baa ɛ o sɛnanar lolɛ bibaala bane ɡe. Bihaah waa ja ba nɛɛ la sɔne Taama.
Kooro Solomɔn naanar
10Kooro Solomɔn naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ.
Rɛhoboam ne Abija ne Asa dɛ Jehosafat,
11ne Jehoram ne Ahasia dɛ Joas,
12ne Amasea ne Ussia dɛ Jotam,
13ne Ahas ne Hɛsɛkea dɛ Manasɛ,
14ne Amɔn dɛ Josia.
15Josia dɔ bibaala banaarɛ,
banee, Johanan ne Jehoiakim ne Sedekia dɛ Salum.
16Jehoiakim ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ, banee Jehoiachin ne Sedekia.
Kooro Jehoiachin naanar
17Kooro Jehoiachin baa lawɔ laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta naanar waa nɔ. Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banuanɛ, banee teŋa nɔ.
Sealteɛl, 18ne Malkiram ne Pɛdaya ne Sɛnasa ne Jekamia ne Hosama dɛ Nedabia.
19Pɛdaya ɡe iro, dɛ lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Sɛrobabɛl ne Simee.
Sɛrobabɛl ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee, Mɛsolam ne Hanania.
Ba nimambie sɔne Sɛlomet.
20Dɛ o dɔ bibaala banue bane ɡe.
Banee, Hasuba ne Ohel ne Bɛrekea ne Hasadia dɛ Jusab Hɛsɛd.
21Hanania ɡe lolɛ bibaala banɛ.
Banee Pɛlatea ne Jesaya, Jesaya lolɛ Refaya, o ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Aanan, o ɡe lolɛ Obadia, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ Sɛkania.
22Sɛkania lolɛ bibaa beŋkpoŋ baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛmaya, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ bibaala banue.
Banee, Hatus ne Iɡal ne Baria ne Nearia dɛ Safat.
23Nearia ɡe lolɛ bibaala batoro.
Banee, Elionai ne Hiskia dɛ Asrikam.
24Elionai ɡe lolɛ bibaala banuanɛ.
Banee, Hodavia ne Eliasib ne Pɛlaya ne Akub ne Johanan ne Delaya dɛ Anani.

Title: 1 WEBENA 4
Content:
Juda naanar
1Juda ɡe naanaree,
Pɛrɛs ne Hɛsrɔn ne Kaami ne Hur dɛ Sobal.
2Sobal bibaalee Reaya, o ɡe lolɛ Jahat, Jahat lolɛ Ahumai dɛ Lahad. Banɔɔ Sora tena naawa, dɛ che tɛ ba deene.
3Etam bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Jesreel ne Isma dɛ Idbas. Ba nimambihaah sɔne Haselelponi. 4Pɛnoɛl bibaa sɔne Gedɔr, asɛ Esa ɡe lolɛ Husa.
Banee Hur waa ɛ Efrata binomoa, waa vɔrɔwe Bɛtlɛham la naanar.
5Asur waa vɔrɔwe Tekoa la mo haahna banɛ. Banee, Hela ne Naara.
6Naara bibaala waa lol ba laanee Ahusam ne Hɛfa ne Temeni dɛ Haahastari. Banee Naara naanar.
7Hela ɡe bibaalaa,
Sɛrɛt ne Soha dɛ Ɛtnan. 8Kos ɡe bibaalaa Anub ne Hasobeba, dɛ deene ba naa aa le Harum bibaa Ahahɛl luɡe ta.
9Dɛ Jabɛs lolanar bini la, dɛ onee dɔ duure kohona. O nya pa o sɔn Jabɛs dɛ ŋɔ, “N bwara nyɛɡ mɛ o lola bini.” 10Jabɛs wio no Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, swee mɛ andɛɛɡa, dɛ́ ɡel n harɛ do kan! Kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, dɛ́ lee mɛ waa aa kpɔ bonyɛɡa ba ta n nɛɛ ta.” Asɛ Korowii no o wesoŋa.
Lolanar bane baa jaa
11Suha dɔɔ Kelub, onee lolɛ Mehir, Mehir ɡe lolɛ Ɛstɔn. 12Ɛstɔn ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Bɛt Rafa ne Pasea dɛ Tehina, asɛ Tehina ɡe lolɛ Ir Nahas. A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ naanar fa soɡe Reka.
13Kenas ɡe bibaalaa,
Otniel ne Seraya.
Otniel ɡe bibaalaa,
Hatat ne Meɔnɔtae. 14Meɔnɔtae ɡee lolɛ Ofra.
Seraya ɡe lolɛ Joab,
asɛ Joab ɡe ir, dɛ ka vɔrɔwe bwɛɛ fɛlembɔjen bɛl bini, Ge Harasim. Gɛɛ ba pa bela sɔn, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa soɡe bela dɛ sɛh kwa.
15Jefune bibaa Kaleb bibaalaa,
Iru ne Ɛla dɛ Naam.
Ɛla ɡe bibaalee,
Kenas.
16Jehalelɛl ɡe bibaalaa,
Sif ne Sifa ne Tiria dɛ Asarɛl.
17Ɛsera ɡe bibaalaa nɔ,
Jɛta ne Mɛrɛd ne Efar dɛ Jalɔn. Mɛrɛd aa ira la, o mo haahna banɛ. Ba bini bɛl bii waa lola laanee Miriam. Dɛ o ɛ bihaah, ne Samai dɛ Isba ba ɡe aa ɛ bibaala. Esba ɡe bibaalee Ɛstemoa. 18Ɛstemoa haah Juda te laanee lolɛ Jɛrɛd, o ɡe lolɛ Gedɔr ne Heba, Heba lolɛ Soko dɛ Jekutiel, o ɡe lolɛ Sanoa. A ɡɛ bibaala nɔɔ Ijipt kooro bihaah Bitia, Mɛrɛd aa moo la lolɛ.
19Naham nahaah waa ɛ Hodia haah bibaalaa,
Keila waa ɛ Gam te la mɛɛ, ne Maaka te Ɛstemoa.
20Simon ɡe bibaalaa,
Amnɔn ne Rina ne Bɛn Hanan dɛ Telɔn.
Asɛ Isi ɡe naanaree, Sohɛt ne Bɛn Sohɛt.
Seela naanar
21Seela ɛ Juda bibaala la bini beŋkpoŋ.
O naanaree Ɛr waa lolɛ Leka ne Laada waa lolɛ Maresa, ne dea bɛl nɛra baa dɛ ɛ yasɔɔhŋwɛɛra, dea waa lɔ Bɛt Asbea, 22ne Jokim ne baala baa lɔ Kosiba, ne Joas ne Saraf waa di kara Moab, dɛ Jasubi Lɛhɛm. A ɡɛ waa nɔ le anɔ la saŋ la tena aa chwera bil la ta. 23A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ mamaala dɛ faa so Nɛtaem ne Gɛdɛra. Dɛ ba soɡe bela dɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ tɛ kooro la.
Simeon naanar
24Simeon naanaree,
Nemoɛl ne Jamin ne Jarib ne Sɛra dɛ Swaul,
25asɛ Swaul lolɛ Salum, Salum lolɛ Mibsam, Mibsam ɡe lolɛ Misma.
26Misma ɡe luɡee la.
O lolɛ Hamoɛl, Hamoɛl lolɛ Sakur, Sakur lolɛ Simee.
27Simee dɔ bibaala fi dɛ banumɛl ne bihaahna banumɛl, kɛ o nimanar te ta bii loɡlɛ kohona, anomanta, ba dea bii ta warɛ kɛ Juda dea tena. 28Dɛ ba soɡe bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ Beɛseeba ne Molada ne Hasar Sual, 29ne Bilha ne Esem dɛ Tolad, 30ne Bɛtoɛl ne Hɔrma dɛ Siklaɡ, 31ne Bɛt Makabɔt ne Hasar Susim ne Bɛt Biri dɛ Saaraim. Dɛ a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ taa ba so mɔɔ Kooro Devid ba di kora. 32Bwɛɛre aa bar ba cheme laanee, Etam ne Ain ne Remɔn ne Token dɛ Asan. A bwa lɔ bwɛɛre anue, 33dɛ bwɛɛre aa bar bela dɛ kpoŋe kaa Baalat. Dɛ belaa ba soŋni, asɛ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ ba naanar aa soɡa denaa ta.
34Banee, Mɛsobab ne Jamlɛk dɛ Amasea bibaa Josa, 35ne Joel ne Josibia bibaa Jehu, ne Seraya bibaa Josibia, dɛ Aseɛl bibaa Seraya, 36ne Elionai ne Jaakoba ne Jesohia ne Asaya ne Adeɛl ne Jesimiel dɛ Bɛnaya, 37ne Sifi bibaa Sesa ne Alɔn bibaa Sifi, ne Jedaya bibaa Alɔn ne Simri bibaa Jedaya, dɛ Sɛmaya bibaa Simri.
38Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɛ nomonome, dɛ chɔ ba deene nyoo. Ba mun yao kohona, 39asɛ dɛ yon le kaa Gedɔr dahare fɛlembɔjen la wee leebɔr, dɛ ka nyin dibɔra tɛ ba peera. 40Ba dɔ harɛdɛɛɡe waa wera tɛ ba peera, dɛ harɛ la paɡri, deŋnesɔɔhna ɡe do o ta, dɛ sɔɔh. Dɛ Ham tena bini bane fa soɡe bela.
41Baala baa chwerɛ ba sɔna la balɔ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea bere saŋ. Ba kaa yo Ham tena la ba soŋnibɔra, ne Meuni tena ba ɡe aa lɔ bela, dɛ chɔɡ ba kwaraa. A ɛ danseɛ dɛ ba le fini. Ba kpɔ ba soŋnibɔra la so, dɛkalkɛ ba peera dɔ kondikwaa kohona dɛ́ di bela. 42Belaa Simeon dea tena nɛra lafraanue ne ba nomonome, Pɛlatea ne Nearia ne Refaya ne Usiel baa ɛ Isi bibaala tɔ ba sie, ba ka yo harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛɛ waa ɛ deŋɡarere harɛ. 43Ba kpoo Amalɛk tena baa kaa la bwa, dɛ kpɔ bela so, dɛ ba le fini.

Title: 1 WEBENA 5
Content:
Rubin naanar
1Jekɔb binomoa sɔne Rubin, dɛ onee biloɡle, kɛ waa lawɛ o mɛɛ haah chɔ la nomanta, ba laa o nomonome lɛ o be tɛ o nime Josef. A ɡɛ nomanta, o sɔn toole ɡɛ baa lol ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la ta. 2Dɛ Juda dea tena dɔ kpeɡri ɡwaa deene la bwa. Kooro le bela dɛ tɛ deene la bwa, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Josef dea fe dɔ kpeɡri kɛ biloɡle. 3Rubin waa ɛ Jekɔb binomoa la bibaala waa lol ba laanee,
Hanɔk ne Palu ne Hɛsrɔn dɛ Kaami.
4Joel bie ne o naanar ɡee nɔ,
Onee lolɛ Sɛmaya, Sɛmaya lolɛ Gɔɡ, Gɔɡ lolɛ Simee, 5Simee lolɛ Maeka, Maeka lolɛ Reaya, Reaya ɡe lolɛ Baal,
6Baal lolɛ Beera. A ɡɛ Beera nɔɔ Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa lawɛ laa ta kaa harɛfale ta la. Dɛ onee Rubin dea tena sitɔɔ.
7Kenii ba chwerɛ Rubin dea nomonome lolanar ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Jeyɛl waa ɛ ba sitɔɔ ne Sekaria, 8ne Asas bibaa Bɛla, Sema bibaa Asas, dɛ Sema bibaa Joel. Dɛ ba soɡo le harɛ waa le Arowa, dɛ kpoŋe ba le Nɛbo ne Baal Meɔn. 9Harɛ la wee leebɔr, ba soɡo ka le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ kaa Yufretis Moo ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba kondɛɛra yao Gelead harɛ ta.
10Kooro Sɔɔl bere saŋ la, ba kaa yo Haɡri tena laa dɛ kpoo ba, dɛ kpɔ ba harɛ waa lɔ Gelead wee leebɔr pera la so.
Gad dea tena
11Gad dea tena ɡe soɡo teŋɛ ba nɛ Basan harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe ka le bwɛɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Saleka.
12Joel ɛ ba sitɔɔ, asɛ Safam teŋɛ, asɛ Janai ne Safat ɡe ja ba bwa so Basan harɛ ta.
13Ba lola bini, ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ laanee,
Maekel ne Mɛsolam ne Seeba ne Jorai ne Jakan ne Siia dɛ Iba. Ba lɔ nɛra banuanɛ.
14Dɛ ba ɛ Huri bibaa Abihel bibaala, Jaroa bibaa Huri ne Jaroa bibaa Gelead, ne Gelead bibaa Maekel ne Maekel bibaa Jesisai, ne Jesisai bibaa Jado, dɛ Jado bibaa ne Bus,
15ne Abdeɛl bibaa Ahi, o naa ɛ Guni la, onee ɛ nomonnyu dɛ chɔ ba nyoa.
16Dɛ Gad tena soɡe Gelead ne Basan harɛre ta ne bwɛɛre aa bara bwa, dɛ kondɛɛra dibɔra aa chɔa dɛ kaa dɛ do Sarɔn bwa.
17Ba chwerɛ ɡɛ naanar nɔ bwa sɔna, ɡɛ saŋ Juda Kooro Jotam aa di kora, ne Israel Kooro Jɛroboam waa teŋa nɛɛ aa di kora.
18Rubin ne Gad dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena lɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banaarɛ, lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl baa dɛ ba wona yo laa. Ba ɛ baala baa dɛ ba wona kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe, dɛɛ yo laa ne keri ne tori, dɛ dɔ laa yoi wejema. 19Ba kaa yo Haɡri ne Jetur ne Nafis dɛ Nɔdab tena bwa. 20Korowii cha ba dɛ ɡel ba pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ kpɔ Haɡri tena ne nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa do ba nɔn ta, dɛkalkɛ laa la ta la, ba wio no Korowii. 21Ba lawɛ Haɡri tena kondɛɛra bwa kaa. Nyoɡmare lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue, ne peera kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraanue, dɛ keeɡore kaɡboŋa anɛ. Ba lawɛ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa laa la ta, 22asɛ dɛ kpoo nɛra baa wara keri ne, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowiirii yoa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba. Ate, ba so harɛ la ta ka tel kɛŋɔ baa laɡ ba kaa harɛfale ta.
Manasɛ dea pera nɛra
23Manasɛ dea pera tena la warɔ, dɛ so le Basan harɛ ta, dɛ kpoŋe kaa Baal Hɛmɔn ne Senir, dɛ Hɛmɔn Bwejen ta.
24Nomonnyuune baa chɔ ba nyoo laanee, Efar ne Isi ne Eliel, ne Asriel ne Jeremia ne Hodavia dɛ Jadiel. Dɛ ba ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ ɛ banyoola dɛ berɛ dɔ sɔna kɛrɛdɛ.
25Kɛ dɛ ba waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la be, dɛ ɡelo kaa tomɛ nɛra Korowii aa doŋa ba siwi ta voɡare. 26Anomanta, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ ɡelɔ Asiiria koojen Pul baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Tiɡlat Pilesa ka yoo ba, dɛ lawɛ Rubin ne Gad dea, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera tena bwa laa ta kaa harɛfale ta. O kaa bane Hala ne Habɔ ne Hara dɛ Gosan Moo ta. Ba lɔ bela dɛ ba le fini.

Title: 1 WEBENA 6
Content:
Lewi dea tena
1Lewi bibaalaa,
Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
2Kohat ɡe bibaalaa,
Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
3Amram ɡe dɔ bibaala banɛ,
Arɔn ne Mosis, asɛ o bihaah beŋkpoŋ sɔne Miriam.
Arɔn ɡe bibaalaa,
Nadab ne Abihu ne Eliasa dɛ Itama.
4Eliasaa lolɛ Fenehas,
Fenehas ɡe lolɛ Abisua,
5Abisua ɡe lolɛ Buki,
Buki ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Usi,
6Usi ɡe lolɛ Serahia,
Serahia ɡe lolɛ Merayɔt.
7Merayɔt lolɛ Amaria,
Amaria lolɛ Ahitub,
8Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk,
Sadɔk lolɛ Ahimas,
9Ahimas lolɛ Asaria,
Asaria ɡe lolɛ Johanan.
10Johanan lolɛ Asaria, a ɡɛ Asaria nɔɔ fa di sɔfore Korowii Dea Kooro Solomɔn aa doa Jerusalam la.
11Asaria lolɛ Amaria,
Amaria ɡe lolɛ Ahitub,
12Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk,
Sadɔk ɡe lolɛ Salum,
13Salum lolɛ Hilkia,
Hilkia ɡe lolɛ Asaria,
14Asaria lolɛ Seraya,
Seraya ɡe lolɛ Jehosadak.
15Korowii ɡelɔ Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Jehosadak, ne Juda tena bane, ne Jerusalam tena bane laa ta kaa harɛfale ta.
Lewi naanar bane ɡe
16Lewi bibaalaa,
Gɛsɔn ne Kohat dɛ Merari.
17Gɛsɔn ɡe bibaalaa,
Libni ne Simee.
18Kohat ɡe bibaalaa,
Amram ne Isiha ne Hɛbrɔn dɛ Usiel.
19Merari ɡe bibaalaa,
Maali ne Musi.
Banɔɔ Lewi dea nomonome, ne ɡɛ ba mɛɛnanar aa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ,
20Gɛsɔn lolɛ Libni,
Libni lolɛ Jahat, Jahat ɡe lolɛ Sima, 21Sima lolɛ Joa, Joa lolɛ Ido, Ido lolɛ Sɛra, Sɛra ɡe lolɛ Jeaterai.
22Kenii Kohat naanar teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
Onee lolɛ Aminadab, Aminadab lolɛ Kora, Kora ɡe lolɛ Asir. 23O ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Ɛbeasaf, Ɛbeasaf ɡe lolɛ Asir. 24Asir ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Tahat, Tahat ɡe lolɛ Uriel. O ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Ussia, Ussia ɡe lolɛ Swaul.
25Bibaala banɛɛ Ɛlkana lolɛ.
Banee, Amasae ne Ahemɔt.
26Ahemɔt aa ira la o lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Sofai, o ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Nahat, 27Nahat lolɛ Eliab, Eliab lolɛ Jɛroham, o ɡe lolɛ Ɛlkana, Ɛlkana lolɛ Samoɛl.
28Samoɛl ɡe bibaalaa,
o binomoa sɔne Joel,
nɛɛte ɡe Abija.
29Merari ɡe lolɛ Maali,
Maali lolɛ Libni, Libni lolɛ Simee, Simee ɡe lolɛ Ussa. 30Ussa lolɛ Simia, Simia lolɛ Haɡia asɛ Haɡia ɡe lolɛ Asaya.
Korowii Dea hɛhɛla ne yelɡoola
31Baa kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ba Jerusalam bela baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii la, baala Kooro Devid aa lee ba ba chɔ yela nyoa laanee nɔ. 32Dɛ banee dɛɛ nyiŋi, baa ɡo yela Korowii Tɛnte Dea, waa ɛ o Dea Cheremibɔr bela, mɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn ba do Korowii Dea Jerusalam la. Ba ɛ ba toma ɡɛ baa lea cheɡ ba ŋɔ ba ɛa ta.
33Baala ba ne ba bibaala aa pea ɛ toma laanee nɔ.
Nɛra baa le Kohat tena bini laanee,
Joel bibaa Heman waa ɛ yelɡoɡoo, Samoɛl bibaa Joel, 34Ɛlkana bibaa Samoɛl, Jɛroham bibaa Ɛlkana, ne Eliel bibaa Jɛroham, dɛ Toa bibaa Eliel, 35ne Suf bibaa Toa, ne Ɛlkana bibaa Suf, ne Mahat bibaa Ɛlkana, dɛ Amasae bibaa Mahat, 36ne Ɛlkana bibaa Amasae, ne Joel bibaa Ɛlkana, ne Asaria bibaa Joel, dɛ Sefania bibaa Asaria 37ne Tahat bibaa Sefania, ne Asir bibaa Tahat, ne Ɛbeasaf bibaa Asi, dɛ Kora bibaa Ɛbeasaf, 38ne Isiha bibaa Kora, Kohat bibaa Isiha, ne Lewi bibaa Kohat, dɛ Jekɔb bibaa Lewi,
39ne Heman dɔŋ Asaf waa chao dɛɛ tomɛ,
ne Barakia bibaa Asaf, dɛ Simia bibaa Bɛrekea, 40ne Maekel bibaa Simia, ne Baaseya bibaa Maekel, dɛ Malkija bibaa Baaseya, 41ne Ɛtini bibaa Malkija, ne Sɛra bibaa Ɛtini, dɛ Adaya bibaa Sɛra, 42ne Etan bibaa Adaya, dɛ Sima bibaa Etan, dɛ Simee bibaa Sima, 43ne Jahat bibaa Simee, ne Gɛsɔn bibaa Jahat, dɛ Lewi bibaa Gɛsɔn,
44ne Merari tena baa jaa dɛ che o ɡal,
ne Kisi bibaa Etan, ne Abdi bibaa Kese, dɛ Maluk bibaa Abdi, 45ne Hasabia bibaa Maluk, ne Amasea bibaa Hasabia, dɛ Hilkia bibaa Amasea, 46ne Amsi bibaa Helkaya, ne Bani bibaa Amsi, dɛ Sɛma bibaa Bani, 47Maali bibaa Sɛma, ne Musi bibaa Maali, ne Merari bibaa Musi, dɛ Lewi bibaa Merari.
48Ba bala Lewi dea tena la nɔn taa ba kpɔ Korowii Tɛnte Dea bela baa dɛ tomɛ la toma aa kaa la do.
Arɔn naanar
49Arɔn ne o naanar ɡboo dɛ́ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ba kon baa dɛ fuh saraha o ta, dɛ́ kpɔ ane ɡe ba kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile o ta la ta. Banee dɛɛ ɛ Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela toma, dɛ́ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa Korowii be ó kpɔ kɛ ba, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis aa do ba la.
50Kenii Arɔn bibaala ne o naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ,
onee lolɛ Eliasa, Eliasa lolɛ Fenehas, Fenehas ɡe lolɛ Abisua, 51Abisua lolɛ Buki, Buki lolɛ Usi, Usi ɡe lolɛ Serahia, 52Serahia lolɛ Merayɔt, Mɛrayɔt lolɛ Amaria, Amaria lolɛ Ahitub, 53Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, Sadɔk ɡe lolɛ Ahimas.
Bela Lewi dea tena aa soɡa
54Harɛ baa kpɔa tɛ Arɔn naanar baa le Kohat dea laanee nɔ. Banee dɔ bɔr waa tɔ sie baa kpɔa tɛ Lewi dea tena o ɛ ba kon.
55Hɛbrɔn waa lɔ Juda harɛ ne o kondɛɛra dibɔra aa baro laanee ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba. 56Kɛ harɛpare ne bwɛɛre aa bar bwejen la, ba kpɔɔ tɛ Jefune bibaa Kaleb.
57Gɛɛ ba kpɔ Hɛbrɔn, o ɛ bwɛjen dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta dɛ́ dɔ o nyu, ne Lebna, ne Jatir dɛ Ɛstemoa, 58ne Hilen dɛ Debir, 59ne Asan ne Juta, dɛ Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa tɛ Arɔn naanar. 60Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡe, ba kpɔ Gebeɔn ne Geba ne Alemɛt ne Anatɔt dɛ a kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa jaa ba.
Bwɛɛre baa bɔna tɛ Kohat dea tena nɔ bwa lɔ fi dɛ atoro.
61Kohat dea naanar baa kaa la, bwɛɛre fii ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera tena be.
62Gɛsɔn naanar ɡe bini deenaa ta la, bwɛɛre fi dɛ atoroo ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba, dɛ le Isaaka ne Aasa ne Naftale dɛ Manasɛ dea pera waa lɔ Basan harɛ la be.
63Merari naanar deenaa ta ɡe, ba dɔ bwɛɛre fi dɛ anɛ, dɛ le Rubin ne Gad dɛ Sebulon deene tena be.
64Gɛɛ Israel tena tɛ Lewi dea tena bwɛɛre nɔ ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa ba so. 65Juda ne Simeon dɛ Bɛnjamen deene bwɛɛre baa tɔ sie kpɔ tɛɛ ba la, daa ba bil, dɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be mɔɔ.
66Ba tɛ Kohat dea bii la bane bwɛɛre ne a kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ le Efrem dea tena harɛ ta.
67Efrem dea tena harɛ waa ɛ deŋɡarere harɛ la, ba tɛɛ ba bwɛjen Sɛkem, dɛ nɛn kpo o dɔŋ aa, ó chwa ka so o ta dɛ dɔ o nyu, dɛ Gɛsa, 68ne Jokmeam dɛ Bɛt Hɔrɔn, 69ne Aejalɔn ne Gat Remɔn, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwaa ba kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
70Kohat dea tena kabora la ɡe, Israel tena tɛɛ ba bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ, Ana ne Beleam ne ba kondɛɛra dibɔra, dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera kon ta.
71Gɛsɔn tena ɡe bɔr baa dɔa laanee nɔ.
Dɛ le Manasɛ dea pera tena be harɛ ta la,
bwɛɛre baa dɔa laanee, Golan waa lɔ Basan harɛ ta ne Astarɔt, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa.
72Isaaka dea tena ɡe be
ba dɔ Kedes ne Daberat 73ne Ramɔt ne Anem, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa,
74Aasa dea tena ɡe be
ba dɔ Masal ne Abdɔn 75ne Hukok ne Rehob, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa,
76Naftale dea tena ɡe be
ba dɔ Kedes waa lɔ Galilia harɛ ta ne Hamɔn ne Kiriataim, dɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra bwa.
77Merari tena baa ɛ Lewi dea tena kabora ɡe bwɛɛre baa dɔa, dɛ le Sebulon dea tena be laanee nɔ.
Jokneam ne Kaata ne Rimono ne Tabɔ, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.
78Rubin dea tena ɡe be, bwɛɛre aa lɔ Jɔɔdan Moo baŋ, Jeriko wee leebɔr,
ba dɔ Bɛsa waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta ne Jaasa, 79ne Kedemɔt ne Mɛfaat, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.
80Asɛ Gad dea tena ɡe be,
ba dɔ Ramɔt waa lɔ Gelead harɛ ta ne Mahanaim 81ne Hɛsbɔn ne Jasa, dɛ ba kondɛɛre dibɔra bwa.

Title: 1 WEBENA 7
Content:
Isaaka dea tena
1Isaaka bibaalaa,
Tola ne Pua ne Jasub ne Simron. Ba lɔ bibaala banaarɛ.
2Tola ɡe bibaalaa,
Usi ne Refaya ne Jeriel ne Jamai ne Ibsam dɛ Samoɛl. Dɛ ba bwa ɛ nomonnyuune. Kooro Devid bere saŋ la, dɛ Tola naanar baa tela ne laa laŋa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ lafraanumɛl.
3Usi ɡe bibaalee,
Israhia.
Israhia ɡe bibaalaa,
Maekel ne Obadia ne Joel dɛ Isihia. Bii banue nɔ bwa ɛ koranar. 4Ba mo haahna warɛ, asɛ ba bibaala ɡe warɛ, anomanta, ba dɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banumɛl baa tela ne laa laŋa.
5Isaaka dea bibaala baa tela ne laa laŋa, ba kur ba dɛ́ le o dea bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanuatoro dɛ banuanɛ.
Bɛnjamen ne Dan naanar
6Bɛnjamen dɔ bibaala batoro,
banee, Bɛla ne Bɛka dɛ Jedial.
7Bɛla ɡe bibaalaa,
Ɛsbɔn ne Usi ne Usiel ne Jerimot dɛ Iri. Ba lɔ nɛra banue, dɛ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune. Ba baala baa tela ne laa laŋa ba kur ba lɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ dɛ fifraatoro nɛra banaarɛ.
8Bɛka ɡe bibaalaa,
Sɛmira ne Joas ne Eliesa ne Elionai ne Omri ne Jɛremɔt ne Abija ne Anatɔt dɛ Alemɛt. Ba bwa lɔ bibaala banuanaarɛ. 9Ba kure ba dea nomonnyuune, asɛ baala baa tela ne laa laŋa lɔ, nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ lafraanɛ.
10Jedial ɡe bibaalee,
Bilhan.
Bilhan ɡe bibaalaa,
Jeyus ne Bɛnjamen ne Ehud ne Kenaana ne Sɛtan ne Taases dɛ Ahisaha. 11Dɛ Jedial bibaala nɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune. Ba dɔ baala kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuanɛ lafraanɛ baa dɛ ba wona la laa.
12Ir naanaree Supi tena ne Hupi tena. Asɛ Hus tena ɡe ɛ Aha naanar.
Naftale naanar
13Naftale bibaalaa,
Jaseel ne Guni ne Jesa dɛ Silem. Bilha naanaree ba bwa.
Manasɛ naanar
14Manasɛ naanar ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ nɔ.
O ne Aram te waa ɛ o sɛno la lolɛ Asriel ne Makir, Makir ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Gelead. 15Makir mo haah tɛ Hupim, dɛ mo bɛl tɛ Supim ɡe. Dɛ Makir dɔ nimambie bɛl baa yerɔ Maaka.
O dɔ bibaa bɛl baa yerɔ Selofehad. Bihaahna ɡboo o te lolɛ.
16Makir haah Maaka lolɛ bibaala banɛ, bɛl sɔne Pɛres asɛ nɛɛte ɡe Sɛrɛs. Pɛres ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Ulam ne Rakem.
17Ulam ɡe bibaalee,
Bɛdan.
A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Gelead o mɛɛ aa ɛ Makir, o nabaa ɛ Manasɛ la naanar. 18Dɛ Gelead dɔ nimambie bɛl baa yerɔ Hamɔlɛkɛt. Onee lolɛ Esɔd ne Abeɛsa dɛ Maala.
19Sɛmeda bibaalaa,
Ahian ne Sɛkem ne Liki dɛ Aniam.
Efrem naanar
20Efrem ɡe bibaala ne o naanar wa.
Onee lolɛ Sutela, Sutela lolɛ Bɛrɛd, Bɛrɛd lolɛ Tahat, Tahat lolɛ Eleada, Eleada ir, dɛ lolɛ Tahat, 21Tahat lolɛ Sabad, Sabad ɡe lolɛ Sutela.
Efrem berɔ lolɛ bibaala bane ɡe baa yer ba Esa ne Elead. Esa ne Elead iro ŋɔ ba ka ŋwɛ Gat tena kondɛɛra, asɛ ba kpoo ba. 22Ba mɛɛ Efrem ɛ ba lwe biɡri, asɛ o lolanar ba larawe o bwara. 23A habɔɔ, o haah kpoŋe tea dɛ lolɛ bibaa dɛ pa o sɔn Bɛrea, dɛkalkɛ o ne o bibaala dɛ na wahala ba soɡa bini. 24Efrem dɔ bihaah baa yerɔ Seera. Seera vɔrɔwe Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ nyunduabɔr, ne Bɛt Hɔrɔn waa chɔ harɛbɔr dɛ Usen Seera.
25Efrem dɔ bie bɛl ɡe baa yerɔ Refa, asɛ o lolɛ Resɛf,
Resɛf lolɛ Tela, Tela ɡe lolɛ Tahan, 26Tahan lolɛ Ladan, Ladan lolɛ Amihud, Amihud ɡe lolɛ Elisama, 27Elisama lolɛ Nun, asɛ Nun ɡe lolɛ Josua.
28Ba harɛ baa dɔa dɛ so o ta le Bɛtel ne bwɛjeɡre aa baro, dɛ kpoŋe ka le Naaran wee leebɔr, ne Gɛsa ne bwɛɛre aa baro wee cholibɔr, ne Sɛkem ne bwɛɛre aa lɔ Aeja ŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛ a bwɛɛre aa baro bwa. 29Dɛ kpoŋe ka le Manasɛ dea jwɛh ta kaa Bɛt San ne Taanak ne Meɡido ne Dɔr, dɛ bwɛɛre aa bar bela bwa. Dɛ Jekɔb bibaa Josef naanaree sosoɡe a ɡɛ bwɛɛre nɔ ta.
Aasa naanar
30Aasa ɡe bibaalaa,
Imna ne Isva ne Isvi dɛ Bɛrea. Bihaah beŋkpoŋ waa ja ba nɛɛ sɔne Sera.
31Bɛrea ɡe bibaalaa,
Heba ne Malkeɛl, asɛ Malkeɛl ir dɛ lolɛ Birsait. A ɡɛ Malkeɛl nɔɔ vɔrɔwe bwɛjen bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Birsait.
32Heba ɡe bibaalaa,
Jaflɛt ne Soma dɛ Hotam. Ba nimambie sɔne Sua.
33Jaflɛt ɡe bibaalaa,
Pasak ne Bimhal dɛ Asvat.
34Soma ɡe bibaalaa,
Ahi ne Roɡa ne Huba, dɛ Aram.
35O nime Hɛlɛm ɡe bibaalaa,
Sofa ne Imna ne Sɛlɛs dɛ Amal.
36Sofa ɡe bibaalaa,
Suua ne Haanefa ne Sual ne Bɛre dɛ Imra 37ne Bɛsa ne Hod ne Sama ne Silsa ne Itran dɛ Beera.
38Jɛta ɡe bibaalaa,
Jefune ne Pispa dɛ Ara.
39Ula ɡe bibaalaa,
Ara ne Haneɛl dɛ Risia.
40Aasa naanaree a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa. Ba ɛ nomonnyuune ne banyoola, dɛ dɔ sɔna kohona. Ba baala baa kpeɡa ba kur ba bá won la laa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banumɛl.

Title: 1 WEBENA 8
Content:
Bɛnjamen naanar
1Bɛnjamen biloɡle la sɔne Bɛla,
Asbɛl teŋɛ nɛɛ, asɛ Ahara teŋɛ tooro, 2Nɔha teŋɛ naarɛ, asɛ Rafa teŋɛ nue.
3Bɛla ɡe bibaalaa,
Adaar ne Gɛra dɛ Abihud 4ne Abisua ne Naaman dɛ Ahoa 5ne Gɛra ne Sɛfofan dɛ Hiram.
6Ehud naanar baa ɛ nomonnyuune tɛ nɛra baa soɡe Geba, ba laɡ ba kaa harɛfale Manahat ta laanee,
7Naaman ne Ahija dɛ Gɛra bwa ɛ Ehud bibaala, asɛ Gɛra waa ɛ Usa ne Ahihud mɛɛ la tɔ ba sie.
8Saharaim baa vɛh o haahna Husim ne Baara, asɛ o berɛ mo hanfale baa dɛ yerɔ Hodes, dɛ lolɛ bibaala bane Moab harɛ ta. 9Bii o ne waa lol ba laanee, Jobab ne Sibia ne Mesa ne Malkam 10ne Jeyus ne Sakia dɛ Mirma. Dɛ a ɡɛ bibaala nɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune. 11O haah Husim lolɛ bibaala banɛ. Bɛl sɔne Abitub, nɛɛte ɡe Ɛl Paal.
12Ɛl Paal ɡe bibaalaa,
Iba ne Misam ne Sɛmɛd, onee vɔrɔwe Ono ne Lod bwɛɛre, dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara cheme bwa. 13Bɛrea ne Sema ba ɡe aa ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ chɔ nɛra bane baa soɡe bwɛjen Aejalɔn nyoa, dɛ berɛ doŋi Gat tena baa soɡe bela la.
14Ahio ne Sasak dɛ Jɛremɔt 15ne Sebadia ne Arad dɛ Ida 16ne Maekel ne Ispa dɛ Joha bwa ɛ Bɛrea naanar.
17Ɛl Paal naanaree, Sebadia ne Mɛsolam ne Hiski dɛ Heba, 18ne Ismerai ne Islia dɛ Jobab.
19Jakim ne Sikri dɛ Sabdi 20ne Elienai ne Siletai dɛ Eliel 21ne Adaya ne Bɛraya dɛ Simrat bwa ɛ Simee naanar.
22Asɛ Ispan ne Iba dɛ Eliel 23ne Abdɔn ne Sikri dɛ Hanan, 24ne Hanania ne Elam dɛ Antotija, 25ne Ifdeya dɛ Pɛnoɛl bwa ɛ Sasak ɡe naanar.
26Samserai ne Seharia dɛ Atalia, 27ne Jaaresia ne Elaeja dɛ Sikri bwa ɛ Jɛroham naanar.
28Banɔ bwa ɛ nomonnyuune ne koranar ba deremi, ba kur ba ba bwa so Jerusalam.
29Jeyɛl vɔrɔwe bwɛjen Gebeɔn dɛ so bela.
O haah sɔne Maaka. 30O binomoa sɔne Abdɔn. O bibaala baa jaa laanee, Sor ne Kes ne Baal ne Nɛr dɛ Nadab, 31ne Gedɔr ne Ahio dɛ Sɛka, 32dɛ Meklɔt o ɡe aa lolɛ Simea. Dɛ ba ɡe soɡo bɛne ba lolanar Jerusalam.
33Nɛr lolɛ Kes, Kes ɡe lolɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl lolɛ Jonatan ne Malki Sua ne Abinadab dɛ Ɛsbaal.
34Jonatan ɡe bibaalee,
Mɛreb Baal, o ɡe aa lolɛ Maeka.
35Maeka ɡe bibaalaa,
Petɔn ne Mɛlɛk ne Tarea dɛ Ahas.
36Ahas ɡee lolɛ Jehoada, Jehoada ɡe lolɛ Alemɛt ne Asmavɛt dɛ Simri, asɛ Simri ɡe lolɛ Mosa. 37Mosa ɡe ir, dɛ lolɛ Binia, Binia ɡe lolɛ Raafa, Raafa ɡe lolɛ Eleasa, asɛ Eleasa ɡe lolɛ Asɛl.
38Bibaala banumɛlee Asɛl ɡe lolɛ. Banee,
Asrikam ne Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia dɛ Hanan.
39O nime Esɛk ɡe bibaalaa,
Ulam, onee binomoa, Jeyus teŋɛ nɛɛ, Ɛlefɛlɛt ɡe teŋɛ tooro. 40Ulam bibaala waa lol ba ɛ banyoola dɛ jemɛ to ne yoi kɛrɛdɛ. Ba dɔ bibaala ne naanar taeh, ba lɔ nɛra lafa fifraanue.
Bɛnjamen naanaree ba nɔ bwa.

Title: 1 WEBENA 9
Content:
1Ba chwerɛ Israel tena bwa sɔna denaa ta do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
Nɛra baa soɡe Jerusalam
Juda tena wechɔɡa nomanta, ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛr ba deŋne. 2Nɛra baa tɔ sie dɛ berɛ ba so ba ɡbaɡba deremi ta ne ba bwɛɛre ta laanee, Israel tena la bini bane ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma.
3Banɔ la baa le Juda ne Bɛnjamen ne Efrem dɛ Manasɛ deene ta dɛ ba so Jerusalam laanee nɔ.
4Amihud bibaa Utai ne Omri bibaa Amihud, Imri bibaa Omri, asɛ Bani bibaa Imri, Bani ɛ Juda bibaa Pɛrɛs naa la.
5Silo tena baa jaa laanee,
Asaya, onee binomoa dɛ o bibaala.
6Sɛra te waa jaa laanee,
Jeyuwel.
Nɛra baa le Juda dea lɔ nɛra lafraanumɛl fifraanuanaarɛ.
7Bɛnjamen dea tena ɡee,
Mɛsolam bibaa Sallu, ne Hodavia bibaa Mɛsolam ne Hasenua bibaa Hodavia, 8ne Jɛroham bibaa Ibneya, ne Usi bibaa Ɛla, ne Mikri bibaa Usi, ne Sɛfatea bibaa Mɛsolam, ne Ruwɛl bibaa Sɛfatea, dɛ Ibnija bibaa Ruwɛl.
9Nɛra baa le Bɛnjamen dea ba chwerɛ ba sɔna bwa lɔ nɛra lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanue dɛ banumɛl. Dɛ ba ɛ nomonnyuune.
10Sɔfore ɡee,
Jedaya ne Jehoiarib dɛ Jakin,
11ne Hilkia bibaa Asaria, ne Mɛsolam bibaa Hilkia ne Sadɔk bibaa Mɛsolam, ne Merayɔt bibaa Sadɔk, ne Ahitub bibaa Merayɔt. Asaria, dɛ onee nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea la ta.
12Jɛroham bibaa Adaya, ne Pasur bibaa Jɛroham, ne Malkija bibaa Pasur, ne Adeɛl bibaa Maasai, ne Jasera bibaa Adeɛl ne Mɛsolam bibaa Jasera, ne Mɛselɛmet bibaa Mɛsolam, dɛ Ima bibaa Mɛselɛmet.
13Dɛ sɔfore baa ɛ nomonnyuune la bwa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋ lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl, dɛ dɔ wejema dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea.
14Lewi dea tena ɡee,
Hasub bibaa Sɛmaya, ne Asrikam bibaa Hasub dɛ Hasabia bibaa Asrikam, o ɛ Merari te, 15ne Bakbakaa, ne Hɛrɛs ne Galal, ne Mika bibaa Matania, ne Sikri bibaa Mika, dɛ Asaf bibaa Sikri, 16ne Sɛmaya bibaa Obadia, ne Galal bibaa Sɛmaya, ne Jedutun bibaa Galal, ne Asa bibaa Bɛrekea, dɛ Ɛlkana bibaa Asa, o fa soɡe Nɛtɔfa tena harɛ ta.
17Nɛra ba ɡe aa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee,
Salum ne Akub, ne Talmɔn ne Ahiman dɛ ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar. Asɛ Salum ɛ ba bwa nyu te 18dɛ so doonyoa bɛl nyoa baa yerɔ Kooro Doonyoa wee leebɔr. Dɛ banɔɔ dɛɛ daah bela Lewi dea tena aa soɡa la doonyoo a ɡɛ saŋ. 19Kore bibaa Salum waa ɛ Ɛbeasaf naa ne o bala baa le Kora dea, dɛ banee dɛɛ daah Korowii Dea la doonyoa ba naawa fa aa toma la. 20Wubwa la, dɛ Eliasa bibaa Fenehas nɛɛ Korowii ja wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la nɛ. 21Mɛselemea bibaa Sekaria ɡe fa dɛ daah Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr doonyoa bela.
22Nɛra baa lee ba baa daah doonyoo aa lɔ bela la bwa lɔ nɛra lafraanɛ dɛ fi dɛ banɛ. Ba chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ dɛ le ba bwɛɛre ta. Kooro Devid ne Samoɛl waa dɛ na chaahna laanee lee ba, dɛ kpɔ ba chɔ ba tomare nyoo, dɛ ŋɔ ba ɛa kasinteŋ ne. 23Ba ne ba naanar nɔn taa ba kpɔ Korowii Dea doonyoo la daahna do. 24Dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la lɔ baŋne anaarɛ la bwa ta. O wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr, ne weekaŋle nyunduabɔr dɛ weekaŋle harɛbɔr. Asɛ bɛlbwa dɔ ba nomoa. 25Bane ba lolanar le ba bwɛɛre ta, dɛ baa cha ba. Bane balɔ ba ɛ toma yawanyoa beŋkpoŋ aa, dɛ ba kaalɔ, asɛ bane ɡe ba. 26Kɛ nomonome banaarɛ baa ɛ Lewi dea tena dɛ chɔ doonyoo la nyoo la, ba nɔn taa ba kpɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini bela la do. 27Baa dɛ daah bela la nomanta, jwaana bwaa ba yon so dɛ bar, doonyoo la safoone do ba be ba kpɔ dɛɛ pila chɔɔ bɛlbwa.
28Ba bini bane chɔ laala baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma bela nyoa. Mɔɔ bá paa le kɛɛ dɛ́ paa baa jo dea la bini la, ba dɛ kura. 29Ba bini bane ɡe, Boɡoroŋ la bini kwaara ne laala aa kaa dɛ do bela la lɔ ba nɔn ta. Dɛ kwaane kɛŋɔ men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ, ne sen ne ɔleve no ne daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ konsɔɔhsoma. 30Kɛ konsɔɔhsoma la koora te, sɔfore la bini bane nɔn taa a do baa ɛ. 31Lewi dea te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Matitia, Kora te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Salum binomoaa, onee ba kpɔ paanoo baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ saraha wɔɔra do o nɔn ta. 32Kohat dea bibaala la bane ɡee dɛɛ ɛ paanoo baa dɛ dawa teebur ta Ona Tɔpera ta.
33Banɔ la baa ɛ yelɡoola ne Lewi nomonnyuune la soɡe deene la bini, ba ta ɡelɛ baa ɛ toma bɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ ba nɔn taa ba kpɔ bela toma ɛɛ do chɔɔ ne jwaana.
34Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ Lewi dea tena nomonnyuune ne koranar ba kur ba teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ, dɛ ba bwa soɡe Jerusalam.
Kooro Sɔɔl nabaala ne o naanar
35Dɛ Jeyɛl waa vɔrɔwe Gebeɔn la soɡe bwɛjen Gebeɔn.
O haah sɔne Maaka, 36O binomoa sɔne Abdɔn, banɔ la baa jaa laanee, Sor ne Kes ne Baal ne Nɛr dɛ Nadab, 37ne Gedɔr ne Ahio ne Sekaria dɛ Meklɔt. 38Meklɔt ɡe ir dɛ lolɛ Simiam. Ba ɡe soɡo bɛne ba lolanar Jerusalam.
39Nɛr ɡe bie sɔne Kes, Kes lolɛ Sɔɔl, Sɔɔl lolɛ Jonatan ne Malki Sua ne Abinadab dɛ Ɛsbaal.
40Jonatan ɡe bibaalaa,
Mɛreb Baal, asɛ o ɡe lolɛ Maeka.
41Maeka ɡe bibaalaa,
Petɔn ne Mɛlɛk ne Tarea dɛ Ahas.
42Ahas ɡee lolɛ Jaada, Jaada ɡe lolɛ Alemɛt ne Asmavɛt dɛ Simri. Asɛ Simri ɡe lolɛ Mosa. 43Mosa ɡee lolɛ Binia, Binia ɡe lolɛ Refaya, Refaya ɡe lolɛ Eleasa, asɛ Eleasa ɡe lolɛ Asɛl.
44Asɛl ɡe lolɛ bibaala banumɛl. Ba sɔnaa,
Asrikam ne Bokeru ne Ismael ne Searia ne Obadia dɛ Hanan.

Title: 1 WEBENA 10
Content:
Kooro Sɔɔl seo wa
1A kaa ba kɛ Filisti tena ne Israel tena cheme Gelboa Bwejen ta dɛ́ yo laa. Ba kpoo Israel tena ɡalɡa Gelboa Bwejen ta. 2Filisti tena la chwao ti Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro, Jonatan ne Abinadab dɛ Malki Sua sibeɡra ne dɛ kpoo o bibaala la. 3Laa la baa do kpeɡri tɛ Kooro Sɔɔl, asɛ o dɔma la bɛl ta hɛm yaɡɔ dɛ doo bol kohona.
4Asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ŋɔ o bonɔɔ waa dɛ che o dɔmkwaa la be ŋɔ, “Pamɛ he kere la dɛ́ ba tɔɡ mɛ kpo, ásɛ nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ nɔ, bɛ men ba kpo dɛ́ chɛɡ mɛ ja.”
Kɛ dɛ bonɔɔ la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛ ó ɛ ɡɛ, anomanta, Kooro Sɔɔl pamɛ o ɡbaɡba kere dɛ chole o ta. 5Bonɔɔ la aa naa kɛ Kooro Sɔɔl sewɔ la, o ɡe chole o kon ta dɛ sewɛ ja o nɛ. 6Gɛɛ a do Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro ne o dem tena bwa serewe, nomɛlbwa ta o luɡe ta leɛ ba di kora kpa.
7Israel tena baa soɡe Jesreel Fɛlembɔjen bini aa noa kɛŋɔ laa tena la bwa chwao, asɛ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala bwa ɡe serewe la, ba chwao ɡel ba bwɛɛre, asɛ Filisti tena la ba so a ta.
8Tɔ aa pera la, Filisti tena la laŋɔ dɛ ka pa laa tena baa kpoo ba la laala, asɛ dɛ na Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala batoro la kɛ baa serewa chɔ Gelboa Bwejen ta. 9Ba teŋe Kooro Sɔɔl nyu, dɛ pa o dɔmkwaa ja, dɛ tomɛ toroma Filisti harɛ la ta bwa ŋɔ bá ka bol amanesoma nɔ ba voɡa deene ne nɛra bwa be. 10Ba kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl dɔmkwaa la ka bil ba voɡare deene bini, dɛ kpɔ o nyu saɡɛ ba voɡ Daɡɔn dea.
11Bwɛjen Jabes waa lɔ Gelead harɛ tena la aa noa ɡɛ Filisti tena la aa ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl la, 12ba bini banyoola laŋɔ ka kpɔ Kooro Sɔɔl ne o bibaala baa kpoo ba, dɛ ba ba ne Jabes. Ba huɡ ba dajen bɛl mun bela, dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa tɔpera anuanɛ.
13Kooro Sɔɔl kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe dɛ tɛ Korowii waa o sewɛ. O ta Korowii waa ta teŋɛ, hale dɛ ka bɔɔ dɛɛ le nɛn waa dɛ yerɛ lala be, ó baɡlo waa waa ɛ, 14dɛ vɛh Korowii nɛɛ teŋa. A waa Korowii kpoo, dɛ berɛ kora la tɛ Jese bibaa Devid.

Title: 1 WEBENA 11
Content:
Devid di kora Israel ne Juda harɛ
1Israel tena bwa ba Devid be Hɛbrɔn dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya bwa ɛ he lolanar dɛ ɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ. 2Kooro Sɔɔl fa aa ɛ ya kooro la, dɛ henee tɔ ya Israel tena sie dɛɛ la ya ne laa. Asɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la ŋɔ he be ŋɔ, ‘Henee dɛ́ nyiŋi n nɛra Israel tena nɛɛ kɛŋɔ peteɡre ken, dɛ́ ɛ ba kooro.’ ”
3Anomanta, Israel nomonome la bwa ba Devid be Hɛbrɔn, o ne ba fɔwɛ fɔo Korowii sie bela, asɛ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ ta, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ Samoɛl nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Kooro Devid yo Jerusalam tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ
4Kooro Devid ne Israel tena bwa kpɔ ba te kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ba fa dɛ yerɔ Jebus, dɛ ka yo Jebus tena baa soɡe bela, 5Jebus tena la ŋɔ Kooro Devid be ŋɔ, “Haa won ba ya be bonɔ.” Kɛ ane a bwa, o yoo dɛ lɛ Jerusalam, asɛ baa yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ne o danjwɛkpeɡ.
6Dɛ Kooro Devid fa bolɔ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa waa tɔ laa sie dɛ́ ka yo Jebus tena la, onee dɛ́ ɛ nomoa dɛɛ tɔ laa tena sie.” Joab o nya aa ɛ Seruya laanee wona ir dɛ tɔ ba sie la ba be, asɛ ba kpɔ laa sitɔɔ la tɛo.
7Belaa Kooro Devid ka so Jerusalam baa ma danjwɛɛ baro la ta. Gɛɛ a do baa yerɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen. 8O berɔ kwaa ma deene bar danjwɛɛ la. Deŋɡare la wee leebɔr pera harɛ waa baro la taa, ba che bwea su bɔɔ la mɔɔ, o le bela dɛ mao, asɛ Joab ba kwaa ma o kar. 9Kooro Devid teŋɔ di kpeɡri kohona, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Nemenɛ Korowii ja o nɛ.
Kooro Devid banyoola baa dɔ sɔna
10Kooro Devid banyoola ne Israel tena bwa baa chao o won di kora, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡ ba nyoa, o kora che kiŋkiŋ laanee teŋa nɔ. 11Banyoo waa ɛ banyoola batoro la bwa nomoa laanee Hakmɔn te Jasobeam.
Onee kpɔ o lampea yo baala lafraatoro, dɛ kpoo ba laa bɛl ta la.
12Nɛɛte waa ja banyoola batoro la nɛɛ ɡee Dodai bibaa Eliasa, o le Aho dea. 13Dɛ o ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ o ka yo Filisti tena, Pas Damim. Dɛ mea koo bɛl chɔ bela, asɛ ba chwa le Filisti tena la be. 14Kɛ o ne o laa tena lɔ bambile che koo la baah ta, dɛ yo Filisti tena la. Korowii ɡelɔ o kpoo ba kɛrɛdɛ awola.
15Awola bɛl, laa nomonome la bini fifraatoro la bini batoro ba Kooro Devid be, Adulam bwebɔɔ la ta. Dɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe boa ba nyoa, dɛ cheme Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini. 16A ɡɛ saŋ dɛ Kooro Devid soɡe bela baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro deŋɡare bɛl doa, asɛ Filisti laa tena ɡe do Bɛtlɛham. 17Nyɔɡre dɛ kpo Kooro Devid, asɛ o ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin nomɛl fe aa kaa dɔ nee kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen la ta ba tɛ mɛ ń nyɔ!” 18Anomanta, banyoola batoro la kpɔ bansua jo harɛ Filisti laa tena la aa soɡe o ta la ta, dɛ ka dɔ nee le kɔlɔŋ waa chɔa bɛne Bɛtlɛham doonyojen bini la ba tɛ Kooro Devid. Kɛ o vɛh nee la nyɔe, dɛ fuɡe ta harɛ tɛ Korowii. 19Asɛ o ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ la ane bojaŋ kɛŋɔ ń nyɔ nee nɔ. Aa ɛo kɛŋɔ maa dɛ nyɔ baala baa ta ba nyu, dɛ won la ka dɔ nee nɔ ba tɛ mɛ nɔ chal.” Anomanta, o vɛh nee la nyɔe. Waa banyoola batoro la aa ɛa laanee la.
20Ate, Joab nime Abisae, onee fa chɔ nomonome batoro, ba ɡe aa ɛ banyoola la nyoa. O kpɔ lampea ka yo baala lafraatoro dɛ kpoo ba. Gɛ taa a che o lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la. 21A lole kɛ dɛ baa on kure dɛɛ ja banyoola batoro la nɛ, kɛ onee bera ba chɔ ba bwa nyoa dɛ lɛ sɔn kohona.
22Dɛ Jehoiada bibaa Bɛnaya ɛ nɛn waa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ le bwɛjen Kabseel ta, o ɡe ɛ wejena kɛrɛdɛ. Onee wona kpo Moab baala banɛ baa won yoi kɛrɛdɛ la. O berɔ jo bɔɔ bini, awola bɛl, dɛ dombwea leero dɛ ka kpo nyujente. 23O berɔ kpo Ijipt te bɛl ɡe, dɛ o kpeɡo kɛrɛdɛ, o jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale anuanɛ ne tamaa. A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ Ijipt te la kpoŋe lampeajen, kɛ Bɛnaya kpɔ o ɡuli la o be sibeɡra ne, dɛ ka to o lampea le o nɔn ta, dɛ kpɔ kpoo. 24Waa Bɛnaya aa ɛa laanee la. O ɡe lɛ sɔn kɛŋɔ banyoola batoro la ken. 25Ba tɛo duure kohona ɡwaa banyoola fifraatoro la bini bɛlbwa, kɛ ba ta on kpɔe ja banyoola batoro la nɛ. Asɛ Kooro Devid ɡel o chɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahno la nyoa.
26Banyoola bane ɡe ba jaa laanee,
Joab nime Asahɛl,
ne Dodo waa le Bɛtlɛham bibaa Ɛlhanan,
27ne Samɔt waa le Harɔd,
ne Hɛlɛs waa le Pɛlɔn,
28ne Ikes waa le Tekoa bibaa Ira,
ne Abeɛsa waa le Anatɔt,
29ne Sibekai waa le Husa,
ne Ilai waa le Aho dea,
30ne Maharai waa le Nɛtɔfa,
ne Hɛlɛd, o mɛɛ sɔne Baana dɛ le Nɛtɔfa,
31ne Itai o mɛɛ aa ɛ Ribai waa le Gebea, dɛ do Bɛnjamen dea,
ne Bɛnaya waa le Peratɔn,
32ne Hurai waa le Gaas Fɛlembɔjena bɔr,
ne Abiel waa le Aaba,
33ne Asmavɛt waa le Baharum,
ne Eliaba waa le Saalbɔn,
34ne Hasem waa le Gesɔn bibaala,
ne Jonatan, o mɛɛ sɔne Saɡee dɛ le Harar,
35ne Ahiam, o mɛɛ sɔne Saka dɛ le Harar,
ne Ur bibaa Elifal,
36ne Hɛfa waa le Mɛkera,
ne Ahija waa le Pɛlɔn,
37ne Hesro waa le Kaamɛl,
ne Ɛsbae bibaa Naarai,
38ne Joel, o nime sɔne Netan,
ne Haɡri bibaa Mibhar,
39ne Amɔn te baa dɛ yerɔ Sɛlɛk,
ne Naharai waa le Bɛrɔt, onee dɛɛ che Seruya bibaa Joab dɔmkwa,
40ne Ira waa le Itri,
ne Gareb o ɡe aa le Itri,
41ne Uria waa ɛ Hiti te,
ne Alae bibaa Sabad,
42ne Sisa bibaa Adina waa le Rubin dea, dɛ o ɛ Rubin dea kooro asɛ nɛra fifraatoro bane ja o nɛ,
43ne Maaka bibaa Hanan,
ne Josafat waa le Mitan,
44ne Usia waa le Astɛra,
ne Jeyɛl ne Sama, ba mɛɛ sɔne Hotam dɛ le Arowa,
45ne Simri bibaa Jedial,
dɛ o nime Joha waa le Tis
46ne Eliel waa le Mahava,
ne Jɛrebai dɛ Josavia, baa ɛ Ɛlnaam bibaala,
ne Itma waa le Moab,
47ne Eliel ne Ɔbɛd, dɛ Jaaseɛl waa le Mɛsoba.

Title: 1 WEBENA 12
Content:
Banyoola bane baa kaa teŋɛ Kooro Devid nɛ
1A balɔ kɛŋɔ Kooro Devid chwao le Kooro Sɔɔl be dɛ ka so Siklaɡ. Waa lɔ bela la, banyoola bane la o be bela, dɛ ba ja laa tena baa chao yo laa la nɛ. 2Ba kpoŋe tori, dɛ jemɛ ane yoi kɛrɛdɛ, kɛɛ dɛ won vamtor bwea tae diɡ ne ɡal bwa. Ba le Kooro Sɔɔl luɡe ta, dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea.
3Ba sitɔɔla sɔne Ahiesa ne Joas, ba mɛɛ Sɛmaa, o le Gebea. Laa tena baa jaa la ɡee, Asmavɛt bibaala Jesial ne Pɛlɛt, ne Bɛraka dɛ Jehu waa le Anatɔt, 4ne Ismaya waa le Gebeɔn. O ja banyoola fifraatoro la nɛɛ dɛ ɛ ba sitɔɔla la bini bɛl, ne Jeremia ne Jehaseɛl ne Johanan dɛ Josabad waa le Gɛdɛra, 5ne Elusai ne Jerimot ne Bealia ne Sɛmaria dɛ Sɛfatea, waa le Haruf, 6ne Ɛlkana ne Isihia ne Aasarɛl ne Joesa dɛ Jasobeam baa le Kora dea, 7ne Joela ne Sebadia baa ɛ Jɛroham waa le Gedɔr bibaala.
8Baala bane le Gad dea dɛ ba ja Kooro Devid laa tena la nɛɛ dekpeɡ la ta pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bobɛl. Ba ɛ banyoola baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo laa ne lampeare. Ba siebɔra do ɔma kɛŋɔ nyujentena ken, dɛ do ɡbaŋre kɛŋɔ kweɡli aa lɔ bwejena dor.
9Ba sitɔɔ sɔne Esa,
Obadia teŋɛ nɛɛ, Eliab teŋɛ tooro,
10Mismana teŋɛ naarɛ, Jeremia teŋɛ nue.
11Atai teŋɛ numɛl, Eliel teŋɛ nuanɛ.
12Johanan teŋɛ nuatoro, Ɛlsabad teŋɛ nuanaarɛ.
13Jeremia teŋɛ fi, Makbanai teŋɛ fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
14Gɛ nɛra baa le Gad dea nɔ bwa ɛ laa sitɔɔla, bane chɔ laa tena lafa nyoa, bane ɡe chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋ nyoa. 15Banee ɡale Jɔɔdan Moo, korobiloɡle ta ɡɛ saŋ waa sua kohona, dɛ doŋi nɛra baa soɡe fɛlembɔjena bini, wee leebɔr ne wee cholibɔr ba bwa peɡre la.
16Awola bɛl, laa tena bane le Bɛnjamen ne Juda deene ta ɡe, dɛ la Kooro Devid be bela waa soɡa o dekpeɡ la bini. 17Asɛ Kooro Devid ir ka chem ba dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ deŋnesɔɔhna nee hɛɛ ba n be dɛ́ ba cha mɛ naa, n sɛoh kɛŋɔ ya nyoa pɛ. Kɛ dɛ he balɔ, dɛ́ ba lee mɛ tɛ n dɔma maa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa lii nɔ tenaa, Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ laanee dɛ́ tɛr he deŋne.”
18Korowii Doma baa so Amasae waa baa ɛ banyoola fifraatoro sitɔɔ la nɛ, asɛ o ŋɔ,
“N naa Kooro Devid, henee dɔ yaa!
He ne nɛra baa dɛ chae bwa dɔ hɛɛra.
Korowii ɛɛ ja he nɛɛ.”
Anomanta, Kooro Devid lɛɛ ba dɛ ɡel ba ɛ o laa sitɔɔla.
19Manasɛ dea laa tena bane pere ba te, dɛ ba ja Kooro Devid nɛɛ ɡɛ saŋ o ne Filisti tena aa dɛ la ka yo Kooro Sɔɔl la. Kɛ o ne o laa tena ta Filisti tena la chae. Dɛ Filisti koranar la dɛ ɔmɛ kɛŋɔ wɛɛ le ba habɔɔ dɛ́ berɛ kaa o nomoa Sɔɔl be. Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ o berɛ ba Siklaɡ. 20Devid aa dɛ ba Siklaɡ la, Manasɛ dea laa tena pere ba te, dɛ ba ja o nɛ. Banee, Adna ne Josabad ne Jedial ne Maekel ne Josabad ne Elihu dɛ Siletai. Dɛ banee Manasɛ dea laa sitɔɔla, dɛ chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo. 21Banee cha Kooro Devid wɛɛ yo nɛra laa, dɛ yon lɔ ka tɔ nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ pa ba laala, dɛkalkɛ ba bwa ɛ banyoola, dɛ ɛ o laa sitɔɔla. 22Tɔpere bɛlbwaa nɛra yon baa ja Kooro Devid laa tena nɛ, a ta biɡre o laa tena warɛ, dɛ do kpeɡri kohona.
Kooro Devid laa tena
23Laa tena baa kpɔ ba te dɛ ba Kooro Devid be Hɛbrɔn, dɛ́ ba yo Kooro Sɔɔl, dɛ́ lɛ o kora tɛo ɡɛ Korowii aa bola laanee teŋa nɔ.
24Juda dea laa tena baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe, ne lampeare lɔ kaɡboŋa banumɛl lafraanuatoro,
25Simeon dea banyoola baa kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ba yo laa lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ dɛ lafa,
26Lewi dea laa tena ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa banaarɛ lafraanumɛl, 27ne Jehoiada waa ɛ Arɔn dem nomoa. O kpoŋe laa tena kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanuanɛ, 28ne Sadɔk waa ɛ banyoo waa kpeɡa kohona, nomonome fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ le o dem dɛ ja o nɛ,
29ne Bɛnjamen dea laa tena, ba ɛ Kooro Sɔɔl lolanar. Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro, dɛ ba fa teŋɛ Kooro Sɔɔl nɛ, dɛ le o habɔɔ taraken,
30ne banyoola baa le Efrem dea, dɛ ba dɔ sɔna ba deene. Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ lafraanuatoro,
31ne Manasɛ dea pera tena baa lee ba cheɡ ŋɔ bá ba cheɡ Devid kora ta. Ba lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa fi dɛ banuatoro,
32ne Isaaka dea baala, banee dɛ wobɛlbwa ba Israel harɛ ta ɡɛ saŋ aa, ba yon tɔ a sie dɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ baa kpɔ a ta. Ba lɔ koranar lafraanɛ, ba lolanar bwa ja ba nɛ,
33ne Sebulon dea laa tena baa dɔ laa yoi wejema kpɔ ba te, dɛ kpoŋe dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi. Ba balɔ dɛ ba cha Devid bambile bwa ne, dɛ yo tɛo. Ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanue.
34Naftale dea ɡe laa nomonome lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋ, dɛ baala kaɡboŋa fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ, baa cheɡɛ kwaa baa kpɔ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta ne lampeare,
35ne Dan dea laa tena baa kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ba yo laa, ba lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro lafraanumɛl,
36ne Aasa dea laa tena baa dɔ laa yoi wejema, dɛ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ ba bá yo laa. Ba lɔ baala kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ,
37ne Rubin ne Gad deene, dɛ Manasɛ dea pera laa tena baa le Jɔɔdan Moo wee leebɔr baa kpoŋe dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi. Ba ɡe lɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ.
38Gɛ laa tena nɔ bwa kpɔ ba te, dɛ ba Hɛbrɔn sibeɡra ne kɛŋɔ, bá ba cheɡ Devid kora Israel harɛ ta. Dɛ Israel tena la kar bwa dɔ liire beŋkpoŋ kɛŋɔ, Devid ɛ kooro Israel harɛ. 39Laa tena la di Devid be bela tɔpera atoro, dɛ di kwaa dɛɛ nyɔ sen ba bala Israel tena aa ɛa ba tɛɛ ba la. 40Deene ane kɛŋɔ Isaaka ne Sebulon, dɛ Naftale deene tena ɡe le bojaŋa, dɛ kpɔ nyoɡmare ne keeɡore ne nabala aa cheɡɛ kondikwa ne men aa kpera kɛrɛdɛ, ne fiɡ daa nɔna aa hola nɔn del, ne daa nɔna ane ɡe aa hola nɔn del, ne sen dɛ ɔleve no. Ba kpɔ nae ne peera aa wara ba ba kpo di, dɛkalkɛ silɛɛ tentenee ba Israel harɛ ta bwa.

Title: 1 WEBENA 13
Content:
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka kpɔe le Kereat Jearim
1Kooro Devid ne o laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo chemo dɛ kpɔ liire. 2Asɛ o ŋɔ Israel tena bwa be ŋɔ, “Dɛ a ɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la nyina, ya sɛh ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin ta naa, yá tomɛ toroma ya bala baa kaa ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bobɛlbwa be, ásɛ ya bwa cheme. 3Ásɛ ya la ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba bonɔ, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Sɔɔl bere saŋee yaa wola o waa bɔɔrɛ.” 4Israel tena baa cheme bela la bwa sɛh a ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a wer dɛ tɛ ba bwa.
5Anomanta, Israel tena bwa baa cheme Kooro Devid sie, le Ijipt harɛ jwɛh ta Sehɔ Moo ta ba le Lebo Hamat, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Kiriat Jearim ba Jerusalam. 6O ne Israel tena la iro le bwɛjen Baala baa bera dɛɛ yerɔ Kiriat Jearim waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le bela dɛ kaa Jerusalam. Nemenɛ Korowii sɔn dawɛ Daka la ta, asɛ o so o kookara ta, kena kwaa baa dɛ yera Kerobim la baah ta.
7Ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la le Abinadab dem, dɛ kpɔ chɔŋɛ torɔɡofale bɛl ta nae ɛɛ tɛɡro. Asɛ Ussa ne Ahio ɛɛ baɡla bela aa kpɔ. 8Dɛ Kooro Devid ne Israel tena la bwa dɛ lɛ ba sie. Ba ɡo yela silɛɛ ne kohona, dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne kalipere, ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛɛ yiiɡi loŋa ɡe Korowii sie.
9Ba valɔ ba tel Kedɔn tena mea lɔ bɔr, asɛ nabala aa dɛ tɛɡre Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la lɔ na, asɛ Ussa ta lawɛ Daka la kpoŋe. 10Korowii baah di Ussa nɛɛ dɛ kpoo buɡ la ta, dɛkalkɛ o kpɔ nɔn lawɛ Daka la. Anomanta, Korowii sie belaa o sewɛ.
11Belaa Kooro Devid ɡe baah di, ɡɛ Korowii baah aa di Ussa nɛɛ dɛ tɛr o deŋne la wa. Anomanta, dɛ ba le fini, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Pɛrɛs Ussa.
12Kooro Devid ɔmɛ Korowii awola tɔpere dɛ ŋɔ, “Dɛ n kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka nɔ ba n be bonɔ naa, ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona nyiŋi o ta nɔ?” 13Dɛ waa berɛ dɛɛ nyin o ba Daka la ne o be Jerusalam kpa. O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ ba cheɡ Ɔbɛd Edom dem, o le bwɛjen Gat. 14Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡɛ Ɔbɛd Edom dem korobie atoro, asɛ Korowii swee o ne o dem tena ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa andɛɛɡa.

Title: 1 WEBENA 14
Content:
Waa Kooro Devid aa ɛa Jerusalam
1Bwɛjen Taaya Kooro Hiram tomɛ nɛra Kooro Devid be ba kpɔ peleme daa ne kapenta tena, dɛ nɛra baa dɔ bwea kpɔe dɛ́ ma dea wejema, bá ma koodem tɛ Kooro Devid. 2Kooro Devid jemɔ kɛŋɔ, Korowiirii cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ bwa, dɛ ɡel o dɔ kpeɡri o harɛ do wer kohona, o nɛra Israel tena wa.
3Kooro Devid mo haahna warɛ Jerusalam bela, dɛ lolɛ bibaala ne bihaahna kohona. 4Bii baa lola tɛo bela laanee Samoa ne Sobab ne Netan dɛ Solomɔn, 5ne Ibha ne Elisua dɛ Ɛlpɛlɛt, 6ne Nɔɡa ne Nɛfɛɡ dɛ Jafia, 7ne Elisama ne Beeliada dɛ Ɛlefɛlɛt.
Kooro Devid yo Filisti tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ
8Filisti tena aa noa kɛŋɔ ba fuɡe noo do Devid nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta Israel harɛ bwa ta la, ba laa tena bwa iro, dɛ kaa nyin o bɔr sibeɡra ne, asɛ Kooro Devid ɡe no ba wa, dɛ le ka chem ba. 9Dɛ Filisti tena la balɔ ba lɔ tɔ Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini dɛɛ kah kwa. 10Belaa Kooro Devid ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, ń la ka yo Filisti tena nɔ naa? Hɛɛ kpɔ baa do n nɔn ta kɛɛ?”
Asɛ Korowii chaŋo ŋɔ, “Ir kaa, mɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn ta, ásɛ he pɔ ba nɛ.”
11Anomanta, Kooro Devid iro, dɛ ka yoo ba Baal Pɛrasem dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. Dɛ ŋɔ, “Gɛ nee yon su ba tɔ bobɛlbwa la, ɡɛɛ Korowii ba tɔ n dɔma nɛɛ n sie.” Anomanta, ba dɛ yerɛ bela Baal Pɛrasem. 12Filisti tena chwao ɡel ba voɡare bela, asɛ Kooro Devid tɛ o nɛra ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ ba fuah.
13Filisti tena la balɔ ba lɔ tɔ Refaim Fɛlembɔjen bini ja dɛɛ kah kwa, 14asɛ Kooro Devid ka bɔɔ le Korowii be ja, asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ berɛ sie pae dɛ́ kaa ba be. Hé bar ba ka che ba habɔɔ, dɛ́ yoo ba daa ane baa dɛ yera balsam sie bela. 15Hé ba dɛ no ba naɡime sii daa la dor aa, hé pa mun dɛɛ yo, a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ men Korowiirii baa tɔ he sie, dɛ́ ka yo Filisti tena la dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.” 16Gɛɛ Kooro Devid ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa doo bwa ta, dɛ won doŋi Filisti tena le Gebeɔn ba Gɛsa.
17Kooro Devid sɔn le harɛre bwa ta, asɛ Korowii ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa ɛɛ ɔmɔ.

Title: 1 WEBENA 15
Content:
Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka ne Jerusalam bala
1Kooro Devid aa do deene o ɡbabir aa so a bini Jerusalam waa ɛ o Bwɛjen ta tonɛ la, o kwaa bobɛl dɛ baŋre tɛnte dea ba kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la cheɡ o bini. 2Ate, Kooro Devid ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ che Daka nɔ ka ja Lewi dea tena nɛ, dɛkalkɛ banee Korowii le ŋɔ baa cheo, dɛɛ tomɔ o sie saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
3Anomanta, o yerɛ Israel tena bwa Jerusalam ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ bɔr waa kwaara la bini. 4O berɔ yerɛ Arɔn naanar ne Lewi dea tena naanar bwa ɡe ja.
5Kohat naanar bini,
Uriel, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafa fifraanɛ nyoa,
6Merari naanar bini,
Asaya, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanɛ nyoa,
7Gɛsɔn naanar bini,
Joel, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafa fifraatoro nyoa,
8Elisafan naanar bini,
Sɛmaya, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafraanɛ nyoa,
9Hɛbrɔn naanar bini,
Eliel, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra fifraanuatoro nyoa,
10Usiel naanar bini,
Aminadab, o ɛ ba nyu te dɛ chɔ nɛra lafa dɛ fi dɛ banɛ nyoa.
11Belaa Kooro Devid yerɛ Sadɔk ne Abiata baa ɛ sɔfore la, ne Uriel ne Asaya ne Joel, ne Sɛmaya ne Eliel, dɛ Aminadab baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la cheme. 12Dɛ ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, “Heyaa ɛ nomonnyuune, dɛ chɔ Lewi deene nyoo, hé ne he bala Lewi dea tena chɛ kɛ he sɔ he doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera, ásɛ dɛ won ka kpɔ Korowii ya Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ bɔr maa kwaara tɛ ŋɔ ó ba che la. 13He Lewi dea tena aa wola toole loɡla dɛ́ cheo la waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ baah di ya nɛ. Ya ta on bɔɔrɛ dɛ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ yaa kpɔ o ta cheo.”
14Anomanta, sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena la sɔ ba doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera, dɛ ka kpɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba. 15Daa Lewi dea tena kpɔ su Daka la keŋkeŋni, dɛ dawa ba vaama ta cheo, ɡɛ Korowii aa cheɡɛ o nyoa wobol ta do Mosis la.
16Kooro Devid ŋɔ Lewi dea nomonome la be ŋɔ, bá le ba bini bane, bá ɡo silɛɛ yela dɛɛ lɔ janjelare, ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ.
17Anomanta, Lewi dea tena le Joel bibaa Heman le o nimanar bini, ne Bɛrekea bibaa Asaf ɡe le Merari tena bini, ne Kusaya bibaa Etan, 18banɔ la baa cha ba laanee, Sekaria ne Jaasiel ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehiel ne Uni, ne Eliab ne Bɛnaya ne Maaseya ne Matitia, ne Elifɛlɛhu ne Mekneya ne Ɔbɛd Edom, dɛ Jeyɛl baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea bela.
19Yelɡoola ɡee, Heman ne Asaf dɛ Etan, banee dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa, 20asɛ Sekaria ne Aseɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehiel, ne Uni ne Eliab ne Maaseya dɛ Bɛnaya, banee chɛ kɛ baa lɔ janjelare ɡɛ aa chɛa, 21ásɛ Matitia ne Elifɛlɛhu ne Mekneya, ne Ɔbɛd Edom ne Jeyɛl, dɛ Asasia ɡee dɛɛ lɔ janjelare, dɛ́ nyiŋi ɡɛ baa dɛ lɔa ta. 22Kenania waa ɛ Lewi dea nomonnyu la, dɛ o dɔ yela ɡoe wejema anomanta, ba leo o chɔ yelɡoola nyoa.
23Bɛrekea ne Ɛlkana ɡee ba le baa daah Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la. 24Sebania ne Josafat ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Amasae ne Sekaria ne Bɛnaya, dɛ Eliesa baa ɛ sɔfore laanee, dɛ́ tɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie dɛɛ hoh bɛle. Ɔbɛd Edom ne Jehia ɡe ja dɛɛ daah Daka la.
25Anomanta, Kooro Devid ne Israel nomonome, dɛ laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo, la Ɔbɛd Edom dem silɛɛ ne, dɛ ka kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba. 26Gɛ aa ɛ ásɛ Korowii cha Lewi dea tena, ásɛ ba won che Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la nomanta, ba kpoo nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii. 27Dɛ Kooro Devid do batakaarejaŋ baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyarɔ, ɡɛɛ Lewi dea tena baa cheɡɛ Daka la ne yelɡoola la, ne Kenania waa chɔ yelɡoola nyoa la ɡe do ane. Dɛ Kooro Devid berɔ do sɔfo batakaarebora efɔd baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe nyarɔ. 28Gɛɛ Israel tena bwa kpɔ silɛɛ lɔŋɔre teŋɛ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la nɛɛ ba Jerusalam. Dɛɛ hoh pebal nyeɡle bɛle, ne bɛle tenten ne kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ janjelare dɛɛ lɔ yela.
29Baa kpɔ Korowii Fɔo Daka la dɛɛ jo Jerusalam Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta la, Kooro Sɔɔl bihaah Mikal, aa cheɡɛ tokoro ta dɛ na Kooro Devid o sa dɛɛ hɛɡre la, o sie ta o nɛɛ lɛɛ, dɛ nyiŋu vah.

Title: 1 WEBENA 16
Content:
1Israel tena la kpɔ Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la ba cheɡ tɛnte dea Kooro Devid aa baŋro la bini, asɛ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare ba Korowii sie bela. 2Kooro Devid aa kpoo kwaa dɛ fuh ɛ sarahare, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare tonɛ la, o soŋe andɛɛɡa Nemenɛ Korowii be tɛ nɛra la. 3Belaa o kpɔ paanoo ne daa nɔna ane aa hola dɛ ɛ nɔndel, dɛ ɡrepo daa nɔna aa hola nɔndel tɛ Israel haah ne baa te bɛlbwa.
4O berɔ le Lewi dea tena la bane ba baa ɛ toma Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie, dɛ baa soŋe dɛɛ jam, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la. 5Asaf ɛ ba nyu te, Sekaria teŋɛ, ne Jeyɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehiel ne Matitia, ne Eliab ne Bɛnaya ne Ɔbɛd Edom, dɛ Jeyɛl ɡe ja. Banee dɛɛ lɔ janjela ne anɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ bwa. Asaf ɡee dɛɛ lɔ kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, 6asɛ Bɛnaya ne Jahaseɛl baa ɛ sɔfore la, ɡe ɛɛ hoh bɛle la tɔpere bɛlbwa, Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Daka la sie.
Kooro Devid kpɛɛra yel
7Le awola tɔpere laanee Kooro Devid kpɔ do Asaf ne o nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ nɔn ta ŋɔ, bá ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii.
8Hé jam Korowii,
dɛ́ yerɛ o sɔn,
hé ɡel harɛre nɛra bwa
jemɛ waa waa ɛa.
9Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro, dɛ́ bol
o nyokpowe-ɛɛla wa.
10Hé ɡel he sie lɛ o sɔn
waa do ɡoroŋ la ta,
nɛra haa dɛ tomɔ,
hé ɡel he sie lɛ.
11Hɛ́ɛ soŋe Korowii
dɛ́ na o kpeɡri,
dɛ́ɛ tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa.
12Hé lii o nyokpowaa waa ɛa,
o wejena ne o waa
aa dɔ kasinteŋ la wa,
13O bonɔɔ Jekɔb naanar,
Jekɔb bibaala waa lee ba
cheɡ tɛ o te.
14Onee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ,
o bol harɛ nɔ ta nɛra
waa dɛɛ pa bole.
15Wɛɛ lii o fɔo la
waa saŋ bɛlbwaa,
o nyoa waa baɡɛ naanar
kaɡboŋa baa ka ba la bwa.
16Fɔo o ne ya naa Abraham
aa fɔwa, ne nyoa
waa baɡɛ Aesek la.
17Korowii ne Jekɔb fɔwɛ fɔo,
o do le saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
18O ŋɔ, “He ne he naanaree
mɛɛ ba Keenan harɛ
kpɔe tɛ,
ó ɛ he kapɛrɛ kon.”
19Gɛ saŋ dɛ Korowii
nɛra aa kanɛ, dɛ ɛ hɔɔhra
do Keenan harɛ ta,
20dɛ harɛre taa ba do
dɛɛ ɡaaɡe,
ba le harɛ bɛl ta naa,
dɛ ba kaa bɛl ta.
21Kɛ Korowii ta ɡelɛ
nomɛlbwa fiɡ ba,
ba lɛɛ nomanta,
o kah koranar ŋɔ,
22“Nomɛlbwa bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡe
n bonɔɔna maa lee ba cheɡ
tɛ n te nɔ,
he bɛ n keamere nɔ bini
bɛlbwa ha.”
23Hé ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii!
Harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa,
hé ɡo yela kpɛɛro!
Hé bol o lɛɛ waa dɛ lɛ nɛra
tɔpere bɛlbwa wa.
24Hé bol o jirima
waa baɡle harɛre nɛra,
dɛ́ bol o nyokpowe-ɛɛla
waa baɡle nɛra bwa.
25Korowii kan,
a chɛ kɛ ya kpɛɛro kohona,
onee chɛ kɛ ya kpɔ duure
tɛ dɛ ɡwaa voɡa.
26Harɛre bwa voɡare ɛ konsale,
kɛ Korowiirii ta nyundua.
27O kan dɛ dɔ jirima kohona,
kpeɡri ne jirima su o Dea.
28Nɛra haa lɔ harɛ ta bwa,
hé kpɛɛ Korowii.
Hé kpɛɛro, o jirima ne kpeɡri
waa dɔa wa.
29Hé kpɛɛ Korowii
