Gɛɛ a do Israel tena pa mun ɛo deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ bwa kaa ba deremi. 17Kɛ Israel tena baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta la te, dɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam dɛ di kora ba nɛ.
18Belaa Kooro Rɛhoboam tomɛ Adoniram, waa chɔ tomkpeɡa ɛɛ nyoa ŋɔ ó la Israel tena be. Asɛ ba bwa foɡro bwea kpo. Kooro Rɛhoboam dɔ warane, dɛ jo o torɔɡo bini, dɛ chwa ka sɔh Jerusalam. 19Le a ɡɛ saŋee Israel tena baa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr ɛ Kooro Devid dem tena deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ pere ba te le ba nɛɛ dɛ ba le fini.

Title: 2 WEBENA 11
Content:
1Kooro Rɛhoboam aa tel Jerusalam la, o boa Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene tena baala baa jemɛ yoi nyoa nɛra kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro ŋɔ, bá ka yo Israel deene aa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ásɛ o won di kora harɛ la bwa ta.
2Dɛ Korowii bol o keame Sɛmaya be ŋɔ, 3“Ŋɔ Kooro Solomɔn bie Kooro Rɛhoboam, Juda dea kooro la, ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene tena nɛra baa jaa la be ŋɔ, 4‘He bɛ he bala Israel tena la ka pu yo. Bɛlbwa berɛ kaa o dem, menee ɛa ɡɛ.’ ” Ate ba no, ba ta Jɛroboam ka yoi kpa, dɛ bwa berɛ kaa ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔa la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam danjwɛkpeɡa mae dɛ bar bwɛjena
5Kooro Rɛhoboam soɡe Jerusalam dɛ ɡel ba ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene bwɛjena aa teŋa nɔ. 6Bɛtlɛham ne Etam dɛ Tekoa, 7ne Bɛt Sor ne Soko dɛ Adulam, 8ne Gat ne Maresa dɛ Sif, 9ne Adoraim ne Lakes dɛ Aseka 10ne Sora ne Aejalɔn dɛ Hɛbrɔn. Dɛ anɔɔ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta. 11O ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar bwɛjena la a do kpeɡri, dɛ kpɔ laa sitɔɔla chɔ a nyoa dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwa ne ɔleve noo dɛ sen, 12ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta ne lampeare. Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ lɛ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛ ba do o lɔɡa.
13Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa lɔ Israel harɛ weekaŋle nyundua bwa ta balɔ, dɛ ba teŋɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam nɛ. 14Lewi dea tena la ɡel harɛre aa ɛ ba kondɛɛra dibɔra dɛ ir ka so Juda ne Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ne o bibaala ta sɛɛh kɛŋɔ bá ɛ Korowii sɔfore. 15Kooro Jɛroboam le o ɡbaɡba kerekpoŋra ba so voɡa ta, dɛɛ tomɛ daabii ne nabali, dɛ voɡa waa sɛah la. 16Nɛra baa le Israel deene bwa bini dɛ le ba bambile bini ŋɔ, baa tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la teŋɛ Lewi dea tena nɛɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ba kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii ba naawa aa toma. 17Ba cheɡɛ o habɔɔ dɛ ɡel Juda kora la che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ cha Kooro Solomɔn bibaa Kooro Rɛhoboam bene atoro, ɡɛ baa ɛa Kooro Devid ne Kooro Solomɔn saŋ la.
Kooro Rɛhoboam haahna ne bii
18Kooro Rɛhoboam mo haah, o sɔne Mahalat. O mɛɛ sɔne Jerimot. Jerimot mɛɛ sɔne Devid, asɛ Jerimot nya ɡe ɛ Abihel. Abihel ɡe nya sɔne Eliab. Abihel nabaa sɔne Jese. 19Bibaala batoroo ba lolɛ. Banee Jeyus ne Sɛmaria dɛ Saham. 20Kooro Rɛhoboam berɔ mo Absalɔm bihaah Maaka. Asɛ o lolɛ bibaala, Abija ne Atai ne Sesa dɛ Sɛlomet. 21Dɛ Kooro Rɛhoboam dɛ nyin Absalɔm bihaah Maaka dɛ ɡwaa o haahna ne o sɛnanar bwa. Dɛ o haahna lɔ fi dɛ banuatoro, asɛ o sɛnanar ɡe lɔ fifraanumɛl. O bibaala lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro, asɛ bihaahna ɡe lɔ fifraanumɛl.
22Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ o ne o haah Maaka bibaa Abija ɛ o bibaala la bwa nomoa, dɛɛ nyin ó cheɡo kora ta. 23Kooro Rɛhoboam ɛ wejemwa, dɛ kpɔ o bibaala la bɛlbwa ka so Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la ta. O ta tea, dɛ tɛɛ ba ba konnyina kohona, dɛ mo haahna ɡe tɛɛ ba warɛ.

Title: 2 WEBENA 12
Content:
Ijipt Kooro Sisak kaa yo Jerusalam tena
1Kooro Rɛhoboam kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ la, o ne Israel tena bwa vɛh Korowii Mmarare ta teŋa. 2Kooro Rɛhoboam aa di kora bene anue ta la, Ijipt harɛ Kooro Sisak baa yo Jerusalam tena, ba deŋnekpeɡ baa ɛa dɛ vɛh Korowii la wa. 3O kpɔ kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ, ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta kaɡboŋa fifraanumɛl, dɛ laa tena baa wola won kur ba, le Lebya ne Itiopia ne Suk tena ja o nɛɛ le Ijipt harɛ. 4Ba yoo lɛ Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara, hale dɛ ba tel Jerusalam.
5Ate, Korowii keame Sɛmaya ba Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Juda nomonome baa kaa cheme Jerusalam la be, Kooro Sisak ɔma wa. Asɛ Korowii keame Sɛmaya ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘He vɛɛh mɛ, anomanta, taraken n ɡe vɛh heyaa tɛ Kooro Sisak.’ ”
6Ate, kooro ne Israel nomonome sɛh kɛŋɔ ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ ŋɔ, “Korowii waa waa ɛa wer.”
7Korowii aa na ba wechɔɡa baa ɛa la, o ŋɔ o keame Sɛmaya be ja ŋɔ, “Ba sɛh ba chɔɡre nomanta, maa ban chɔɡ kpa. Kɛ dɛ Kooro Sisak baa yoo ba aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo ba le a nyoa. Maa ɡel a che Kooro Sisak nɛɛ Jerusalam tena nyɔ n danana ne. 8Kooro Sisak ɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ bá do o lɔɡa, ásɛ ba na ɡɛ n toma aa korɛ harɛre koranar toma ta.”
9Ijipt Kooro Sisak aa baa yo Jerusalam tena la, o pa kwaa aa lɔ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem bwa kaa. Dɛ berɛ pa kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta Kooro Solomɔn aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa la. 10Anomanta, Kooro Rɛhoboam kpɔ ayaawa ɛ ane chiɡ suuɡaswɛm kwaa la naa ta, dɛ kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ so koodem la doonyoa dɛɛ daah bela la nomonome nɔn ta, ŋɔ báa nyiŋi a ta. 11Saŋ bɛlbwa kooro aa la Korowii Dea la, nɛra baa dɛ daah bela yon kpɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta la kpoŋe, ásɛ a habɔɔ ba yon kpɔ ka cheɡ dea baa dɛ cheɡa o bini la ta.
12Kooro Rɛhoboam aa pwɛr o te tɛ Korowii nomanta, Korowii bandia le o nɛ, o ta on chɔɡɛ kwaraa kpa. Kasinteŋ, dɛ wobɛlbwa pa mun dɛɛ do wer Juda harɛ ta tama tama.
13Kooro Rɛhoboam di bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ mɔɔ dɛ di kora. O kora cheɡɔ kiŋkiŋ, o so Jerusalam Korowii aa lea cheɡ Israel harɛre bwa bini ŋɔ, baa tomɔ bela la, dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anuanɛ. O nya sɔne Naama, Amɔn tee. 14Kooro Rɛhoboam ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta o bambile bwa kpɔe tɛ Korowii.
15Kooro Rɛhoboam kora dii le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ne o haahna ne bii wa, ba chwera do Korowii keamere Sɛmaya ne Ido waa dɛ na chaahna waa tɔne bini. Dɛ yoi chɔ Kooro Rɛhoboam ne Kooro Jɛroboam baah ta saŋ bɛlbwa. 16Kooro Rɛhoboam sewɔ, asɛ ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Abija chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 13
Content:
Juda Kooro Abija
1Kooro Jɛroboam aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa Abija di kora Juda harɛ ta. 2Kooro Abija di kora Jerusalam bene atoro. Uriel waa le bwɛjen Gebea bihaah Maaka biee Kooro Abija.
Aa ba dɛ la sie la, laa chole Kooro Jɛroboam ne Kooro Abija baah. 3Kooro Abija kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kaɡboŋa lafraanaarɛ, asɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɡe kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kaɡboŋa lafraanuatoro, ba ka cheme dɔŋa.
4Kooro Abija ne o laa tena la kaa che Semaraem Bwejen waa lɔ Efrem deŋɡare harɛ ta dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ ŋɔ, “Kooro Jɛroboam ne Israel tena, hé no n be! 5Haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la cheɡɛ fɔo waa chɔ le waa wola chɔɡ ta dɛ kpɔ Israel kora tɛ Kooro Devid ne o naanar saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la kɛɛ? 6Kɛ Nɛbat bibaa Jɛroboam fa aa wola kooro ɛɛ mɔɔ la, o ɛ o dɔɔ Kooro Solomɔn deŋnekpeɡ dɛ pere o te le o nɛ. 7A habɔɔ, nɛnsale bane boa ba nyoa, dɛ ba ja o nɛ, dɛ vuuɡi Kooro Rɛhoboam, ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o nɔn ta kao waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ, dɛ puu ba yo.
8Taraken he dɛ nyin kɛ he yo Korowii Kora waa kpɔa do Kooro Devid naanar nɔn ta la. He laa tena warɔ dɛ berɛ dɔ nabali Kooro Jɛroboam aa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa, a ɛ voɡa haa dɛ toma. 9He laa doŋi Korowii sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ berɛ le nɛra bane so ba buɡ ta, ɡɛ harɛre ane nɛra aa ɛa la aa? Nomɛlbwa ɛɛ won kpɔ nabale kɛɛ peera anuanɛ ba ŋɔ bá sɔ o doŋa ta, dɛ́ ɛo kerekpoŋri kwaa haa dɛ yera he voɡa la ta.
10Ya te, Korowiirii yaa tomɛ, ya ta on vɛɛh. Arɔn naanar ɛ sɔfore dɛɛ ɛ Korowii toma, asɛ Lewi dea tena ɡe ɛɛ cha ba. 11Chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra bwaa ba kpɔ saraha kwaa ba baa fuh, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛ Korowii. Ba kpɔ paanoo dɛɛ dawɛ teebur waa do ɡoroŋ doŋa bɛlbwa aa wola toole o ta, dɛ choŋi kandere aa lɔ kandea daa baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛo jɔmɔra bɛlbwa. Ya dɛ ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa do yaa, kɛ he te vɛoh. 12Korowii ja ya nɛ, onee ya sitɔɔ. O sɔfore ɛɛ hoh laa bɛlee yerɛ yaa yá ba yo heya. Israel tena, he bɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ yo, haa won pɔ o nɛ.”
13Dɛ Kooro Jɛroboam ɡelɔ o laa tena la bane bar Juda laa tena la dɛ do habɔɔ, asɛ ba bini bane ɡe do ba sie. 14Juda tena laa tena nao kɛŋɔ Israel laa tena la bar ba cheme, belaa ba do lɔŋɔ yerɛ Korowii. Asɛ sɔfore la hoh bɛle, 15asɛ Juda laa tena la do laa lɔŋɔ, asɛ Kooro Abija tɔ ba sie ba ka yoo ba. Korowii ɡelɔ ba pɔ Kooro Jɛroboam ne Israel tena nɛ. 16Israel laa tena chwao le Juda tena la be, asɛ Korowii kpɔ ba do Juda tena nɔn ta. 17Kooro Abija ne o laa tena kpoo Israel laa tena baa jemɛ yoi taeh, laa tena dɛ ɛ kaɡboŋa lafraanue. 18Gɛɛ Juda tena pɔ Israel tena nɛ, dɛ sɔɔh ba nyoa, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ ba te dawɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ nɛ.
19Kooro Abija ti Kooro Jɛroboam laa tena, dɛ ka lɛ ba bwɛjena Bɛtel ne Jesana dɛ Efron, ne a bwɛjeɡre aa bara cheme bwa. 20Kooro Jɛroboam ta berɛ dɔ kpeɡri Kooro Abija bere saŋ kpa. Korowii tɛr o deŋne asɛ o sewɛ.
21Kɛ Kooro Abija te teŋɔ di kpeɡri kohona. O mo haahna fi dɛ banaarɛ, bibaala lɔ fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ dɛ bihaahna ɡe fi dɛ banumɛl.
22Waane ɡe Kooro Abija aa ɛa dɛ bol o kora dii ta la, ba chwera do Korowii keame Ido bwara waa tɔn bini.

Title: 2 WEBENA 14
Content:
1Kooro Abija sewɔ ba huɡo o naawa huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Asa chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora. Kooro Asa bere saŋ la, deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ harɛ la ta bene fi.
Juda Kooro Asa pɔ Itiopia tena nɛ
2Kooro Asa ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre, Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la be. 3O le harɛre ane kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta, ne bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa deŋɡarere ta bwa ne. O paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ta. 4O do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ, baa ɛ waa Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin, dɛɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare ne o webaɡla ta. 5O chɔɡ bela baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa, ne kwaa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma a ta bwa Juda harɛ bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta, asɛ deŋnesɔɔhna do harɛ la ta o bere saŋ. 6O bere saŋ, o ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar Juda harɛ bwɛjena, dɛ laa toole harɛ la ta kpa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii tɛo deŋnesɔɔhna.
7Kooro Asa ŋɔ Juda tena be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ma danjwɛkpeɡa bar bwɛjena nɔ, dɛ́ ma dejaŋa dɛ́ do bune a nyoo, dɛɛ kaɡra bune ne. Harɛ la ɛ ya kon. Yaa ɛ waa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la aa dɛ nyin la waa o ɡel ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna la.” Anomanta, ba ɛ ɡɛ asɛ a do wer tɛɛ ba.
8Dɛ Kooro Asa dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro Juda dea ba kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta anjena ne lampeare. Dɛ berɛ dɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro baa kpoŋe kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe anjeɡre laa ta, ne tori le Bɛnjamen dea. Dɛ ba bwa ɛ banyoola kɛrɛdɛ!
9Sɛra waa le Itiopia kpɔ laa tena baa wara kohona, ne kwaa aa do kɛ torɔɡore lafraatoro dɛ ba bwɛjen Maresa. 10Ate, Kooro Asa le, dɛ ka puu yo, bɛlbwa ne o laa tena cheɡɛ ba chebɔra Sɛfata Fɛlembɔjen bini, o bɛne Maresa.
11Asɛ Kooro Asa yerɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ dɛ ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won cha nɛra baa wola kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe, bá won ka yo nɛra baa kpeɡa kɛ hen. N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, cha yaa, he nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya te dawɛ. He sɔn taa ya ba, dɛɛ ba ba yo laa tena baa wara nɔ la. Bɛ ɡel nɛwɛnyini pɔ he nɛ.”
12Korowii cha Kooro Asa ne Juda laa tena, asɛ ba pɔ Itiopia tena la nɛ. Ba chwao, 13asɛ Kooro Asa ne o laa tena ti ba ka tel Gerar. Korowii ɡelɔ ba kpoo Itiopia laa tena la warɛ, ba kar ta wone yo kpa, asɛ ba pa ba laala. 14Ate, ba chɔɡ bwɛjeɡre aa bar Gerar la bwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ɔmee kohona chole ba nɛ. Ba jo bwɛjeɡre la ta dɛ pa ba laala, dɛkalkɛ dɛ laala lɔ bela kɛrɛdɛ. 15Ba kaa yo nɛra bane ɡe baa dɛ nyiŋi boohna ne peera nɛ, bela baa soɡa, dɛ larawe boohna ne peera, dɛ nyoɡmare kohona dɛ laa berɛ ba Jerusalam.

Title: 2 WEBENA 15
Content:
Juda Kooro Asa voɡa chɔɡa o harɛ ta
1A habɔɔ la, Korowii Doma baa so Ɔdɛd bibaa Asaria nɛ, 2asɛ o le ka cheme Kooro Asa, dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa Kooro Asa ne Juda dɛ Bɛnjamen deene nɛra bwa, hé no n be. Dɛ Korowii waa lɔ he bambile ta naa, wɛɛ ja he nɛɛ. He dɛ nyin o bɔr aa, wɛɛ ɡeloo he nao, kɛ dɛ he berɛ habɔɔ kpoo waa, o ɡe ɛɛ vɛh heyaa. 3Israel tena soɡo la sie baa wola kasinteŋ Korowii tomɛ. Ba ta sɔfore dɔe bá baɡ ba wa, baa Korowii Mmara ɡe jemɛ. 4Kɛ wenaale aa ba ba nɛɛ la, ba ɡaaɡe Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la bɔr, asɛ o ɡel ba nao. 5A ɡɛ saŋ, dɛ a kpeɡri kɛŋɔ nɛn won dɛɛ ɡaaɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta, dɛkalkɛ wenaale ne wesaɡasaɡare lɔ Israel harɛ la ta. 6Harɛre nɛra yon dɛɛ yo dɔŋa, bwɛjena ɡe ɛɛ yo dɔŋa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ Korowiirii kpɔ wenaale baa ta ba nɛ harɛre la ta. 7Kɛ he Juda tena te, hé che kiŋkiŋ, dɛ bɛ ɡel he bwara hwah, hɛɛ dɔ he kembɔree le teŋa haa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ la ta.”
8Kooro Asa aa no Korowii waa Ɔdɛd bibaa Korowii keame Asaria aa bola la, a tɛo kpeɡri bɛl. O le voɡa aa ɛ kii kwaa la bwa ne, Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene harɛre ta, ne anɔ la aa lɔ bwɛjena bwa waa yoa dɛ pɔ a nɛra nɛɛ Efrem deŋɡarere ta la. O berɔ kwaa kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta o do Korowii Dea pato sie la.
9Nɛra warɔ le Efrem ne Manasɛ ne Simeon deene ta dɛ ba ja Kooro Asa nɛ, dɛ so o harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba nao kɛŋɔ Korowii ja o nɛ. Kooro Asa yerɛ ba bwa, ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene nɛra cheme.
10Ba cheme Jerusalam ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Asa aa di kora bene fi dɛ anue, korobie atoro ta. 11Awola tɔpere la, ba kpoo kwaa baa kpɔa le laa ta la ane ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii. Nae lɔ lafraanuanɛ, asɛ peera ne boohna ɡe kaɡboŋa anuanɛ. 12Juda tena la baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, baa tomɛ Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la ba bambile ne ba liire bwa nee. 13Nomɛlbwa, bechala kɛɛ nomoa, haah kɛɛ baa waa wola Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ la nɛɛ teŋɛ la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo. 14Ba do lɔŋɔ kohona dɛ hoh bɛle, ne pee nyeɡle bɛle, dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam baɡle Korowii ŋɔ, baa teŋɛ fɔo la taa. 15Juda tena la bwa sie lɛo dɛɛ hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋwɛɛ ntam bambile bwa ne. Ba nyin Korowii sibeɡra ne, asɛ dɛ nao. Anomanta, Korowii tɛɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna le ba dɔma nɔn ta.
16Kooro Asa ir o naa Maaka haŋkora ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ voɡ Asera daa aa ɛ kii kwaa la. Kooro Asa teŋni daa la, dɛ fuah Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen ta. 17A lole kɛŋɔ Kooro Asa ta bela voɡtoroma aa soɡa dɛɛ tomɛ ba voɡa bwa chɔɡɛ le Israel harɛ ta te, kɛ dɛ o bambile cheɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ o soɡa bini bwa. 18O kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne kwaa bwa o ne o mɛɛ aa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta la ba Korowii Dea.
19Dɛ laa toole kpa, dɛ ka tel Kooro Asa kora dii bene fifraatoro dɛ anue ta.

Title: 2 WEBENA 16
Content:
Israel Kooro Baasa kaa yo Juda Kooro Asa
1Kooro Asa aa di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl taa Israel Kooro Baasa kpɔ laa tena ka lɔ tɔ Juda Kooro Asa nɛ dɛ pɔ o nɛ, dɛ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjen Rama, ásɛ bɛlbwa bɛ won le Juda harɛ ta kaa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ba jo bela.
2Kooro Asa kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm cheɡ deene baa kpɔ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛɛ cheɡ a bini Korowii Dea la, ne anɔ la aa lɔ o koodem bela, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka tɛ Siiria Kooro Bɛn Hadad, dɛ o soɡe Damaskɔs waa ɛ harɛ la bwɛjen tenten ta dɛɛ di kora. 3Kooro Asa ŋɔ, “N dɛ nyin kɛ n ne he fɔwɛ fɔo, ɡɛ ya naawa fa aa ɛa la. N kpɔ koŋkɛɛla aa ɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, á ɛ fɔo dɛ́ chɔɡ he ne Israel Kooro Baasa fɔo la taraken, ásɛ o ne o laa tena le n harɛ nɔ ta kaa.”
4Kooro Bɛn Hadad no Kooro Asa be dɛ tomɛ o laa sitɔɔla ne ba laa tena ŋɔ, bá ka yo Israel harɛ bwɛɛre. Ba pɔ Ijon ne Dan dɛ Ebel Bɛt Maaka bwɛɛre, dɛ Naftale dea harɛ bwɛjena baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini bwa. 5Kooro Baasa aa no ɡɛ la, o ɡel danjwɛɛ mae dɛ bar Rama toma la a ka. 6Belaa Kooro Asa do Juda tena bwa ŋɔ bá la, dɛ́ ka che bwea ne daa Kooro Baasa aa kpɔa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ Rama la. Anee Kooro Asa kpɔ ma danjwɛkpeɡ bar bwɛjena Geba ne Mispa.
7A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keame Hanani ba Kooro Asa be dɛ ŋɔ, “Haa kpɔ he te dawɛ Siiria kooro nɛɛ dɛ vɛh he te kpɔe dɛ dawɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ nɛɛ nomanta, Siiria kooro laa tena la le he habɔɔ. 8Itiopia tena ne Lebya laa tena fa ta warɛ taeh dɛ dɔ kwaa aa do kɛŋɔ torɔɡore, ne nɛra baa dɛ so jaɡre ta naa? Kɛ haa kpɔ he te dawɛ Korowii nɛɛ la, o ɡelɔ he pɔ ba nɛ aa?” 9Korowii sie lɔ harɛ nɔ ta bwa, wɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra ba wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛo, dɛ tɛɛ ba kpeɡri. He ɛ ɡɛnewa, le fini dɛɛ kaa, laa ɡboo hɛɛ ba dɛɛ yoi.
10Kooro Asa baah di Korowii keame Hanani nɛɛ kohona, asɛ dɛ lawɔ do dea. Dɛ berɛ le ɡɛ saŋ dɛɛ kaa la, Kooro Asa pa mun dɛɛ ɛ nɛra la bane hɔhɔrɔwa kohona.
Kooro Asa kora dii jaɡa
11Kooro Asa aa di kora le mumpar kaa a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Juda Koranar ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔn bini. 12Kooro Asa aa di kora dɛ dɔ bene fifraatoro dɛ anuanaarɛ la, o we nakpaweela ane soo siwi. A lole kɛŋɔ weela la baa do kpeɡri, kɛ o ta Korowii soŋɛ ŋɔ ó chao, dɛ tɛɡre tena ɡbo bee wɛɛ la. 13O kora dii bene fifraanaarɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ ta la, o sewɔ, 14asɛ ba huɡo Kooro Devid Bwɛjen Jerusalam, bwe bɛl waa komɔ kɛŋɔ dea o ɛ o ɡbaɡba huɡribɔr bini. Ba kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma ne nosɔɔhsoma fɔɡlo dɛ huɡo. Nɛra warɔ cheme dɛ mar nijena a fuh, a baɡle jirima baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o seo la wa.

Title: 2 WEBENA 17
Content:
Juda Kooro Jehosafat
1Kooro Asa bibaa Jehosafat chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora. O nyiŋo dɛ ɡel o laa tena do kpeɡri Israel tena nɛ. 2O kpɔ laa tena ka so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa, ne bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛ bwɛjena a fa aa lɔ Kooro Asa lɔɡa Efrem harɛ ta bwa.
3Dɛ Korowii ja Kooro Jehosafat nɛ, dɛkalkɛ o teŋɛ waa o nabaa Kooro Devid fa aa ɛa la ta. O ta voɡ Baalre tomɛ. 4O tomɛ Korowii o mɛɛ aa toma la, dɛ teŋɛ waa waa doo ta. O ta waa Israel koranar aa ɛa ta teŋɛ. 5Korowii ɡelɔ o kora che kiŋkiŋ Juda harɛ, asɛ nɛra la bwa kpɔ koŋkɛɛla baa tɛo, a che a ta o dɔ kondɔɔh ne duure kohona. 6O bambile lawɛ Korowii toma kohona, asɛ dɛ chɔɡ bɔra voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
7Kooro Jehosafat aa di kora bene atoro ta la, o tomɛ o nomonome ŋɔ bá baɡle Korowii waa Juda harɛ bwɛjena ne bwɛjeɡre bwa ta. Banee, Bɛn Hael ne Obadia ne Sekaria ne Nɛtanɛl dɛ Mikaya. 8Dɛ Lewi dea tena banuanaarɛ ne sɔfore banɛ ja ba nɛ. Lewi dea tena laanee, Sɛmaya ne Nɛtanea ne Sebadia, ne Asahɛl ne Sɛmeramɔt ne Jehonatan, ne Adonija ne Tobija dɛ Tob Adonija. Asɛ sɔfore la ɡee, Elisama ne Jehoram. 9Ba iro kpɔ Korowii Mmara Tɔn la, dɛ ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛre bwa ta, dɛɛ baɡle o bini waa nɛra be.
10Korowii kpɔ ɔmee ta harɛre aa bar Juda la nɛ kɛŋɔ, bá la ka yo Kooro Jehosafat laa. 11Filisti tena bane kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa ne suuɡapoŋa ba kɛo, Arab tena ɡe ba tɛo peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanuanɛ, dɛ boohna kaɡboŋa anuanɛ lafraanuanɛ.
12Gɛ taa a che Kooro Jehosafat pa mun dɛɛ do kpeɡri kohona. O ma dekpeɡa aa jaŋa ne deene baa cheɡ kondikwaa a bini bwɛjena Juda harɛ ta, 13dɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta. O berɔ kpɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi kɛrɛdɛ ba so Jerusalam. 14Gɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna lolanar bini laanee teŋa nɔ,
Dɛ le Juda dea, laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa nyoo laanee nɔ.
Adna waa ɛ laa sitɔɔ, on chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro nyoa.
15Nɛɛte sɔne Jehohanan, o ɛ sitɔɔ dɛ chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro nyoa.
16Toorotee Sikri bie Amasia, o ɡbabir le o te tɛ Korowii toma, o chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ nyoa.
17Dɛ le Bɛnjamen dea ɡe,
Eliada waa jemɛ yoi kohona, o chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ baa kpoŋe tori ne hɛma, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe dɛɛ yo laa nyoa.
18Nɛɛte sɔne Jehosabad, o ɡe chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanuatoro baa kpɔ ba te, dɛ́ ka yo laa nyoa.
19A ɡɛ nɛra nɔɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Kooro Jehosafat Jerusalam. Ba ta banɔ la waa kpɔ ba so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara la nɛɛ jae.

Title: 2 WEBENA 18
Content:
Korowii keame Mikaya jae waa ja Kooro Ahab
1Kooro Jehosafat dɔ kondɔɔh, asɛ o sɔn ɡe le kohona. O cheɡɛ hahmor ta o ne Kooro Ahab kpɔ darame. 2Bene ane aa baa kaa habɔɔ la, Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Samaria, dɛ ka na Kooro Ahab. Kooro Ahab kpoo peera ne nae kohona tɛ Kooro Jehosafat, ne nɛra baa ja o nɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba jirima, dɛ soŋe Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, ó ja o nɛ, bá ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena. 3Asɛ Israel Kooro Ahab bɔɔ Juda Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ ja n nɛɛ yá ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena aa?”
Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N sɛh ɡɛ, n ne he bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ. N nɛra ɛ he nɛra, yaa ja he nɛɛ dɛ́ ka yo.” 4Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Gel ya soŋe le Korowii be mɔɔ.”
5Anomanta, Kooro Ahab yerɛ Korowii keamere lafraanaarɛ, dɛ kpɔ bil ba sie ŋɔ, “Ń ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ ń ɡel ɔ?”
Ba ŋɔ, “La ka yoo ba, Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ baa do he nɔn taa.”
6Ate, Kooro Jehosafat bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Amɔ Korowii keame bɛlbwa toole yá che o nɛɛ dɛ́ soŋe le Korowii be naa?”
7Anee Kooro Ahab chaŋe ŋɔ, “Korowii keame beŋkpoŋ bɛl lole. Onee Imla bibaa Mikaya. Kɛ n ne waa somɛ, dɛkalkɛ o ta wobɛlbwa nae le Korowii be dɛ tɛ mɛ a ɛ wedɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ bwa, atane wechɔɡa ɡbo.”
Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡɛ ŋɔ.”
8Asɛ Kooro Ahab yerɛ o nomonome la bini bɛl dɛ ŋɔ, “La ka kpɔ Imla bibaa Mikaya ba taraken.”
9Dɛ Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat do ba koolaala, dɛ so ba kookane ta, pɛla bɛl waa bɛne bwɛjen Samaria doonyoa, asɛ Korowii keamere la bwa che ba sie, dɛɛ bol waa baa naa ba be. 10Keamere la bini bɛlee, Kenaana bibaa Sedekia. O kpɔ bune ɛ kwaane a do kɛ nyeɡlare. O ŋɔ Kooro Ahab be ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ. ‘Kwaa nɔɔ hɛɛ ba kpɔe yo Siiria tena dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ.’ ”
11Dɛ ɡɛ tentenee keamere la bwa bol Korowii waa dɛɛ ŋɔ, “Ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena, hɛɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ. Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo he pɔ ba nɛ.”
12Torome waa laŋa ka ɡaaɡe Mikaya bɔr la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Korowii keamere la bwa nyoa pɛo ba bol ŋɔ kooro wobɛlbwa chiɡo kɛrɛdɛ. Sɛh dɛ́ ɡel he ne ba waa la ɛ beŋkpoŋ.”
13Anee Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛ Korowii waa lole kɛŋɔ, mɛɛ bol waa Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ŋɔa ń bol o bee.”
14Mikaya aa ba Kooro Ahab be la, kooro pɛɛro ŋɔ, “N ne n dɔŋ Kooro Jehosafat ka yo Ramɔt Gelead tena kɛɛ yá ɡel ɔ?”
Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé la ka yoo ba, Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo hé pɔ ba nɛ.”
15Asɛ Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Keraŋwɛnɛɛ ń ɡel he ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ hé bol kasinteŋ Korowii sɔn ta nɔ?”
16Mikaya ŋɔ, “N na Israel laa tena baa perɛ deŋɡarere ta kɛŋɔ peera aa wola teɡre dɔe ken. Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Ba ta sitɔɔ dɔe, ɡel bá berɛ kaa dem deŋnesɔɔhna ne.’ ”
17Belaa Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “N ta he be ŋɔe ŋɔ o ta wedɛɛɡa bolɛ n be bwa atane wechɔɡa ɡbo aa?”
18Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ teŋɛ dɛ ŋɔ, “No waa Korowii aa bola. N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii aa soɡe o kookara ta nyundua, o dɔm baa ja o nɛ dɛɛ tomɔ che baro. 19Ate, Korowii pɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee dɛ́ neɡre Kooro Ahab, ásɛ o la Ramɔt Gelead dɛ́ ka yoo ba, ásɛ ba kpoo bela ɔ?’
Korowii dɔm baa cheɡa baro nyundua la bwa waa koɡrɔ. Bane ŋɔ ken, bane ɡe ŋɔ ken. 20Ate, doma bɛl ba che Korowii sie dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ neɡroo.’
Asɛ Korowii chaŋe ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa hɛɛ ba kpɔe neɡro wɔ?’
21Asɛ doma la ŋɔ, ‘Mɛɛ ɡeloo Korowii keamere baa dɛ tomɛ Kooro Ahab neɡro.’
Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ, ‘Kaa dɛ́ ka ɛ ɡɛ.’ ”
22Korowii keame Mikaya berɛ ŋɔ, “Korowiirii ɡela he keamere la neɡre, o ɡbabirii bol he chɔɡa waa kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ hé sewɛ.”
23Ate, Kenaana bibaa Korowii keame Sedekia la, dɛ ka kpaa Korowii keame Mikaya lwɛɛma dɛ ŋɔ, “Saŋ besoo Korowii Doma ɡel mɛ dɛ ba bol wa he be bwa nɔ?”
24Korowii keame Mikaya chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hɛɛ naa, awola haa ŋɔ he ka jo dea bini ka sɔh la.”
25Belaa Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ o nomonome la bɛl be ŋɔ, “Lawɛ Korowii keame Mikaya kaa Amɔn waa dɛ nyiŋi bwɛjen nɔ ta, ne n bibaa Joas be, 26dɛ́ ka ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, n ŋɔ ba lawɔ do dea, dɛɛ tɛo paanoo ne nee ɡbo ka tel kɛŋɔ maa ba jo sɔnɔnɔɔ.”
27Korowii keame Mikaya ŋɔ, “Dɛ he baa jo sɔnɔnɔɔ naa, amɔ dɛ Korowii laa cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛ bol wa.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nomɛlbwa kpɔ waa nɔ do o nyu bini.”
Kooro Ahab kpoe Ramɔt Gelead
28Ate, Israel Kooro Ahab ne Juda Kooro Jehosafat la bwɛjen Ramɔt Gelead, dɛ ka yoo ba. 29Israel Kooro Ahab ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Mɛɛ beɡre n tenee dɛ́ ka ja laa tena nɔ nɛ, kɛ he te, do he koolaala.” Anomanta, Kooro Ahab beɡre o te, dɛ kaa laa la ta.
30Dɛ Siiria kooro do o laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi torɔɡore baa vɔwa pɛl jaɡre la be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nomɛlbwa ka yo ka ja Israel kooro ɡbo nɛ.” 31Laa sitɔɔla la aa na Kooro Jehosafat la, ba liiro ŋɔ Israel kooroo, asɛ ba laa berɛ ŋɔ bá ka yoo. Kɛ waa dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre la, Korowii chao dɛ ɡel ba laa berɛ kaa. 32Laa sitɔɔla la nao kɛŋɔ Israel kooro laa, anomanta, ba ɡel o nɛɛ teŋa.
33Siiria laa tena la bɛl ta hɛm o ka yaɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab kon waa kpɔa tɔ ɡbemɡbe la keŋkeŋ, asɛ dɛ ka yaɡɛ o bambinyoa, dɛ o laa saahna. Asɛ kooro la ŋɔ nɛn waa soɡe o torɔɡo baa vɔwa pɛl jaaɡɔ la be ŋɔ, “Ba do mɛ bol, le n ne laa nɔ ta.” 34Dɛ yoi la kpeɡri tɔpebir la bwa, asɛ ba lawɛ kooro la kpoŋe o so torɔɡo la bini, o sie chaɡɛ Siiria laa tena la. Jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ o sewɔ.

Title: 2 WEBENA 19
Content:
1A balɔ kɛŋɔ Juda Kooro Jehosafat berɔ ba o koodem Jerusalam deŋnesɔɔhna ta, 2asɛ Hanani bibaa Jehu waa ɛ Korowii keame la ka cheme Kooro Jehosafat dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé cha nyubinikpeɡ tena, ásɛ dɛɛ nyin nɛra baa hah Korowii aa? Gɛ nomanta, Korowii bandia ba he nɛ. 3Kɛ he ɛ wedɛɛɡa tama ane, dɛkalkɛ he teŋni voɡ Asera daa nɛra aa dɛ tomɛ le he harɛ ta, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin ta.”
Kooro Jehosafat le o nomonome
4Dɛ Kooro Jehosafat soɡe Jerusalam, kɛ o yon ir la harɛ la nɛra be, le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, ne Efrem deŋɡarere harɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, dɛ charɛ ba liire le Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la be. 5O le nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole bwɛjen bɛlbwa baa ma danjwɛkpeɡ baro Juda harɛ ta, 6dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé nyiŋi dɛ́ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta, nɛn kpeɡri ne laa, Korowii kpeɡri taa, wɛɛ ja he nɛɛ he waa bola dɛɛ pa bole ta. 7Hé kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ bol waa aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ be te, waa waa sie berɛ bole pae ta, waa nɛn siebɔr kɛɛ sen yawa nyiŋi.”
8Jerusalam ɡe la, Kooro Jehosafat le Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore, dɛ Israel nomonnyuune baa chɔ ba lolanar nyoo ŋɔ, baa nyiŋi nomɛlbwa waa koni Korowii Mmara la, dɛ́ bol nɛn ne o dɔŋ baah wa, dɛɛ pa bole Jerusalam. 9O do ɡɛ nomonome la ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ kasinteŋ ne bambidɛɛɡe, dɛ Korowii ɔma dɛɛ ɛ he toma. 10He bini bɛlbwa le bwɛjena nɔ ta, dɛ ba waa aa ɛ nɛŋkpoa kɛɛ Korowii Mmara la bini bɛlbwa ne naa, hé kah ba ŋɔ ba bɛ wechɔɡa ɛ dɛ́ jo Korowii nɛ, ásɛ o bandia bɛ he nɛɛ ba. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa bolchɔɡee di.
11Sɔfonomoa Amariaa dɛɛ ba he sie tɔe Korowii waa bwa ta, ásɛ Ismael bibaa Sebadia waa ɛ Juda dea nomoa la chɔ waa aa ɛ kooro waa nyoa, ásɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ɛɛ cha heya. Hé ɛa bambile bwa ne, Korowiirii dɛ ja banɔ la baa ɛa kɛrɛdɛ la nɛ.”

Title: 2 WEBENA 20
Content:
Kooro Jehosafat yo Amɔn ne Moab tena
1A habɔɔ la, Moab ne Amɔn dɛ Meuni tena vɔrɔwe laa, dɛ́ ba yo Juda Kooro Jehosafat ne o nɛra.
2Asɛ nɛra bane ba ŋɔ Kooro Jehosafat be ŋɔ, “Laa tena damanta le Edom harɛ Yar Mpo baŋ le dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yoi. Ba tel Hasasɔn Taama.” 3Kooro Jehosafat ɔmɔ, dɛ bɔɔ le Korowii be ŋɔ ó baɡlo ɡɛ waa ɛ, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ Juda te bɛlbwa vɔwɛ nyoa, á baɡle kɛ ba dɛ di suna. 4Juda tena baa cheme Jerusalam, dɛ ba bɔɔ le Korowii be. Juda harɛ bwɛɛ bɛlbwa taa nɛra le, dɛ ba soŋe Korowii.
5Ate, Kooro Jehosafat ir che nɛra baa le Juda ne Jerusalam bwa sie, Korowii Dea dembaah onfale la sie, 6dɛ ŋɔ,
“N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, henee dɛɛ di kora nyundua ne harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ. Henee dɔ bokpeɡa ne kpeɡri kohona, nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won che he sie. 7Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ. He doŋi nɛra ba fa aa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta le he nɛra Israel tena sie, dɛ kpɔ tɛ he dam Abraham naanar, o ɛ ba kon saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. 8Ba soɡe harɛ nɔ ta dɛ do Dea he sɔn ta dɛ ŋɔ, 9‘Dɛ wechɔɡa ane bɛlbwa ba ya nɛ, dɛ laa kɛɛ weechɔɡa kɛɛ lɔr aa, yaa ka che Dea nɔ sie he siee, dɛ́ wi noe a wa, ásɛ he no dɛ́ lɛ yaa.’
10Taraken, Amɔn ne Moab ne Edom tena balɔ dɛ́ ba yo yaa. Ya naawa fa aa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ ba la, he ta ɡelɛ ba jo ɡɛ harɛre la ta. Ba valɔ dɛ bar ba, dɛ ɡel ba kpoora. 11Na waa taraken baa kpɔa dɛɛ ba ba bɔ yaa kem kɛŋɔ, bá doŋi yaa le harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa o ɛ ya kapɛrɛ kon la ta. 12Henee Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ. Tɛr ba deŋne, dɛkalkɛ ya ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ won che laa tena baa wara dɛɛ ba ya nɛɛ nɔ sie. Yaa jemɛ ɡɛ yaa ɛ, he siwi taa yaa nyiŋi.”
13Dɛ Juda harɛ ta baala ne ba haahna ne bii bwa cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie.
14Belaa Korowii Doma ba so Sekaria bie Jahaseɛl nɛɛ nɛnlaa la baah. Sekaria mɛɛ sɔne Bɛnaya, Bɛnaya lolɛ Jeyɛl, Jeyɛl lolɛ Matania. Jahaseɛl ɛ Lewi dea te dɛ le Asaf dea.
15Anee Jahaseɛl ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ne nɛra haa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam bwa, hé no. Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee nɔ, ‘He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr laa tena baa wara nɔ wa. Korowiirii dɛ́ yo tɛ heya. 16Hé ir ka yoo ba kere, ɡɛ saŋ baa teeh kpɔ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa chɔa kaa Sis dɛɛ ba la. Hɛɛ ka chem ba fɛlembɔjen la nyoa Jeruel waa lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la bɔr. 17He laa dɛɛ ba laa nɔ yoi. Hé te ka che he chebɔra dɛɛ kpa. Hé che kiŋkiŋ, ásɛ dɛ na ɡɛ Korowii aa yo tɛ heya, dɛ́ ɡel he pɔ ba nɛ. Juda ne Jerusalam tena, he bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr, hé te le ka puu ba kere, dɛ́ na ɡɛ Korowii aa ja he nɛ.’ ”
18Asɛ Kooro Jehosafat ɡuŋi dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ. Asɛ nɛra la ɡe bwa ɡuŋi dɛ jam Korowii. 19Ate, Lewi dea tena bane baa le Kohat ne Kora deene ta la ir che, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ takpeɡ ne.
20Tɔ aa pera chɔɔ la, ba leɔ kaa Tekoa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela. Baa dɛ ba kaala la, Kooro Jehosafat iro che dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé no, Juda ne Jerusalam tena. Hé yarada Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la, dɛ́ yarada waa o keamere ɡe aa bola la, aa chiɡ heyaa kɛrɛdɛɛ.” 21Kooro ne nɛra la bane bol wa, asɛ o le yelɡoola bane ŋɔ bá ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii, o ɡoroŋ waa doa dɛ do kan kohona la wa, asɛ ba tɔ laa tena la sie dɛɛ ɡo yela ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii o nyina waa dɛ nyin yaa lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
22Baa pa mun dɛɛ ɡo yela la, Korowii ɡelɔ Amɔn ne Moab, dɛ Edom laa tena baa dɛ ba ba lɔ tɔ Juda tena nɛɛ dɛ́ yoo ba la wili. 23Amɔn ne Moab laa tena pɛo, dɛ yo Edom laa tena dɛ kpoo ba bwa kwaraa. Baa kpoo ba tonɛ la, ba berɛ sie dɔŋa be dɛɛ kpoo dɔŋa, ka tel kɛŋɔ ba bwa aa tona.
24Juda laa tena la baa tel bobɛl o sie aa chaɡɛ pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ la ta, asɛ dɛ ha sie nyiŋi, dɛ na kɛŋɔ laa tena damanta la bwa serewɔ chɔ. Beŋkpoŋ kwaraa ta kae. 25Ate, Kooro Jehosafat ne o laa tena la ka pa ba laala kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa. Ba na nae ne dɔmkwa dɛ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaare a yoɡ aa kpeɡa warɛ taeh. Tɔpera atoroo ba won kpɔ boa a bwa nyoa, kɛ ba ta wone kpɔ a bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a warɔ kɛrɛdɛ. 26Tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ba kaa cheme Bɛraka Fɛlembɔjen ta ɡo yela, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii a wa. A waa baa yerɔ Bɛraka Felembɔjen ba le fini la.
27Ate, Kooro Jehosafat tɔ o laa tena sie, asɛ ba berɛ ba Jerusalam silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ba pɔ ba dɔma nɛ. 28Baa tel Jerusalam la, ba lɔ janjelare dɛ hoh bɛle ka jo Korowii Dea.
29Harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra no ɡɛ Korowii aa yo Israel tena dɔma tɛɛ ba la aa, dɛ ɔmee kohona laɡ ba. 30Anee ɡela Kooro Jehosafat dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna o harɛ waa dɛ di kora o ta, dɛkalkɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ ja o nɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛlbwa ta.
Kooro Jehosafat kora dii jaɡa
31Kooro Jehosafat aa di kora Juda harɛ dɛ o di bene fifraatoro dɛ anue. O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue. Dɛ o nyaa Silhi bihaah Asuba. 32Kooro Jehosafat ɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Asa aa ɛa wobɛlbwa ta, o ta an ɡelɛ. O ɛ waa aa toɡra Korowii be. 33Deŋɡarere voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa la te, o ta an chɔɡɛ. Ba ta ba bambile bwa kpɔe tomɛ Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la.
34Waane ɡe Kooro Jehosafat aa ɛa, le mumpar ba a jaɡa, ba chwera ja Hanani bibaa Jehu bwara waa aa lɔ Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini.
35A habɔɔ, Juda Kooro Jehosafat ne Israel Kooro Ahasia o nyu bini aa kpeɡa kohona la fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo. 36Kooro Jehosafat ne Kooro Ahasia pɛo, dɛ ɛ stiimaere aa kpeɡa, ba kpɔ dɛɛ kpɔ mpo sie dɛɛ la bonadibɔr. Baa kwaara Eseɔn Gɛba tonɛ la, 37Dodavahu waa le Maresa bibaa Korowii keame Eliesa cheɡɛ Korowii waa ta, dɛ kah Kooro Jehosafat ŋɔ, “He ne Kooro Ahasia aa fɔwɛ nyopɛo fɔo nomanta, Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ kwaa haa ɛa nɔɔ.” Anomanta, stiimaere la paɡrɔ ba ta wone kpɔa la bonadibɔr.

Title: 2 WEBENA 21
Content:
1Kooro Jehosafat sewɔ ka chɔ o naawa hoɡa ta Jerusalam, o naa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Asɛ o bibaa Jehoram chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
2Juda Kooro Jehosafat bibaa Kooro Jehoram dɔ nimanar bibaala banumɛl. Banee, Asaria ne Jehiel ne Sekaria, ne Asariahu ne Maekel, dɛ Sɛfatea. Kooro Jehosafat bibaalaa a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa. 3Ba mɛɛ tɛɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa dɛ kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kohona, dɛ berɛ tɛ bɛlbwa Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara ba ka so a ta. Kɛ Jehoram aa ɛ binomoa la, onee Kooro Jehosafat le o chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehoram
4Kooro Jehoram kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ la, o kpoo o nimanar la ne Israel nomonome bane. 5Kooro Jehoram di bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora, dɛ so Jerusalam di kora bene anuatoro. 6O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta. Dɛ o mo Kooro Ahab bihaah, anomanta, o ɛ wechɔɡa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. 7Dɛ Korowii aa nyin kɛŋɔ o chɔɡ Kooro Devid dem kora, dɛkalkɛ o ne Devid fɔwɛ fɔo o baɡɔ nyoa ŋɔ o naanar ɛɛ di kora saŋ bɛlbwaa dɛɛ la.
8Kooro Jehoram aa di kora saŋee Edom harɛ tena pere ba te le Juda tena nɛ, dɛ ka chiɡ ba kooro. 9Belaa Kooro Jehoram kpɔ o laa sitɔɔla ne o torɔɡore la ba be. Edom tena la bar o ne o laa sitɔɔla baa dɛ nyiŋi o torɔɡore la, kɛ Kooro Jehoram ne o laa sitɔɔla iro jwaana, dɛ jo ba baah le, dɛ chwa kaa. 10Ba le fini, Edom harɛ tena pere ba te le Juda tena lɔɡa.
Gɛɛ bwɛjen Lebna tena ɡe pere ba te ɡɛ saŋ, dɛkalkɛ Kooro Jehoram vɛh Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la. 11Hale o kwaa bɔra Juda harɛ deŋɡarere ta baa tomɛ voɡa, a che a ta Juda ne Jerusalam tena ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛ.
12Korowii keame Elaeja chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Kooro Jehoram ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii he naa Devid aa tomɔ aa dɛ bol laanee nɔ, ‘He ta waa he mɛɛ Kooro Jehosafat, kɛɛ he nabaa Kooro Asa aa ɛa ta teŋɛ. 13He teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta, a che a ta Juda ne Jerusalam tena kaa tomɛ voɡa, ɡɛ Kooro Ahab ne banɔ la baa di kora o habɔɔ aa ɛa la. Hale he berɔ kpoo he nimanar ba waa aa wera ɡwaale la. 14Anomanta, Korowii ɛɛ tɛr he nɛra deŋnee taeh, he bii ne he haahna, dɛ chɔɡ kwaa haa dɔa ɡe bwa. 15He ɡbabir ɡe ɛɛ we teweelaa taeh, ka tel kɛŋɔ haa sewɛ.’ ”
16Dɛ Filisti tena bane ne Arab tena fa soɡo bɛne bela Itiopia tena bane fa aa soɡa mpo nyoa. Korowii ɡelɔ ba ne Kooro Jehoram yo laa. 17Ba kaa lɔ tɔ Juda tena nɛ, dɛ pa laala aa lɔ koodem ne o haahna ne bibaala kaa. O bibaa bechala Ahasia ɡboo baa ka.
18Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡelɔ teweela baa wola won chaah ba Kooro Jehoram nɛ. 19Weela la kpoŋo ka tel dɛ ɛ bene anɛ, asɛ o looni le o sewɛ weweele ne. O nɛra ta on koo huɡa huɡe, dɛ mar nijena, dɛ baɡle jirima baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɛo o seo la wa. Dɛ ɡɛɛ ba ɛ o naawa baa tɔ sie la.
20Kooro Jehoram aa di kora dɛ o di bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene anuatoro. O seo ta nomɛlbwa nɛɛ weɛ. Ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, kɛ bela baa dɛ huɡe koranar la laa.

Title: 2 WEBENA 22
Content:
Juda Kooro Ahasia
1Arab tena bane aa baa lɔ tɔ Kooro Jehoram bibanomonome bwa nɛɛ dɛ kpoo ba, asɛ a ka o bibaa bechala Ahasia la, Jerusalam tena cheɡo kora, o so o mɛɛ buɡ ta.
2Kooro Ahasia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora. O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora benanyoa beŋkpoŋ. O nya sɔne Atalia, dɛ Kooro Omri o fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta ka la naa.
3O ɡe teŋɛ waa Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena aa ɛa la ta, dɛkalkɛ o nya doo o ɛ wechɔɡa. 4O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kɛ Kooro Ahab ne o dem tena, dɛkalkɛ o mɛɛ seo habɔɔ la, dɛ banee dɛɛ jao, a che a ta o chole. 5Kooro Ahasia teŋɛ jae baa jao la ta, o ne Israel Kooro Joram ka yo Siiria harɛ Kooro Hasael bwɛɛ Ramɔt Gelead. Yoi la ta la, Siiria laa tena la do Kooro Joram bol. 6Anomanta, o berɔ ba Jesreel dɛ baa chah, asɛ Juda Kooro Ahasia la ka nao.
7Dɛ Korowiirii ɛa kɛŋɔ Kooro Ahasia ka na Kooro Joram dɛ kpoo. Waa laŋa la, o ne Kooro Joram laŋɔ ka cheme Nimsi bibaa Jehu, Korowii aa leo ŋɔ ó ba kpo Kooro Ahab dem nɛra la. 8Kooro Jehu aa dɛ kpoo ba la, o kaa tel Juda nomonome ne Kooro Ahasia naanar baa ja o nɛɛ la, asɛ dɛ kpoo ba bwa. 9O ɡelɔ baa ɡaaɡe Kooro Ahasia bɔr, asɛ o nɛra ka nao bwɛjen Samaria dɛ lawɔ. Ba kpɔɔ ba tɛ Kooro Jehu, asɛ o kpoo. Asɛ ba koh ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Jehosafat aa nyin Korowii o bambile bwa ne waa dɛ huɡo. Anomanta, dɛ nomɛlbwa toole Kooro Ahasia dem, dɛ dɔ kpeɡri dɛ́ won nyiŋi Juda harɛ la ta kpa.
Juda Haŋkooro Atalia
10Kooro Ahasia nya Atalia aa naa kɛ o bibaa Kooro Ahasia sewɔ la, o ŋɔ ba kpoo koobii baa ba di kora Juda harɛ ta bwa. 11Dɛ Kooro Ahasia mɛɛ bihaah bɛl sɔne Jehoseba, dɛ yalɛ sɔfo Jehoiada. O sɔɔh dɛ lɛ Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas le koobii baa dɛ ba ba kpoora la bini, dɛ kpɔɔ ka sɔh o be dea, dɛ ɡel haah bɛl ɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ Korowii Dea. O ɛ ɡɛ dɛ lɛo le haŋkooro Atalia kpoe o fe aa dɛ nyin o kpoe la nɔn ta. 12Jehoseba kpɔ Joas sɔh Korowii Dea bela bene anumɛl, ɡɛ saŋ haŋkooro Atalia aa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta la.

Title: 2 WEBENA 23
Content:
1Bene anuanɛ ta la, sɔfo Jehoiada baɡle o kpeɡri. O ne laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena lafare nyoo, ne Jɛroham bibaa Asaria, ne Jehohanan bibaa Ismael, ne Ɔbɛd bibaa Asaria, ne Adaya bibaa Maaseya, dɛ Sikri bibaa Elisafat fɔwɛ fɔo. 2Ba la Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta, dɛ ka kpɔ Lewi dea tena ne nomonnyuune baa chɔ Israel deene nyoo bwa ba Jerusalam. 3Asɛ nɛra la bwa ne kooro bibaa Joas ba cheme Korowii Dea dɛ fɔwɛ fɔo. Anee sɔfo Jehoiada ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Kooro Ahasia bibaa Joas ɛɛ di koraa, ɡɛ Korowii aa baɡɛ Kooro Devid naanar nyoa la. 4Gɛ maa dɛ nyin kɛ he sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, he balɔ dɛɛ ba ba daah Korowii Dea Ona Tɔpere aa, he bini bele batoro ba daah doonyoone la, 5bele batoro ɡe ka daah koodem, bele batoro ɡe do Mumpar Doonyoa, ásɛ nɛra la kabora ka boa nyoa Korowii Dea dembaahna bela. 6Nomɛlbwa bɛ Korowii Dea la bini jo, atane sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela dɛɛ ɛ toma. Ba te ɛɛ won jo bela, dɛkalkɛ ba sɔ ba doŋa ta ba do ɡoroŋ. Kɛ banɔ la baa kaa la te chɛ kɛ bá teŋɛ waa Korowii aa bola la ta, dɛ́ so dahara. 7Lewi dea tena chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ ba dɔmkwaa kpoŋe, dɛ́ che bar Joas, dɛ́ so o jwɛh, bobɛlbwa waa kaa. Ásɛ nomɛlbwa ba dɛ jo Korowii Dea aa, bá kpoo.”
8Lewi dea tena ne Juda baala la ɛ ɡɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa do ba la bwa. Ba bini bɛlbwa ta nɛra baa dɛ ba toma ta Ona Tɔpere ta, ne banɔ la baa wola toma ta ba Ona Tɔpere ta la ŋwɛnɛ tɛɛ ba kaa ba deremi. 9Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, a ɛ Kooro Devid kwaa ba kpɔ cheɡ Korowii Dea la tɛ laa sitɔɔla la. 10Ate, o ɡel nɛra baa dɛ daah la bɛlbwa kpoŋe o dɔmkon ba che Korowii Dea ne saraha kon la sie, dɛ bar Kooro Joas. 11Name sɔfo Jehoiada ka lawɛ Joas le buse dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, dɛ cheɡo kora ta. Ba kpɔ kooɡbɛrɛ piu, dɛ kpɔ fɔo baa fɔwa dɛ che o ta dɛɛ di kora harɛ la ta do o nɔn ta. Asɛ ba lɔ kpaŋa dɛ moo ŋɔ, “Kórowii tɛ kooro mkpajaŋ!”
12Haŋkooro Atalia aa no moola nɛra baa dɛ daah ne nɛra baa lɔ bela aa dɛ moo la, o ɛ warane la ba be Korowii Dea bela. 13O baa na kɛŋɔ kooro la cheɡɛ Korowii Dea la sie pila bɛl jwɛh ɡɛ ba nawee wa aa doa. Asɛ laa sitɔɔla ne bɛlhoohla che kooro jwɛh. Asɛ harɛ la ta nomɛlbwa sie lɛ, baa hoh bɛle, dɛɛ lɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, asɛ yelɡoola ɡo yela tɔ ba sie. Belaa haŋkooro Atalia laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o baah diu kohona, dɛ ŋɔ, “He bwa lee mɛ tɛ! He ɛɛ mɛ dɔm!”
14Dɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa nyin kɛ bá kpo Atalia Korowii Dea bɔr bela, anomanta, o do laa sitɔɔla la ŋɔ, “Hé lawɔ le laa tena nɔ baah ta, dɛ́ kpo nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛ ó ba lɛo.” 15Ate, ba tɛɡro le, dɛ kpoo Jaɡre Doonyoa bela jaɡre aa cheɡa dɛɛ jo koodem la ta.
16Sɔfo Jehoiada ne Kooro Joas fɔwɛ fɔo o chɔ Korowii ne harɛ la nɛra baah ta kɛŋɔ nɛra la ɛɛ tomɛ Korowii. 17Ate, harɛ la ta nɛra bwa la voɡ Baal dea, dɛ ka paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo, ne voɡare aa lɔ dea la bini bwa, dɛ paɡre o dea la bwa ɡe kwaraa. Dɛ lawɛ o kerekpoŋri baa dɛ yerɔ Matan, dɛ kpoo kwaa ba fa aa dɛ ɛ sarahare o ta la sie.
18Ate, Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ Korowii Dea bela toma do sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena nɔn ta. Banee Kooro Devid kpɔ do ba nɔn ta ŋɔ, báa fuh saraha kwaa baa kpɔa baa tɛ Korowii la, ɡɛ aa lɔ Mosis Mmara Tɔn bini. Dɛ banee chɔ yela ɡoe ne wobɛlbwa aa dɛ ba silɛɛ ne nyoa. 19Sɔfo Jehoiada kpɔ nɛra ba che, baa daah Korowii Dea doonyoo la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa kah doŋa la bɛ Dea la bini jo.
20Sɔfo Jehoiada yerɛ laa sitɔɔla baa chɔ laa tena lafare nyoo ne nomonome dɛ nomonjena, asɛ ba kpɔ Kooro Joas le Korowii Dea bela ba. Ba kpɔ koodem Nyundua Doonyoa la ta jo, asɛ kooro ba so o kookara ta, 21asɛ harɛ la ta nɛra bwa sie lɛ, bwɛjen la sɔɔh, kpoe baa kpo haŋkooro Atalia la wa.

Title: 2 WEBENA 24
Content:
Juda Kooro Joas
(2Ko 12:1-16)
1Kooro Joas aa di kora Juda harɛ dɛ o dɔ bene anuanɛ. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanaarɛ. O nya sɔne Sebea, dɛ le bwɛjen Beɛseeba. 2Kooro Joas ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, ɡɛ saŋ sɔfo Jehoiada aa dɛ di sɔfore bwa. 3Sɔfo Jehoiada mo haahna banɛ tɛ Kooro Joas, asɛ o dɔ bibaala ne bihaahna.
4A habɔɔ la, Kooro Joas liiro kɛŋɔ wɛɛ berɔɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la. 5Asɛ o yerɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena cheme, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡaaɡe Juda harɛ bwɛjena ta, dɛ́ lɛ toɔ aa chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa bɔ benanyoa la ba, ásɛ n kpɔ kwaa Korowii Dea la. Hé ɛa warane.” Kɛ Lewi dea tena la ta mun pae warane.
6Anomanta, o yerɛ Sɔfonomoa Jehoiada dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he ta nyiŋe Lewi dea tena la Juda ne Jerusalam, dɛ ka lɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa toɔ, Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis ne Israel tena bwa aa ŋɔa bá ka lɛ ba kwaa Korowii Dea Cheremibɔr laɔ?”
7Dɛ Haŋkooro Atalia nyubinikpeɡ te la habɔteŋra ku Korowii Dea la, dɛ pa kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la bini ane kaa tomɛ voɡ Baalre.
8Ate, Kooro Joas do Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ, bá kwaa daka cheɡ Korowii Dea la doonyoa dɛɛ lɛ suuɡare. 9Ate, ba kpɔ kala ka tɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena ŋɔ, nómɛlbwa kpɔ toɔ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis fa aa lɛa Israel tena be pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta la ba. 10Nɛra la ne ba nomonome kpɔ ba toɔre ba silɛɛ ne, asɛ daka la su. 11Tɔpere bɛlbwa, Lewi dea tena la yon kpɔ daka la ba koodem karakere baa dɛ nyiŋi o ta la be. Dɛ o suu waa, karakere la ne Sɔfonomoa nachiɡe yon fuɡa, dɛ berɛ kpɔ daka la ka cheɡ o buɡ ta. Gɛɛ baa ɛ tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛ dɔ suuɡa a warɛ. 12Kooro Joas ne sɔfo Jehoiada yon kpɔ suuɡa la do nɛra Korowii Dea kwaara aa lɔ ba nɔn ta. Ásɛ ba kpɔ mamaala ne kapenta tena, dɛ nɛra baa jemɛ bune ne ayaawa toma ŋɔ ba kwaa Dea la.
13Tom-ɛɛra la do sie ɛ toma kohona, dɛ ɡel Korowii Dea la berɛ do ɡɛ o fa aa doa wubwa la, dɛ do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ. 14Tom-ɛɛra la aa tona la, ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa la kar tɛ kooro ne sɔfo Jehoiada, asɛ ba kpɔ kwaa loɡbaala ne konjeɡre bwa soo siwi baa hiah cheɡ Korowii Dea la bini. Sɔfo Jehoiada bere saŋ, nɛra kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bela saŋ bɛlbwa.
15Sɔfo Jehoiada hwɛɛhrɔ taeh mɔɔ dɛ sewɛ, dɛ o di bene lafa fifraatoro. 16Ba huɡo koranar huɡribɔr Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, o wedɛɛɡa waa ɛa Israel harɛ tɛ Korowii ne Korowii Dea toma la wa.
Kooro Joas nyubinikpeɡ wa
17Kɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa sewa habɔɔ la, Juda nomonome ba Kooro Joas be, dɛɛ soŋo ŋɔ wɛɛ no ba deŋna wa. 18Juda harɛ nɛra vɛh Korowii ba naawa fa aa dɛ tomɔ la ka toma o Dea bela, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa ne voɡa. A ɡɛ wechɔɡa nɔ nomanta, Korowii baah di Juda tena ne Jerusalam tena nɛ. 19Korowii tomɛ o keamere ba be, dɛ kah ba ŋɔ bá charɛ dɛ berɛ ba o be, kɛ ba vɛoh.
20Belaa Korowii Doma ba so sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa Sekaria nɛ, asɛ o ka che nɛra la sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Waa Korowii aa dɛ bol he be laanee nɔ, ‘Ɛrɛɛ he vɛh n waa maa do heyaa a ta nɔɔ? He wobɛlbwa aa werii do tɛ heyaa bwa. Haa vɛh mɛ nomanta, n ɡe vɛh heya.’ ”
21Kooro Joas sɛoh o ne ba vɔrɔwe Sekaria vɔrɔwa. Asɛ o ɡel ba foɡro bwea Korowii Dea dembaah dɛ kpoo. 22Kooro Joas soh ɡɛ Sekaria mɛɛ sɔfo Jehoiada aa chao la, dɛ ɡarɛ kpo Sekaria. Waa chɔa dɛɛ sewɛ la o ŋɔ, “N dɛ soŋe kɛ Korowii na waa haa ɛa nɔ, dɛ́ bɔe a kem!”
Kooro Joas kora dii jaɡa
23Lɔmɔɡa saŋ aa tela la, Siiria laa tena warɔ, dɛ ba Juda ne Jerusalam ba yoo ba, dɛ kpoo ba nomonome bwa. Dɛ pa ba laala bwa kɛŋɔ laa ta kwa ka tɛ ba kooro Damaskɔs. 24Dɛ Siiria laa tena aa kanɛ, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ ba yo, dɛ pɔ Juda laa tena baa wara kohona nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa dɛ tomɔ la. Gɛɛ a do Kooro Joas dɔ o deŋnetɛra. 25Baa do Kooro Joas bol laa ta la, Siiria laa tena la kaalɔ, belaa o nomonome la banɛ vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo, kpoe waa kpo sɔfo Jehoiada bibaa la wa. Ba kpoo ɡɛ saŋ dɛ o chɔ mpa ta, asɛ ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, kɛ koranar huɡribɔr laa.
26Nɛra baa vɔrɔwe o kpoe vɔrɔwa la bɛl sɔne Sabad. O nya sɔne Simiat dɛ ɛ Amɔn te, ne Jehosabad, o ɡe nya sɔne Simrit dɛ ɛ Moab te. 27Ba chwerɛ Kooro Joas bii waa ne ɡɛ Korowii keamere aa bol o wa, ne ɡɛ waa bera kwaa Korowii Dea la waa do Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. O bibaa Amasea baa chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 25
Content:
Juda Kooro Amasea
1Amasea di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ dɛ di kora. O di kora Jerusalam bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ. O nya sɔne Jehoadin dɛ le Jerusalam. 2Kooro Amasea ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, kɛ dɛ o bambile bwa ne laa. 3Kooro Amasea kora aa baa che kiŋkiŋ name la, o kpoo nomonome baa kpo o mɛɛ o fa aa di kora la. 4Kɛ o ta ɡɛ nomonome la bii kpoorɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa chwera Mosis Mmara la ta kɛŋɔ, “Mɛɛ kɛɛ nya ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo o bie, bii ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa aa, haa won kpɔ kpo mɛɛ kɛɛ nya. Nɛn o ɡbaɡba aa ɛ wechɔɡa laanee chɛ kɛ ó sewɛ o wechɔɡa wa.”
5Kooro Amasea boa baala bwa baa lɔ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene, dɛ le ba nomonnyuune ba chɔ laa tena kaɡboŋa ne lafare nyoo ba deene ta. Baala baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa lɔ nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraatoro. Banee ba le ba kpɔ ba te dɛ jemɛ lampeare ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta ne yoi kɛrɛdɛ. 6O berɔ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, dɛ ka bɔ Israel laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa paa ŋɔ bá ba yo tɛo.
7Anee Korowii keame bɛl la kooro be ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, bɛ ɡel Israel laa tena teŋɛ he nɛ. Korowii ta Israel tena baa le weekaŋle nyundua harɛ la nɛɛ teŋɛ. 8He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba ja he nɛ aa, anee he do kpeɡri laa la ta, kɛ Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri, dɛ ɡel nɛn ɛɛ pɔ o dɔŋ nɛɛ kɛɛ wɛɛ chole. Wɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔma pɔ he nɛ.”
9Anee Kooro Amasea bɔɔ Korowii keame la ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ maa bɔa tɛ Israel laa tena la waɔ?”
Anee o ŋɔ, “Korowii ɛɛ won berɛ tɛɛ ane a ɡwaa ɡɛ.”
10Anomanta, Kooro Amasea ɡelɔ Israel laa tena la berɛ kaa ba bwɛɛre ta. Ba baah di Juda tena nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ berɛ kaa.
11Asɛ Kooro Amasea do ɡbemba dɛ tɔ laa tena la sie dɛ kaa Yar Fɛlembɔjen ta. Ba kpoo Edom laa tena kaɡboŋa fi bela. 12Ba berɔ lawɛ Edom laa tena la bini kaɡboŋa fi ɡe, dɛ kpɔ ba ka che bwejen bɛl doa waa lɔ bwɛjen Sela, dɛ taɡ ba ta, ba lee o lɔɡa dɛ serewe.
13Israel laa tena Kooro Amasea aa ɡela ba berɛ kaa ŋɔ ba bɛ o nɛɛ teŋɛ la laa la ta la, kaa lɔ tɔ Juda bwɛjena ta, le Samaria kaa Bɛt Hɔrɔn, dɛ kpoo nɛra kaɡboŋa batoro, dɛ pa laala aa wara le bela kaa.
14Kooro Amasea aa kaa kpoo Edom tena dɛ ba la, o pa bela voɡa dɛ ba cheɡa, dɛ toma dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare a ta. 15Anomanta, Korowii baah di Kooro Amasea nɛ, dɛ tomɛ o keame bɛl o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ tomɛ harɛre ane voɡa aa wola wone lɛ a nɛra le he nɔn ta nɔɔ?”
16Korowii keame la nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol la, Kooro Amasea ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ya lee ŋɔ hɛɛ ja kooro aa? Tɔ nyoa! Gɛ laa aa, mɛɛ ɡeloo bá kpoe.”
Ate, Korowii keame la tɔ nyoa, dɛ berɛ pili nyoa ŋɔ, “Taraken te n jemɔ kɛŋɔ Korowii dɛ ba he kpoe, dɛkalkɛ he vɛh waa maa jae ŋɔ he bɛ ɛ la.”
17Juda Kooro Amasea ne nɛra baa dɛ jao vɔrɔwe Israel tena vɔrɔwa. Belaa o kpɔ kala tɛ Israel Kooro Jehoas waa ɛ Kooro Jehoahas bibaa, dɛ ɛ Kooro Jehu o fa aa di kora Israel la naa ŋɔ bá cheme dɔŋa dɛ yo laa.
18Anee Israel Kooro Jehoas ɡe tomɛ toroma Juda Kooro Amasea be, dɛ sɛɡlo ŋɔ, “Lɛbanɔn harɛ ta jabalnadaŋɛ bɛlee fa ira, dɛ ka ŋɔ bela dajen bɛl be ŋɔ, ‘Kpɔ he bihaah tɛ mɛ ń tɛ n bie ó mo.’ Asɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl ɡe ir, dɛ ba tiɡri jabalnadaŋɛ la ta dɛ laa kuuɡi.” 19O berɔ ŋɔ Kooro Amasea be ŋɔ, “He yo Edom tena dɛ pɔ ba nɛ he nyu bini do he som, ɡel a maɡre he ne dɛ́ so he dem. Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ nyin waa ba dawɛ ya nɛ, dɛ́ chɔɡ he kora ne Juda tena nɔɔ?”
20Kɛ Kooro Amasea ta a mun noɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ ó kpɔ ba do Kooro Jehoas nɔn ta, toma baa dɛ tomɛ Edom harɛ ta voɡa la wa. 21Anomanta, Israel Kooro Jehoas ne Juda Kooro Amasea kaa cheme dɔŋa Bɛt Sɛmɛs waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta, dɛ yo laa. 22Israel laa tena pɔ Juda laa tena nɛ, asɛ ba chwa peɡre kaa ba bwɛɛre. 23Israel Kooro Jehoas lawɛ Juda Kooro Amasea, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Jerusalam, dɛ ka kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa baro la. Ba kuuɡu le Efrem Doonyoa ka tel bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Loŋkora Doonyoa. O jaŋne ɛɛ ɛ naɡale lafraanumɛlee. 24Kooro Jehoas pa suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa ne kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, Lewi dea te Ɔbɛd Edom naanar aa dɛ nyiŋi a ta, ne koodem bela laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa kaa Samaria. O lawɛ nɛra ɡe ja kaa.
25Juda Kooro Joas bibaa Kooro Amasea di bene fi dɛ anue, Israel Kooro Jehoahas bibaa Kooro Jehoas seo habɔɔ. 26Waa aa bera chiɡ Juda Kooro Amasea kora dii ta, le mumpar ba a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. 27Le ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Amasea aa vɛh Korowii toma la, dɛ ba dɛ vɔrɔwe o kpoe vɔrɔwa Jerusalam. Anomanta, o chwao kaa bwɛjen Lakes ta, asɛ ba tomɛ nɛra ba teŋɛ la, dɛ ka kpoo bela. 28Ba kpɔ o chɔɔ dawɛ jaaɡɔ ta ba Jerusalam, asɛ ba huɡo bela baa huɡe o naawa Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta.

Title: 2 WEBENA 26
Content:
Juda Kooro Ussia
1Kooro Amasea aa sewa la, Juda tena bwa lawɛ o bibaa Ussia baa chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta o di kora. Dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anumɛl. 2Kooro Ussia berɔ ka yo lɛ Elat dɛ kwaa vɔrɔwo, o mɛɛ seo habɔɔ.
3Waa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fi dɛ anumɛl. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anɛ. O nya sɔne Jekolia dɛ le Jerusalam. 4Kooro Ussia ɛ waa a too Korowii tea, ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Amasea fa aa ɛa la. 5O tomɛ Korowii o bambile bwa ne ɡɛ saŋ Korowii keame Sekaria, waa dɛ jao Korowii waa ta taa soɡe le, asɛ Korowii sweero andɛɛɡa.
6Kooro Ussia ne Filisti tena yo laa, asɛ dɛ ka paɡre danjwɛkpeɡa aa bar bwɛjena Gat ne Jamnia dɛ Asdɔd. O berɔ kwaa vɔrɔwe bwɛjena aa bɛne Asdɔd dɛ Filisti harɛ la ta bobɛla bwa. 7Korowii chao o pɔ Filisti tena ne Arab tena baa soɡe Gur Baal, dɛ Meuni tena nɛ. 8Amɔn tena kpɔ harɛ la ta kwaa baa tɛ Kooro Ussia, asɛ o sɔn le dɛ ba Ijipt harɛ ta bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɔ kpeɡri kohona.
9Kooro Ussia ɡelɔ ba ma dejaŋa aa do kpeɡri Jerusalam Loŋkora Doonyoa, ne bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa, dɛ bela danjwɛɛ baa maa bar bwɛɛ la loŋkora ta. 10O berɔ ɡel ba ma dejaŋa pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta, dɛ kwi bɔɔne aa won nee lɛɛ bwea lɔɡre, ne deŋɡarere harɛ aa chɔa kaa la ta, dɛkalkɛ o dɔ kondɛɛra kɛrɛdɛ. Dɛ o dɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma o kooni ne daa kooni aa lɔ deŋɡarere ne harɛpare andɛɛɡa ta, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o sie dɛ lɛ para ta.
11Dɛ o dɔ laa tena baa jemɛ yoi, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te saŋ bɛlbwa dɛ́ ka yo laa. O karakere banɛ Jeyɛl ne Maaseyaa chwerɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ dɛɛ bil, asɛ kooro nomoa Hanania chɔ ba nyoa. 12Dɛ nomonnyuune baa dɛ nyiŋi laa tena la nɛɛ lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanumɛl. 13Laa tena kaɡboŋa lafraatoro dɛ banuanɛ lafraanue baa dɛ ba wona yo kooro dɔma tɛo kɛrɛdɛ la lɔ ba lɔɡa. 14Kooro Ussia tɛ o laa tena la kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, ne lampeare ne bune ɡbɛrɛre, ne laa batakaani ne tori, dɛ vamtor bwea. 15O ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɔ wejema kpɔ bune kwaa kwaane nɛra aa dɛ ba wona che a ta dejaŋa dor, ne danjwɛkpeɡa aa bar bwɛjen Jerusalam loŋkoni ta, dɛɛ ta hɛma ne bwejena. O sɔn leɔ kaa bobɛlbwa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii chao kohona mɔɔ o dɔ kpeɡri.
16Kɛ Kooro Ussia aa ba dɛ di kpeɡri la, mbarafo nomanta o cholo. O waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ka jo Korowii Dea ŋɔ o ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma kon baa dɛ fuah a ta la ta. 17Sɔfo Asaria ne sɔfore fifraanuatoro bane ɡe ba bambile aa kpeɡa teŋɛ o nɛɛ kaa Korowii Dea bela. 18Asɛ ba la o be ka bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛŋɔ he fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ Korowii. Sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar baa sɔ ba doŋa ta, ba do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera la, banee dɔ a ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá ɛ ɡɛ toma nɔ. Le Korowii Dea bonɔ kaa, dɛkalkɛ he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe o sie, waa andɛɛɡaa swee tɛɛ kpa.”
19Dɛ Kooro Ussia cheɡɛ Korowii Dea bela, kon baa dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma o ta la jwɛh, dɛ kpoŋe kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ fuh konsɔɔhsoma. O baah di sɔfore la nɛ, asɛ buɡ la ta, bwadabii weechɔɡa ane ba le o tile ta. 20Sɔfo Asaria ne sɔfore la nyoa kpoo baa nyiŋu, dɛ na kɛ wee lɔ o tile ta, asɛ ba doŋu le buse warane. Dɛ o ɡbabir kwaraa fe dɛ nyin buse lee wubwa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛr o deŋne.
21Korowii kpɔ wee ta Kooro Ussia nɛɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa sewɛ. O ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe jo Korowii Dea dɛ so o ɡbaɡba dem. Wobɛlbwa toole wɛɛ ɛ kpa, asɛ o bibaa Jotam ba so koodem bela dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la tena nɛ.
22Waane ɡe aa chiɡ Kooro Ussia kora dii ta, le mumpar kaa a jaɡa la, Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya chwera do tɔn bini. 23Kooro Ussia baa sewɛ asɛ ba huɡo bɛne o naawa koo bɛl koranar harɛ ta, dɛkalkɛ ba ŋɔ o we wee. O bibaa Jotam chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 27
Content:
Juda Kooro Jotam
1Kooro Jotam aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl. O nya sɔne Jerusa, asɛ o nya ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Sadɔk. 2Kooro Jotam ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, dɛ teŋɛ waa o mɛɛ Kooro Ussia aa ɛa la ta. Kɛ o te ta Korowii Dea joɛ, dɛ ka fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii nɛ. Dɛ harɛ la ta nɛra ta teŋɔ, dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. 3Kooro Jotam berɔ kwaa ma Korowii Dea doonyoa baa dɛ yerɔ Weekaŋle Nyundua Doonyoa la. Dɛ berɛ kwaa ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam Ofel deŋɡare ta. 4O vɔrɔwe bwɛjena Juda harɛ bwejena ta, dɛ ma dekpeɡa ne dejaŋa kɔne bini ɡe.
5O kaa yo Amɔn kooro ne o laa tena, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. O ham ba dɛ ɡel ba kpɔ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛo benanyoa bɛlbwa. Kwaa kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne mea baaɡe a tɔɡre aa ɛ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ, dɛ mea ane ɡe soo siwi baaɡe a ɡe tɔɡre aa ɛ kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ. Ba teŋɔ kpɔ ɡɛ tenten ba tɛo bennɛɛte ne bentooro te ta.
6Kooro Jotam baa do kpeɡri kɛrɛdɛ, dɛkalkɛ o teŋɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la nɛɛ kasinteŋ ne.
7Waa aa chiɡ Kooro Jotam kora dii ta, ne laa waa yoa, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. 8Kooro Jotam aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl. 9Kooro Jotam aa baa sewɛ la, ba huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen bela baa huɡe o naawa. Asɛ o bibaa Ahas chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 28
Content:
Juda Kooro Ahas
1Kooro Ahas di bene fifraanɛ mɔɔ dɛ di kora. O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fi dɛ anumɛl. Dɛ o ta doe kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid, o ta waa aa too Korowii tea ɛɛ. 2O teŋɛ waa Israel koranar aa ɛa la ta, dɛ ɛ voɡa dɛɛ tomɛ voɡ Baalre. 3O kpoo kwaa dɛ fuah ɛ saraha Bɛn Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini. O kpo o bibaala, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ saraha, dɛ teŋɛ harɛre ane nawee waa Korowii aa kia, dɛ koh a wa doŋ ba le ba Israel tena sie la ta. 4Kooro Ahas kpoo kwaa dɛ ɛ saraha, dɛ fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma tɛ voɡare bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ, ne deŋɡarere dor, dɛ dajen bɛlbwa mun.
5Anomanta, Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la kpɔɔ do Siiria kooro nɔn ta. Siiria laa tena baa yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛ, dɛ lawɛ o nɛra ɡalɡa, dɛ ba ba ne Damaskɔs.
O berɔ kpɔɔ do Israel kooro nɔn ta o yoo, dɛ kpoo o laa tena taeh. 6Tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta, Remalia bibaa Kooro Pɛka ne o laa tena iro ka kpoo Juda laa tena kaɡboŋa lafa fifraanɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la. 7Sikri waa ɛ banyoo dɛ le Efrem dea kpo Kooro Ahas bibaa baa dɛ yerɔ Maaseya, ne koodem nomoa Asrikam dɛ Ɛlkana. Dɛ kooro toole naa Ɛlkanaa lole. 8Israel tena lawɛ Juda tena ba fe aa ɛ ba lolanar laa ta, nɛra kaɡboŋa lafraanɛ baa ɛ ba haahna ne bihaahna dɛ bibaala. Ba berɔ pa ba laala aa wara laa la ta, dɛ ba a ne Samaria.
9Dɛ Korowii keame Ɔdɛd lɔ Samaria bela. O iro dɛ la ka cheme laa tena la ɡɛ saŋ baa ba Samaria la. O ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la baah di Juda tena nɛɛ waa o ɡel he yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ la. Kɛ he berɔ kpoo ba warɛ kohona to. 10Taraken he dɛ́ nyin he ɛ baala ne haahna baa lɔ Juda ne Jerusalam bwa he yoma. He ɛ ɡɛ naa, haa jemɛ kɛŋɔ he di bolchɔɡe dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa jo Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la nɛ aa? 11Hé no n be! Hé ɡel he lolanar haa laɡ ba yoma nɔ berɛ kaa, dɛkalkɛ Korowii baah di he nɛɛ kohona.”
12Belaa Israel nomonome la bane baa ɛ Jehohanan bibaa Asaria, ne Mɛselɛmɔt bibaa Bɛrekea, ne Salum bibaa Jehiskia, dɛ Hadlai bibaa Amasa ir ka cheme nɛra baa le laa ta dɛɛ ba la. 13Ba ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He bɛ nɛra haa laɡ ba la kpɔ ba bonɔ, ɡɛ laa aa, yaa di bolchɔɡe Korowii siee. He bɛ ɡel ya kpɔ wechɔɡa ja bolchɔɡe dii ta, a kan ya nɛɛ wubwa, ásɛ Korowii baah di ya nɛɛ kohona.”
14Anomanta, laa tena la kpɔ nɛra la ne laala baa paa laa la ta bwa tɛ nomonome baa lɔ bela la bwa, ba siwi ta. 15Asɛ nomonome banaarɛ la lawɛ nɛra la, dɛ ka kpɔ yale aa ja laala laa tena la aa paa la bini ane tɛ banɔ la baa cheɡɛ mumɡbal la, dɛ tɛɛ ba yale ne naŋɡaware ne kondikwa, dɛ noo baa kpɔ do ba ŋwɛra ta. Ba bini banɔ la baa ɡwɛɡra ɡe la, ba kpɔ ba so keeɡore ta. Gɛɛ a ɛ ba kpɔ ba bwa berɛ kaa ba bala be Jeriko baa dɛ yerɔ Bambie Bwɛjen la, dɛ berɛ ba Samaria.
16Aa ba dɛ la sie la, Kooro Ahas tomɛ nɛra Asiiria koojen be ŋɔ ó ba chao. 17Dɛ Edom tena berɔ ba yo Juda tena, dɛ lawɛ nɛra laa ta kaa, 18asɛ Filisti tena ɡe ba lɔ tɔ Juda harɛ ta bwɛɛre aa lɔ deŋɡarere ta, ne Nɛɡɛv pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ tena nɛ. Ba yoo dɛ lɛ bwɛjena Bɛt Sɛmɛs ne Aejalɔn, ne Gɛdɛrɔt ne Soko ne Temna dɛ Gimso, ne a bwɛjeɡre aa bara bwa dɛ so a ta. 19Juda Kooro Ahas wechɔɡa waa ba a ne Juda harɛ ta, ne kasinteŋ waa wola dii tɛ Korowii la nomanta, Korowii kpɔ wahala ba ta Juda tena nɛ. 20Asiiria koojen Tiɡlat Pilesa ba o be, kɛ wenaale nee o ba ɡwaa kɛ o fe aa ba chao. 21Anee Juda Kooro Ahas kpɔ suuɡaswɛm aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la aa lɔ koodem, ne anɔ la aa le nomonnyuune be, dɛ tomɛ ba kpɔ ka kɛ Asiiria koojen la, kɛ a ta wone chao.
22Kooro Ahas wenaale aa baa ɡwaa o nɛɛ bwa habɔɔ la, dɛ o ta teŋɔ ɛ wechɔɡa dɛɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ kohona. 23O kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahare Damaskɔs tena baa yoo dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ voɡare ta, dɛkalkɛ o liiro ŋɔ, “Siiria koranar voɡa aa cha ba nomanta, mɛɛ kpoo kwaa ɛ sarahaa tɛa, ásɛ a cha mɛ.” Kɛ anee ɡela o ne Israel tena lɔ harɛ.
24Kooro Ahas berɔ pa kwaa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la, dɛ ka paɡra burbur ken. O laa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la ɡbeni tɔɔɡe, dɛ kwaa bɔra baa ɛ sarahare a ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡa Jerusalam bobɛlbwa. 25O berɔ ɛ bɔr tɛ voɡtoroma Juda harɛ ta bwɛjena ne bwɛɛre ta, dɛ fuh daawiile dɛɛ tɛ harɛre ane voɡa. Anɔ ɡelɔ Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la baah di o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
26Wobɛlbwa Kooro Ahas aa ɛa la, ba chwera do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne bini. 27Kooro Ahas sewɔ, asɛ ba ka huɡo Jerusalam waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta. Kɛ ba ta on koranar huɡribɔr huɡe, asɛ o bibaa Hɛsɛkea ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 29
Content:
Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea
1Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ. O nya sɔne Abija, Sekaria bihaahnee. 2O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea kɛŋɔ o nabaa Kooro Devid ken.
3Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora benanyoa beŋkpoŋ korobiloɡle ta la, o berɔ kwaa pili Korowii Dea ɡbeni, dɛ ɡel ba kwaara. 4Asɛ o ɡel sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ba cheme Korowii Dea dembaah wee leebɔr pera, 5dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé Lewi dea tena hé no! Hé tɔ sie le he te cheɡ tɛ Korowii, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ he nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ́ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ Dea nɔ ta. Hé laa komɛlbwa aa ɡela o kah doŋa kpɔ o bini. 6Ya naawa waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ. Ba ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo o nɛɛ dɛ vɛoh, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoo bela waa lole. 7Ba berɔ laa Korowii Dea la ɡbeni tɔɔɡe, dɛ ɡel kandere la dirimi, dɛ vɛh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma, kɛɛ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah fueh Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Dea bini. 8Korowii koh a wa, asɛ o baah di Juda ne Jerusalam tena nɛ, asɛ o tɛr ba deŋne nomɛlbwa bwara yɔr dɛɛ ɔmɛ. Hé ɡbabir jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ. 9Ba kpoo ya naawa laa ta, dɛ lawɛ ya haahna ne bii ɡe laa ta kaa. 10Anomanta, men Kooro Hɛsɛkea kpɔ liire kɛŋɔ n ne Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ o baah bɛ ya nɛɛ di kohona. 11N bii, he bɛ bɔhwaah dɛɛ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ heyaa Korowii le ŋɔ he che o sie fuh daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma dɛɛ tɛo, dɛ́ tɔ nɛra sie baa tomɔ.”
12Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela dɛ pa mun dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee teŋa nɔ.
Le Kohat dea tena bini,
Amasae bibaa Mahat
ne Asaria bibaa Joel.
Le Merari dea tena bini,
Abdi bibaa Kes ne Jehalelɛl
bibaa Asaria.
Le Gɛsɔn dea tena bini,
Sima bibaa Joa ne Joa
bibaa Eden.
13Le Elisafan naanar bini,
Simri ne Jeyɛl.
Le Asaf naanar bini,
Sekaria ne Matania.
14Le Heman naanar ɡe bini,
Jehiel ne Simee.
Le Jedutun naanar bini,
Sɛmaya ne Usiel.
15Baa yerɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena cheme, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ kpɔ dɛ do ɡoroŋ la, ba kaa jo Korowii Dea la ɡe bini, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ o ta o do ɡoroŋ, ɡɛ kooro la aa do ba ɡɛ Korowii wa aa dɛ baɡle la. 16Sɔfore la ɡe jo Korowii Dea la bini, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ o ta kpɔ, o do ɡoroŋ ɡɛ tenten. Ba pa komɛlbwa aa lɔ o bini dɛ kah doŋa le ba Korowii Dea dembaah bela. Asɛ Lewi dea tena la chea le bela ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini. 17Ba pa ɡɛ waa nɔ mun korobie waa tɔ sie la tɔpeloɡle ta, asɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ba tel Korowii Dea pato la ta. Tɔpera anuatoro ja, dɛ ba tonɛ Korowii Dea la bini tenten toma. Ba tonɛ toma la bwa, korobie waa tɔ sie, o tɔpera fi dɛ anumɛl la ta.
Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta nɛɛtena
18Ate, Lewi dea tena la la Kooro Hɛsɛkea be dɛ ka ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, ya laa doŋa kpɔ Korowii Dea la bwa ta o do ɡoroŋ, ne kon baa dɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta ne o loɡa, ne teebur baa kpɔ paanoo aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ dawɛ o ta, dɛ o laala aa jaa bwa ta. 19Ya berɔ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ kwaa ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Ahas aa di kora, o waa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii, o le a ne kaa la ba. A cheɡɛ saraha kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la sie bela taraken.”
20Tɔ aa pera chɔmbibi la, Kooro Hɛsɛkea yerɛ Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme, asɛ ba la Korowii Dea bela. 21Ba kpɔ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ, ne pebiiri anuanɛ dɛ bombala anuanɛ, dɛ ka ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha tɛ harɛ la nɛra bwa, ne Korowii Dea la, dɛ Juda harɛ nɛra ɡe bwa. Kooro do Arɔn naanar baa ɛ sɔfore la ŋɔ, bá kpoo kwaa la kon baa kpoo kwaa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta. 22Asɛ sɔfore la tɔ sie kpoo nabala, dɛ kpoo pebala ne pebiiri la, dɛ kpɔ a chal merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta. 23Ba kpɔ boohna baa kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha la ba kooro ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa sie, asɛ ba kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ a nɛ. 24Asɛ sɔfore la kpoo boohna la, dɛ ɛ a chal ba merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ta, dɛ kpɔ soŋe Israel tena bwa wechɔɡa Korowii be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ kooro laanee do ba ŋɔ bá fuh kwaa ɛ saraha ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare la tɛ Israel tena bwa.
25Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɡelɔ Lewi dea tena la do Korowii Dea bela, dɛ kpoŋe kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne Gad waa dɛ na chaahna, dɛ Korowii keame Netan aa baɡla la. Korowiirii cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ dɛ do ba. 26Anomanta, dɛ Lewi dea tena iro che, dɛ kpoŋe Kooro Devid kwaa waa dɛ hɛlɛ ane la, asɛ sɔfore la ɡe kpoŋe ba bɛle.
27Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ ba kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la ba kon baa ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta la ta. Saraha ɛɛ la aa pa mun la, ba pa mun ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, asɛ bɛle ne kwaa Israel Kooro Devid aa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela ɡe ja. 28Nɛra baa cheme bela bwa pɛo dɛ ɡuŋi harɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, asɛ yelɡoola ɛɛ ɡo yela bɛlhoohla ɡee hoh ba bɛle. Gɛ waa nɔ bwa ɛo ka tel kɛŋɔ baa fuh saraha kwaa la tonɛ.
29Baa tonɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah tonɛ la, kooro ne nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la ɡuŋo, dɛ tomɛ Korowii. 30Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome ŋɔ Lewi dea tena be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ yela Kooro Devid ne o keame Asaf waa dɛ na chaahna aa chwera la kpɛɛ Korowii. Anomanta, ba ɡo kpɛɛra yela silɛɛ ne, dɛ ɡuŋi tomɛ Korowii.
31Anee Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Taraken te, he bwa kpɔ he te do Korowii nɔn ta, doŋa bɛlbwa toole he nɛɛ kpa. Hé kpo kwaa ɛ sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ jam kwaa ba Korowii Dea.” Anomanta, ba ba sarahare ne jam sarahare ne, asɛ bane le ba bambile bini, dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa dɛ fuah ba.
32Ba kpɔ nabala fifraanuanɛ ne pebala lafa, dɛ pebiiri lafraanɛ ba fuh ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii. 33Kwaa baa kpoora ɛ sarahare la lɔ nabala lafraanumɛl, dɛ peera ne boohna kaɡboŋa atoro. 34Dɛ sɔfore la ta warɛ, dɛ́ won swe ola baa kpoora dɛ́ fuah ɛ saraha la, anomanta, ba bala Lewi dea tena la cha ba dɛ swea tonɛ. Gɛ saŋ dɛ sɔfore baa dɔ bɔr dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ warɔ. Dɛ Lewi dea tena la waa dɔ kasinteŋ doŋa laa dɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ dɛ ɡwaa sɔfore la kwara. 35Dɛ saraha kwaa baa fuah la warɔ, dɛ ja ola noorare baa fuah ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, ne sen sarahare la ta.
Gɛɛ a do ba berɛ kwaa pa mun, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii Dea la bini. 36Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne nɛra la bwa sie lɛo, Korowii chae waa cha ba ba ɛ a ɡɛ waa la bwa warane la.

Title: 2 WEBENA 30
Content:
Kooro Hɛsɛkea Galekaa Tɔpejen dii
1Kooro Hɛsɛkea tomɛ nɛra Israel ne Juda harɛ ta, dɛ chwerɛ tɔn ta nɔn yerɛ Efrem ne Manasɛ deene tena ŋɔ, bá cheme Korowii Dea Jerusalam, dɛ́ di Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen la. 2Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome, dɛ nɛra baa cheme Jerusalam la bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ bá di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, korobinɛɛte ta. 3Dɛ baa di tɔpejen la o saŋ ta biɡro, dɛkalkɛ dɛ sɔfore ta warɛ dɛ́ won laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ bá do ɡoroŋ, asɛ dɛ nɛra la ɡe bwa aa won Jerusalam cheme. 4Dɛ waa nɔ maɡrɔ tɛ kooro ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa. 5Anomanta, ba yerɛ Israel harɛ nɛra le Dan waa lɔ weekaŋle nyunduabɔr, ka le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr ŋɔ, bá ba cheme Jerusalam dɛ́ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la sɔn ta. Dɛ nɛra ta warɛ dɛ ba di tɔpejen la, ɡɛ baa chwerɛ o waa do tɔn bini la bwa.
6Kooro la ɡelɔ toroma kpɔ tɔne la kaa Israel ne Juda harɛre bwa ta kɛŋɔ,
“Israel tena, he le Asiiria tena laa baa yo heyaa la nyoa. Hé berɛ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii Abraham ne Aesek dɛ Jekɔb aa tomɔ la, ásɛ o ɡe lawɛ heyaa ba o be. 7He bɛ do kɛ he naawa ne he bala Israel tena ba waa fa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la, asɛ o tɛr ba deŋne kohona ɡa he siwi ta la. 8He bɛ lwɛmkpeɡ ɛ kɛ ban, dɛ́ kpɔ he te do Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la lɔɡa. Hé ba o Dea waa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ saŋ bɛlbwa la bini Jerusalam, dɛɛ tomɔ ásɛ o bandia le he nɛ. 9Dɛ he berɔ kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii aa, aa ɡeloo nɛra baa lawɛ he lolanar laa ta kaa la dɔ tedoma tɛɛ ba, dɛ́ tɛɛ ba ŋwɛnɛ ba berɛ ba ya harɛ nɔ ta. Dɛkalkɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la dɔ tedoma dɛɛ na nɛn sum. Hé ba o be naa, waa habɔɔ berɛ kpo heya.”
10Toroma la le bela, dɛ la bwɛjen bɛlbwa ta Efrem ne Manasɛ deene harɛre ta, dɛ ka le Sebulon dea harɛ ɡe ta bwa, kɛ nɛra la mam ba dɛɛ muɡli ba baah. 11Kɛ dɛ ba bini bane le Aasa ne Manasɛ, dɛ Sebulon deene ta, dɛ sɛh kɛŋɔ baa ba Jerusalamee. 12Gɛɛ Korowii ɛ, dɛ ja Juda tena nɛ, dɛ ɡel ba dɔ nyopɛo, dɛ teŋɛ waa kooro ne o nomonome aa do ba la ta, ɡɛ waa bola la.
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii
13Korobinɛɛte ta la, nɛra warɔ dɛ ba cheme Jerusalam, dɛ di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen. 14Ba le kwaa harɛre ane nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡa aa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta ne Jerusalam, dɛ chɔɡ anɔ la baa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta, dɛ pa a bwa ka ta Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen bini.
15Korobinɛɛte tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, ba kpo Galekaa Tɔpejen pebie la. Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ, dɛ kpɔ saraha kwaa baa fuah la ba Korowii Dea. 16Ate, bɛlbwa ka che o chebɔr, ɡɛ Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis Mmarare aa dɛ baɡle la. Asɛ Lewi dea tena la kpɔ kwaa baa kpoora ɛ saraha chale la tɛ sɔfore la, asɛ ba ɛ merɛ saraha kon la ta. 17Nɛra la ɡalɡa aa wola doŋa bɛlbwa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ laa kpɔ dɛ do ɡoroŋ nomanta, Lewi dea tena laanee kpoo Galekaa Tɔpejen pebiiri la ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii tɛɛ ba. 18Nɛra ɡalɡa ba ɡe aa le Efrem ne Manasɛ ne Isaaka, dɛ Sebulon deene dɛ ba la, dɛ ba ta doŋa bɛlbwa laa kpɔ ba nɛ dɛ do ɡoroŋ, anomanta, dɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa nee baa di Galekaa Tɔpejen la. Asɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba dɛ ŋɔ, 19“N Naa Korowii ya naawa aa tomɛ, che he wer haa doa ta dɛ́ kpɔ kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ bambile bwa ne nɔ, a lole kɛŋɔ ba ta doŋa laa kpɔ ba nɛ.” 20Asɛ Korowii no Kooro Hɛsɛkea wesoŋa la, o kpɔ ba wechɔɡa kɛ ba, o ta ban wobɛlbwa ɛɛ.
21Israel tena aa baa cheme Jerusalam la, ba di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole a ta Tɔpejen la silɛɛ kohona ne, tɔpera anuanɛ. Asɛ Lewi dea tena ne sɔfore ɡe kpɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ lɔ yela, dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii kohona tɔpere bɛlbwa, bokpeɡa bwa ne.
22Kooro Hɛsɛkea jam Lewi dea tena wejema ne kpɛɛra baa dɔa, dɛ kpɔ cha tɔpejen la dii la. Tɔpera anuanɛ bwa la, ba tɛɛ ba saraha kwaa aa ɛ ba dibɔra la ba di, dɛ ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la.
23Nɛra la bwa sɛoh kɛŋɔ ba berɛ di tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ ja. Anomanta, ba berɔ di tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ silɛɛ ne ja. 24Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea tɛ nɛra baa cheme bela nabala kaɡboŋ, dɛ boohna ne peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ, asɛ o nomonome la ɡe tɛɛ ba nabala kaɡboŋ, dɛ boohna ne peera kaɡboŋa fi. Asɛ sɔfore baa wara laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ, ba do ɡoroŋ. 25Anomanta, Juda tena baa cheme bela sie lɛo kohona, ba ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ Israel tena baa ba bela bwa, ne hɔɔhra baa le Israel ne Juda harɛre ta bwa. 26Silɛɛ kohona ba Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛ, le Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa di kora Israel harɛ ta bwa, a ɡɛ waa nɔ dɔŋa ta chiɡe bwa. 27Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la iro, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ nɛra la, asɛ Korowii no ba wesoŋa le nyundua dɛ ɛ tɛɛ ba.

Title: 2 WEBENA 31
Content:
Kooro Hɛsɛkea mmarafala dɔe wa
1Baa di tɔpejen la tonɛ la, Israel tena baa lɔ bela la jo Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta, dɛ paɡre bwea baa paaɡa dɛɛ duura, dɛ teŋni voɡ Asera dajaŋa ta. Ba chɔɡ bɔra baa dɛ tomɛ voɡare deŋɡarere ta, ne kwaa baa dɛ ɛ sarahare a ta, Juda harɛ ne Bɛnjamen ne Efrem, dɛ Manasɛ harɛre deene ta bwa. Baa chɔɡ a bwa tonɛ la, asɛ ba bwa berɛ kaa ba bwɛɛre.
2Kooro Hɛsɛkea bɔne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bini, ɡɛ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛɛ ɛ o toma. Asɛ ba fuh kwaa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛro o Dea doonyoo la ta. 3Kooro Hɛsɛkea lawɛ o ɡbaɡba nae ne boohna ne peera tɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ɛ sarahare baa dɛ fuah chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra, ne Ona Tɔpera ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, dɛ tɔpejena ane baa lea cheɡ ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara tɔn bini la. 4Kooro berɔ ŋɔ Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, bá kpɔ saraha kwaa aa chɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la dɛɛ tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ aa ɛ, ásɛ ba won kpɔ ba te tɛ kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ ɡɛ Korowii Mmara la aa dɛ baɡle. 5Baa no waa kooro aa bola la, Israel tena la le ba bambile ta, dɛ kpɔ ba kooni kondikonloɡla kɛŋɔ mea ne senfala, ne ɔleve noo ne tooh dɛ kondikwa bɛlbwa baa dɔa dɛ le kooni ta, ba tɛ Korowii toma. Kwaa baa ba a ne warɔ kɛrɛdɛ. Nomɛlbwa bɔne komɛlbwa waa dɔa bini bɔre fi, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba. 6Israel ne Juda baala baa soɡe Juda harɛ bwɛɛre ta ɡe bɔne ba nae ne boohna dɛ peera bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba. Gɛɛ ba kpɔ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii ba, dɛ bila a daŋɛ chɔ. 7Ba pa mun le korobitooro te ta ba koŋkɛɛla la ne, dɛ ba tel korobinuanɛ te ta. 8Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nomonome aa baa na ɡɛ koŋkɛɛla la aa daŋa chɔ la, ba kpɛɛ Korowii, dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛ o nɛra Israel tena.
9Kooro Hɛsɛkea pɛɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la koŋkɛɛla nɔ wa, 10asɛ Sɔfonomoa Asaria waa ɛ Sadɔk lole la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Dɛ le saŋ nɛra la aa pa mun kpɔ koŋkɛɛla dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea bonɔ la, ya dɔɔ dɛɛ di, ásɛ ane ka chɔ warɛ, dɛkalkɛ Korowii swee o nɛra andɛɛɡa, asɛ andamanta nɔ ta ka dɛ daŋɛ chɔ la.”
11Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɡel ba kwaa deene baa dɛɛ cheɡ laala a bini Korowii Dea bɔr bela. 12Asɛ ba pa koŋkɛɛla la ne kwaa baa bɔne a bini fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa ba, dɛ kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii la cheɡ bela. Ba kpɔ Lewi dea te bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Konania ɛ nomoa ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi a ta, asɛ o nime Simee ja o nɛ. 13Ba le Lewi dea tena nɛra fi ŋɔ bá do Konania ne o nime Simee lɔɡa dɛɛ ɛ toma bela. Banee, Jehiel ne Asasia ne Nahat, ne Asahɛl ne Jerimot ne Josabad ne Eliel, ne Ismakia ne Mahat dɛ Bɛnaya. Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Sɔfonomoa Asaria kpeɡri taa a che, ba lee ba.
14Lewi dea te Imna bibaa Koree ba le wɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea wee leebɔr doonyoa la ta, dɛ chɔ sarahare koŋkɛɛla aa le nɛra bambile ta ba kpɔ baa tɛ Korowii ne a bɔna nyoa. 15Dɛ Kore dɔ o bala Lewi dea tena baa chao bwɛɛre ane sɔfore aa soɡe a ta. Banee, Eden ne Miniamin ne Jesua ne Sɛmaya ne Amaria dɛ Sɛkania. Ba ɡe dɛ lɛ koŋkɛɛla la dɛ bɔna kasinteŋ ne tɛ Lewi dea tena baa lɔ bela ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa, bechala kɛɛ nomoa toole.
16Ba berɔ dɛɛ tɛ bibaala baa di bene atoro, kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa ba chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ la. Gɛ ba bini bɛlbwa waa jo Korowii Dea bela, ka ɛ toma baa kpɔa do o nɔn ta tɔpere bɛlbwa la aa doa. 17Ba bɔne tomare tɛ sɔfore la ɡɛ baa chwerɛ ba sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ lolanar ta, dɛ tɛ Lewi dea tena ɡe baa di bene fifraanɛ kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa, ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma ne dea waa le o ta aa doa. 18Bane ba haahna ne ba bechale, dɛ nɛra ba ne baa soɡa sɔnaa ba chwerɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ kasinteŋ dɛɛ ɛ toma baa lea cheɡ tɛ Korowii.
19Kɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar dɛ so harɛre baa dɛ parɛ a ta, dɛ so ba bwɛɛre ta kɛɛ bobɛlbwa la te, ba le baala ba bɔne kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ baala baa le sɔfore dea, ne nomɛlbwa baa chwerɛ o sɔn o le Lewi dea la bwa.
20Gɛɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɛ Juda harɛ ta bwa, dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera dɛ toɡre Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la be. 21Wobɛlbwa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa Korowii Dea Jerusalam, ne ɡɛ waa teŋɛ Korowii Mmarare, ne waa waa doo a ta bambile bwa ne la ɡelɔ o wobɛlbwa chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ.

Title: 2 WEBENA 32
Content:
Asiiria Koojen Senakerib kaa yo Juda tena
1Waa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa kasinteŋ ne la bwa habɔɔ, Asiiria koojen Senakerib kpɔ o laa tena ba lɔ tɔ Juda harɛ nɛra nɛ. O ɡelɔ o laa tena chɔ bar bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa, dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ won yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ. 2Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa naa kɛŋɔ Koojen Senakerib balɔ dɛɛ nyin ó ba yo Jerusalam tena la, 3o ne o nomonome ne o laa nomonome chemo, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ bá tɔɔɡe neerare nyuune aa lɔ Jerusalam dahare, asɛ ba sɛh dɛ chao. 4Belaa nɛra warɛ dɛ cheme, dɛ tɔɔɡe neerare nyuune bwa, ne nee waa pala dɛ kpɔ harɛ la ta bwa dɛ ŋɔ, “A chɛ kɛ Asiiria koranar ba ya be dɛ́ ba na nee nyɔ aa?” 5Kooro Hɛsɛkea ɛ toma taeh, dɛ ɡel ba kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la bobɛla aa kuuɡa la, dɛ ma dejaŋa chɔŋɛ danjwɛɛ la ta. O berɔ ɡel ba ma danjwɛfale bɛl bar ombene la, dɛ che bwea su harɛ waa ɛ bɔɔ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta. O berɔ ɛ dɔmkwaa ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta warɛ.
6Kooro Hɛsɛkea le laa sitɔɔla ba chɔ baala baa lɔ Jerusalam nyoo, dɛ ɡel ba ba cheme o sie bela bwɛɛla bwa yon dɛɛ cheme bwɛjen la doonyojen ta, asɛ dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, 7“Hé che kiŋkiŋ, hé dɔ bambile. He bɛ ɔmɛ, he bɛ ɡel he bwara yɔr Asiiria koojen ne o laa tena baa wara kohona nɔ wa. Kpeɡri waa ja ya nɛɛ la ɡwaa kpeɡri waa ja ba nɛ. 8Nɛwɛnyini kpeɡrii ba dɔ, kɛ ya te, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee dɛ́ cha yaa, dɛ́ yo tɛ yaa.” Ate, nɛra la dɔ hwɛɡa dɛ le waa Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa bola la ta.
9A habɔɔ la, Asiiria koojen Senakerib ne o laa tena baa chɔ bar bwɛjen Lakes, anomanta, o tomɛ o nomonome Jerusalam ba kpɔ kala ka tɛ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne o nɛra baa lɔ bela ŋɔ,
10“Men Asiiria koojen Senakerib, n dɛ bɔɔ he Jerusalam tena waa haa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta dɛ ta so bela n laa tena tɔ heyaa do la. 11Kooro Hɛsɛkea ŋɔ, ‘Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ lɛ heyaa le n nɔn taa,’ yaa, neɡraa wɛɛ neɡre heya, ásɛ nyɔɡre ne lɔr kpo heyaa he serewe. 12Kooro Hɛsɛkea laa paɡre kwaa baa ɛ saraha a ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ne bela baa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ŋɔ Juda ne Jerusalam tena be ŋɔ, báa tomɛ dɛɛ fuh daawiile saraha kombeŋkpoŋ ɡbo ta la aa?
13Hé ta ɡɛ n ne n naawa aa kpɔa ɛ harɛre nɛra noɛ kɛɛ? Gɛ harɛre la voɡare wono lɛ a nɛra le n nɔn ta naa? 14Harɛre nɔ voɡ besoo n naawa aa chɔɡa wona lɛ a nɛra le n be nɔ? Ɛrɛɛ voɡ haa dɛ tomɔ ɛɛ ba wona lɛ heyaa le n nɔn ta nɔ? 15He bɛ ɡel Kooro Hɛsɛkea lɔ nepor ta he sie ta, dɛɛ neɡre heyaa ɡɛ. Harɛ bɛlbwa voɡ ta wone lɛ o harɛ le Asiiria koojen bɛlbwa nɔn ta bwa. He voɡ haa dɛ tomɔ nɔ laa dɛ́ won lɛ heya!”
16Gɛɛ Asiiria koojen Senakerib nomonome teŋɛ bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii ne o bonɔɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea kohona. 17Koojen Senakerib chwerɛ tɔne dɛ chɛɡre Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Gɛ harɛre ane voɡare aa wola wone lɛ a nɛra n be la, ɡɛɛ voɡ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa dɛ tomɔ la aa wola won lɛ o nɛra.” 18Ate, nomonome la kpɔ takpeɡ dɛ bol waa waa bola la Hibru tena wobol ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ nɛra baa cheɡɛ Jerusalam danjwɛɛ ta ɔmɛ, ásɛ o dɔ bɔr ba lawɛ bwɛjen la tena. 19Ba bol waa yaɡɛ Korowii Jerusalam tena aa dɛ tomɔ, ɡɛ tenten baa bol harɛre ane voɡare nɛwɛnyini aa kpɔ nɔn ɛa la.
20Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya wi no Korowii ŋɔ ó cha ba. 21Asɛ Korowii tomɛ nyundua torome bɛl o ba kpoo Asiiria laa tena ne ba laa sitɔɔla, dɛ nomonome baa lɔ bela baa soɡa bwa. Anomanta, Koojen Senakerib kpɔ sihiih berɛ ba kaa Asiiria harɛ ta. Waa laŋa la, o kaa jo o voɡ dea, asɛ o bibaala bane ka kpoo keri ne.
22Gɛɛ a do Korowii lɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Jerusalam tena le Asiiria koojen Senakerib, ne ba dɔma baa kaa bwa nɔn ta. O ɡelɔ ba dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna le harɛre aa bar ba nɛra nɛ. 23Nɛra warɔ kpɔ saraha kwaa ba tɛ Korowii Jerusalam pirim, ne koŋkɛɛla a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ba tɛ Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea. Le bela dɛɛ kaa la, harɛre nɛra bwa kpɔ jirima tɛo kohona.
Kooro Hɛsɛkea weela ne o mbarafo ɛɛ
24Aa ba dɛ la sie la, weela lɔ Kooro Hɛsɛkea wɛɛ ba sewa. Asɛ o soŋe Korowii a wa ŋɔ, ó ɡel o na waane kɛŋɔ waa sewɛ. 25Kɛ mbarafo nomanta, o siwi ta waa Korowii aa ɛa tɛo la sui, anomanta, Korowii baah di o ne Juda ne Jerusalam tena nɛ. 26Ate, Kooro Hɛsɛkea ne Jerusalam tena charɛ ba liire le mbarafo we-ɛɛla la ta, anomanta, Korowii bandia ta ba nɛɛ balɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea bere saŋ waa di kora.
27Kooro Hɛsɛkea dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima taeh, asɛ dɛ ma deene dɛɛ cheɡ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ne konsɔɔhsoma, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe laa ta, dɛ kondɛɛɡa bwa soo siwi a bini. 28O berɔ ma dea waa dɛ cheɡ mea ne senfala, dɛ ɔleve no. Dɛ do naleɡa ne peera leɡa tɛ o nae ne peera. 29A habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡelɔ o dɔ suuɡa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ dɔ nae ne peera taeh, asɛ dɛ vɔrɔwe bwɛɛre ɡe.
30Gɛ saŋ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa di kora la, onee ɡela ba kwi bɔɔ le Gehɔn bule ta, asɛ nee kpɔ o bini palɛ dɛɛ ba Jerusalam. Kasinteŋ, wobɛlbwa Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa la, a chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ. 31A balɔ kɛŋɔ Babelɔn harɛ ta nomonome tomɛ nɛra Kooro Hɛsɛkea be ŋɔ, bá ba pɛɛro ŋwɛnɛ waa cheɡɛ o ta, dɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla la o harɛ la ta. Asɛ Korowii le o habɔɔ, dɛ daahno na kɛ wɛɛ di kasinteŋii kɛɛ.
32Waane ɡe Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, ne ɡɛ waa kpɔ o te tɛ Korowii la bwa, ba chwera do Emɔɔs bibaa Korowii keame Aesaya waa waa naa chaahna ta do Juda ne Israel Koranar Waa Tɔn bini. 33Kooro Hɛsɛkea sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo deŋɡare bɛl ta, bela baa dɛ huɡe Kooro Devid naanar. Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa kpɔ duure tɛo o serewe wee. Asɛ o bibaa Manasɛ ba chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 33
Content:
Kooro Manasɛ di kora Juda harɛ
1Kooro Manasɛ aa baa di kora Juda harɛ ta la, dɛ o di bene fi dɛ anɛ. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fifraanue dɛ anue. 2O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, dɛ teŋɛ harɛre nɛra baa tɔ sie ba so bela, Korowii aa doŋ ba le ba harɛre ta tɛ Israel tena we-ɛɛla baa ɛa Korowii kia la ta. 3Kooro Manasɛ kwaarɔ cheɡ voɡa o mɛɛ Kooro Hɛsɛkea aa paɡra bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ la, dɛ berɛ ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta tɛ voɡ Baal waa ɛ baa, dɛ paaɡe voɡhaah Asera dajaŋa, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Ahab fa aa ɛa la. O berɔ tomɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie, dɛ weweela bwa. 4O ɛ kwaa voɡtoroma aa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta Korowii Dea, bela Korowii aa ŋɔa belaa a chɛ kɛ baa tomɔ saŋ bɛlbwa la. 5Korowii Dea dembaahna anɛ la bini la, o ɛ kwaa baa dɛ ɛ saraha a ta, baa tomɛ kwaa aa lɔ nyundua kɛŋɔ wee ne korobie, dɛ weweela. 6O kpoo o bibaala, dɛ fuuh ba ɛ saraha Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen bini. O ɛ sɔm we-ɛɛla, dɛ voɡɛ dɛ yerɛ lala, dɛ la tɛɡre tena be. O ɛ wechɔɡa taeh, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ dɛ ir o bandia kohona.
7Kooro Manasɛ sɛh voɡ dɛ kpɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea, bela Korowii aa ŋɔ Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Kooro Solomɔn be ŋɔ, “Dea nɔ ne Jerusalamee n le cheɡ, dɛ le Israel deene bwa bini kɛŋɔ baa tom mɛ o bini saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la la. 8Dɛ Israel tena ɛɛ teŋɛ waa maa do ba a ta, ne mmarare la bwa n fa aa cheɡɛ n bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛɛ ba la ta tenaa, maa ɡel ba doŋ ba le harɛ maa kpɔa tɛ ba naawa la ta.” 9Kooro Manasɛ ɡelɔ Juda harɛ ta nɛra nyoɡre, dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa ɡwaa harɛre nɛra Korowii fa aa doŋ ba le o nɛra Israel tena sie la.
10Korowii kah Kooro Manasɛ ne o nɛra, kɛ ba vɛh o be noe. 11Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ Asiiria koojen laa sitɔɔla ne ba laa tena lɔ ba tɔ Juda harɛ tena nɛɛ dɛ yoo ba. Ba lawɛ Kooro Manasɛ, dɛ do ɡoŋa o mee ta, dɛ vɔrɔwo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre ne, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta. 12O bwara aa ba dɛ nyɛɡo la, o soŋe Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ la, dɛ pwɛr o te tɛo. 13Korowii no o wesoŋa, a che a ta o ɡel ba berɛ kpɔɔ ba Jerusalam o ba di kora ja. Anɔɔ ɡela Kooro Manasɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowii ɛ kasinteŋ Korowii.
14A habɔɔ la, Kooro Manasɛ ɡelɔ ba kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa lɔ Jerusalam, waa ɛ Kooro Devid Bwɛjen habɔɔ la, dɛ le Gehɔn bule waa lɔ felembɔjen bini wee cholibɔr, dɛ kaa Pɛŋe Doonyoa waa bar Ofel deŋɡare bɔr. O ɡelɔ ba mao o do jaŋne kohona, asɛ o kpɔ laa sitɔɔla ka so Juda harɛ bwɛjena baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa bara bwa ta.
