15O berɔ le harɛre ane voɡa, ne voɡ waa sɛah ka cheɡ Korowii Dea, ne kwaa waa ɛa ba kpoo kwaa a ta ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare, a do Korowii Dea deŋɡare doa Jerusalam la bwa ne, dɛ paa le bwɛjen la bini ka ta. 16O berɔ ɡel ba kwaa ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la, asɛ o kpoo kwaa ɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ne jam sarahare o ta. O ŋɔ Juda harɛ nɛra be ŋɔ, bá tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la. 17A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ bela voɡtoroma aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa laanee nɛra la kaa ɛ sarahare, kɛ dɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la ɡboo ba yon ɛ dɛɛ tɛ.
18Kooro Manasɛ waa waa ɛa bwa, ne soŋa waa soŋe Korowii o naawa aa tomɔ, ne waa Korowii keamere aa bol o be Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta la, ba chwera do Israel Koranar Waa Tɔne Bini. 19Gɛ waa soŋe Korowii asɛ o no o be, ne o wechɔɡa waa ɛa mɔɔ dɛ charɛ o liire, ne bɔra waa ɛa tɛ voɡtoroma baa tomɛ voɡare, ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa waa paaɡa, dɛ voɡa waa toma la, ba chwera do Korowii Keamere Waa Tɔne bini. 20Kooro Manasɛ sewɔ ka pu o naawa, asɛ ba huɡo o koodem. Asɛ o bibaa Amɔn chiɡ o naa ta, dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Amɔn wa
21Kooro Amɔn aa di kora la, dɛ o di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene anɛ. 22Kooro Amɔn ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ɡɛ o mɛɛ Kooro Manasɛ aa ɛa la, dɛ tomɛ voɡa o mɛɛ fa aa toma la, dɛ kpoo kwaa dɛɛ tɛa. 23Kooro Amɔn ta o te pwɛrɛ tɛ Korowii kɛ o mɛɛ, dɛ o wechɔɡa ɡwaa o mɛɛ kwaa kohona.
24Kooro Amɔn nomonome la bini bane vɔrɔwe o vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo o koodem. 25Asɛ Juda harɛ nɛra kpoo nɛra baa vɔrɔwe Kooro Amɔn vɔrɔwa dɛ kpoo la. Dɛ kpɔ o bibaa Josia chiɡ o naa ta, o di kora.

Title: 2 WEBENA 34
Content:
Kooro Josia di kora Juda harɛ
1Josia aa di kora dɛ o dɔ bene anuatoro. O soɡe Jerusalam dɛ di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ beŋkpoŋ. 2O ɛ waa aa too Korowii tea, o teŋɛ waa o nabaa Kooro Devid aa ɛa ta. O teŋɛ Korowii waa ta kɛrɛdɛ.
3Kooro Josia aa di kora bene anuatoro la, dɛ o ta ɛ bonɔmbi, asɛ o pa mun dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o nabaa Kooro Devid aa tomɔ la. Bene fi dɛ anɛ ta la, o pa mun dɛɛ chɔɡ bela Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam tena aa dɛ tomɛ voɡa, ne voɡ Asera dajaŋa ne voɡare baa sɛah ne anɔ la bwa aa jaa. 4Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba chɔɡ voɡ Baalre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta dɛɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa dɛ fuh daawiile a ta a bɛna la, dɛ kuuɡi Asera voɡare ne voɡare bwa soo siwi burbur ken, dɛ paa ka ta nɛra baa ɛ sarahare a ta mɔɔ dɛ serewe la ŋwama ta. 5O ɡelɔ ba fuh kerekpoŋra baa soɡe voɡa ta hoɡa kwaa baa ɛ sarahare a ta la doa. Gɛɛ o ɛ dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ le voɡa toma ne, Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam. 6Gɛ tentenee o ɛ Manasɛ ne Efrem ne Simeon, dɛ Naftale deene harɛ bwɛjena aa paɡra bwa ta. 7Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba paɡre kwaa baa kpoo kwaa a ta, dɛ ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ voɡare la, dɛ chɔɡ voɡ Asera dajaŋa Israel harɛ ta bobɛlbwa. O paɡre voɡare la mohooh ken, dɛ paɡre kwaa baa fuh konsɔɔhsoma a ta dɛɛ tɛ voɡare la ɡe, dɛ berɛ laa berɛ kaa Jerusalam.
8Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro ta, dɛɛ nyin o laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ harɛ la ne Korowii Dea la, o tomɛ Asalia bibaa Safan, ne harɛ nomoa Maaseya waa lɔ Jerusalam, dɛ Joahas bibaa Joa waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔn bini ŋɔ, bá la ka kwaa Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la Dea.
9Ba la Sɔfonomoa Hilkia be, dɛ kpɔ suuɡa Lewi dea tena baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo aa lɛa le Manasɛ ne Efrem deene tena, ne Israel tena baa kaa la be, ne Juda harɛ nɛra bwa, ne Bɛnjamen dea tena, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ Jerusalam tena be la ba tɛo. 10Asɛ ba kpɔ do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea kwaara ta la nɔn ta, ásɛ ba kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea la kem. 11Ba berɔ tɛ kapenta tena ne demamaala suuɡa ŋɔ bá kpɔ yawɛ daa ne bwea, dɛ́ kwaa deene Juda koranar aa ɡela a chɔɡ la.
12Tom-ɛɛra la ɛ toma kasinteŋ ne. Baala baa lee ba baa nyiŋi ba nɛɛ laanee, Lewi dea tena Jahat ne Obadia dɛ le Merari dea, ne Sekaria dɛ Mɛsolam ba ɡe aa ɛ Lewi dea tena dɛ le Kohat dea. Dɛ ba bwa dɔ kwaa baa kpɔa dɛ hɛlɛ wejema, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ hɛlɛ kɛrɛdɛ. 13Dɛ Lewi dea tena bane ɡe chɔ tom-ɛɛra nyoa, dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra bwa soo siwi nɛ, ba tomare ta. Ba bini bane chwerɛ waa dɛɛ do tɔne bini, bane ɡe chwerɛ webena aa chiɡa dɛɛ bil, bane ɡe ɛɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoone.
Ba na Korowii Mmara Tɔn la
14Baa laa suuɡa la dɛɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea bela baa cheɡa la, sɔfo Hilkia na Korowii Mmara Tɔn waa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ, o nyoɡre la. 15Asɛ sɔfo Hilkia ŋɔ karake Safan waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil la be ŋɔ, “N na Korowii Mmara Tɔn waa nyoɡra la Korowii Dea.” Asɛ o kpɔ tɔn la tɛ Safan.
16Ate, Safan kpɔ tɔn la la Kooro Josia be dɛ ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, he nomonome ɛ wobɛlbwa haa kpɔa do ba nɔn ta kɛrɛdɛ.” 17Ba kpɔ suuɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea la do nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra la nɛɛ, ne tom-ɛɛra la nɔn ta. 18Ate, Safan waa ɛ karake dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil la, berɛ ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, “N naa, sɔfo Hilkia kpɔ tɔn bɛl tɛ mɛ.” Asɛ o che kooro sie bela kure tɔn la bini waa baɡlo.
19Kooro Josia aa no Mmara Tɔn la bini waa la, o laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o dɛ di suna. 20Buɡ la ta, kooro do sɔfo Hilkia ne Safan bibaa Ahikam, ne Maeka bibaa Abdɔn dɛ Safan waa ɛ karake, dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ o bonɔɔ Asaya be ŋɔ, 21“Hé la ka bɔɔ le Korowii be tɛ n ne nɛra baa ka Israel ne Juda, tɔn nɔ baa ɡaaɡa dɛ ka nao nɔ wa. Korowii baah di n ne Juda harɛ nɔ ta nɛra bwa nɛɛ taeh, dɛkalkɛ ya naawa ta waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ bini nɔ ta teŋɛ.”
22Anee sɔfo Hilkia ne Ahikam ne Akbɔ ne Safan, dɛ Asaya la Korowii keame bɛl waa ɛ haah baa yerɔ Hulda be, dɛ ka bɔɔ le o be. Dɛ Korowii keame Hulda soɡe Jerusalam bampera bofale. O jaaree Tikva bibaa Salum, asɛ o nabaa sɔne Haahas. Onee dɛɛ nyiŋi Korowii Dea batakaarere ta.
23Korowii keame Hulda ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la ŋɔ, “Hé la ka ŋɔ Kooro Josia waa tomɛ heyaa la be ŋɔ, 24Korowii ŋɔ o dɛ ba Jerusalam nɛra deŋne tɛra, ɡɛ waa baa chwera do Juda kooro tɔn bini aa dɛ baɡle la, 25dɛkalkɛ ba vɛɛh mɛ dɛ ka fuh konsɔɔhsoma voɡa ta, dɛɛ muɡli n baah voɡa ba ɡbaɡba aa ɛa ne. N baah ɛɛ di ba nɛɛ bonɔ kohonaa, aa wola sɔɔh bwa. 26Hé ŋɔ Juda kooro waa tomɛ heyaa ŋɔ hé ka bɔɔ le Korowii be la be ŋɔ waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola, waa waa noa dɛ le tɔn la bini laanee nɔ. 27Haa kure tɔn la dɛ no Jerusalam nɛra deŋnetɛra, he loo ku he kɛɛ he batakaare haa doa, dɛ ba he te ne harɛ dɛɛ wi nomanta, n no he wii haa wia la bwa. 28Anomanta, mɛɛ ɡeloo he sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ta ka pu he naawa. Haa deŋnetɛra kohona men Korowii aa dɛ ba a ne bala ba ta nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta laanee na.”
Asɛ toroma la ka ŋɔ waa la Kooro Josia be.
29Asɛ Kooro Josia yerɛ Juda ne Jerusalam nomonome bwa cheme. 30O ne Juda baala ne Jerusalam tena, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, le bechale nɛɛ ba kaa nomonjena bwa nɛɛ ba Korowii Dea. Asɛ kooro kure Korowii Ne Nɛwɛnyina Fɔo Tɔn waa nyoɡra ba nao Korowii Dea la, asɛ ba bwa no. 31Kooro Josia cheɡɛ o koochebɔr pila bɛl jwɛh, o ne Korowii berɛ kwaa fɔwɛ fɔo ŋɔ wɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii nɛɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ waa waa bola ne o Mmarare ta o bambile ne o liire bwa ne.
32Asɛ o ɡel Jerusalam ne Bɛnjamen dea tena bwa baa lɔ bela ŋwɛɛ ntam ŋɔ, baa dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la fɔo la taa.
33Kooro Josia ɡelɔ ba le voɡa Korowii aa kia bwa ne Israel harɛ bwa ta, asɛ dɛ ɡel nɛra baa soɡe bela bwa tomɛ Korowii. Waa soɡe le la, o ta ɡelɛ ba vɛh Korowii ba naawa fa aa tomɔ la toma bwa.

Title: 2 WEBENA 35
Content:
Kooro Josia Galekaa Tɔpejen dii
1Kooro Josia di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Jerusalam Korowii sɔn ta, dɛ kpo pebie waa kpɔa di tɔpejen la korobiloɡle tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta. 2O kpɔ tomare sɔfore la aa ɛ do ba nɔn ta, dɛ do ba ɡbemba ŋɔ bɛlbwa ɛ o toma kɛrɛdɛ Korowii Dea bela. 3O ŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ, dɛ le ba te cheɡ tɛ Korowii dɛɛ ɛ toma o Dea, dɛɛ baɡle nɛra o Mmarare la be ŋɔ, “Hé kpɔ Korowii Fɔo Daka waa do ɡoroŋ la ka cheɡ Korowii Dea Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa doo la bini. He bɛ che dɛɛ ɡaaɡe kpa, dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii ne o nɛra Israel tena. 4Hé ka che he chebɔra Korowii Dea la bini denaa ta, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Kooro Solomɔn aa bɔne tomare tɛ heya, Korowii Dea bela la.
5Hé bɔne he bini, dɛ́ che Dea la bini, ásɛ dɛ won dɛɛ cha lolanar bɛlbwa baa lɔ bela Israel tena la bini. 6Hé kpoo Galekaa Tɔpejen pebiiri la, dɛ́ sɔ he doŋa ta, dɛ́ do ɡoroŋ Korowii be pera, ásɛ dɛ kwaa saraha kwaa la tɛ he bala la, ásɛ ba won dɛɛ teŋɛ waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ bol la ta.”
7Kooro Josia lawɛ peera ne boohna kaɡboŋa fifraatoro, dɛ nae kaɡboŋa atoro tɛ nɛmpɛɛne la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ Galekaa sarahare.
8Kooro nomonome ɡe le ba bambile ta kpɔ kwaa tɛ nɛra la ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena. Asɛ Sɔfonomoa Hilkia ne Sekaria dɛ Jehiel baa ɛ nomonome, dɛɛ nyiŋi toma aa lɔ Korowii Dea la ɡe le ba bambile ta, dɛ tɛ nɛra la pebiiri ne boohna kaɡboŋa anɛ lafraanumɛl, dɛ nabala lafraatoro ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ sarahare Galekaa Tɔpejen la ta. 9Konania ne o nimanar Sɛmaya ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Hasabia ne Jeyɛl dɛ Josabad, ba bwa aa ɛ Lewi dea tena nomonome la ɡe lawɛ pebiiri ne bombiire kaɡboŋa anue, ne nabala lafraanue tɛ Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen sarahare la.
10Baa ɛ wobɛlbwa tonɛ, dɛ pa Galekaa Tɔpejen la dii mun la, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la kaa che ba chebɔra ɡɛ Kooro Josia aa ŋɔa la. 11Baa kpoo pebiiri ne bombiire la tonɛ la, sɔfore la kpɔ a chal merɛ kon baa ɛ saraha o ta dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta, asɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ɛɛ swea. 12Ba laa anɔ la baa fuah ɛ sarahare la kpɔ, dɛ bɔna denaa ta tɛ nɛra la, asɛ ba kpɔ ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa lɔ Mosis Tɔn bini la. Gɛ tentenee ba ɛ nabali la ɡe. 13Lewi dea tena la wɔɔ Galekaa Tɔpejen ola la ɡɛ baa baɡla, dɛ daa anɔ la aa do ɡoroŋ la viine ne loɡa bwa soo siwi ne, dɛ bɔne ola la warane tɛ nɛra la bwa. 14Anɔ habɔɔ, Lewi dea tena la yon kpɔ ola la ane, dɛ tɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar sɔfore la ɡe, dɛkalkɛ jwaana bwaa sɔfore la yon so dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa ne a noorare bɔra la. Gɛɛ Lewi dea tena la yon laa ba dibɔr kpɔ, dɛ laa anɔ la ɡe aa ɛ sɔfore baa le Arɔn luɡe ta dibɔr kpɔ tɛɛ ba.
15Asaf naanar bane baa ɛ yelɡoola, yon ka che ba chebɔra, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne Asaf ne Heman, dɛ kooro keame Jedutun aa do ba la. Nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo la ta chɛ kɛ bɛlbwa le kɛrɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba bala Lewi dea tena la daa Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la ane baa tɛɛ ba.
16Anomanta, awola tɔpere la te, ba dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen la Korowii sɔn ta, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa kon baa ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ Korowii la ta, ɡɛ Kooro Josia aa do ba la. 17Israel tena baa lɔ bela la di Galekaa Tɔpejen la, ne Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ. 18Le Korowii keame Samoɛl bere saŋ, ba ta Galekaa Tɔpejen waa do ken dii bwa. Gɛɛ Israel kooro bɛlbwa ɡe aa wola Galekaa Tɔpejen dii, kɛŋɔ Kooro Josia kon o ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea ne Juda ne Israel tena, dɛ Jerusalam tena nɔ dɔŋ dii bwa. 19Kooro Josia aa di kora bene fi dɛ anuatoro taa ba di ɡɛ Galekaa Tɔpejen nɔ.
Kooro Josia Kora dii jaɡa
20Kooro Josia aa ɛ anɔ bwa, dɛ kwaa Korowii Dea tonɛ la, Ijipt Kooro Neko kpɔ o laa tena dɛ́ ka yo laa Kaakɛmes waa lɔ Yufretis Moo nyoa. Kooro Josia kpɔ o laa tena ka chem ba, dɛ yoo ba. 21Kɛ Kooro Neko kpɔ kala tɛ Juda Kooro Josia ŋɔ, “Juda kooro, n ne he laa dɛɛ yo laa nɔ, n ne n dɔmaa mɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yoo ba, asɛ Korowii ŋɔ ń ɛ warane, o cheɡɛ n mun ta, anomanta, bɛ men tɔŋle, ásɛ o ba kpoe.”
22Ane a bwa, dɛ Kooro Josia ta dɛ nyin ó ka yo. O ta waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ Kooro Neko nɛɛ dɛ bol la ta teŋɛ, anomanta, o beɡre o te dɛ la ka yoo Meɡido harɛ waa chɔa kaa la ta.
23Baa dɛ yo la, Ijipt laa tena ta hɛm yaɡɛ Kooro Josia, asɛ o ŋɔ o bonɔɔna be ŋɔ, “Hé le n ne bonɔ kaa, ba do mɛ bol kohona.” 24Kooro Josia bonɔɔna lawɔ le o torɔɡo bini, dɛ kpɔɔ do onfale waa lɔ bela bini kaa Jerusalam. O sewɛ bela ba huɡo o naawa hoɡa ta, asɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena bwa ɛ o lwe.
25Korowii keame Jeremia taa Kooro Josia wiile. Dɛ kpoŋe ba le fini haahna ne baala dɛ́ taa wiile, dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ lii Kooro Josia. Ba chwera do Israel tena Wiile Taara Tɔn bini a ɛ ba nawee wa.
26Wobɛlbwa Kooro Josia aa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, ne ɡɛ waa kpɔ o te tɛ Korowii ɡɛ aa lɔ Korowii Mmara tɔn bini, 27ne waa bwa waa ɛa le mumpar ba a jaɡa la, ba chwera do Israel ne Juda Koranar Waa Tɔn bini.

Title: 2 WEBENA 36
Content:
Juda Kooro Jehoahas
1Juda harɛ tena lawɛ Kooro Josia bibaa Jehoahas, dɛ fuɡe noo do o nyu ta, o chiɡ o mɛɛ naa ta, dɛ di kora Jerusalam. 2Kooro Jehoahas di bene fifraanɛ dɛ atoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro. 3Ijipt Kooro Neko ir Kooro Jehoahas kora ta, asɛ dɛ ɛɡre Juda tena lɛ toɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore fifraatoro dɛ anaarɛ. 4Ijipt Kooro Neko kpɔ Kooro Jehoahas nime Eliakim chiɡ o dɔɔ naa ta, o di kora Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ. Dɛ kpɔ Kooro Jehoahas kaa Ijipt harɛ ta, dɛ charɛ Kooro Eliakim sɔn la, dɛ pao Jehoiakim.
Juda Kooro Jehoiakim
5Kooro Jehoiakim di bene fifraanɛ dɛ anue mɔɔ dɛ di kora Juda harɛ ta. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ. O ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ nɛ. 6Asɛ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa kpɔ o laa tena dɛ ka lɛ Juda harɛ dɔɔh, dɛ lawɛ Kooro Jehoiakim dɛ doo ayaawa jɔɡrɔre, dɛ kpɔɔ kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta. 7Kooro Nebukadnesa berɔ pa laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ do Korowii Dea la kaa Babelɔn ka do o koodem bela. 8Wobɛlbwa Kooro Jehoiakim aa ɛa ne kii wa, dɛ wechɔɡa waa ɛa bwa, ba chwera do Israel ne Juda Koranar Waa Tɔn bini. Asɛ o bibaa Jehoiachin ba chiɡ o naa ta dɛ di kora.
Juda Kooro Jehoiachin
9Kooro Jehoiachin di bene fi dɛ anuatoro mɔɔ dɛ di kora. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora korobie atoro dɛ tɔpera fi. Kooro Jehoiachin ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ. 10Benanyoa aa chema la, Kooro Nebukadnesa ɡelɔ ba ba lawɛ Kooro Jehoiachin kaa Babelɔn harɛ ta, dɛ pa kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ do Korowii Dea ja kaa. O kpɔ Kooro Jehoiachin naara Sedekia chiɡ o naa ta, o ɛ Juda harɛ ta kooro, dɛ so Jerusalam.
Juda Kooro Sedekia
11Kooro Sedekia di bene fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛ di kora. O soɡe Jerusalam di kora bene fi dɛ beŋkpoŋ. 12Kooro Sedekia ɛ wechɔɡa dɛ jo Korowii nɛ, o ta o deŋne pwɛrɛ dɛ no Korowii keame Jeremia waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o nɛɛ dɛ bol la.
Jerusalam paɡra wa
13Kooro Sedekia berɔ ɛ Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɡela o ŋwɛɛ Korowii sɔn ta ŋɔ, wɛɛ kpɔ o tenee do o lɔɡa la deŋnekpeɡ. O taŋ deŋne, o ta o liire charɛ dɛ ba Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la be. 14Anɔ la aa bera ja laanee kɛŋɔ, Juda harɛ nomonome ne sɔfore, dɛ bela tena teŋɛ harɛre aa bar ba cheme kii we-ɛɛla Korowii aa kia ta, dɛ kaa tomɛ voɡa. A che a ta, ba kpɔ doŋa kah Korowii Dea Korowii ɡbaɡba aa ɡela o do ɡoroŋ Jerusalam la.
15Korowii ba naawa aa tomɔ la cheɡɛ o keamere nɛɛ bol waa baɡ ba keraŋwɛnɛ bwa, dɛkalkɛ o dɔ tedoma tɛ o nɛra ne o Dea la. 16Kɛ ba nyiŋi keamere la nyubaah, dɛ mam ba, dɛ vɛh o waa la ka tel kɛŋɔ Korowii baah aa di o nɛra nɛɛ kohona, baa wola won le a nyoa kpa. 17Anomanta, Korowii ɡelɔ Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa ba yoo ba, dɛ kpo bonɔmbie baa lɔ Korowii Dea keri ne. Ba ta bonɔɔ kɛɛ tolo, banjena kɛɛ nomɛlbwa waa hwɛɛhra ɡelɛ. O kpɔ ba bwa do Kooro Nebukadnesa nɔn ta. 18Babelɔn Kooro ɡelɔ ba pa laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne anɔ la a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ do deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa a bini Korowii Dea, dɛ anɔ la aa lɔ kooro ne o nomonome be bwa, kɛŋɔ laa ta kwaa kaa Babelɔn harɛ. 19O ɡelɔ ba fuh Korowii Dea la, dɛ kuuɡi danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la, dɛ fuh kooderemi bwa ne komɛlbwa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa bwa.
20Nɛra baa kaa waa wola ban kpoorɛ la, o laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, ba kaa tomɛ o ne o bii dɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ harɛ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Pɛɛsea aa baa ir dɛɛ di kpeɡri. 21Anee ɡela waa Korowii aa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol la ɛ kpela. O ŋɔ, “Harɛ la ɛɛ chɔɡoo, dɛ́ chɔ kɛ dimɡbia bene fifraanuanɛ baa wola won parɛ o ta.”
Koojen Saeros berɔ ɡel Juda tena ba Jerusalam
22Koojen Saeros baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta, o kora dii benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii ɡelɔ waa waa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol la ɛ kpela. O ɡelɔ Pɛɛsea harɛ Koojen Saeros chwerɛ tɔne kaa o harɛ bwa ta ŋɔ, 23“Waa men Pɛɛsea Koojen aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ, ‘Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua laanee cheɡ mɛ kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ berɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ma o Dea tɛo Jerusalam waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta. Taraken, hé nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii bwa ir kaa bela, Kórowii haa dɛ tomɔ ja he nɛ.’ ”

Title: ƐSRA TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Ɛsra Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa pili ŋwɛnɛ tɛ Juda tena, asɛ ba berɛ won ba ba harɛ ta, dɛ ba kwaa ma Korowii Dea Jerusalam wa. Dɛ ba ɛ yoma dɛ do Babelɔn harɛ ta bene fifraanue, kɛ Pɛɛsea koojen cha ba, asɛ ba won berɛ ba ba deremi. Bene fifraanɛɛ ba won kpɔ dɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea la. Ba chwera do nyuune 1—6. A habɔɔ la, nɛra warɔ ja Ɛsra nɛɛ ba, asɛ o cha ba, ba so ɡɛ Korowii waa la aa dɛ baɡle. Ba chwera do nyuune 7—10.

Title: ƐSRA 1
Content:
Koojen Saeros berɔ ɡel Juu tena ba Jerusalam
1Koojen Saeros baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta. O kora dii benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, Korowii ɡelɔ waa waa cheɡɛ o keame Jeremia nɛɛ bol la ɛ kpela. O ɡelɔ Koojen Saeros chwerɛ tɔne kaa o harɛ bwa ta.
2O ŋɔ, “Waa men Pɛɛsea Koojen aa dɛ bol laanee kɛŋɔ,
‘Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua laanee cheɡ mɛ kora harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ, dɛ berɛ lee mɛ ŋɔ ń ma o Dea tɛo Jerusalam waa lɔ Juda harɛ ta. 3Taraken, hé nɛra haa dɛ tomɛ Korowii bwa ir kaa bela, dɛ́ ka berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam. Onee dɛ́ ja he nɛ. 4Hé bala bane baa kaa dɛ ta so bojaŋ harɛre ta la, hé tɛɛ ba suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, ne laala baa kpɔ ɛ toma ne kondɛɛra, dɛ saraha kwaa aa le ba bambile ta, bá kpɔ ba Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini.’ ”
5Asɛ Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene nomonnyuune, ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nomɛlbwa Korowii aa ɡela o bambile aa lawa ir, dɛ́ ka berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la. 6Ba bala la bwa cha ba, dɛ tɛɛ ba suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa, ne laala baa kpɔ ɛ toma ne kondɛɛra, ne koŋkɛɛla a yoɡ aa kpeɡa, dɛ kpɔ ja saraha kwaa bwa aa le ba bambile ta. 7A bwa habɔɔ la, Koojen Saeros berɔ kpɔ laala aa lɔ Korowii Dea Jerusalam Kooro Nebukadnesa fa aa paa, dɛ kpɔ ba cheɡ o voɡ dea bini la ba tɛɛ ba. 8Koojen Saeros kpɔɔ do nomoa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Mitredat waa dɛ nyiŋi koodem laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa nɔn ta, o kura, dɛ kpɔ do Sɛsbasa waa dɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta nɔn ta.
9Gɛ waa kure laala laanee teŋa nɔ.
Suuɡaswɛm loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ sarahare fifraatoro,
ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa baa kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ sarahare kaɡboŋ,
ne suuɡapoŋa loɡbaala fifraanɛ dɛ anuanaarɛ,
10ne suuɡaswɛm loɡjeɡre fifraatoro,
ne suuɡapoŋa loɡjeɡre lafraanaarɛ dɛ fi,
dɛ loɡa ane ɡe aa jaa kaɡboŋ.
11Suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa ne anɔ la aa jaa bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa anue lafraanaarɛ. Asɛ Sɛsbasa kpɔ a bwa, ɡɛ saŋ o ne nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn dɛɛ ba Jerusalam la ba.

Title: ƐSRA 2
Content:
Nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn ba wa
1Nɛra Babelɔn Koojen Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, asɛ ba berɛ won ba Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta, dɛ ba so ba bwɛɛre ta laanee teŋa nɔ, 2Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua, ne Nehemia ne Seraya, ne Relaya ne Mɔdekae, ne Bilsan ne Mispar, ne Biɡvai ne Rehum, dɛ Baana.
Baala baa le Israel harɛ taa teŋa nɔ.
3Parɔs naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
4Sɛfatea naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
5Ara naanar lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ banue.
6Pahat Moab ne Jesua dɛ Joab luɡe nɛra lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ, lafraanuatoro dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
7Elam naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
8Satu naanar lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
9Sakai naanar lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl.
10Bani naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
11Bebai naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
12Asɡad naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
13Adonikam naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanumɛl dɛ banumɛl.
14Biɡvai ɡe naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
15Adin naanar lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
16Ata waa le Hɛsɛkea luɡe ta, o ɡe naanar lɔ nɛra fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
17Bɛsae naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
18Jora naanar lɔ lafa dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
19Hasum naanar ɡe lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
20Giba naanar lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banue.
21Baala baa le Bɛtlɛham lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
22Baala baa le Nɛtɔfa lɔ fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
23Baala baa le Anatɔt lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
24Baala baa le Bɛt Asmavɛt lɔ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
25Baala baa le Kiriat Jearim ne Kefira, dɛ Beɛrɔt lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ batoro.
26Baala baa le Rama ne Geba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
27Baala baa le Mikmas lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
28Baala baa le Bɛtel ne Ai lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
29Baala baa le Nɛbo lɔ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
30Baala baa le Maɡbes lɔ lafa fifraanue dɛ banumɛl.
31Baala baa le Elam ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
32Baala baa le Harim lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ.
33Baala baa le Lod ne Hadid, dɛ Ono lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banue.
34Baala baa le Jeriko ɡe lɔ lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
35Baala baa le Senaa lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanumɛl fifraatoro.
36Sɔfore baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Jedaya naanar baa le Jesua luɡe ta nɛra lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro.
37Ima naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
38Pasur naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuanɛ.
39Harim naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ dɛ fi dɛ banuanɛ.
40Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ.
Jesua naanar dɛ le Kadmiel dɛ Hodavia luɡe nɛra lɔ fifraanuanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
41Yelɡoola baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Asaf naanar lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
42Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡee nɔ.
Salum ne Ata ne Talmɔn ne Akub ne Hatita dɛ Sobai naanar lɔ nɛra lafa fifraatoro dɛ banuanaarɛ.
43Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡee nɔ.
Ba naanaree,
Siha ne Hasufa dɛ Tabaot,
44ne Keros ne Siaha dɛ Padɔn,
45ne Lebana ne Haɡaba dɛ Akub,
46ne Haɡab ne Samlai dɛ Hanan,
47ne Gedɛl ne Gahar dɛ Reaya,
48ne Resin ne Nekoda dɛ Gasam,
49ne Usa ne Pasea dɛ Besai,
50ne Asna ne Meunim dɛ Nefusim,
51ne Bakbuk ne Hakufa dɛ Haahur,
52ne Baslut ne Mehida dɛ Haasa,
53ne Baakɔs ne Sisera dɛ Tɛma,
54ne Nɛsea dɛ Hatifa.
55Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar ɡee nɔ.
Ba naanaree,
Sotai ne Hasofɛrɛt dɛ Pɛruda,
56ne Jaalaa ne Daakon dɛ Gedɛl,
57ne Sɛfatea dɛ Hatil,
ne Pɔkɛrɛt Hasebaim dɛ Ami.
58Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
59Nɛra baa teŋa nɔ le bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ Tɛl Mɛla ne Tɛl Hasa, ne Kɛrɔb ne Adon dɛ Ima. Kɛ ba ta wone chaɡle kɛŋɔ ba lolanar mun le Israel harɛ ta. Banee nɔ,
60Delaya ne Tobia dɛ Nekoda naanar, ba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
61Sɔfore ɡe pera, ba naanaree nɔ.
Hobaya ne Hakɔs dɛ Baasilai. A ɡɛ Baasilai nɔɔ fa mo Baasilai waa le Gelead bihaah, a che a ta baa yerɔ ɡɛ sɔn nɔ.
62A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡaaɡe ba naawa luɡe tɔne bini kahonɛ, anomanta, ba kpɔ ba kɛŋɔ nɛra doŋa aa lɔ ba nɛ, baa wola won ɛ sɔfore. 63Asɛ Juda harɛ nomoa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, baa won di kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa baa kpɔa ba tɛ Korowii la, atane sɔfo bɛl lɔ bela dɛ́ do batakaare baa sɔh Urim ne Tumim dawɛ o ta, dɛ́ che a ta bɔɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la mɔɔ.
64A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ, lafraatoro fifraanumɛl. 65Ba bonɔɔna ne toli baa dɛ tomɛ ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ. Dɛ ba berɔ dɔ baala ne haahna yelɡoola lafraanɛ. 66Ba jaɡre lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl, ba keeɡore aa jweera a loɡle la bii lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue. 67Nyoɡmare ɡe lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraatoro dɛ anue, ne keeɡore kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ.
68Nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛre ta la aa baa tel Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la, deene nomonnyuune la bini bane le ba bambile bini tɛ kwaa ba berɛ kpɔ ma Korowii Dea la cheɡ o buɡ bene ta bela. 69Gɛ bɛlbwa aa wona laanee o tɛ ba kpɔ ɛ toma la. Suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafraanue, ne suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa anɛ lafraanuatoro, dɛ sɔfore batakaani lafa.
70Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne yelɡoola, ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la soɡe ba bwɛɛre ta, ba ne nɛra la bane. Asɛ Israel tena baa kaa la ka so bwɛɛre ba naawa fa aa soɡe a ta la ta.

Title: ƐSRA 3
Content:
Ba berɔ kwaa ma kon baa ɛ saraha o ta tɛ Korowii
1Korobie anuanɛ ta la, Israel tena bwa kaa so ba bwɛɛre ta. Asɛ ba bwa pɛ ka cheme Jerusalam, 2asɛ Josadak bibaa Jesua ne o bala sɔfore, ne Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne o bala baa ja o nɛ, pa mun dɛ berɛ kwaa ma saraha kon tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa o ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii bonɔɔ Mosis Mmara tɔn bini la. 3A lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba dɛ ɔmɛ nɛra baa bar ba cheme la te, kɛ ba berɔ kwaa ma saraha kon la cheɡ o buɡ bene la ta, dɛ fuh kwaa chɔɔ ne jɔmɔra ɛ sarahare dɛɛ tɛ Korowii o ta. 4Ba di Kukure Tɔpejen ɡɛ baa chwerɛ o waa bil la, dɛ fuh kwaa ɛ sarahare ɡɛ aa chɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa ta. 5A habɔɔ la, ba kpɔ kwaa baa fuah dɛɛ ɛ sarahare tɔpere bɛlbwa kɛŋɔ Korobifale ne saraha kwaa baa lea cheɡ tɔpejena aa do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii la ne, dɛ anɔ la aa le nɛra bambile ta, ba kpɔ ba ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii la. 6Korobie anuanɛ tɔpeloɡle ta la, ba pa mun fuh kwaa ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ ba ta Korowii Dea la mun pae mɔɔ.
Korowii Dea kwaara dɛ́ ma mumpar
7Ate, nɛra la tɛ suuɡa baa kpɔ bɔ tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ peɡri bwea ne kapenta tena, dɛ berɛ kpɔ kondikwaa ne sen dɛ ɔleve noo ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛ bwɛjena Sidon ne Taaya tena, ásɛ ba kpɔ ka charɛ peleme daa le Lɛbanɔn, ásɛ dɛ taɡa kpɔ mpo sie ba Jopa, ɡɛ Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa bola la.
8Anomanta, bennɛɛte korobinɛɛte ta nɛra la aa le bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba la, dɛ daa la tel bela baa dɛ ba Korowii Dea la doe Jerusalam, asɛ ba pa o mun. Ate, Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Josadak bibaa Jesua, dɛ bwɛɛla la kar ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bwa kaa ja dɛɛ ɛ toma la. Ba le Lewi dea tena baa di bene fifraanɛ, kɛɛ dɛ ɡwaa la ba ɛ nomonome dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ma Korowii Dea la nɛ. 9Jesua ne o bibaala dɛ o nimanar, ne Kadmiel ne o bibaala baa ɛ Hodavia naanar, ne Henadad bibaala, ne ba ɡe bibaala ne ba dɔɔranar ne nimanar, ba bwa aa ɛ Lewi dea tena la bwa pɛo dɛ ba ja, dɛɛ nyiŋi tom-ɛɛra baa dɛ ɛ Korowii Dea toma la nɛ.
10Mamaala la aa pa Korowii Dea la mun la, sɔfore do ba laala dɛ ka che ba chebɔra dɛ kpoŋe bɛle, asɛ Lewi dea tena baa ɛ Asaf bibaala kpoŋe kwaa anɛ ane baa kpɔ ayaawa ɛa dɛɛ hɛlɛ, dɛ ka che ba chebɔra, dɛ lɔ dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ɡɛ Israel Kooro Devid fa aa do Israel tena la. 11Ba ɡo yela kpɛɛ Korowii dɛ jaamo ŋɔ,
“Korowii wer, o nyina waa dɛ nyin Israel tena
lole saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.”
Asɛ nɛra la bwa moo kohona dɛ jam Korowii, dɛkalkɛ ba pa Korowii Dea la mun. 12Kɛ sɔfore baa ɛ nomonome ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nomonnyuune baa tɔ sie na loɡle Dea la aa cheɡa dɛɛ nyiŋi baa pa Dea la mun la, ba wio dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre kɛrɛdɛ, asɛ bane ɡe ɛɛ do silɛɛ lɔŋɔre. 13Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ banɔ la baa dɛ wi, ne banɔ la baa sie aa lɛa kpa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ɡbɔɡa aa lɔ bela kan kohona dɛɛ la bojaŋ.

Title: ƐSRA 4
Content:
Korowii Dea kwaara dɛ́ do webeɡra
1Juda ne Bɛnjamen tena dɔma noɔ kɛŋɔ Israel tena baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta la berɔ ba, dɛ berɛ baa do Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ la Korowii Dea. 2Anomanta, ba ba Sɛrobabɛl ne deene nomonnyuune la be ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya ba cha heya Korowii Dea nɔ toma ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii beŋkpoŋ nɔɔ ya bwa ɛɛ tomɛ, dɛ ɛ saraha dɛɛ tɛo dɛ le saŋ Asiiria koojen Esaahadon aa ba ya ne bonɔ ba so bwa.” 3Kɛ Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua, dɛ Israel deene nomonnyuune la chaŋɔ ŋɔ, “Ya ta he chae hiaeh Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea toma nɔ ta. Ya ɡbo ɛɛ doo, ɡɛ Pɛɛsea Koojen Saeros aa do yaa la.”
4Belaa nɛra baa soɡa bar ba la pa mun dɛɛ chɔɡ Juu tena la liire, a ɡel baa ɔmɛ Korowii Dea la toma ɛɛ. 5Ba yawɛ Pɛɛsea harɛ nomonome sen ŋɔ bá chɔɡ vɔrɔwa bɛlbwa baa dɛ vɔrɔwe Dea la toma wa, dɛ le Pɛɛsea Koojena Saeros ne Dareɔs kora dii saŋ bwa.
Jerusalam kwaara dɛ́ ma webeɡra waa ja
6Koojen Sɛksɛs kora dii mumpar la, ba dɔma la chwerɛ waa yaɡɛ Juda ne Jerusalam tena.
7A habɔɔ, Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta la, baala bane baa dɛ yer ba Bislam ne Mitredat, ne Tabeel dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛ chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Koojen Atasɛksɛs. Aram tena wobol taa ba chwera, asɛ nɛn waa kure la, ó baɡle a mun.
8Rehum waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la bampera bobɛl, ne karake Simsai waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, chwerɛ Jerusalam waa aa teŋa nɔ ba tɛ Koojen Atasɛksɛs.
9“Tɔn nɔ le Rehum waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la bampera, ne karake Simsai waa chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil be. Bane ba bala baa jaa bwa, nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole, dɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi nɛra baa le Tripolis, ne Pɛɛsea ne Ɛrɛk ne Babelɔn, dɛ Elam tena baa lɔ Susa, 10dɛ nɛra bane Koojen Asubanipal waa dɛ di kpeɡri dɛ dɔ jirima kohona, aa doŋ ba le ba deremi ba so bwɛjen Samaria, dɛ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛre ta la be.”
11Waa aa teŋa nɔɔ ba chwera do tɔn bini.
“Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Koojen Atasɛksɛs be, dɛ le he bonɔɔna baa soɡe Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr la be. Ya dɛ nae kohona.
12N naa kooro, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ Juu tena baa le he harɛre ta dɛ ba la kaa Jerusalam, dɛ berɛ ka kwaa dɛɛ ma deŋnekpeɡ ne nyubinikpeɡ tena bwɛjen la ja. Ba kwaarɔ dɛɛ ma o danjwɛɛre, dɛɛ kwaa a mune la ɡe.
13N naa kooro, berɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ dɛ ba wono kwaa do bwɛjen nɔ tonaa, baa toɔ bɛlbwaa bɔ tɛɛ kpa, ásɛ komɛlbwa aa he kara munii do kpa. 14Yaa lɔ he lɔɡa nɔ, yaa nyin kɛŋɔ sihiih ba kpoe haa wola duuree dɔ, anomanta, ya kpɔ kala nɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ, 15ásɛ he nyiŋi koranar baa tɔ he sie di kara la tɔne bini, hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ Jerusalam ɛ deŋnekpeɡ tena bwɛ, dɛɛ ha ba koranar ne harɛ nomonome. Deŋnekpeɡ tena lɔ o ta le saŋ la bwa. A waa o fa chɔɡ la. 16Ya ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ kɛŋɔ, dɛ ba wono ma bwɛjen nɔ ne o danjwɛɛre tonaa, haa won di kpeɡri bɛlbwa harɛre aa chɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛre nɛra nɛɛ kpa.”
17Ate, koojen la chaŋe ŋɔ,
“Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Rehum waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi harɛ la bampera, ne Simsai waa ɛ karake dɛ chwerɛ waa dɛɛ bil, dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛ, dɛ so bwɛjen Samaria ne Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ pera bobɛlbwa kɛŋɔ, n dɛ na ba.
18Ba kure tɔn haa chwera la n sie, dɛ baɡle o bini waa n no. 19N le nɛra ŋɔ bá nyiŋi tɔne bini, asɛ ba na kɛŋɔ, le saŋ la bwaa Jerusalam tena le dɛ le ba koranar habɔɔ, a che a ta deŋnekpeɡ ne wesaɡasaɡare su o ta. 20Koranar baa kpeɡa Jerusalam di kora dɛ nyiŋi harɛ waa chɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ le bwa ta, dɛ ɡel ba bɔ toɔre dɛ lɛ harɛ la kwaa baa tɛɛ ba. 21Anomanta, ɡel ba ŋɔ baala baa dɛ ɛ toma la be ŋɔ bá ɡel ka tel kɛŋɔ, n ɡbabir aa tɛ ŋwɛnɛ. 22Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ waa nɔ vɛh, ásɛ a ba chɔɡ n liire maa dɔa Jerusalam tena nɛɛ la ta.”
23Baa kure Kooro Atasɛksɛs tɔn la waa baɡle Rehum ne Simsai dɛ nɛra baa ja o nɛɛ la, ba ɛ warane la Jerusalam dɛ ka ŋɔ Juu tena la be ŋɔ bá ɡel Dea la toma ɛɛ.
24Anomanta, ba ɡelɔ Korowii Dea la toma ka che, ka tel kɛŋɔ Koojen Dareɔs aa baa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ bene anɛ ta.

Title: ƐSRA 5
Content:
Tatenai tɔn waa chwera ka tɛ Kooro Dareɔs
1A ɡɛ saŋ la, Korowii keamere Haɡae ne Sekaria waa ɛ Ido naa, pa mun dɛɛ bol Korowii waa Juu tena ne banɔ la baa lɔ Jerusalam be, Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ sɔn ta. 2Ate, Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Josadak bibaa Jesua aa no ba waa la, ba berɛ pa mun dɛɛ do Korowii Dea la Jerusalam ja, asɛ Korowii keamere banɛ la cha ba.
3Gɛ saŋ la, Tatenai waa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo harɛ baŋ ne Sɛta Bosenai, dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ la ba ba be, dɛ ka bɔɔ ba ŋɔ, “Umee tɛ heyaa kpeɡri ŋɔ he berɛ kwaa do Korowii Dea nɔ cheɡ o buɡ bene ta nɔ?” 4Ba berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ “Nɛra baa dɛ ma Dea nɔ sɔne ɛrɔɔ?” 5Kɛ dɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la sie lɔ Juu tena nomonome la nɛ, a ɡel Pɛɛsea nomonome la ta wone ɛ wobɛlbwa, ka tel kɛŋɔ baa chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Koojen Dareɔs, asɛ o chaŋ ba mɔɔ.
6Tatenai ne Sɛta Bosenai dɛ nɛra baa ja ba nɛɛ bwa chwerɛ tɔn ka tɛ Kooro Dareɔs.
7Kenii tɔn la bini wa ɛɛ baɡle.
“Tɔn nɔ dɛ ba Koojen Dareɔs be, Korowii ɡel he nyiŋi he nɛra nɛɛ deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
8N naa kooro, ya dɛ nyin he jemɛ kɛŋɔ ya la Juu tena harɛ ta, bela Korowii waa kana la Dea aa lole ba berɛ kwaa dɛɛ mao la. Bwejena nee baa mao, dɛ kpɔ dadɛɛɡa dawɛ o danjwɛɛre ta. Ba toma ɛɛ wer, dɛɛ kaa wɔrɔbe nɛ, ɡɛ baa chaɡ ba la.
9Ya bɔɔ ba nomonome ŋɔ, ‘Umee tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ he berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔɔ?’ 10Ya berɔ bɔɔ ba ba nomonome sɔna, ɡɛ aa ɛ ya won ɡel he jemɛ nɛra baa chɔ ba nyoa.
11Waa baa chaŋe yaa teŋa nɔ.
‘Ya ɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ne harɛ bonɔɔna, asɛ ya berɛ kwaa dɛɛ ma Korowii Dea ba fa aa mao saŋ la bwa la. Israel kooro bɛl o fa aa dɛ di kpeɡri kohona laanee pa o mun dɛ tonɔ. 12Kɛ ya naanar aa ir Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua bandia nomanta, o kpɔ ba do Kooro Nebukadnesa waa ɛ Babelɔn kooro nɔn ta. Kooro Nebukadnesa chɔɡ o Dea la, dɛ lawɛ nɛra la kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn.
13Kɛ a bwa habɔɔ, Babelɔn koojen Saeros aa di kora benanyoa waa tɔ sie ta la, o do mmara kɛŋɔ bá berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔ. 14O berɔ kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa Kooro Nebukadnesa aa paa le Korowii Dea Jerusalam ba bil o voɡ dea bini Babelɔn la ba.
Ate, Koojen Saeros kpɔ ɡɛ loɡa la tɛ Sɛsbasa waa leo harɛ la nomoa, wɛɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta. 15Dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Berɛ kpɔ loɡa nɔ ka cheɡ Korowii Dea Jerusalam, dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma Dea la cheɡ o buɡ bene la ta.” 16Anomanta, Sɛsbasa balɔ dɛ ba pa Korowii Dea la mun Jerusalam. Nɛra ta lɔ o ta dɛɛ ɛ toma baa wola tonɛ mɔɔ.’
17N naa kooro, dɛ he sie lɛo waa, ɡel ba nyiŋi koranar tɔne bini bwɛjen Babelɔn, dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ Koojen Saeros tɛ ŋwɛnɛ ŋɔ bá kwaa ma Korowii Dea nɔ Jerusalam kɛɛ o ta ŋɔe, ásɛ dɛ ɡel ya jemɛ he liire aa lɔ waa nɔ ta.”

Title: ƐSRA 6
Content:
Koojen Dareɔs mmara
1Koojen Dareɔs do mmara ŋɔ, bá nyiŋi koranar tɔne baa kpɔa cheɡ Babelɔn la bini. 2Baa ka dɛ nyiŋi la, ba na tɔn bɛl bwɛjen baa dɛ yerɔ Ɛkbatana waa lɔ Midia harɛ ta, asɛ ba chwerɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ o bini ŋɔ,
3Koojen Saeros aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ benanyoa beŋkpoŋ ta la, o do mmara Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la waa ŋɔ,
“Hé berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea la ó ɛ bɔr nɛra aa dɛɛ ɛ sarahare bela. Gel ba ma chɔŋɛ Dea la buɡ bene la ta. A chɛ kɛ o jaŋne dɛ́ kaa nyundua ɛ naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ, ásɛ o paɡri ɡe naɡale fifraanuanaarɛ. 4Ba kpɔ bwea atoro ma chɔŋɛ ɛ o danjwɛɛre ta bar aa, dɛ ba kpɔ dola dawɛ a ta. Koodem bela suuɡaa bá kpɔ bɔ a kem. 5Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa loɡa aa lɔ Korowii Dea, Koojen Nebukadnesa aa paa le Jerusalam ba Babelɔn la, a chɛ kɛ bá berɛ kaa ane a buɡ ta bela tenten a fa aa cheɡa, Korowii Dea Jerusalam.”
Koojen Dareɔs do nɛra bá berɛ ɛ toma
6Ate, Koojen Dareɔs chaŋe dɛ ŋɔ, “Name Tatenai waa ɛ nomonjen dɛɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta, ne Sɛta Bosenai ne he bala nomonome haa lɔ harɛ la ta la, hé le bela kaa. 7He bɛ wobɛlbwa ɛ dɛ́ tɔ Korowii Dea mae toma la ŋwɛnɛ. Hé ɡel Juu tena harɛ nomoa, ne o nomonome ɡel ba berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea la cheɡ o buɡ bene ta bela.
8N dɛ do heyaa kɛŋɔ hé cha ba, ásɛ ba won mao.
Hé kpɔ suuɡa aa le Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ baa bɔa dɛɛ do kara mun la, dɛɛ bɔ Dea la toma bɛlbwa kem, ɡɛ aa ɛ toma la bɛ ba ka che. 9Tɔpere bɛlbwa a chɛ kɛ hé nyiŋi dɛɛ tɛ sɔfore baa lɔ Jerusalam kwaa baa dɛ nyin, dɛ́ kpɔ tɛɛ ba. Nabali ne peera, dɛ pebiiri baa fuh ɛ sarahare tɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua, ne jaaɡe ne yar ne sen dɛ ɔleve no. He bɛ ban dɛɛ vɔmɛ, 10ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba won dɛɛ ɛ sarahare aa dɛɛ su Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua siwi, dɛ́ soŋe tɛ kooro ne o bibaala ɡe.
11N berɔ dɛɛ do heyaa kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ waa nɔ ta la, bá tɛr dola le o dea ta dɛ́ seɡre o nyoa dɛ́ kpɔ tooh ó saɡɛ. O wechɔɡa waa ɛa nomanta, o dem paɡre dɛ́ berɛ puldoa. 12Korowii waa le Jerusalam cheɡ ŋɔ nɛra ba bela dɛ́ baa tomɔ la, ó ir kooro kɛɛ harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra baa vɛh waa nɔ ta teŋa, kɛɛ dɛ́ ka chɔɡ Korowii Dea nɔ la.
Men Koojen Dareɔs, menee do ɡɛ mmara nɔ. Bɛlbwa nyiŋi dɛɛ teŋɛ o ta kɛrɛdɛ.”
Korowii Dea kpɔe dɛ́ do o nɔn ta
13Belaa Tatenai waa ɛ nomoa harɛ la ta, ne Sɛta Bosenai dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛɛ la, bwa ɛ waa koojen la aa do ba a ta la bwa kɛrɛdɛ ken. 14Korowii keamere Haɡae ne Sekaria ɡbemba baa do Juu tena nomonome la nomanta, Korowii Dea toma la kaa sie ɡɛ aa chɛa. Ba tonɛ Dea la toma ɡɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, ne Pɛɛsea harɛ Koojena Saeros, ne Dareɔs dɛ Atasɛksɛs aa do ba la. 15Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora bene anumɛl, Adar korobie tɔpetooro wee taa ba ma Korowii Dea la tonɛ.
16Belaa Israel tena bwa, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, dɛ nɛra baa kaa dɛ le bojaŋ harɛ, dɛ berɛ ba la bwa kpɔ silɛɛ kohona, dɛ kpɔ Dea la do Korowii nɔn ta. 17Dea la kpɔe dɛ do Korowii nɔn ta la, ba kpɔ nabala lafa ne pebala lafraanɛ, dɛ pebali lafraanaarɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛ berɛ kpɔ bombala fi dɛ anɛ, bɛlbwa che tɛ Israel deene fi dɛ anɛ la, dɛ kpɔ ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha tɛ Israel tena bwa. 18Ba bɔne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la bini ɡɛ bɛlbwa toma aa doa Korowii Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bini, ɡɛ baa chwera do Mosis Tɔn bini la.
Galekaa Tɔpejen dii
19Korobie waa tɔ sie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ta la, nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la, di Galekaa Tɔpejen la. 20Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la tɔ sie laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛ, dɛ do ɡoroŋ. Asɛ Lewi dea tena la kpo Galekaa pebie la tɛ nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la bwa, ne ba bala sɔfore dɛ ba ɡbabir. 21Anomanta, Israel tena baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta dɛ ba la, ne nɛra baa pere ba te le waa nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ aa dɛ ɛa nɛɛ, dɛ so harɛ la ta bwa pɛo, dɛ ba tomɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ di Galekaa Tɔpejen kondikwaa la. 22Ba di Paanoo Iisi Aa Wola Toole A Ta Tɔpejen tɔpera anuanɛ silɛɛ ne, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii charɛ Asiiria koojen liire, o won cha ba ba ma Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea la.

Title: ƐSRA 7
Content:
Ɛsra Jerusalam bala
1Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta la, dɛ baa bɛl lole baa yerɔ Ɛsra. O mɛɛ sɔne Seraya, Seraya ɡe mɛɛ Asaria, asɛ Asaria ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Hilkia. 2Salum lolɛ Hilkia, Sadɔk lole Salum, Ahitub lolɛ Sadɔk, 3Amaria lolɛ Ahitub, Asaria lolɛ Amaria, asɛ Merayɔt lolɛ Asaria. 4Serahia lolɛ Merayɔt, Usi lolɛ Serahia, asɛ Buki lolɛ Usi. 5Abisua lolɛ Buki, Fenehas lolɛ Abisua, Eliasa lolɛ Fenehas, asɛ Arɔn waa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la lolɛ Eliasa. 6A ɡɛ Ɛsra nɔ ɛ sɔfo dɛ le Babelɔn ba. Dɛ o ɛ chicha ɡe, dɛ jemɛ mmarare Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa kpɔa tɛ Mosis la kɛrɛdɛ, dɛɛ baɡla. Komɛlbwa waa bɔɔ le koojen be la, o dɛ tɛo, dɛkalkɛ Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ la nɔn dawɛ o nɛ. 7Israel tena la bane ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne yelɡoola, ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡe ba Jerusalam, ɡɛ saŋ Kooro Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene anuanɛ ta.
8Koojen la aa di kora bene anuanɛ, korobie anue taa sɔfo Ɛsra ba Jerusalam. 9Korobiloɡle tɔpere waa tɔ sie taa ba pa mun le Babelɔn harɛ ta, asɛ korobie anue tɔpeloɡle ne tela dɛ Korowii chao o ba tel Jerusalam. 10Sɔfo Ɛsra le o te cheɡ dɛ tɛ Korowii Mmarare la hwela ne a bini nyiŋa, asɛ dɛɛ chaɡle Korowii waa ne mmarare aa lɔ Israel harɛ ta.
Tɔn Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa chwera ka tɛ Ɛsra
11Koojen Atasɛksɛs chwerɛ waa aa teŋa nɔ tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa bera ɛ chicha dɛ jemɛ Korowii Mmarare ne waa waa do Israel tena a ta la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
12“Tɔn nɔ le men Atasɛksɛs maa ɛ koranar bwa koojen be.
N chwerɔ dɛɛ tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra haa ɛ chicha, dɛɛ baɡle Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua la Mmarare.
N dɛ nae.
13Taraken nɔ, n dɛ doe kɛŋɔ Israel te bɛlbwa waa lɔ n harɛ ta, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ba bini bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ o pui kaa Jerusalam la won kaala. 14Men Koojen, ne n nomonome banuanɛ baa dɛ ja mɛ, dɛ tomɛ ŋɔ he ka bɔɔ dɛ na kɛ nɛra dɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la mmarare waa kpɔa do he nɔn ta la ta kɛɛ. 15A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm koojen ne nɛra baa dɛ jao aa le ba bambile bini, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ, o Dea do Jerusalam la. 16Berɛ kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm haa dɔa le Babelɔn harɛ ta, ne deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare Israel tena ne ba sɔfore aa kpɔa tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ Dea waa lɔ Jerusalam la bwa. 17Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ kpɔ a ɡɛ suuɡa nɔ yawɛ nabala ne pebala ne pebiiri, dɛ mea sarahare ne sen sarahare, dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ saraha Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ la Dea, kon baa dɛ ɛ saraha o ta Jerusalam la ta.
18Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm bɛlbwa aa ka la, he ne he bala Juu tena ɛɛ won kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa aa wera tɛ heya, ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ nyin. 19Kpɔ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa baa kpɔa do he nɔn ta, ba kpɔ dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Dea la bwa ka tɛo Jerusalam. 20Komɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin dɛ ja Korowii Dea bini la, hé lɛa le suuɡa aa le kooro kara mun ka yawɛ.
21Taraken, men Koojen Atasɛksɛs dɛ do Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ nɛra baa dɛ cheɡ n harɛ suuɡare la ŋɔ, bá do sie tɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua chicha dɛɛ baɡle o Mmarare bini la komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin, 22he tɛo waa, he bɛ ɡel a ɡwaa suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, ne jaaɡe a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fi, ne sen aa ɛ ɡalɔŋre lafraanue, ne ɔleve no aa ɛ ɡalɔŋre lafraanue. Kɛ yar te, he tɛo ɡɛ del bwa waa dɛ nyin. 23Komɛlbwa Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua aa baɡla la, hé nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɡel á ɛ ɡɛ aa chɛa tɛo o Dea bela. Ásɛ o baah bɛ n nɛɛ kɛɛ kooro bɛlbwa waa ba di kora n habɔɔ nɛɛ di. 24A chɛ kɛ hé jemɛ ja kɛŋɔ he ta kpeɡri dɔe kɛ he lɛ toɔ bɛlbwa soo siwi le sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ne yelɡoola dɛ nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, kɛɛ tom-ɛɛ bɛlbwa waa kaa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea be.
25Hen sɔfo Ɛsra, che wejema Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ aa tɛɛ ta, dɛ le nomonome ne banɔ la baa jemɛ waa bola dɛɛ pa bole, ásɛ baa nyiŋi nɛra baa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta nɛ, dɛɛ teŋɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ Mmarare ta. Takapɔ chaɡle banɔ la ɡe baa wola mmarare la jemɛ la. 26Nomɛlbwa waa ɛ deŋnekpeɡ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ mmarare kɛɛ koojen mmarare ta la, a chɛ kɛ bá kpoo buɡ la ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ doŋu le o harɛ ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta, kɛɛ dɛ́ lawɔ ka do dea, ásɛ a ɛ deŋnetɛra tɛo.”
Sɔfo Ɛsra Korowii kpɛɛra
27Ate, sɔfo Ɛsra ŋɔ, “Korowii ya naawa aa tomɔ laanee dɔ jam. Onee ɡela Koojen Atasɛksɛs dɔ liire, dɛ ɡel ba berɛ kwaa ma Korowii Dea waa do ken, dɛ dɔ jirima cheɡ Jerusalam. 28O berɔ sune n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ n dɔ jirima koojen ne o nɛra baa dɛ jao, dɛ o nomonjena baa kpeɡa bwa sie. Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa ja n nɛɛ nomanta, n dɔ ɡbemba dɛ won boa Israel deene nomonnyuune nyoa, asɛ n ne ba berɛ ba Jerusalam.”

Title: ƐSRA 8
Content:
Nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛ ta ba wa
1Gɛ saŋ Israel deene nomonnyuune baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta Babelɔn la, nɛra baa teŋɛ sɔfo Ɛsra nɛɛ ba Jerusalam ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora laanee nɔ.
2Fenehas naanar bini, Gɛɛsɔm.
Itama naanar bini, Daneɛl,
Devid naanar bini, Hatus 3ne Sɛkania naanar.
Parɔs naanar bini, Sekaria. Baala baa ja o nɛɛ ba chwerɛ ba sɔna lɔ lafa fifraanue.
4Pahat Moab naanar bini, Serahia bibaa Eliehonai, asɛ baala lafraanɛ ja o nɛ.
5Satu naanar bini, Jahaseɛl bibaa Sɛkania, asɛ baala lafraatoro ja o nɛ.
6Adin naanar bini, Jonatan bibaa Ɛbɛd, asɛ baala fifraanue ja o nɛ.
7Elam naanar bini, Atalia bibaa Jesaya asɛ baala fifraanuanɛ ja o nɛ.
8Sɛfatea naanar bini, Maekel bibaa Sebadia, asɛ baala fifraanuatoro ja o nɛ.
9Joab naanar bini, Jehiel bibaa Obadia, asɛ baala lafraanɛ dɛ fi dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛ.
10Bani naanar bini, Josifia bibaa Sɛlomet, asɛ baala lafa fifraanumɛl ja o nɛ.
11Bebai naanar bini, Bebai bibaa Sekaria, asɛ baala fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛ.
12Asɡad naanar bini, Hakatan bibaa Johanan, asɛ baala lafa dɛ fi ja o nɛ.
13Adonikam naanar bini, banɔ la baa ka mun ba laanee, Ɛlefɛlɛt ne Jeyuwel dɛ Sɛmaya, asɛ baala fifraanumɛl ja ba nɛ.
14Biɡvai naanar bini, Utai ne Sakur, asɛ baala fifraanuanɛ ja ba nɛ.
Sɔfo Ɛsra berɔ ba Jerusalam
15Ate, men sɔfo Ɛsra boa nɛra baa le harɛfale ta ba la nyoa, bɔɔ bɛl baa kwiu asɛ nee palɛ kpɔ o bini dɛɛ kaa Ahava ta, asɛ ya so bela tɔpera atoro. Maa nyiŋi nɛra la ne sɔfore la bini la, n ta Lewi dea te bɛlbwa nae. 16Anomanta, n yerɛ Eliesa ne Areɛl ne Sɛmaya, ne Ɛl Netan ne Jarib ne Ɛl Netan, ne Netan ne Sekaria dɛ Mɛsolam ba fa aa ɛ nomonome, dɛ yerɛ Joiarib ne Ɛl Netan baa dɔ wejema kohona, 17dɛ tom ba bwɛɛ nomoa bɛl waa lɔ Kasifia baa yerɔ Ido be. N bol waa baa ka bol Ido ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea be ŋɔ, bá tɛ yaa nɛra bá baa tomɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ o Dea. 18Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ aa sune ya nɛ, dɛ ja ya nɛɛ nomanta, ba tɛ yaa Sɛrebea waa dɔ kwaa ɛɛ wejema kohona. O ɛ Lewi dea te, dɛ le Maali dea, asɛ o bibaala ne o nimanar baala fi dɛ banuatoro ja o nɛɛ dɛ ba. 19Ba ɡelɔ Hasabia dɛ Jesaya baa le Merari dea ɡe ba, ba lolanar fifraanɛ ja ba nɛ. 20Ba berɔ ba bonɔɔna baa dɛɛ ɛ Korowii Dea bini toma nɛra lafraanɛ fifraanɛ ne, ba ɛ nɛra Kooro Devid aa le ba ne ba nomonome cheɡ ŋɔ baa cha Lewi dea tena la. Ba chwerɛ ba bwa sɔna teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ do tɔn bini.
21Ahava bela baa kwi bɔɔ nee ɛɛ palɛ o bini belaa n do ba ŋɔ ya vɔwɛ nyoa, ɡɛ aa ɛ yá won pwɛr ya te do Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ lɔɡa. Ya soŋo o ja ya nɛɛ ya kpɔ ya bii dɛ kwaa yaa dɔa bwa kaa Jerusalam sɔnɔnɔɔ. 22Dɛ sihiih dɛ kpo mɛ kɛ n soŋe laa tena ne nɛra baa soɡe jaɡre ta le koojen be ŋɔ, bá tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe le ya dɔma baa lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta la be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ya ŋɔ koojen la be ŋɔ Korowii dɛ sune nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te dɛɛ tɛo nɛ, kɛ nɛra baa vɛoh la te, o baah ɛɛ diu kohona ó tɛr ba deŋne. 23Anomanta, ya vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii ŋɔ o lɛ yaa le ɡɛ waa nɔ ta. Asɛ o no ya wesoŋa, dɛ lɛ yaa.
Koŋkɛɛla baa kpɔa ba Korowii Dea
24Ate, n le sɔfo nomonome fi dɛ banɛ, ne Sɛrebea ne Hasabia dɛ ba bala fi ja. 25Asɛ n maɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, dɛ loɡa Koojen Atasɛksɛs ne o nɛra baa dɛ jao ne o nomonome, dɛ anɔ la Israel tena aa ba a ne bá kpɔ ɛ toma Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea. 26Kwaa maa maɡa tɛɛ ba laanee, suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa fifraanɛ dɛ anɛ dɛ lafa, suuɡapoŋa koŋkwaa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, dɛ suuɡaswɛm koŋkwaa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa atoro lafraanaarɛ, 27ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore anuatoro ne tama, dɛ ayaawa loɡa anɛ ne suuɡaswɛm loɡa a bwa tɔɡre aa ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
28N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “He fa le he ne laala nɔ bwa cheɡ tɛ Korowii dɛ do ɡoroŋ wubwa. Suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm la ɛ saraha kwaa aa le nɛra bambile bini ba kpɔ ba tɛ Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ la. 29Hé daahna kɛrɛdɛ ka tel kɛŋɔ haa jo Korowii Dea bini Jerusalam, ásɛ dɛ kari a tɔɡre sɔfo nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ Israel nomonnyuune la sie.” 30Ate, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm, dɛ koŋkwaa aa do ɡoroŋ ba kari a tɔɡre la dɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ kaa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea Jerusalam.
31Korobiloɡle, tɔpera fi dɛ anɛ taa ya le bela baa kwi bɔɔ nee ɛɛ palɛ o bini dɛ do Ahava dɛ kaa Jerusalam. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ja ya nɛ, dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe le ya dɔma ne ŋwɛɛra baa sɔh ŋwɛnɛ ta nɔn ta. 32Yaa jo Jerusalam la, ya soɡo dɛ onɛ tɔpera atoro.
33Asɛ tɔpenaarɛ wee la, ya la Korowii Dea, dɛ ka maɡɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm dɛ koŋkwaa aa do ɡoroŋ la do sɔfo Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt waa ɛ sɔfo la nɔn ta, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea la bini. Dɛ Fenehas bibaa Eliasa ja o nɛ, ne Lewi dea tena baa ɛ Jesua bibaa Josabad dɛ Binui bibaa Noadia. 34Ba kure kwaa la bwa dɛ jemɛ a nyoa ne ɡɛ a tɔɡre aa doa. Dɛ chwerɛ a bwa do tɔn ta bil ɡɛ saŋ.
35Nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta aa le bela ba la, ba kpɔ saraha kwaa ba ba fuh tɛ Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ. Ba kpɔ nabala fi dɛ anɛ tɛ Israel harɛ tena bwa, pebala fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ anumɛl ne pebali fifraanuanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bombala fi dɛ anɛ ɡe ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ saraha soŋe ba wechɔɡa. Ba fuh ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa ɛ saraha tɛ Korowii. 36Ba berɔ kpɔ tɔn koojen la fa aa kpɔa tɛɛ ba la tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre aa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ, ne o nomonome bwa, asɛ ba cha nɛra la ne Korowii Dea toma la.

Title: ƐSRA 9
Content:
Ɛsra soŋe Korowii hɔɔhra hahmor ne yal wa
1Baa ɛ anɔ bwa tonɛ la, nomonome la ba men sɔfo Ɛsra be ŋɔ, “Israel tena ne sɔfore, dɛ Lewi dea tena la ta ba te pere le Keenan ne Hiti ne Pɛrɛs, ne Jebus ne Amɔn ne Moab ne Ijipt, dɛ Amɔre tena we-ɛɛla Korowii aa kia aa wola were la ta. 2Israel baala la kpɔ harɛre aa bar ba cheme la haahna mo, a che a ta ba ne Korowii nɛra ba wa aa do ɡoroŋ la, ne ba we-ɛɛla aa wola were la koo dɔŋa. Nomonome ne sitɔɔla laanee tɔ ba sie ba ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ.”
3Maa no ɡɛ waa nɔ la, n kɛɛ n batakaare, dɛ tɛr n nyumpona ne n tampona, asɛ dɛ so harɛ n bwara yɔr, n tea bini aa chɔɡa wa. 4Nomɛlbwa waa no waa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɔ aa bola la baa bar mɛ cheme dɛɛ chel, dɛkalkɛ nɛra baa le bojaŋ harɛfale ta dɛ ba la waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe. Asɛ n so bela dɛɛ di suna ka tel kɛŋɔ jɔmɔr saraha ɛɛ aa tela.
5Jɔmɔr saraha ɛɛ aa tela la, n iro le bela maa soɡa dɛɛ di suna la, n batakaare maa kɛɛra ta do mɛ, asɛ n ɡuŋi harɛ dɛ ɡɔɔ n nɔɔra Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ la be nyundua, 6dɛ soŋo ŋɔ,
“N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, sihiih dɛ kpo mɛ n di ncho ɡe kohona, kɛ maa ɡɔɔ nyu dɛɛ nyiŋi he siwi ta nɔ, dɛkalkɛ ya wechɔɡa ɡwaa ya nɛ, hale dɛɛ tel he be nyundua. 7Le ya naawa bere saŋ ba le fini, ya wechɔɡa kan kohona. Anomanta, ya ne ya koranar ne sɔfore bwaa harɛre ane koranar lawɛ laa ta dɛ kpoo yaa, dɛ pa ya laala kaa. A ɡel sihiih kpo yaa, asɛ ya do ba lɔɡa ba le fini nɔ.
8Kɛ taraken nɔ, n Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, he sune ya nɛɛ tama bɛl, dɛ ɡel ya bini bane won chwa le yoma yawa ta, dɛ ba so deŋnesɔɔhna ta he Dea ta. He ɡelɔ ya dɔ ya te, dɛ tɛ yaa mkpafale. 9Dɛ ya ɛ yoma, kɛ hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ ta yaa ɡelɛ ya wenaale ta. He baɡle he nyina ya nɛɛ Pɛɛsea harɛ koojena sie. He tɛ yaa mkpafale ya berɛ won kwaa ma hen Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ Dea waa kuuɡa la, asɛ dɛ tɔ yaa ɡbemɡbe, dɛ ɡel ya dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam bwɛdaa ta.
10N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, anɔ bwa habɔɔ, ɛrɛɛ yaa ba wona bol ɔ? Dɛkalkɛ ya ta waa haa do yaa a ta teŋɛ, 11he cheɡɛ he bonɔɔna baa ɛ he keamere la nɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Harɛ haa dɛ kaa o ta ka so la, wechɔɡa ɡelɔ nɛra baa soɡe o ta chɔɡo. Ba kpɔ we-ɛɛla men Korowii aa kia ne wedoŋa su harɛ la bwa. 12Anomanta, he bɛ he bihaahna kpɔ tɛ ba bibaala bá mo, ɡɛɛ aa wola chɛɛ kɛ he ɡe bibaala mo ba bihaahna. Hé ne ba bɛ nyopɛo fɔo bɛlbwa fɔwɛ, ɡɛ aa ɛ he won so dɛ́ biɡri, dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ́ di harɛ la ta kondɛɛɡa, ásɛ a chɔ le tɛ he bii saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.’
13Waa aa pu yaa nɔ bwa le ya wechɔɡa aa ɡela ya di bolchɔɡe la. Kɛ ane a bwa, N Naa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɛ, tamaa kenii he tɛr ya deŋne. He ta ɡelɛ a ɡwaa ya nɛ, dɛ ɡel ya bini bane dɔ ya nyuune dɛ ta so le. 14Yaa wono teŋɛ dɛɛ koni waa haa dɛ do yaa a ta, ya ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ waa baa kia nɔ kaa mo dɔŋa bihaahna, kɛɛ bihaahna kaa yalɛ ba bibaala aa? He baah aa ya nɛɛ di kohona he chɔɡ yaa, ya bini bɛlbwa aa wola ka dɛ́ so le kpa aa? 15N Naa Korowii Israel tena aa dɛ tomɛ, he waa toɡrɔ kohona! He ɡelɔ ya bini bane ta so le. Ya di bolchɔɡe dɛ kpɔ ya wechɔɡa dɛɛ bil he sie, anomanta, ya bini bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ won ba che he sie.”

Title: ƐSRA 10
Content:
Juu tena wechɔɡa bola
1Sɔfo Ɛsra taa ɡuŋa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii o Dea la sie, dɛ wi dɛɛ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa la, Israel tena baa wara, baala ne haahna, dɛ bechale baa baro cheme la ɡe wio kɛrɛdɛ. 2Belaa Jehiel bibaa Sɛkania waa ɛ Elam naa la bini bɛl ŋɔ Ɛsra be ŋɔ, “Ya waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, kɛŋɔ yaa dɛ mo harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa nɔ haahna nɔ. Kɛ ane a bwa, ya Israel tena ta dɔ hwɛɡa. 3Hé ɡel ya ne Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ fɔwɛ fɔo, ásɛ ya doŋi haahna nɔ ne ba bii bwa kaa. Yaa teŋɛ waa he ne nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii waa ta aa bola ŋɔ yá ɛ laanee. Yaa ɛa ɡɛ Korowii Mmara aa dɛ baɡle la. 4Anomanta, sɔfo Ɛsra, ir nyu ne, dɛkalkɛ he nɔn taa ɡɛ waa nɔ do. Yaa che he habɔɔ, dɔ bambile dɛ́ ɛa.”
5Ate, Ɛsra ir che dɛ ɡel sɔfo nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ Israel tena bwa ŋwɛɛ kɛŋɔ baa ɛ ɡɛ Sɛkania aa bola laanee. 6Asɛ Ɛsra le Korowii Dea la sie bela dɛ kaa Eliasib bibaa Jehohanan dea. Waa lɔ bela la, o ta kondikwaa dii dɛ vɛh nee ɡe nyɔe, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ o tea bini chɔɡɔ, nɛra baa kaa bane bojaŋ harɛfale ta, ba berɛ ba ba kasinteŋ bɛ dɔe la wa.
7Anomanta, ba kpɔ kala tɛ ba bola Juda harɛ ne Jerusalam bwa ŋɔ, nɛra baa kaa bane bojaŋ harɛ ta ba berɛ ba la bwa cheme Jerusalam. 8Nomɛlbwa waa vɛh a ɡɛ chema nɔ mun bala ka tel tɔpera atoro la, wɛɛ paŋɛ kwaa waa dɔa bwaa, ɡɛ nomonome aa bola la, ásɛ ba berɛ doŋu le o harɛ waa soɡe o ta la ta.
9Tɔpera atoro la ne tela la, dɛ baala baa soɡe Juda harɛ ne Bɛnjamen dea harɛ bwa cheme Jerusalam. Asɛ korobie anuanaarɛ tɔpera fifraanɛ ta la, ba ka so Korowii Dea dembaah bela. Dɛ bwaala dɛ nɛ kohona, asɛ ba so o bini dɛɛ chel, dɛkalkɛŋɔ dɛ ba chema la waa hiaoh kohona. 10Belaa sɔfo Ɛsra ir che, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe. Harɛfale ta haahnaa he mo, dɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ba ja bolchɔɡe Israel tena aa dia ta. 11Taraken, hé bol he wechɔɡa baɡle Korowii he naawa aa tomɔ, dɛ́ɛ ɛ o bambile bini wa. Hé laa he te kpɔ harɛfala aa bar heyaa cheme nɔ nɛra, ne haahna baa wola he harɛ ta tena ɛɛ he mo ba la nɛ.”
12Ate, nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa sɛh takpeɡ ne ŋɔ, “He waa la wer dɛ toɡre, yaa ɛ ɡɛ haa bola nɔɔ.” 13Kɛ ba berɔ bol ja ŋɔ, “Ya warɛ bonɔ asɛ bwaala ɡe ɛɛ nɛ, anomanta, yaa won che o bini wɛɛ kpo yaa ɡɛ. A ɡɛ waa nɔ ta tɔpebeŋkpoŋ kɛɛ tɔpera anɛ ɡbo waa ɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ ya nɛra yaa di bolchɔɡe ɡɛ waa nɔ ta warɔ. 14Hé ɡel ya nomonome so dɛ́ nyiŋi a ta tɛ ya bwɛɛla bwa, ásɛ nomɛlbwa waa mo a ɡɛ haahna nɔ bɛl la, bá yerɔ ó ba tɔpere baa doo ta, dɛ́ kpɔ nomonome ne nɛra baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole harɛ waa soɡe o ta ja ba. Kenii dɛ́ ɡel waa nɔ Korowii baah aa di ya nɛɛ a waa nɔ le ya nɛ.” 15Nɛra la bwa no waa la mun, atane Asahɛl bibaa Jonatan ne Tikva bibaa Jaseya ɡbo. Mɛsolam ne Sabetai baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la ɡe ja ba nɛ.
16Anomanta, nɛra baa laɡ ba kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba berɛ ba la sɛh ɡɛ baa bola la ta. Asɛ sɔfo Ɛsra le baala baa ɛ deene nomonnyuune, asɛ ba chwerɛ bɛlbwa sɔn denaa ta. Korobie fi tɔpeloɡle ta la, ba soɡe harɛ dɛ nyiŋi waa la ta, 17korobie atoro ne tela, dɛ ba bol baala baa mo haahna baa wola ba harɛ ta tena ɛɛ la waa tonɛ.
Baala baa mo harɛfala ta haahna
18Sɔfore naanar bini, nɛra baa mo harɛfala ta haahna laanee teŋa nɔ.
Josadak bibaa Jesua naanar ne o nimanar bini, Maaseya ne Eliesa ne Jarib dɛ Gedalia. 19Ba bwa baɡɛ Korowii nyoa ŋɔ baa vɛh ba haahna laanee, asɛ bɛlbwa lawɛ pebal ba ɛ wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ́ kɛ saraha, bolchɔɡe baa dia la wa.
20Le Ima naanar ɡe bini,
Hanani ne Sebadia.
21Le Harim naanar bini,
Maaseya ne Elaeja ne Sɛmaya ne Jehiel dɛ Usia.
22Le Pasur naanar bini,
Elionai ne Maaseya ne Ismael ne Nɛtanɛl ne Josabad dɛ Elasa.
23Le Lewi dea tena ɡe bini,
Josabad ne Simee ne Kelaya, ba berɔ dɛɛ yerɔ Kelita, ne Pɛtahea ne Juda dɛ Eliesa.
24Le yelɡoola ɡe bini,
Eliasib.
Le nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo bini,
Salum ne Telem dɛ Uri.
25Le Israel tena bane ɡe baa kaa bini,
Parɔs naanaree nɔ,
Ramia ne Isia ne Malkija ne Mijamin ne Eliasa ne Malkija dɛ Bɛnaya.
26Le Elam naanar bini,
Matania ne Sekaria ne Jehiel ne Abdi ne Jɛremɔt dɛ Elaeja.
27Le Satu ɡe naanar bini,
Elionai ne Eliasib ne Matania ne Jɛremɔt ne Sabad dɛ Asisa.
28Bebai naanar bini,
Jehohanan ne Hanania ne Sabai dɛ Atlai.
29Le Bani ɡe naanar bini,
Mɛsolam ne Maluk ne Adaya ne Jasub ne Seal dɛ Jɛremɔt.
30Le Pahat Moab naanar bini,
Adna ne Kelal ne Bɛnaya ne Maaseya ne Matania ne Besalɛl ne Binui dɛ Manasɛ.
31Le Harim ɡe naanar bini,
Eliesa ne Isihija ne Malkija ne Sɛmaya dɛ Simion, 32ne Bɛnjamen ne Maluk dɛ Sɛmaria.
33Dɛ le Hasum ɡe naanar bini,
Matinai ne Mataata ne Sabad ne Ɛlefɛlɛt ne Jɛremai ne Manasɛ dɛ Simee.
34Bani naanar bini,
Maadai ne Amram dɛ Uwɛl, 35ne Bɛnaya ne Bɛdeya dɛ Keluhi, 36ne Vania ne Mɛremɔt dɛ Eliasib, 37ne Matania ne Matinai dɛ Jaasu.
38Binui naanar bini,
Simee, 39ne Sɛlɛmia ne Netan dɛ Adaya, 40ne Maknadibai ne Sasai dɛ Saarai, 41ne Aasarɛl ne Sɛlɛmia dɛ Sɛmaria, 42ne Salum ne Amaria dɛ Josef.
43Nɛbo ɡe naanar bini,
Jeyɛl ne Matitia ne Sabad ne Sebina ne Jadai ne Joel dɛ Bɛnaya.
44Dɛ a ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa mo haahna baa wola ba harɛ ta nɛra ɛɛ, hale ba bini bane ne ba haahna loɡle. Asɛ ba doŋi haahna la ne ba bii bwa kaa.

Title: NEHEMIA TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Nehemia Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Pɛɛsea koojen aa tɛo ŋwɛnɛ o ba bwɛjen Jerusalam dɛ ba kwaa ma o danjwɛɛre aa kuuɡa. Nehemia boa nɛra nyoa baa ma danjwɛɛre la, dɛ berɛ tɔ dɔma ŋwɛnɛ ásɛ ba bɛ won ba chɔɡ toma la. O kpɔ ɡɛ toma nɔ bwa do Ɛsra nɔn ta ja, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nɛra warɛ dɛ́ ba so Jerusalam dɛɛ tomɛ Korowii o Dea la bini, dɛkalkɛ ba kpɔ ba te tɛ Korowii waa la kɛrɛdɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 1
Content:
Nehemia wesoŋa
1Waa Hakalia bibaa Nehemia aa ɛa laanee teŋa nɔ.
Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta bene fifraanɛ, Keslɛv ta, dɛ men Nehemia lɔ bwɛjen Susa. 2Belaa n dɔŋ Hanani ne nɛra bane le Juda harɛ ta dɛ ba. Asɛ n bɔɔ ba Juu tena baa wona chwa le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba kaa laa ta, ne bwɛjen Jerusalam wa.
3Anee ba ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Banɔ la baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la balɔ. Ba lɔ wahala ne sihiih ta. Danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam la kuuɡo, asɛ bwɛɛ la doonyojen ɡbeni la ɡe, ba fuah a ɛ tɔɔ.”
4Maa no waa nɔ la, n soɡo dɛ wi. N wio la sie tɔpere bɛl tama dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ŋɔ,
5“N Naa Korowii haa dɛ di kora nyundua, he kan dɛ do ɔma kohona. He dɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne nɛra baa dɛ nyini aa fɔwa, dɛɛ teŋɛ he Mmarare ta kasinteŋ ne. 6Cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ wesoŋa maa kpɔa dɛɛ bil he sie chɔɔ ne jwaana, he bonɔɔna baa ɛ Israel tena nɔ wa. N dɛ bol n wechɔɡa ne ya Israel tena bwa kwa, dɛ anɔ la n naawa aa ɛa dɛ jo he nɛɛ bwa. 7Ya ɛ nyubinikpeɡ, dɛ jo he nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Ya ta waa he fa aa kpɔa tɛ he bonɔɔ Mosis dɛɛ do yaa a ta, ne mmarare la ta teŋɛ.
8Lii waa he fa aa do he bonɔɔ Mosis dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Dɛ he Israel tena waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe yaa, mɛɛ lɔ heyaa peɡre harɛre ta, 9kɛ dɛ he berɔ ba n be dɛ ba teŋɛ waa maa dɛ do heyaa a ta tenaa, hale dɛ ba lawɛ heyaa laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ jaɡa kwaraa naa, mɛɛ boa he nyoaa, dɛ́ lawɛ heyaa ba bela maa lea cheɡ ŋɔ baa tom mɛ la.’
10N Naa Korowii, ba ɛ he bonɔɔna ne he ɡbaɡba nɛra. He kpeɡri ne he bokpeɡa nee he lɛɛ ba. 11Cheɡ deŋne no n wesoŋa ne he bonɔɔna baa dɛ nyin ba kpɔ duure tɛɛ la wesoŋa. Gel a chiɡ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ fini, dɛ́ ɡel koojen na n sum.”
Gɛ saŋ dɛ menee dɛɛ do Koojen Atasɛksɛs sen.

Title: NEHEMIA 2
Content:
Nehemia Jerusalam kaala
1Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene fifraanɛ, korobie Nisan ta la, ba ba sen ne ba tɛo. Asɛ n lɛ dɛ kpɔ ka tɛo. Dɛ o ta men nae n waa do sum o be bwa. 2Anomanta, koojen la bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “He bwara aa hen we, aah bɔkwa waa ɡela he waa do sum he tea bini chɔɡ ken?”
Ate, dɛ n dɛ ɔmɛ kɛrɛdɛ. 3Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Kórowii tɛɛ mkpajaŋ! Bɔkwaa dɛ́ ɡel n waa aa wola sumii doɔ? Bwɛjen baa huɡe n naawa o bini paɡrɔ dɛ berɛ dimɡbia, o doonyojen ɡbeni ɡe bwa fuh.”
4Ate, Koojen Atasɛksɛs ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ n ɛ́ tɛɛ nɔ?”
Asɛ n soŋe Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua, 5dɛ chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ he tea too men maa ɛ he bonɔɔ nɛɛ he no n wesoŋa nɔ naa, ɡel ń kaa Juda harɛ ta, bwɛjen Jerusalam baa huɡe n naawa la ta, dɛ́ ka kwaa vɔrɔwo.”
6Anee koojen la ne o haah waa soɡe o jwɛɛh bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, “Tɔpera aŋwɛnɛɛ hɛɛ ba kpɔe dɛ́ tel bela, dɛ́ berɛ ba nɔ?” Dɛ koojen la tea toorɔ kɛŋɔ ó ɡel n kaa, anomanta, n doo tɔpere.
7Asɛ n berɛ ŋɔ Koojen Atasɛksɛs be ŋɔ, “Dɛ a too he tea aa, cha mɛ dɛ́ chwerɛ tɔne tɛ mɛ ń kpɔ ka tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr baŋ harɛre ta la, ásɛ ba nyiŋi n nɛ, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ ń won kaa Juda harɛ ta sɔnɔnɔɔ.” 8N berɔ soŋo ŋɔ ó chwerɛ tɔn tɛ mɛ ń kpɔ ka tɛ Asaf waa dɛ nyiŋi koojen kɔne ta la, ásɛ o tɛ mɛ doli maa kpɔ ɛ dekpeɡ la doonyoo aa bɛne Korowii Dea, ne danjwɛkpeɡ waa bar bwɛjen la, dɛ dem maa ka so o ta. Korowii ja n nɛɛ nomanta, koojen la tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa maa soŋo. 9Koojen Atasɛksɛs kpɔ laa nomonome ne banɔ la baa soɡe jaɡre ta ba ja n nɛ, asɛ n la Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr harɛ ta, dɛ ka kpɔ tɔne waa chwera tɛ nomonome baa dɛ nyiŋi bela harɛre ta la ka tɛɛ ba.
10Asɛ Sanbalat waa le Bɛt Hɔrɔn, ne Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn nomonome la bini bɛl noɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛl koh Israel tena kɛrɛdɛ doe wa dɛ ba, asɛ a we ba nɛ.
Nehemia kaa nyiŋi Jerusalam danjwɛɛre
11Belaa men Nehemia la Jerusalam, maa di bela tɔpera atoro habɔɔ la, 12baala tama banee ja n nɛ, n ne ba ir jwaana. N ta waa Korowii aa kpɔa do n liire bini ŋɔ ń ɛ Jerusalam la bolɛ baɡle nomɛlbwa, keeɡo maa soɡe o ta ɡboo, ane ta jae kpa.
13Asɛ n kpɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa ta awola jwaana, dɛ kpɔ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Kalampoŋa Kɔlɔŋ ne Puldoa Doonyoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam danjwɛjena baa kuuɡa, ne ɡɛ baa fuh o doonyoone bwa la. 14Ate, n berɛ kpɔ sie chaɡɛ Nee Nyu Doonyoa ne Kooro Tam ta, kɛ dɛ bɔr toole keeɡo maa soɡe o ta la dɔ bɔr kpɔ, 15anomanta, n kpɔ Kedrɔn Fɛlembɔjen la bini jwaana la ne, dɛ ha sie dɛɛ nyiŋi danjwɛɛ la. Asɛ n berɛ habɔɔ dɛ berɛ ka kpɔ Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa la ta dɛ jo bwɛjen la ta. 16Nomonome baa lɔ bwɛjen la ta, ta bela maa laŋa kɛɛ waa maa dɛ ɛ jemɛ. Dɛ n ta wobɛlbwa n bala Juu tena, ne sɔfore ne nomonjena ne nomonome, dɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ba jae dɛ́ ɛ toma la be bolɛ.
17Ate, n ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Hé na waa yaa lɔ a ta! Jerusalam berɛ dimɡbia, ba fuh o doonyojen ɡbeni. Hé ɡel ya kwaa ma danjwɛɛ o fa aa baro la, ásɛ sihiih bɛ yaa kpo kpa.” 18N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ɡɛ Korowii maa dɛ tomɔ aa sune n nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ nɔn tɔ n nɛ, ne koojen la waa waa bol n be la.
Anee ba chaŋe ŋɔ, “Hé ɡel ya pa mun kwaa dɛɛ ma.” Anomanta, ba kpɔ ba te dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ tondɛɛɡa nɔ.
19Asɛ Sanbalat waa ɛ Hɔrɔn te, ne Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn tena nomonome la bini bɛl, dɛ Gɛsem o ɡe aa ɛ Arab te noɔ, asɛ ba mamɛ dɛɛ muɡli ya baah ŋɔ, “Bɔkwa waa hɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ? Koojenii hɛɛ ba deŋnekpeɡ ɛɛ la.”
20Asɛ n chaŋ ba ŋɔ, “Korowii Waa Dɛ Di Kora Nyundua ɛɛ ɡeloo wobɛlbwa kaa kɛrɛdɛ tɛ yaa. Yan yaa ɛ o bonɔɔnaa ɛɛ pa munii dɛɛ ma. Kɛ he te nɔn toole Jerusalam komɛlbwa ta. He toole o saŋ la waa ɡe ta.”

Title: NEHEMIA 3
Content:
Jerusalam danjwɛɛ kwaara dɛ́ ma
1Nɛra baa kwaara ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Jerusalam laanee Sɔfonomoa Eliasib ne o bala. Ba kwaarɔ ma Peera Doonyoa dɛ do o ɡbeni, dɛ ma danjwɛɛ kaa Lafa Dejaŋ ne Hananɛl Dejaŋ ta, dɛ kpɔ do Korowii nɔn ta. 2Asɛ Jeriko baala ɡe kwaa ma choŋi, Imri bibaa Sakur ɡe ne o nɛra ma onɔ la waa teŋa choŋi.
3Hasena bibaala ɡe berɛ kwaa ma Pɛŋa Doonyoa, dɛ kpɔ doli dawɛ o ta, dɛ do ɡbeni ne bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kara. 4Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt o nabaa aa ɛ Hakɔs ne o nɛra ɡe ma choŋi. Bɛrekea bibaa Mɛsolam o nabaa aa ɛ Mɛsesabɛl ne o baala ma choŋi. Asɛ Baana bibaa Sadɔk ne o baala ɡe ma choŋi. 5Tekoa baala kwaarɔ ma bampera, kɛ bwɛɛ la sitɔɔla ta ba te kpɔe ja nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi toma la ta nɛ.
6Pasea bibaa Joiada ne Besodiya bibaa Mɛsolam ɡe berɛ kwaa ma Jesana Doonyoa. Ba kpɔ doli ne ɡbeni do o ta, dɛ kpɔ bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ karɛ ɡbera la do o ta. 7Asɛ Melatia waa le Gebeɔn ne Jadɔn waa le Mɛrɔnɔt, ne Gebeɔn dɛ Mispa baala ɡe ma choŋi ka tel harɛ nomoa waa lɔ Yufretis Moo wee cholibɔr dem. 8Haahaya bibaa Usiel waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ɡe ma choŋi. Asɛ Hanania, waa jemɛ nosɔɔhsoma ɛɛ ma choŋi ka tel danjwɛɛ la bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Danjwɛpaɡ la ta. 9Hur bibaa Refaya o fa aa ɛ nomoa dɛɛ nyiŋi Jerusalam bampera ɡe kwaarɔ ma choŋi. 10Asɛ Harumaf bibaa Jedaya kwaa ma choŋi, dɛ bela bɛne o dem. Asɛ Hasabeneeya bibaa Hatus ɡe kwaa ma choŋi. 11Asɛ Harim bibaa Malkija dɛ Pahat Moab bibaa Hasub ɡe kwaa ma bampera bobɛl ne dejaŋ bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Fononoo Dejaŋ la. 12Halɔhɛs bibaa Salum, o ɡe fa aa ɛ Jerusalam bampera nomoa kwaa ma choŋi. O bihaahna chao.
13Hanun ne nɛra baa soɡe bwɛjen Sanoa ɡe berɛ kwaa vɔrɔwe Fɛlembɔjen Doonyoa. Ba do ɡbera ne bune o ta, dɛ bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ karɔ. Ba berɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la dɛ ka tel Puldoa Doonyoa la ta. O jaŋne lɔ naɡale kaɡboŋ lafraanue.
14Puldoa Doonyoa la, Rekab bibaa Malkija o fa aa ɛ Bɛt Hakerem harɛ nomoa la ɡee kwaara mao. O do ɡbera o nyoa, dɛ do bune o ta ba kpɔ dɛɛ karɔ.
15Kol Hose bibaa Salum o fa aa ɛ Mispa harɛ nomoa laanee kwaara ma Nee Nyu Doonyoa. O tɔɔ dɛ do ɡbeni o nyoa, dɛ do bune baa kpɔ dɛɛ kara. Onee bera kwaa ma danjwɛɛ waa bar Siloam tam, waa bɛne Kooro bodɛɛɡe waa du daa jwɛh. O mao ka tel kwaa baa kpɔ a ta tu dɛɛ le Kooro Devid Bwɛjen la ta. 16Asɛ Asbuk bibaa Nehemia, o fa aa ɛ Bɛt Sor harɛ nomoa ɡe kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl o ne bela baa huɡe Kooro Devid sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa, ne tam bɛl baa kwiu, dɛ bobɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Banyoola Dea.
17Lewi dea tena baa teŋa nɔ ɡee kwaara ma danjwɛɛ la baŋ bɛla ane choŋi. Banee, Bani bibaa Rehum waa ɛ ba sitɔɔ, ne Hasabia o fa aa ɛ Keila harɛ nomoa, o ɡee aa maa choŋi tɛ o harɛ tena. 18Ba ɡe nɛɛ Henadad bibaa Bavae o ɡe fa aa ɛ Keila harɛ nomoa ne o nɛra teŋɛ dɛ berɛ kwaa ma choŋi. 19Asɛ Jesua bibaa Esa o fa aa ɛ nomoa Mispa ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi dea baa dɛ cheɡ dɔmkwa o ta la sie, ka jaɡɛ dea la loŋkora waa ɡoŋa ta. 20Sabai bibaa Baruk ɡe kpɔ sibeɡra kwaa ma choŋi o ta, ka tel sɔfo Eliasib dem doonyoa. 21Uria bibaa Mɛremɔt, o nabaa sɔne Hakɔs, on ɡe kwaara ma choŋi sɔfo Eliasib dem doonyoa bampera kaa o jaɡa.
22Sɔfore baa teŋa nɔɔ bera kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la bamperi ɡalɡa. Banɔ la baa soɡa bar Jerusalam laanee bera kwaa maa. 23Bɛnjamen ne Hasub kwaarɔ ma choŋi. Bela lɔ ba dem sideŋ. Asɛ Maaseya bibaa Asaria, baa yerɛ o nabaa Anania ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi. Bela lɔ o dem jwɛh. 24Henadad bibaa Binui ɡe berɔ kwaa ma choŋi le Asaria dem ka jaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la loŋkora bobɛl. 25Asɛ Usai bibaa Palal kwaa ma choŋi le danjwɛɛ la loŋkora bela dɛ kaa dejaŋ waa lɔ koodem la nyundua. O bɛne dembaah bela nɛra aa dɛ daah la. Asɛ Parɔs bibaa Pɛdaya ɡe kwaa ma choŋi. 26Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea dɛ so Ofel deŋɡare ta ɡe kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl o ne Nee Doonyoa sie aa chaɡɛ dɔŋa, dɛɛ kaa wee leebɔr ne dejaŋ waa tɔ Korowii Dea la ta. 27Asɛ Tekoa baala ɡe kwaa ma choŋi le dejaŋ waa tɔ Korowii Dea la bɔr, dɛ ka tel Ofel danjwɛɛ ta.
28Sɔfore bane pɛo, dɛ kwaa ma choŋi Jaɡre Doonyoa, weekaŋle nyunduabɔr. Bɛlbwa mao chɔŋɛ o dem sie. 29Asɛ Ima bibaa Sadɔk berɛ kwaa ma choŋi o dem sie. Sɛkania bibaa Sɛmaya ɡe berɛ kwaa ma choŋi, dɛ onee dɛɛ daah Wee Leebɔr Doonyoa. 30Sɛlɛmia bibaa Hanania, ne Salaf binumɛlte Hanun ɡe berɔ kwaa ma choŋi, asɛ Bɛrekea bibaa Mɛsolam kwaa ma choŋi o dem sideŋ. 31Asɛ Malkija waa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema, kwaa ma choŋi ka tel bobɛl waa ɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne bonadiire dem. O ne Kwaa Nyoa Boara Doonyoa sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa, dɛ teŋɛ kaa danjwɛɛ waa lɔ weekaŋle nyundua, o wee leebɔr loŋkora bɔr. 32Nɛra baa dɔ suuɡaswɛm kpɔe dɛ ɛ kwaa wejema ne bonadiire la kwaarɔ ma danjwɛɛ waa kaa la choŋi, dɛ le dea waa lɔ loŋkora dɛ kaa Peera Doonyoa la ta.

Title: NEHEMIA 4
Content:
Nehemia di bole o dɔma nɛ o toma ɛɛ ta
1Sanbalat aa noa kɛŋɔ ya Juu tena berɔ kwaa dɛɛ ma Jerusalam danjwɛjen la, bwaawee lawɔ o baah di taeh, wɛɛ mamɛ yaa. 2O cheɡɛ o bala ne Samaria laa tena sie dɛ ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa Juu tena baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ nɔ ɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ? Baa won berɛ kwaa ma ba danjwɛɛ nɔ cheɡ aa? Baa won ɛ sarahare aa? Baa won ɛ sarahare ásɛ dɛ won tonɔ tɔpebeŋkpoŋ ɡbo aa? Baa won berɛ dɔ bwea le anɔ la baa fuah a daŋɛ chɔ nɔ ta naa?”
3Dɛ Tobia waa ɛ Amɔn te cheɡɛ nomoa la jwɛh. O ŋɔ, “Danjwɛɛ baa dɛ ma nɔ, hale dɛ kɔkɔbo kwaraa teehno waa, wɛɛ taɡɔ ɡo.”
4Ate, men Nehemia soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ baa dɛ chɛɡre yaa, ɡel chɛɡa baa dɛ chɛɡre yaa nɔ ɡure ba nyu ta. Gel ba paŋɛ komɛlbwa baa dɔa, ásɛ ba laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛfale ta. 5Bɛ ba bolchɔɡe dii ta tɔ, bɛ ba wechɔɡa soh, dɛkalkɛ ba chɛɡre ya nɛra yaa bera kwaa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ la.”
6Anomanta, ya teŋɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la ka tel bela waa kpeɡ ka tel la baah ta tonɛ, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la ɛ toma la sibeɡra ne.
7Ate, Sanbalat ne Tobia ne Arab ne Amɔn, dɛ Asdɔd tena aa noa kɛŋɔ Jerusalam danjwɛɛ baa bera kwaa dɛɛ ma la chemo dɛɛ nyin tona la, ba baah diu kɛrɛdɛ. 8Asɛ ba bwa pɛ, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ, bá ba yo Jerusalam, dɛ́ kpɔ sibeɡra ba ta nɛra baa lɔ bela nɛ. 9Anee ya soŋe Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ, dɛ ɡel nɛra ɛɛ daah toma la webaŋa ne jwaana, dɛ́ tɔ ba ŋwɛnɛ.
10A bwa habɔɔ, dɛ Juda tena dɛ ɡo yel bɛl wáa do ba ɡbemba toma la ta ŋɔ, “Tom-ɛɛra la dɛ ɡwɛɡre, berekese aa kuuɡa warɔ, yaa wola won kpɔ dɛ́ berɛ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la.”
11Ya dɔma la berɔ ŋɔ, “Ba ne ŋɔ ba jemɛ kɛɛ dɛ na yaa la, dɛ ya jo ba bini dɛ́ kpoo ba, ásɛ toma la den ka dɛ́ ba a jaɡa.”
12Ate, Juu tena baa soɡa bɛne ya dɔma la ba ŋɔ ya be kera fi ne a habɔɔ bwa ŋɔ, “Bobɛlbwa haa kpɔ bwa, baa yo yaa.”
13Anomanta, men Nehemia, n kpɔ nɛra la bane so danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ bela waa wola nyundua kaalɛ. N kpɔ ba so denaa ta, ba kpoŋe ba keri ne lampeare ne tori dɛ hɛma. 14N iro dɛ ka na kɛŋɔ a ɛ waa tɛ nɛra la, anomanta, n ŋɔ ba ne ba sitɔɔla ne ba nomonome, ne banɔ la baa jaa la bwa be ŋɔ, “He bɛ ban ɔmɛ, hé lii ɡɛ Korowii aa do kan dɛ do ɔma kohona, ásɛ dɛ yo tɛ he bwɛɛ tena, ne he bibaala ne bihaahna, ne he haahna dɛ he deremi.”
15Ya dɔma noɔ kɛŋɔ ya jemɛ vɔrɔwa baa vɔrɔwa la, dɛ berɛ na kɛŋɔ Korowii chɔɡ ba wa. Ate, ya bwa berɛ ba danjwɛɛ toma la ta, bɛlbwa baa ɛ o toma.
16Le awola tɔpere dɛɛ kaa la, baala la pera ka dɛ ɛ danjwɛɛ la toma, asɛ bane ɡe kpoŋe lampeare, ne kwaa baa kpɔa dɛɛ tɔ ɡbemɡbe laa ta, ne tori ne hɛma, dɛ dɔmkwaa bwa soo siwi. Asɛ ya nomonome ba che ya Juda tena 17yaa dɛ ma danjwɛɛ la habɔɔ. Banɔ la baa dɛ che danjwɛɛ la laala la, ba bwa ɛ beŋkpoŋ dɛɛ ɛ toma, bɛlbwa kpoŋe dɔmkon nɔn beŋkpoŋ ɡe ta. 18Mamaala la bɛlbwa kpɔ kere sɛɡle o kɛɡre ta dɛɛ ɛ toma. Kɛ nɛn waa dɛ hoh laa bɛla la te soɡe n jwɛh.
19Asɛ n ŋɔ nomonome ne sitɔɔla, dɛ nɛra baa kaa la be ŋɔ, “Toma la kan dɛ paɡri kaa, asɛ bɛlbwa ɡe ta o dɔŋ bɛnɛ danjwɛɛ nɔ mun. 20Dɛ hé ba dɛ no laa bɛla nɔ sii aa, hé bwa chwa ba ya jwɛh. Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la ɛɛ yoo tɛ yaa.”
21Anomanta, tɔpere bɛlbwaa ya bini bane ɛɛ ɛ toma, asɛ bane ɡe kpoŋe lampeare, dɛ che dɛɛ daah yaa. Ya dɛ ɛ toma le chɔmbibi ka tel kɛ bɔr aa jo, weweela le. 22A ɡɛ saŋ la, n ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Nómɛlbwa ne nɛn waa dɛ chao ɛɛ baa so Jerusalam jwaanaa, dɛ́ won dɛɛ daah bwɛjen nɔ jwaana, dɛ́ bwa berɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma webaŋa ɡe. 23N ne n bala ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma dɛ banɔ la baa dɛ daah dɛ ja n nɛɛ la, bɛlbwa ta o laala waa doa la foore bil. Bɛlbwa dɛ kpoŋe o dɔmkon hale o dɛ nyɔ ne.”

Title: NEHEMIA 5
Content:
Nehemia nyaara chae
1Saŋ bɛl, Juu tena la ɡalɡa baala ne haahna bwa pa mun dɛɛ naɡre ba bala Juu tena la wa. 2Ba bini bane ŋɔ, “Ya ne ya bii warɔ, ya dɛ nyin kondikwaa dɛ́ di, dɛ́ won so.”
3Bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Yá kpɔ ya kooni ne daa kooni, dɛ ya deremi cheɡ awɔba, dɛ́ kpɔ nyin kondikwaa cheɡ lɔr saŋ.”
4Asɛ bane ɡe ŋɔ, “Yá kemɛ suuɡa, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ toɔ kooro aa dɛ lɛ yaa ya kooni ne daa kooni ta. 5Ya ne ya bala Juu tena bwa beŋkpoŋ. Gɛɛ ya bii ne ba ɡe bii ɛ kɛrɛdɛ, kɛ ya kpɔ ya bibaala ne bihaahna do ba lɔɡa kɛŋɔ yoma ken, ya bihaahna bane tɔ sie ɛ yoma. Taraken ya ta kpeɡri bɛlbwa dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛ ya kooni ne daa kooni berɛ nɛra bane kwa.”
6Men Nehemia aa no waa baa dɛ naɡre a waa la, n baah diu kɛrɛdɛ. 7N lii a waa n nyu bini taeh, asɛ n kah sitɔɔla ne nomonome la ŋɔ, “He kemɛ he bala Juu tena suuɡa dɛɛ lɛ a ne!” Anomanta, n yerɛ nɛra la bwa cheme, dɛ nyiŋi waa la bini, 8dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Ya lɛ ya bala Juu tena baa yoɡ ba te tɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ. Taraken he ɡe berɔ ɛɡre he ɡbaɡba nɛra ba yoɡ ba te dɛɛ tɛ yaa!” Ate, nomonome la hel, dɛkalkɛ ba ta wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol.
9N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Gɛ haa dɛ ɛ nɔ aa were. A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ́ ɛ wa aa toɡra. Ásɛ dɛ bɛ nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ dɛ ɛ ya dɔma la ŋwɛnɛ tɛ, bá ba mamɛ yaa. 10N ne n bala ne n nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma nɔ ɡba dɛ kem ba suuɡa ne kondikwa. Hé ɡel ya kpɔ kema yaa dɛ kem ba kwaa dɛɛ lɛ a nee la kɛ ba. 11Hé kpɔ ba kooni ne daa kooni, ne ɔleve kooni ne deremi, ne suuɡa haa dɛ lɛ a nee bɔre lafa, ne mea ne senfala, dɛ noo la kɛ ba buɡ nɔ ta.”
12Ate, nomonome la chaŋe ŋɔ, “Yaa berɛ ba kwaa tɛɛ ba, ɡɛ haa bola la, yaa komɛlbwaa lɛ le ba be kpa.”
Asɛ n yerɛ sɔfore la cheme, dɛ ɡel sitɔɔla ne nomonome la ŋwɛɛ ntam ba sie kɛŋɔ, baa teŋɛ nyoa baa baɡa la taa. 13N ɡe laa yal waa vɔwɛ n chara la kpɔ dɛ jwiiru, dɛ ŋɔ, “Kenii Korowii ɛɛ ba nomɛlbwa waa wola o nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ jwiira ta le o dem, ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta, ásɛ o nya so.”
Asɛ nomɛlbwa waa lɔ bela ŋɔ, “Aamen!” dɛ kpɛɛ Korowii. Asɛ nomonome la ɛ ɡɛ baa baɡɛ nyoa la.
14Koojen Atasɛksɛs di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ. Waa di kora bene fifraanɛ ta la, o le men Nehemia mɛɛ nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta bene fi dɛ anɛ. Gɛ saŋ la bwa la, ba ta men kɛɛ n lolanar kondikwaa aa chɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta tɛɛ n di. 15Nomonome baa tɔ n sie nyiŋi Juda harɛ ta mɔɔ la ɛɡre Juda harɛ ta nɛra dɛ lɛ suuɡapoŋa fifraanaarɛ, dɛ kondikwaa ne sen. Hale ba bonɔɔna ɡba fiiɡi nɛra la. Kɛ n te, ɔma maa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii nomanta, n ta ɡɛ ɛɛ. 16N kpɔ n liire bwa do Jerusalam danjwɛɛ la kwaara dɛ ma toma ta. Nɛra baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa chemo, toma la ɛɛ ta, ya ta harɛ bɛlbwa nyine tɛ ya te.
17Waa aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ, dɛ Juu tena ne ba nomonome lafa fifraanue dɛ di kwaa n be, harɛre nɛra baa bar yaa cheme te ta jae. 18Tɔpere bɛlbwaa n ɡel baa kpo nabal ne pedɛɛɡa anumɛl dɛ jala, asɛ tɔpera fi bɛlbwa ɡe, n ɡel baa tɛ sene bwa soo siwi kohona. Anɔ bɛlbwa la, n ta kondikwaa aa chɛ kɛ bá kpɔ tɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ ta waa pɛɛrɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ a ɡwaa nɛra la nɛ.
19N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lii n wa, dɛ́ ɛɛ mɛ kɛrɛdɛ, waa bwa maa ɛa tɛ nɛra nɔ wa.

Title: NEHEMIA 6
Content:
Nehemia waa vɔrɔwa dɛ́ kpoo
1Sanbalat ne Tobia ne Arab te Gɛsem, dɛ ya dɔma baa kaa aa noa kɛŋɔ n berɔ kwaa ma danjwɛɛ la tonɛ, bojeɡaa bɛlbwa ta kae, a lole kɛŋɔ dɛ n ta ɡbeni o doonyoone la ta doe mɔɔ la, 2Sanbalat ne Gɛsem kpɔ kala tɛ mɛ ŋɔ, “Gel ya ne he cheme Ono deŋɡarere dor harɛ waa chɔa kaa bwɛjeɡre la bɛl ta.”
Dɛ n vɔrɔwaa baa vɔrɔwe dɛ́ che a ta ɛɛ mɛ waane, 3anomanta, n tomɛ toroma ba be ŋɔ, “Toma maa dɛ ɛ la waa hiaoh kohona, maa won tu ba he be bela. Maa won ɡel toma la bil dɛ́ ba he be.” 4Ba kal mɛ ɡɛ kala nɔ kera anaarɛ, asɛ n ɡe kpɔ a ɡɛ kala la tenten tɛɛ ba.
5Ate, Sanbalat tomɛ o bonɔɔna la bini bɛl n be anɔ la aa teŋa nue, ɡɛ waa la tenten ne. Dɛ o kpoŋe tɔn la o nɔn ta, o ta o nyoa marɛ. 6Gɛ o bini waa aa dɛ baɡle laanee nɔ.
“Gɛsem ŋɔ men Sanbalat be ŋɔ, harɛre nɛra dɛ bol ŋɔ he ne Juu tena dɛ nyin he pere he te, a waa he berɛ kwaa dɛɛ ma danjwɛɛ la. Anɔ la aa jaa ɡee kɛŋɔ, he berɔ dɛɛ nyin he cheɡ he ɡbaɡba kora ta. 7Hale he le Korowii keamere ŋɔ bá bol nɛra bwa no he waa Jerusalam kɛŋɔ, ‘Kooro bɛl lɔ Juda harɛ ta.’ N jemɔ kɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ ɛɛ tel Pɛɛsea koojen bee, anomanta, ba yá cheme dɛ́ kpɔ a liire.”
8Anee n tomɛ ba ka ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Waa haa dɛ bol nɔ bɛlbwa ta kasinteŋ ɛɛ, he ɡbabir nyu bini liiree.”
9Dɛ ba dɛ nyin ba aah yaa, ásɛ ya bwara yɔr ya ɡel toma la ɛɛ. Asɛ n soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, tɛ mɛ bokpeɡa!”
10Awola bɛl, n la Delaya bibaa Sɛmaya dem. O nabaa sɔne Mɛhetabɛl. Maa laŋa la, dɛ o laa ɡbera tɔ o nɛ. O ŋɔ n be ŋɔ, “Gel n ne he ka sɔh Korowii Dea Boɡoroŋ Tenten bela, dɛ́ laa ɡbeni la tɔ ya nɛ, dɛkalkɛ ba dɛ nyini dɛ́ kpo. Baa bao jwaana saŋ nɔ bɔr, dɛ́ ba kpoe.”
11Anee n chaŋe ŋɔ, “N do ken dɛ́ chwa aa? Nɛn waa do kɛ men koh n nyu lɛɛ waa dɛ́ chwa ka sɔh Korowii Dea aa? Akai, maa la!”
12N nao kɛŋɔ Korowii laa tomɔ, kɛ yawaa Tobia ne Sanbalat yawɔ sen ŋɔ, ó ba bol ɡɛ waa la n be. 13Ba kpɔɔ ŋɔ ó ba aah mɛ, ásɛ a che a ta n fee ɛ wechɔɡa, ásɛ ba dɔ n sɔnchɔɡe yerɛ dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ.
14Asɛ n soŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii, nyiŋi waa Tobia ne Sanbalat aa ɛa nɔ, dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne a wa. Berɛ lii kɛŋɔ he keame bɛl waa ɛ haah baa yerɔ Noadia, dɛ keamere baa jaa ɡe jao dɛɛ aah mɛ ɡɛ.”
Toma la tona
15Ba ma danjwɛɛ la tonɛ Elul korobie tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anue ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔpera fifraanue dɛ anɛ tonɛ toma la bwa. 16Ya dɔma aa no waa nɔ la, harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar yaa la ɔmɔ, ba liire bwa chɔɡ, dɛkalkɛ bɛlbwa nao kɛŋɔ, Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ laanee cha yaa yá won tonɛ toma la bwa.
17Gɛ saŋ la bwa, sitɔɔla baa lɔ Juda harɛ bwa chwerɛ tɔne kaa tɛ Tobia, asɛ o ɡe kwa ɛɛ la ba be, 18dɛkalkɛ dɛ Juda harɛ ta tena ɡalɡa ja Tobia nɛ. Dɛ Ara bibaa Sɛkania helabaalee Tobia, asɛ Sɛkania bibaa Jehohanan mo Mɛsolam o mɛɛ aa ɛ Bɛrekea. 19Nɛra yon baa bol Tobia wedɛɛɡa bwa waa ɛa n be, dɛ kaa bol anɔ la n ɡe aa bola o be. Asɛ o teŋɛ chwerɛ tɔne dɛ baa aah mɛ.

Title: NEHEMIA 7
Content:
1Danjwɛɛ la kwaara dɛ ma aa tona asɛ n do o doonyoo ɡbeni la, men Nehemia le nɛra baa so doonyoa la ta dɛɛ daah, dɛ le Korowii Dea yelɡoola ne Lewi dea tena baa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, dɛ kpɔ ba tomare do ba nɔn ta. 2N kpɔ Jerusalam do n dɔŋ Hanani ne Hanania nɔn ta ŋɔ baa nyiŋi o ta. Dɛ Hanania ɛ nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi dekpeɡ la ta. O waa dɔ kasinteŋ wɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii, o dɔŋ aa wola toole. 3N ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ chɔɔbɔr bá ɡel wee ɛɛ baŋɛ mɔɔ baa ya Jerusalam doonyoo ɡbeni la, ásɛ wee joɔ ɡe aa, ba tɔa dɛ́ kaɡra mɔɔ nɛra baa dɛ daahna la le bela. N berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, bá le nɛra bane baa daah bwɛɛ la bobɛla, bane ɡe ɛɛ daah ba deremi bɔra.
Nɛra baa bera le bojaŋ harɛfale ta ba sɔna
4Dɛ Jerusalam kan, kɛ dɛ nɛra baa lɔ o ta aa kanɛ. Dɛ ba ta berɛ kwaa ma deene a warɛ mɔɔ. 5Korowii tɛ mɛ liire kɛŋɔ ń yerɛ bwɛɛ la sitɔɔla ne nomonome, dɛ nɛra baa lɔ bela la cheme, dɛ́ chwerɛ ba sɔna ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ lola ta. N na banɔ la ba naawa aa tɔ sie le bojaŋ harɛfale ta dɛ ba la. Kenii ba chwerɛ ba sɔna ɡɛ baa teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛ.
6Nɛra Babelɔn Koojen Nebukadnesa aa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ Babelɔn, asɛ ba berɛ won ba Jerusalam ne Juda harɛ ta, dɛ ba so ba bwɛɛre ta laanee teŋa nɔ. 7Nomonome baa tɔ ba sie laanee, Sɛrobabɛl ne Jesua ne Nehemia, ne Asaria ne Raamia ne Nahamani, ne Mɔdekae ne Bilsan ne Misperet, ne Biɡvai ne Nehum dɛ Baana.
Baala baa le Israel harɛ taa teŋa nɔ.
8Parɔs naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
9Sɛfatea naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
10Ara naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
11Pahat Moab ne Jesua dɛ Joab luɡe nɛra lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraanuatoro dɛ fi dɛ banuatoro.
12Elam naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
13Satu naanar lɔ lafraanuatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
14Sakai naanar lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanumɛl.
15Binui naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
16Bebai naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
17Asɡad naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
18Adonikam naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanumɛl dɛ banuanɛ.
19Biɡvai naanar lɔ kaɡboŋa banɛ fifraanumɛl dɛ banuanɛ.
20Adin naanar lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanue dɛ banue.
21Ata waa le Hɛsɛkea luɡe ta ɡe naanar lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
22Hasum naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
23Bɛsae naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
24Harif naanar ɡe lɔ lafa dɛ fi dɛ banɛ.
25Gebeɔn naanar lɔ fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banue.
26Baala baa le Bɛtlɛham ne Nɛtɔfa lɔ lafa fifraanuatoro dɛ banuatoro.
27Baala baa le Anatɔt lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro.
28Baala baa le Bɛt Asmavɛt lɔ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
29Baala baa le Kiriat Jearim ne Kefira dɛ Beɛrɔt lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ batoro.
30Baala baa le Rama ne Geba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
31Baala baa le Mikmas lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ.
32Baala baa le Bɛtel ne Ai lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ batoro.
33Baala baa le Nɛbo lɔ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
34Baala baa le Elam lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanue dɛ banaarɛ.
35Baala baa le Harim lɔ lafraatoro fifraanɛ.
36Baala baa le Jeriko lɔ lafraatoro fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue.
37Baala baa le Lod ne Hadid dɛ Ono lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ dɛ beŋkpoŋ.
38Baala baa le Senaa lɔ kaɡboŋa batoro lafraanuanaarɛ fifraatoro.
39Sɔfore baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Jedaya naanar dɛ le Jesua luɡe ta nɛra lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanuanɛ dɛ batoro.
40Ima naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ fifraanue dɛ banɛ.
41Pasur naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuanɛ.
42Harim naanar lɔ kaɡboŋ dɛ fi dɛ banuanɛ.
43Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ.
Jesua naanar dɛ le Kadmiel dɛ Hodavia luɡe nɛra lɔ fifraanuanɛ dɛ banaarɛ.
44Yelɡoola baa jaa ɡee nɔ.
Asaf naanar, ba lɔ lafa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banuatoro.
45Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡee nɔ.
Salum ne Ata ne Talmɔn, ne Akub ne Hatita dɛ Sobai naanar, ba lɔ nɛra lafa fifraatoro dɛ banuatoro.
46Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ɡee nɔ,
ba naanaree,
Siha ne Hasufa dɛ Tabaot,
47Keros ne Sia dɛ Padɔn,
48Lebana ne Haɡaba dɛ Samlai,
49Hanan ne Gedɛl dɛ Gahar,
50Reaya ne Resin dɛ Nekoda,
51Gasam ne Usa dɛ Pasea,
52Besai ne Meunim dɛ Nefusesim,
53Bakbuk ne Hakufa dɛ Haahur,
54Baslut ne Mehida dɛ Haasa,
55Baakɔs ne Sisera dɛ Tɛma,
56Nɛsea ne Hatifa.
57Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar ɡee nɔ.
Sotai naanaree,
Soferet ne Pɛreda,
58Jaala ne Daakon dɛ Gedɛl,
59Sɛfatea ne Hatil,
ne Pɔkɛrɛt Hasebaim dɛ Amɔn.
60Bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea ne Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar lɔ lafraatoro fifraanuanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
61Nɛra baa teŋa nɔ le bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ Tɛl Mɛla ne Tɛl Hasa, ne Kɛrɔb ne Adon dɛ Ima. Kɛ ba ta wone chaɡle kɛŋɔ ba lolanar mun le Israel harɛ ta. Banee nɔ.
62Delaya ne Tobia dɛ Nekoda naanar, ba lɔ lafraanumɛl fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ.
63Dɛ le sɔfore ɡe be peraa nɔ, ba naanaree,
Hobaya ne Hakɔs dɛ Baasilai. A ɡɛ Baasilai nɔɔ fa mo Baasilai waa le Gelead bihaah, a che a ta baa yerɔ ɡɛ sɔn nɔ.
64A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ ɡaaɡe ba naawa luɡe tɔne bini kahonɛ, anomanta, ba kpɔ ba kɛŋɔ nɛra doŋa aa lɔ ba nɛɛ baa wola won ɛ sɔfore. 65Asɛ Juda harɛ nomoa ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ baa won di kondikwaa aa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa baa kpɔa ba tɛ Korowii laa, atane sɔfo bɛl lɔ bela, dɛ́ do batakaare baa sɔh Urim ne Tumim dawɛ o ta ó che a ta bɔɔ waa Korowii aa dɛ nyin la mɔɔ.
66A ɡɛ nɛra nɔ bwa lɔ kaɡboŋa fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ, lafraatoro fifraanumɛl. 67Ba bonɔɔna ne toli baa dɛ tomɛ ɡe lɔ kaɡboŋa banuanɛ lafraatoro fifraatoro dɛ banuanɛ.
