Dɛ ba berɔ dɔ baala ne haahna yelɡoola lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banue. 68Ba jaɡre lɔ lafraanuanɛ fifraatoro dɛ anumɛl, ba keeɡore aa jweera a loɡle la bii lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ anue, 69ba nyoɡmare lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraatoro dɛ anue ne keeɡore kaɡboŋa anumɛl lafraanuanɛ fifraanɛ.
70Nomonnyuune la bini bane le ba bambile bini tɛ kwaa bá berɛ kpɔ cha Korowii Dea toma la. Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta tɛ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore anuatoro ne tama, ne loɡa baa do nee kɛɛ chal a bini, dɛ ɛ dɛɛ merɛ Korowii Dea fifraanue, dɛ sɔfore laala lafraanue fifraatoro. 71Nɛra la nomonome la bini bane tɛ kwaa bá kpɔ cha toma la. Ba tɛ suuɡaswɛm aa tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafa fifraanuanɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa aa tɔɡre aa ɛ boyu baaɡe fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ. 72Nɛra la kabora kwaa baa tɛa lɔ suuɡaswɛm a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore lafa fifraanuanɛ, ne suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ boyu baaɡe fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ, dɛ sɔfore batakaani fifraanumɛl dɛ anuanɛ.
73Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo, ne yelɡoola ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, ne nɛra la bane, dɛ Israel tena baa kaa la bwa kaa so ba bwɛɛre ta.

Title: NEHEMIA 8
Content:
Ɛsra kure Korowii Mmara baɡle nɛra la
1Korobinuanɛ te ta la, dɛ Israel tena bwa kaa so ba bwɛɛre ta. Asɛ o tɔpeloɡle ta ba bwa ba cheme Nee Doonyoa la sie Jerusalam kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ bii. Asɛ ba ŋɔ sɔfo Ɛsra ne tɔnjereme la be ŋɔ, ó kpɔ Korowii Mmara Tɔn o fa aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ba.
2Anomanta, korobie la tɔpeloɡle ta, sɔfo Ɛsra kpɔ Mmara Tɔn la, dɛ ba che baala ne haahna, dɛ bechale baa kpeɡa dɛ won waa mun noe sie. 3O kure tɔn la Nee Doonyoa la sie, nɛnlaa la sie, le chɔmbibi ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa baa che nyufala, asɛ ba bwa cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no waa aa lɔ Mmara Tɔn la bini kɛrɛdɛ.
4Dɛ ba koh waa la waa dɛ kpɔ daa kwaa komɛl o kaa nyundua, asɛ Ɛsra ka che o ta. Asɛ Matitia ne Sema ne Anaya, ne Uria ne Hilkia dɛ Maaseya che o diɡ pera. Pɛdaya ne Mesael ne Malkija, ne Hasum ne Hasbadana ne Sekaria, dɛ Mɛsolam ɡe cheɡɛ o ɡal ta.
5Ɛsra kaa che kon waa kaa nyundua la ta, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ nomɛlbwa won dɛɛ nao. Waa pili tɔn la asɛ nomɛlbwa den ir che. 6Anee Ɛsra ŋɔ, “Hé kpɛɛ Korowii waa ɛ Korowijen la.” Asɛ nɛra la bwa ir nɔɔra nyundua dɛ ŋɔ “Aamen, Aamen” Ba ɡuŋo, dɛ kpɔ sie pi harɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii.
7Ate, nɛra la ir che, asɛ Jesua ne Bani ne Sɛrebea, ne Jamin ne Akub ne Sabetai, ne Hodia ne Maaseya ne Kelita, ne Asaria ne Josabad ne Hanan, dɛ Pɛlaya, baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la baɡle Mmara la bini dɛɛ baɡ ba. 8Ba kure Korowii Mmara Tɔn la, a bini chɔ chasee ken, asɛ nɛra la jemɛ dɛ no waa baa kura la mun kɛrɛdɛ.
9Ate, Nehemia waa ɛ harɛ la ta nomoa, ne sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme, dɛ Lewi dea tena baa baɡle waa la bini tɛ nɛra la ŋɔ, “Fini tɔpere do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii haa dɛ tomɔ, he bɛ wi.” Dɛkalkɛ nɛra la aa dɛ no waa la, dɛ ba dɛ wi.
10Nehemia ŋɔ nɛra la be ŋɔ, “Hé kaa dem, dɛ́ ka di he silɛɛ kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ sensoma, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ane ka tɛ banɔ la baa wola ane dɔe. Fini tɔpere nɔ do ɡoroŋ tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ. He bɛ suna di, dɛkalkɛ silɛɛ Korowii aa tɛ heyaa la ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ bokpeɡa.”
11Asɛ Lewi dea tena larawe nɛra la bwara dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé hel jeiih ken, fini tɔpere nɔ do ɡoroŋ, he bɛ suna dɛɛ di.”
12Ate, nɛra la bwa la ka di kwaa la dɛ nyɔ sen silɛɛ kohona ne, dɛ kpɔ ane kɛ banɔ la baa wola dɔe, dɛkalkɛ ba no waa baa bola baɡ ba la mun kɛrɛdɛ.
Kukure Tɔpejen dii
13Korobie anuanɛ tɔpenɛɛte ta la, nomonnyuune ne sɔfore, dɛ Lewi dea tena la kaa cheme Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme be, o baɡ ba Mmara waa la ja. 14Ba nao kɛŋɔ Mmara Korowii aa cheɡɛ Mosis nɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Israel tena la ŋɔ kukure lɔɡree chɛ kɛ Israel tena so, dɛ́ di Kukure Tɔpejen la korobinuanɛ ta, 15dɛ ŋɔ, bá kpɔ Korowii waa la perɛ ba bwɛɛre ne Jerusalam bwa, dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé la deŋɡarere harɛ ta, dɛ́ ka teŋni dadɛɛɡa, ne ɔleve daa kpala, dɛ bambie ne daa bwa soo siwi kpala, ne a papooni, dɛ́ kpɔ ba ɛ kukure ɡɛ baa chwera do Mmara Tɔn bini la.”
16Asɛ nɛra la ir ka nyin daa kpala la, dɛ ba ɛ kukure ba saldor, ne ba dembaahna ne Korowii Dea dembaahna, ne Nee Doonyoa sie bela nɛra aa dɛ cheme, dɛ Efrem Dea Doonyoa la sie. 17Nɛra baa laɡ ba laa ta kaa bojaŋ harɛ ta la bwa berɔ ba, dɛ ba do kukure, dɛ so a bini, dɛ di Kukure Tɔpejen la. Dɛ le Nun bibaa Josua bere saŋ ba ɡɛ tɔpere la ta la, Israel tena ta Tɔpejen nɔ ken dii bwa. Ba sie lɛo kohona.
18Sɔfo Ɛsra kure Korowii Mmara Tɔn la bini waa baɡle nɛra tɔpere bɛlbwa, le Tɔpejen la tɔpeloɡle ta ba kaa tɔpere waa ka mun ta. Ba di Kukure Tɔpejen la tɔpera anuanɛ, asɛ tɔpenuatoro wee la, ba cheme ɡɛ Mmara la aa baɡla la.

Title: NEHEMIA 9
Content:
Israel tena bol ba wechɔɡa
1Korobinuanɛ la tenten, tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ anaarɛ ta, Israel tena chemo dɛ vɔwɛ nyoa, dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ ɛ teera do ba nyuune ta, a baɡle kɛŋɔ ba tea bini chɔɡɔ ba wechɔɡa wa. 2Ba bini banɔ la baa ɛ Israel tena naanar la, pere ba te le banɔ la baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra naanar la bini, dɛ ka che dɛ bol ba wechɔɡa, ne ba naawa nyubinikpeɡ waa baɡle Korowii. 3Ba cheɡɛ bela baa cheɡa, dɛ he bɔne tɔpebir bini bɔre anaarɛ naa, ba kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ kure Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ Mmara Tɔn la bini waa baɡ ba. Asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ɡe bol ba wechɔɡa, asɛ dɛ tomɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ la.
4Asɛ Jesua ne Bani ne Kadmiel, ne Sebania ne Buni ne Sɛrebea, ne Bani dɛ Kanani baa ɛ Lewi dea tena la, ir ka che komɛl waa kaa nyundua ta, dɛ kpɔ takpeɡ kohona yerɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ.
5Ate, Jesua ne Kadmiel ne Bani, ne Hasabeneeya ne Sɛrebea ne Hodia, ne Sebania dɛ Pɛtahea ba ɡe aa ɛ Lewi dea tena la ŋɔ,
“Hé ir che dɛ́ kpɛɛ Korowii
haa dɛ tomɔ, onee lole
saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la.
Bɛ́lbwa kpɛɛ o sɔn
waa dɔ jirima la,
o kan ɡwaa ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini
aa kpɔ nyoa bol.
6He ɡboo Korowii,
henee ta nyundua
ne weweela bwa.
Henee ta harɛ ne mpo,
dɛ kwaa aa lɔ a ta bwa,
dɛ ɡel a bwa do le.
Kwaa aa lɔ nyundua bwa
dɛ ɡuŋi.
7N Naa Korowii,
henee le ya naa Abram,
dɛ kpɔɔ le Ur waa lɔ
Babelɔn harɛ ta,
asɛ dɛ beɡre o sɔn
Abraham.
8He nao kɛŋɔ
o waa dɔ kasinteŋ tɛɛ,
asɛ he ne o fɔwɛ fɔo.
He baɡɔ nyoa kɛŋɔ
hɛɛ kpɔ Keenan
ne Hiti ne Amɔre,
ne Pɛrɛs ne Jebus,
dɛ Girɡasi tena harɛree
tɛ o naanar ba so a ta.
He teŋɛ he nyobaɡa ta,
dɛkalkɛ he waa dɔ kasinteŋ.
9He na wahala ya naawa
aa naa Ijipt harɛ ta,
dɛ no ba wii Mposwɛm
la ta, dɛ cha ba.
10He ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla
baɡle Ijipt kooro,
ne o nomonome
dɛ harɛ la tena bwa.
Dɛkalkɛ he na ɡɛ baa fiiɡi
he nɛra, dɛ lɛ sɔn
o ta chɔ le ba le fini.
11He ɡelɔ ŋwɛnɛ chɔ mpo bini
tɛ he nɛra,
dɛ tɔ ba sie ba valɛ harɛ
waa hola ta.
He ɡelɔ ba dɔma baa dɛ ti ba
ka nee la ta,
kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ bwe ta
mpo vil ta ken.
12He cheɡɛ bam waa do jaŋne
kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie
webaŋa, jwaana ɡe,
he kpɔ nii waa tɛra
kaa nyundua tɔ ba sie
wɛɛ chaah ba won vala.
13He le nyundua ba
Sinai Bwejen ta, dɛ ba bol
waa baɡle he nɛra,
dɛ kpɔ waa aa wera ne
webaɡla aa toɡra baɡ ba.
14He ŋɔ báa di he Ona Tɔpera
a do ɡoroŋ,
dɛ che he bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ
kpɔ he Mmarare tɛɛ ba.
15Lɔr aa dɛ kpo ba la,
he tɛɛ ba kondikwaa
le nyundua,
nyɔɡre aa dɛ kpo ba la,
he ɡelɔ nee le bwe ta
tɛɛ ba ba nyɔ.
He ŋɔ bá ka kpɔ harɛ
haa baɡ ba nyoa
ŋɔ hɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la.
16Kɛ ya naawa ɛ mbarafo
ne deŋnekpeɡ, dɛ vɛh waa
haa do ba a ta la ta teŋa.
17Ba vɛh he waa la ta teŋa,
dɛ soh nyokpowe-ɛɛla bwa
haa ɛa. Ba ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ,
dɛ le nomoa
ŋɔ ó berɛ kpɔ ba kaa ba
somanjiri dii ta Ijipt harɛ.
Kɛ he ɛ Korowii
haa kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ kɛ,
he dɔ tedoma dɛɛ nyin nɛn,
he baah aa di
warawara ɡe.
He tedoma haa dɔa
tɛ nɛra kan, he ta ban tae.
18Ba ɛ voɡ waa do kɛ nabale,
dɛ ŋɔ onee tɔ ba sie le bane
Ijipt harɛ ta.
N Naa Korowii, na ɡɛ baa
bole nɛnhɛlwobol.
19Kɛ he ta ban ɡelɛ
pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta bela,
dɛkalkɛ tedoma haa dɔa
tɛ nɛra kan kohona.
He ta bam kɛɛ nii waa tɔ
ba sie dɛɛ baɡ ba ŋwɛnɛ
webaŋa ne jwaana laa kpɔ.
20He kpɔ he Doma waa wera
tɛɛ ba wɛɛ baɡ ba wa,
dɛ tɛɛ ba maana ba di,
dɛ tɛɛ ba nee ɡe ba nyɔ.
21He nyiŋi ba nɛɛ
bene fifraanaarɛ
pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta,
dɛ tɛɛ ba komɛlbwa
baa dɛ nyin.
Ba bwara laala ta kɛɛrɛ,
ba napaala ta ɔɡrɛ.
22He ɡelɔ ba yo dɛ pɔ koranar
ne harɛre nɛra nɛ,
harɛre aa lɔ ba jwɛh ta.
Ba yo Hɛsbɔn Kooro Sihon,
ne Basan Kooro Ɔɡ,
dɛ pɔ ba nɛ, dɛ lɛ ba harɛre.
23He tɛɛ ba bii ba warɛ
kɛŋɔ weweela ken,
dɛ ɡel ba yo nɛra dɛ pɔ ba nɛ,
dɛ so harɛ haa baɡɛ
ba naawa ŋɔ
hɛɛ kpɔɔ tɛɛ ba la ta.
24Ba naanar laŋɔ ka yo
dɛ kpɔ harɛ la, o ɛ ba kon.
He tɔ ba sie dɛ sɔɔh nɛra
baa soɡe harɛ la ta nyoa,
dɛ tɛ he nɛra kpeɡri ba pɔ
Keenan harɛ koranar
ne nɛra baa lɔ bela nɛ,
dɛ ɛɛ ba ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin.
25He nɛra yoo dɛ pɔ bwɛjena
baa ma danjwɛkpeɡa
bara nɛ,
ne harɛpare ondɛɛɡe,
ne deremi kondɛɛɡa
bwa soo siwi aa lɔ a ta,
ne bɔɔne baa kwia
a won nee lɛɛ,
ne ɡrepo daa kooni
ne ɔleve daa kooni,
dɛ daa baa dɛ di a nɔna
bwa soo siwi aa wara.
Ba diu vaɡre dɛ je,
ba sie lɛ kondɛɛɡa kohona
haa tɛɛ ba la wa.
26Kɛ ba ɛɛ deŋnekpeɡ
dɛ le he habɔɔ.
Ba laa ba liire kpɔ
he Mmara ta teŋa ta.
Ba kpoo he keamere baa kah
ba ŋɔ, bá charɛ ba liire
ba he be la.
Ba bol wedoŋa
dɛ taah he sɔn la.
27Anomanta, he ɡelɔ
ba dɔma yoo ba,
dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ dɛ fiɡ ba.
Kɛ ba wenaale ta la,
ba wio noe asɛ he no
le nyundua dɛ cha ba.
He cheɡɛ tedoma
haa dɔa kohona ta
dɛ le nomonome tɛɛ ba,
ba ba lɛɛ ba
le ba dɔma nɔn ta.
28Deŋnesɔɔhna aa bala la,
ba berɔ ɛ wechɔɡa ja,
asɛ he ɡel ba dɔma
ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛɛ ja.
Kɛ baa charɛ ba liire
dɛ wi noe ŋɔ hé lɛɛ ba la,
he dɔ tedoma dɛ no
le nyundua, dɛ teŋɛ no
ba be, dɛ lɛɛ ba.
29He kah ba ŋɔ
baa teŋɛ he webaɡla ta,
kɛ ba ɛ mbarafo ba ta
he Mmarare ta teŋɛ,
a lole kɛŋɔ he waa
ta teŋa taa dɛɛ tɛ mkpa.
Ba ɛ deŋnekpeɡ,
dɛ berɛ habɔɔ kpoe,
dɛ vɛh he waa ta teŋa.
30He dɔ bambile tɛɛ ba
bena bɛlbwa,
dɛ che he Doma ta ɡel
he keamere bol waa baɡ ba,
kɛ ba ta noɛ, asɛ he kpɔ ba
do harɛre nɛra nɔn ta,
ba yoo ba dɛ pɔ ba nɛ.
31Kɛ he nɛn nɛɛ suna
aa kana nomanta,
he ta ban vɛɛh
kɛɛ dɛ chɔɡ ba.
He ɛ Korowii haa dɛ sune
nɛra nɛɛ dɛɛ na ba sum.
32Nemenɛ Korowii
yaa dɛ tomɛ,
he kan dɛ do kpeɡri,
he waa ɔma kohona.
He waa dɔ kasinteŋ
hɛɛ teŋɛ fɔo he ne ya
naawa aa fɔwa ta.
Dɛ le saŋ Asiiria koranar
aa fiiɡi yaa dɛ ba le saŋ nɔ,
na ɡɛ ya bwara aa nyɛɡa.
Ya koranar ne nomonome,
ne sɔfore
ne Korowii keamere
ne ya naawa,
dɛ nɛra bwa na bonyɛɡa,
na ɡɛ ya bwara aa nyɛɡa.
33He waa toɡrɔ dɛ dɔ kasinteŋ
kɛŋɔ he tɛr ya deŋne,
a lole kɛŋɔ ya ɛ wechɔɡa.
34Ya koranar ne nomonome
ne sɔfore, dɛ ya naawa ta
he Mmarare ta teŋɛ.
Ba ta waa haa do ba a ta
ne waa haa kah ba ta teŋɛ.
35He swee koranar andɛɛɡa
ba nyiŋi he nɛra nɛ,
ɡɛ saŋ baa soɡe
harɛpare ondɛɛɡe
waa kana he kpɔ
tɛɛ ba la ta,
kɛ ba vɛh ba liire chara,
dɛ le ba wechɔɡa ta
dɛ tomɛ.
36Taraken, ya berɛ yoma
harɛ haa kpɔa tɛ yaa ta,
harɛ o fe aa wera kohona
ya dɔ kondikwaa
dɛɛ di o ta la ta.
37Ya wechɔɡa nomanta,
harɛ la ta kondikwaa bwa
dɛ kaa koranar
yaa lɔ ba lɔɡa be.
Gɛ baa dɛ nyin laanee
baa ɛ ya ne ya kondɛɛra,
anomanta, ya lɔ wahala
kohona ta.
Nɛra la fɔo fɔwa
38Anɔ bwa aa chiɡa nomanta, ya Israel tena dɛ baɡɛ nyoa dɛ́ chwera, ásɛ ya nomonome ne Lewi dea tena dɛ sɔfore kpɔ ba nonibala ɛɡre fɔo nɔ lɔɡa.”

Title: NEHEMIA 10
Content:
1Nɛra baa kpɔ ba nɔɔra ɛɡre do nyoa baa baɡa dɛ chwera la lɔɡa laanee,
men Hakalia bibaa Nehemia maa ɛ harɛ la ta nomoa,
ne Sedekia, 2ne Seraya ne Asaria dɛ Jeremia,
3ne Pasur ne Amaria dɛ Malkija,
4ne Hatus ne Sebania dɛ Maluk,
5ne Harim ne Mɛremɔt dɛ Obadia,
6ne Daneɛl ne Gineton dɛ Baruk,
7ne Mɛsolam ne Abija dɛ Mijamin,
8ne Maasia ne Bilɡai dɛ Sɛmaya.
Gɛ nɛra nɔ bwa ɛ sɔfore.
9Lewi dea tena baa jaa laanee nɔ,
Asania bibaa Jesua ne Binui waa le Henadad dea dɛ Kadmiel,
10ne ba daamanar, Sebania,
ne Hodia ne Kelita ne Pɛlaya dɛ Hanan,
11ne Mika ne Rehob dɛ Hasabia,
12ne Sakur ne Sɛrebea dɛ Sebania,
13ne Hodia ne Bani dɛ Bɛneno.
14Harɛ la ta nomonome laanee nɔ,
Parɔs ne Pahat Moab ne Elam ne Satu dɛ Bani,
15ne Buni ne Asɡad dɛ Bebai,
16ne Adonija ne Biɡvai dɛ Adin,
17ne Ata ne Hɛsɛkea dɛ Asuur,
18ne Hodia ne Hasum dɛ Bɛsae,
19ne Harif ne Anatɔt dɛ Nebai,
20ne Maɡpias ne Mɛsolam dɛ Hesir,
21ne Mɛsesabɛl ne Sadɔk dɛ Jadua,
22ne Pɛlatea ne Hanan dɛ Anaya,
23ne Hosia ne Hanania dɛ Hasub,
24ne Halɔhɛs ne Pelha dɛ Sobek,
25ne Rehum ne Hasabena dɛ Maaseya,
26ne Ahia ne Hanan dɛ Anan,
27ne Maluk ne Harim dɛ Baana.
28Nɛra la kabora baa kaa, sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa, ne yelɡoola ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea, dɛ nɛra baa koh Korowii Mmara la ta teŋa waa dɛ pere ba te le harɛre nɛra baa soɡa bar ba nɛ, ne ba haahna ne bibaala ne bihaahna baa dɛ no waa mun. 29Ba bwa kpɔ ba te ja ba sitɔɔla nɛɛ dɛ ŋwɛɛ ntam kɛŋɔ, baa teŋɛ Korowii Mmara waa cheɡɛ o bonɔɔ Mosis nɛɛ dɛ kpɔ tɛ la taa, dɛ́ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛɛ teŋɛ o waa waa do ba a ta ne o webaɡla bwa ta. Ba ŋɔ, dɛ ba ta a ta teŋaa, Kórowii taah ba.
30Ya baɡɛ nyoa kɛ yaa ya bihaahnaa kpɔ tɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡa bar yaa la yal, kɛɛ ba bihaahna ɡe tɛ ya bibaala ba mo ba.
31Dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa soɡa bar yaa yoɡ mea kɛɛ komɛlbwa tɛ yaa Ona Tɔpere kɛɛ tɔpere waa do ɡoroŋ bɛlbwa ta naa, yaa yawɛ.
Bene anuanɛ bɛlbwa ta la, yaa ɡel ya harɛre ta paraa, dɛ́ kpɔ kema nɛra aa di yaa ɡe kɛ.
32Ya sɛoh kɛŋɔ bena bɛlbwa yaa bɔ suuɡabwe jeɡaa, dɛ́ kpɔ cha Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea kema. 33Kema kɛŋɔ, paanoo waa do ɡoroŋ bá kpɔ dawɛ teebur ta, ne mea sarahare baa dɛ ɛa tɔpere bɛlbwa, ne sarahare baa dɛ fuah, ne Ona Tɔpera sarahare, ne Korobifala Tɔpejena, ne tɔpejena baa lea cheɡ, ne sarahare kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ, ne wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ sarahare baa kpɔ soŋe Israel tena wechɔɡa, dɛ tomare bwa aa lɔ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea.
34Ya sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena ne nɛra la bwa ta bie, dɛ́ jemɛ dem bɛlbwa tena baa kpɔ damara ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ Dea benanyoa bɛlbwa, bá kpɔ fuh sarahare kwaa la Korowii saraha kon la ta, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini la.
35Ya bwa berɔ sɛh kɛŋɔ benanyoa bɛlbwa, yá kpɔ ya koo kondikonloɡla, ne daa bɛlbwa nɔna aa tɔ sie dɛɛ ba Korowii Dea.
36Yaa kpɔ ya bibanloɡla ne nae biloɡla, ne ya boohna ne peera biloɡlaa ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea ba tɛ sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma bela la, ɡɛ baa chwera do Korowii Mmara Tɔn bini la.
37Yaa kpɔ ya kondikonloɡlaa la Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea, bela baa dɛ cheɡ kwaa la, dɛ́ kpɔ ka tɛ sɔfore la, ya mendɛɛɡa ne mea sarahare, ne ya daa nɔna, ne senfala dɛ ɔleve no. Yaa bɔne komɛlbwa aa le ya kooni ta bɔre fii, dɛ́ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ka tɛ Lewi dea tena la, dɛkalkɛ banee dɛɛ lɛa ya bwɛɛre bwa ta. 38Sɔfo waa le Arɔn luɡe ta teŋɛ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ lɛ kwaa nɛra aa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ bɔrbeŋkpoŋa dɛɛ ba a ne la nɛ, ásɛ Lewi dea tena la kpɔ anɔ la baa lɛa la bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋ ba Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea. Dɛ́ kpɔ ba cheɡ deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a yoɡ aa kpeɡa la bini. 39Israel tena ne Lewi dea tena la kpɔ ba mea ne senfala, dɛ ɔleve noo la kaa dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea la bini, bela sɔfore baa dɛ ɛ toma ne nɛra baa dɛ daah doonyoo dɛ yelɡoola aa dɛ so la.
Yaa Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ la Dea vɛh.

Title: NEHEMIA 11
Content:
Nɛra baa bera ba so Jerusalam
1Aa ba dɛ la sie tama la, harɛ la ta nomonome baa so Jerusalam, asɛ nɛra la kabora bil daa, dɛ le dembeŋkpoŋ nɛra le deremi fi bɛlbwa bini, ba ba so Jerusalam bwɛjen waa do ɡoroŋ la ta, asɛ banuanaarɛ kar la ɡe ka so ba bwɛɛre ta. 2Asɛ harɛ la ta tena jam nɛra baa le ba te cheɡ ŋɔ baa so Jerusalam la bwa.
3Nɛra la bini bane baa soɡe bwɛɛre ne bwɛjena ta laanee, Israel tena la bini bane, ne sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena, ne bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea. Dɛ Kooro Solomɔn bonɔɔna naanar soɡe Juda bwɛɛre ane ta. Bɛlbwa kaa so o ɡbaɡba bwɛɛ waa le o ta, 4asɛ nɛra la bane le Juda ne Bɛnjamen deene ta, dɛ ba so Jerusalam.
Nɛra baa teŋa nɔɔ le Juda dea.
Ussia bibaa Ataya waa ɛ Sekaria naa. O nabaala baa jaa nɔ, Amaria ne Sɛfatea dɛ Mahalalel, ba bwa ɛ Pɛrɛs waa ɛ Juda bibaa naanar. 5Dɛ Baruk bibaa Maaseya, o nabaa aa ɛ Kol Hose. O naawa baa jaa laanee Hasaya ne Adaya ne Joiarib, dɛ Sekaria ba bwa aa ɛ Seela waa ɛ Juda bibaa naanar. 6Pɛrɛs naanar baa soɡe Jerusalam lɔ lafraanaarɛ fifraanumɛl dɛ banuatoro, ba ɛ baala baa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ.
7Nɛra baa le Bɛnjamen dea laanee nɔ,
Mɛsolam bibaa Sallu waa ɛ Joed naa. O naawa baa jaa laanee, Pɛdaya ne Kolaya ne Maaseya ne Itiel dɛ Jesaya, 8ne Gabai ne Salai baa ɛ Sallu lolanar tenten. Bɛnjamen dea nɛra baa kaa so Jerusalam la bwa lɔ lafraanuanaarɛ fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro. 9Dɛ Sikri bibaa Joel ɛ ba sitɔɔ, asɛ Hasenua bibaa Juda ɛ nomoa waa teŋa nɛɛ dɛ ja o nɛ bwɛjen la ta.
10Sɔfore ɡee teŋa nɔ,
Joiarib bibaa Jedaya ne Jakin, 11dɛ Hilkia bibaa Seraya o nabaa aa ɛ Mɛsolam. O nabaalaa Sadɔk ne Merayɔt dɛ Ahitub o fa aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa. 12Dɛ ba bwa lɔ lafraanuatoro fifraanɛ dɛ banɛ, dɛ le sɔfore dea dɛɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea. Jɛroham bibaa Adaya o nabaa sɔne Pɛlalia. O nabaala bane ɡee, Amsi ne Sekaria ne Pasur dɛ Malkija. 13O ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ dɛ ɛ nomonnyuune la, ba lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanaarɛ dɛ banɛ. Aasarɛl bibaa Amasae o nabaa aa ɛ Asai, o nabaala bane ɡee Mɛselɛmɔt dɛ Ima. 14O ne o bala baa ja o nɛɛ lɔ lafa fifraanɛ dɛ banuatoro. Dɛ ba ɛ laa tena baa kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ. Ba sitɔɔ sɔne Sabdiel, o mɛɛ ɡe sɔne Haɡedolim.
15Lewi dea tena ɡee nɔ,
Hasub bibaa Sɛmaya, o nabaa sɔne Asrikam. O nabaala bane ɡee Hasabia ne Buni, 16ne Sabetai ne Josabad baa ɛ Lewi dea nomonnyuune. Dɛ ba ɡee Korowii Dea habɔɔ toma do ba nɔn ta. 17Mika bibaa Matania, o nabaa sɔne Sabdi, o ɛ Asaf naa. Dɛ Asaf nɔɔ dɛɛ tɔ yelɡoola sie Korowii Dea baa ɡo jam yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii, ne Bakbukia, onee ja Matania nɛɛ dɛɛ chao, ne Samoa bibaa Abda, o nabaa aa ɛ Galal o ɛ Jedutun naa. 18Dɛ Lewi dea tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Jerusalam waa do ɡoroŋ la bwa lɔ lafraanɛ fifraanuatoro dɛ banaarɛ.
19Nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoa laanee,
Akub ne Talmɔn dɛ ba lolanar, ba bwa lɔ lafa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banɛ.
20Israel tena baa kaa la ne sɔfore dɛ Lewi dea tena, soɡe ba ɡbaɡba bwɛɛre aa lɔ Juda harɛ ta.
21Dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ ɛ toma Korowii Dea soɡe Jerusalam bampera, Ofel deŋɡare ta, asɛ Siha ne Gispa ɛɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ.
22Nomoa waa dɛ nyiŋi Lewi dea tena baa soɡe Jerusalam nɛɛ sɔne Usi. O mɛɛ sɔne Bani, o nabaalee Hasabia. O nabaala bane ɡee Matania ne Mika. Dɛ Usi ɛ Asaf naanar baa chɔ yela ɡoe nyoa Korowii Dea la bini bɛl. 23Dɛ Pɛɛsea koojen do mmara tɛ yelɡoola la, ɡɛ dea bɛlbwa nɛra aa tɔ nɛra sie tɔpere bɛlbwa dɛɛ ɡo yela Korowii Dea.
24Mɛsesabel bibaa Pɛtahea waa ɛ Sɛra naanar la bini bɛl dɛ le Juda dea, chiɡ Israel tena naa ta Pɛɛsea koodem.
25Juu tena la ɡalɡa soɡe bwɛɛre aa bɛne ba kooni ta. Banɔ la baa le Juda dea la soɡe bwɛɛre ane kɛŋɔ, Kiriat Aaba ne Debɔn dɛ Jekabsiil ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, 26ne bwɛjena ane kɛŋɔ, Jesua ne Molada dɛ Bɛt Pɛlɛt, 27dɛ Hasar Sual ne Beɛseeba dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, 28ne Siklaɡ ne Mekona dɛ bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, 29ne Ɛn Remɔn ne Sora dɛ Jaamut, 30ne Sanoa ne Adulam dɛ a bwɛjeɡre ta, ne Lakes ne kooni aa baro ta, ne Aseka ne o bwɛjeɡre ta. Gɛɛ ba so le Beɛseeba waa lɔ weekaŋle harɛbɔr, dɛ teŋe ba kaa Henɔm Fɛlembɔjen weekaŋle nyundua.
31Bɛnjamen dea tena soɡe Geba ne Mikmas ne Aeja dɛ Bɛtel ne bwɛjeɡre aa bara ta, 32ne Anatɔt ne Nɔb dɛ Anania, 33ne Hasɔ ne Rama dɛ Getaim, 34ne Hadid ne Seboim dɛ Nebalat, 35ne Lod ne Ono, dɛ Baala Baa Dɛ Sɛh Kwaa Fɛlembɔjen bini.
36Lewi dea tena la bini bane baa le Juda dea la koo Bɛnjamen dea tena la bini, ba ne ba so.

Title: NEHEMIA 12
Content:
Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena
1Sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena baa teŋɛ Sealteɛl bibaa Sɛrobabɛl ne Sɔfonomoa Jesua nɛɛ ba le bojaŋ harɛ baa laɡ ba kaa ta ba laanee nɔ. Seraya ne Jeremia dɛ Ɛsra,
2ne Amaria ne Maluk dɛ Hatus,
3ne Sɛkania ne Rehum dɛ Mɛremɔt,
4ne Ido ne Gineton dɛ Abija,
5ne Mijamin ne Moadia dɛ Bilɡa,
6ne Sɛmaya ne Joiarib dɛ Jedaya,
7dɛ Sallu ne Amɔk ne Hilkia dɛ Jedaya.
Banɔɔ sɔfore sitɔɔla ne banɔ la baa dɛ cha ba, Jesua bere saŋ.
8Lewi dea tena ɡe sɔnaa, Jesua ne Binui ne Kadmiel, ne Sɛrebea ne Juda dɛ Matania, ne o bala baa ja o nɛ. Banee chɔ yela baa ɡoa dɛɛ kpɛɛ Korowii Dea la nyoa. 9Asɛ Bakbukia ne Uni dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛɛ ɡe che Korowii Dea bampera, ba ne ba sie chaɡɛ dɔŋa baa ɡo yela la ane.
Sɔfonomoa Jesua naanar
10Jesua lolɛ Joiakim, Joiakim lolɛ Eliasib asɛ Eliasab lolɛ Joiada, 11Joiada lolɛ Jonatan, Jonatan lolɛ Jadua.
12A saŋ Joiakim aa ɛ Sɔfonomoa la, dɛ banɔɔ nomonnyuune ba lolanar bini,
Seraya lolanar bini, Meraya,
Jeremia lolanar bini, Hanania,
13Ɛsra lolanar bini, Mɛsolam,
Amaria lolanar bini, Jehohanan,
14Maluk lolanar bini, Jonatan,
Sɛkania lolanar bini, Josef,
15Harim lolanar bini, Adna,
Mɛremɔt lolanar bini, Helkai,
16Ido lolanar bini, Sekaria,
Gineton lolanar bini, Mɛsolam,
17Abija lolanar bini, Sikri,
Miniamin ne Moadia lolanar bini, Peltae,
18Bilɡa lolanar bini, Samoa,
Sɛmaya lolanar bini, Jehonatan,
19Joiarib lolanar bini, Matinai,
Jedaya lolanar bini, Usi,
20Sallu lolanar bini, Kalai,
Amɔk lolanar bini, Iba,
21Hilkia lolanar bini, Hasabia,
Jedaya ɡe lolanar bini, Nɛtanɛl.
22Ba chwerɛ Lewi dea nomonnyuune ne sɔfore sɔna bil ɡɛ saŋ Sɔfonomonome ba sɔna aa teŋa nɔ aa lole. Banee, Eliasib ne Joiada ne Johanan, dɛ Jadua. Ba chwerɛ ɡɛ sɔna nɔ tonɛ ɡɛ saŋ Koojen Dareɔs aa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta. 23Ba chwerɛ Lewi dea tena nomonnyuune sɔna do tɔne bini, ɡɛ saŋ Eliasib bibaa Johanan aa lole. 24Dɛ Lewi dea tena nomonome laanee, Hasabia ne Sɛrebea dɛ Kadmiel bibaa Jesua, dɛ ba bala baa ja ba nɛ. Ba bɔne ba bini kuore anɛ, beŋkpoŋ dɛ ɡo yela asɛ beŋkpoŋ ɡe ɛɛ sɛh ba nyoa. Ba bwa pɛo dɛ ɡo yela dɛɛ kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii, ɡɛ Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid aa baɡla la.
25Dɛ Matania ne Bakbukia ne Obadia, ne Mɛsolam ne Talmɔn dɛ Akub, dɛ daah dejeɡre baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini a bɛne Korowii Dea doonyoo la. 26Gɛ saŋ dɛ Jesua bibaa Joiakim, o nabaa aa ɛ Josadak, ne Nehemia waa dɛ nyiŋi harɛ la ta, dɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme la lole.
Jerusalam danjwɛɛ kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta
27Baa dɛ ba bwɛjen Jerusalam danjwɛɛ baa maa baro kpɔe dɛ́ do Korowii nɔn ta la, ba yerɛ Lewi dea tena le bobɛlbwa baa soɡa ba. Asɛ ba ba ja, dɛ ɡo jam yela, dɛ kpɔ kwaa bwa soo siwi baa kpɔa dɛɛ hɛlɛ lɔ yela lɛ ba sie. 28Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɡo yela la boa ba nyoa le bwɛɛre aa bar Jerusalam, dɛ Nɛtɔfa tena bwɛɛre ta, 29ne Bɛt Gelɡal ne Geba dɛ Asmavɛt, dɛkalkɛ dɛ yelɡoola la ma ba deene dɛ so bar Jerusalam. 30Sɔfore la ne Lewi dea tena la ɛ we-ɛɛla, dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ Korowii be pera, ne nɛra la ne doonyoo, dɛ danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la bwa ta.
31Ate, men Nehemia yerɛ Juda nomonome la cheme danjwɛɛ waa bar bwɛjen la doa, dɛ ɡel ba chɔ yelɡoola kuore anɛ aa kana nyoa ŋɔ, bá valɛ bar bwɛjen la, dɛ́ ɡo yela jam Korowii. Kuo beŋkpoŋ tɔ sie kpɔ sie chaɡɛ danjwɛɛ la diɡ pera, dɛ kaa Puldoa Doonyoa la ta. 32Asɛ Hosaya ne Juda nomonome pera ɡe teŋɛ ba nɛ. 33Ba ne Asaria ne Ɛsra dɛ Mɛsolam, 34ne Juda ne Bɛnjamen ne Sɛmaya dɛ Jeremia, 35dɛ sɔfore bane ba ɡe aa dɛ hoh bɛle, dɛ Jonatan bibaa Sekaria, o nabaa sɔne Sɛmaya. O nabaala bane ɡee, Matania ne Mikaya dɛ Sakur, baa ɛ Asaf naanar. 36O bala ba ɡe aa ɛ Asaf naanar la bane teŋɛ o nɛ. Banee, Sɛmaya ne Aasarɛl ne Milalai, ne Gilalai ne Maai ne Nɛtanɛl, ne Juda dɛ Hanani. Dɛ ba bwa kpoŋe Korowii nɛn Kooro Devid kwaa waa kpɔa dɛɛ lɔ yela la dɔŋa. Asɛ sɔfo Ɛsra waa ɛ tɔnjereme tɔ ba sie. 37Baa tel Nebule Doonyoa ta la, ba cheɡɛ kwaa ane a do kɛ sanjol ta teeh kaa Kooro Devid Bwɛjen ta, dɛ ɡarɛ Kooro Devid koodem, dɛ berɛ habɔɔ ba Nee Doonyoa waa lɔ bwɛjen la wee leebɔr pera ta.
38Kuo nɛɛte baa ɡo yela jam Korowii la kpɔ ɡal pera, dɛ kpɔ danjwɛɛ la doa, asɛ n ne nomonome la bini bane teŋɛ ba nɛ. Ya valɔ dɛ ka ɡarɛ Fononoore Dejaŋ dɛ kaa Danjwɛpaɡ la ta, 39dɛ le bela ka ɡarɛ Efrem ne Jesana ne Pɛŋa Doonyoo, ne Hananɛl ne Lafa Dejaŋa, dɛ kaa Peera Doonyoa la ta. Yaa vala ka tel doonyoa waa bɛne Korowii Dea la, asɛ ya che.
40Kuore anɛ baa ɡo yela jam Korowii la bwa kaa che ba chebɔra Korowii Dea bela, asɛ n ɡe ka che, n ne nomonome baa ja n nɛɛ la bwa, 41dɛ sɔfore bane kɛŋɔ, Eliakim ne Maaseya ne Miniamin, ne Mikaya ne Elionai ne Sekaria, dɛ Hanania kpoŋe ba bɛle. 42Asɛ Maaseya ne Sɛmaya ne Eliasa, ne Usi ne Jehohanan ne Malkija, ne Elam dɛ Esa teŋɛ ba nɛ. Asɛ Jesrahia tɔ yelɡoola la sie, ba kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ɡo yela. 43Awola tɔpere la, ba kpoo kwaa warɛ ɛ sarahare, dɛɛ hɛɡre, dɛkalkɛŋɔ Korowii ɡelɔ ba dɔ silɛɛ kohona. Haahna ne bechale ɡe sie lɛo, nɛra la silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa ɛɛ la bojaŋa bwa.
44Gɛ saŋ la, ba le baala bane baa nyiŋi deene baa lɛ kwaa dɛ kpɔ baa cheɡ a bini Korowii Dea la ta. Kondikonloɡla ne kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi, dɛ kpɔ a bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa dɛɛ ba ne. Ba lɛa le kooni aa bar bwɛɛre ta ba cheɡ deene la bini, ɡɛ Mmara aa chaɡla kɛŋɔ, anee chɛ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la. Dɛkalkɛ, dɛ Juda tena bwa sie lɛ ba ne Lewi dea tena la nɛ. 45Ba ɛ we-ɛɛla dɛ laa doŋa bɛlbwa kpɔ ba nɛɛ Korowii baa dɛ tomɔ be pera, ɡɛ Korowii aa do ba la. Gɛɛ yelɡoola ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea doonyoo ɡe ɛ, ɡɛ Kooro Devid ne o bibaa Solomɔn aa do ba la. 46Le Kooro Devid ne Asaf bere saŋ, dɛ nɛra tɔ yelɡoola sie baa kpɛɛ dɛɛ jam Korowii yela ne. 47Anomanta, le Sɛrobabɛl ne Nehemia bere saŋ bwaa Israel tena le, dɛɛ tɛ yelɡoola ne nɛra baa dɛ daah Korowii Dea kwa tɔpere bɛlbwa. Ba kpɔ saraha kwaa aa do ɡoroŋ dɛɛ tɛ Lewi dea tena, ásɛ ba ɡe kpɔ anɔ la aa chɛ sɔfore baa ɛ Arɔn naanar kwaa tɛɛ ba.

Title: NEHEMIA 13
Content:
Hɔɔhra pera dɛ́ le Israel tena bini
1Awola tɔpere la, ba kure Mosis Mmara Tɔn la a le baŋ nomɛlbwa no. Ba kure o bobɛl waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ, Amɔn te kɛɛ Moab te bɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ Korowii nɛɛ ja, 2dɛkalkɛ ba ta Israel tena kondikwaa ne nee tɛɛ, ɡɛ saŋ baa le Ijipt harɛ ta dɛɛ kaa la. Ba kaa kpɔ Balam ŋɔ, ó ba taah Israel tena, kɛ Korowii ɡelɔ taahna la berɛ hɛɛra. 3Israel tena la aa no ɡɛ Mmara nɔ la, ba le nɛŋhɔɔhra baa koo ba bini la bwa ne harɛ la ta.
4Gɛ waa nɔ aa wola balɛ mɔɔ la, dɛ sɔfo Eliasib dɛ nyiŋi deene baa dɛ cheɡ laala a bini Korowii Dea. Dɛ o ne Tobia som. 5Asɛ Eliasib kpɔ dejen ba fa aa dɛ cheɡ mea baa kpɔa ba ɛ saraha ne daawiile, ne laala bwa soo siwi aa lɔ Korowii Dea, ne mea baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi bini bɔrbeŋkpoŋa, ne senfala dɛ ɔleve noo aa chɛ kɛ ba kpɔ tɛ Lewi dea tena, ne Korowii Dea yelɡoola dɛ nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi doonyoo ta, dɛ anɔ la baa kpɔ tɛ sɔfore bwa, do Tobia nɔn ta.
6Gɛ waa nɔ bwa aa dɛ ɛ la, dɛ men Nehemia toole Jerusalam, dɛkalkɛ Babelɔn Koojen Atasɛksɛs aa di kora bene fifraatoro dɛ anɛ taa n berɛ kaa o be. A habɔɔ n soŋo ŋwɛnɛ, 7dɛ berɛ ba Jerusalam. Maa bala la, n nao kɛŋɔ Eliasib ɛ wechɔɡa kɛ waa kpɔ dea tɛ Tobia, o do o bini Korowii Dea la. 8A ɛɛ mɛ bwaawee kohona taeh, asɛ n pa Tobia laala bwa aa lɔ Dea la bini ta buse. 9Ate, n ɡel ba ɛ we-ɛɛla a ɡel deene la do ɡoroŋ, asɛ n berɛ kpɔ Korowii Dea laala la bwa ne mea sarahare, dɛ daawiile a sɔɔh aa soma la ka cheɡ o bini.
10N berɔ na kɛŋɔ Lewi dea tena baa dɛ ɡo yela Korowii Dea la, ne Lewi dea tena la bane ɡe le Jerusalam, dɛ berɛ kaa ba kooni ta, dɛkalkɛ nɛra la aa ban kwaa aa chɛ kɛ ba tɛɛ ba la tɛ. 11N baah diu, n kah nomonome la ɡɛ baa ɡela Korowii Dea chɔ pɛɛ la. Asɛ n berɛ ba Lewi dea tena la ne yelɡoola la ne Korowii Dea, ba baa ɛ ba tomare ja.
12Asɛ Juda tena la bwa berɛ pa mun dɛɛ ba ba kwaa baa bɔne a bini bɔre fi bɔrbeŋkpoŋa kɛŋɔ, mea ne senfala dɛ ɔleve noo ne, dɛ kpɔ baa cheɡ deene aa lɔ Korowii Dea la bini ja. 13N kpɔ nɛra ŋɔ baa nyiŋi deene baa kpɔ kwaa dɛɛ cheɡ a bini la ta. Banee, sɔfo Sɛlɛmia ne tɔnjereme Sadɔk dɛ Lewi dea te Pɛdaya. Asɛ Hanan ɛɛ cha ba, o mɛɛ sɔne Sakur, o nabaa sɔne Matania. Banee n ŋɔ ba bɔne kwaa la dɛɛ tɛ ba bala tom-ɛɛra la. Dɛ n dɛ yarada ba.
14N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, nyiŋi waa maa ɛa kasinteŋ ne he Dea nɔ ta nɔ, ne ɡɛ baa dɛɛ tomɛ bela.
15A ɡɛ saŋ la, n na Juda tena bane baa dɛ tiɡri ɡrepo nɔna ta, dɛ kpɔ a nee dɛɛ ɛ sen Ona Tɔpere ta. Bane ɡe che mea ne sen ne ɡrepore, ne fiɡ daa nɔna, dɛ kwaa bwa soo siwi ba keeɡore ta, dɛɛ ba Jerusalam. Anomanta, n kah ba ŋɔ, bá nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ komɛlbwa yoɡ Ona Tɔpere ta. 16Dɛ bwɛjen Taaya tena bane soɡe Jerusalam, dɛ kpɔ pɛŋa ne laala bwa soo siwi ba yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ Juda tena Ona Tɔpere ta. 17N baah di Juu tena nomonome nɛ, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “Waa aa ɛ wechɔɡaa he ɛ dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere la. 18Gɛ tentenee he naawa ɛ, asɛ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne, dɛ chɔɡ bwɛjen nɔ la. Asɛ he ta teŋɛ dɛɛ chɔɡ Ona Tɔpere, dɛ kpɔ Korowii bandia kohona ba ta Israel harɛ ta la.”
19Anomanta, n ŋɔ bɔr aa dɛ ba joe ásɛ Ona Tɔpere tel la, bá laa bwɛjen la doonyoo ɡbeni tɔɔɡe ka tel kɛŋɔ waa baa kaa. N kpɔ n tom-ɛɛra la bane so doonyoo la ta, ásɛ ba nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomɛlbwa bɛ komɛlbwa kpɔ ba jo bwɛjen la ta Ona Tɔpere ta. 20Saŋ bɛlbwaa bonadiire ne nɛra baa dɛ yoɡ kwaa bwa soo siwi yon dɛɛ so bwɛjen Jerusalam baŋ Fiara jɔmɔra dɛ́ yoɡ ba kwa. 21Kɛ n kah ba, dɛ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “A ta aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ kɛŋɔ he baa so danjwɛɛ la baŋ jɔmɔra ka tel kɛ tɔ aa pera. He berɔ ɛ ken ja aa, mɛɛ tɛr he deŋnee.” A habɔɔ, ba ta Ona Tɔpere ta balɛ kpa. 22Asɛ n ŋɔ Lewi dea tena la be ŋɔ, bá sɔ ba doŋa bwa ta Korowii be pera, dɛ́ kaa daah doonyoa la, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ ba di Ona Tɔpere la, o do ɡoroŋ.
N Naa Korowii, lii n waa anɔ ɡe ta ja, dɛ́ sune n nɛɛ ɡɛ he nyina kohona aa doa la.
23A ɡɛ saŋ n berɔ na kɛŋɔ Juda baala la ɡalɡa mo Asdɔd ne Amɔn dɛ Moab haahna. 24Ba bii la bini bane dɛ bol Asdɔd wobol, kɛɛ nɛra bane ɡe baa jaa wobol ane. Baa won Juda wobol te bol. 25Asɛ n baah di ba nɛ, dɛ taah ba. N lɔɔ ba, dɛ chuɡri ba bini bane ɡe nyumpona, dɛ ɡel ba ŋwɛɛ ntam Korowii sɔn ta kɛŋɔ, ba ne ba bibaala ne bihaahna bɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra baa wola Korowii tomɛ mo, kɛɛ dɛ yalɛ kpa bwa. 26Hahmor aa do ken taa a che Israel Kooro Solomɔn ɛ wechɔɡa la. Dɛ o ɡwaa harɛre koranar bwa. Korowii waa dɛ tomɔ nyin o wa, dɛ cheɡo kora ta wɛɛ nyiŋi Israel tena nɛ. Kɛ ane a bwa, haahna baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra moe ɡela o ɛ wechɔɡa. 27A chɛ kɛ yá teŋɛ wechɔɡ damanta ne kasinteŋ haa wola dɔe dɛ tɛ Korowii yaa dɛ tomɔ nɔ nɛ, dɛ́ ɡe ka mo haahna baa ɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra kɛɛ?
28Dɛ Sɔfonomoa Eliasib bibaa Joiada ɡe bibaa bɛl mo Sanbalat waa le Bɛt Hɔrɔn bihaah. Anomanta, n doŋi o bibaa la le Jerusalam.
29N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, tɛr ba deŋne kɛŋɔ, baa kpɔ doŋa kah sɔfore toma, ne fɔo waa chɔ he ne Lewi dea tena ne ba baah ta la wa.
30Anomanta, n sɔ sɔfore ne Lewi dea tena la doŋa bɛlbwa ta Korowii be pera le wobɛlbwa aa ɛ wehɔɔhra ta, asɛ dɛ kpɔ bɛlbwa toma do o nɔn ta, asɛ bɛlbwa jemɛ waa waa dɛɛ ɛ. 31N baɡle saŋ aa chɛ kɛŋɔ bá kpɔ daa baa kpɔ dɛɛ fuh saraha kwaa ne ba koo kondikonloɡla dɛɛ ba.
N Naa Korowii maa dɛ tomɛ, lii n wa, dɛ́ sune n nɛ.

Title: ƐSTA TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Ɛsta Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle Juu tena bane baa wola wone berɛ ba Jerusalam, dɛ ta so Pɛɛsea harɛ ta wa. Baa bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Heeman swɛɛ siwi kɛŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ Juu tenaa dɛ́ kpoo ba bwa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o hah ba. Korowii le Juda harɛ bitolo Ɛsta, asɛ o ba ɛ kooro haah. O le o te cheɡ, hale dɛ sɛh seo kwara, dɛ che o dɔɔ Mɔdekae nɛɛ lɛ o harɛ nɛra. Tɔn nɔ dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii aa dɛ di kpeɡri wobɛlbwa ta, dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ o nɛra nɛ.

Title: ƐSTA 1
Content:
Kooro Sɛksɛs vɛh o haah Vasti
1Waa aa chiɡ Koojen Sɛksɛs bere saŋ, ɡɛ saŋ waa di kora Pɛɛsea harɛ ta laanee nɔ. Dɛ o dɛ nyiŋi harɛre lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ ta, le India harɛ dɛ́ kpoŋe ba kaa Itiopia harɛ ta. 2Dɛ o soɡe Susa waa ɛ Pɛɛsea koobwɛɛ ta. 3Waa di kora bentooro te ta la, o yerɛ o nomonjena ne o nomonome bwa ba cheme, asɛ ba di kondikonjena dɛ lɛ ba sie. Pɛɛsea harɛ ne Midia harɛ laa nomonome, ne nomonome baa chɔ o harɛre bwa nyoo ne nomonjena balɔ.
4O kpɔ kondɔɔh aa lɔ kara la mun bwa le asɛ nɛra ba naa, dɛ na ɡɛ o kondɔɔh ne o kora kan aa doa. O ɛ ɡɛ korobie anumɛl bwa. 5Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Kooro Sɛksɛs berɔ ɛ kondikonjena la ane ja, dɛ yerɛ o koobwɛɛ Susa tena bwa, hale dɛ́ le nomonjena nɛɛ dɛ́ kaa dansaara bwa nɛ. Ba di kwaa la koodem bela, bodɛɛɡe bɛl baa du dadɛɛɡa ane lɔɡre tɔpera anuanɛ. 6Bela baa di kwaa la, ba paaɡe pilare baa kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa ane soo siwi maa bar, asɛ dɛ kpɔ pateesanpoŋa ne pateesanburumre saɡre a ta bar. Ba berɔ pɛrɛ jisepoŋ ne jisekɔl pɛ, dɛ kpɔ do pateesanre la ta, dɛ lawɛ vɔwɛ suuɡapoŋa noniseɡa baa kpɔa paaɡe pilare la ta kaa. Ba kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa, dɛ ɛ bobɛl o ir nyundua. Ba kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa ampoŋa ne answɛɛma, ne anɔ la aa dɛ nyɛɡle, dɛ anɔ la aa ɛ burum bwa, dɛ kwaa bela harɛ o do wer. 7Kooro la ɡelɔ ba do sen tɛ nɛra suuɡaswɛm numoli bini ba nyɔ. Numoli la koɡrɔ, asɛ sen la warɛ kohona a baɡle kooro bonya waa dɔa tɛ nɛra la. 8O ŋɔ nɛra baa cheme bela la bɛlbwa nyɔ sen la ɡɛ del waa won nyɔ. O ŋɔ o bonɔɔna la be ŋɔ bá do nomɛlbwa ɡɛ del waa dɛ nyin.
9Dɛ Kooro Sɛksɛs haah sɔne Vasti. O ɡe ɛ kondikonjena la ane, dɛ yerɛ haahna baa lɔ koodem bela la ba ba di.
10Tɔpenuanɛ wee kooro aa nyɔ sen dɛ dɛɛ la, o yerɛ o bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure baa tomɔ la cheme. Banee, Mehuman ne Bista ne Haabona, ne Biɡta ne Abaɡta ne Sɛta, dɛ Kaakas. 11O ŋɔ bá lawɛ o haah Vasti ó kpɔ o ɡbɛrɛ waa dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ o ɛ kooro haah la pi, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ba o sie. Vasti wer kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, kooro la dɛ nyin kɛ Vasti kpɔ o te ba baɡle nomonjena, ne nɛra baa cheme bela la bwa, ásɛ ba na o wer waa doa. 12Kooro bonɔɔna aa la o haah Vasti be la, o vɛh bala. Kooro aa noa la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ.
13Dɛ kooro dɛ nyin nɛra chao waane ta naa, o kpɔɔ dɛɛ bil wejerema baa jemɛ mmarare ne bela waa bini sie, ásɛ ba yon jao. Anomanta, o tao tɛ wejerema baa won waa bini baɡla, 14dɛ dɔ dibɔra kooloŋ ta bela. Banee, Kaasena ne Sɛta ne Admata, ne Taases ne Meres ne Maasena, dɛ Mɛmokan. Gɛ nomonjena banuanɛ nɔ le Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre ta, dɛ ɛ nomonjena ɡwaa nomonome baa lɔ o kora bini bwa.
15Ate, kooro ŋɔ o nomonome la be ŋɔ, “Vasti vɛh yera men Kooro Sɛksɛs aa tomɛ n bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá yerɔ ó ba la. Ɛrɛɛ mmara ɛɛ baɡle kɛ ń ɛo wɔ?”
16Asɛ Mɛmokan che kooro ne o nomonjena la bwa sie dɛ chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ he haah Vasti ɛ ɡɛ tenaa, o ɛ wechɔɡa. He ɡbo sie laa o lawɛ teɡɛ harɛ. Nomonjena ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛre nɔ bwa ta ɡe jao. 17He haah waa waa ɛa nɔ, haahna noɔ waa, baa che a taa ba siwi sa ba jaranar, dɛɛ bol ŋɔ, ‘Kooro Sɛksɛs kwaraa aa do o bonɔɔna ŋɔ bá ka yerɛ o haah la, o vɛoh.’ 18Fini tɔpere nɔ, dɛ Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre nomonjena haahna no he haah waa waa ɛa nɔ naa, ba ɡee dɛɛ ɛ yaa ɡɛɛ. Haahna bwa aa yaa bu kpa, ásɛ ya baala ɡe baah ɛɛ di ba nɛ saŋ bɛlbwa.”
19Mɛmokan ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, do mmarafale bá chwerɛ ja Pɛɛsea ne Midia harɛre mmarare ta, nomɛlbwa aa wola won beɡra bwa, kɛŋɔ Vasti bɛ hen Kooro Sɛksɛs sie tire kpa. O bɛ he haah ɡe ɛ kpa, bá nyin haah waa dɔ da dɛ ɡwaalo tɛɛ he moo. 20Dɛ ba ɡelɔ mmarafale nɔ kaa he kora harɛre aa do kan kohona nɔ bwa ta naa, anee dɛ́ ɡel haah te bɛlbwa ɛɛ duu o jaa, hale dɛ́ le nomonjena nɛ dɛ́ kaa dansaara nɛ.”
21Kooro ne o nomonjena la sie lɛ Mɛmokan waa waa bola la ta, anomanta, o do mmara la. 22O ɡelɔ ba kpɔ mmara la kaa harɛre waa dɛ di kora a ta la bwa ta. Ba chwerɔ tɛ harɛ bɛlbwa tena, ɡɛ ba chwera ne ba wobol aa doa, kɛŋɔ baa bɛlbwa ɛɛ di nomonome o dem.

Title: ƐSTA 2
Content:
Ɛsta baa ɛ kooro haah
1A habɔɔ, Kooro Sɛksɛs baah sɔɔhnɔ tama, asɛ o lii Vasti wa, ne waa waa ɛa la, ne ɡɛ waa koh o waa do mmara la. 2Anomanta, kooro ɡbaɡba bonɔɔna baa lɔ o jwɛɛh la ba liire ne ŋɔ, “N Naa kooro, ɡel bá nyiŋi harɛre la bwa ta, dɛ́ nyin toli baa wera, baa wola baa jemɛ bwa tɛɛ. 3Hɛɛ won ɡel nɛra baa dɛ nyiŋi harɛre haa dɛ di kora a ta la bwa, kpɔ toli baa wera ba koodem haahna dobɔr koobwɛɛ Susa nɔ ta, ásɛ dɛ kpɔ ba do Heɡai baa fɔɡɔ o lur, o do koodem haahna dobɔr dɛɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la nɔn ta, wɛ́ɛ di ba toli. 4Ba bini bɛlbwa he sie aa lɛ o nɛɛ la, kpɔɔ ɛ he haah chiɡ Vasti naa ta.” Kooro aa no ɡɛ baa jao la, o sie lɛ a ta, dɛ ɡel ba ɛa ɡɛ.
5Ate, Susa bwɛjen ta bela, dɛ Juu te bɛl lole baa yerɔ Mɔdekae. Bɛnjamen dea o le. O mɛɛ sɔne Jɛɛ, asɛ Jɛɛ ɡe mɛɛ sɔne Simee, asɛ Simee mɛɛ sɔne Kes. 6Babelɔn Kooro Nebukadnesa lawɛ Juda Kooro Jehoiachin ne nɛra bane le Jerusalam kaa o harɛ ta, dɛ Mɔdekae ja ba nɛ. 7Dɛ Mɔdekae mɛnjen bie bɛl sɔne Ɛsta. O sɔn bɛl ɡee Hadasa, Hibru tena wobol ta. O siebɔr ne o mar wer kɛrɛdɛ. Ɛsta nya ne o mɛɛ aa sewa la, Mɔdekae kpɔɔ berɛ o ɡbaɡba bie dɛɛ nyiŋu.
8Kooro Sɛksɛs aa ŋɔa bá ɡaaɡe toldɛɛɡa bɔr la, ba dɔ bane dɛ kpɔ ba kaa koobwɛɛ Susa koodem haahna dobɔr ka tɛ Heɡai ŋɔ wɛ́ɛ nyiŋi ba nɛ. Dɛ Ɛsta ɡe ja bɛl. 9Heɡai sie lɛ Ɛsta nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ o waa su o siwi, anomanta, o do sie nyiŋu ɡɛ aa chɛa. Buɡ la ta, o tɛo kwaa waa kpɔ dɛɛ di toli, ne kondikondɛɛɡa wɛ́ɛ di, dɛ berɛ tɛo haahna banuanɛ dɛ le koodem bela báa tomɔ, dɛ kpɔ ba ka do haahna dobɔr bela waa wera kɛrɛdɛ.
10Dɛ Mɔdekae fa kah Ɛsta ŋɔ ó bɛ ɡel ba jemɛ o nɛnsoo, anomanta, o ta baɡlɛ kɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te. 11Tɔpere bɛlbwaa Mɔdekae yon le o dem dɛ́ la haahna dobɔr la sie bela, dɛ́ ka valɛ la sie dɛɛ ba habɔɔ kɛŋɔ o ken ɛɛ na Ɛsta dembaah belaa ɡɛ waa doa.
12Mɔɔ toli la bɛlbwa dɔ bɔr la kooro be o ne ó chɔ la, korobie fi dɛ anɛɛ o kpɔ dɛɛ kwaa o te. Korobie anumɛlee o kpɔ dɛɛ fɔɡle nosɔɔhsoma baa dɛ yera korobo la, dɛ́ berɛ fɔɡle konsɔɔhsoma aa dɛ kwaa bwara ɡe korobie anumɛl. 13Awola tɔpere toli la bɛlbwa aa le haahna dobɔr bela dɛɛ la kooro be la, komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin la, ba kpɔɔ dɛɛ tɛo. 14Jɔmɔraa wɛɛ la o be dɛ́ ka chɔ. Tɔɔ perɔ aa, baa kpɔɔ la sɛnanar denɛɛte ta, dɛ́ ka do kooro bonɔɔ Saasɡas baa fɔɡɛ o lur, wɛɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la nɔn ta. Waa kooro bee la kpa, nemenɛ kooro sie lɛ o nɛɛ ó baɡle o sɔn ŋɔ bá yerɔ tɛo ja.
15Aa tela kɛ Mɔdekae mɛnjen Abihel bie Ɛsta waa kpɔɔ berɛ o ɡbaɡba bie la kooro be la, o ta laala ne komɛlbwa soŋɛ ka ja anɔ la Heɡai waa dɛ nyiŋi kooro haahna nɛɛ la aa ŋɔa ŋɔ a wer tɛo la. Nomɛlbwa ɡe waa na Ɛsta la, dɛ o dɛ nyin o wa. 16Kooro Sɛksɛs kora dii bene anuanɛ Tɛbɛt korobie taa a tel kɛŋɔ Ɛsta la kooro be o koodem.
17Ɛsta aa la o be la, kooro sie lɛ o nɛɛ kohona, o waa su o siwi dɛ ɡwaa o haahna ne toli la bwa. Asɛ o kpɔ ɡbɛrɛ waa baɡla kɛŋɔ ó ɛ o haah la piu. O kpɔɔ ɛ o haah chiɡ Vasti naa ta. 18Kooro ɡelɔ ba ɛ kondikonjena a warɛ kohona tɛ Ɛsta waa ɛo o haah la. O yerɛ o nomonjena ne nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la bwa, ba ba di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie. Dɛ ɛ awola tɔpere la ona tɔpere, dɛ kɛ nɛra kwaa kohona aa baɡle kan waa doa.
Mɔdekae lɛ Kooro mkpa
19Ba berɔ ba toli la ne koodem bela nɛɛtena, dɛ Mɔdekae dɔ nomonome dɛ so koodem doonyoa bela. 20Mɔdekae aa ŋɔ Ɛsta be ŋɔ o bɛ ɡel ba jemɛ o nɛnsoo kɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te la, o noɔ tɛo ɡɛ waa dɛ no o waa le o bechale saŋ bwa la.
21Gɛ saŋ Mɔdekae aa lɔ toma ta koodem doonyoa la, dɛ bonɔɔna baa dɛ daah kooro dea doonyoa la bini banɛ baa dɛ yer ba Biɡtana ne Tɛrɛs la baah diu baa vɔrɔwe kɛ baa kpo kooroo. 22Mɔdekae no waa la, dɛ ka taa baɡle kooro haah Ɛsta. Asɛ o ɡe kpɔ ka taa kooro be kɛŋɔ, ɡɛɛ Mɔdekae no dɛ ba bol o be. 23Kooro ɡelɔ ba nyiŋi waa la bini, asɛ dɛ na kɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ, dɛ ɡel ba saɡɛ ɡɛ nɛra banɛ la. O ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ waa la do Koojen Sɛksɛs harɛ waa dɛ di kora o ta la waa tɔn bini.

Title: ƐSTA 3
Content:
Heeman vɔrɔwe Juu tena kpoora vɔrɔwa
1Aa baa tel saŋ bɛl la, Koojen Sɛksɛs kpɔ nomonome tɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman o nabaa aa ɛ Aɡaɡ, o ɛ nomonjen ɡwaa harɛ la nomonome bwa. 2Koojen do nɛra baa lɔ koodem bela dɛɛ ɛ toma la bwa ŋɔ, báa ɡuŋi Heeman harɛ, dɛ́ɛ duuru saŋ bɛlbwa. Ba bwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ, kɛ dɛ Mɔdekae te aa on ɡɛ ɛ.
3Belaa Mɔdekae nomondɔŋa baa lɔ koodem la bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ kooro do yaa ŋɔ yáa duu Heeman, he te aa wola a ta teŋɛ nɔɔ?” 4Tɔpere bɛlbwaa ba teŋɛ dɛɛ bol waa la o be, kɛ o ta ba be noɛ. O ŋɔ, “Juu tee men. Maa won ɡuŋi Heeman.” Anomanta, ba bol Heeman be, dɛ na kɛ o sie ɛɛ lɛ Mɔdekae waa la taa.
5Heeman ɡbabir aa naa kɛŋɔ Mɔdekae aa on harɛ ɡuŋi dɛɛ duuru la, o baah diu kɛrɛdɛ. 6Waa naa kɛ Mɔdekae ɛ Juu te la, o ɛ o liire kɛ waa o ɡboo kpo, dɛ vɔrɔwe kɛŋɔ wɛɛ kpoo o ne Juu tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛ ta la bwaa.
7Kooro Sɛksɛs kora dii bene fi dɛ anɛ Nisan korobie ta la, Heeman ɡelɔ ba bil daa o sie, dɛ́ lawɛ korobie ne tɔpere waa wera tɛo, ó kpɔ ɛ waa waa vɔrɔwa la. Korobie baa lawɔ laanee Nisan korobie.
8Belaa Heeman la ka ŋɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, nɛra bane perɛ he kora harɛre la ta bobɛlbwa. Ba we-ɛɛla korɛ nɛra bwa we-ɛɛla ta. Baa he kora mmarare ɡe ta teŋɛ, anomanta, dɛ he le ba ne naa, a fe wer. 9Dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, do mmara, ásɛ ya kpoo ba. A ba ɡɛ naa, mɛɛ bɔ suuɡapoŋa a tɔɡre aa ɛ kilore kaɡboŋa lafraatoro fifraanaarɛɛ do he kara mun tɛ nɛra baa kpoo a ɡɛ nɛra la.”
10Belaa kooro sɛh, dɛ foo o noniseɡ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛɡɛ tɔn ta la, dɛ ɛ mmara la, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman waa hah Juu tena kohona la. 11Kooro ŋɔ Heeman be ŋɔ, “Gel suuɡa la do he be, ásɛ dɛ ka ɛ nɛra la ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin.”
12Korobiloɡle tɔpera fi dɛ atoro ta la, Heeman yerɛ kooro nomonome bwa cheme. O ɡelɔ ba chwerɛ ɡɛ waa bol Juu tena waa la wobol bwa soo siwi aa lɔ harɛre la bɛlbwa ta, ne ɡɛ ba chwera aa doa, dɛ kpɔ ka tɛ koranar ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛ bɛlbwa nyoa, ne ba nomonjena bwa. Kooro sɔn taa ba chwera, dɛ kpɔ o noniseɡ ɛɡɛ a ta, asɛ a ɛ mmara, dɛ chɔ le saŋ bɛlbwa. 13Ba le toroma bá kpɔ tɔne la kaa harɛre kooro aa di kora a ta la bwa ta. A bini waa dɛ chaɡle kɛ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa. Toli ne bonɔɔna ne nomonome, dɛ haahna ne bechale, bɛlbwa bɛ ka, bá ɛa tɔpebeŋkpoŋ. Adar korobie o tɔpera fi dɛ atoro weeree aa ba chiɡa, ásɛ ba pa ba laala ɡe bwa. 14Toroma la laŋaa, bá tɛ nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo la bɛlbwa mmarafale tɔn la bɛl, ásɛ ba ɡel nɛra bwa soo siwi baa lɔ ba harɛre ta jemɛ a wa, dɛ́ kpɔ ba te dɛɛ kpa tɔpere la.
15Kooro aa do mmara la nomanta, toroma la ɛ warane dɛ kaa, asɛ bane kpɔ waa la perɛ koobwɛɛ Susa ta. Dɛ kooro ne Heeman soɡo dɛɛ nyɔ sen, asɛ bwɛɛ la bwa ɛɛ vuuɡi.

Title: ƐSTA 4
Content:
Mɔdekae soŋe Esta ŋɔ ó chao
1Mɔdekae aa na waa baa ɛa la, o kɛɛ o laala dɛ kpɔ lweyal tɔ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ do o nyu ta, a baɡle kɛŋɔ o tea bini chɔɡɔ. O valɛ bwɛjen Susa fɔɡbaahna dɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona. 2Koodem doonyoa ɡboo o jaɡɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa waa tɔ lweyal la ta ŋwɛnɛ dɔe kɛ ó jo bela. 3Harɛre la bɛlbwa ta kooro mmara la aa tela la, Juu tena baa lɔ bela la tea bini chɔɡɔ baa dooɡe lɔŋɔre dɛɛ wi kohona. Ba vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ kpɔ lweyale tɔ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ merɛ harɛ dɛ chɔ a ta. A baɡle kɛ ba lɔ sibeɡra ta.
4Kooro haah Ɛsta toli ne baala baa fɔɡɛ ba lure baa nyiŋi o nɛɛ la aa kaa bol Mɔdekae waa o be la, a we o nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. O kpɔ laala tɛɛ ba ŋɔ, bá kpɔ ka tɛo ó do, dɛ́ foo lweyal la bil, asɛ o vɛh, o ta laala la lɛɛ. 5Kooro haah berɔ yerɛ baa bɛl baa fɔɡɛ o lur baa yerɔ Hatak, kooro aa leo wɛɛ nyiŋi o nɛɛ la, dɛ doo ŋɔ ó ka bɔɔ Mɔdekae waa aa bala wɛɛ wi.
6Anomanta, Hatak leɔ dɛ ka na Mɔdekae kɛ waa soɡe bwɛɛ la cheremibɔr, waa lɔ koodem doonyoa la sie. 7Mɔdekae baɡle waa aa chiɡa la bwa, dɛ berɛ baɡle suuɡa Heeman aa baɡɛ nyoa ŋɔ, wɛɛ bɔɔ do kooro kara mun, ásɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa la. 8O kpɔ tɔn baa chwera, asɛ ba bol o bini waa Susa la bɛl tɛ Hatak ŋɔ, ó kpɔ ka tɛ Ɛsta dɛ́ baɡle o bini waa o be, ásɛ o la kooro be, dɛ́ ka soŋo ŋɔ ó na o ne o nɛra bwa sum.
9Hatak kaa bol waa Mɔdekae aa bola la bwa kooro haah Ɛsta be. 10O berɔ tomɛ Hatak Mɔdekae be ŋɔ, 11“Nɛra baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem bela, ne nɛra baa lɔ harɛre la ta bwa jemɛ mmara la kɛŋɔ, baa kɛɛ haah aa won la kooro be kooloŋ ta, nemenɛ kooro yerɔ mɔɔ. Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, kpoe chɛ kɛ bá kpoo, nemenɛ kooro tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la tɛo dɛ́ lɛ o nyu.” Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Kooro aa yer mɛ n la o be, tɔpera fifraatoroo nɔ.”
12Hatak aa kaa bol waa Ɛsta aa bola nɔ Mɔdekae be la, 13Mɔdekae berɔ chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kooro haah, bɛ lii kɛŋɔ haa lɔ koodem bela nomanta, dɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa naa, hɛɛ dɔ he nyuu. 14He tɔ nyoa he ta waane bolɛ taraken nɔ naa, Juu tena ɛɛ dɔ nomɛlee ó cha ba, kɛ he te ne he mɛɛ nɛra bwa ɛɛ serewoo. Dɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ waa he ɛ kooro haah taraken nɔ naa, he jemaa?”
15Ɛsta berɔ ŋɔ bá ka ŋɔ Mɔdekae be ŋɔ, 16“Kaa dɛ́ ka yerɛ Juu tena baa soɡe bwɛjen Susa nɔ ta bwa cheme, ásɛ he vɔwɛ nyoa dɛ soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ. He bɛ kwaa di, dɛ bɛ nee ɡe nyɔ tɔpera atoro chɔɔ ne jwaana. N ne n toli ɡe ɛɛ ɛ ɡɛɛ, a lole kɛŋɔ kooro ta nɛn yerɛ aa waa o sie la, kɛ mɛɛ lao. Hale seo kwaraa yaa, ń sewɛ.”
17Ate, Mɔdekae la dɛ ka ɛ ɡɛ kooro haah Ɛsta aa doo ŋɔ ó ka ɛ la bwa.

Title: ƐSTA 5
Content:
Ɛsta ta nɔn yerɛ Kooro
1Baa vɔwɛ ba nyoa tɔpetooro wee tonɛ la, Ɛsta kpɔ laala aa baɡla kɛ o ɛ kooro haah la do, dɛ ka che koodem baah bela kooro dea doonyoa aa chaɡa, dɛ kooro soɡe o kookara ta o sie chaɡɛ doonyoa. 2Waa na o haah Ɛsta bela la, o sie lɛ o nɛ, dɛ tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala waa kpoŋa la pa Ɛsta nɛ, asɛ o suuh tel o be dɛ kpɔ o nɔn leɡe suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la nyoa.
3Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “N haah Ɛsta, a som tenaa? Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ? Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin la, mɛɛ ɛo tɛɛ. Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.”
4Belaa Ɛsta chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, he ne Heeman ba fini dɛ́ ba di kondikonjena maa daala tɛɛ la.”
5Ate, kooro tomɛ o bonɔɔ Heeman be ŋɔ ó ba warane, ásɛ ba la o haah Ɛsta be.
Asɛ ba bwa pɛ la ka di kondikonjena la. 6Baa dɛ nyɔ sen la, kooro bɔɔ o haah Ɛsta ja ŋɔ, “Bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin kɛ ń ɛ tɛɛ nɔ? Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.”
7Asɛ o chaŋo ŋɔ, “Kon maa dɛ nyin laanee kɛŋɔ, 8Dɛ n waa su he siwi hɛɛ nyin kɛ he cha mɛ naa, kere he ne Heeman ba n be dɛ́ ba di kondikonjena maa dɛ ba daala tɛɛ ja. Gɛ saŋee mɛɛ ba kon maa dɛ nyin baɡla.”
Heeman vɔrɔwɔ dɛ́ kpo Mɔdekae
9Heeman iro le bela, o sie lɛ kohona. Kɛ waa na Mɔdekae o so koodem doonyoa bela, waa wola ire che dɛ kpɔ duure tɛo o ba kaa la, o baah berɔ di kohona. 10Kɛ ane abwa, o lawɛ bambile dɛ kaa o dem, dɛ ka tomɛ nɛn ŋɔ ó ka yerɛ o daamanar ne o haah Seres tɛo. 11Ba bwa aa baa cheme la, o kpɔ o kondɔɔh aa kana ne o bibaala wara baa wara dɛ ta nyoa. Dɛ berɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ kooro aa cheɡɛ o ta dɛ tɛo jirima, ne nomonome waa tɛo o ɡwaa o dɔŋa nomonjena ne banɔ la baa dɛ ɛ toma koodem la bwa.
12O berɔ ŋɔ ba be ŋɔ, “N ɡboo kooro haah yerɛ ka ja kooro nɛɛ ya pɛ di kondikonjena. Kɛ a ɡbo laa, o berɔ dɛɛ yerɛ n ne kooro bwa kere ɡe ja. 13Ane abwa, n ta sie na ɡɛ Juu te Mɔdekae aa soɡe koodem doonyoa bela la aa, anɔ bɛlbwa aa n siwi su kpa.”
14Heeman daamanar ne o haah la ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Gel ba pa daa o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue kaa nyundua, ásɛ he ŋɔ kooro be ŋɔ, ó ɡel ba saɡɛ Mɔdekae o ta kere chɔɔ. A ba ɡɛ naa, he ne kooro ɛɛ won berɛ la kondikonjena la bɔr, ásɛ he sie lɛ.” Ba wobol la wer tɛ Heeman kɛrɛdɛ, anomanta, o sɛoh dɛ ɡel ba pa daa la.

Title: ƐSTA 6
Content:
Kooro ɡɔɔ Mɔdekae sɔn
1Awola tɔpere la jwaana, kooro ta wone chɔ dom. Anomanta, o ɡelɔ ba ba tɔne o kora dii waa aa lɔ a bini la ne bá kure tɛo. 2Ba kuro ka tel bela Mɔdekae aa ɡela kooro dɔ o nyu la, Biɡtana ne Tɛrɛs, koodem bonɔɔna ba fa aa dɛ daah kooro dem doonyoa la vɔrɔwa ba fe aa vɔrɔwa ŋɔ, bá kpo kooro la.
3Kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Webesoo ń ɛ tɛo ɡɛ waa nɔ ta nɔ? Kembɔr besoo ń tɛo wɔ?”
Anee o bonɔɔna la ŋɔ, “He ta wobɛlbwa ɛɛ tɛo.”
4O berɔ bɔɔ ŋɔ, “N nomonjena la bane lɔ dem bonɔ naa?” Gɛ saŋ dɛ Heeman ɡe deno ba jo koodem baah bela, dɛ́ ba soŋe ŋwɛnɛ kooro be ŋɔ, bá ka saɡɛ Mɔdekae daa waa pao la ta.
5Kooro bonɔɔna la chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa, Heeman lɔ bonɔ.”
Asɛ kooro ŋɔ, “Hé yerɔ ba!”
6Waa bala la, kooro bɔɔro ŋɔ, “Sɔn besoo ń tɛ nɛn n bambile aa lawɔ, o waa su n siwi ɔ?”
Belaa Heeman lii o nyu bini ŋɔ, “Nomɛl lole kooro ɛɛ nyin kɛ ó duuru dɛ ɡwaa mɛ naa?” 7Anee Heeman chaŋe kooro ŋɔ, “N naa, dɛ he bambile lawɛ nɛn o waa aa su he siwi kɛ he tɛo sɔn aa, kenii chɛ kɛ he ɛ. 8Ŋɔ he bonɔɔna la be bá kpɔ he ɡbaɡba laala haa dɛ doa la ane ba, dɛ́ berɛ kpɔ jaɡre haa dɛ so a ta la bɛl ɡe ba. Gel bá kpɔ kondɛɛɡe haa kpɔa dɛɛ dawɛ he jaaɡɔ nyu ta, aa baɡle kɛŋɔ he jaaɡɔɔ la ba dawɛ ɡɛ jaaɡɔ la nyu ta. 9Ásɛ dɛ ɡel he nomonjena tenten la bɛl kpɔ koolaala la do naate, ó so jaaɡɔ la ta, ásɛ nomoa la tɔ o sie, dɛ́ kpɔɔ ɡaaɡe bwɛɛ nɔ fɔɡbaahna, dɛ́ kpɔ takpeɡ dɛɛ ŋɔ, ‘Kenii kooro ɛɛ tɛ ɡɛ nɛn nɔ sɔn.’ ”
10Kooro do Heeman ŋɔ, “Ɛ warane ka kpɔ koolaala la ne jaaɡɔ la, dɛ́ ka ɛ ɡɛ haa bola nɔ bwa tɛ Mɔdekae, Juu te la. Bɛ a bini bɛlbwa ɡel. Hɛɛ nao kɛ waa soɡe koodem doonyoa bela.”
11Anomanta, Heeman lɛ koolaala la ne jaaɡɔ la kaa Mɔdekae be, dɛ ka kpɔ laala la doo, asɛ Mɔdekae teeh so jaaɡɔ la ta. Heeman kpɔɔ kpɔ bwɛɛ la fɔɡbaahna, o nyoa che chiŋ wɛɛ ŋɔ, “Hé na ɡɛ kooro aa ɛ nɛn o bambile aa lawɔ kɛ ó tɛo sɔn!”
12Baa tona la, Mɔdekae berɔ ka so koodem doonyoa la ta. Heeman ɡe kpɔ sihiih ne baŋaɡola dɛ le bela kaa o dem warane. 13Waa kaa jo dem la, o baɡle waa aa puu la bwa o haah ne o daamanar la be.
Asɛ ba jao ŋɔ, “Haa dena pa mun di sihiih Mɔdekae sie nɔ, o lɔɡaa hɛɛ ba doe, ásɛ o pɔ he nɛ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o ɛ Juu te.” 14Ba ta aa soɡa dɛɛ bol waa la, kooro bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure la baa kpɔ Heeman kaa kooro haah Ɛsta be kondikonjena waa ɛa ŋɔ bá ba di la mun warane.

Title: ƐSTA 7
Content:
Ba saɡɛ Heeman
1Kooro Sɛksɛs ne Heeman dɛ kooro haah Ɛsta bwa pɛo di kwaa la. 2Baa dɛ nyɔ sen ba kondikonjena nɛɛtena dii ta la, kooro bɔɔ o haah Ɛsta ja ŋɔ, “Ɛsta, bɔkwaa hɛɛ nyin ɔ? Hale harɛ maa dɛ di kora o ta nɔ peraa hɛɛ nyin kwaraa naa, mɛɛ tɛɛ.”
3Anee Ɛsta chaŋe ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, n wesoŋa bwaa kɛŋɔ dɛ n waa su he siwi hɛɛ nyin kɛ he cha mɛ naa, lɛ n nyu dɛ lɛ n nɛra ɡe nyu. 4Ba yoɡ yaa tɛ ŋɔ bá kpoo yaa, dɛ́ he yaa kwaraa. Dɛ yoɡaa ba yoɡ yaa kɛŋɔ yoma kwaraa naa, n fe ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol dɛɛ hae.”
5Kooro Sɛksɛs bɔɔ Ɛsta ŋɔ, “Ume baahnee sua o won ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔɔ? Naate sɛ?”
6Anee Ɛsta chaŋo ŋɔ, “Nɛnchɔɡe Heeman nɔɔ ya dɔm waa do yaa ɡɛ wahala nɔ ta.”
Belaa ɔmee chole Heeman nɛɛ kohona kooro ne o haah Ɛsta sie. 7Kooro baah diu kɛrɛdɛ o ir ɡel sen waa dɛ nyɔ la, dɛ le buse ka jo koodem bodɛɛɡe bobɛl baa du daa ane la. Heeman nao kɛŋɔ kooro dɔɔ kpɔ liire ɡɛ waa dɛ ba o deŋne tɛra. Anomanta, o soɡo dɛɛ soŋe kooro haah Ɛsta ŋɔ ó lɛo ta.
8Kooro aa bera dɛɛ jo koodem la, dɛ Heeman marɛ o haah karajaŋ waa yale o ta la ta, dɛɛ soŋo sibeɡra ne, anee kooro nyɛɡ ŋɔ, “Ei! Baa nɔ dɛ nyin kɛ ó paɡɛ n haah n siwi ta koodem bonɔ kwara!”
Kooro nyoa ne chiɡa dɛ o bonɔɔna baa fɔɡɛ ba lure la kpɔ yal bɔle Heeman sie. 9Kooro bonɔɔna la bini bɛl baa dɛ yerɔ Haabona waa lɔ o jwɛɛh ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, Heeman pa da o jaŋne aa ɛ naɡale fifraanuanɛ dɛ anue dɛ kaa nyundua o dem. O ɛo kɛŋɔ bá fee saɡɛ Mɔdekae waa lɛ he nyu ta la o ta.”
Belaa kooro la do ba ŋɔ, “Hé ka saɡɛ Heeman o ta.” 10Gɛɛ a do ba saɡɛ Heeman daa waa paa dɛɛ ba Mɔdekae o ta saɡa la, asɛ kooro baah sɔɔh tama.

Title: ƐSTA 8
Content:
Ba do Juu tena ŋɔ bá ka yo
1Awola tenten baa saɡɛ Heeman la, Kooro Sɛksɛs kpɔ Heeman waa ɛ Juu tena dɔm la dem ne o kondɔɔh te bwa do o haah Ɛsta nɔn ta. Dɛ Ɛsta fa ŋɔ o be ŋɔ Mɔdekae ɛ o lole tenten. Anomanta, le ɡɛ saŋ, Mɔdekae dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ ó jo koodem dɛɛ la kooro sie, saŋ bɛlbwa. 2Kooro laa o noniseɡ waa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛɡre tɔne ta aa ɛ mmarare o faa kpɔ tɛ Heeman la foo, dɛ kpɔ tɛ Mɔdekae. O haah Ɛsta kpɔ Heeman kondɔɔh la bwa ɡe do Mɔdekae nɔn ta.
3Kooro haah Ɛsta berɔ ba kooro sie, dɛ ba ɡuŋu harɛ siniire ne, dɛ soŋo ŋɔ, ó ɡel ba teŋe liichɔɡa Aɡaɡ naa Heeman aa liira kɛ ba kpoo Juu tena bwa la ta. 4Ate, kooro tɛr o suuɡaswɛm daŋɡbala la pa Ɛsta nɛɛ ja, asɛ o ir che o sie.
5Belaa Ɛsta ŋɔ, “N naa kooro, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh, dɛ he sie lɛ n nɛ, n wesoŋa nɔ toɡrɔ aa, ɡel he karakere chwerɛ tɔne kɛŋɔ, Hamedata bibaa Heeman tɔne waa chwera kɛŋɔ, bá kpoo Juu tena baa lɔ he harɛre bwa ta la bɛ toma ɛ kpa. 6Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona so nyiŋi, ásɛ wechɔɡa nɔ bwa dɔŋa chiɡ n nɛra Juu tena nɛɔ? Maa won so nyiŋi bá kpoo n dem nɛra.”
7Belaa Kooro Sɛksɛs chaŋe o haah ne Juu te Mɔdekae ŋɔ, “Vɔrɔwa Heeman aa vɔrɔwa ŋɔ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa la nomanta, n kpɔ o kondɔɔh bwa tɛ Ɛsta, dɛ ɡel ba ka saɡɔ. 8Taraken nɔ, n tɛ heyaa ŋwɛnɛ kɛ hé kpɔ n sɔn, dɛ́ chwerɛ mmarafale ja ka tɛ nɛra baa lɔ n harɛre la bwa ta, dɛ́ tɔ Juu tena kpoora la ŋwɛnɛ. Hé chwerɔ ɡɛ bɛlbwa haa dɛ nyin. Hé chwerɔ tonaa, hé kpɔ n noniseɡ ɛɡre a ta, dɛkalkɛŋɔ tɔne baa chwerɛ n sɔn ta dɛ kpɔ n noniseɡ ɛɡre a ta la, nomɛlbwa aa won tire a ta.”
9Sevan korobie tɔpera fifraanɛ dɛ atoro ta la, Mɔdekae yerɛ kooro nomonome la bwa cheme, dɛ ɡel ba chwerɛ mmara tɔne ka tɛ Juu tena ne koranar, ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛre bwa nyoa, ne nomonjena dɛ le harɛre lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ la bwa ta, dɛ le India harɛ kpoŋe kaa Itiopia harɛ ta. Ba chwerɔ ka tɛ wobobele aa lɔ harɛre la bwa ta, ne ɡɛ a bɛlbwa chwera aa doa, hale Juu tena bwa jao. 10Kooro Sɛksɛs kpeɡri taa Mɔdekae che dɛ ɡel ba chwerɛ tɔne la, asɛ dɛ kpɔ noniseɡ la ɛɡre a ta, dɛ kpɔa tɛ nɛra ba so kooro jaɡre aa won chwae ta, dɛ kpɔ tɔne la ka bɔne tɛ nɛra baa soɡe o harɛre la bwa ta.
11Kooro waa la tɛ Juu tena baa lɔ bwɛjena bwa ta la kpeɡri kɛŋɔ, bá cheme dɛ́ won yo lɛ ba nyu. Ba dɔ ŋwɛnɛ kɛ bá kpoo laa tena baa le wobol bɛlbwa ne harɛ bɛlbwa ta, dɛɛ ba dɛ́ ba yo ba ne ba haahna ne bii la, dɛ́ kpɔ ba kondɔɔh. 12Tɔpere Mɔdekae aa lea tɛ Juu tena ŋɔ bá kpɔ ɛ ɡɛ waa la Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre la bwa ta laanee Adar korobie, tɔpere fi dɛ atoro ta. 13A chɛ kɛ tɔne la mmarafale la aa lɔ a ta la tel wobol te bɛlbwa tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre la bwa ta la be, ásɛ ba jemɛ a wa, ɡɛ aa ɛ ásɛ Juu tena la won kpɔ ba te kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ won yo ba dɔma bɔ kem.
14Kooro aa do mmara la nomanta, o toroma la soɡe o jaɡre la ta kaa wɔrɔbe nɛ. Bane kpɔ waa la perɛ koobwɛɛ Susa ɡe bwa ta.
15Mɔdekae aa le kooro sie bela dɛ kaa la, dɛ o do laalapoŋa ne laalaburum, dɛ berɛ do batakaare baa kpɔ yapondɛɛɡe ɛo dawɛ kɛŋɔ koolaala ken, dɛ pi suuɡaswɛm ɡbɛrɛdɛɛɡe bɛl. Asɛ Susa bwɛɛ tena la bwa ɡe ɛɛ moo silɛɛ ne. 16Dɛ a ɛ silɛɛ ne hɛɡra dɛ tɛ Juu tena la, baa duu ba bobɛlbwa. 17Harɛ bɛlbwa ne bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta toroma la aa la mmarafale nɔ ne la, Juu tena baa lɔ bela la bwa sie dɛ lɛ baa hɛɡre, dɛ so di kwaa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie. Nɛra baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ la bini bane ɔmɔ, dɛ kpɔ ba te berɛ Juu tena, dɛkalkɛ ba we-ɛɛla la ɡelɔ ɔmee laɡ ba.

Title: ƐSTA 9
Content:
Juu tena yo ba dɔma dɛ kpoo ba
1Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ atoro weeree tɔpere kooro aa do mmara ŋɔ, Júu tena pɛ nyoa dɛ́ yo ba dɔma. Dɛ ba dɔma la dɛ lii kɛ baa won yoo ba dɛ́ pɔ ba nɛ. Kɛ waa la berɔ berɛ. Juu tena la pɛ nyoa yo ba dɔma, dɛ pɔ ba nɛ. 2Juu tena baa lɔ bwɛɛre aa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre ta la bwa chemo kɛ, bá yo ba dɔma baa dɛ ba bá ha ba la. Nɛra la bɛlbwa ta wone puu ba yo, dɛkalkɛ wobobele aa lɔ bela la bwa nɛra dɛ ɔm ba. 3Hale harɛre la bwa nomonjena ne koranar ne nomonome baa chɔ harɛre nyoo, dɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ kooro la bwa baa che Juu tena la habɔɔ, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba bwa dɛ ɔmɛ Mɔdekae taeh. 4Mɔdekae berɛ nomonjen koodem bela, nomɛlbwa no o waa harɛre la bwa ta, asɛ o ta na dɛɛ dɔ kpeɡri saŋ bɛlbwa.
5Juu tena la kpɔ keri dɛ ka kpoo ba dɔma dɛ he ba. Ba ɛɛ ba ɡɛ bwa baa dɛ nyin. 6Koobwɛɛ Susa ɡbo ta la, Juu tena la kpoo nɛra lafraanue. 7Ba kpoo Pasandata ne Dalfɔn dɛ Aspata, 8ne Porata ne Adalia dɛ Aridata, 9ne Pamasta ne Arisai, ne Aridai dɛ Vaisata, 10baa ɛ Hamedata bibaa Heeman bibaala. Dɛ Heeman ɛ Juu tena dɔm. Kɛ Juu tena la ta ba komɛlbwa kpɔe kaa.
11Awola tenten la, ba baɡle nɛra baa kpoora koobwɛɛ Susa bela la kooro be. 12Kooro Sɛksɛs ŋɔ Ɛsta be ŋɔ, “Koobwɛɛ Susa bonɔ ɡbo, Juu tena la kpoo nɛra lafraanue, dɛ kpo Heeman bibaala fi ja. Dɛ he nyiŋaa, nɛra baŋwɛnɛɛ baa ba kpoora harɛre maa dɛ di kora a ta nɔ ta nɔ?” Dɛ berɛ bɔɔ Ɛsta ja ŋɔ, “Waane lole ń ɛ tɛɛ ja aa? Baɡle kon haa dɛ nyin ásɛ n ɛ tɛɛ.”
13Belaa Ɛsta chaŋo ŋɔ, “N naa, dɛ hɛɛ sɛoh waa, tɛ Juu tena baa lɔ Susa bonɔ ŋwɛnɛ kere ɡe ba ɛ ɡɛ baa ɛa fini nɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ Heeman bibaala fi la lala la ka saɡɛ daa ta.”
14Kooro no ɡɛ dɛ ɡel Susa tena no dɛ ɡel ba saɡɛ Heeman bibaala fi la. 15Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ wee la, Juu tena baa lɔ Susa la chemo. Ba kpoo nɛra lafraatoro bwɛɛ la ta ja, kɛ ba ta ba komɛlbwa kpɔe.
16Gɛ saŋ waa nɔ aa chiɡ Susa la, dɛ Juu tena baa lɔ harɛre la kabora ta ɡe chemo, dɛɛ kpa ba nyu. Ba kpoo ba dɔma kaɡboŋa fifraanuanɛ dɛ banue, dɛ dɔ ba te. Ba ta ba ɡe komɛlbwa kpɔe. 17Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ atoro taa waa nɔ chiɡ, asɛ o tɔperafi dɛ anaarɛ ta ba onɛ, dɛ di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛ kpɔ a ɡɛ tɔpere la berɛ ba tɔpejen.
Purim Tɔpejen dii
18Juu tena baa lɔ Susa la yoo tɔpera fi dɛ atoro ne fi dɛ anaarɛ la ta. Tɔpera fi dɛ anue wee la, ba ɡel yoi dɛ onɛ, dɛ di kwaa lɛ ba sie.
19A waa Juu tena baa lɔ bwɛjeɡre ta kpɔ a ɡɛ korobie la tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ wee la ɛ ba tɔpejen, dɛ di kwa dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛ berɛ dɛɛ kɛ kwaa o ta.
20Mɔdekae chwerɛ waa aa chiɡa la bwa bil. O berɔ chwerɛ tɔne ka tɛ Juu tena baa soɡe Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre bojaŋa ne bela aa bɛno bwa ta. 21O ŋɔ bá kpɔ Adar korobie tɔpera fi dɛ anaarɛ ne fi dɛ anue wee la ɛ tɔpejena dɛɛ dia bena bɛlbwa, 22dɛɛ lii tɔpera Juu tena aa lɛ ba te le ba dɔma nɔn ta, ne tɔpera ba suna dii aa ber ba silɛɛ, ba wii ɡe berɛ hɛɡra la. Mɔdekae ŋɔ, dɛ ba dɛ di tɔpera la aa, báa di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, dɛɛ tɛ dɔŋa ne nyaara bwa kondikwa.
23Anomanta, Juu tena la teŋɛ waa Mɔdekae aa chwera tɛɛ ba la ta, dɛɛ di ɡɛ tɔpejena nɔ bena bɛlbwa. 24Gɛ tɔpera nɔ munii kɛŋɔ Hamedata bibaa Heeman waa ɛ Aɡaɡ naa, Juu tena bwa dɔm la, fa aa vɔrɔwa kɛŋɔ bá kpoo Juu tena bwa la. O bil daa dɛ na tɔpere baa kpɔ kpoo ba dɛ́ he ba kwaraa. 25Ɛsta aa la Kooro Sɛksɛs be dɛ ŋɔ Heeman vɔrɔwe Juu tena vɔrɔwa dɛ́ fee kpoo ba la, kooro do mmara dɛ ɡel Heeman liichɔɡa waa liira la ɡure o ɡbaɡba nyu ta, asɛ ba saɡɛ o ne o bibaala fi la. 26Anomanta, dɛ ba dɛ yerɛ ɡɛ tɔpere nɔ Purim, tɔn Mɔdekae aa chwera ne waa aa puu ba la bwa wa. 27Juu tena la lɛo dawɛ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ, ba ne ba naanar ɛɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛɛ, dɛɛ di ɡɛ tɔpera anɛ la bena bɛlbwa. Hale banɔ la baa wola Juu tena ɛɛ, dɛ kpɔ ba te ba ja ba nɛɛ la bwa jao. Asɛ baa dia ɡɛ Mɔdekae aa do ba, ne saŋ waa lea cheɡ tɛɛ ba la. 28Ba ɛa a chɔ kɛŋɔ, Juu tena ne ba naanar baa lɔ harɛre ne bwɛɛ bɛlbwa ta, Kooro Sɛksɛs aa di kora a ta la ɛɛ di ɡɛ tɔpera anɛ nɔ saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. A chɛ kɛ bá bwa won dɛɛ di a ɡɛ Purim tɔpera nɔ bɛlbwa.
29Anomanta, Abihel bihaah Ɛsta waa ɛ kooro haah la kpɔ kpeɡri waa dɔa la, asɛ Juu te Mɔdekae la chao, dɛ chwerɛ o Ɛsta ɡbaɡba tɔn dɛ bol Purim dii la wa, ásɛ a ɡel Mɔdekae tɔn nɛɛte la won ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ. 30Mɔdekae bɔne tɔne la tɛ Juu tena baa lɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs harɛre lafa fifraanɛ dɛ anuanɛ la bwa ta. O chwerɛ tɔne la, dɛ do ba ɡbemba kɛŋɔ tɔpera aa lɔ sie nɔ baa dɔ deŋnesɔɔhnaa, 31dɛ́ berɛ ɡel a ɡɛ Purim tɔpera nɔ che kiŋkiŋ baa dia saŋ la Juu te Mɔdekae ne kooro haah Ɛsta aa doa tɛ ba ne ba naanar kɛŋɔ, ba fa aa cheɡ nyoa vɔwa ne suna dii tɔpera la. 32Ɛsta mmara la ɡelɔ ɡɛ baa dɛɛ di Purim tɔpera la che kiŋkiŋ, asɛ ba chwera do tɔn bini.

Title: ƐSTA 10
Content:
Kooro Sɛksɛs ne Mɔdekae
1A berɔ ba kɛŋɔ Kooro Sɛksɛs dɛ lɛ nɛra baa lɔ o harɛre ta bwa toɔ, hale dɛ kpoŋe kaa o harɛre aa lɔ mpo nyoa bwa. 2Wejena waa ɛa o kora dii saŋ, ne ɡɛ bwa waa ɛ Mɔdekae nomonjen la, ba chwerɔ do Midia ne Pɛɛsea koranar waa tɔne bini. 3Mɔdekae ɛ nomonjen, dɛ Kooro Sɛksɛs toole naa, dɛ onee lole. O ɛ nɛnjen o dɔŋa Juu tena la bwa bini, asɛ baa tɛo jirima dɛɛ nyin o wa, dɛkalkɛŋɔ o nyin kɛrɛdɛ tɛɛ ba, dɛ nyin deŋnesɔɔhna tɛ o naanar bwa.

Title: JOB TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Job Tɔn nɔ ɛ tɔn waa biɡra kɛrɛdɛ. O dɛ baɡle ɡɛ Job bwara aa nyɛɡo kohona, asɛ a bwa habɔɔ o ta habɔɔ berɛ kpo Korowii. Korowii tɛ Bɔnsam ŋwɛnɛ o daah Job na. Dɛ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe dɛ dɔ kwaa ɡe. Job bii bwa serewɔ, o paŋɛ o kondɔɔh dɛ we weela ɡe a ka tama o sewɛ. O daamanar takapɔ ɡel o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o wechɔɡa waa Korowii ɛɛ tɛr o deŋne, kɛ dɛ baa waa Korowii aa dɛ ɛ la mun jemɛ. Anɔ nomanta, ba ta Job chae kwaraa. Job ta lɛɛ do kɛŋɔ a chɛ kɛ Korowii fee tɛr o deŋne ɡɛ. Anɔ bwa habɔɔ la, Korowii ɡbaɡba bol waa o be. Job ɡbabir baa na kɛŋɔ waa Korowii nyokpowe-ɛɛla bɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ jemɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ o bol ɡɛnewobol. Korowii kpɔ Job ne o daamanar wechɔɡa kɛ ba ɡɛ saŋ Job aa soŋe Korowii tɛɛ ba la.

Title: JOB 1
Content:
Job bwara wa
1Baa bɛl fa lole, o sɔne Job, dɛ do harɛ bɛl ta baa yerɛ bela Us. Wobɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o waa toɡre. O dɛ tomɛ Korowii, dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta. 2O lolɛ bibaala banuanɛ dɛ bihaahna batoro, 3dɛ dɔ peera kaɡboŋa anuanɛ, nyoɡmare kaɡboŋa atoro ne nae kaɡboŋ baa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ, ne keeɡore lafraanue, dɛ dɔ bonɔɔna ne toli ɡe kohona. Job aa dɔ kwaa kohona nomanta, dɛ onee suuɡate dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa lɔ wee leebɔr harɛ la bwa ta.
4O bibaala la bɛlbwa yon le o tɔpere cheɡ, dɛ́ ɡel ba daa kondikonjena o dem, dɛ́ yerɛ ba nimambihaahna batoro la, bá ka puu ba di kwaa la dɛ́ lɛ ba sie. 5Ba di kondikonjena la dɛ bar chiɡ tonaa, ba mɛɛ Job yon ir chɔɔ, dɛ kpo kon ɛ saraha soŋe ba wechɔɡa Korowii be, bɛlbwa nyu ta. O yon lii ŋɔ, “N bii nɔ ken ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ jo Korowii nɛɛ ba ta jemɛ.” Dɛ waa Job aa dɛ ɛ saŋ bɛlbwa laanee la.
Job loɡla daahna dɛ́ na
6Awola bɛl, nyundua toroma la Korowii be, dɛ Bɔnsam ɡe ja bɛl. 7Anee Korowii pɛɛ Bɔnsam ŋɔ, “Leperaa he le dɛ ba nɔ?”
O ŋɔ, “Gaaɡaa n do harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ɡaaɡe la dɛɛ ba.”
8Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he na n bonɔɔ Job waɔ? Nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre kɛ on harɛ nɔ ta, wechɔɡe bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o dɛ tom mɛ, o laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta.”
9Ate, Bɔnsam chaŋe ŋɔ, “He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ Job ɛɛ tomɛ pɛɛpɛɛ yaa? 10He kpɔ nɔn tɔ o ne o dem tena ne komɛlbwa waa dɔa nɛ. Dɛ swee andɛɛɡa tɛo o toma bɛlbwa ta, dɛ ɡel o kondɛɛra ya perɛ harɛ la bwa ta. 11Laa nɔn kpɔ komɛlbwa waa dɔa ta dɛ́ na, wɛɛ taahnee he na.”
12Anee Korowii ŋɔ Bɔnsam be ŋɔ, “A wer, komɛlbwa waa dɔa la lɔ he nɔn ta, kɛ o te ɡbabir te, bɛ nɔn kpɔ leɡo.”
Asɛ Bɔnsam le Korowii be dɛ kaa.
13Awola bɛl, Job bibaala ne bihaahna la dɛ di kondikonjena la ane, dɛɛ lɛ ba sie ba dɔɔ nomoa dem, 14belaa torome bɛl kpɔ chwae ba Job be dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Ya kpɔ nae kaa parɛ, asɛ keeɡore ɡe do ya jwɛɛh dɛɛ di, 15asɛ Seba tena ba lɔ jo a bini, dɛ lawa kaa. Ba kpoo n bala la bwa. N ɡboo wona dɔ bɔr chwa, dɛ baa bol he be la!”
16Torome la nyoa taa lɔ waa la ta wɛɛ bol la, dɛ torome la bɛl ɡe balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Bwaala kɔrɔ jo ya ne kondɛɛra la bini, dɛ fuh a ne n bala la bwa. N ɡboo le a nyoa, asɛ dɛ baa bol he be la.”
17O ɡe nyoa ta chiɡe, dɛ torome bɛl ɡe balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Kaldea tena baa kpoŋe dɔmkwaa dɛɛ ŋwɛ bɔne ba bini nɛmbele batoro, dɛ ba lɔ jo ya bini, dɛ lawɛ he nyoɡmare la bwa kaa. Ba kpoo n bala la bwa. N ɡboo wona dɔ bɔr chwa, dɛ baa bol he be la!”
18Torome la ɡe nyoa ta chiɡe, dɛ bɛl ɡe balɔ dɛ ba ŋɔ, “Dɛ he bibaala ne bihaahna la lɔ ba dɔɔ nomoa la dem, dɛɛ di kondikonjena dɛɛ lɛ ba sie, 19asɛ peukpeɡ den ta le pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta dɛ ba lɔ dem la, o bwa ku chole ba nɛɛ ba bwa serewe. N ɡboo wona le a nyoa, dɛ baa bol he be la.”
20Job aa no ɡɛ la, o ir che dɛ laa o batakaare kɛɛ, a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu, dɛ fonɛ o nyu. Ate, dɛ chɔ kpɔ sie pi harɛ, dɛ jam Korowii, 21dɛ ŋɔ,
“Ba lol mɛ mumɡbal,
mumɡbal nee n berɛ
dɛɛ ba kaala.
Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ, onee dɛɛ lɛ.
Hé ɡel ya kpɛɛ o sɔn.”
22Waa nɔ bwa ta la, Job ta Korowii nɛɛ nyae a ɛ wechɔɡa tɛo.

Title: JOB 2
Content:
Job nɛɛtena daahna dɛ́ na
1Awola bɛl ɡe ja, nyundua toroma la baa cheme Korowii sie, dɛ Bɔnsam ɡe ja bɛl. 2Anee Korowii pɛɛ Bɔnsam ŋɔ, “Leperaa he le dɛ ba nɔ?”
O ŋɔ, “Gaaɡaa n do harɛ nɔ ta dɛ ɡaaɡe la dɛɛ ba.”
3Ate, Korowii ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ he na n bonɔɔ Job waɔ? Nomɛlbwa toole o waa toɡre kɛ on harɛ nɔ ta, wechɔɡe bɛlbwa toole o nɛ, o dɛ tom mɛ, dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ wechɔɡa ta. He ba n be ŋɔ n tɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ he ka chɔɡo, dɛ o ta waane ɛɛ, kɛ ane a bwa, o waa ta toɡrɔ.”
4Bɔnsam chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, “Nɛn dɛ nyin o nyu aa, wɛɛ won kpɔ kwaa waa dɔa bwa charɛ. 5Lɔɔ bil weela ta dɛ́ na, dɛ waa hen taah he na naa.”
6Belaa Korowii ŋɔ Bɔnsam be ŋɔ, “A wer ɡa, n kpɔɔ do he nɔn ta, kɛ na kɛ haa on kpo.”
7Anomanta, Bɔnsam le Korowii be bela dɛ ka kpɔ ŋwɛrchɔɡa ta Job nɛ, le o nyu ta ba ta o napaala ta. 8Asɛ Job ka so tɔɔ ta a baɡle kɛ o loo kuu, dɛ kpɔ kaŋli dɛɛ paa ŋwɛra la.
9Job haah ŋɔ o be ŋɔ, “He ta lɔ toɡra he wa aa toɡra la ta naa? Taah Korowii dɛ́ sewɛ!”
10Asɛ Job chaŋo ŋɔ, “He dɛ bol ɡɛnewobol. Wedɛɛɡa ɡboo yaa ba dɔe le Korowii be, yaa wola wechɔɡa tenee dɔ aa?”
A ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa ta la, o ta waa bolɛ yaɡɛ Korowii bwa.
Job daamanar batoro wa
11Dɛ Job dɔ daamanar batoro bane. Bɛlee Teman te Elifas, ne Bildad waa le Su harɛ ta, dɛ Sofar o ɡe aa le Naama harɛ ta. Ba no wahala waa dɛ na la, dɛ ka cheme, dɛ bwa sɛh kɛŋɔ baa lao, dɛ́ ka bwɛɛlo. 12O daamanar la aa dɛ ba, dɛ che bojaŋ nao la, ba ta on jemɛ. Ba wio kohona, dɛ laa ba laala kɛɛ, dɛ ɛ tɔɔ do ba nyuune ta, a baɡle kɛ ba loo kuu. 13Ba ne o soɡe harɛpɛɛ, chɔɔ ne jwaana, tɔpera anuanɛ. Bɛlbwa ta waa o be bolɛ, dɛkalkɛ dɛ ba na ɡɛ o bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ.

Title: JOB 3
Content:
Job waa naɡra
1Job ne o daamanar aa soɡa yawanyoa habɔɔ la, o taah nyoa tɔpere baa lolɔ. 2O ŋɔ,
3“Korowii ɡel tɔpere
baa lol mɛ o ta ne jwaana la
baa kpoŋe n tea la
bɛ ba kpa!
4Korowii, ɡel tɔpere la
te waa ta kwara,
bɛ o waa lii kpa bwa,
bɛ ɡel wee le o ta.
5Gel biro o bini aa ɔma
tɔ ɡɛ tɔpere la ta,
kpɔ baama tɔ o ta o waa le,
bochaah bɛ o ta ba kpa
bwa.
6Le ɡɛ tɔpere jwaana la le,
o bɛ benanyoa bɛlbwa ta
ba kpa,
a ba ɛ kɛ baa lii o waa.
7Bɛ ɡel ba kpoŋe bie tea
a ɡɛ jwaana la ta,
bɛ ɡel silɛɛ ɡbɔɡa bɛlbwa
le o ta.
8Gel voɡra taah
a ɡɛ tɔpere la,
nɛra baa won mpo bini
oljen waa dɛ tuuɡi harɛ,
waa do kɛŋɔ lɛŋɔ yera la.
9Bɛ ɡel o chɔɔlen weweela
chaah,
bɛ ɡel bɔr chaah a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ
wee ɛɛ leo, dɛ́ chaah bɔr
o ta.
10Taah awola jwaana
baa lol mɛ,
n ba dɛ baa na wa,
dɛɛ di suna o ta nɔ.
11Ɛrɛɛ maa wola n nya
tea bini sewɛ buɡ ta
waa lol mɛ laɔ?
12Bɔkwaa n nya kpɔ mɛ
dawɛ o nakpale ta,
kɛɛ dɛ ɔr mɛ elɔ?
13Dɛ n fe sewɔ ɡɛ saŋ aa,
n fe chɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ta,
dɛɛ onɛ,
14n ne koranar ne nomonjena,
ba fa aa ma dejena a saŋ la,
dɛ so a ta bwa berɛ dimɡbia.
15N ne koranar
baa kpɔ suuɡaswɛm
ne suuɡapoŋa su ba deene
dɛ serewe la bwa fe chɔɔ.
16Ɛrɛɛ maa wola doe kɛŋɔ
bie baa haro ta dɛ huɡo,
kɛɛ bechasɔɔhna waa sewa
o ta wee nae bwa nɔ?
17Lalbɔɔ binii nyubinikpeɡ tena
we-ɛɛla ɛɛ tonɛ,
nɛra baa ɛ toma koh la ɡe
kaa onɛ.
18Belaa nɛra baa laɡ ba do
deene bwara ɛɛ sɔɔh ba,
baa nyɛɡa ne dokpeɡa
bɛlbwa na kpa.
19Nomonjena ne dansaara bwa
lɔ bela,
bela te, yom toole
o dɔɔ lɔɡa kpa.
20Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɡel nɛra
ba bwara aa dɛ nyɛɡ
so le nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ o tɛ banɔ la baa
dɛ di suna mkpa nɔɔ?
21Ba pɛla lawɔ kɛ bá sewɛ
kɛ baa dɔ, dɛ ɡaaɡe
dɛɛ nyinu ɡwaa
kondɛɛɡe bɛl waa sɔah,
22ba sie aa lɛ kɛrɛdɛ,
kɛŋɔ ba fe aa sewa
ba huɡ ba.
23Korowii ɡelɔ baa ba kerekere
waa jemɛ,
dɛ tɔ ba do bobɛlbwa.
24Suna dii ber mɛ kondikwa,
maa won ɡel pɛma bwa.
25Waa maa dɛ ɔma kohona,
laanee ba n nɛ.
26N ta deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe,
n ta ona dɔe,
atane wenaale ɡbo.”

Title: JOB 4
Content:
Job dam Elifas
1Belaa Teman te Elifas ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ,
2“Dɛ n bol waa baɡle naa,
hɛɛ no n bee yaa?
Maa won tɔ nyoa ɡɛ kpa.
3He chaɡle nɛra ɡalɡa wa,
dɛ cha banɔ la baa ɡwɛɡra
ɡe ba dɔ bokpeɡa.
4He wobol cha nɛra baa
nyoɡre Korowii ŋwɛnɛ,
dɛ ɡel ba won che ja.
5He ɡe kwaa bala fini,
dɛ kpɔ bambichɔɡa
ba ta he nɛɛ la.
6He tomɛ Korowii,
wechɔɡa bɛlbwa
aa wola toole he nɛ,
a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ yarada
dɛ dɔ hwɛɡa.
7Nyiŋi waa nɔ, umee wola
wechɔɡa ɛɛ dɛ sewɛ bwa
nɔ?
Nɛn o wa aa toɡra ɡe
dɛ dɔ wekpeɡa aa?
8N ɡbabir nao kɛŋɔ nɛra
baa dɛ vɔrɔwe
wechɔɡa vɔrɔwa,
ne banɔ la baa dɛ nyin
waa la, anee baa dɔ.
9Korowii bandia
do kɛŋɔ dompeu,
o hwee ta ba nɛɛ
ba serewe.
10Nyubinikpeɡ tena do kɛŋɔ
nyujentena aa dɛ si,
kɛ Korowii sɔɔh a nyoa
dɛ kuuɡi a nyena.
11Nyujente ta ol dɔe lawɛ di aa,
o dɛ sewɛ,
ásɛ o bii bwa ɡe lɔ peɡre.
12Nomɛl sɔɔh ba lɔɡ mɛ
waane tamaa ken,
aa do ɡɛ la, n ta wone
no a bini kɛrɛdɛ.
13A do kɛŋɔ
jwaanen deechɔɡa ken,
a chɔɡ n dom,
14ɔmee ne bochela laɡ mɛ,
n bwara bwa ɛɛ sa.
15Komɛl ɡale n sie ta,
asɛ n bwara ɛɛ mɛ nyirr.
16Kon la cheɡɔ,
kɛ n ta wone jemɛ
o konsoo.
N na o dor o che n sie,
asɛ n no taa bɛl o ŋɔ,
17‘Nɛwɛnyini waa ɛɛ won
toɡre ɡwaa Korowii aa?
Nɛn ɛɛ won do ɡoroŋ
ɡwaa Korowii waa tao
wa aa?
18Dɛ Korowii ta hwɛɡa dɔe
o nyundua toroma nɛ,
hale o na wechɔɡa
ba nɛ aa,
19he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wɛɛ dɔ hwɛɡa
nɛn waa kpɔ teera mao
nɛɛ ya?
Wɛɛ won sewɛ warane
kɛŋɔ baa dɛ kpo
konɡaahle la!
20Hɛɛ nao chɔɔ
kɛ jɔmɔra ne tela dɛ o sewɔ
dɛ he ta ɡɛ liire.
21Baa pa o kondɔɔh bwaa kaa,
o sewɛ dɛ o ta wejema bɛlbwa
dɔe le Korowii be.’ ”

Title: JOB 5
Content:
1Elifas berɔ ŋɔ, “Job yerɛ na,
umee dɛ́ chaŋe nɔ?
Nyundua torome bɛl lole
dɛ́ no he be naa? Akai!
2Bandia dɛ kpo ɡɛne,
sibeɡra ɡe ɛɛ kpo nɛn
waa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ.
3N ɡbabir na nɛn waa ɡɛna
o soɡa bini do wer,
kɛ buɡ la ta, nyotaahna
chole o dem.
4O bii dɛ na sibeɡrewaa
kohona, nɛn toole dɛ́ bol
ba waa tɛɛ ba kɔɔto.
5Nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo dɛ́ di
ɡɛne kondikwaa waa dua,
hale anɔ la aa lɔ
sɔɔhne baah,
asɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo
siwi ɛɛ beɡre
ɡɛ ɡɛne la kondɔɔh.
6Teera ta laa wechɔɡa le kɛŋɔ
konduuli, a ta laa wenaale le.
7Ba lolɛ nɛn aa, dɛ o ne waa,
kɛŋɔ nihɛm yon chuɡri
dɛɛ kaa nyundua la.
8Kɛ dɛ menee yaa,
n fe ɛɛ soŋe Korowiirii,
dɛ́ kpɔ n waa bil o sie.
9Wejena haa wola won no
a munii Korowii ɛɛ ɛ,
nyokpowaa haa wola
won kuraa wɛɛ ɛ.
10O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nɛ harɛ ta,
dɛ ɡel wɛɛ tel
kpɔɡbaah bwa.
11Korowii dɛ tɛ nɛŋɡwɛɡra
chebɔr,
banɔ la baa dɛ wi
ɡe dɔ silɛɛ.
12O dɛ chɔɡ nɛra baa dɛ lii
kɛŋɔ ba jemɛ waa liire,
dɛ ɡel baa won wedɛɛɡa
bɛlbwa ɛ.
13O ɡelɔ nɛra baa dɛ lii
kɛŋɔ ba jemɛ waa la
ɡbaɡba liire ɛɛ laɡ ba,
wobɛlbwa baa ɛ la
aa maɡre.
14Biro dɛ ba ba nɛɛ webaŋa,
baa laɡre bɔr
kɛŋɔ jwaana ken.
15Korowii lɛ nɛra dɛɛ le
ba seo nyoa,
o lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le fiiɡa ta.
16Anomanta, banɔ la
aa hiah ba dɔ hwɛɡa,
nɛnchɔɡa ta waa dɔe
dɛ́ bol kpa.
17Nomɛlbwa Korowii
aa dɛ kaoh la na som,
anomanta, dɛ Korowii
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ
la dɛ toɡre naa,
bɛ an wesale lii.
18Onee dɛɛ do nɛn bol
dɛ berɛ dɛɛ vɔrɔwo,
dɛɛ do nɛn weela
dɛɛ chaoh.
19Saŋ bɛlbwa Korowii
ɛɛ lɛɛ le wenaale ta.
20Lɔr saŋ wɛɛ lɛɛ le seo
nyoa dɛ́ lɛɛ le laa ta.
21Wɛɛ lɛɛ le chɔɡa
nɛra aa dɛ chɔɡe ta,
wekpeɡa dɛ ba he nɛ aa,
bɛ ɔmɛ,
wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he nɛ.
22Lɔr ne wekpeɡa dɛ ba naa,
hɛɛ soo dɛɛ mamɛ,
haa kpɔɡ bini olaa ɔmɛ.
23Koo haa parɛ la,
bwea aa o taa do,
kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa aa
hen ɡbaa bwa.
24Hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ
he dem sɔɔhnɔ kɛrɛdɛ,
he kure he kondɔɔh,
dɛ́ na kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa
ta nyoɡrɛ.
25Hɛɛ nao ɡe kɛŋɔ he bii warɔ,
ásɛ he naanar warɛ
kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa ken.
26Hɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee,
he bwara ta do kpeɡri mɔɔ
he sewɛ, kɛŋɔ mea yon be
kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ ba koma la.
27Job, ya ɡbabir nyiŋi
ɡɛ waa nɔ,
dɛ na kɛŋɔ a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Anomanta, kpɔ dɛ ɛ
ɡɛ tenten.”

Title: JOB 6
Content:
Job wobol
1Job chaŋe Elifas ŋɔ,
2“Dɛ ba fe kari n wenaale
ne n suna maa
dɛ di bwa naa,
3a fe ɛɛ do tɔɡree
ɡwaa mpo nyoa hɛŋle bwa,
a waa he na kɛŋɔ
n wobol la bini nyɛɡre la.
4Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ la ta mɛ hɛma,
asɛ tɛɛɡa aa lɔ a ta la jooɡe
n bini.
Korowii kpɔ wenaale aa do
ɔma teŋɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ ta n nɛ.
5Keeɡo dɔ kpɔɡa dɛɛ
chwe aa, waa si,
ɡɛɛ nabal ɡe dɔ kwaa
dɛɛ dia aa, waa wola si.
6Yar toole kondikwaa ta naa,
a dɛ do som aa?
Jahal kompoŋ ɡbo som aa?
7N pɛla aa ɡɛ kondikwaa nɔ
dɔ, a dɛ tɛ mɛ weela.
8N dɛ soŋe Korowii ó tɛ mɛ
anɔ la n pɛla aa lawa,
kɛ ó fe tɛ mɛ komɛlbwa
n hwɛɡa aa lɔ a ta,
9kɛŋɔ wɛɛ sɛoh ba kpo mɛ,
ásɛ dɛ teŋe me mkpa ta.
10Belaa mɛɛ ba bolarawa dɔe
n sie lɛ, n weweele
aa wola tonɛ bwa ta,
á baɡle kɛŋɔ n ta Korowii
O Wa Aa Do Goroŋ la
waa vɛɛh.
11N dɔ bokpeɡa dɛ ta
dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ
kɛ mɛɛ so lee yaa?
Ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba le soɡa
dɛ n ta hwɛɡa dɔe yɔ?
12N bwara kpeɡri kɛŋɔ bwe aa?
Kɛɛ n bwadabii
do kɛŋɔ ayaawa ɔ?
13N ta kpeɡri dɔe dɛ́ lɛ n te,
bobɛlbwa toole ń kpɔ sie
chaɡɛ nɛn cha mɛ.
14Dɛ waa pu nɛn aa,
a chɛ kɛ o daamanar
ɛɛ chao,
hale dɛ o vɛh Korowii
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ
ɔma kwaraa noo.
15Kɛ n bala ta nɛra maa kpɔ
n te dawɛ ba nɛɛ ɛɛ,
ba do kɛŋɔ nenabɔɔne
bwaala yon nɛ a su,
o baa ɡel nɛɛ yaa,
a yon hweeh la ken.
16Dombwea baa ta aa,
nenabɔɔne dɛ suuɡi,
17kɛ wee baa lɔ aa,
dɛ a mwɛɛlɔ,
a bini yon hol dɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
18Nɛra baa soɡe nyoɡmare ta,
dɛ valɛ dɛɛ ɡaaɡe nee
dɛ nyɔ nyoɡrɔ,
ba ɡaaɡɔ dɛ ka serewe
pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta.
19Nɛra soɡe nyoɡmare ta
le Seeba ne Tema dɛ valɛ
dɛɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin ne.
20Ba hwɛɡa kaa tonɛ,
nenabɔɔne aa hweehra
bini.
21Hé do kɛ nenabɔɔne la n be,
he ta chae bɛlbwa dɔe,
he na waane aa ba n nɛ
dɛ ɔmɛ dɛ le habɔɔ.
22N bol he be
kɛŋɔ he tɛ mɛ komɛl,
kɛɛ he che n naa ta
bɔ komɛl tɛ nomɛl,
dɛ́ le he kondɔɔh ta naa?
23Kɛɛ he lɛɛ mɛ le n dɔma
nɔn ta,
kɛɛ dɛ cha mɛ le nɛn
waa dɔɔ mɛ,
o nyu bini do kpeɡri
nɔn ta nɔ?
24A wer, hé baɡ mɛ
n wechɔɡa maa ɛa,
mɛɛ tɔ nyoa dɛ́ no he be.
25Kasinteŋ dii dɛ we,
kɛ waa haa dɛ bol nɔ
ta mun dɔe.
26He dɛ lii ŋɔ n dɛ bol wepuu,
ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ chaŋe n waa,
kɛŋɔ nɛn waa wola
kerekere waa lii nɔɔ?
27Hɛɛ won ta bie bilalbii
waa kwara!
Dɛ yoɡ he daamanar
dɛ́ dɔ suuɡa.
28N dɛ soŋe heya, hé nyiŋ mɛ
kɛrɛdɛ!
Mɛɛ teŋe nyosone
he sie yaa?
29Hé berɛ nyiŋi a bini,
dɛ bɛ men bolchɔɡe pa,
hé kwaa lii, dɛkalkɛ
n waa la wer.
30Nyosone ane le n nyoa kɛɛ?
Maa wedɛɛɡa ne wechɔɡa
jemɛ aa?”

Title: JOB 7
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ,
“Nɛwɛnyini soɡa bini,
tomkpeɡaa chɔ le dɛ tɛo,
kɛŋɔ paate waa dɛ ɛ
toma la.
2A do kɛŋɔ yom aa
nyin chunchule dɛɛ onɛ,
kɛɛ paa te aa dɛ kpa
o kembɔr la.
3Gɛɛ mɛɛ so
korobie bɛlbwa pɛɛpɛɛ,
jwaana bɛlbwaa
mɛɛ na wa.
4N yon chɔ dɛɛ lii ŋɔ,
‘Bɛweeree bɔr ɛɛ ba
chaahna ń irɔ?’
Dɛ chɔ kalaŋ ta, dɛ beɡre
ɡɛ naa dɛɛ nyin bɔr chaah.
5Dudule ne ŋwɛra su
n bwadabii bwa,
nee ɛɛ le n ŋwɛra ta.
6N tɔpera teŋo baa kaa
warane kɛŋɔ yasɔɔh
aa dɛ ta kokorowa la,
a dɛ tonɛ kɛ dɛ
n ta hwɛɡa dɔe.
7N Naa Korowii,
bɛ soh kɛŋɔ me mkpa
ka kerabeŋkpoŋ hweera,
silɛɛ toole n soɡa bini kpa.
8Taraken haa na mɛ nɔ,
haa men na kpa,
hɛɛ baa nyin n bɔree,
dɛ n toole.
9Gɛ bam aa wola
le do saŋ bɛlbwa la,
ɡɛɛ nɛn sewaa
waa wola ba kpa.
10Waa berɛ ba so o dem kpa,
bela o fa aa soɡa la,
baa on na kpa.
11Anomanta, maa nyoa tɔ,
mɛɛ che n weweele taa,
dɛ́ bol waa sum ne.
12N ɛ mpo, kɛɛ o bini oljen
asɛ hɛɛ do mɛ dɛɛɡɔ aa?
13N Naa Korowii, n baa chɔ
kalaŋ ta dɛ́ ŋɔ n onaa,
n chɔɔbɔr la ɡelɔ
waa aa dɛ ha mɛ la
nyoa ɛɛ sɔɔh,
14bela kwaraa la,
he dɛ aah mɛ deera ta,
he ɡelɔ mɛɛ na wepila
dɛɛ ɔmɛ,
15dɛ́ ɡel n pɛla lawɛ kɛŋɔ
baa hamɛ n lobi n sewɛ
dɛ ɡwaa kɛ aa ka n hoɡa
ɡbo nɔ.
16N soɡa bini pe mɛ,
maa nyin kɛ n so le dɛɛ la.
Gel mɛ, n soɡa ta mun dɔe.
17Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyina ɡe
ba waa hiaeh nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ dawɛ waa
baa dɛ ɛɔ?
18He dɛ nyiŋi ba we-ɛɛla,
chɔɔ bɛlbwa dɛɛ daah
ba saŋ bɛlbwa.
19Haa sie laa kpɔ n nɛɛ tama,
dɛ́ ɡel n lile nentane
kwaraa naa?
20Dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa kwaraa naa,
bɔkwa waa n ɛɛ nɔ?
He laa dɛɛ daah nɛra la aa?
Ɛrɛɛ he fome siwi pa
n nɛɛ nɔɔ?
N ɛ bone tɛɛ kɛɛ?
21Ɛrɛɛ haa wola n wechɔɡa
kpɔe kɛ mɛ, dɛ ɡel waa
maa koni a ta la taɔ?
Maa biɡri chɔ n banɔn ta,
hɛɛ dɛɛ nyin n bɔree,
kɛ dɛ n toole.”

Title: JOB 8
Content:
Job dam Bildad wobol
1Bildad waa le Su la chaŋe Job ŋɔ,
2“Saŋ besoo he wobobala nɔ
ɛɛ ba tona ɔ?
He wobol do kɛŋɔ
peukpeɡ, kɛ a ɛ wepuu.
3Waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ la,
Korowii dɛ ɡolaa?
Waa aa toɡraa
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ la ɛɛ ɛ.
4He bii ken ɛ Korowii
wechɔɡa, a waa o tɛr
ba deŋne ɡɛ aa chɛa.
5Dɛ he dɛ nyin Korowii bɔr,
dɛ́ ɡuŋi dɛɛ soŋe On
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la,
6dɛ he waa wer dɛ toɡre aa,
wɛɛ ba chae dɛ́ berɛ tɛɛ
sobɔrdɛɛɡe a ɛɛ kembɔr.
7Kwaa haa dɔa
mumpar la ken aa kanɛ,
anɔ la Korowii aa ba tɛɛ
a habɔɔ la ɛɛ do kanee
kohona.
8Ta sie nyiŋi,
saŋ la tena waa bini,
dɛ na waa
ya naawa aa hwela.
9Ya te aa biɡri,
yaa wobɛlbwa jemɛ,
ya soɡa bini do kɛŋɔ
lileo ken harɛ nɔ ta.
10Hé ɡel ya naawa
wejema baɡle heyaa wa,
dɛ́ nyiŋi waa baa bola
bil la ta kɛrɛdɛ.
11Bela nee aa lole laanee
pul won kpeɡa kɛrɛdɛ,
aa won kpeɡ bela
nee aa wola toole.
12Nee la hweehraa,
anee tɔ sie dɛɛ hol,
kɛ dɛ a ta kpeɡe kɛŋɔ
ba kua dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
13Gɛɛ nɛra baa soh Korowii
waa la bwa do,
baa vɛh Korowii nomanta,
ba ta hwɛɡa dɔe.
14Kon baa kpɔ ba hwɛɡa
dawɛ o ta, do kɛ ŋwandare
yal ken.
15Ba yale ŋwandare yal ta naa,
wɛɛ won laɡ ba kpoŋaa?
Ba lawɔ kpoŋe aa,
baa won che naa?
16Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra do kɛ kpɔɡa
aa kpeɡa dɛ che webaah,
ba do kɛŋɔ anɔ la aa moɡa tɔ
bodɛɛɡe baa du daa.
17A dɛ ta lune bar bwea,
ásɛ dɛ lawa kpoŋe kiŋkiŋ.
18Kɛ dɛ nomɛl tua le bela aa,
nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ kɛŋɔ
a fa lɔ bela.
19Gɛɛ a do, silɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
aa dɔa laanee,
banfalaa yon ba so
ba buɡ ta.
20Kpelaa, Korowii aa nɛra
ba waa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la
vɛh bwa,
ɡɛɛ waa wola wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
ɡe cha.
21Wɛɛ ɡeloo he sie lɛ he mamɛ,
dɛ́ hɛɡre dɛɛ moo.
22Wɛɛ ɡeloo sihiih kpo he dɔma,
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deremi
ɡe chɔɡ.”

Title: JOB 9
Content:
Job chaŋe Bildad
1Job chaŋe Bildad ŋɔ,
2“Kpelaa, n jemɔ kɛ
a ɛ kasinteŋ.
Aah ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba
wona di bole Korowii nɛɔ?
3Umee dɛ́ won tɔŋle
Korowii ɔ?
Wɛɛ won pɛɛ webele
kaɡboŋ, nɛn aa won
chaŋe a bini beŋkpoŋ
kwara.
4Korowii dɔ wejema,
dɛ do kpeɡri taeh!
Umee dɛ́ won ɛ
deŋnekpeɡ o nɛ,
á chiɡu kɛrɛdɛ nɔ?
5O huɡri bwejena dɛɛ ta,
o baah diu waa, o dɛ chɔɡa.
6Korowii ɡelɔ harɛ ɛɛ jiɡri
dɛ́ le o buɡ ta,
ásɛ kwaa waa chɔŋɛ a ta,
a do kɛ pilare la ɛɛ yiiɡi.
7Wɛɛ won ŋɔ wee bɛ le,
jwaana ɡe weweela
bɛ won chaah.
8O ɡboo paɡri nyundua bɔle
kɛ yal, dɛ berɛ won valɛ
mpo nehɛma ta.
9Onee ta weweela
bwa soo siwi,
ne anɔ la aa lɔ nyundua
weekaŋle harɛbɔr.
10O dɛ ɛ wejena nomɛlbwa
aa wola won jemɛ a mun,
dɛɛ ɛ nyokpowe-ɛɛla
aa wola nyoa dɔe.
11Korowii kpɔ n jwɛɛh
ba kaa laa, maa on na.
12Dɛ o ŋɔ wɛɛ lɛ komɛlee yaa,
umee dɛ́ won tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?
Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ o be ŋɔ,
‘Bɔkwaa hɛɛ ɛ nɔɔ?’
13Korowii baah diu waa,
o ɡbaɡba aa won
o te larawe warane,
o dɛ sɔɔh mpo bini oljen
ne kwaa aa dɛ chao
la nyoa, á do o lɔɡa.
14A do ɡɛ naa, n dɔ waane
dɛ chaŋe Korowii aa?
N ne waa won cheme.
15Dɛ n waa fe toɡrɔ kwaraa naa,
n fe aa won chaŋo,
waa maa ɛ bwaa
kɛ ń fe soŋe Korowii
waa dɛ di n waa la
ó sune n nɛ.
16Dɛ n fe yerɔ o sɛh n be naa,
maa lii kɛŋɔ o fe ɛɛ no
n bee.
17Wɛɛ ɡeloo peuchɔɡe ta
dɛ́ lɔ mɛ bil, n bwara foɡri,
aa wola mun dɔe.
18Waa ɡel ń won hwee ɡba,
dɛ́ kpɔ suna dii ta
n nɛɛ kohona.
19Dɛ kpeɡri waa yaa,
onee kpeɡa dɛ ɡwaa mɛ!
Dɛ kɔɔto ɡee yaa,
umee dɛ́ won la o ne nɔ?
20N waa fe toɡrɔ kwaraa naa,
n wobol fe ɛɛ
pa mɛ bolchɔɡee.
Wobɛlbwa fe toole
n nɛɛ aa,
n waa fe ta maɡrɛ.
21N waa toɡrɔ te,
kɛ n waane laa wobɛlbwa
aa ba n nɛ.
N soɡa bini pe mɛ.
22A bwa beŋkpoŋ, a waa n ŋɔ,
‘Korowii dɛ chɔɡ nɛra
ba wa aa toɡra,
ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bwa la.’
23Wekpeɡa piɡro ba seo ne
naa, Korowii dɛ mamɛ nɛn
wobɛlbwa aa wola toole
o nɛ.
24Harɛ bɛl baa do nɛnchɔɡa
nɔn ta naa,
Korowii dɛ damɛ nɛra
baa dɛ di ba waa liire.
Dɛ o laa aa,
umee dɛ́ won ɛ ɡɛ nɔ?
25N soɡa bini tɔpera
dɛ kaa warawara
kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ chwa,
silɛɛ bɛlbwa ɡe toole a ta.
26A do kɛŋɔ ɡbera
aa chɔŋɛ nee sie
dɛɛ kaa warane,
kɛɛ kee aa le nyundua,
dɛɛ ba ba lawɛ kon
di la ken.
27Dɛ n ŋɔ mɛɛ soh
n weweelee yaa, atane
n tɔ nyoa, dɛ́ kwaa n sie do,
dɛ mamɛ.
28N weweele bwa ta, n dɛ ɔmɛ,
n jemɔ kɛ Korowii ɛɛ pa mɛ
bolchɔɡee.
29Dɛ n di bolchɔɡe aa,
a chɛ kɛŋɔ
ń koh ta pɛɛ ja aa?
30Hale n sɔ semina
dɛ sarame nɔɔra o ne
kwaraa naa,
31Korowii ɛɛ taɡ mɛɛ
do bɔluŋ doŋa aa lɔ o bini,
n bwara laala kwaraa
aa men nyin,
kɛŋɔ nɛn yon hah o dɔŋ la.
32O ta nɛn ɛɛ ásɛ n ŋɔ
mɛɛ chaŋoo, kɛɛ dɛ́ ŋɔ
n ne wɛɛ ka che kɔɔtoo.
33Kɛ nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ ba che
n ne Korowii baah ta
dɛ́ bol ya wa.
34N Naa Korowii,
ɡel n deŋne tɛra,
laa ɔmee bɛlbwa kpɔ n nɛ.
35N fe ɛɛ bol waa
maa wola ɔmɛ,
kɛ ɡɛ aa doa taraken nɔ,
maa won bol.”

Title: JOB 10
Content:
1Job berɔ bol Korowii be
ŋɔ, “N soɡa bini pe mɛ,
mɛɛ bol waa
maa wola ɔmɛ.
No n tebinichɔɡ waa nɔ.
2N Naa Korowii,
Bɛ men bolchɔɡe pa,
ɡel ń jemɛ
waa aa bala n ne he dɔ.
3A wer he be kɛŋɔ he fiɡ mɛ,
dɛ́ vɛh kon he ɡbabir
aa tao wa aa?
Hɛɛ sɛh waa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
aa dɛ vɔrɔwe taa yaa?
4Nɛn sibie he dɔ dɛɛ nyiŋi waa
kɛ nɛwɛnyini aa dɛ nyiŋi
naa?
5He tɔpera do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini
waa won sewa kwa aa?
He bene haa di
do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini kwa aa?
6Dɛ ɡɛɛ a do aa, ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ
nyin he na n wechɔɡa
dɛɛ nyin he jemɛ wechɔɡa
bɛlbwa maa ɛa nɔɔ?
7He ɡbabir jemɔ kɛŋɔ
n ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ,
nomɛl aa won lɛɛ mɛ
le he nɔn ta.
8Men he ɡbabir
aa kpɔ nɔɔra ma nɔ,
hɛɛ berɔ chɔɡ mɛ naa?
9Lii kɛŋɔ choh nee he ma mɛ,
hɛɛ berɔ chɔɡ mɛ
ń berɛ teera aa?
10Hen tɛ n mɛɛ bokpeɡa
o lol mɛ, he ɡelɔ n kpeɡ
n nya tea bini.
11Henee kpɔ dɛɛhne
choŋri n hoɡa,
dɛ kpɔ ol ne tɔn bɔla.
12He nyin mɛ dɛ tɛ mɛ mkpa,
dɛ nyiŋi n nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ
n ta do le.
13Kɛ n nao kɛŋɔ
anɔ bwa lɔ he bini,
asɛ n jemɛ kɛŋɔ
ɡɛɛ lɔ he nyu bini.
14Dɛ he dɛ nyiŋi kɛ
n fee ɛ wechɔɡa,
ásɛ he fe bɛ kpɔ kɛ mɛ.
15N ɛ wechɔɡa aa, n fe na wa!
N waa toɡrɔ ɡe aa,
n fe aa won ir nyu ne,
ásɛ sihiih fe kpo mɛ
wenaale ɡwaala
aa ɡwaa n nɛɛ nomanta.
16N ɛ wedɛɛɡa
n baŋa pa kwaraa naa,
he dɛ bɛɛ mɛ
kɛŋɔ nyujente,
dɛɛ aah mɛ dɛ́ do mɛ bol
he nyokpowe-ɛɛla ne.
17Saŋ bɛlbwaa he kpɔ wefala
dɛɛ dawɛ n nɛ,
he bandia teŋɛ dɛɛ ɡwaa n nɛ,
dɛ na vɔrɔwe wefala
dɛ́ ba yoo mɛ.
18N Naa Korowii, bɔkwa
waa he ɡel ba lol mɛ nɔ?
N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa sewa,
nomɛlbwa bɛ men na.
19Dɛ ba ta men lolɛ,
n fe den sewɛ tea bini
bɔ kɛ baa lol mɛ nɔ.
20N tɔpera aa kaa
ta tama kae yaa?
Gel mɛ n so
dɛ́ lɛ n sie tama,
21ásɛ n berɔ kaa laa,
maa wola berɛ ba kpa.
N dɛ kaa bela bochaah
naa wola toole, bela
biro ne suna ɡbo aa lole,
22bela ɛ biro ɡbo dɛ do kɛŋɔ
harambaŋa o ta mar dɔe,
dɛ do saɡasaɡa.”

Title: JOB 11
Content:
Job dam Sofar wobol
1Job bol waa tonɛ, asɛ o dam Sofar waa ɛ Naama te ɡe ŋɔ,
2“Amɔ nomɛlbwa aa ɡɛ
waa nɔɔ chaŋe aa?
Wobol kohona ɡelɔ nɛn
waa ɛɛ do wer aa?
3He dɛ lii kɛŋɔ
yaa won chaŋe kɛɛ?
He wepuu waa nɔ ɛɛ won
tɔ yaa ŋwɛnɛ,
ya bɛ won bol wa aa?
4He dɛ bol ŋɔ he waa ɛ kasinteŋ,
he ŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ
Korowii sie.
5Gɛ n fe aa dɛ nyin
kɛ Korowii fee chaŋe!
6Dɛ ɡel he jemɛ kɛ wejema fuuh,
waane lole dɛ ɡwaa
nɛwɛnyina liire ta.
Korowii fe chɛ kɛ
ó tɛr he deŋne ɡwaa ken.
7Hɛɛ won jemɛ Korowii
waa nyoa aa? Korowii
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
kpeɡri waa dɔa la,
hɛɛ won no a mun aa?
8Korowii wejema la ɡwaa
nyundua ne harɛ jaŋne.
A bini luŋri ɡwaa lalabwɛ.
Hɛɛ won jemɛ ɡɛ naa?
