9O wejema la kan ɡwaa
ɡɛ harɛ nɔ paɡri aa doa,
dɛ ɡwaa mpo ɡba.
10O lawɛ ŋɔ ba bol he waa
dɛ́ doe dea aa,
umee dɛ́ won tɔɔ ŋwɛnɛ ɔ?
11Korowii jemɛ nyosonteŋna wa,
o dɛ na ba wechɔɡa
we-ɛɛla bwa kɛrɛdɛ.
12Gɛne ne wejema dɔe la,
dɛ ba wono dɛɛ kpɔɡ bini
ol o berɛ dem kon.
13Job, kpɔ he bambile bwa
tɛ Korowii, dɛɛ soŋo.
14Gel wechɔɡa ɛɛ,
hale wechɔɡa haa ɛa
dɛɛ sɔh bwa.
15Anee dɛ́ ɡel he ir nyu ne,
dɛ́ dɔ hwɛɡa,
he che kiŋkiŋ haa wola ɔmɛ.
16Hɛɛ soh he wenaale la bwaa
kwaraa,
kɛŋɔ nee aa pala ba kaa,
haa wola an na kpa la.
17He soɡa bini ɛɛ chaahnoo
dɛ ɡwaa webaŋa,
ásɛ he wenaale aa do kɛŋɔ
biro la do kɛŋɔ chɔmbibi
wechɛn ken.
18Hɛɛ soo kɛrɛdɛ dɛkalkɛ
he dɔ hwɛɡa,
Korowii ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ
dɛ́ ɡel he onɛ,
ɔmee bɛlbwa aa wola toole.
19Hɛɛ chɔɔ nomɛlbwa
aa wola won aahre,
nɛra ɡalɡa ba he be,
hɛɛ cha ba.
20Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ nao
baa a munii no,
baa bɔree dɔ dɛ́ chwa kaa.
Ba hwɛɡa bwaa kɛŋɔ
ba fee sewɛ.”

Title: JOB 12
Content:
Job chaŋe Sofar
1Asɛ Job chaŋe Sofar ŋɔ,
2“Kpelaa, heyaa bol
waa nɛra ɛɛ no,
he toole n be naa,
nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ bol
wejema waa n be kpa.
3Kɛ n dɔ liire kɛ heya,
he ta men ɡwaalɛ.
Umee lole waa wola
ɡɛ waa nɔ jemɔɔ?
4N berɛ akwekwe nɛn
n daamanar be,
ba dɛ mam mɛ,
kɛ n waa toɡrɔ,
wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ,
Korowii fa no n wesoŋa ka.
5Nɛn waa lɔ bosɔɔhna ta
dɛ mamɛ nɛn waa
aa lɔ o nɛ.
He nyin waa dɛɛ tɛ
nɛn waa dɛ na wa.
6Kɛ ŋwɛɛra ne nɛra baa
wola Korowii tomɛ
soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta,
kwaa baa dɛ tomɛ la
taa ba kpeɡri do.
7He dɛ nyin waa dɛ hweli aa,
he bɔɔ ola ne jumbii
á baɡle heyaa wa,
8kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta kontaala,
ne mpo bini pɛŋa
á baɡle heyaa wa.
9A ɡɛ kwaa nɔ bwa jemɛ
waa Korowii aa ɛa.
10Korowii kontaala bwa nyu
lɔ o nɔn ta,
hale nɛwɛnyina bwa.
11Gɛ kondikwa aa dɛ do
nyondoŋe som,
asɛ wobol ɡe ɛɛ
do deŋne som la,
12ɡɛɛ ya dɔ wejema
dɛɛ le nɛra baa biɡra be.
13Korowii bee wejema ne kpeɡri,
ne nɛra jae dɛ waa mun
noe le.
14Korowii taɡɛ kon ta aa,
nomɛlbwa aa won berɛ
kwaaro cheɡ. O do nɛn dea aa,
nomɛlbwa aa won leo.
15O won ɡela bwaala ɡel nɛɛ
ásɛ hwel che,
o pili nyundua bwaala nɛ
kohona naa, neerare
dɛ suuɡi dɛ́ chɔɡ kwa.
16Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri
ne wejema, nɛra baa dɛ
neɡre nɛra ne banɔ la
baa neɡ ba bwa lɔ o lɔɡa.
17O lɛ nɛra baa dɛ ja
nɛra wejema, dɛ ɡel nɛra
baa bol waa dɛɛ pa bole
do kɛŋɔ ɡɛna ken.
18O dɛ lɛ koranar kpeɡri,
dɛ́ ɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ yoma.
19O dɛ lɛ sɔfore wejema,
dɛɛ ba banɔ la baa di kpeɡri
biɡri ne harɛ.
20O dɛ sɔɔh nɛra
baa dɛ di kasinteŋ nyoa,
dɛɛ lɛ nomonome wejema.
21O ɡelɔ sihiih ɛɛ kpo nɛnjena,
dɛɛ sɔɔh kpeɡnɛra nyoa.
22O dɛ le kwaa aa sɔah
nɛra aa wola a mun jemɛ
ne baŋ, dɛɛ le biro ta kwaa
ne bochaah.
23O won ɡela harɛ bɛl
do kpeɡri dɛ́ chɔɡ bɛl ɡe,
dɛ́ berɛ ɡel ba warɛ
ó lɔ ba peɡre.
24Korowii dɛ lɛ harɛre la
nomonome liire,
dɛ́ ɡel ba wili do hɛŋle ɡbo
harɛ ta dɛɛ ɡaaɡe.
25Dɛ do biro ta dɛɛ laɡre,
dɛɛ yɛɛɡe kɛŋɔ
sennyɔdɛɛra ken.”

Title: JOB 13
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ, “N na ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa,
n noɔ, dɛ jemɛ a mun.
2Waa haa jema la, n ɡe jema,
he ta men ɡwaalɛ.
3N ne Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔree dɔa,
n ne he laa. N dɛ nyin kɛ
n ne Korowii cheme, ásɛ
n baɡle kɛ n ta bolchɔɡe dii.
4Hé kpɔ nyosone tɔ kasinteŋ ta,
hé do kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa te
waa wola won chah weela!
5Hé tɔ nyoa kwaraa naa,
dɛ a fe ɛ wejemwa.
6Hé no n waa nɔ bini,
hé no n wesoŋa maa kpɔa
dɛɛ bil he sie nɔ.
7Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ teŋe nyosone nɔɔ?
Hé dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ
dɛ́ won cha Korowii kɛɛ?
8Hɛɛ won ɡel o baŋa pa aa?
Hɛɛ won bol o waa tɛo
kɔɔto aa?
9Korowii nyiŋi he bini naa,
wɛɛ na wedɛɛɡa anee yaa?
Hɛɛ won neɡro ɡɛ
haa dɛ neɡre nɛra la kɛɛ?
10Dɛ he ɛ waa dɛ sɔh dɛɛ nyiŋi
nɛra sie ta naa,
Korowii ɛɛ pa heyaa
bolchɔɡee.
11O kan waa doa la
ɛɛ ɡeloo he jum jah.
Aa ɡel ɔmee lawɛ heya aa?
12He sɛɡla ta mun dɔe,
a do kɛŋɔ tɔɔ.
Waa haa bola dɛ kpɔ
dɛɛ lɛ he te do kɛŋɔ choh
aa wola kpeɡe ken.
13Hé tɔ nyoa, dɛ́ tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ
ń bol wa,
ásɛ waa aa ba n nɛɛ la ba.
14Dɛ wobɛlbwa kwaraa yaa,
n sɛoh kɛŋɔ
n kpɔ n nyu charɛ seo.
15Hale dɛ Korowii kpo mɛ naa,
n ta dɔ hwɛɡa o be dɛ́ chemo,
dɛ́ baɡle kɛŋɔ
n ta bolchɔɡe dii.
16Anee dɛ́ ɡel n dɔ lɛɛ,
dɛkalkɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ bɛlbwa
aa won ba o sie.
17Hé cheɡ deŋne no waa
maa dɛ ba bola,
dɛ́ no ɡɛ maa dɛ baɡle nɔ.
18Maa dɔa lii n waa cheɡ nɔ,
n jemɔ kɛ Korowii
ɛɛ pa mɛ bolee.
19Nomɛl lole n ne o won cheme
n waa nɔ ta naa?
Nɛn lole ɡɛ naa,
n fe ɛɛ heloo dɛ́ sewɛ.
20N Naa Korowii, ɛ webele
anɛ nɔ ɡbo tɛ mɛ,
ásɛ n won ba he sie.
21Gel n deŋne tɛra
dɛ laa ɔmee kohona
kpɔ n nɛ.
22Dɛ he yer mɛ naa
mɛɛ chaŋee, kɛɛ n bol wa
ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.
23Keraŋwɛnɛɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa
dɛ koni waa ta nɔ? Gel ń
jemɛ waa maa koni a ta.
24Ɛrɛɛ he laa sie kpɔ n nɛ,
dɛ kpɔ mɛ berɛ
he dɔm nɔɔ?
25He dɛ nyin he aah mɛɛ kɛɛ?
He ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ papohole
peu aa taa kpɔ
dɛɛ kaa kɛɛ?
Hɛɛ doŋ mɛɛ kɛŋɔ haahra
peu aa dɛ kaa a nee yaa?
26He chwerɛ n bwara waa
aa wola were,
hale anɔ la maa ɛa
n bonɔɔne saŋ.
27He do kpɛɛ n nakpale,
dɛɛ nyiŋi n vala bini,
dɛɛ dawɛ n nabuɡe.
28Gɛɛ a do, nɛn do kɛ daa
waa pɔah, kɛŋɔ yal chao
aa dɛ diu ken.”

Title: JOB 14
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Ba lolɛ
nɛn aa, o tɔpera aa kanɛ,
a lɔ tamaa ken, wenaale ɡe
ɡboo a bwa.
2O dɛ kpeɡ warane kɛ
kpɔɡa ken, dɛɛ hol warane,
tamaa ken dɛ o nyoɡrɔ
kɛŋɔ lileo ken.
3N Naa Korowii, hɛɛ nyiŋ mɛɛ
dɛ́ na kɛ n lɔ bonɔ,
dɛ́ ba bol n waa kɛɛ?
4Nɛn waa kah doŋa la
ɛɛ won lolɛ nɛn waa wola
doŋa kaeh yaa? Nɛn toole!
5He tɔ sie jemɛ
ɡɛ nɛn aa so ka tel,
dɛ jemɛ korobie
aa lɔ o soɡa la ta. He maɡa
ɡɛ bil aa wola charɛ.
6Laa sie kpɔ o nɛɛ
dɛ́ ta o waa tɛo,
dɛ́ ɡel o ɛ o toma
ka tel kɛŋɔ waa tonɛ
dɛ́ onɛ kɛŋɔ paate.
7Hwɛɡa lole dɛ tɛ daa
baa teŋo ta,
wɛɛ berɔɔ pamɛ dɛ moɡɛ.
8Hale dɛ o lune la ɛ ambena
o muŋkpul sewɛ
dɛ ka harɛ bini,
9dɛ berɛ dɔ nee tama aa,
o berɔ dɛɛ ir dɛ ta kpala
kɛŋɔ daa baa chɔɔro ken.
10Kɛ dɛ nɛn te sewaa, dɛ a tonɔ,
o sewaa, dɛ lee o dɔɔ jaɔ?
11Gɛ neerare yon ɡel pala,
ásɛ nenabɔɔne hweeh
dɛ́ hol la,
12ɡɛɛ nɛn yon sewɛ, waa wola ir kpa.
Nyundua ne harɛ taa lole nɔ,
waa won ir kpa.
13N Naa Korowii,
n dɛ nyin kɛŋɔ
he laɡ mɛ sɔh lalabwɛ,
dɛ́ ɡel n do bela ka tel saŋ
he bandia nyoa aa sɔɔh,
ásɛ he lii n waa tɔpetooro
bɛl.
14Nɛn sewaa, wɛɛ won ir
dɛ́ dɔ mkpa ja aa?
N fe ɛɛ ɛ tomaa
dɛ kpa ka tel
kɛŋɔ n wenaale bwa
aa ba a jaɡa.
15He fe ɛɛ yer mɛɛ,
ásɛ n ɡe chaŋe,
ásɛ he sie lɛ men
haa ta mɛ la nɛ.
16Kasinteŋ, he fe ɛɛ dɛɛ nyiŋi
n vala binii, haa wola
n wechɔɡaa nyiŋi.
17Hɛɛ kpɔɔ kɛ mɛ
haa wola an lii kpa,
dɛ́ fee wechɔɡa bɛlbwa
maa ɛa.
18Gɛɛ, bwejena yon kuuɡi
dɛ́ choɡli, ásɛ bwea huɡri
le bela aa lole,
19ásɛ nee palɛ dɛ́ kpɔ bwea ta
dɛɛ kɛɡra, bwaalajen
won teera taɡa dɛ́ kaa,
ɡɛɛ he won ɡela
nɛwɛnyini hwɛɡa ɛɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
20He dɛ pɔ o nɛɛ o sewɛ dɛ́ kaa,
dɛ́ ɡel o siebɔr beɡre ó kaa.
21O bibaala dɔ jirima
kwaraa naa waa jemɛ,
ba di sihiih ɡe aa, waa no.
22O ɡbosoroo bwadabii wee,
ne suna waa dɛ dii
wɛɛ na.”

Title: JOB 15
Content:
Elifas wobol nɛɛtena
1Belaa Elifas, Teman te la chaŋe ŋɔ,
2“Job, wejereme bɛlbwa
aa waa bol kɛ he kwaa nɔ,
a ta mun dɔe
kɛ peuchɔɡe aa dɛ ta.
3Wejereme bɛlbwa aa waa
kenii bol,
kɛɛ dɛ́ bol waa lɛ o te
wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne.
4Haa Korowii ɔma kpɔe
dɛɛ ɛ waane,
anomanta, nomɛlbwa
aa on soŋe.
5He nyoa wobol dɛ baɡle
he da,
neɡra lɔ he nyoa wobol ta.
6He ɡbabir nyoa wobol
pae bolchɔɡe,
waa aa le he nyoa
dɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ.
7Henee nɛn baa tɔ sie lolɛ aa?
He lole mɔɔ Korowii ta
deŋɡarere aa?
8He no waa Korowii aa
vɔrɔwa aa? He ɡboo nɛn
haa dɔ wejemaa?
9Wobɛlbwa toole he jemɛ
ya ɡe aa wola jemɛ.
Wejema besoo he dɔ
ya ɡe aa wola dɔe yɔ?
10Banjeni ne nyumpompoŋa
tena lɔ ya bini, banɔ la
baa ɡwaa he mɛɛ kwara.
11Aa were kɛŋɔ Korowii ɡbabir
dɛ larawe he bwara aa,
he vɛh.
Ya sɔɔh bwara dɛ che
o naa ta bol waa he be.
12Ɛrɛɛ he bwaawee ir
asɛ he sie beɡre ya nɛɛ,
13he baah di Korowii nɛɛ
kohona dɛ ɡel
ɡɛ wobochɔɡa nɔ ɛɛ le
he nyoa nɔɔ?
14Nɛnee bɔkwa ó ŋɔ
doŋa toole o nɛɔ?
Nɛn bɛlbwa toole
o waa toɡre Korowii be.
15Kpelaa, Korowii
ta hwɛɡa dɔe tɛ
nyundua toroma,
ba waa ta toɡrɛ o be,
16nɛn te pɔɔh,
wechɔɡa suu
kɛŋɔ waa dɛ nyɔ ne.
17Job, cheɡ deŋne,
ń bol waa he be,
waa maa naa la,
mɛɛ baɡle a binii.
18Waa wejerema aa bola,
anɔ la aa le ba naawa be
saŋ la bwa,
ba ta kpɔe sɔh.
19Ba naawa ɡboo fa dɔ harɛ la,
dɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra toole dɛ ɡel
ba laa ba te kpɔ
Korowii nɛ.
20Nyubinikpeɡ tena baa dɛ fiiɡi
ba bala, bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ baa
ba soɡa bini bwaa.
21Ɔmewa ɛɛ chole
ba deŋna taa, ɡɛ saŋ baa ŋɔ
ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta,
ŋwɛɛra den lɔ ba tɔ ba nɛ.
22Ba ta hwɛɡa dɔe
kɛŋɔ baa le waa nyoaa,
nomɛl lee ba cheɡ
dɛ́ kpoo ba,
23ásɛ kɔkɔsakire di ba ola.
Ba jemɔ kɛ ba seo tɔpere
dɛ́ tel.
24Wekpeɡa ne wenaale ɡelɔ
baa ɔmɛ kohona
a dawɛ ba nɛɛ kɛŋɔ kooro
waa dɛ la ka yoo ba laa,
25dɛkalkɛ banee nɛra
baa ume nɔn dɛ pa Korowii
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ nɛ,
dɛ yo Korowii dɛ vɛoh la.
26Ba deŋne kpeɡri dɛ kpɔ kwaa
tɔ ba te ɡbemɡbe
dɛ ka yo Korowii.
27Sodɛɛɡa ɡelɔ ba je faɡra,
ba teene do bare.
28Baa ka so bwɛɛre aa paɡra,
ne deremi a nɛra
aa chwaa kaa la taa,
a ka tama deene la choɡli.
29Baa nyao, ba kondɔɔh bwa
le ba nɔɔra ta,
nɛra aa ba kondɔɔh
bɛlbwaa na kpa.
30Sewaa chɛ kɛ bá sewɛ.
Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ daa nii
aa fuh o kpala,
peu ta kpɔ o fee kaa ken.
31Ba bɛ ba te neɡre dɛ́ kpɔ ba
te dɛɛ dawɛ konsale ta,
baa komɛlbwaa dɔ le a ta.
32Ba tɔpere aa tel dɛ ba holɔ,
kɛŋɔ daa kpale,
baa wola won moɡɛ kpa.
33Baa ɛo kɛŋɔ ɡrepo daa
o nɔna aa wola beɛ dɛ lee,
kɛɛ ɔleve daa o fee bwa
aa leera.
34Nɛra baa wola Korowii
tomɛ la aa biirii dɔ,
ásɛ nii fuh nɛra
baa dɛ nyin kɛ baa yaɡ
ba sen la deremi.
35Gɛ nɛra nɔɔ
dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa,
neɡra ɡe ɡboo ba bwa
saŋ bɛlbwa.”

Title: JOB 16
Content:
Job chaŋe Elifas
1Anee Job chaŋe Elifas ŋɔ,
2“N no waa nɔ
dɔŋa bwa ka,
he berɔ dɛɛ chwee
n ŋwɛr kwara.
3He wobojaŋa nɔ aa tonɛ bwa,
bɔkwa waa dɛɛ ha heyaa
hɛɛ bol ɡɛ waa nɔ
n be nɔɔ?
4Dɛ he fe do ɡɛ maa doa nɔ,
n ɡe do ɡɛ haa doa nɔ naa,
n fe ɛɛ bol waa ɡwaa heya
he kwaa la berɛ
dɔ wesoma.
5Kɛ n nyoa wobol
ɛɛ won tɛ heyaa bokpeɡa,
dɛ́ tɛ heyaa bosɔɔhna.
6Wobɛlbwa toole ń bol
a cha mɛ,
n tɔ nyoa ɡe aa,
n weweele nyoa aa sɔɔh.
7N Naa Korowii,
he ɡelɔ n bokpeɡa tonɛ,
dɛ kpoo n dem tena bwa.
8He laɡ mɛ dɛ ɛɛ mɛ dɔm,
n ɡwaŋɔ dɛ ka hoɡa ɡbo
nɛra cheɡɛ ɡɛ ta,
dɛ pa mɛ bolchɔɡe.
9He toɡri n bini bandia ne
kɛ kpɔɡ bini ol ken.
He hah mɛ dɛ fome siwi
pa n nɛ.
10Nɛra dɛ muɡli n baah
ba dɛ warɛ
dɛ bar mɛ cheme,
dɛɛ kpaa n lwɛrɛme.
11Korowii kpɔ mɛ do
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɔn ta,
o taɡ mɛ ta ba bini.
12N fa soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta,
Korowii den ba hamɛ
n baŋa dɛ taɡ mɛ
ta harɛ.
O kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ hweli hɛm tae.
13O ta hɛma le bobɛlbwa
dɛɛ yaɡ mɛ,
hɛma la yaɡ mɛ dɛɛ vah.
O ɡel n teabini kwaa
bwa chɔ baŋ, hale o ta
n nɛɛ sune tamaa bɛlbwa.
14O teŋɔ dɛɛ do mɛ bola,
kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ yo laa
siswɛm ne la.
15N tɔ lweyal dɛɛ wi,
Korowii pɔ n nɛɛ
n so bomboɡ ta.
16N wio n sibie swɛɛ
dɛ bwa ɔɡre.
17N ta naɡrenyin we-ɛɛla
ane bɛlbwa ɛɛ,
n Korowii soŋa ta ɡe
n kpɔ duure tɛo.
18Dɛ n sewaa, bɛ nɛra baa ɛɛ
mɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ kɛ ba!
Bɛ ɡel wii maa dɛ wi
n kasinteŋ waa la ta tɔ.
19Taraken, n dɔ nomɛl nyundua
waa dɛ ba n naa ta cheɡa,
dɛ́ bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
20N daamanar dɛ mam mɛ,
n dɛ wi siniire
ŋɔ Korowii cha mɛ.
21N dɛ nyin nomɛl
ó che n naa ta
soŋe Korowii tɛ mɛ,
ɡɛ dam yon soŋe
dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ la.
22A ka n bene tamaa ken,
n kaa bela baa wola
laŋɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.”

Title: JOB 17
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ, “Maa won hwee
kɛrɛdɛ kpa, n seo
tɔpere telo tonɛ,
lalbɔɔ ɡbosoo kaa dɛ chɔ
kpaa mɛ.
2Nɛra bwa dɛ mam mɛ,
n dɛ na ɡɛ ba sie aa beɡra
baa muɡli n baah.
3N Naa Korowii,
he ɡbabir ba che tɛ mɛ nɔ.
Umee lole dɛ́ ba che
n habɔɔ?
4He kpɔ waa mun noe sɔɔh ba,
haa ɡel ba di bole n nɛ.
5Gɛ baa dɛ sɛɡle ŋɔ,
Dɛ nomɛl le o daamanar tɛ
dɛ lɛ komɛl aa, naate la
biirii dɛ́ na a waa la.
6Gɛɛ nɛra kpɔ sɛɡla nɔ
dɛɛ bol n wa,
nɛra lawɛ n sie
dɛɛ teɡɛ harɛ.
7Suna dii ɡelɔ maa na kɛrɛdɛ
n nɔɔra ne nakpale ɡwaŋre,
dɛ do kɛŋɔ dawii ken.
8Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra bwara
yɔrɔ a wa,
dɛɛ pwaah mɛ ŋɔ
maa Korowii tomɛ.
9Kɛ ane a bwa, nɛra ba wa
aa toɡra la
ɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛ́ do ɡɛ dɛɛ la,
dɛ́ teŋɛ dɔ bokpeɡa
saŋ bɛlbwa.
10Dɛ ba bwa berɔ ba dɛ ba che
n sie naa,
maa ba bini bɛlbwaa
na kɛ o ɛ wejereme.
11N soɡa bini tɔpera tonɔ,
n waa maa maɡla bil
ɡe chɔɡ,
n hwɛɡa ɡe tonɛ.
12N daamanar kpɔ jwaana
berɛ webaŋa
bɔr joɔ ɡe aa ba ŋɔ,
‘A ka tama bɔr chaah.’
13N hwɛɡa bwa lɔ lalabwɛ,
belaa mɛɛ ba n kalaŋ pae
dɛ́ chɔ biro ta.
14Ásɛ n ŋɔ lalbɔɔ be ŋɔ,
‘N mɛɛ hen,’
dɛ́ ŋɔ dudule ɡe be ŋɔ,
‘Heyaa n nya
ne n nimambii.’
15Dɛ lee n hwɛɡa dɔɔ jaɔ?
Waa n sie aa dawɛ a ta la,
umee dɛ́ na nɔ?
16Waa maa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta la,
n ne aa lalabwɛɛ kaa.”

Title: JOB 18
Content:
Bildad wobol nɛɛtena
1Anee Bildad, Su te la chaŋe Job ŋɔ,
2“Saŋ besoo he wobobala nɔ
ɛɛ ba tona ɔ?
Tɔ nyoa ya ɡe bol ane.
3Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ lii yaa kɛ ola nɔɔ?
He dɛ lii kɛ ya ɡɛnɔ kɛɛ?
4He kpɔ bandia
dɛɛ chɔɡ he wa.
He bandia nomanta,
Korowii chɔɡ harɛ
kɛɛ dɛ huɡri bwejena
le a chebɔra aa?
5Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra kandea ɛɛ dimoo,
wɛɛ ɡel hɔe.
6Kandere aa lɔ ba deenee
ɛɛ dimoo,
bɔr bir ta ba nɛ.
7Ba vala bini fa kpeɡri,
kɛ a sɔɔhnɔ,
jae baa dɛ ja nɛra bane la
ɡelɔ ba ɡbabir chole.
8Ba ɡbaɡba soɡa bini we-ɛɛla
dɛ laɡ ba kɛŋɔ bel ken,
ba valɛ kaa jo o ta.
9Bel la dɛ lawɛ ba nalurumi,
dɛ kpoŋe ba bini kiŋkiŋ.
10Ba harɛ bel ba ŋwɛnɛ ta,
o chɔ dɛɛ kpaa ba.
11Kwaa aa dɛ aah
ba ɛɛ bar baa cheme,
dɛ ti ba dɛɛ di ba nafeena.
12Ba fa dɔ kwa, taraken lɔr
dɛ kpo ba.
Wekpeɡa chɔ le
dɛɛ kpaa ba.
13Weechɔɡa ɡboo ba bwadabi,
a ɡelɔ ba nɔɔra
ne nakpale bwa pɔh.
14Seo kpɔ ba le bela
baa soɡa ba bwara sɔɔh ba,
dɛ kaa ba ne lalabwɛ.
15Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin
o ka so ba deene la ta
ɛɛ won ka so,
kɛ bá kpɔ jebɔrɔwe merɛ
a bwa bini mɔɔ.
16Ba do kɛ daa waa sewa
le o lune ta ka ta
o kpala ta.
17Nomɛlbwa aa ba
waa lii harɛ nɔ ta
ba sɔna he kwaraa.
18Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba dɔma
doŋ baa le harɛ nɔ ta,
dɛ́ le bochaah ta
kaa biro ta.
19Baa bii kɛɛ naanaree dɔ,
ba dwee bɛlbwa aa ka.
20Nɛra baa le wee leebɔr,
dɛ ka tel wee cholibɔr
tena nɛ ɛɛ no ba waa,
ásɛ ɔmee chole ba nɛɛ
kohona baa chel.
21Gɛ aa dɛ ba wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
nɛɛ chiɡa laanee la,
nɛra baa wola
Korowii tomɛ la.”

Title: JOB 19
Content:
Job chaŋe Bildad
1Ate, Job chaŋe Bildad ŋɔ,
2“Saŋ besoo hɛɛ ba ɡela
n bambile sɔɔh mɛ nɔ?
3Saŋ bɛlbwaa hɛɛ chɛɡ mɛ,
sihiih aa heyaa kpo ɡɛ
haa dɛ sopa mɛ nɔ naa?
4Dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa kwaraa naa,
he waane laa,
n nɛɛ a dawɛ.
5He dɛ lii kɛ he ɡwaa mɛ,
dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ n wechɔɡaa
ɡela mɛɛ na wa.
6Hé jemɛ kɛŋɔ Korowiirii ɡela
wenaale nɔ ba n nɛ,
o harɛ bel dɛ laɡ mɛ.
7N wio dɛɛ nyin nomɛl
ó ba lɛɛ mɛ
le n wenaale nɔ ta,
n do lɔŋɔ, kɛ kasinteŋ te
bɛlbwa toole dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ.
8Korowii tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ,
n ta bɔr dɔe dɛ́ kpɔ,
o ɡelɔ n ka biro ta
dɛɛ nyin bɔr dɛ kaa.
9O laa n wer doe bwa kpɔ
n nɛ,
dɛ ɡel n paŋɛ n jirima
waa lɔ n nɛɛ
kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ la.
10O chɔɡ mɛ kɛŋɔ baa kuuɡi
dea ta ken,
dɛ ɡel n hwɛɡa bwa tonɛ,
kɛ baa huɡri daa ta la ken.
11O baah dɛ di n nɛɛ kohona,
wɛɛ yoo mɛ kɛ o dɔm ken.
12O ɡelɔ o laa tena
lɔ ba tɔ n nɛɛ dɛɛ yoo mɛ,
ba ma kwaa dɛ che a ta
bar mɛ cheme,
ba vɔrɔwe ba sobɔra bar
n dea.
13Korowii ɡelɔ n ne n lolanar
baah do jaŋne,
n berɛ hɔɔh nɛra
baa jem mɛ be.
14N lolanar bwa chwa mɛ,
n daamanar soh n wa.
15Nɛra baa soɡe n dem
ne n toli dɛ lii mɛ hɔɔh,
n berɛ nɛŋhɔɔh ba siwi ta.
16N yerɛ n bonɔɔ o ta men chaŋɛ,
hale n soŋo ŋɔ ó cha mɛ.
17N haah naa n hweera
sɔɔh nyin dɛ́ no,
n dɔɔranar ne n nimanar
aa n jwɛɛh bala nyin.
18Bechale ɡba dɛ nyiŋi
n nyubaah,
ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ mam mɛ.
19N daamanar tenten kii mɛ,
nɛra maa dɛ nyin ba berɛ
habɔɔ kpo mɛ.
20N bwadabii tonɔ a ka
n hoɡa ɡbo,
a ka tama n fee sewɛ.
21N daamanar, hé dɔ tedoma tɛ mɛ,
Korowiirii lɔ mɛ bil.
22Ɛrɛɛ he che n nɛɛ ɡɛ
Korowii aa ɡela aa noo mɛ
nɔɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ hɛɛ ha mɛ ɡɛ nɔɔ?
23N dɛ nyin kɛ nomɛl fee lii
n waa nɔ,
dɛ́ chwera do tɔn bini,
24kɛɛ ba fee kpɔ buni ɛa dawɛ
bwe ta,
á do le saŋ bɛlbwa.
25N jemɔ kɛŋɔ n Lɛɛ lole,
waa bwa jaɡa saŋ la,
wɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ taa,
dɛ́ ba bol n waa tɛ mɛ.
26Weela nɔ aa chɔɡ n bwadabii
nɔ habɔɔ
n ta do le nɔ,
mɛɛ na Korowiirii.
27N ɡbabir ɛɛ nao siwi nee,
nomɛl laa dɛɛ ba o nae,
n sie cheɡɛ chiŋ o wa.
28Dɛ he ŋɔ, ‘Ŋwɛnɛ besoo taa
yaa ba wona ɡel
o bwara nyɛɡo wɔ?’
Hé dɛ nyin ŋwɛnɛ haa
kpɔ o ta dɛ́ ha mɛ.
29A chɛ kɛ he ɡbabir ɔmɛ
Korowii tokobi
dɛ o baah diu waa, ó kpɔ
dɛɛ tɛr nɛra deŋne,
ásɛ he jemɛ kɛŋɔ
nomɛl lole
dɛ bol waa dɛɛ pa bole.”

Title: JOB 20
Content:
Sofar wobol nɛɛtena
1Ate, Sofar Naama te la chaŋe Job ŋɔ,
2“Waa la ha mɛ asɛ n piɡri
chaŋe,
n liire ɛɛ mɛ kɛŋɔ ń chaŋe.
3N no waa haa bola la
a ɛ chɛɡa,
kɛ n jemɛ ɡɛ maa chaŋe.
4He ɡbabir jemɛ ɡɛ aa doa
dɛ le mumpar,
dɛ le ɡɛ saŋ Korowii
aa ta nɛwɛnyini
o ba so harɛ nɔ ta,
5nyubinikpeɡ tena silɛɛ
aa biɡri,
nɛra baa wola
Korowii jemɛ dɔ silɛɛ,
kɛ aa ɡɛɛ ka.
6Ba dɛ ɛ mbarafo dɛɛ ɡɔɔ
ba te,
ba nyu kaa leɡe baama ta,
7baa nyoɡro kwaraa kɛŋɔ
peu aa kpɔ tutuɡ kaa la,
ásɛ nɛra baa na ba ka la ɛɛ
pɛɛ ŋɔ,
‘Leperaa ba dɔɔ?’
8Hɛɛ na baa fini, kere
dɛ ba toole kpa
kɛŋɔ deera ken,
kɛŋɔ wepila haa naa
jwaana,
haa wola an na kpa la.
9Nɛra ba fa aa na ba la aa ban
na kpa,
bela ba fa aa soɡa la.
10Ba ɡbabir biirii chɛ kɛ bá bɔ
kwaa baa lɛa le nyaara
be la,
ba ɡbabirii dɛ́ berɛ kwaa
baa lɛa la tɛ a tena.
11Ba bonɔɔne saŋ bokpeɡa la,
ba ne anee dɛ́ ka chɔ
teera bini.
12A do kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa
aa ɛ kontora
ba nyoa bini ken,
asɛ ba kpɔ do ba kaŋa bini
dɛɛ moɡra,
13ba ɡelɔ a do bela biɡri,
a som la nomanta, a yon
ka do ba kaŋa bini.
14Kondikwa aa jo ba tea bini la,
ɛɛ do kpelii kɛŋɔ
tɛɡchɔɡa ken.
15Nɛra kondɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ
tena aa lɛa la,
Korowii ɛɛ ɡeloo ba uɡe
a bwa.
16Kwaa nyubinikpeɡ tena
aa lɛa la
do kɛŋɔ tɛɡchɔɡa ken,
aa kpoo baa kɛ harɛ
aa kpɔ ba ken.
17Baa kondikwaa ne sen
Korowii aa sweera tɛɛ ba
laanee dɔ kohona,
a warɛ kɛŋɔ nee aa sua la.
18Komɛlbwa baa ɛ toma dɔ la,
baa bera tɛ,
kwaa baa koah dɔ la,
baa dɔ di,
19dɛkalkɛ ba fiiɡi nyaara
dɛ vɛɛh ba,
dɛ lɛ deene ba laa maa.
20Ba siwi aa komɛlbwa su,
kwaa baa lɛa cheɡ la,
bɛlbwa aa won lɛɛ ba.
21Ba lɛ nɛra kondɔɔh ba be
a tonaa,
anɔ la baa lea cheɡ ba be
la ɡe ɛɛ le ba nɔn taa.
22Nyubinikpeɡ tena la aa
ba dɔ kwaa kohona la,
a taa wenaale ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ
bala,
nɛra baa di suna la waa ɛɛ
ka dawɛ ba nɛɛ taeh.
23Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ o bandia
kohonaa ba ba nɛ,
dɛ́ tɛr ba deŋne,
saŋ ba ta aa lɔ kwaa la ta
dɛɛ di la.
24Ba chwao le dɔmkon
baa kpɔ buni ɛo nyoa aa,
hɛm o nyoa aa ɛ ayaawaa
dɛɛ ba ba yaɡa dɛ́ kpoo ba.
25Hɛma la ɛɛ yaɡ baa dɛ vah le,
a nyoo aa dɛ nyɛɡle la yaɡɛ
dɛ che ba pwɛ ta le.
Ɔmee kohona ɛɛ chole ba nɛɛ,
26komɛlbwa baa dɔa nyoɡre
biro ta,
nii nɛn aa wola an marɛ,
ba fuh ba ne ba haahna
ne bii bwa.
27Nyundua ne harɛ,
ɛɛ lee baa tɛ kɛŋɔ ba ɛ
wechɔɡa.
28Ba kondɔɔh bwa ɛɛ chɔɡoo,
awola Korowii baah aa di
kohona,
kɛŋɔ nee aa sua dɛ yon kpɔ
komɛlbwa kaa la.
29Waa Korowii aa lea cheɡ
nyubinikpeɡ tena
laanee la,
ɡɛɛ baa ba nae.”

Title: JOB 21
Content:
Job wobol
1Ate, Job chaŋe ŋɔ,
2“N dɛ soŋe heya,
hé cheɡ deŋne no
waa maa dɛ ba bola nɔ,
dɛ he ɛ ɡɛ naa,
aa larawe n bwaraa.
3Hé tɛ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ, ásɛ n bol n wa,
ásɛ n tonɔ mɔɔ naa,
hé mam mɛ.
4Nɛn siee n kpɔ waa dɛɛ bil aa?
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ ń lawɛ
bambile ɔ?
5Hé nyiŋ mɛ asɛ he bwara yɔr,
dɛ́ kpɔ nɔɔra sawɛ nyoo.
6N lii waa aa puu mɛ nɔ naa,
dɛ ɔmee laɡ mɛ taeh,
n bwara bwa ɛɛ sa.
7Ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɡel
nyubinikpeɡ tena so biɡri,
dɛ hwɛɛh dɛɛ dɔ ba te nɔɔ?
8Ba dɛ dɔ bii ne naanar,
dɛ́ so ba kpeɡ ba siwi ta.
9Ba soɡe deŋnesɔɔhna ta
ba deremi,
baa wola ɔmɛ,
Korowii aa ba deŋne tɛr.
10Ba nabala dɛ jwee,
ba naneene loɡle,
aa harɛ dɛɛ ta.
11Nyubinikpeɡ tena la ɡelɔ
ba bii ɛɛ le,
dɛ́ do bobɛlbwa dɛɛ hɛlɛ
dɛɛ jah
kɛŋɔ pebiiri ken.
12Ba yiiɡi kwaa dɛɛ lɔ janjela
ba bii ɛɛ sa,
ba bii no kalipe sii ba sie
lɛ kohona.
13Gɛ nɛra la dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh
ba soɡa bini bwa,
dɛ yon sewɛ deŋnesɔɔhna
ta, bá huɡ ba.
14Ane a bwa, ba dɛ bol
Korowii be ŋɔ,
‘Gel ya so ya soɡa jeiih ken!
Yaa he waa la nyin
dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta.
15Umee Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ ya tomɔ wɔ?
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ yaa ba dɔe le
Korowii soŋa ta nɔ?’
16Ba wer doe toole ba
ɡbaɡba be,
anomanta, n ne ba toole
wobɛlbwa bini.
17Korowii ɡelɔ nyubinikpeɡ
tena piɡri dɛɛ sewaa?
Wekpeɡa toolo dɛɛ ba
ba nɛ aa?
Korowii baah diu
o tɛr nɛnchɔɡe deŋne bwa
naa?
18Ba do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡhole
peu kpɔa ba kaa la aa?
Kɛɛ haahra dompeu kpɔ
ba kaa. Akai!
19He bolɔ ŋɔ,
‘Korowii kwaa mɛɛ
wechɔɡa dɛɛ cheɡ o bie.’
Korowii tɛr mɛɛ la
ɡbaɡba deŋne
o wechɔɡa la waa o na.
20Gel wechɔɡ-ɛɛ la ɡbabir na
o deŋnetɛra waa dɛ ba dɔe,
dɛ́ nyɔ Korowii Waa Ɛ
Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
danana ne.
21O waane laa bii
waa ta ba habɔɔ wa,
ɡɛ saŋ o tɔpera aa ba su
dɛ ba a jaɡa la.
22Nomɛl ɛɛ won baɡle Korowii
wa aa?
Onee dɛɛ bol hale
nomonjena wa.
23Nomɛl dɛ́ sewɛ
dɛ o bwara ta kpeɡri
kohona,
ɡɛ saŋ o bwara aa sɔɔhno
o dɔ bosɔɔhna,
24o bwadabii dɛ́ do wer kɛrɛdɛ,
o hoɡa bini ɡe do kpeɡri.
25Nomɛl ɡe dɛ́ sewɛ sum ne,
o ta som bɛlbwa nae bwa.
26Ba bwa dɛ́ sewɛ baa huɡ ba,
ásɛ kwaa di ba ola.
27N jemɛ waa bwa aa lɔ hé liire
bini, ne liichɔɡa
haa liira dɛɛ tɛ mɛ bwa wa.
28He dɛ bɔɔ ŋɔ, ‘Leperaa
nɛnjena la nɛra, ba fa aa ɛ
nyubinikpeɡ tena deremi,
ba fa aa soɡe a bini la
dɔɔ?’
29He ta vavala la bɔɔrɛ kɛɛ?
He ta waa baa baa bol noɛ
kɛɛ?
30Korowii laa wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
daa le,
awola waa ba tɛr
nɛra deŋne,
wɛɛ ɡel ba tenee awola
waa ba kembɔr ne la.
31Umee dɛ́ won bol
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra waa baa
ɛa ba be nɔ?
Waa baa dɛ ɛ la,
umee dɛ́ won bɔ ba
ba we-ɛɛla kem ɔ?
32Ba te la, ba dɛ la ka huɡ ba,
nɛra dɛ daah ba ŋwama,
33nɛnlaa tenten dɛ teŋɛ
ba nɛɛ kaa ba huɡribɔr,
ásɛ teera tɔ ba nɛ,
ba chɔ jeiih ken.
34He te, waa aa wola mun dɔe
he bol dɛɛ larawe n bwara,
he wobol bwa ɛ nyosone.”

Title: JOB 22
Content:
Elifas wobol toorotena
1Belaa Elifas, Teman te la ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ,
2“Nɛn waa ɛɛ won dɔ tɔnɔ
dɛ tɛ Korowii aa?
Nɛn waa jemɛ waa
kwaraa la,
wɛɛ won ɛ waa á do wer
o be naa?
3Dɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa,
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔ dɛ dɔ komɛl,
kɛɛ he waa wer aa, a dɔ
tɔnɔ dɛɛ tɛ Korowii ɔ?
4Haa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii waa
wɛɛ ba he pwaeh,
dɛ́ bol he waa kɛɛ?
5He wechɔɡa laa kana aa?
He wechɔɡa ta nyoa dɔe.
6He lɛ he dɔŋ kon cheɡ
awɔba pɛɛpɛɛ,
he laa o yal wur,
o che dakpaŋ.
7He vɔmɛ nɛra nyoɡre
aa dɛ kpo ba ne,
dɛ vɔmɛ nɛra lɔr
aa dɛ kpo ba kondikwa,
8a lole kɛŋɔ he dɔ kpeɡri
dɛ dɔ harɛ,
dɛ dɔ jirima dɛ so o ta.
9He doŋi luhaahna
ba kaa nɔŋɡbala ne,
dɛ fiiɡi bilalbii ɡe.
10A waa nafuɡere bare cheme,
asɛ ɔmee den su he bwa la.
11A waa a do kɛŋɔ bɔr biro ta
he nɛɛ haa wola na,
a do kɛ nee suu tɔ
he nɛɛ la.
12Nyundujaɡla laa Korowii do
aa?
Dɛ ba sie ne harɛ
dɛɛ nyiŋi weweela
a ɡe aa lɔ nyundua aa?
13Kɛ he ŋɔ,
‘Bɔkwaa Korowii jemɔɔ?
Wɛɛ do biro nɔ taa dɛ́ bol
nɛra waa dɛ́ pa bole aa?
14Baama aa kana tɔ o nɛ,
dɛ ɡel waa yaa na.
O lɔ nyundujaɡla
ne harɛ baah ta dɛɛ valɛ.’
15Hɛɛ soo kɛŋɔ saŋ la tena aa?
Gɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra fa aa
soɡa la aa?
16Ba serewɔ mɔɔ ba saŋ tel,
kɛŋɔ nee yon su
ba bɔle deene ta la.
17Ba ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ,
‘Gel yaa! Bɔkwaa hen
Haa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ
ɛɛ ba wona ɛ yaa ɔ?’
18Kɛ Onee tɛɛ ba kondɛɛɡa
a su ba deene,
anomanta, n laa n te kpɔ
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra liire la ta.
19Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra na ɡɛ
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ ba
chɔɡa ba sie lɛ,
nɛra wobɛlbwa aa
wola toole
ba nɛɛ dɛ mam ba ŋɔ,
20‘Kpelaa, Korowii chɔɡ
ya dɔma,
asɛ nii fuh ba
kondɔɔh bwa.’
21Job, kpɔ he te tɛ Korowii,
ásɛ he bwara sɔɔhne,
he ɛ ɡɛ naa,
wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ.
22No waa waa dɛ doe a ta,
dɛ́ kpɔa do he nyu bini.
23Dɛ he berɔ ba Korowii
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
be naa, wɛɛ lɛɛ.
Dɛ he laa wechɔɡa
kpɔ bela haa soɡa,
24dɛ pa he suuɡaswɛm
ta bomboɡ ta,
ne he suuɡaswɛm tenten ta
bwea aa lɔ nenabɔɔne
aa hweehra baah ta,
25ásɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ
la do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm,
ne suuɡapoŋ kohona tɛɛ.
26Anee dɛ́ ɡel he sie lɛ o nɛɛ
kohona,
ásɛ he won dɛɛ tomɔ
bambidɛɛɡe ne.
27Hɛɛ wiu noo ásɛ o no he be,
hɛɛ baɡɔɔ nyoa
dɛ́ won teŋɛ a ta.
28Waa haa dɛ lii ŋɔ
hɛɛ ɛo ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ,
he ŋwɛnɛre bwa chaah.
29Dɛ nɛn lɔ harɛ naa,
hé soŋe Korowii tɛo ŋɔ
ó lawɔ ir,
o dɛ lɛ banɔ la
baa dɛ pwɛr ba te.
30Nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola
toole o nɛɛ kwaraa la,
Korowii ɛɛ lɛo,
wɛɛ che he tepoŋ
haa dɔa la taa dɛ lɛo.”

Title: JOB 23
Content:
Job chaŋe Elifas
1Belaa Job chaŋe Elifas ŋɔ,
2“Hale fini n waa
ta kpeɡri dɛ ɡwaa n nɛɛ ja,
n pɛma habɔɔ, Korowii ta
dɛ tɛr n deŋne.
3N dɛ nyin kɛ n fe aa na Korowii,
dɛ́ na ɡɛ maa ɛ dɛ́ la
bela waa soɡa!
4N fe ɛɛ kpɔ n waa bil o sie,
dɛ́ bol n waa aa cha mɛ
bwa baɡlo.
5N fe ɛɛ nao ɡɛ waa chaŋ mɛ,
dɛ́ no waa waa bol baɡ mɛ.
6Korowii ɛɛ che o kpeɡri
waa dɔa kohona
la taa n ne o tɔŋle
waa naa?
Akai, waa waa kpɔ dawɛ
n nɛ.
7N waa toɡra nomanta,
awola mɛɛ kpɔ n waa
bil o sie,
ó pa mɛ bole dɛ́ lee mɛ ta
kwaraa.
8Kɛ n la wee leebɔr aa,
o toole bela,
n berɔ la wee cholibɔr
ɡe aa, maa on na.
9O dɛ ɛ toma weekaŋle
nyunduabɔr aa,
maa on na.
O berɔ do weekaŋle
harɛbɔr ɡe aa,
n sie aa o nɛɛ dawɛ.
10Kɛ o jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ maa dɛ kpɔ
o ta,
o daah mɛɛ na naa,
mɛɛ do werii,
kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm baa doo
nii ta.
11N dɛ teŋɛ ŋwɛnɛ
waa dɛ kpɔ o ta
kasinteŋ ta,
n dɛ teŋɛ o waa ta,
maa bɛlbwa ɡel.
12N dɛ teŋɛ o Mmarare
waa do mɛ ta,
n kpoŋe o nyoa wobol bini,
dɛ ɡwaa n wenyina.
13Korowii te, ɡɛ waa doa
o den do,
nomɛlbwa aa won beɡre
waa do o nyoa,
anɔ la waa dɛ nyinii wɛɛ ɛ.
14Waa waa do mɛ a ta la,
anee wɛɛ ba ɡela a ɛ,
o ta dɔ a dɔŋa warɛ o be
cheɡ mɛ.
15A waa ɔmee chole n nɛɛ
o sie nɔ,
n lii a ɡɛ waa nɔ naa,
n dɛ ɔmɔ.
16Korowii ɡelɔ n bambile chɔɡ,
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ la ɡelɔ n ɔmɛ.
17Kɛ ane a bwa, biro la ta
ɡelɛ n ɡel wii,
a lole kɛŋɔ biro kohona la
ta ɡelɛ mɛɛ na.”

Title: JOB 24
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ aa wola tɔpere bɛl
leɛ cheɡ, dɛ́ bol nɛra waa
dɛ́ pa bole ɔ?
Nɛra baa dɛ tomɔ la
bɛ on na
kɛ o dɛ bol wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
la wa.
2Nɛra dɛ huɡri bwea baa kpɔa
bil harɛ jwɛhre ta,
ásɛ ba kwaa do kan,
ba ŋwɛ peera ba ja
ba kwaa ta,
dɛ́ kpɔa dɛɛ la dibɔra.
3Ba dɛ ŋwɛ bilalbie keeɡo,
dɛ́ kpɔ suuɡa kemɛ luhaah,
dɛ́ lɛ o nabal cheɡ awɔba.
4Ba dɛ tɔ nyaara ŋwɛnɛ
ba wenyina ta,
dɛ́ doŋ ba bwa bá chwa
ka sɔh.
5Gɛ keeɡore yon do
pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta
dɛɛ ɡaaɡe kondikwaa la,
ɡɛɛ nyaara la ɡe do,
ɡɛ tentenee ba ɡaaɡe nyin
kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ ba bii.
6Kooni aa wola ba kwaa ɛɛ
taa baa kuuh kondikwa,
dɛ́ ka kuuh daa nɔna
nyubinikpeɡ tena kooni ta.
7Ba ta yale dɔe,
dɛɛ chɔ dakpaŋ,
waa dɛ kpo ba jwaana,
komɛlbwa toole ba kpɔ tɔ.
8Bwaalajena nɛo dɛɛ kpo
ba bwejena dor,
baa wola bobɛlbwa dɔe
dɛ jo la,
ba yon ka pɛɡle bwea
ba bwara wɔrɔbe.
9Ba lɛ bilalbie o taa dɛ ɔr
le o nya be,
dɛ lɛ nyaa bie ka cheɡ
awɔba.
10Baa wola yale dɔe nomanta,
pɛɛpɛɛ ɡɛɛ baa valɛ,
dɛ́ che mea le kooni ta
dɛ́ chɔ lɔr.
11Nyaara la harame
nyubinikpeɡ tena noo
dɛɛ tɛɛ ba,
dɛ harame ba ɡrepo nɔna
nee baa kpɔa dɛɛ ɛ sen,
kɛ baa ɡel ba nyɔ ane.
12Nɛra baa dɛ ba serewa
dɛ pɛmɛ bwɛjen la ta,
banɔ la baa do ba bola
ɡe ɛɛ wi,
dɛɛ nyin Korowii ó cha ba,
kɛ Korowii laa sie kpɔ
ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra la nɛ.
13Nɛra bane lole
dɛ hah bochaah,
baa jemɛ webaŋa valɛ.
14Bɔr joɔ waa, dɛ nɛn waa
dɛ kpoo nɛra iro,
dɛ́ kaa kpoo nɛŋɡwɛɡra
ne nyaara,
jwaana dɛɛ bɛɛ kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ.
15Nɛn waa lawɛ nɛra bane
haahna dɛɛ chɔ la,
dɛ́ kpa kɛŋɔ bɔr bir.
O dɛ lii kɛŋɔ,
‘Nomɛlbwa aa men na,’
dɛ́ kpɔ sie sɔh.
16Ŋwɛɛra ku deene ɡbeni
dɛɛ jo a bini jwaana,
kɛ webaŋa dɛ ba tɔ ba te
do dea,
baa bɔr chaahna nyin
dɛ́ kpɔ ɛ wobɛlbwa.
17Bɔr biraa, o ber ba webaŋa,
ɔmewaa aa lɔ biro ta la
man ba.
18Nyubinikpeɡ tena la do kɛŋɔ,
doŋa aa jaah nee sie,
Korowii taah harɛ baa dɔɔ,
nomɛlbwa aa ba daa kooni
taa la kaa ɛ toma.
19Gɛ dombwea yon nyoɡre
bɔwɔb kɛɛ hwel saŋ la,
ɡɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe nyoɡre
dɛɛ kaa lalabwɛ.
20Ba nyare baa lol ba ɡba soh
ba wa,
dudule di ba ola.
Ba dɛ soh nyubinikpeɡ tena
la waa kwaraa,
ba dɛ do kɛŋɔ daa
waa kuuɡa ken.
21Ba fiiɡi hambara
ne haahna baa wola
bii dɔe,
ba ta luhaahna nɛɛ sune.
22Kɛ Korowii cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta
dɛ chɔɡ kpeɡnɛra,
a lole kɛŋɔ ba soɡe le,
kɛ ba jemɔ kɛ baa
mkpaa dɔ.
23Korowii ken ɛɛ ɡeloo ba
bwara sɔɔh ba
ba soɡa bini,
kɛ dɛ o sie lɔ ba we-ɛɛla ta.
24Nyubinikpeɡ tena la
soɡa bini dɛ do wer
tamaa bɛl,
tamaa ken ɡe dɛ ba
kaa harɛ,
ba nyanyini tonɛ kɛŋɔ
kpɔɡa baa kua dɛ boa
a nyoa,
dɛ berɛ do kɛŋɔ mea
paa aa koma
a ka a daa ɡbo la.
25Dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, umee dɛ won
ŋɔ n teŋe nyosone,
dɛ́ baɡle kɛ ɡɛ laa waa la
doɔ?”

Title: JOB 25
Content:
Bildad wobol toorotena
1Belaa Bildad, Su te la chaŋe ŋɔ,
2“Korowiirii dɔ kpeɡri
komɛlbwa ta,
a chɛ kɛŋɔ bɛlbwa ɔmɔ,
o ɡelɔ deŋnesɔɔhna do
o be nyundua bela.
3Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ
o laa tena nyoa ɔ?
Bobɛlbwa toole
o bochaah la aa wola toole.
4Ɛrɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ ba wona ŋɔ
o waa toɡrɔ Korowii be nɔ?
Ɛrɛɛ nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba wona
ŋɔ doŋa toole o nɛɔ?
5Hale dɛ korobie aa chaah
Korowii be,
weweela aa were o be naa,
6bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini waa do
kɛŋɔ dudul kɛɛ sɔɡlɔ
do o be nɔ?”

Title: JOB 26
Content:
Job wobol
1Belaa Job chaŋe Bildad ŋɔ,
2“Na ɡɛ haa cha nɛn
waa wola bokpeɡa dɔe!
Berɛ na ɡɛ haa lɛ
men maa ɡwɛɡraa nɔ!
3Na jae haa ja nɛn
waa wola wejema dɔe!
Na ɡɛ haa baɡ mɛ
waa mun noe kohona!
4Umee chae he bol
ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?
Umee tɛɛ liire he bol
ɡɛ waa nɔɔ?
5Lala bwara dɛ sa kɛrɛdɛ,
banla baa lɔ neerare bini,
ne kwaa aa soɡe a bini bwa.
6Lalabwɛɛ chɔ pɛɛ
Korowii siwi ta,
komɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔ o ta
waa wola on na.
7Korowii paɡri weekaŋle
nyunduabɔr bɔle,
bela komɛlbwa aa wola
toole, o ta ɡelɛ
harɛ saɡɛ komɛlbwa ta
o lawɔ kpoŋe.
8Korowiirii vɔrɔwe bwaala
nee do o baama bini,
kɛ bwaala nee la tɔɡre ɡe
aa won baama la pere.
9O kpɔ kon tɔ korobie bwa,
dɛ paɡri o baama tɔ o ta.
10O pere bochaah le biro ta,
o do kɛŋɔ jwɛh dɛ teŋɛ
mpo ne nyundua baah.
11Dɛ Korowii ŋɔ wɛɛ chɔɡ pilare
aa lawɛ nyundua kpoŋe
laanee yaa,
aa yiiɡuu ɔmee lawa.
12O cheɡɛ o kpeɡri ta dɛ ɡel
mpo ɛɛ vuuɡi,
dɛ che o wejema ta
chɔɡ mpo bini oljen Rahab.
13O nyoa peuwee ɡela
nyundua chaah, o nɔn nee
o kpo kontuuɡi damanta
waa ɛ harɛkon,
dɛ tuuɡa dɛɛ kaa la.
14Waa waa ɛa la bini tamaa la,
a bini wetama anee ya no.
Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kpela,
ɡɛ Korowii kan ne
o kpeɡri aa doa ɔ?”

Title: JOB 27
Content:
1Job ta teŋɔ dɛɛ bol o waa la dɛ ŋɔ,
2“N ŋwɛɛ Korowii,
waa lole saŋ bɛl bwa,
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔ waa wola
men kɛrɛdɛ ɛɛ,
dɛ ɡel mɛɛ na wahala,
3n ta aa lɔ mkpa bini,
Korowii ta ɡel
mɛɛ hwee nɔ,
4maa nyoa pili bol
wechɔɡe bɛlbwa,
maa nyosonee teŋe.
5Maa won ŋɔ he waa wer,
maa sɛh ŋɔ n di bolchɔɡe
ka tel kɛŋɔ maa sewa.
6Mɛɛ che toɡra n wa aa toɡra
taa kiŋkiŋ maa wola ɡel.
N liire aa men
bolchɔɡee pa,
saŋ bɛlbwa n ta
aa soɡe le nɔ.
7Korowii, ɡel n dɔma na
ɡɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa dɛ na,
bá na ɡɛ nɛra ba wa aa
wola kasinteŋ dɔe
aa dɛ na.
8Dɛ Korowii teŋe nɛra
baa wola on tomɛ
hweera ta naa,
bɔkwa hwɛɡaa baa ba
dɔe yɔ,
dɛ o teŋe ba mkpa ta naa?
9Korowii ɛɛ no ba wii
ɡɛ saŋ wenaale aa ba ba
nɛɛ yaa?
10Ba sie ɛɛ dɛɛ lɛ
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔ nɛɛ yaa?
Baa dɛɛ soŋe Korowii
saŋ bɛlbwaa yaa?
11Mɛɛ baɡle ɡɛ Korowii kpeɡri
aa doa, maa On
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
ŋwɛnɛree kpɔ sɔh heya.
12He bwa siwi na ɡɛ waa nɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ he ta ɛɛ bol waa
aa wola mun dɔe nɔɔ?
13Waa Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri
Bwa Dɔɔ, aa dɛ ba ɡela
a pu nyubinikpeɡ
ne sikpeɡ tena laanee nɔ.
14Ba bii ɛɛ warɔɔ, kɛ baa kpoo
ba laa taa,
ba naanar aa kondikwaa
dɔ di vaɡɛ.
15Weechɔɡaa dɛ́ kpoo ba bii
ne ba naanar baa ba ka la,
ba luhaahna aa ban wi.
16A lole kɛ ba dɔ suuɡapoŋ
kɛ nee ken,
dɛ dɔ yale kohona,
17nɛra ba wa aa toɡra laanee
dɛ́ tɔ yale la,
ásɛ banɔ la wobɛlbwa
aa wola toole ba nɛɛ kpɔ
suuɡapoŋa la bɔne dɔŋa.
18Nyubinikpeɡ tena deene baa
maa do kɛŋɔ kon dudul
yon sɔh tɔ o nɛɛ la,
kɛɛ pata nɛn waa
dɛ kpa koo aa doa.
19Ba dɛ chɔ kɛ kondɔɔhna,
kɛ baa ɡɛɛ ka,
ba ne jara dɛ a bwa
le ba nɔn ta.
20Ɔmee dɛ́ piɡ ba
kɛŋɔ nee aa sua,
peukpeɡ ta dɛ́ ba kpɔ
ba kaa jwaana.
21Peu waa le wee leebɔr ta
dɛ́ ba kpɔ ba kaa,
dɛ́ le ba ne ba deremi ta
kaa.
22Wɛɛ ba taɡ baa ta,
waa wola ba nɛɛ sune,
ba chwa dɛɛ le o be.
23Peu lɔ kpaŋa ta ba nɛɛ
kɛ nɛn,
ba wechɔɡa wa,
o nyoa ɛɛ si
dɛ taɡ ba le ba deremi.”

Title: JOB 28
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ, “Bela baa
dɛ kwi suuɡapoŋa lole,
bela baa laa doŋa dɛɛ kpɔ
suuɡaswɛm ta ɡe do le.
2Harɛ binii ba kwi buni dɛɛ le,
dɛ dɔ ayaawa dɛɛ le
bwea ane ɡe ta.
3Nɛra kpɔ kandere jo
dɛɛ kaa harɛ bini biro ta,
ba kwiu dɛɛ la bojaŋ,
dɛɛ nyin bwea ɡɛ kwaa nɔ
aa lɔ a ta biro ta bela.
4Ba kwiu dɛɛ la bela
nɛn aa wola soɡe bwa,
bela nɛn aa wola valɛ
dɛɛ la,
bela nɛra aa wola toole
bwaa baa ɛ toma,
ŋwɛɛra taa ba saɡre ɡɛ saŋ
dɛ jo kaa kwia.
5Harɛ nɔ taa kondikwa le
dɛɛ ba,
kɛ o bini ɡe, ba kpɔ nii
dɛɛ peɡri bwea la ɡɛ saŋ.
6Bwedɛɛɡa ane
a yoɡ aa kpeɡa
lɔ bwea la ta,
suuɡaswɛm do bwea la
men ta.
7Jumbii aa dɛ di ola
bɛlbwa aa bela
ŋwɛnɛ jemɛ,
kɔla siwi ta bela nae bwa.
8Kpɔɡ bini ola
ta bela kpɔe bwa,
nyujente ta bela laŋɛ bwa.
9Nɛra kwiu dɛ paɡre
bwekpeɡa, dɛ kwi
bwejena a lɔɡre chɔ.
10Ba forɛ bɔɔ bwea la bini,
ba siwi ɛɛ na kwaa a yoɡ
aa kpeɡa la bwa.
11Ba nyiŋi neerare nyuune ta,
dɛ kpɔ kwaa aa sɔah la
ɛɛ le baŋ.
12Kɛ leperaa yaa ba
wejema nae yɔ?
Leperaa waa mun noe
ɡe doɔ?
13Nɛwɛnyini aa ɡɛ wejema
waa aa hiah jemɛ,
haa won nao harɛ nɔ ta.
14Haa won na wejema
neerare vile ta.
Mpo ta ɡe, haa won dɔɔ
bela.
15Baa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm
tenten yawɔ, kɛɛ dɛ kpɔ
ɡɛ suuɡapoŋ tɔɡre
aa doa maɡɛ o yoɡ.
16Haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm
koŋkwaa dɔɔ,
haa won kpɔ bwedɛɛɡa
a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɔɔ.
17Haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm
kɛɛ diɡi maɡɔ,
haa won kpɔ suuɡaswɛm
koŋkwaare charɔ.
18Bwedɛɛɡa ane a yoɡ
aa kpeɡa ta wejema tele,
bwedɛɛɡa ane aa ɛ ampoŋa
ne answɛɛma dɛɛ nyɛɡle
ta on tele.
19Ane ɡe a yoɡ aa kpeɡa,
ne suuɡaswɛm baa yawa
dɛɛ le bojaŋ harɛ ɡba,
ta on tele.
20Amɔ dɛ leperaa wejema leɔ?
Lee waa mun noe doɔ?
21O sɔh nɛra ne ola bwa
Korowii aa taa,
hale jumbii aa dɛ ɡah ɡba.
22Banɔ la baa lɔ lalabwɛɛ ŋɔ,
‘Tamaa kenii ya no o wa.’
23Korowii dɔ o ŋwɛnɛ wejema,
o ɡboo jemɛ bela waa lole,
24dɛkalkɛ o dɛ na
harɛ jaɡa bwa,
dɛɛ na komɛlbwa waa lɔ
o ta.
25Korowiirii ɡela peu nyoa
do kpeɡri,
dɛ maɡɛ mpo bini ne,
26dɛ baɡle ɡɛ saŋ bwaala
aa dɛɛ nɛ,
dɛ baɡle ŋwɛnɛ bwaala
aa kɔr dɛɛ kpɔ o ta.
27O na wejema kɛŋɔ
o waa hiaoh,
dɛ na kɛŋɔ o wer,
dɛ daahno na.
28Asɛ Korowii ŋɔ nɛwɛnyini be
ŋɔ, ‘N ɔmaa
dɛɛ ba ɡela hé dɔ wejema,
he ki wechɔɡa ɡe aa,
anee waa mun noe.’ ”

Title: JOB 29
Content:
1Job teŋɔ dɛ bol o waa la ŋɔ,
2“Gɛ n fe aa dɛ nyin
kɛ n berɛ do kɛ ɡɛ saŋ
Korowii aa nyiŋi n nɛɛ,
3ɡɛ saŋ waa ɡela
n ŋwɛnɛre chaah dɛ ɡel
n won valɛ biro ta!
4Gɛ saŋ n fa aa cheɡɛ
n naa ta,
dɛ kpɔ Korowii ɛ
n dam tenten,
o kpɔ nɔn tɔ n ne
n dem tena nɛ.
5Dɛ ɡɛ saŋ Korowii Waa Ɛ
Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
ja n nɛ,
asɛ n bii bar mɛ cheme,
6ɡɛ saŋ n fa aa ɛ kondɔɔh
dɛ n dɔ ɔleve noo taeh!
7Dɛ n dɛ la bwɛjen la
doonyojen la ta,
dɛ́ ka so bela nomonome
bwa aa dɛ so la,
8ásɛ bonɔɔna na mɛ
dɛ́ kɛrɛ che,
banjeni ir che dɛ́ kpɔ
duure tɛ mɛ,
9nomonome ɡel wobol,
dɛ́ kpɔ nɔɔra tɔ nyoo.
10Hale nomonjena dɛ hel,
baa wola waa bol.
11Nomɛlbwa waa no n wobol
dɛ́ bol n bwara wedɛɛɡe,
banɔ la baa na mɛ
kpɛɛ mɛ,
12lɛɛ maa dɛ lɛ nyaara baa wia
dɛɛ nyin nɛra bá cha ba
la wa,
ne bilalbii baa wola
nomɛlbwa dɔe ó lɛɛ ba.
13Nɛra baa cheɡɛ seo nyoa
soŋe andɛɛɡa tɛ mɛ,
n ɡel luhaahna baah
sɔɔh ba.
14Toɡra n wa aa toɡra
do kɛŋɔ maa tɔ yal,
kasinteŋ bola ɡe do kɛŋɔ
maa do batakaare
dɛ kpɔ yal vɔwɛ nyu.
15Menee fa dɛ tɔ nyoŋa sie,
dɛɛ cha boobie.
16N do kɛŋɔ mɛɛ dɛ tɛ nyaara,
dɛɛ cha hɔɔhra ba wa
aa lɔ kɔɔto.
17N dɛ sɔɔh nyubinikpeɡ tena
nyoa,
dɛ́ lɛ nɛra baa dɛ di kpeɡri
ba nɛɛ la ta.
18N liiro kɛŋɔ ń dɔ mkpajaŋ,
dɛ́ chɔ n dem sewɛ
sɔnɔnɔɔ.
19N do kɛŋɔ daa o lune
aa kaa nee ta, asɛ mɛn
ɛɛ ta o kpala ta jwaana.
20N nyanyini aa tonɛ bwa,
n bwara ɛɛ do kpeɡri
saŋ bɛlbwa.
21Nɛra dɛ kpa dɛ́ no n wa,
ba dɛ hel jeiih ken,
dɛ́ no n wejaala.
22N bol waa tonaa,
baa waa bol kpa,
n waa dɛ jo ba nyuune
bini.
23Ba dɛ kpaa mɛ kɛŋɔ
nɛra yon dɛɛ kpa
bwaala la,
kɛŋɔ paara aa dɛ kpa
yoo saŋ bwaala ken.
24N mamɛ ba be naa,
a dɛ ɛɛ ba wepiɡra,
dɛkalkɛ baa ɡɛ lii,
n pur sie ba be naa,
ba dɛ dɔ bokpeɡa.
25N ɛ ba nyu te dɛɛ tɔ ba sie,
n soɡe ba bini kɛŋɔ
kooro ne o laa tena,
dɛ do kɛ nɛn waa dɛ larawe
nɛra ba loo aa kua bwara.”

Title: JOB 30
Content:
1Job teŋɔ ŋɔ,
“Nɛra maa ɡwaa ba
nomonome kwaraa
dɛ mam mɛ taraken!
Ba mɛɛnanar kwaraa
n fe aa wola ban kpɔ,
ba ne n nyootena daah
n peera.
2Wedɛɛɡa besoo mɛɛ ba dɔe
le, a ɡɛ nɛra baa do ken
dɛ ɡwɛɡre nɔ be nɔ?
3Nyaa ne lɔr nomanta,
ba lɔ pua hɛŋle ɡbo
harɛ ta, dɛ ɡaaɡe
dɛɛ nyin kondikwa jwaana.
4Kpɔɡ la binii ba toɡri
papooni a bini
aa do nyɛɡre,
ne dalune a ɛ ba kondikwa.
5Ba doŋi a ɡɛ nɛra la
le ba bala bini,
dɛɛ moo ba kɛŋɔ
ŋwɛɛra ken.
6Nenabɔɔne aa hweehra
binii ba ka so,
bwea baah ne bɔɔne
bini bwa.
7Ba lɔ kpɔɡ bini dɛɛ wi
kɛŋɔ ola,
dɛ pɛɡle dɔŋa kpɔɡa lɔɡre,
ɡɛ aa ɛ ba bwara wɔrɔbe.
8Ba ɛ nɛra ba wa
aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe,
ba ta sɔna dɔe,
ba doŋ ba le harɛ la ta.
9Name, menee ba bibaala
kpɔ ɡo yela dɛɛ mamɛ,
menee ba kpɔ maɡɛ waa
dɛ bol dɛɛ mamɛ.
10Ba hah mɛ, baa men bɛne,
baa waa haŋre,
dɛ ta nentane dɛɛ ta n siebɔr.
11Korowii aa ɡela n ɡwɛɡre,
maa wola won ɛ wobɛlbwa
nomanta,
ba na mɛ naa, ba dɛ ɛɛ mɛ
wobɛlbwa baa dɛ nyin.
12Ba yon pɛ nyoa lɔ ba tɔ n nɛɛ
dɛɛ yoo mɛ,
dɛ doŋ mɛ n chwa dɛɛ kaa,
dɛɛ nyin mɛ dɛ́ kpo.
13Ba tɔ mɛ ŋwɛnɛ,
dɛ́ dɔ bɔr chɔɡ mɛ,
nomɛlbwa toole dɛ́ kah ba.
14Ba yoo mɛ kɛŋɔ laa tena
aa ku danjwɛɛ dɛ jo ken,
dɛ che bela aa peɡra la
dɛ wur ba n be.
15Ɔmee kohona chole n nɛ,
n nyanyini kaa kɛŋɔ
peu ken,
n kondɔɔh ɡe bwa le
n nɔn ta
kaa kɛŋɔ bam ken.
16N dɛ ba sewa,
tɔpere bɛlbwaa mɛɛ na
wahala.
17N hoɡa bini dɛ
chwee mɛ jwaana,
n bwara bini wee
aa men ɡel bwa.
18Korowii hamɛ n baŋa,
n batakaare jwereme
marɛ n nɛ.
19O taɡ mɛ ta kpechɛɡre ta,
n do kɛŋɔ teera ne tɔɔ
aa wola toole
wobɛlbwa bini la.
20N Naa Korowii, n wio dɛɛ
yerɛ kɛ haa men chaŋe,
n iro che, kɛ he sie pa
n nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
21He nyu bini kpeɡri n nɛ,
dɛɛ yoo mɛ he kpeɡri
bwa ne.
22He laɡ mɛ ir che,
dɛ ɡel peu ta
dɛ kpɔ mɛ dɛɛ kaa,
he vuɡ mɛ dɛɛ ta
peukpeɡ bini bobɛlbwa.
23N jemɔ kɛŋɔ seo binii
hɛɛ kaa n ne, bela haa
lea cheɡ nomɛlbwa la.
24Kpelaa, nɛn waa lɔ wahala
ta, dɛ wi dɛɛ nyin nɛn
ó chao la,
baa on lɔ.
25N fa ta wie tɛ banɔ la
baa lɔ wahala ta naa?
N loo fa ta kui tɛ
nyaara aa?
26Kɛ maa dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ wedɛɛɡa
ta la,
wechɔɡaa mɛɛ dɔ,
maa dɛɛ nyin bochaah la,
biroo mɛɛ na.
27N bambile bini dɛ wure,
waa ɡel bwa,
tɔpere bɛlbwaa wenaale
ɛɛ puu mɛ.
28N lɔ tebinichɔɡ ta
saŋ bɛlbwa,
maa wɛre bwa,
n iro dɛɛ che nɛra baah ta,
dɛɛ soŋe kɛ ba cha mɛ.
29N dɛ wi suna wii
kɛŋɔ kalampoŋa kɛɛ
taataa aa dɛ si la ken.
30N bwadabii sie biro dɛɛ sɔle,
n bwara bwa wɔrɔbɔ kɛŋɔ
kabul aa laɡ mɛ ken.
31N harame n janjela
dɛɛ lɔ wii yela, dɛ hoh
n kalipe dɛɛ taa wiile.”

Title: JOB 31
Content:
1Job berɔ ŋɔ, “N ŋwɛɛrɔ
kɛŋɔ maa bitoloo nyiŋi
n pɛla dɔɔ.
2Aa do ɡɛ nɔ, bɔkwaa
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔ la kpɔ tɛ nɛn
dɛ le nyundua ɔ? Bɔkwaa
Korowii le cheɡ tɛ nɛn ɔ?
3O ta kon waa chɔɡ
nyubinikpeɡ tena ɛɛ yaa?
O ta wenaale ɛɛ tɛ
nɛra baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa?
4Waa n we-ɛɛla jemaa?
Waa n naɡale bɛlbwa na
naa?
5Dɛ n teŋɛ wepuu ta, kɛɛ
dɛ teŋɛ nyosone waa ta naa,
6amɔ Korowii nyiŋi
n waa bini,
wɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa
bɛlbwa toole n nɛ,
7dɛ n bɛɡɔ le o ŋwɛnɛ la ta,
dɛ n siwi ɡelɔ n bambile
lawɛ wechɔɡa kɛɛ
dɛ n ɛ wechɔɡa
dɛ kah doŋa aa,
8amɔ Korowii ɡel nɛra
bane di kwaa maa para,
dɛ́ ɡel ba fuɡri
n koo kondikwa.
9Dɛ n pɛla dɔ haah,
kɛɛ dɛ n kaa pɛl n dɔŋ
bɛl doonyoa aa,
10amɔ Korowii ɡel n haah
ka ɛ kondikwaa dɛɛ tɛ
baa bɛl, ásɛ dɛ kaa chɔ
baala bane habɔɔ.
11A fe ɛ sihihwa,
dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ
bá bol a waa dɛ́ pa bole.
12Aa doo kɛŋɔ nii
dɛɛ chɔɡ kwa,
dɛ́ kaa n ne seo ta,
dɛ́ chɔɡ komɛlbwa
maa dɔa.
13Dɛ n ta kasinteŋ bolɛ
n bonɔɔna ne toli be,
ɡɛ saŋ waa aa lɔ
n ne ba baah ta naa,
14ɛrɛɛ mɛɛ ba wona
ka che Korowii sie nɔ?
Bɔkwa waa mɛɛ ba dɔe
dɛ́ bol o be
n we-ɛɛla waɔ?
15Korowii waa ta mɛ do n nya
tea bini laa ta ba ɡe aa?
O tenten laa ta ya bwa
do teene bini naa?
16Dɛ n vɛh nyaara pɛla
kwaa kpɔe dɛ tɛɛ ba,
kɛɛ dɛ ɡel luhaana
hwɛɡa ta pɛɛ,
17n ɡbosoo kpɔ n kondikwa,
n ta bilalbii ane tɛɛ,
18kɛ n bonɔɔne saŋ n nyiŋi
nyaara nɛɛ kɛŋɔ ba mɛɛ,
dɛ nyiŋi luhaahna nɛɛ
le n bechale saŋ,
19dɛ n na nomɛl waa dɛ ba
sewa yal bɛ dɔe wa,
kɛɛ nyaa waa wola
komɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ tɔ,
20o ta andɛɛɡa sweerɛ tɛ mɛ,
kɛ maa wola n peera pona
kpɔe sɔh yal tɛo,
21kɛɛ dɛ n aah bilalbie dɛ fiiɡu,
jema maa jema kɛŋɔ
mɛɛ di bole kɔɔto la
waa yaa,
22Kórowii ɡel n nɔɔra kuuɡi,
dɛ́ tor le n vam ta.
23N ɔmɛ waa Korowii
aa ɡel a ba n nɛ,
n ɔmɛ o kan waa doa,
n ta wone ɛ ɡɛ waa la.
24Dɛ n fe kpɔ n hwɛɡa dawɛ
suuɡaswɛm ta kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ
suuɡaswɛm tenten be
kɛŋɔ nɛn ŋɔ, ‘Henee n lɛɛ,’
25dɛ n fe dɛ hɛɡre
n kondɔɔh kohona wa,
kɛɛ kwaa maa dɔa,
26n na ɡɛ wee aa dɛ
lɔ dɛɛ chaah bɔr,
kɛɛ korobie kaala
ne o wer waa doa,
27a ta wone ɡel n liire
berɛ kɛ n sɔh dɛ́ toma,
n ta ɡuŋe dɛ kpɔ duure
tɛa aa,
28a ɡe fe ɛ wechɔɡa Korowii be
ó bol dɛ́ pa bole,
n fe ɛ nɛn n wa aa wola
kasinteŋ dɔe, Korowii waa
lɔ nyundua be.
29Dɛ n sie fe lɛ n dɔm
wahala waa dɛ na,
kɛɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ
o waa waa dɛ na ta,
30n ta waa bolɛ dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa,
dɛ taahno o sewɛ,
31dɛ n dem nɛra fe ta bolɛ ŋɔ,
‘Umee wola Job nɔn ta ola
dɔe chwe kohona kaɔ?’
32Kɛɛ hɔɔh bɛlbwa ta
fɔɡbaah chɔe jwaana,
dɛkalkɛ saŋ bɛlbwaa mɛɛ lɛ
hɔɔhra n dem,
33dɛ n tɔ n wechɔɡa ta
ɡɛ bane aa dɛ ɛ,
a do n bambile bini,
34kɛŋɔ maa bol waa
nɛra aa bol la wa,
asɛ n ɔmɛ mama n lolanar
aa mam mɛ waa kohona,
n tɔ nyoa n ta buse leɛ.
35Dɛ n fe dɔ nɛn waa no n wa,
n kpɔ n waa bil o sie,
Korowii Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔree dɛ́ chaŋ mɛ,
nɛn n ne waa dɔa la,
ó chwerɛ waa la.
36Mɛɛ kpɔa dawɛ n vam ta,
dɛ́ kpɔ pi kɛ kooɡbɛrɛ.
37Mɛɛ baɡle Korowii wobɛlbwa
maa ɛa n baŋa pa
ásɛ n ba o sie
maa wola ɔmɛ.
38Dɛ n harɛ la dɛ wi n tɛl
kɛŋɔ nɛn,
o pweeri ɛɛ wi siniire,
39dɛ n di harɛ la ta kondikwa
n ta a kem bɔe, dɛ ɡel
harɛ la tena bambile chɔɡ aa,
40ate Korowii ɡel mea a fe aa le
la, jabalnadaŋɛre le
chiɡ a naa ta,
ane ɡe soo siwi aa le la,
kpɔɡa le chiɡ a naa ta.”
Job nyoa wobol la chiɡo.

Title: JOB 32
Content:
Elihu wobol
1Gɛɛ a do Job daamanar batoro la ɡel o chaŋa, dɛkalkɛ dɛ o dɛ lii kɛ o waa toɡrɔ o ɡbaɡba be. 2Belaa Barakɛl bibaa Elihu, o nabaa sɔne Ram, ba bwa le Bus dea. Elihu baah di Job nɛɛ kɛ waa ŋɔa ŋɔ o waa toɡrɔ ɡwaa Korowii la. 3O baah di Job daamanar batoro la ɡe nɛ, kɛ baa wola wone ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ o waa ta maɡrɛ la. 4Elihu lawɛ bambile tama mɔɔ dɛ bol waa Job be, dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba ɡwaalo nomonome. 5Waa naa kɛŋɔ nɛra batoro la ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol Job be la, o baah diu.
6Ate, Barakɛl bibaa Elihu ŋɔ,
“Bechalaa men,
heyaa nomonome,
a waa mɛɛ ɔmɛ kɛ n pili nyoa
dɛ́ baɡle waa maa jema
he be.
7N liiro kɛŋɔ, ‘Nomonomee
chɛ kɛ ba bol wa,
ásɛ nɛra baa biɡra ɡe
ɛɛ baɡle nɛra wejema.’
8Kɛ Korowii kpɔ o Doma
dɛɛ do nɛn bini,
On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔree hweera
dɛɛ tɛo wejema.
9Nɛra baa hwɛɛhra
ɡbo laa dɔ wejema,
nɛra baa biɡra ɡe
ɡbo laa dɛɛ no waa mun.
10Anomanta, n ŋɔ,
he cheɡ deŋne no n be!
N ɡe ɛɛ baɡle heyaa
anɔ la maa jema.
11N tɔ nyoa he bol wa,
dɛ no waa haa baɡla,
dɛ he dɛ nyin waa dɛ bol,
12n cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ
dɛ no he be.
Kɛ he bini bɛlbwa ta wone
ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ
o waa ta maɡrɛ,
bɛlbwa ta wone chaŋe
waa waa bola.
13He bɛ ŋɔ, ‘Ya na wejema,
Korowiirii dɛ ŋɔ
o wa aa were,
nɛn te laa.’
14N laa Job bol waa yaɡɛ,
maa he nyoa wobol taa che
dɛ́ chaŋo.
15Job daamanar batoro la
bwara yɔrɔ,
ba ta waane dɔe dɛ́ bol,
baa jemɛ waa baa bol.
16Baa hela nɔ, n kpa tama aa?
Baa cheɡa baa wola
wobɛlbwa dɔe dɛ́ bol nɔ.
17N ɡee bol waa,
mɛɛ bol anɔ la maa jemaa.
18Wobol su n nyoa, maa won
ɡel a ka n tea bini.
19Waa su n bini kɛŋɔ loŋ
baa do sen o bini
dɛ tɔ o nyoa,
mɛɛ peroo kɛŋɔ loŋfale,
baa do senfala o bini
wɛɛ ba pera.
20A chɛ kɛ n bol wa
ásɛ n bwara sɔɔh mɛ,
a chɛ kɛ n pili nyoa
dɛ́ chaŋe.
21Maa bɛlbwa siebɔree
nyiŋi ɡwaa bɛl,
maa waa bol dɛɛ fɛrɛ,
22dɛ n bol waa dɛɛ fɛrɛ aa,
Korowii ɛɛ chɔɡ mɛɛ.”

Title: JOB 33
Content:
1Elihu berɔ ŋɔ, “Job,
taraken dɛɛ no n be,
cheɡ deŋne no
wobɛlbwa maa dɛ ba bola.
2N dɛ nyin n bol wa,
wobol lɔ n nyoa.
3Tepoŋ nee mɛɛ ba waa bola,
kasinteŋii mɛɛ ba bola.
4Korowii Doma taa o che ta
mɛ, On Waa Ɛ
Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔree hweera
do n bini n dɔ mkpa.
5Hɛɛ wonoo waa, chaŋ mɛ,
kpɔ he te dɛ́ ba n sie.
6N deno do kɛ hen
Korowii sie,
teeraa ba kpɔ ma n ɡe.
7A ta chɛ kɛ he ɔm mɛ,
kɛɛ mɛɛ fiiɡii.
8N no waa haa bola la
n deŋna bini, n no waa
hen Job aa bola ŋɔ,
9‘N waa toɡrɔ,
wechɔɡa bɛlbwa toole n nɛ,
n do kaih, wobɛlbwa toole
n nɛ.
10Kɛ Korowii na wechɔɡa n nɛ,
o kpɔ mɛ ɛ o dɔm.
11O do kpɛɛ n nakpale,
dɛɛ nyiŋi n vala bini bwa.’
12Job, he waa ta kasinteŋ dɔe
anɔ ta,
Korowii ɡwaa nɛwɛnyini.
13Ɛrɛɛ he bol he waa dɛɛ
baɡle Korowii waa wola
hen chaŋe nɔɔ?
14Korowii dɛ bol waa fini,
kere dɛ bol anfala,
kɛ nɛn aa liire a ta do.
15Deera ne wepila ta jwaana,
ɡɛ saŋ nɛn aa chɔ dom
kwaraa o kalaŋ ta la,
16a taa Korowii bol waa dɛɛ
do ba deŋna ta, dɛɛ kah ba
ɔmee kohona ɛɛ laɡ ba,
17dɛ́ berɛ ba liire le wechɔɡa
ɛɛ ta,
dɛ́ le ba ne mbarafo ta,
18dɛ́ lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa,
dɛ́ lɛɛ ba ba bɛ ban kpoo.
19Korowii dɛ́ tɛr nɛra deŋne
weela ne, ba hoɡa bini
bwa ɛɛ wee ba kohona,
20ásɛ kondikwa aa ba som do,
ba pɛla yon le
kondikondɛɛɡa ta.
21Ba ɡwaŋɛ, haa won jem ba
kpa, dɛ́ ka hoɡa ɡbo.
22A ka tama ba sewɛ
ba huɡ ba,
dɛ́ sewɛ kaa lalabwɛ.
23Kɛ dɛ nyundua torome
balɔ dɛ́ ba cha ba aa,
bɛl le kaɡboŋa bini ba
dɛ́ ba che tɛɛ ba,
dɛ́ baɡle waa aa wera
tɛ nɛwɛnyini,
24dɛ ba na ba sum,
dɛ́ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ,
‘Lɛɛ ba le seo nyoa
n dɔ kon dɛ́ kpɔ charɛ
ba nyu,’
25ásɛ nɛra ba fa aa ka hoɡa la,
bwadabii berɛ do wer
kɛŋɔ bechale ken,
dɛ́ do kɛŋɔ ba bonɔɔne saŋ.
26Gɛ nɛra la soŋe Korowii aa,
o dɛ na ba sum,
ba dɛ tomɛ Korowii
silɛɛ ne,
Korowii dɛ lɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ
ba waa toɡrɔ o be.
27Asɛ bɛlbwa ba che nɛra
baah ta dɛ ŋɔ,
‘N ɛ wechɔɡa, dɛ le
waa aa toɡra ta,
Korowii ta ɡelɛ n dɔ
deŋnetɛra aa chɛ mɛ.
28O lɛɛ mɛ le seo nyoa,
n ta so le dɛɛ na som nɔ.’
29Korowii ɛ ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa
dɛɛ tɛ nɛn kera anɛ,
hale kera atoro,
30dɛ́ lawɔ le seo ta, ó bɛ sewɛ,
dɛ́ so mkpa ta silɛɛ ne.
31Job, cheɡ deŋne,
ásɛ dɛ no n be,
hel, ásɛ n bol wa.
32Dɛ he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol aa,
he chaŋ mɛ, bol wa
n jemɛ kɛŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ.
33Kɛ dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, no n be,
hel, mɛɛ chaɡle wejemaa.”

Title: JOB 34
Content:
Elihu wobol nɛɛtena
1Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,
2“Nɛra haa ɛ wejerema,
hé no n waa nɔ,
hé no, nɛra haa jemɛ wa.
3Deŋnee dɛɛ no wa,
asɛ nyondoŋe ɛɛ daɡɛ
kondikwa.
4Hé ɡel ya kpɔ waa
aa toɡra dawɛ ya nɛ,
hé ɡel ya pɛ hweli
waa aa wera.
5Job te ŋɔ, ‘N ta bolchɔɡe dii,
kɛ Korowiirii vɔm mɛ
bole pae.
6A lole kɛ n waa toɡrɔ,
kɛ ba dɛ lii mɛ
nyosonteŋni, a lole kɛ
n ta bolchɔɡe dii,
Korowii do mɛ bol,
asɛ mɛɛ ba sewa.’
7Nɛn besoo Job, waa wola
duure kpɔe tɛ Korowii nɔɔ?
8O ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa pɛa,
o ne nyubinikpeɡ tena
ɛɛ valɛ.
9Kɛ Job te bolɔ ŋɔ,
‘Tɔnɔ bɛlbwa toole
dɛ tɛ nɛn kɛŋɔ
o ne Korowii pɛ.’
10Anomanta, hé no men
Elihu be, he nɛra
haa dɛ no waa mun.
Nomɛlbwa jemɔ kɛ
Korowii aa wechɔɡa ɛ,
On Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ
la aa won ɛ wechɔɡa.
11O dɛ bɔ nɛwɛnyini waa
waa ɛa kem, dɛɛ ba waa ne
o nɛɛ ɡɛ o we-ɛɛla aa doa.
12Kpelaa, haa lii kɛ Korowii
ɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡaa, On
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
aa bole pa aa ɡole.
13Umee kpɔ harɛ nɔ
do o nɔn ta nɔ?
Umee ŋɔa wɛɛ nyiŋi
harɛ nɔ bwa ta nɔ?
14Dɛ Korowii fe saahnɔ ŋɔ,
wɛɛ laa o hweeraa kpɔ
nɛn bini naa,
15nɛwɛnyina bwa fe ɛɛ
pɛo serewe, dɛ́ bwa berɛ
kaa teera bini.
16Job, he dɛ no waa mun aa,
no waa nɔ, cheɡ deŋne
no waa maa dɛ bol.
17Nɛn waa hah kasinteŋ la
ɛɛ won nyiŋi nɛra nɛ aa?
Hɛɛ won pwah
Korowii waa kana
o waa toɡre la aa?
18O laa dɛɛ bol koranar be ŋɔ,
‘He waa ɛ wesale,’
dɛɛ bol nomonjena ɡe be ŋɔ,
‘He nyu bini kpeɡri’ la aa?
19Waa koranar siebɔr nyiŋi,
waa suuɡa tena kpɔe
dɛɛ ɡwaa nyaara,
dɛkalkɛ, onee ta ba bwa.
20Gɛ nɛmbele banɛ la bwa
piɡro dɛɛ sewɛ harambaŋa,
Korowii lɔ ba dɛɛ bil
baa serewe, o dɛ le
nomonjena la ne sɛmɛlɛŋ
ken.
21O sie lɔ nɛra we-ɛɛla ta,
dɛɛ na ba naɡale bɛlbwa.
22Bɔr bira toole,
biro toole bobɛlbwa,
dɛ́ tɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛ
ba kpɔ ba te sɔh Korowii.
23A ta hiaih kɛ Korowii nyiŋi
nɛra waa bini la sie,
mɔɔ ba ba o be
o bol ba waa dɛ́ pa bole.
24Waa nomonjena waa bini
nyiŋi mɔɔ dɛɛ ir ba,
dɛ kpɔ bane
dɛɛ chiɡ ba naa ta.
25Waa dɛ nyiŋi
ba we-ɛɛla bini nomanta,
o dɛ le ba ne jwaana
dɛɛ lɛ ba nomonome ba be.
26O dɛ tɛr ba deŋne
ba wechɔɡa wa,
ásɛ nomɛlbwa na ba,
27dɛkalkɛ ba laa ba te kpɔ,
dɛ vɛh o nɛɛ teŋa,
baa sie aa o Mmarare
la ta do.
28Ba ɡelɔ nyaara wi
dɛɛ no Korowii, asɛ wɛɛ no
yera baa dɛ yerɔ
ŋɔ ó cha ba.
29Kɛ dɛ Korowii helɔ aa,
umee dɛ won pwaoh wɔ?
O kpɔ sie sɔh aa,
umee dɛ nao wɔ?
Kɛ o dɛ nyiŋi nɛmbeŋkpoŋ
ne nɛra baa lɔ
harɛ nɔ ta bwa kɛrɛdɛ,
30Korowii ta ɡelɛ nɛn waa
wola on tomɛ ɛɛ di kora,
dɛ́ haɡre nɛra la bela.
31Dɛ nɛn ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ,
‘N ɛ wechɔɡa,
maa ɡɛɛ ɛ kpa.
32Chaɡ mɛ waa maa wola
an nae, dɛ n ɛ
wechɔɡa aa, maa an ɛ kpa.’
33Job, a chɛ kɛ Korowii
tɛɛ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin kembɔr,
haa vɛh he liire chara
nɔ naa?
Henee chɛ kɛŋɔ he lii, n laa,
bol anɔ la haa jema
baɡ mɛ.
34Nɛra baa dɛ no
waa mun dɛ sɛh ɡɛ,
wejerema baa dɛ no
n be la dɛ ŋɔ,
35‘Job dɛ bol waa aa,
wejema toole a ta,
o wobol ta mun dɔe.’
36Dɛ he nyiŋi Job
waa bini ka tonaa,
hɛɛ nao kɛ o dɛ bol
waa kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ.
37O kpɔ deŋnekpeɡ dɛɛ ja
wechɔɡa ta,
ya bini kwaraa la,
o mamɔ dɛɛ lɔ kpaŋa,
dɛ teŋɛ bol waa kohona
dɛɛ yaɡɛ Korowii.”

Title: JOB 35
Content:
Elihu wobol toorotena
1Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,
2“Job, he dɛ lii kɛŋɔ
waa nɔ toɡraa?
He ŋɔ, ‘N Naa Korowii, ɛrɛɛ
n bolchɔɡe dii ɛɛ ba wona
ɛɛ nɔ?’
3Kɛ he berɔ ŋɔ Korowii be ŋɔ,
‘Tɔnɔ besoo aa ba dɔe
tɛ mɛ, bɔkwaa mɛɛ ba
dɔe wechɔɡa maa wola
ɛ ta nɔ?’
4N dɛ nyin kɛ n chaŋe,
he ne he daamanar
baa ja he nɛ.
5Hé nyiŋi nyundua na,
hé ha sie nyiŋi jeiih
ɡɛ baama aa kaa nyundua.
6Dɛ he ɛ wechɔɡa aa,
a dɛ ɛ Korowii waane aa?
He wechɔɡa wara aa,
bɔkwaa aa ɛo wɔ?
7Dɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa,
bɔkwaa aa tɛo wɔ?
Korowii aa komɛlbwa
lɛ he be.
8He wechɔɡa ɡelɔ
nɛra bane ɛɛ na wa,
he waa toɡraa,
nɛra banee a dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ.
9Ba dɛ fiiɡi nɛra kohona
a ɡwaa ba nɛɛ aa,
ba dɛ pɛmɛ,
ba dɛ wi dɛɛ soŋe nɛn
ó lɛɛ ba
le kpeɡnɛn la nɔn ta.
10Kɛ bɛlbwa aa bol ŋɔ,
‘Leperaa Korowii waa ta
mɛ la dɔɔ?
Onee dɛɛ larawe nɛn bwara
o wenaale ta jwaana.
11Onee dɛɛ baɡle yaa waa dɛ
ɡwaa ɡɛ waa
dɛ baɡle kpɔɡ bini ola,
dɛ ɡel ya dɔ wejema
ɡwaa jumbii.’
12Ba dɛ wi aa,
Korowii aa ban chaŋe,
mbarafo wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa
dɛ ɛ nomanta.
13Kasinteŋ, Korowii
aa soŋa baa dɛ soŋo
ba wesale ta no, On
Waa Ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ la
aa deŋne
cheɡɛɛ dɛɛ no ba be.
14Job, dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa,
ɛrɛɛ Korowii ɛɛ ba
he be noe,
a ba ɛ kɛŋɔ haa ŋɔa ŋɔ
haa on na nɔɔ?
He waa chɔ o sie,
a chɛ kɛ he lawɛ bambile
dɛɛ kpao.
15Anɔ la aa jaa, he ŋɔ waa nɛra
deŋne tɛr o bandia ne,
waa sie do kohona
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra be.
16Job, he dɛ bol waa pɛɛpɛɛ,
haa wola wejema dɔe
nomanta, he wobol warɔ.”

Title: JOB 36
Content:
Elihu wobol naarɛtena
1Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,
2“Job, lawɛ bambile tɛ
mɛ tama, n ta dɔ waa
dɛ́ che
Korowii naa ta dɛ́ bol.
3Mɛɛ baɡle kɛ n dɔ wejema
kohona,
dɛ́ baɡle kɛ Korowii
waa ta mɛ la waa wer.
4Nɛn waa dɔ wejema
kohonaa cheɡɛ he sie la,
jemɛ kɛrɛdɛ
kɛŋɔ maa nyosone teŋe.
5Na ɡɛ Korowii
aa kana kohona,
waa nomɛlbwa vɛh,
o kan dɛ jemɛ wobɛlbwa
bini.
6O ta ɡelɛ nyubinikpeɡ tena
so dɛɛ biɡri,
o bol nyaara waa
dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.
7Waa sie laa dɛɛ kpɔ nɛra
ba wa aa toɡra nɛ,
o ɡelɔ baa do kɛ koranar,
dɛɛ dɔ duure saŋ bɛlbwa.
8Dɛ ba lawɛ nɛra do dea,
dɛ do ba jɔɡrɔre
baa na waa baa ɛa aa,
9Korowii dɛ́ baɡle
ba bá wechɔɡa
ne ba mbarafo we-ɛɛla.
10Korowii dɛ kah ba
bá sɛh ba chɔɡre,
dɛ́ do ba bá charɛ liire
le ba wechɔɡa ta.
11Dɛ ba no Korowii
baa dɛ tomɔ wa aa,
ba sie ɛɛ lɛ tɔpera
aa ka ba sie taa,
ásɛ dɛ so bosɔɔhna ta.
12Kɛ dɛ baa no aa,
baa kpoo ba keri nee,
dɛ ba ta wejema dɔe.
13Nɛra baa wola Korowii tomɛ la
dɔ bandia ba bini,
dɛ Korowii tɛr ba deŋne
kwaraa naa,
baa on soŋe ŋɔ ó cha ba.
14Ba dɛ serewe ba bonɔɔne saŋ,
ba we-ɛɛla ɡelɔ
baa dɔ sihihseo seo.
15Kɛ banɔ la baa lɔ wenaale
ta la,
Korowii lɛɛ ba dɛɛ le,
o cheɡɛ ba wenaale ta,
dɛ bol waa dɛɛ baɡ ba.
16Korowii siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ó lawɛ
dɛɛ le he wenaale ta,
dɛ́ tɛɛ bosɔɔhna, dɛ́ ɡel
he dɔ kondikondɛɛɡa
kohona dɛɛ di.
17Kɛ taraken he dɔ deŋnetɛra
ɡɛ aa chɛa kɛ ba kpɔ tɛɛ.
18Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ nomɛlbwa
bɛ kondɔɔh kpɔ neɡre,
bɛ ɡel sen yawa ɡole he wa.
19He kondɔɔh kɛɛ he
kpeɡri haa dɔa bwa,
aa won chae.
20Bɛ too ŋɔ seo ba kpɔe warane,
ɡɛ saŋ harɛ nɔ nɛra bwa
aa serewe.
21Nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ bɛ he te
kpɔ jo wechɔɡa ta,
a waa Korowii kpɔ
wahala ba ta he nɛ.
22Korowii kpeɡri kan
dɛ ɡwaa wobɛlbwa.
Umee dɛ won baɡle waa kɛ
Korowii ɔ?
23Umee dɛ won baɡle
Korowii wa, kɛɛ dɛ ŋɔ
o ɛ wechɔɡa ɔ?
24Lii dɛ kpɛɛro kohona
o we-ɛɛla wa, ɡɛ nɛra
aa ɡo yela kpɛɛro a waa la.
25Nɛwɛnyina bwa na waa waa ɛa,
nɛra che bojaŋ
dɛ nyiŋa jeiih ken.
26Na ɡɛ Korowii aa kana!
O kan waa doa
ɡwaa nɛn liire ta,
nomɛlbwa aa saŋ waa lea
do le, ba le fini jemɛ.
27Onee tɛr nee le harɛ
kaa nyundua,
dɛ ɡel a berɛ bwaala,
dɛ palɛ
dɛɛ jo nenabɔɔne ta.
28Bwaala le baama ta,
dɛɛ nɛ kohona nɛwɛnyina
bwa nɛ.
29Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ ɡɛ
Korowii aa kpɔ
baama bɔle nyundua,
o wobol le bwaala
kɔra bini
bela waa lole nɔ?
30Na ɡɛ waa ɡela bwaala
ɛɛ nyɛɡle nyundua bwa,
asɛ dɛ ɡel mpo vile
bwa te bir.
31Ken taa o che dɛɛ nyiŋi
harɛre nɛra bwa nɛ,
dɛɛ tɛɛ ba kondikwaa
kohona.
32Bwaala kɔra kpeɡri
lɔ o nɔn ta,
dɛ́ won ɡel o ka chiɡ
bela bwa waa dɛ nyin.
33Bwaala kɔra dɛ tɔ sie
ásɛ dompeu teŋɛ,
ásɛ nae bwa jemɛ
o bala wa.”

Title: JOB 37
Content:
Elihu wobol nuetena
1Elihu berɔ ŋɔ,
“N bambile dɛ lɔ
bwaala kɔra la wa,
o dɛ lɔ warawara ken.
2Hé bwa no Korowii taa
waa do kɛ bwaala
aa dɛ kɔr,
kɔɡra aa dɛ le o nyoa.
3O ɡelɔ bwaala ɛɛ nyɛɡle
nyundua bobɛlbwa,
o nyɛɡla dɛ tel harɛ
jaɡa bwa.
4A habɔɔ, ba no o nyɛɡa waa
do kɛ bwaala aa nyɛɡla la,
o nyɛɡa la kan
kɛ bwaala aa kɔra.
O baa nyɛɡ kohona naa,
dɛ komɛlbwa chɔ baŋ.
5Korowii bol wa aa,
ba dɛ na o nyokpowa,
a ɛ wejena nɛn aa wola
a mun no.
6O ŋɔ dombwea lee harɛ ta,
dɛ ŋɔ bwaalajena
nɛ harɛ ta.
7O ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa toma ba a
jaɡa, asɛ nɛwɛnyina
waa ta ba bwa jemɛ
o toma wa.
8Kpɔɡ bini ola kaalɔ,
ka chɔ a bɔɔne bini.
9Peujen tao le weekaŋle
harɛbɔr,
asɛ waa kohona le
weekaŋle nyunduabɔr.
10Korowii hweero
asɛ neerare sɔɔh,
a sɔɔhnɔ kohona dɛ hel.
11Korowii kpɔ nee
do baama bini,
dɛ ɡel bwaala nyɛɡle
do a bini bwa.
12Bela waa dɛ nyinii
o ɡel baama
baa kaa harɛ nɔ ta bwa,
dɛɛ ɛ ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin.
13O won baama kpɔe
ba tɛr nɛra deŋne,
kɛɛ dɛ́ ba sɔɔh harɛ,
dɛ́ baɡle o nyina.
14Job, dɛɛ no waa nɔ,
tɔ nyoa dɛ nyiŋi Korowii
nyokpowaa waa ɛ.
15He jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa
Korowii ɡel bwaala nyɛɡle
dɛɛ le baama bini naa?
16He jemɛ ɡɛ aa ɛa baama
saɡɛ nyundua,
ne ɡɛ Korowii
nyokpowe-ɛɛla aa doa aa?
17Bɔwɔb dɛ kpoe he yal bini,
ɡɛ saŋ peuchɔɡe waa le
weekaŋle harɛbɔr, aa ba
ta harɛ la ta dɛ́ chɔɡo la.
18Hɛɛ won ja Korowii nɛɛ
dɛ́ paɡri nyundua,
waa do kpeɡri kɛ ayaawa
aa dɛ nyɛɡle kɛ diɡi aa?
19Baɡle yaa waa yaa bol
Korowii be dɛ́ chaŋo,
ya liire damɔ nomanta,
ya ta wobɛlbwa dɔe.
20Nomɛl ɛɛ won ka bol
o be ŋɔ
n dɛ nyin ń bol wa aa?
A chɛ kɛ n tɛo ŋwɛnɛ
ó chɔɡ mɛ naa?
21Peu tao dɛ laa baama
kpɔ nyundua aa,
wee dɛ chaah kohona,
nomɛlbwa aa won nyiŋi
nyundua.
22Korowii jirima le weekaŋle
nyunduabɔr dɛɛ ba
kɛ suuɡaswɛm,
ya na o jirima waa kana la
dɛɛ ɔmɛ.
23Korowii Waa ɛ Kpeɡri Bwa
Dɔɔ kan,
yaa won bɛno,
o waa toɡrɔ dɛ do wer,
waa nɛn fiiɡi.
24Nɛra dɛ duuru a wa,
nɛra baa dɛ lii
kɛ ba jemɛ wa,
kɛ dɛ ɡɛn la,
waa ban nyin.”

Title: JOB 38
Content:
Korowii chaŋe Job
1Korowii chaŋe Job le peujen la bini ŋɔ,
2“Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle n waa
wobol aa wola mun dɔe ne
nɔɔ?
3Ir dɛ́ ba che n sie,
ń bɔɔre wa,
ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.
4Maa ta harɛ dɛ ɡel
o ba che o chebɔr,
dɛ leperaa he doɔ?
He jemaa, he baɡ mɛ.
5Umee maɡɛ o paɡri
ne o jaŋne ɔ?
Umee tɛr ŋwɛn dɛ maɡɔ wɔ?
He jemaa?
6Bɔkwa kwaa taa
harɛ chɔŋɛ a lawɔ kpoŋe,
kɛɛ umee pa o mun ɔ?
7Awola chɔmbibii la
weweela ɡo yela
kɛŋɔ nɛra ken,
nyundua toroma ɡe
sie lɛ dɛɛ dooɡe lɔŋɔre.
8Men Korowiirii ɡela
mpo nyoa boa
chɔ bobeŋkpoŋ,
ɡɛ saŋ maa ɡela nee le
o vile ta, kɛ baa lolɛ bie,
9dɛ kpɔ baama tɔ o ta,
dɛ kpɔ biro tenten fɔrɔwo,
10dɛ pe bela waa baa jaɡɛ,
dɛ kpɔ kwaa tɔ o nyoa
kɛŋɔ ɡbera,
11dɛ ŋɔ, ‘Bonɔɔ hɛɛ ba
wona ba jaɡɛ, haa ɡarɛ!
He nehɛma aa kpeɡa la
nyoa ɡe jaɡɛ bonɔ.’
12Job, le saŋ baa lolɛ,
he wono ɡel jwaana
berɛ webaŋa aa?
13He wono ɡel bɔr chaah
harɛ bwa ta,
asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra na
dɛ chwa
le ba sɔɔhbɔra kaa la aa?
14Bɔr chaahnaa, a ɡelɔ
baa na deŋɡarere
ne nenabɔjena,
a do kɛŋɔ baa kpɛrɛwe yal,
kɛɛ baa di ɡwine
vii ta ken.
15Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa
bɔchaah ta nyin,
aa ɡelɛ ba dɔ bɔr
dɛɛ di ba dichɔɡa.
16Job, he wono valɛ mpo
vile bini ka aa?
He wono valɛ mpo
bɔluŋ tenten bini naa?
17Nomɛl baɡle bela baa kpɔa
dɛɛ jo lalabwɛɛ
waa ɛ biro la ta kaa?
18He jemɛ ɡɛ harɛ nɔ
aa kana aa?
He jemɛ anɔ bwa naa,
he chaŋ mɛ.
19He jemɛ bela bɔr chaahna
aa lea ba naa?
Leperaa biro doɔ?
20Hɛɛ won kpɔa kaa
bela aa lea aa?
He wono jemɛ bela
a fa aa lole naa?
21He jemɔ, dɛkalkɛ baa lolɛ
biɡro! Gɛ saŋ maa
ta harɛ nɔ la
dɛ he lole.
22He jemɛ bela maa ɡela mɛn
ne dombwea do aa?
23N lea cheɡ tɛ wenaale
ne laa yoi tɔpera.
24Hɛɛ won jemɛ bela
bɔr chaahna aa lea dɛɛ ba,
kɛɛ bela wee leebɔr peu
aa taa le dɛɛ kaa la aa?
25Umee baɡle bwaala luɡri
o che a ta dɛɛ ba,
ne bwaala kɔra ŋwɛnɛre ɔ?
26Umee ɡela bwaala ɛɛ nɛ
pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ ta,
harɛ nomɛlbwa aa wola
o ta soɡe,
27dɛ ɡel o do wer,
kpɔɡa won le o ta nɔ?
28Bwaala do kɛ nɛn
dɛ dɔ mɛɛ aa?
Nomɛlee lolɛ mɛn
aa dɛ le ɡe aa?
29Umee lolɛ dombwea ɔ?
Umee lolɛ mɛn aa le
nyundua ɡeɔ?
30Gɛ kwaa nɔ yon sɔɔh dɛ hel,
dɛ tɔ neerare ne mpo sie.
31Hɛɛ won ta weweela
aa wera bwa soo siwi pɛ,
kɛɛ dɛ pere ane bini,
bɛlbwa ka che
a che bɔr aa?
32Hɛɛ won baɡle saŋ
weweela bɛlbwa aa le,
kɛɛ dɛ ɡel Baŋɡaahna le
dɛ tɔ o bii nɛ aa?
33He jemɛ Mmarare
aa dɛ baɡle weweela
aa lɔ nyundua
dɛɛ chaah wa aa?
Hɛɛ won jemɛ ɡɛ tenten tɛ
kwaa aa lɔ harɛ ta ɡe aa?
34Hɛɛ won do baama
ŋɔ á kpɔ nee ba bɔle he nɛɛ
kɛŋɔ nee yon su la aa?
35Hɛɛ won do bwaala ó nyɛɡle
dɛ ba ŋɔ, ‘Ya dɔɔree
hen naa?’
36Umee kpɔ wejema
do nɛn liire bini,
kɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ no waa mun ɔ?
37Umee dɔ wejema kohona
dɛ́ won kure baama ɔ?
Umee ɡela aa nɛ bwaala ɔ?
38Umee ɡela bwaala yon
nɛ kohona,
ásɛ harɛ bwa lamɛ nɔɔ?
39Hɛɛ won tɛ nyujentena
kondikwa, ásɛ a bii
lɔr aa dɛ kpoa won vaɡɛ,
40ɡɛ saŋ aa sɔh a bɔɔne bini,
kɛɛ dɛ chɔ dɛɛ kpa,
dɛɛ nyin ola
dɛ́ lawɛ di la aa?
41Umee tɛ ɡaahɡaah bii
kondikwa aa di
dɛ a wio dɛɛ no Korowii,
dɛ ɡaaɡe dɛɛ nyin
kondikwa dɛ diɔ?”

Title: JOB 39
Content:
1Korowii berɔ ŋɔ,
“He jemɛ saŋ
bwea dor boohna aa
dɛ lolɛ a bii aa?
He siwi nao kweɡla
lolɛ o bie ka aa?
2Hɛɛ won kure korobie
aa kpoŋe a teene aa?
Hɛɛ won jemɛ
saŋ aa dɛ loɡle aa?
3He jemɛ saŋ loltea
aa lɔa aa loɡle a bii aa?
4Kpɔɡ binii a bii yon do
dɛ́ kpeɡ,
a bwara do kpeɡri dɛ kaa,
aa berɛ ba a be kpa.
5Keeɡo waa kpaŋa la,
umee ɡela o dɔ o te nɔ?
Umee pur ŋwɛɛra
baa kpɔa vɔrɔwo wɔ?
6Pua hɛŋle ɡbo harɛ
taa n kpɔ tɛo o so,
bela kpɔɡa aa wola
won kpeɡ.
7Waa ɡbɔɡa aa dɛ le
bwɛjena ta nyin,
nomɛlbwa aa won dɛɛro
dɛ́ kpɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ toma.
8Bwea doree o do dɛɛ ɡaaɡe,
dɛɛ nyin kpɔɡlwɛɛ bɛlbwa
waa lea dɛ́ chwe.
9Kpɔɡ bini nao
ɛɛ sɛoh ɛ toma tɛɛ naa?
Wɛɛ sɛoh chɔ he kondɛɛra
kondikondibɔr jwaana aa?
10Hɛɛ won lawɛ o par ŋwɛn
kpoŋe ó ɛ toma aa?
Wɛɛ won parɛ he harɛ tɛɛ naa?
11O bokpeɡa kohona nomanta,
hɛɛ kpɔ he tenee dawɛ
o nɛ aa?
Hɛɛ ɡel he tomkpeɡaa ta
o nɛ aa?
12He dɛ yarada kɛ o kpɔ he
mea ba, dɛ ba boa
a nyoa a lɔ bɔr aa?
13Taataa dɛ lɔ a kena silɛɛ ne,
kɛ a ta do kɛŋɔ
chaŋɡal kwa,
14harɛɛ taataa yon hwe
hala bil,
dɛ́ ɡela a chɔ bomboɡ ta
wɔrɔbe.
15Waa jemɛ kɛŋɔ a ken
ɛɛ won paɡre,
kɛɛ kpɔɡ bini ol bɛl
ɛɛ won ba tiɡri a ta.
16O nyu bini kpeɡri o bii nɛ,
á do kɛ o bii laa ken,
o waane laa kɛŋɔ o koeh
waa koah la ɛ pɛɛ.
17Men Korowii ta ɡelɛ
o jemɛ wa, kɛɛ dɛ tɛo
waa mun noe bɛlbwa.
18Kɛ dɛ o paɡri kena
dɛɛ ba chwae yaa,
o dɛ mamɛ jaaɡɔ waa won
chwae kohona ne nɛn
waa soɡe o ta.
19Job, henee ɡela jaaɡɔ
bwara do kpeɡri
dɛ tɛo pona a bɔle
o baŋa ta naa?
20He ɡelɔ o won jaeh
kɛŋɔ hɔɔhre dɛɛ aah nɛra
hweera kohona ne naa?
21O nafikoko kwii harɛ dɛɛ ta,
bokpeɡa nee wɛɛ chwa
silɛɛ ne kaa jo laa ta.
22Waa ɔmee kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ
wobɛlbwa, waa tokobii na
dɛ́ le habɔɔ.
23Dɔmkwaa nɛn waa soɡe
o ta aa kpoŋa la dɛ si,
dɛɛ nyɛɡle pelɔpelɔ ken.
24Jaaɡɔ la kpɔ sibeɡra chwa
dɛɛ kaa,
o no bɛla sii yaa,
waa won bobeŋkpoŋ che.
25Ba hoh bɛla aa, dɛ o sio.
O won laa ɡbɔɡa noe dɛ le
bojaŋ, laa nomonome
nyɛɡa baa dɛ nyɛɡ
ne lɔŋɔre baa dɛ do laa ta.
26Henee baɡle kɔla wɛɛ ir,
dɛ́ paɡri kena kaa
weekaŋle harɛbɔr aa?
27He bee kee ɛɛ hweli
o kɔr sɔeh nyundua aa?
28Bwejaŋa baahnee wɛɛ so
jwaana, belaa o so
o bwara ɛɛ sɔɔhno.
29Nyundua belaa o do,
dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ lawɛ,
o siwi dɛ naa dɛ le bojaŋ.
30Ol lwɛɛ chalee ɛ o bii
kondikwa,
bela nɛra aa serewa chɔ
laanee baa nao.”

Title: JOB 40
Content:
1Korowii berɔ ŋɔ Job be ŋɔ,
2“Umee hen hɛɛ tɔŋle
Men Kpeɡri Bwa Dɔɔ rɔ?
Dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, amɔ te
chaŋ mɛ.”
3Anee Job chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ,
4“N Naa Korowii, menee ume,
ń ŋɔ mɛɛ chaŋee yɔ?
Maa wobɛlbwaa bol.
5N bol waa kpee he ta men
chaŋɛ, dɛ bol nɛɛ,
kɛ taraken
maa waa bol kpa.”
6Belaa Korowii bol waa Job be dɛ le peujen la bini ŋɔ,
7“Ir dɛ́ ba che n sie,
ásɛ n bɔɔree wa,
he chaŋ mɛ.
8Hɛɛ ŋɔɔ he waa wer,
dɛ́ chɔɡ mɛ ŋɔ
n te waa aa were kɛɛ?
9He kpeɡri tel men
Korowii aa?
He nyɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ won do kan
kɛŋɔ n nyɛɡa,
kɛŋɔ bwaala aa kɔra aa?
10Job, dɛ ɡɛɛ yaa, baɡle he
nyanyini ne he kan
haa doa, baɡle kɛŋɔ
he kan nɛra ɛɛ duuri.
11Nyiŋi nɛra baa dɛ ɛ mbarafo,
ɡel he baah di ba nɛ,
ásɛ ba nyoa sɔɔh,
12nyiŋi, dɛ́ ba mbarafo te
bɛlbwa ne harɛ,
chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
bobɛlbwa baa lole.
13Huɡe ba bwa pɛ,
kwaa ba sie sɔh lalbɔɔ bini.
14Ate, n fe ɛɛ tɔ sie kpɔ
jaamee tɛɛ, dɛ́ sɛh
kɛ he kpeɡri ɛɛ won lɛɛ.
15Nyiŋi kaka maa ta he ne
on la na,
wɛɛ chwe kpɔɡaa kɛŋɔ nao
aa dɛ chwe la aa?
16O bwara kpeɡri taeh,
o dɛɛhne ɡel o dɔ bokpeɡa!
17O din pao kɛŋɔ peleme
daa ken,
o nakpadɛɛhne do kpeɡri.
18O hoɡa kpeɡri kɛŋɔ ayaawa,
o nakpale do kɛŋɔ bune ken.
19Korowii kontaala bwa bini,
onee tɔ sie.
Korowii waa tao
la ɡboo dɛ́ won bɛno.
20Kpɔɡa le deŋɡarere ta
o dɔa dɛɛ chwe,
asɛ kpɔɡ bini olchɔɡa bwa
ɛɛ hɛlɛ o jwɛh.
21O chɔ sɔɔhne bini, o sɔh
kataŋa bini kpɔɡa tɔ o nɛ.
22Sɔɔhne la tɔ o nɛ,
asɛ daa aa cheɡɛ
nee nyoa baro cheme.
23Hale Jɔɔdan Moo suu ba tɔ
o nɛɛ kwaraa naa,
waa ɔmɛ.
24Umee dɛ́ won bɛɛlo
dɛ́ dɔɔ lawɔ ɔ?
Umee dɛ won lawɔ bel ne
dɛ́ do ŋwɛn o mee ta nɔ?”

Title: JOB 41
Content:
1Korowii berɔ bɔɔ Job ŋɔ,
“Hɛɛ won ta ɡoŋa
lawɛ lɛŋɔ, kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ
ŋwɛn vɔwɛ o nyoa aa?
2Hɛɛ won kpɔ ŋwɛn do
o mebɔɔ bini,
kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ ɡoŋa lawɛ
o nyoa aa?
3Wɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ soŋe
wobopwɛra ne ŋɔ
hé na o sum aa?
4Wɛɛ sɛoh he ne o fɔwɛ fɔo,
ásɛ dɛɛ tomɛ
saŋ bɛlbwa naa?
5Hɛɛ won dɛɛro kɛŋɔ jumbie,
kɛɛ dɛ́ do ŋwɛn o nakpala,
he toli ɛɛ hɛlɛ o ne naa?
6Bonadiire ɛɛ ba chemoo,
dɛɛ nyin ba yawɔ,
kɛɛ dɛ́ bɔne o bini naa?
7Hɛɛ won yaɡɛ o bɔtɔn,
kɛɛ o nyu tim ne naa?
8He te kpɔ nɔn dawɛ o nɛɛ
dɛ́ na,
hɛɛ nao ɡɛ waa vuuɡi,
haa won leɡo nɛɛtena kpa.
9Nomɛlbwa toole
dɛ́ won sɔɔh o nyoa,
he siwi ne o nɛɛ dawa,
dɛ he bwara yɔrɔ.
10O ɡɔɔ o te naa, dɛ́ o ɔma.
Nomɛlbwa toole
dɛ́ won ba che o sie.
11Nomɛlbwa aa won ŋɔ
men Korowii di o kem,
komɛlbwa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta
ɛ n kwa.
12Gel n baɡle ɡɛ lɛŋɔ nakpale,
ne o kan ne o bokpeɡa
aa doa.
13Umee dɛ́ won wur o bɔtɔn,
kɛɛ dɛ́ kpɔ kabaɡrare
ba che o sie nɔ?
14Umee dɛ́ won hah o nyoa,
nyena aa do ɔma
dɛ bar cheme nɔɔ?
15O nyaŋ pɛɡa kpeɡri
dɛ tɔ o nɛ,
dɛ marɛ dɔŋa kiŋkiŋ ken.
16Bɛlbwa marɛ dɔŋa,
peu ɡba aa won jo a baah.
17A deno marɛ dɔŋa kɛrɛdɛ ken,
komɛlbwa aa wola won
pere a baah.
18O sio waa, a do kɛ nii
aa dɛ le o mee ne o nyoa,
o sibie swɛɛ kɛŋɔ
chɔɔlen wee aa dɛ le ken.
19Ninlao dɛ le o nyoa,
nihɛma ɡe ɛɛ chuɡri kohona.
20Chuu dɛ le o mebɔɔne bini,
kɛŋɔ vii aa chɔŋɛ kpɔɡa
nii ta ken.
21O hweeraa, hɔla dɛ lawɛ nii,
ninlao chuɡri
dɛɛ le o nyoa.
22O kpeɡri lɔ o baŋa ta,
a ɡelɔ nomɛlbwa
waa chemo la, dɛ o dɛ ɔmɛ.
23O bwara bobɛlbwa
kpeɡri kɛŋɔ buni,
dɛ che kiŋkiŋ nomɛlbwa
aa wola won taɡɔ.
24O bambile kpeɡri
kɛ bwe ken, o kpeɡri
ɡwaa nambwe kwara.
25O ɡɔɔ o te naa,
ɔmee dɛ́ chole
kpeɡnɛra nɛ,
bá chwa le o sie dɛɛ kaa.
26Tokobii aa won ɛo waane,
hale lampea kɛɛ hɛm
wa bini bɛlbwa.
27Buni do kɛŋɔ haahra
o siwi ta,
ayaawa ɡe do kɛŋɔ
daa waa pɔah ken.
28Waa hɛma nae dɛɛ chwa,
vamtor bwea do kɛŋɔ
haahra o be,
aa on wobɛlbwa ɛ.
29Guli kpɔe dɛ lɔɔ do kɛŋɔ
kpɔɡ o be,
lampeare tae dɛ yaɡɔ
ɛ wesoma tɛo.
30O tea pɛɡa do kɛŋɔ kaŋle,
o dɛ tuuɡi kpechɛɡre ta
kɛŋɔ baa tuuɡi daa ken.
31O jo mpo vile ta naa,
a dɛ wure kɛŋɔ newɔb,
dɛ ɡel mpo ɛɛ wure kɛŋɔ,
baa kpɔ sooma noo
chɔŋɛ nii ta la.
32O pere nee dɛɛ kaa laa,
nehɛma dɛ to teŋɛ o nɛɛ
kɛŋɔ nyumpompoŋa ken.
33Haa won kpɔ komɛlbwa
maɡɔ harɛ nɔ ta,
o ɛ hweera kon
waa wola ɔmɛ.
34O na oljen bɛlbwa naa,
o jeɡa tɛo o siwi ta,
o dɛ di kora kpɔɡ bini
oljena bwa nɛ.”

Title: JOB 42
Content:
Job chaŋe Korowii
1Anee Job chaŋe Korowii ŋɔ, 2“N Naa Korowii,
n jemɔ kɛŋɔ henee dɔ
kpeɡri kohona.
Nomɛlbwa aa won tɔe
ŋwɛnɛ wobɛlbwa ta.
3He bɔɔ mɛ ŋɔ, ‘Umee hen hɛɛ
tɔŋle n waa wobol
aa wola mun dɔe ne nɔɔ?’
Kasinteŋ, n bol waa
maa wola a mun no,
waa aa ɛ nyokpoa kohona,
maa wola a mun jemɛ.
4He ŋɔ, ‘Cheɡ deŋne
ń bol waa he be,
mɛɛ bɔɔre waa
ásɛ he chaŋ mɛ.’
5Noe n no nɛra ɛɛ bol he wa,
kɛ taraken, n ɡbabir kpɔ
siwi nae.
6Anomanta, sihiih kpo mɛ
n charɛ n liire dɛ so
bomboɡ ne tɔɔ ta,
á baɡle kɛŋɔ
n bambile chɔɡɔ.”
Waa la jaɡa
7Korowii aa bol ɡɛ waa nɔ baɡle Job tonɛ la, o ŋɔ Elifas, Teman te la be ŋɔ, “N baah di he ne he daamanar banɛ la nɛ, dɛkalkɛ he ta n bwara wedɛɛɡe bolɛ kɛ n bonɔɔ Job. 8Anomanta, lawɛ nabala anuanɛ ne pebala anuanɛ ka tɛ n bonɔɔ Job ó kpɔ ɛ saraha baa dɛ fuah tɛ heya. Wɛɛ soŋoo tɛ heya, ásɛ n no dɛ bɛ he deŋne tɛr he ɡɛna waa kpa. He ta n waa kasinteŋ bolɛ kɛ n bonɔɔ Job.” 9Asɛ Elifas ne Bildad, dɛ Sofar ɛ ɡɛ Korowii aa ŋɔ ba be la, asɛ Korowii no Job wesoŋa la.
10Ate, Job aa soŋa tɛ o daamanar batoro la tonɛ la, Korowii ɡelɔ o ɛ kondɔɔh ja. O dɔ anɔ la o fa aa dɔa la bele anɛ ja. 11O dɔɔranar ne nimanar ne nimambii, dɛ nɛra ba fa aa jemɔ bwa ba o dem, ba ne o di kwaa dɛ lɛ ba sie. Ba bwɛɛlo dɛ larawe o bwara wenaale Korowii aa ɡela o na la wa, asɛ bɛlbwa tɛo suuɡa ne suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ.
12Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛo dɛ ɡwaa loɡla la. O berɔ dɔ peera kaɡboŋa fi dɛ anaarɛ, nyoɡmare kaɡboŋa anumɛl, nae baa kpɔa dɛɛ parɛ kaɡboŋ, dɛ keeɡore kaɡboŋ. 13O bibaala lɔ banuanɛ dɛ bihaahna batoro. 14Bihaah waa tɔ sie sɔne Jemima, nɛɛte sɔne Kesia, asɛ toorote ɡe Keren Hapuk. 15Dɛ haah bɛlbwa toole dɛ do wer harɛ la ta kɛŋɔ Job bihaahna la, asɛ ba mɛɛ tɛ bane ba nimanar ne dɔɔranar o kondɔɔh la pera.
16Anɔ habɔɔ, Job berɔ dɔ bene lafa fifraanaarɛ. O soɡo dɛ na o bii ne ba ɡe bii ka tel naanar bele banaarɛ. 17Anomanta, waa sewa dɛ o biɡro kɛrɛdɛ.

Title: SƐꞬLA TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Sɛɡla Tɔn nɔ, Kooro Solomɔnee boa waa ɡalɡa nyoa dɛ chwerɔ. Le nyuune 1—9 la, a ɛ waane mɛɛ bɛl aa bola dɛɛ ja o bie, ásɛ o hweli wejemwaa dɛ́ kpɔ so. Waa aa kaa nɛn ne wechɔɡa ta, kɛŋɔ haah waa ɡela baala ɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. Ba chwera do nyuune 2:16-19, 7:6-27, 9:13-18. Wejema do kɛŋɔ handɛɛɡe waa ɡela baa ɛɛ dɔ liidɛɛɡa. Ba chwera do nyuune 8:1-16, 9:1-12. Waa aa lɔ tɔn nɔ kabora ta dɛ baɡle sɛɡla ane aa cha yaa, ásɛ ya dɔ wejema dɛ bɛ ɡɛn.

Title: SƐꞬLA 1
Content:
Gɛ sɛɡla aa cheɡa tɛ
1Kooro Devid bibaa Kooro Solomɔn o fa aa di kora Israel harɛ ta la sɛɡla.
2Waa aa lɔ sɛɡla la taa kɛ,
nɛra che a ta
dɛ́ dɔ wejema,
ne ɡɛ baa lawɛ ba te,
á cha ba bá won dɛɛ no waa
a mun noe aa kpeɡa mun.
3Aa che sɛɡla nɔ taa
nɛra won jemɛ wa,
dɛ́ won ba te lawa
dɛ́ dɔ dadɛɛɡe,
dɛɛ ɛ waa aa wera
ne kasinteŋ,
dɛ waa aa toɡra.
4Aa ɡeloo nɛra baa wola
wobɛlbwa jemɛ sie pili,
ásɛ toli ne bonɔɔna
dɔ wejema.
5Wejerema, hé cheɡ deŋne,
dɛ́ no sɛɡla nɔ,
dɛ́ dɔ wejema kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛra baa dɛ no waa mun la
won ba te lawa,
anɔ la aa wera ne anɔ la
aa wola were ta,
6dɛ́ won dɛɛ no sɛɡla
a mun noe aa kpeɡa,
ne wejerema wobol ne
wobobeela mun.
7Wejema mumparee Korowii
ɔma.
Gɛna ɡboo dɛɛ vɛh
wejema,
ne waa baa dɛ do ba a ta.
Bonɔɔna ne toli jae wa
8N bie, no waa he mɛɛ
aa dɛ doe a ta,
bɛ waa he nya
aa dɛ baɡle vɛh.
9Ba webaɡla la ɛɛ ɡeloo
he dɔ dadɛɛɡe,
ásɛ he waa do wer kɛŋɔ,
haa di bonɔɔne kɛɛ toli,
dɛ kpɔ yal vɔwɛ nyu,
kɛɛ dɛ do baŋa kwaa la.
10N bie, dɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra dɛ doe
hé ɛ wechɔɡa aa, bɛ sɛh.
11Dɛ ba ŋɔ he be ŋɔ,
“Ba ya ka nyin nɛn kpo,
kɛɛ ya ka teŋe ŋwɛnɛ,
dɛ́ kpo nɛn ne o tepoŋ pɛɛ,
12ya ka kwaa ba ne ba bokpeɡa
sɔh,
kɛɛ ya ka do ba ŋwɛnɛ ba
kaa lalabwɛ.
13Yaa dɔ kondɔɔh bwa soo siwii,
ba su ya deremi kɛŋɔ laa ta
kwa.
14Anomanta, ba ja ya nɛɛ
ásɛ ya bwa ka bɔne kwaa
yaa ŋwɛ la.”
15N bie, he ne nɛra baa do ɡɛ
la bɛ valɛ, laa he te
kpɔ ba nɛ,
16ba ɡbaŋre wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta,
baa won ba te lawɛ
nɛŋkpoa ta.
17He dɛ nyin jumbie dɛ́ lawaa,
baa on bel harɛ o siwi ta,
baa mea lwee nyubaah ta du.
18Nɛn waa do ɡɛ la
dɛ harɛ o te bel,
o dɛ nyin o ɡbaɡba seo!
19Gɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo
waa do,
o dɛ sewɛ ɡɛ yoi we-ɛɛla
la ta.
Wejema dɛ yerɛ
20Wejema do kɛ haah
dɛ do fɔɡbaahna dɛɛ yerɛ,
o taa cheɡɛ chiŋ yawa
baahna.
21O cheɡɛ bwɛɛ doonyoo
ne bela nɛra aa wara,
dɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa o taa che
chiŋ ŋɔ,
22“Nɛra he sie aa wola pile,
saŋ besoo hɛɛ nyin kɛ he
ɡɛn ka tel ɔ?
Haa waa hweli aa?
23Dɛ he no kaeh maa dɛ
kah heya aa,
n fe ɛɛ kpɔ n bambile bwaa
tɛ heya,
dɛ́ baɡle heyaa wa.
24N teŋɔ dɛɛ yerɛ heya,
kɛ he vɛoh,
n ta nɔn ŋɔ he ba,
kɛ he mwaa n ne.
25Haa waa maa dɛ ja heyaa
a waa la nyin,
he vɛh waa maa bola
dɛɛ baɡle heyaa la ɡe.
26Sibeɡra pu heya aa,
n ɡe ɛɛ mamɛ heyaa,
wekpeɡa ane aa do ɔma
kohona ba he nɛ aa,
n ɡe ɛɛ di he loroo.
27Awola siswɛm aa pu heyaa
kɛŋɔ dompeu,
dɛɛ ba he nɛɛ kohona
kɛŋɔ peukpeɡ,
ásɛ hɛɛ na weweele
ne wahala la,
28belaa hɛɛ ba men
maa dɔ wejema nɔ yera,
ásɛ n mwaa he bwa ne.
Hɛ́ɛ ɡaaɡoo dɛɛ nyin n bɔr
bobɛlbwa yalayala ken,
kɛ haa men na.
29Hé kii wejema,
haa nyin kɛ he ɔmɛ Korowii.
30Hé ta waa maa dɛ ja heyaa la
ta teŋɛ, he vɛh kaeh
maa kah heyaa la
nɛra bwa siwi ta.
31Anomanta, hɛɛ dɔ ɡɛ
haa dɛ nyinii,
ásɛ he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla ɡure
he nyu ta.
32Gɛna dɛ sewɛ wejema baa
vɛah wa,
dɛkalkɛŋɔ ba kpɔ wejema
dɛɛ ta habɔɔ,
baa sie waa ta do.
33Kɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no
n waa la te
ɛɛ so lee jeiih ken,
o bwara sɔɔhno,
ɔmee liire bɛlbwa aa wola
on pu.”

Title: SƐꞬLA 2
Content:
Tɔnɔ aa lɔ wejema ta
1N bie, dɛ he no waa
maa bola dɛɛ baɡle,
dɛɛ do liire n waa ta,
2dɛ cheɡ deŋne wejemwaa ta,
dɛ sɔɔh bwara dɛɛ no
n waa mun,
3dɛ he soŋe Korowii wejema,
dɛɛ no waa a mun
noe aa kpeɡa mun,
4dɛ he siwi beɡrɔ,
hɛɛ nyina kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ,
kɛɛ kondɔɔh ane
aa sɔh bobɛl aa,
5a taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ
Korowii ɔma mun,
dɛ́ berɛ jemɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
6Korowii bee wejema le,
onee dɛɛ tɛ wejema
ne waa mun noe.
7Onee dɛɛ cha nɛn
o wa aa toɡra,
dɛɛ tɔ nɛn o ŋwɛnɛre
aa wera ɡbemɡbe.
8Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ nɛra
baa dɛ ɛ ba bala kɛrɛdɛ nɛ,
dɛɛ nyiŋi banɔ la
baa ta ba te tɛo nɛ.
9Dɛ he no n be naa,
hɛɛ jemɛ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ
dɛ do wer,
ne anɔ la aa toɡra.
Dɛ́ berɛ jemɛ
waa aa chɛ kɛŋɔ hé ɛ.
10He sie ɛɛ piluu,
ásɛ he wejema ɡel he sie lɛ.
11He waa mun noe
ne he wejema ɛɛ nyiŋi he nɛɛ,
12ásɛ dɛɛ lee waa
aa wola were ta.
Aa kee le nɛra baa wola
kasinteŋ bol dɛɛ ba waa
ne nɛ,
13nɛra baa vɛh wedɛɛɡa ŋwɛnɛ,
dɛ kaa kpɔ wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ
aa ɛ biro ta wa,
14nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ
wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta,
ne banɔ la ba sie aa dɛ lɛ
waa aa wola mun dɔe ta.
15Ba ɛ nɛra ba wa
aa wola sie chɔ,
dɛ ɛ nɛra baa wola
ba nɛɛ hwɛɡɛ.
Ba waa bwaa kɛ
baa neɡre nɛra.
16Wejemaa dɛ won lɛɛ le
hanjwamane nɔn ta,
haah waa kpɔ wobosoma
kaa he ne wechɔɡa ta.
17Haah waa le o sɛnojaa habɔɔ,
dɛ chɔɡ fɔo o ne o jaa
fa aa fɔwa Korowii sie la,
18ɡɛ haah la dem ŋwɛnɛ
kaa seo ta,
o chɔɔ kaa lalabwɛ.
19Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ la o be
aa berɛ dɛɛ ba kpa.
Naate aa mkpa
ŋwɛnɛ ta chiɡ kpa.
20Anomanta, teŋɛ nɛndɛɛɡe
luɡe ta,
ásɛ dɛ so kɛ nɛn
o wa aa toɡra.
21Nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa
dɛɛ ba harɛ nɔ ta soɡa.
Banɔ la wechɔɡa
aa wola toole ba nɛɛ
dɛɛ ba o ta kae.
22Korowii ɛɛ teŋe nɛnchɔɡaa
le harɛ nɔ ta,
wɛɛ chuɡri wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa
le o ta kɛŋɔ kpɔɡa kɛɛ daa
ken.

Title: SƐꞬLA 3
Content:
Bonɔɔna ne toli jae waa ja
1N bie, bɛ waa maa baɡle nɔ soh, ɡel he liire do waa
maa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛ ta,
2aa ɡeloo he dɔ mkpajaŋ,
dɛ́ berɛ ɡel he soɡa bini
do wer.
3Bɛ ɡel Korowii nyina
ne nɛnnyin dɛ kasinteŋ paŋɛ.
Kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ baŋa kon,
ɡel a ɛ he bambile wa.
4He ɛ ɡɛ naa, hɛɛ dɔ sɔndɛɛɡee
Korowii ne nɛra bwa be.
5Bɛ he te kpɔ dawɛ
anɔ la haa jema ta,
kpɔ he hwɛɡa bwa
do Korowii nɛ.
6Wobɛlbwa haa dɛ ɛ la,
lii Korowii wa,
ásɛ o baɡle ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe
hé kpɔ o ta.
7Bɛ he te wejereme kohona
dɛɛ lii,
ɔmɛ Korowii,
dɛ ke he te wechɔɡa ta.
8Dɛ he teŋɛ a ta naa,
aa ɛo kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa,
dɛ́ do he bwara bini
dɛɛ chaeh.
9Kpɔ he kondɔɔh,
ne he koo kondikonloɡla
tɛ Korowii,
dɛ́ kpɔ duuru.
10Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he dɔ
mea kohona he dɔndɔŋ su,
ásɛ dɛ berɛ dɔ senfala
kohona,
haa wola won dɔ
kwaa dɛ́ do a bwa.
11N bie, dɛ Korowii
dɛ tɛr he deŋne aa,
bɛ an wesale lii.
Dɛ o dɛ toɡre naa,
bɛ ɡel a hwah he bwara.
12Nɛn Korowii aa dɛ nyin la,
onee wɛɛ kah,
kɛŋɔ mɛɛ yon dɛɛ
toɡre o binyini la.
13Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ
wejema la, o na som.
Nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun
la,
14a dɔ tɔnɔ dɛ ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ,
a ɛ kondɔɔh ɡwaa
suuɡaswɛm.
15Wejema yoɡ kpeɡri,
dɛ ɡwaa kwaa baa
kpɔ suuɡaswɛm ɛa,
he konnyini bɛlbwa toole
he won kpɔ maɡɔ.
16O dɛ tɛ mkpajaŋ,
dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tɛ
kondɔɔh ne jirima.
17O ɡelɔ he soɡa bini ɛɛ do
wer, dɛ́ berɛ ɡel
hɛɛ dɔ bosɔɔhna.
18Nɛra baa dɔ wejema la,
ba na som,
o dɛ tɛ mkpa kohona.
19Wejema nee Korowii ta harɛ,
waa mun noe taa o che,
dɛ ta nyundua ɡe.
20O wejema taa o che,
dɛ ta neerare aa palɛ,
dɛ berɛ ta baama
aa ɛ bwaala dɛɛ nɛ.
21N bie, lawɛ he wejema
ne waa mun noe bini,
bɛ ɡel a paŋɛ.
22Aa tɛɛ mkpaa,
dɛ́ ɡel he soɡa bini do wer.
23Anee dɛɛ ba ɡela he valɛ
wobɛlbwa ta sɔnɔnɔɔ,
haa wola nachɔɡee lɔ.
24He chɔɔ waa haa ɔmɛ,
dɛ́ chɔ domsoma.
25Haa wekpeɡa aa
dɛ piɡri nɛn waa lii,
kɛɛ wenaale aa dɛ ba
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra nɛɛ laanee
ɔmɛ.
26Korowii ɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ he
nɛ, waa ɡel he jo waa ta.
27Gɛ haa dɛ ba wona ɛ tɛ nɛra
aa hiah ba la ɛ,
dɛ he dɔ a kpeɡri aa.
28Dɛ he dɔ komɛl
dɛ́ tɛ he dɔŋ aa tɛo,
bɛ ŋɔ ó kaa kere dɛ́ ba.
29Bɛ wechɔɡa lii tɛ he dɔŋ
waa dɔ hwɛɡa he nɛɛ
dɛ so bɛne.
30Bɛ waa kpɔ dawɛ
he dɔŋ nɛɛ pɛɛpɛɛ,
dɛ o ta hen waane ɛɛ.
31Bɛ ɡel he sie beɡre nɛn
waa dɛ nyin yoi kwaa ta,
bɛ waa waa dɛ ɛ la ane ɛ.
32Korowii kii nɛn
o ŋwɛnɛre aa ɡola,
o dɔ hwɛɡa tɛ nɛn
o wa aa toɡra,
dɛɛ bol o waa o be.
33Korowii nyotaahna
lɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ dem,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra
dem te,
o swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.
34Korowii dɛ mamɛ
mbarafo tena
baa dɛ mamɛ ba bala,
dɛɛ sune nɛra baa
dɛ pwɛr ba te la nɛ.
35Wejeremaa dɛɛ dɔ jirima,
ɡɛna ɡee dɛɛ so sihiih ta.

Title: SƐꞬLA 4
Content:
Wejema kan taeh
1N bii, hɛɛ no waa he mɛɛ aa dɛ baɡle,
hé cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no,
ásɛ dɛɛ no waa mun.
2Wedɛɛɡaa mɛɛ baɡle heyaa
la,
hé ɡel a do he liire bini.
3N fa aa lɔ n nya ne n mɛɛ sie,
dɛ ɡbo ɛ bibaa
dɛ ta ɛ bechala la,
4n mɛɛ fa yon bol
waa dɛɛ baɡ mɛ dɛ ŋɔ,
“Gel waa nɔ ɛɛ liire dɛ bɛ
soh.
Dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta ásɛ dɛ biɡri.
5Kpɔ wejema dɛɛ no waa mun,
do liire a ta, dɛ bɛ waa
maa bola la ta le.
6Bɛ wejema vɛh,
ásɛ o nyiŋi he nɛ.
Nyinu he bambile bwa,
ásɛ o kpɔ nɔn tɔ he nɛ.
7Wejema kan taeh,
anomanta, hwelu.
Waa mun noe ɡwaa
komɛlbwa haa dɔa.
8Duu wejema, ásɛ o ɛɛ nɛnjen,
kpɔ he te pɛlo,
ásɛ o tɛɛ jirima.
9Wɛɛ kpɔ jirimaa
sime kɛŋɔ botidɛɛɡe,
dɛ́ kpɔ pii kɛŋɔ kooɡbɛrɛ
he dɔ jirima.”
10N bie, no n be,
dɛ́ do sie a ta kɛrɛdɛ,
ásɛ dɛ dɔ mkpajaŋ.
11N baɡle wejema,
n kpɔe cheɡ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe
haa kpɔ o ta dɛ́ so.
12Dɛ he dɛ valɛ wejema ne naa,
wobɛlbwa toole dɛ́ tɔe ŋwɛnɛ,
he dɛ chwa kwaraa naa,
haa nakpalaa lɔ.
13Lawɛ waa haa hwela la bini
saŋ bɛlbwa,
dɛ bɛ ɡel a le he nɔn ta,
nyiŋi a ta kɛrɛdɛ,
anee he mkpa.
14Bɛ bela nɛnchɔɡa aa dɛ la la,
bɛ ba waa dɔŋa ɛ.
15Dɛɛ ke he te, bɛ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la
ta kpɔ, ke o ta,
dɛ́ kpɔ he ŋwɛnɛ.
16Gɛ nɛra la aa won chɔ,
dɛ ba ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ,
baa won haŋre, dɛ ba ta
wechɔɡa dii.
17Nyubinikpeɡ ne yoi we-ɛɛlaa
ɛ ba kondikwaa ne sen.
18Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra
waa do kɛŋɔ, bɔr aa
chaahna chɔmbibii
ka tel kɛŋɔ wee aa baŋa.
19Kɛ nɛnchɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ te
do kɛŋɔ, bɔr aa bira
kpirkpir ken,
baa kon baa lɔ naa o ta na.
20N bie, cheɡ deŋne dɛɛ no
waa maa bol baɡle,
dɛɛ no n be kɛrɛdɛ.
21Bɛ ɡel a le he liire ta,
ɡel a do he nyu bini.
22A ɛ mkpa dɛ tɛ banɔ la
baa dɛ no a mun,
dɛ berɛ dɛɛ tɛɛ ba bokpeɡa.
23He dɛ lii wa aa,
dɛɛ nyiŋa kɛrɛdɛ,
waa haa dɛ lii la,
anee hɛɛ ɛ.
24Bɛ waa aa wola kpela ɛɛ bol
bwa,
laa he te kpɔ neɡra wobol
ta.
25Do sie dɛɛ ɛ waa haa dɛ ɛ,
do sie a ta,
dɛ bɛ bobɛlbwa nyiŋi.
26Nyiŋi he vala bini kɛrɛdɛ,
ásɛ dɛ che kiŋkiŋ
bela haa dɛ kaa.
27Laa he te kpɔ wechɔɡa ta,
dɛ́ ɡel he ŋwɛnɛ toɡre.
Bɛ ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe la ta le.

Title: SƐꞬLA 5
Content:
Jwamane jae wa
1N bie, cheɡ deŋne,
dɛ́ no n wejema nɔ,
no waa aa dɛ tɛ waa mun
noe.
2Ásɛ dɛ che a ta dɔ dadɛɛɡe,
ásɛ he wobol baɡle kɛŋɔ
he dɔ wejema.
3Hanjwamane nyoa wobol
som kɛŋɔ tooh ken,
o taa pwɛre ɡwaa no,
4kɛ a habɔɔ la,
waa waa doe a ta la
kpeli kɛŋɔ ol kpela.
O nyoa wobol
dɛ do nɛn bol
kɛŋɔ naŋɡɔse ken.
5Wɛɛ kaa he ne seo taa,
lalabwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛɛ wɛɛ kpɔ.
6Waa ŋwɛnɛ waa
dɛ tɛ mkpa la ta kpɔ,
valaa o valɛ dɛɛ valɛ,
waa jemɛ anɔ la waa dɛ ɛ.
7N bii, hé berɛ no,
hɛɛ berɛ waa maa
dɛ bol he be nɔ soeh.
8Haah waa do ɡɛ la,
hé laa he te kpɔ o nɛ,
he bɛ o doonyoa kwaraa
fɛrɛ.
9Gɛ laa aa, hɛɛ paŋɛ
he bonɔɔne saŋ
jirima he fa aa dɔa la
nyubinikpeɡ tena nɔn taa.
10Ásɛ nɛŋhɔɔhra
ba kpɔ he kondɔɔh di,
ásɛ kwaa haa ɛ toma
dɛ dɔ la,
bɛ nomɛl kwaa ba berɛ.
11Haa ba hwɛɛh la,
he ba chɔ dɛɛ hime,
ɡɛ saŋ he bwadabii
bwa aa ɡwɛɡra la,
12ásɛ he ba ŋɔ,
“N deŋnekpeɡ ne n waa
bɛ noe,
ne n bambikpeɡii tɛ mɛ.
13N ta nɛra baa baɡ mɛ
waa la be noɛ,
n ta nɛra baa do mɛ
la waa ta teŋɛ.
14Asɛ buɡ nɔ ta
mɛɛ ba ncho dii,
nɛra bwa siwi ta nɔ.”
15He ne he haah ɡbo ɛɛ chɔ,
kɛŋɔ haa dɛ nyɔ
he dem nee ɡbo la.
16Bɛ fɔɡbaahna haahna
ka nyin.
Ba do kɛŋɔ nee aa
wola were ne nyɔe.
17Kpoŋe he haah ɡbo,
he ne nomɛlbwa kon laa.
18Gel he sie ɛɛ lɛ
he bonɔɔne saŋ haah nɛ.
Korowii swee andɛɛɡa
tɛɛ he ne o chɔe bini.
19O wer kɛŋɔ diɡi ken,
o we-ɛɛla ɡe do wer,
ɡel he sie ɛɛ lɛ o nɛ,
hɛɛ nyinu kohona
saŋ bɛlbwa.
20N bie, bɔkwaa ɡela he berɛ
kpɔ he te tɛ hanfale bɛl
jaɔ?
Bɔkwaa ɡela hɛɛ sewɛ
he dɔŋ bɛl haah nɛɛ jaɔ?
21Korowii dɛ na wobɛlbwa
haa dɛ ɛ,
o jemɛ he vala bini bwa.
22Nɛnchɔɡe wechɔɡa
do kɛŋɔ bel dɛ tɛo,
o dichɔɡaa dɛɛ lawɔ.
23Lawa waa wola won o te
lawɛ laanee dɛ́ kpoo,
o ɡɛnaa ɡela wɛɛ sewɛ.

Title: SƐꞬLA 6
Content:
Gɛna wejaala ane
1N bie, a balɔ kɛŋɔ he di
ajinamuu tɛ he dɔŋ,
dɛ he baɡɛ nyoa
waane ta tɛ nomɛl aa,
2amɔ dɛ he nyobaɡa
la ɛ bel dɛ tɛɛ,
waa haa bola la harɛ bel.
3N bie, a ba ɡɛ naa,
dɛ he nɔn lɔ he dɔŋ la
nyoa,
ɛ warane la o be dɛ́ ka soŋo,
dɛ́ dɔ he te.
4Bɛ kpoŋe so,
bɛ kpɔ chɔ.
5Ɛ warane kɛŋɔ
welo aa na kpaah,
dɛ laa o te kpɔ,
kɛɛ jumbie aa na nɛn
waa dɛ harɔ bel la.
6Bɔhwaah bɛlbwa
nyiŋi vaɡla we-ɛɛla,
dɛ́ che a ta hweli wa.
7A ta nomoa kɛɛ nyu te dɔe,
a ta kooro dɔe,
8kɛ a nyin a kondikwaa
dɛɛ cheɡ hwel saŋ,
dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kpa
bwaala nee saŋ.
9Bɔhwaah, saŋ besoo
hɛɛ nyin he chɔ ka tel,
dɛ́ ir saŋ besoo?
10He yon ŋɔ, “Chɔe tama,
dom chuɡla tama,
nɔɔra fɔɔla dɛ́ so onɛ
tama.”
11He ne ŋɔe he ba jemɛ la,
dɛ nyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa
kpoŋe dɔmkon
dɛ́ ba che he nɛ.
12Nɛnsale baa ɛ ba te nɛnchɔɡaa
vala dɛɛ teŋe nyosone.
13Ba kpɔ sie ne nakpale
dɛɛ bol wa,
dɛ kpɔ nonie dɛɛ baɡle wa,
14ba dɔ liichɔɡa ba nyu bini,
dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa
ba bambile ta.
Wobochɔɡa lɔ ba nyoo
baa ir nɛra bandia.
15Anomanta, kerabeŋkpoŋii
wekpeɡa ɛɛ ba ba nɛɛ bala,
buɡ taa aa ba ba nɛɛ chiɡa,
dɛ́ chɔɡ ba, ba chah kahonɛ.
16Webele anumɛl kɛɛ anuanɛ
ane lole Korowii haah
kɔkɔkɔkɔ, anee,
17nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛn dɛɛ vah,
ne nyosonteŋni, ne nɛŋkpoa,
18ne nɛn waa dɔ wechɔɡa
vɔrɔwa o nyu bini,
ne nɛn waa ɡbaŋa
wechɔɡa ɛɛ ta,
19ne dansewea
dɛ nɛn wobochɔɡa aa lɔ o
nyoa,
dɛɛ ba peɡra ne o dem
tena baah ta.
Jwamane jae wa
20N bie, dɛɛ no waa
he mɛɛ aa dɛ doe a ta.
Bɛ waa he nya aa dɛ baɡle
vɛh.
21Kpɔa ɛ kɛŋɔ baŋa kon,
ɡel a ɛ he bambile wa.
22Aa tɔ he siee
bobɛlbwa haa dɛɛ la,
he chɔe bini,
aa nyiŋi he nɛ,
ásɛ he iro ɡe aa, a tɛɛ liire.
23Webaɡla nɔ do kɛŋɔ
kandea dɛɛ chaahne,
wejaala nɔ ɛɛ won baɡle
ɡɛ haa dɛ ba wona so.
24Aa won kee le hanchɔɡe nɛ,
dɛ́ won ɡel he laa he te kpɔ
haah o nyoa wobol aa
soma, dɛ ɛ nomɛl haah nɛ.
25Bɛ o wer waa koh
dɛ́ ɡel he sie do o nɛ,
bɛ ɡel o kpɔ o tolsie neɡre.
26Hɛɛ won kpɔ kondikwaa
tamaa ken dɔ hanjwamane.
Kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin
nomɛl haah tenaa,
komɛlbwa dɛ le he nɔn ta.
27Hɛɛ won pa ninhɔla kore,
he laala aa wola fuah?
28Hɛɛ won valɛ ninhɔla ta,
he napaala aa wola bwɛ
aa?
29Gɛɛ a do,
nomɛlbwa waa lawɛ
o dɔŋ haah chɔ la,
baa tɛr o deŋne.
30Dɛ nɛn dɛ chɔ lɔr,
dɛ ka ŋwɛ kwaa di aa,
he bɛ on hah,
dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
31Kɛ dɛ ba lawɔ tenaa,
a chɛ kɛŋɔ ó bɔ kwaa
waa ŋwɛa la bele anuanɛ.
Kwaa waa dɔa bwa ɛɛ le
o nɔn taa.
32Baa waa le o haah habɔɔ,
dɛ kaa nyin hanfala la ta
liire dɔe,
o dɛ chɔɡ o ɡbaɡba.
33Waa duure dɔ,
lɔɔraa chɔ le tɛo,
sihiih aa o nɛɛ le bwa.
34Baa baah aa di kohona,
nemenɛ o meera tɔpere
o yon bɔ a kem
ɡɛ bwa waa dɛ nyin.
35O sie aa larawa bɛlbwa ta lɛ,
komɛlbwa toole
he kpɔ tɛo o baah sɔɔh.

Title: SƐꞬLA 7
Content:
Hanjwamane jae wa
1N bie, dɛɛ teŋɛ n waa ta,
dɛ́ɛ do liire waa maa
dɛ doe a ta la ta.
2Dɛɛ no n waa dɛ́ dɔ mkpa,
dɛ́ɛ nyiŋi waa maa
dɛ baɡle la ta kɛrɛdɛ,
kɛŋɔ he siwinyiŋi ken.
3Kpɔa do kɛŋɔ noniseɡ,
dɛ́ ɡel a do he bambile
bini.
4Kpɔ wejema kɛŋɔ
he nimambie,
dɛ́ kpɔ waa mun noe
kɛŋɔ he dansom.
5Aa lawɛɛ le hanjwamane,
ne nomɛl haah
o nyoa wobol aa soma nɛ.
6Awola bɛl, n lɔ dea
dɛ ha sie nyiŋi tokoro ta,
7dɛ na bonɔɔna bane
baa wola wobɛlbwa jemɛ,
ba bini la,
dɛ bɛl te ɛ ɡɛne tenten.
8Baa dɛ kaa la,
dɛ ɡɛne la te valɔ
dɛɛ kpɔ bela hanjwamane
la aa soɡa.
Dɛɛ fɛrɛ haah la dem,
9dɛ bɔr dɛ jo,
bobɛlbwa ɛɛ bir.
10Ate, haah la kpɔ o te
dɛ ba cheme bonɔɔ la,
dɛ haah la do jwamanlaala
dɛɛ taaɡe sie.
11O ɛ haah o deŋne aa kpeɡa,
waa sihiih jemɛ,
dɛ do ɡaaɡa ɡbo ta,
12hɛɛ nao kɛŋɔ o cheɡɛ loŋkoni
ta,
kɛɛ fɔɡbaahna ane ta yawa
ta,
dɛ́ dɔ baa lawɛ.
13Belaa haah la ba
ɡbaa bonɔɔ la pɛl o te,
dɛ kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ o vaama
ta,
dɛ nyiŋi o siebɔr,
dɛ ŋɔ o be ŋɔ,
14“Fini n kpo kon dɛ ɛ
deŋnesɔɔhna sarahare,
asɛ a ka ola la ane.
