15Asɛ n le dɛ baa ɡaaɡe he bɔr,
n nyin he bɔr asɛ dɛ nae la!
16N kpɔ yadɛɛɡe
Ijipt harɛ tena aa ɛo,
o do wer kɛrɛdɛ pa n
chɔɔbɔr.
17Dɛ kpɔ korobo ne konsɔɔhsoma
bwa soo siwi merɛ o ta.
18Ba ya ka lɛ ya sie jwaana nɔ
ne bwa,
ya ka di ya bwara!
19N jaa toole,
o kaa bobɛl, bela jaŋne.
20O kpoŋe suuɡa kohona dɛ kaa,
wɛɛ dɔ yawanyoa anɛɛ.”
21Haah la kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ
ne wobosoma dɛ dɔɔ kaa.
22Buɡ la ta, bonɔɔ la den teŋɛ
o nɛɛ kɛŋɔ nao baa tɛɡro
dɛɛ la ka kpo la,
kɛɛ kweɡla aa jo bel ta
23bela hɛm aa yaɡɔ
dɛ́ kpoo la.
O berɔ do kɛŋɔ jumbie
aa toola dɛɛ kaa bel ta,
waa wola jemɛ kɛŋɔ
o dɛ ba sewa la.
24N bii, name hé no n be,
hé cheɡ deŋne dɛ́ no n wa.
25Hé bɛ ɡel he pɛla do haah
waa do ɡɛ nɔ nɛɛ
ó ba neɡre heya,
he bɛ bɛl nɛɛ teŋɛ bwa.
26Gɛ haah nɔ chɔɡ baala taeh,
dɛ berɛ ɡel bane ɡe serewe
baa wola won kur ba.
27He nakpala tire o dem aa,
amɔ dɛ lalabwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ taa
he che la.
Bela ne seo bori.

Title: SƐꞬLA 8
Content:
Wejema yera waa dɛ yerɛ
1Hɛɛ no, wejema do kɛŋɔ haah dɛɛ yerɛ,
o do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɔ liire,
dɛɛ no waa mun,
o taa che chiŋ.
2O cheɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nyoa
deŋɡarere ta,
o lɔ ŋwɛnɛ chɛchɛre ta.
3O cheɡɛ bwɛjen doonyoo,
bela baa kpɔa dɛɛ jo o bini,
o lɔ bela dɛɛ yerɛ.
4O ŋɔ, “N dɛ yerɛ nomɛlbwa,
nɛra baa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta
bwaa mɛɛ yerɛ.
5He sie ta pilaa,
hé hweli sipila wa.
He ɡɛnaa,
hé hweli wejemwa.
6Hɛ́ɛ no, n waa nɔ wer taeh,
anɔ la bwa maa dɛ bol he
be la toɡrɔ.
7Kpelaa mɛɛ bol,
maa nyosone teŋe bwa.
8Wobɛlbwa maa bol la bwa
ɛ kasinteŋ,
a bɛlbwa toole dɛ
ɛ nyosone kɛɛ neɡra.
9Nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la,
a bwa bini chɔɔ tɛo,
dɛ berɛ toɡre tɛ banɔ la
baa dɔ wejema.
10Hé kpɔ waa maa kpɔa
dɛɛ ja heya dɛ́ ɡel suuɡapoŋ,
hé kpɔ wejema ɡwaa
suuɡaswɛm tenten.
11Menee Wejema,
n ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ
suuɡaswɛm ɛa,
haa won kpɔ he bambile ta
komɛlbwa maɡ mɛ.
12Menee Wejema, n sie pilo,
n jemɛ waa dɛɛ no waa
mun.
13Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɔmɛ
Korowii kii wechɔɡa,
anomanta, n kii mbarafo
ne maŋkurae we-ɛɛla,
ne wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛre,
dɛ nyosone.
14N dɛ baɡle nɛra waa
bá kpɔ ɛ toma aa cha ba,
n ɡelɔ baa no waa mun,
dɛ́ dɔ kpeɡri.
15N cha koranar baa di kora,
ásɛ nomonome won
mmarare aa wera doe.
16Nomonjena ba wa aa toɡra
cheɡɛ n nɛɛ dɛɛ di kora,
dɛ́ won bol waa dɛɛ pa bole
aŋwɛnɛ ta.
17N dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ nyin
mɛ,
nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin
n bɔr dɛ́ na mɛ.
18Menee dɔ kondɔɔh ne jirima
dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ tɛ,
dɛ soɡa bini wer doe
dɛ ka tonɛ.
19Kon haa dɔ le n be la
ɡwaa suuɡaswɛm baa laa
doŋa kpɔ o ta,
dɛ ɡwaa suuɡapoŋ tenten.
20Waa aa toɡraa mɛɛ ɛ,
dɛɛ teŋɛ kasinteŋ ta,
21dɛɛ tɛ banɔ la baa dɛ nyin mɛ
kondɔɔh,
ba deremi ɛɛ su kohona.
22Men Wejema, menee Korowii
tɔ sie ta, mɔɔ
dɛ pa mun ta komɛlbwa.
23Menee Korowii tɔ sie ta
mumpar la,
mɔɔ dɛ ta harɛ nɔ.
24O ta mɛ mɔɔ dɛ ta mpore,
ne nee nyuune.
25Waa wola bwejena tae mɔɔ
la,
dɛ n lole,
mɔɔ o kpɔ deŋɡarere ba
cheɡ la, dɛ ba lol mɛ.
26Waa wola harɛ ne kpɔɡ bini
kɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta teera
kwaraa tae mɔɔ la,
dɛ n lole.
27N siwi taa Korowii ta
nyundua,
dɛ pe mpo ne nyundua
chenchema,
28ɡɛ saŋ waa kpɔ baama
do nyundua,
dɛ ta neerare a palɛ
kaa jo mpo ta la.
29N lole o maɡɛ bela
mpo aa dɛɛ jaɡɛ,
dɛ ŋɔ o bɛ bela ba ɡarɛ,
ne ɡɛ saŋ waa pe harɛ
mun.
30Dɛ n lɔ Korowii jwɛɛh
ya bwa pɛ dɛɛ ɛ toma,
dɛ n dɛ ɛ waa o bambile
aa dɛ nyin tɔpere bɛlbwa,
n sie ɛɛ lɛ o be saŋ bɛlbwa.
31Asɛ n sie lɛ toma yaa pɛa ɛ la
ta, n tea too
nɛwɛnyina bwa nɛ.
32N bii, name hé no n be,
nomɛlbwa waa dɛ teŋɛ n
waa ta la, o na som.
33Hé no anɔ la maa dɛ do
heyaa a ta,
he bɛ an vɛh,
ásɛ dɛ jemɛ wa.
34Nɛn waa dɛ no n waa la,
o na som,
nɛn waa dɛ so n dem
doonyoa
kɛɛ dɛɛ kpa bela la,
o na som.
35Nomɛlbwa waa na mɛ la dɔ
mkpa,
Korowii tea ɛɛ too o nɛɛ.
36Nomɛlbwa waa wola men nae
la, o ɛ o te,
nomɛlbwa waa hah mɛ la
pɛla lawɛ seo.”

Title: SƐꞬLA 9
Content:
Wejema ne ɡɛnewa
1Wejema do kɛ haah waa ma o dem,
asɛ dɛ ɛ pilare anuanɛ
do o ta.
2O kpo ol dɛ kpɔ ɛ
kondikonjena,
dɛ kpɔ konsɔɔhsoma ane
koo sen ta,
dɛ pa chɔŋre teebur ta.
3O tomɛ o toli ŋɔ bá la bwɛɛ la
bela aa dawɛ deŋɡare ta
ka yerɛ nɛra.
4Dɛ ŋɔ, “Hé banɔ la he sie
aa wola pile la ba,”
dɛ berɛ ŋɔ ɡɛna ɡe be ŋɔ,
5“Hé ba di kwaa
dɛ́ nyɔ sen maa koo kwaa
a ta nɔ ane.
6Hé le he sie bɛ pila la ta,
dɛ́ dɔ he nyu.
Hé teŋɛ wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta.
7He dɛ ja nɛn waa dɛ ɛ
sisawa aa,
chɛɡaa hɛɛ dɔ.
He dɛ di wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɡe
kasinteŋ aa, waa hɛɛ dɔ.
8Bɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ nɛra sisawaa
kasinteŋ di o ba haeh,
di wejereme kasinteŋ,
ásɛ o nyini.
9Hé dɛ ja wejereme aa,
a ɡelɔ wɛɛ jemɛ waa
kohona.
Anɔ la bɛlbwa haa bol nɛn
o wa aa toɡra be la,
a dɛ ja o wejema ta.
10Wejema mumparee
Korowii ɔma,
waa mun noe ɡe cheɡɛ
Korowii Waa Do Goroŋ
jema ta.
11Menee Wejema, he teŋɛ
n nɛ aa,
hɛɛ dɔ mkpajaŋee.
12He jemɛ wa aa,
aa do werii tɛɛ,
he vɛah ɡe aa,
hɛɛ na waa.”
13Gɛna do kɛŋɔ haah
waa ɛ wobobala te,
waa wola sihiih jemɛ.
14O dem doonyoa
kɛɛ bwɛɛ la deŋɡare taa
o kara che wɛɛ so o ta,
15dɛɛ yerɛ nɛra baa ba dɛ kaa,
banɔ la baa teŋa baa kaa
ba liire do ba waa ta.
16Dɛ ŋɔ ɡɛna be ŋɔ,
“Nɛra he sie aa wola pile,
hé ba n be bonɔ.”
17Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Nee haa ŋwɛ
nyɔ la som taeh,
kondikwaa haa sɔh
di la som.”
18Nɛra waa dɛ lɛɛ ba la aa jemɛ
kɛŋɔ ba la o dem aa,
ba dɛ sewɛ.
Banɔ la baa tɔ sie
jo bela la,
ba bwa serewɔ kaa
lalabwɛ.

Title: SƐꞬLA 10
Content:
Kooro Solomɔn sɛɡla
1Kooro Solomɔn sɛɡlaa teŋa nɔ.
Bechawejereme ɡelɔ
o mɛɛ baŋa ɛɛ pa,
kɛ bechaɡɛne te ɡelɔ o nya
loo ɛɛ ku.
2Wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ kpɔe
dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh
ta tɔnɔ bɛlbwa dɔe,
kɛ dɛ he waa toɡraa,
a dɛ lee seo ta.
3Korowii aa ɡel lɔr kpo
nɛn o wa aa toɡra.
O lɔ nɛnchɔɡe konnyini
dɛɛ ta.
4He dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah aa,
nyae hɛɛ nya,
kɛ dɛ he dɛ ɛ toma tenaa,
kwaa hɛɛ dɔ.
5Wejereme dɛ́ komɛ
o koo kwaa a koma saŋ,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ́ chɔ
kwaa koma saŋ te
dɛ́ di sihiih.
6Nomɛlbwa swee andɛɛɡa
dɛɛ tɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te mur,
waa yoi waa bol á le baŋ.
7Nɛn o wa aa toɡra na som,
baa o waa soh,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te
waa won soeh warane.
8Wejereme dɛ́ no jae,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ bol ɡɛnewaa
te waa dɛ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
9Nɛn o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la,
o wobɛlbwa dɛ́ do wer,
nɛn o wa aa wola sie
chɔ te, ba dɛ nao.
10Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ tɔ
kasinteŋ ta la
dɛ́ ba waa ne,
kɛ nɛn waa dɔ bambile
dɛɛ bol waa la,
o dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
11Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol
dɛ́ ba mkpa ne,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te mur,
waa yoi waa bol á le baŋ.
12Che kaɡraree dɛɛ ba tim
kaɡrare tae ne,
kɛ nɛnnyin te
dɛ́ tɔ wechɔɡa ta.
13Wejereme wobol binii
wejema do,
kɛ ɡɛne te,
lɔɔraa baa lɔɔro.
14Wejereme dɛ hweli wa,
dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ do o nyu bini,
kɛ nɛn waa ɡɛna wobol te,
dɛ ba waa ne.
15Dɔɔh suuɡaa dɛɛ tɔɔ
ɡbemɡbe,
kɛ nyaa te, o nyae
dɛ́ kaa o ne chɔɡa ta.
16Nɛn o wa aa toɡra kembɔree
mkpa,
asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ we-ɛɛla
ɛɛ ba wechɔɡa ɡbo ne.
17Nɛn waa cheɡ deŋne
dɛɛ no jae la dɛ́ biɡri,
kɛ onɔ la waa wola o
wechɔɡa sɛh la dɛ́ dɔ wa.
18Nɛn waa hah o dɔŋ
dɛɛ tɔh la ɛ nyosonteŋni,
asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ taa
nyokpɛl la ɡɛnɔ.
19Wobobala te bɛlbwa dɛ koni,
asɛ nɛn waa won o nyoa
lawa la jemɛ wa.
20Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol
do kɛŋɔ suuɡapoŋ tenten,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te liire ɛ wepuu.
21Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol
dɔ tɔnɔ dɛɛ tɛ nɛndamanta,
kɛ ɡɛne te,
liire waa wola dɔe la,
dɛ́ kaa o ne seo ta.
22Korowii swee andɛɛɡa tɛɛ naa,
a dɛ ba kondɔɔh ne,
wenaale bɛlbwa aa a ta ja.
23Gɛne siee dɛɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ta,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa
mun te,
o sie dɛ lɛ wejemwaa ta.
24Waa nɛnchɔɡe aa dɛ ɔmɛ la,
a dɛ ba o nɛ,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te,
dɛ́ dɔ kon waa dɛ nyin.
25Wekpeɡa pu wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa,
o dɛ sewɛ,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te,
o dɛ do le saŋ bɛlbwa.
26Gɛ konnyɛɡa aa dɛ nyɛɡ
nyena,
asɛ ninchuu ɡe ɛɛ we
sie la,
ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ɛ bonyɛɡa
do tɛ nɛn waa tomɔ.
Waa on bansɔɔhna tɛ.
27He dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii aa,
he dɛ biɡri,
kɛ he dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa aa,
haa he saŋ tel.
28Kon nɛn o wa aa toɡra
aa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o ta la,
ɛ silɛɛ kon,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te hwɛɡa
dɛ́ ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
29Korowii kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ nɛra
ba wa aa toɡra nɛ,
dɛɛ chɔɡ banɔ la
baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
30Nɛn o wa aa toɡra
dɛ́ so deŋnesɔɔhna ta,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te,
baa doŋu le o harɛ ta.
31Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa
dɛɛ bol nɛmbiwa,
kɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe
aa bar o nyu te
waa dɔ jaɡa.
32Nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol
dɛ́ sɔɔh baah,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te,
o wobol dɛ muɡli baah.

Title: SƐꞬLA 11
Content:
1Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta.
O sie dɛ lɛ nɛn
waa kpɔ kon waa maɡra
ne kwaa maɡa nɛ.
2Mbarafo dɛ ba sihiih ne,
asɛ pwɛre doe ɡe ɛɛ ba
wejema ne.
3He waa toɡrɔ aa,
a ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ anɔ la haa
ɛ,
kɛ nɛra baa wola kasinteŋ
dɔe la
we-ɛɛlaa dɛɛ chɔɡ ba.
4Kondɔɔh ta tɔnɔ dɔe
seo tɔpere,
kɛ he waa toɡrɔ aa,
a dɛ lee seo ta.
5He waa toɡrɔ aa,
dɛ he waa wer,
kɛ he ɛ nɛnchɔɡe aa,
he ɡbaɡba we-ɛɛla
dɛ chɔɡe.
6Nɛn o wa aa toɡra daa dɛɛ
lɛo,
asɛ nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ
dɔe la ɡbaɡba pɛla
waa dɛɛ lawɔ.
7Nɛnchɔɡe sewaa, o hwɛɡa
bwa ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ,
anɔ la o sie aa dawɛ a ta
bwa tonɔ.
8Korowii dɛ lɛ nɛn o wa aa
toɡra dɛɛ le wahala ta,
a yon berɛ ba nɛnchɔɡe nɛ.
9Nyoa nee nɛn waa nyiŋi nɛn
sie mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛ waa
ɛɛ chɔɡ o dɔŋ,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te,
o wejemaa dɛɛ lɛo.
10Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɔ kɛrɛdɛ
naa,
bwɛɛ la tena bwa sie dɛ lɛ,
kɛ dɛ nɛnchɔɡe baa sewaa,
bɛlbwa dɛ mamɛ.
11Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra we-ɛɛla
taa a che bwɛɛ ɛɛ pili,
dɛ berɛ che nɛnchɔɡe
wobol ta bwɛɛ ɛɛ paɡre.
12A ɛ ɡɛnewaa kɛŋɔ he muɡli
he dɔŋ baah,
kɛ he jemɛ waa tenaa,
he dɛ lawɛ he nyoa.
13Nɛn waa dɛ ŋwalɛ nɛra
aa won waa ta tɔ,
kɛ nɛn nɛra aa dɔ hwɛɡa
o nɛɛ te dɛ tɔ wobɛlbwa ta.
14Dɛ wejerema toole
dɛ nyiŋi harɛ bɛl ta naa,
o dɛ paɡre.
Bela nomondɛɛɡa aa lole
la, deŋnesɔɔhna lɔ bela.
15Haa nɛn jemɛ aa,
haa o habɔɔ che kem ta.
Haa on ajinamuu di.
He vɛoh bɔ kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ
he te do a ta.
16Haah waa dɔ dadɛɛɡe la
dɛ dɔ nyanyini,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ lɛ ɡaeh
dɛ́ dɔ kondɔɔh ɡbo.
17Nɛn o wa aa wera dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ,
nyubinikpeɡ te
dɛ ha o ɡbaɡba.
18Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ koeh aa tɔnɔ
bɛlbwaa dɔ tɛo,
nɛn o wa aa toɡra
dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ.
19Nɛn o siwi aa swɛɛra
kɛŋɔ o waa toɡre kɛrɛdɛ la,
dɛ́ dɔ o nyu,
kɛ nɛn waa teŋa dɛɛ ɛ
wechɔɡa la te dɛ́ sewɛ.
20Korowii kii nɛn
o liire aa wola were,
o sie dɛ lɛ nɛn
o we-ɛɛla aa wera nɛ.
21A ɛ kpela kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
ɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛraa,
kɛ nɛndɛɛɡa te ɛɛ dɔ ba
nyuu.
22Handɛɛɡe waa wola da dɔe la,
do kɛŋɔ baa kpɔ
suuɡaswɛm noniseɡ
do parakoo mee ta!
23Nɛn o wa aa toɡra konnyini ɛ
wedɛɛɡa,
kɛ kon wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa dɛ
hwɛɡɛ o waa la,
o dɛ ba bandia ne.
24Nomɛl nɔn dɛ pili kɛ dɛ ta ɛɛ
dɔ,
asɛ bɛl ɡe nɔn aa pili
kɛ dɛ ɡe nya.
25Dɛɛ pili nɔn ásɛ wobɛlbwa do
wer tɛɛ,
dɛɛ cha banfala
ásɛ ba cha he ɡe.
26Nɛn waa tɔ mea cheɡ,
dɛɛ kpa suuɡajena la,
nɛra dɛ taahno,
kɛ onɔ la waa le o kwaa ne
dɛɛ yoɡa la,
ba swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo.
27He dɛ nyin wedɛɛɡa aa,
nɛra dɛ nyin he wa,
kɛ he dɛ nyin wechɔɡa aa,
he dɛ dɔ.
28Nɛn waa dɛ hwɛɡɛ o kondɔɔh
ta la, wɛɛ cholo
kɛŋɔ hwel saŋ papoo
yon le la,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te
ɛɛ do werii,
kɛŋɔ bwaala nee saŋ
papoo ken.
29Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ waa dɛɛ
dawɛ o dem tena nɛɛ la
dɛ chɔ pɛɛ.
Gɛɛ a do ɡɛne ɛɛ berɛ
wejereme bonɔɔ.
30Nɛn o wa aa toɡra we-ɛɛla
ɡelɔ nɛra ɛɛ dɔ mkpa,
kɛ naɡrenyin te
dɛ chɔɡ o bala.
31Nɛndɛɛɡa dɛ dɔ ba wedɛɛɡa
kembɔr harɛ nɔ ta naa,
ɡɛɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra baa wola
Korowii ɔmɛ la, ɛɛ ba ba
wechɔɡa kembɔr dɔe.

Title: SƐꞬLA 12
Content:
1Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin
o jemɛ waa la dɛ sɛh
chɔɡre.
Gɛnee wola sɛh kɛ ba baɡlo
wa.
2Korowii tea dɛ to nɛndɛɛɡa
nɛ,
dɛɛ pa nɛra baa dɛ lii
wechɔɡa bolchɔɡe.
3Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ aa won che
o we-ɛɛla ta dɛ́ lɛ o te,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te
dɛ́ so le kiŋkiŋ ken.
4Handɛɛɡe ɡelɔ o jaa ɛɛ dɔ
jirima,
kɛ haah waa kpɔ sihiih
dɛɛ kpo o jaa la,
do kɛŋɔ weela aa lɔ
nɛn nɛ.
5Nɛn o wa aa toɡra bol waa
dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta,
kɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar
o nyu te liire ɛ nyosone
ɡbosoo.
6Nɛnchɔɡe wobol do kɛŋɔ
nɛn aa sɔah dɛɛ nyin o dɔŋ
dɛ́ kpo,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra wobol
dɛ́ lɛ nɛra.
7Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra mun ɛɛ heo
kwaraa,
ásɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te
dwee do le.
8Wejeremee baa kpɛɛ,
dɛɛ nyiŋi ɡɛna nyubaahna.
9Dansaa waa dɔ bonɔɔ la,
bɔ nɛn waa dɛ lii o te
nɛnjen dɛ berɛ dɛɛ chɔ lɔr.
10Nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ nyiŋi
o kondɛɛra nɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ.
Nɛnchɔɡaa dɛɛ ɛ
nyubinikpeɡ ba kwaa nɛ.
11Paa waa swɛɛ siwi
dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee,
dɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona.
Gɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o te toma
aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe ta.
12Nɛnchɔɡa pɛla waa bwaa
kɛŋɔ bichɔɡwa,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te,
dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ ken.
13Nɛnchɔɡe nyoa wobolee
dɛɛ lawɔ,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te
dɛ́ le wahala ta.
14Nɛn kembɔr lɔ anɔ la
waa bol ne o we-ɛɛle ta.
Anee ɡela wɛɛ dɔ kwaa aa
chɛo.
15Gɛnee yon dɛɛ lii kɛŋɔ
o wobɛlbwa wer,
kɛ nɛn waa lɛ o dɔŋ waa
dɛɛ ja o kwaa ta laanee
wejereme.
16Gɛne bandiaa baa na warane,
kɛ nɛn waa dɔ nfɛrɛ laa
liire dɛɛ kpɔ chɛɡa ta.
17Nɛn waa dɛ di
kasinteŋ laanee
dɛɛ di danseɛ aa toɡra,
nyosonteŋnii dɛɛ di
dansewea.
18Nɛra baa dɛ bol waa
baa wola liire a ta do la,
ba wobol dɛ we kɛŋɔ
nii ken,
wejereme wobol dɛ larawe
bwara.
19Kasinteŋ lole saŋ bɛlbwa,
nyosonee dɔ jaɡa.
20Nyosone ɡboo nɛn waa
dɛ lii wechɔɡa nyu bini.
Nɛra baa dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna
ne la dɔ silɛɛ.
21Wechɔɡa aa nɛn o wa aa
toɡra pu,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te ne wejoree.
22Korowii kii nyosonteŋni,
o sie dɛ lɛ nɛn waa
dɛ di kasinteŋ nɛ.
23Wejereme dɛ tɔ o wejemwaa
ta,
ɡɛnee dɛɛ pili o ɡɛnewaa
ta dɛɛ tɛ nɛra.
24Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ toma kohonaa
dɛɛ dɔ nomonome,
bɔhwaahree dɛɛ do nɛn lɔɡa,
baa doo tomkpeɡa ta.
25Waa liira kohona do kɛŋɔ
bone ken,
asɛ wobodɛɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ sɔɔh
baah.
26Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa
dɛɛ tɛ o dɔŋ liidɛɛɡa,
nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ neɡre o dɔŋ.
27Nɛn waa ɛ bɔhwaah la,
waa o tetoo kwaa dɔ,
kɛ nɛn o sie aa wola
on hwah la o dɛ dɔ kwa.
28Waa aa toɡra ŋwɛnɛ chɔɔ kaa
mkpa ta,
wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ te,
seo taa o kaa.

Title: SƐꞬLA 13
Content:
1Bechawejeremee dɛɛ no waa o mɛɛ aa
dɛ doo a ta,
kɛ deŋnekpeɡ te te,
waa o wechɔɡa sɛh.
2He dɔ wobodɛɛɡa aa,
he na som,
kɛ nɛn waa wola kasinteŋ
bol te, dɛ na wa.
3He jemɛ he wobol nyiŋaa,
he laa he te
dɛɛ kpɔ waa ta,
kɛ nɛra baa bol waa baa
wola liire a ta do la,
dɛ chɔɡ ba te.
4Bɔhwaah bɛlbwa
aa o konnyini dɔ,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ nyin
toma te,
o dɛ dɔ kon waa dɛ nyin.
5Nɛn o wa aa toɡra
aa nyosone nyin,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe wobol te,
sihihwaa ne ncho ɡboo a
bwa.
6Nɛn wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ dɛ chao
o soɡa bini,
asɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɡe ɛɛ
chɔɡ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
7Nɛra bane dɛ ɛ ba te
kɛ dɔɔhna,
kɛ dɛ komɛlbwa toole
ba be,
bane ɡe ɛ ba te nyaara,
kɛ dɛ dɔɔhnaa ban.
8Dɔɔhnee ba lawɛ dɛɛ
lɛ suuɡa,
kɛ nyaa te, ba waane
laa o wa.
9Nɛn o wa aa toɡra soɡa bini
chaahnɔ kɛŋɔ bochaah ken,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te do kɛŋɔ
kandea waa dɛ dime.
10Waa nee jenu ɛɛ ba,
wejeremee dɛɛ bɔɔ waa
bini.
11Ŋwɛɛ ŋwɛnɛ waa kpɔ
o ta dɛɛ dɔ kwaa la,
ɡelɔ aa kaa kɛŋɔ peu ken.
Bɔwɔb kweena dɛ́ dɔ kwaa
ɡe ɡelɔ a che dɛɛ warɛ.
12He hwɛɡɛ kon ta,
dɛ he ta dɔe yaa,
he bambilee dɛɛ chɔɡ,
kɛ he hwɛɡɛ komɛl ta
dɛ dɔ aa, he sie dɛ lɛ.
13He ɡelɔ wedɛɛɡa kpɔ
he deŋna habɔɔ kaa laa,
waa he nyin
dɛɛ dawɛ he nɛ,
kɛ he teŋɛ a ta naa,
he bwara dɛ sɔɔhne.
14Wejereme webaɡla do kɛ bule
dɛɛ tɛ mkpa,
a dɛ le nɛn seo ta.
15Nɛn waa dɔ wejema la,
dɛ́ dɔ duure,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa wola
kasinteŋ dɔe te,
a dɛ kaa o ne wechɔɡa ta.
16Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ lii waa
mɔɔ dɛɛ ɛa,
kɛ ɡɛne te ɡelɔ baa na
o ɡɛna.
17Torome o wa aa wola
kasinteŋ dɔe laanee
dɛɛ ba waa ne.
Kɛ onɔ la o wa aa dɔ
kasinteŋ te,
o dɛ ba deŋnesɔɔhna ne.
18Nɛn waa wola jae no la
dɛ nya dɛɛ di sihiih,
kɛ naate waa dɛ no jae la,
o dɛ dɔ nyanyini.
19Na ɡɛ aa dɛ do som
kɛ haa dɔ ɡɛ haa dɛ nyin!
Nɛn waa ɡɛnaa ki o
wechɔɡa ta lee.
20Kpɔ he te pɛl wejereme
ásɛ dɛ jemɛ wa,
kɛ nɛn o ne ɡɛne aa pɛa la,
o dɛ na wahala.
21Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ne waa
bobɛlbwa,
kɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra te,
wedɛɛɡaa ɛ ba kembɔr.
22Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra
naanaree
dɛɛ di ba kapɛrɛre,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡa te kapɛrɛre
dɛ kaa nɛra
ba wa aa toɡra be.
23Dɛ nyaa koo kondikwaa ɛo
kohona naa,
nɛnchɔɡa ɡelɔ aa le
o nɔn ta.
24He dɛ fah he bie nyu aa,
dɛ haa on nyin,
kɛ dɛ he dɛ nyinu waa,
he do sie dɛɛ kaoh buɡ ta.
25Nɛn o wa aa toɡra
di kwaa o baah ɛɛ sɔɔhno,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te
dɛ chɔ lɔr saŋ bɛlbwa.

Title: SƐꞬLA 14
Content:
1Hanwejeremee dɛɛ vɔwɛ dea, kɛ hanɡɛnee yon
dɛɛ paɡre dea.
2Nɛn o wa aa toɡra laanee
dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre nɛraa
wola Korowii kpɔe dɛɛ ɛ
wobɛlbwa.
3Gɛne mbarafo wobol taa
a che wɛɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra,
asɛ wejereme wobol ɡe ɛɛ
leo waa ta.
4Bela baa kpɔ nae dɛɛ parɛ la,
dɛ nae toole naa,
kondikwa aa le do.
Kɛ nae lɔ bela tenaa,
kondikwaa dɛ bu.
5Nɛn waa dɔ kasinteŋ la
aa nyosone teŋe,
nɛn waa dɛ di dansewea la,
nyosone ɡboo o bwa.
6Nɛn waa dɛ mamɛ wejemwaa
la aa waa jemɛ,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no
waa mun te,
dɛ́ jemɛ waa warane.
7Laa he te kpɔ ɡɛne nɛ,
waa won baɡle wobɛlbwa.
8Wejereme jemɛ waa aa wera
kɛ o ɛ.
Gɛnee yon dɛɛ neɡre o nyu
kɛ o jemɔ.
9Gɛna waane laa wechɔɡa baa
ɛ wa,
nɛra ba wa aa toɡraa
yon dɛɛ soŋe ba wechɔɡa.
10Nomɛlbwa toole dɛ jemɛ
waa aa dɛ ha o dɔŋ,
kɛɛ ɡɛ o silɛɛ aa doa.
11Nɛnchɔɡe dem dɛ chole,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra dem
te dɛ che le.
12Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ
o soɡa waa soɡa la ken
wer, kɛ dɛ aa were,
o ka tona la ɛ seo.
13Mama bɛl ɡelɔ tebinichɔɡ ɛɛ
le nɛn nɛ,
asɛ silɛɛ bɛl habɔɔ ɡe ɛɛ
berɛ wii.
14Nɛn waa ɡel wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ
dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra,
nɛndɛɛɡa ɡe ɛɛ dɔ
ba we-ɛɛla kembɔr.
15Gɛnee yon dɛɛ yarada
wobɛlbwa waa dɛ no,
kɛ wejereme te dɛ́ nyiŋi
o vala bini.
16Wejereme dɛ nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ
o soɡa bini kɛ o bɛ waa dɔ.
Gɛnee dɛɛ ɛ waa saɡasaɡa,
o baah ɛɛ di warawara.
17Nɛn o baah aa wola
biɡri dii dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛnewa,
wejeremee dɛɛ lawɛ bambile.
18Nɛn ta wejema dɔe yaa,
a ɡelɔ wɛɛ ɡɛn kohona,
kɛ nɛn waa jemɛ waa te ne
wejemaa.
19Wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ ba ɡuŋi
nɛndɛɛɡa baa dɛ ɔmɛ
Korowii siee.
20Nyaa dɔŋ kwaraa laa sie dɛɛ
kpɔ o nɛ,
suuɡatee dɔ chamene tena
warɛ.
21Nɛn waa dɛ na nyaara sum
la, o na som,
kɛ a ɛ wechɔɡa kɛŋɔ
he hah he dɔŋ,
dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
22He dɛ lii liichɔɡa aa,
dɛ he kono,
kɛ he dɔ liidɛɛɡa aa,
nɛra dɛ yaradae,
dɛɛ tɛɛ duure ɡe.
23Koeh habɔɔ tɔnɔ do,
kɛ nyoa wobol te,
pɛɛpɛɛ dea aa la.
24Wejereme kondɔɔh o wejema,
asɛ ɡɛne ɡe we-ɛɛla
ɡel baa jemɔ.
25Kasinteŋ danseɛ dii
dɛ́ lɛ nɛn nyu,
dansewea tee dɛɛ le nɛn
habɔɔ.
26Baa waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii
bwara dɛ sɔɔhno.
Wɛɛ kpɔ nɔnee tɔ o haah
ne bii nɛ.
27Korowii ɔma do kɛ bule waa
dɛ tɛ mkpa,
anee dɛɛ le nɛn seo
ŋwɛnɛre ta.
28Nɛn nee baa di kora,
nɛra toole naa,
kora ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
29Nɛn o baah aa wola di
warawara la,
o dɛ no waa mun taeh,
kɛ nɛn waa wola bambile
dɔe la,
o dɛ maŋkura o te ɡɛna ta.
30Deŋnesɔɔhna dɛ tɛ bokpeɡa,
kɛ bɔweela te, ɛ weela.
31He dɛ do nyaara weweele aa,
he dɛ chɛɡɛ Korowii waa
ta ba,
kɛ he dɛ ɛɛ ba kɛrɛdɛ naa,
he dɛ tɛ Korowii jirima.
32Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ we-ɛɛlaa
dɛɛ ba o chɔɡa ne,
nɛn o wa aa toɡra
dɔ hwɛɡa, hale seo ta.
33Nɛn waa dɔ liiree dɔ wejema,
ɡɛnee wola wejema liire dɔe.
34Harɛ bɛl ɛɛ dɔ sɔnee yaa,
dɛ a cheɡɛ toɡra o nɛra aa
toɡra ta,
wechɔɡaa ɛ sihiih tɛ
harɛ bɛlbwa nɛra.
35Kooro bɛlbwa siwi dɛ su
o bonɔɔ waa jemɛ wa.
O dɛ tɛr onɔ la waa dɛ ɛ
sihihwaa deŋne.

Title: SƐꞬLA 15
Content:
1Tahaah dɛ sɔɔh bandia,
takpeɡ ɡe ɛɛ ir bwaawee.
2Wejereme wobol ɡelɔ wejema
ɛɛ dɔ pɛla,
ɡɛne ɡee dɛɛ bol waa
warawara,
wejema aa wola toole a ta.
3Korowii dɛ na bobɛlbwa,
o dɛ nyiŋi wechɔɡ-ɛɛra
ne wedɛɡ-ɛɛra bwa.
4Wobodɛɛɡa do kɛŋɔ tɛɛɡa ken,
neɡra wobolee dɛɛ ku loo.
5Gɛnee dɛɛ vɛh o mɛɛ wa,
kɛ nɛn baa dɛ jao
wɛɛ no la, dɛ jemɛ wa.
6Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa
dɛɛ dɔ kondɔɔh o dem,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡa kwaa dɔe
dɛ tɛɛ ba wa.
7Wejerema wobol
dɛ tɛ wejema,
Gɛne wobolee wola won
wobɛlbwa tɛ.
8Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡa saraha,
o dɛ no nɛra ba wa aa
toɡra wesoŋa.
9Korowii hah nɛnchɔɡa
we-ɛɛla,
O dɛ nyin nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ
waa aa toɡra ta.
10He laa sie kpɔ wedɛɛɡa ta
naa,
he dɛ dɔ deŋnetɛra kohona,
he kii kɛ ba bol waa baɡle
naa,
sewee hɛɛ dɔ.
11Korowii dɛ na lalbɔɔ
ne lalabwɛɛ waa bwa,
a ta do kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini
bambile bini.
12Nɛn waa dɛ muɡli nɛra baah
la,
aa nɛn waa jao la waa nyin,
waa nɛn waa jemɛ waa la
be la.
13Nɛn sie lɛo waa, o dɛ mamɛ,
o loo kuu tenaa, o bambile
dɛ chɔɡ.
14Nɛra baa dɔ liire la pɛlaa dɛɛ
lawɛ
kɛŋɔ ba hweli waa dɛɛ ja,
ɡɛnee dɛɛ do sie ɡɛnewaa
ta.
15Nɛra baa lɔ wahala ta la
soɡa bini aa were,
kɛ nɛra ba sie aa dɛ lɛ la,
do kɛŋɔ baa dɛ di
kondikonjena
saŋ bɛlbwa ken.
16He dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛ dɔ
kwaa tama,
bɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɔ kwaa
kohona dɛɛ dɔ wa.
17He di dɔkpɔɡa dɔr komɛlbwa
aa wola toole a ta bela baa
dɛ nyini,
bɔ kɛŋɔ haa di nao waa do
noo dɔr bela baa haeh.
18Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di
warane la dɛ ba naɡra ne,
kɛ nɛn waa dɔ bambile te
dɛ sɔɔh waa nyoa.
19Bɔhwaah soɡa bini do kɛŋɔ,
waa dɛ valɛ sɔɔhne ta,
kɛ he waa toɡraa,
he ŋwɛnɛ wer.
20Bechawejereme ɡelɔ o mɛɛ
baŋa ɛɛ pa,
kɛ biɡɛne te hah o nya,
dɛɛ nyiŋi o nyubaah.
21Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe la,
ɡɛnewaa dɛ lɛ o sie,
kɛ nɛn waa dɔ liire la waa
toɡrɔ.
22He maɡle waa dɛ he ta
jajaa dɔe yaa, a dɛ chɔɡ,
kɛ dɛ he dɔ jajaala waraa,
a dɛ do wer.
23He chaŋe waa aŋwɛnɛ ta naa,
a dɛ ba silɛɛ ne dɛɛ tɛɛ.
Waa bola a saŋ ta wer ɡa.
24Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ kpɔ
mkpa ŋwɛnɛ ta,
dɛ laa o te dɛɛ kpɔ waa aa
ba seo ne.
25Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ mbarafo la,
Korowii dɛ chɔɡ o dem,
dɛ kpɔ nɔn dɛɛ tɔ luhaahna
kwaa ta.
26Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡa liire,
nɛndɛɛɡa liiree dɛɛ lɛ o sie.
27Nɛn waa dɛ nyin kafo la
kpɔ waa dɛɛ ba o ne
dem tena nɛ,
kɛ nɛn waa kia kɛ ba yawɔ
sen la ɛɛ so lee.
28Nɛn o wa aa toɡraa yon dɔ
haŋra waa ta mɔɔ
dɛɛ chaŋe,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡee yon too
wobochɔɡa ɛɛ le o nyoa.
29Korowii ne wechɔɡ-ɛɛ baah
jaŋne,
o dɛ no nɛn o wa aa toɡra
wesoŋa.
30Dɔŋa be mama dɛ́ ba silɛɛ ne,
asɛ amanesoma ɡe ɛɛ ba
bokpeɡa ne.
31Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no jae
aa dɛ ba mkpa ne la,
o ne wejeremaa dɛɛ pɛ.
32Nomɛlbwa waa wola jae no
la ta o nyu,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ no jae la,
o dɛ no waa mun.
33Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii la
dɛ jemɛ wa,
he ta he te pwɛraa,
haa jirima dɔ.

Title: SƐꞬLA 16
Content:
1Nɛwɛnyinii dɛɛ maɡle wa,
asɛ Korowii ɛɛ baɡle
ɡɛ haa bola a do wer.
2Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ
o we-ɛɛla wer o be,
kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi
a bini.
3Kpɔ he wobɛlbwa haa ɛ la
do Korowii nɔn ta,
ásɛ wobɛlbwa haa maɡla la
do wer tɛɛ.
4Wobɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛ la,
dɛ waane waa dɛ nyin
waa o ɛa.
O ɡelɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɛɛ so le,
ka tel saŋ baa dɔ deŋnetɛra.
5Korowii hah nɛn
waa dɛ ɛ mbarafo,
kpelaa, naate ɛɛ di
bolchɔɡee dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra.
6Nyina ne kasinteŋ taa
wechɔɡa kpɔe dɛ kɛ do.
Korowii ɔma ɡe taa
nɛn che dɛɛ ke wechɔɡa.
7Dɛ nɛn waa dɛ su Korowii
siwi aa,
o ɡelɔ deŋnesɔɔhna ɛɛ ba o
ne o dɔma kwaraa baah ta.
8Ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta cheɡa dɔ
kontama wer,
ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ
ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta,
dɛ dɔa kohona.
9Nɛn nyubini liire nee wɛɛ
maɡle wa,
kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ baɡle
waa waa ɛ.
10Kooro nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ
Korowii waa ken,
waa bole pae ta koni.
11Korowii dɛ nyin kasinteŋ
bona dii waa ta,
a waa o ɡel kwaa baa kpɔa
dɛɛ kari kwaa do le.
12Kooro bɛlbwa kii wechɔɡa,
waa aa toɡraa ɡela kora
ɛɛ che.
13Koranar siwi dɛ́ su nɛn
waa dɛ bol kasinteŋ,
ba dɛ nyin nɛn
waa dɛ bol kpela.
14Kooro baah diu waa,
wɛɛ won ɡel ba kpoe,
wejeremee jemɛ o larawa.
15Kooro sie lɛo waa,
a dɛ ba mkpa ne,
a do kɛŋɔ sitɔ bwaala
baama ken,
a nɛo waa, kwaa dɛ do wer.
16A wer kɛŋɔ haa dɔ wejema
ne waa mun noe,
dɛ ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa dɔ
suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋa!
17Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la
dɛ ke wechɔɡa o vala bini,
nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyiŋi
o vala bini la, dɛ dɔ o nyu.
18Mbarafo dɛ ba chɔɡa ne,
asɛ maŋkurae ɡe ɛɛ ba harɛ
lɔe ne.
19He pwɛre he te
dɛ nya bɔ ɡwaa
kɛŋɔ he ne mbarafo tena
aa bɔne laa ta kwa.
20Nomɛlbwa waa cheɡ deŋne
dɛɛ no waa la, dɛ́ dɔ kɛrɛdɛ,
nomɛlbwa waa dɛ hwɛɡɛ
Korowii nɛɛ la, o na som.
21Nɛn o liire aa wera
dɛ dɔ wejema
laanee ba ŋɔ o dɛ no waa
mun.
O wobosoma taa a che
nɛra sɛh dɛɛ ba o be.
22Wejema do kɛ bule dɛɛ tɛ
wejereme mkpa,
asɛ ɡɛne ɡe deŋnetɛra ɛɛ
leo o ɡɛnewaa ta.
23Wejeremee lii waa mɔɔ dɛɛ
bol,
o wobol ɡelɔ nɛra sɛh
dɛɛ ba o be.
24Wobodɛɛɡa do kɛŋɔ tohnoo
ken,
a som nyoa ta dɛɛ tɛ
bokpeɡa ɡe.
25Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ
o soɡa waa soɡa la ken
wer, kɛ dɛ aa were,
o ka tona la ɛ seo.
26Teabɔɔ ɡela nɛn ɛɛ ɛ toma,
onee dɛɛ doo a ta.
27Nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ vɔrɔwe
wechɔɡa,
o wobol do kɛŋɔ ninlao
ken.
28Nɛnchɔɡee kpɔ waa dɛɛ perɛ,
onee dɛɛ ba waa ne,
dɛɛ peɡri daamanar baah.
29Nɛn waa dɛ nyin yoi la dɛ
faah o dɔŋ,
o kpɔ o dɔŋ la dɛɛ kpɔ
ŋwɛnɛchɔɡe ta.
30Nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ
waa ta la dɛ lii wechɔɡa,
o dɛ tɔ nyoa nyiŋi wechɔɡa
chiɡ.
31Nyumpompoŋa ɛ jirima
botire,
nɛn o wa aa toɡra laanee
dɛɛ dɔa.
32Bambile dɔe wer ɡwaa
banyoo tenten,
he jemɛ he te lawa aa,
a ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa yoa lɛ
bwɛbir.
33Nɛra dɛ ta bie dɛɛ nyin liire a
ta,
kɛ Korowiirii jemɛ
ɡɛ aa chiɡ.

Title: SƐꞬLA 17
Content:
1Kondikonchwee bosɔɔhna aa lɔ a ta,
ɡwaa kondikondɛɛɡa naɡra
aa lɔ a ta.
2Yom waa jemɛ waa la,
dɛ nyiŋi o dɔɔ bie
o wa aa wola kɛrɛdɛ doe nɛ,
o dɛ dɔ kapɛrɛ kwaa aa ɛ
bii la kwaa la ane.
3Niinii ba kpɔ dɛɛ jemɛ
suuɡapoŋ
ne suuɡaswɛm kɛŋɔ a wer,
ɡɛɛ Korowii ɡe ɛɛ nyiŋi
bambile bini.
4Nɛnchɔɡee dɛɛ do deŋna
wobochɔɡa ta,
ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe cheɡ
deŋne dɛɛ no musuwa.
5He dɛ mamɛ nyaaraa,
Korowii waa ta baa hɛɛ
chɛɡɛ,
ɡɛɛ a do dɛ he sie dɛ lɛ
he dɔŋ wahala ta naa,
hɛɛ ba deŋnetɛra kohona
dɔe.
6Banjeni ne hanjeni jirimaa ba
naanar,
ɡɛɛ nya ne mɛɛ ɡe jirima ɛ
ba bii.
7Mbarafo wobol aa were tɛ
ɡɛne,
ɡɛɛ a ta chɛ kɛ kooro teŋe
nyosone.
8Nɛn waa dɛ yawɛ nomɛl sen la,
dɛ lii kɛŋɔ a ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl
waa kpɔ o ta dɛ vɔrɔwo.
O dɛ lii kɛ ɡɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o
wobɛlbwa do wer tɛo.
9Nɛn waa laa sie dɛɛ kpɔ waa
o dɔŋ aa ɛo ta la dɔ nyina.
A kpoŋa dɛɛ bol te dɛ peɡri
darame.
10Nɛn waa jemɛ wa dɛ́ hweli waa
dɛɛ le webeŋkpoŋ haa bol
baɡlo ta la,
ɡwaa ɡɛne baa chao
chweema kera lafa.
11Nɛnchɔɡe waa dɛ nyin
deŋnekpeɡ we-ɛɛla ɡbo la
nɛn waa wola nɛn sum naa
baa tomɛ o be.
12He cheme sisire baa pa o bii
kaa
bɔ ɡɛne waa lɔ o ɡɛne
we-ɛɛla ta.
13He kpɔ wechɔɡa dɛɛ bɔ
wedɛɛɡa kem aa,
wechɔɡa aa he demii
paŋɛ bwa.
14Naɡra mumpar do kɛŋɔ
haa teɡɛ nee bio,
waa la aa wola dɔe do kan
la,
teŋe a ta mɔɔ a kaa sie.
15Korowii hah nɛn waa dɛ pa
nɛn
waa wola wechɔɡa ɛɛ
bolchɔɡe,
dɛ hah nɛn waa pa nɛn
waa ɛ wechɔɡa boldɛɛɡe ɡe.
16Tɔnɔ besoo a dɔ kɛŋɔ ɡɛne
kpoŋe suuɡa
dɛɛ nyin wejema dɛ o ta a
liire dɔe yɔ?
17Darame dɛ baɡle nyina saŋ
bɛlbwa,
asɛ lolanar ɡe do le tɛ dɔŋa
chae waa ta.
18Gɛnee di ajinamuu
dɛɛ tɛ nomɛlbwa.
19Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin
naɡra sie dɛ lɛ wechɔɡa ta,
ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ ta nyoa ɛɛ
kaa chɔɡa ta.
20Nɛnchɔɡe waa kpɔ waa dɛɛ
perɛ,
aa andɛɛɡa dɔ,
ɡɛɛ nɛn o nyondoŋe aa bar
o nyu la ɛɛ na wa.
21Biɡɛne lola dɛ we,
silɛɛ toole tɛ o mɛɛ.
22Silɛɛ dɛɛ tɛ bokpeɡa,
asɛ lokua ɡee sɔɔh nɛn.
23Nɛnchɔɡee ba sɔh dɛɛ yawɛ
sen,
asɛ wɛɛ berɛ waa sie.
24Wejereme sie lɔ wejema ta
saŋ bɛlbwa,
ɡɛnee wola wobɛlbwa dɔe
dawɛ o sie ta.
25Biɡɛnee wola ɡelɛ o mɛɛ sie
ɛɛ lɛ,
onee ɡela o nya tea bini ɛɛ
chɔɡ.
26A ta maɡrɛ kɛŋɔ nɛn ɛ kɛrɛdɛ
ba tɛr o deŋne,
kɛɛ dɛ lɔɔ nomonome baa
dɛ di kasinteŋ.
27Wejereme wobol lɔ tamaa
ken,
nɛn waa dɛ no waa mun la
jemɛ o te lawa.
28Hale ɡɛne tɔ o nyoa so naa,
ba dɛ liiru wejereme.

Title: SƐꞬLA 18
Content:
1Nɛn waa wola nɛra baah jo la waane laa
nomɛlbwa wa,
o dɛ lɛ ɡaeh, waa nɛn waa
lɛɛ dɛɛ do.
2Gɛne waane laa waa mun
noe,
o waa bwaa kɛŋɔ o ɡe
baɡle o wejema.
3Nyubinikpeɡii dɛɛ ba nɛn bɛ
bua ne,
sihiih ɡe ɛɛ ba ncho dii ne.
4Nɛn nyoa wobol do kɛŋɔ
nee waa luŋa ken,
wejema leebɔr do kɛŋɔ
nee waa dɛ palɛ.
5Aa were kɛŋɔ bá nyiŋi
nɛnchɔɡe siebɔr,
dɛ́ kpɔ bolchɔɡe tɛ nɛn
waa wola bolchɔɡe dii.
6Gɛne wobol dɛ ba naɡra ne,
o nyoa wobolee ɡela baa
lɔɔro.
7Gɛne wobolee dɛɛ chɔɡo,
o nyoa dɛɛ doo waa ta.
8Nɛn ŋwala som,
a do kɛŋɔ kondikonsoma
aa dɛ jo tea.
9Bɔhwaah aa toma ɛɛ nyin,
o dɔŋee nɛn waa dɛ chɔɡ
kwa.
10Korowii do kɛŋɔ dejaŋ waa
kpeɡa,
belaa nɛra ba wa aa
toɡra
bwa chwa dɛɛ kaa wɛɛ
lɛɛ ba.
11Kondɔɔhna dɛ lii kɛŋɔ ba
kondɔɔh
do kɛ bwɛjen baa ma
danjwɛkpeɡ baro,
ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ o ɛ kon
waa dɛ ba wona lɛɛ ba.
12Maŋkurae nɛn aa dɛ
maŋkura o te
laanee dɛɛ ba o harɛ lɔe
ne,
pwɛra waa dɛ pwɛr o te
ɡe ɛɛ tɛo jirima.
13A ɛ ɡɛnewaa dɛ dɔ sihiih
kɛŋɔ haa wola waa mun
noɛ dɛɛ chaŋe.
14Liire haa dɔ he weela ta kɛŋɔ
hɛɛ ɡbaŋroo la, dɛ ɛ ɡɛ,
dɛ he ta ɡɛ liire dɔe yaa,
dɛ hwɛɡa toole.
15Wejerema dɔ liire kɛŋɔ
baa dɛɛ hweli waa,
baa cheɡ deŋnee dɛɛ no
wa.
16Koŋkɛɛla pili ŋwɛnɛ dɛɛ tɛ
nɛn,
a ɡelɔ wɛɛ jo nomonome
bini.
17Suune anɛ ta sie yaa,
haa nyosom te jemɛ.
Nɛn tɔ sie bɔ on koro aa,
nɛra dɛ lii kɛ o waa toɡrɔ.
Nemenɛ o dɔŋ baa baɡle
o waa bini mɔɔ.
18Waa lɔ nɛra banɛ ba waa
aa kpeɡa baah ta naa,
Korowii siee ba kpɔ dɛɛ bil
wɛɛ baɡle a kasinteŋ.
19A kpeɡri kɛŋɔ he won kwaa
he ne he dam haa ɛo
wechɔɡa baah,
ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa paɡre
danjwɛkpeɡ
baa maa bar bwɛjen.
Naɡra do kɛŋɔ bune baa kpɔa
kaɡre bwɛjen doonyoa la.
20He bol wedɛɛɡaa, he dɛ vaɡɛ
kɛŋɔ haa di kondikondɛɛɡa
ken,
wobol aa wera ɡelɔ he
baah ɛɛ sɔɔhne.
21Nyoa wobol dɛ ba seo ne
mkpa ne.
Anomanta, nyiŋi he nyoa
wobol bini kɛrɛdɛ,
dɛ bɛ waa dɔ.
22He dɔ haah naa, dɛ he dɔ
kondɛɛɡe,
a dɛ baɡle kɛ Korowii chae.
23Nyaa dɛ bol wa aa,
o kpɔ nɔɔra dawɛ dɔŋa nɛɛ
dɛɛ soŋe,
kondɔɔhnee dɛɛ chaŋe waa
kpeɡri nɛ.
24Chamene tena kpɔe kohona
dɛ chɔɡe,
kɛ damsom bɛl ɡwaa lole.

Title: SƐꞬLA 19
Content:
1Nyaa o bwara aa wola
wechɔɡe bɛlbwa dɔe la,
ɡwaa nyosonteŋni waa
ɡɛna.
2Aa were kɛŋɔ nɛn nya wejema,
ɡɛɛ dɛ haa waa bini nyiŋi
dɛɛ ɛa warawara ɡe aa,
hɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa.
3Nɛŋɡɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o te,
kɛ o yon berɛ kpɔ nya
Korowii nɛ.
4Dɔɔh daamanaree dɛɛ warɛ,
nyaa daamanaree yon
chwao.
5He di dansewea aa, he dɛ dɔ
deŋnetɛra,
ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe aa wola
o bwara kpɔe kaa di.
6Nɛra ɡalɡa takapɔ kɛŋɔ
ba waa ɛɛ lɛ nɛnjen sie,
ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa ɡe ɛ nɛn
waa dɛ kɛ kwaa dam.
7He nyao waa, he lolanar dɛ́
vɛɛh,
n baa bol he daamanar wa.
He dɔ waa dɛɛ nyin ba bɔr
aa, haa ban na.
8Nomɛlbwa waa dɔ wejema la,
dɔ nyina tɛ o ɡbaɡba,
ɡɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ no waa
mun la,
o wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do wer.
9Dansewea te dɛ́ dɔ deŋnetɛra,
ɡɛɛ nyosonteŋni ɡe ɛɛ sewɛ.
10Yɛɛra ta ɡɛne chɛɛ,
ɡɛɛ yom ɡe aa wola chɛɛ
kɛ nomonjena do o lɔɡa.
11Wejeremee won bambile
lawa,
o dɛ dɔ jirima waa kpɔe dɛ́
kɛ ta.
12Kooro bandia do kɛŋɔ
nyujente aa sia ken,
asɛ o silɛɛ ɡe do kɛŋɔ
mɛn aa ta kpɔɡa ta ken.
13Bibaa waa ɡɛna dɛ́ tɛ o mɛɛ
wa,
asɛ hannaɡrenyini we-ɛɛla
do kɛŋɔ
nee aa dɛ kor la ken.
14Dem ne suuɡaa baa ne
o haah sewɛ dɛɛ ɡel o bii,
kɛ handɛɛɡe te, Korowiirii
dɛɛ tɛ.
15Bɔhwaahree dɛɛ chɔ dom
kohona,
ɡɛɛ nɛn waa wola waane
ɛɛ nyin la ɡe ɛɛ chɔ lɔr.
16Nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ Korowii
Mmara ta la, o dɛ dɔ o
nyu,
nɛn waa wola a ta teŋɛ la,
ó dɛ sewɛ.
17Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ nyaa kɛrɛdɛ la,
Korowiirii o kpɔ dɛɛ kemɛ,
waa waa ɛa la, o dɛ tɛo a
nachiɡe.
18Kah he bii, ba nɛɛ he dɔ
hwɛɡa kerekere,
dɛ ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ ɡeloo ba
chɔɡ.
19Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di
kohona dɔ wa aa,
bɛ on lɛ, ɡel a noo,
ɡɛ laa aa hɛɛ teŋɔɔ dɛɛ lɛo.
20Ba dɛ jae naa dɛɛ no,
dɛɛ teŋɛ a ta, ásɛ tɔpebɛl
he ba dɔ wejema.
21Nɛn won waa maɡla kohona,
kɛ anɔ la Korowii aa dɛ
nyin laanee dɛɛ ɛ.
22Kɛrɛdɛ nɛn aa dɛ ɛ waa
ba teŋɛ dɛɛ nyin o wa,
nɛn nyao bɔ kɛŋɔ waa dɛ
teŋe nyosone.
23Korowii ɔmaa dɛɛ ba mkpa
ne,
anee ɡela nɛn liire ɛɛ chɔ
bobeŋkpoŋ o bwara ɛɛ
sɔɔhno.
24Nɛra bane bɔhwaah ɡwaa ba
nɛɛ kɛ,
bá won kpɔ kondikwaa
kwaraa la nyoa.
25Bammuɡli nɛn dɔ deŋnetɛra
aa,
nɛra baa wola wobɛlbwa
jemɛ hweli waa
dɛɛ le a ta,
ɡɛɛ ba baɡle wejereme
waa, wɛɛ jemɛ wa.
26Bechala waa dɛ fiiɡi o mɛɛ,
dɛ doŋi o nya dɛɛ le dem
la, o ɛ sihihbie.
27N bie, he dɛ vɛh waa baa
dɛ doe a ta hwela aa,
hɛɛ le wejema ŋwɛnɛ taa.
28Dansewea tee kpɔ o dɔŋ
kasinteŋ waa dɛɛ hɛlɛ,
ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa ɛɛ do
wechɔɡ-ɛɛ
som kɛ kondikwa.
29Deŋnetɛra chɔ le kpa
bammuɡli nɛn,
ɡɛɛ lɔɔra ɡe do le tɛ ɡɛne.

Title: SƐꞬLA 20
Content:
1Sen nyɔe kohona ɡelɔ
nɛn ɛɛ do ɡbɔɡa dɛɛ ɡɛn.
Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ a nyɔe
berɛ o toma la ta liire dɔe.
2Kooro bandia do kɛŋɔ
nyujente aa dɛ si ken.
Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ doo
bwaawee la dɛ ta o nyu.
3Baa bɛlbwa jirimaa kɛŋɔ
o laa o te kpɔ naɡra
we-ɛɛla ta,
ɡɛnee dɛɛ nyin yoi.
4Paa waa dɛ ɛ bɔhwaah
kwaa para saŋ la,
ɡɛɛ waa wola kondikwaa
dɔ a koma saŋ ɡe.
5Waa aa lɔ nɛn liire bini
do kɛŋɔ bule waa luŋa bini
nee ken,
naate waa dɔ wejema
laanee won nee la dɔe.
6Nɛra ɡalɡa dɛ bol ŋɔ
ba dɔ nyina saŋ bɛlbwa,
kɛ umee dɛ́ won jemɛ nɛn
o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ ɔ?
7Nɛn o wa aa toɡra o bwara
aa wola wechɔɡe bɛlbwa
dɔe la, o seo habɔɔ,
o bii dɛ na som.
8Kooro soɡe o kookara ta
dɛ́ bol waa dɛ́ pa bole aa,
o dɛ na anɔ la aa wola
were.
9Umee dɛ́ won ŋɔ, “N te tea
bini too,
wechɔɡa toole n nɛ kwaraa
nɔ?”
10Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah
nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta,
ne kon baa kpɔa dɛɛ maɡɛ
kwaa o faah la.
11Bechala we-ɛɛla taa ba che
dɛɛ jemɛ kɛ o ɛ
bechadɛɛɡe.
12Deŋna nɛn aa kpɔa dɛɛ no
waa nɔ,
ne sibie waa dɛ na a ne nɔ,
Korowiirii ta a bwa.
13Dom dɛ do he som kohona
naa, nyae hɛɛ nya,
he iro dɛɛ ɛ toma aa,
kondikwaa dɛɛ bu he nɛ.
14He yon ŋɔ kon yoɡ aa were,
dɛ berɛ kaa maŋkura he te
o yawa ta.
15Dɛ he jemɛ waa haa dɛ
bol aa, he dɔ kon ɡwaa
suuɡaswɛm ne suuɡapoŋ.
16Nomɛl di hɔɔh ajinamuu
he be naa, lɛ o yal cheɡ,
dɛ naate ta he bini bɛl ɛɛ
yaa,
lɛ o komɛl cheɡ awɔba.
17He kpɔ neɡra ŋwɛnɛ lɛ
kwaa di aa, a som,
kɛ a habɔɔ la, a dɛ do kpeli
he nyoa bini.
18Wobɛlbwa haa maɡla la,
ɡel ba jae mɔɔ he ɛ.
Nyin ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe mɔɔ
dɛ vɔrɔwe laa.
19Nɛn waa dɛ ɡaaɡe la dɛ taa
nyokpɛl,
anomanta, laa he te kpɔ nɛn
waa dɛ bol waa kohona nɛ.
20He taah he nya kɛɛ he mɛɛ aa,
he piɡro dɛɛ sewɛ kɛŋɔ
kandea aa dima biro ta la.
21Dɛ he ta koɛh dɛ dɔ he te
mumpar aa,
a habɔɔ la, aa hen kɛrɛdɛ
chiɡ.
22Bɛ wechɔɡa kpɔ bɔ wechɔɡa
kem,
dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ Korowii nɛɛ
o ɛ wobɛlbwa tɛɛ.
23Korowii kii nɛn waa dɛ faah
nɛra kwaa yoɡa ta,
ne onɔ la baa kpɔa dɛɛ
maɡɛ kwaa dɛɛ faah nɛn.
24Korowiirii kpɔ ya nakpale
ɛɛ cheɡ bela waa wera,
ɛrɛɛ nɛn ɛɛ ba wona jemɛ
o vala bini nɔ?
25He toolo baɡɛ Korowii nyoa
aa, a ɛ bel dɛ chɔ kpae,
a habɔɔ a ba ɛ waa dawɛ
he nɛ.
26Kooro waa jemɛ waa laanee
yon na nɛnchɔɡe, dɛ yon tɛr
o deŋne waa wola o sum
na.
27Korowii hweera waa hweera
do nɛn bini la,
do kɛ kandea dɛɛ chaah
waa aa lɔ ya liire bini.
28Nyina ne kasinteŋ ɡelɔ
Kooro ɛɛ biɡri,
nyina taa a che o kora ɛɛ
che.
29Bonɔɔ bokpeɡaa ɡela o dɔ
jirima,
ɡɛɛ nyumpompoŋa ɡel
banjeni ɛɛ dɔ duure.
30Deŋnetɛra kohona won
wechɔɡa laa
dɛ́ kpɔ nɛn bambile ta.

Title: SƐꞬLA 21
Content:
1Kooro bɛlbwa liire lɔ Korowii nɔn ta,
kɛŋɔ nɛn yon pere bɔr
tɛ nee wɛɛ kpɔ o ta la.
2Nɛwɛnyini dɛ lii kɛŋɔ
o wobɛlbwa toɡrɔ o be,
kɛ Korowiirii dɛɛ nyiŋi a
bini.
3We-ɛɛla aa wera dɛ toɡre,
dɛ su Korowii siwi
ɡwaa kɛŋɔ haa ɛ saraha
tɛo.
4Sisa we-ɛɛla ne mbarafo,
ne wedoŋa bwa ɛ wechɔɡa.
5Nɛn waa dɛ maɡle waa
kɛrɛdɛ la dɛ́ dɔ kwaa taeh,
kɛ he too waa ta naa,
nyae hɛɛ nya.
6He kpɔ nyosone ŋwɛnɛ ta
dɛ dɔ kwa aa,
a dɛ le he nɔn ta kɛŋɔ
peu ken, dɛ́ berɛ ba seo ne.
7Nyubinikpeɡ te naɡrenyinii
dɛɛ chɔɡo,
o dɛ vɛh waa aa wera ɛɛ.
8Nɛn waa di waa ane bolchɔɡe
la,
o wobɛlbwa aa toɡre,
kɛ nɛn waa di bole la soɡa
bini toɡrɔ.
9He ɡbo soɡe saldoa bɔ
kɛ he ne hannaɡrenyini aa
pɛ dem.
10Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te bɛlbwa
dɛ nyin wechɔɡa taeh,
waa o dɔŋ nɛɛ sune.
11Bammuɡli nɛn dɔ deŋnetɛra
aa,
ɡɛne hweli waa dɛɛ le a ta,
ɡɛɛ ba baɡle wejereme wa
aa, wɛɛ jemɛ wa.
12Korowii O Wa Aa Toɡra
jemɛ waa aa lɔ nɛnchɔɡe
dem.
Wɛɛ tɛr o deŋnee.
13He laa deŋna kpɔ nyaa wii
waa dɛ wi ta naa,
he ɡe ɛɛ baa wiu,
haa nɛnee dɔ ó lɛɛ.
14Dɛ nomɛl baah di he nɛ,
he sɔh kpɔ kon kɛo waa,
a ɡelɔ o baah ɛɛ sɔɔh.
15Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la,
ba bol kasinteŋ aa,
o sie dɛ lɛ,
dɛ ɛ ɔmee kohona tɛ
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra.
16Nɛn waa kona le
wejema ŋwɛnɛ ta la,
sewaa wɛɛ sewɛ.
17He dɛ nyin silɛɛbɔra
kohona naa, nyae hɛɛ nya.
Gɛɛ dɛ he dɛ nyin sen
ne kondikondɛɛɡa aa,
a do dɛɛ tɛɛ.
18Nyubinikpeɡ te dɛ nyin nɛn
o wa aa toɡra ne wechɔɡa
aa, a dɛ ɡure o nɛ.
19Baa ɡbo soɡo bɔ ɡwaa
kɛŋɔ waa mo
hannaɡrenyini
o baah aa dɛ di kohona.
20Nɛn waa jemɛ waa la dɛ́ dɔ
kondɔɔh ne kondɛɛɡa,
kɛ ɡɛnee dɛɛ chɔɡ o kwa.
21Nɛn waa teŋɛ waa aa toɡra
ta, dɛ dɔ nyina ɡe la,
o dɛ biɡri,
o wobɛlbwa ɡe ɛɛ
do wer wɛɛ dɔ jirima.
22Nɛn waa jemɛ waa la
won bwɛjen bokpeɡa tena
aa lɔ o ta yoi, dɛ́ paɡre ba
dekpeɡa baa dɛ hwɛɡɛ a ta.
23He jemɛ he nyoa lawa aa,
haa waa dɔ.
24Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ maŋkura
o te la dɛ́ ɛ mbarafo.
O ɛ bammuɡli nɛn o
we-ɛɛla ɛɛ ɡwaa kohona.
25Bɔhwaah pɛla konee dɛɛ
kpoo,
dɛkalkɛ waa toma ɛɛ nyin.
26O sie dɛ beɡre kohona
o dɔ kwaa dɛɛ ja tɔpere
bɛlbwa.
Kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra la te
ta tea dɛɛ tɛ kon,
waa nɔn nyore.
27Korowii kii nɛnchɔɡe saraha,
n baa bol kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ
liichɔɡa ɛa.
28Dansewea te dɛ sewɛ,
asɛ nomɛlbwa waa dɛ no
o be la ɡe sewɛ.
29Nɛnchɔɡe dɛ ɛ o siebɔr
kɛŋɔ o ɛ nɛndɛɛɡe,
nɛn o wa aa toɡra te
dɛ́ nyiŋi o waa bini kɛrɛdɛ.
30Nɛwɛnyini wejema ne waa
mun noe,
dɛ wejaala ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ,
dɛ Korowii ta o nɛɛ jae yaa.
31He dɔ jaɡre ɡɛ bɛlbwa
dɛ won kpɔa yo aa,
Korowiirii dɛ won ɡel he
yo le.

Title: SƐꞬLA 22
Content:
1Sɔndɛɛɡee chɛ nyina ɡwaa kondɔɔh tenten,
ɡɛɛ duure do wer ɡwaa
suuɡapoŋ kɛɛ suuɡaswɛm.
2Suuɡate ne nyaa bwa
ɛ beŋkpoŋ Korowii be.
Onee ta ba bwa.
3Wejereme dɛ na waa aa lɔ sie
dɛɛ ba dɛ fel dɛɛ kea,
nɛn waa wola wobɛlbwa
jemɛɛ yon ka jo a ta
dɛɛ na wa.
4Ɔmɛ Korowii, pwɛr he te,
hɛɛ dɔ kwaa ne jirima
ne mkpajaŋee.
5Nafuɡere ne sɔɔhne lɔ
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ŋwɛnɛ ta,
he dɛ nyin he nyu aa,
laa he te kpɔ ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ la
ta.
6Do he bie kɛrɛdɛ waa aa
wera ta,
ásɛ dɛ o baa kpeɡ aa,
o bɛ an ɡel.
7Gɛ suuɡate aa dɛ di kpeɡri
nyaa nɛɛ la,
ɡɛɛ nɛn waa di kem la ɛ nɛn
waa kemɔ suuɡa la bonɔɔ.
8Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ ɛ
wechɔɡa la dɛ na a wa,
nɛra waa dɛ ɛɛ ba hɔhɔrɔwa
la dɛ ba a jaɡa.
9Nɛn waa dɔ tesom
dɛɛ tɛ nyaara kondikwa la,
Korowii ɡelɔ wɛɛ na som.
10Doŋi bammuɡli nɛn le he
jwɛh,
ásɛ wobobala ne naɡra
ne chɛɡa bwa tonɛ.
11Dɛ he dɔ bambidɛɛɡe
dɛ jemɛ wobol aa,
kooro dɛ kpɔe dam.
12Korowii dɛ nyiŋi nomɛlbwa
waa dɔ wejema,
dɛ taɡɛ nyosonteŋni waa
dɛɛ ta.
13Bɔhwaahree yon ŋɔ,
“Nyujente lɔ dahare!”
Kɛɛ, “O ken ɛɛ kpo mɛ
fɔɡbaahnaa!”
dɛɛ so dem.
14Hanjwamane wobol
do kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ ken.
Nɛn waa dɛ ɛ Korowii
bandiwaa la dɛ le o bini.
15Gɛnewa lɔ bechala bɛlbwa
bambile ta,
kɛ dɛ he kpɔ chweema
toɡro waa, o dɛ jemɛ wa.
16Nɛn waa ɛɡre nyaara
dɛ dɔ kwaa dɛɛ ja la,
ne onɔ la waa kpɔ kwaa
dɛɛ kɛ dɔɔhna la,
ba bwa dɛ nya.
Wejerema waa baa bola
17Cheɡ deŋne dɛ no nɛn
waa jemɛ waa wobol,
dɛ́ hweli waa
maa dɛ baɡle nɔ.
18A wer kɛ he kpɔ do he nyu bini,
dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ bol wa.
19N ɡelɔ hɛɛ jemɛ fini,
ɡɛ aa ɛ he kpɔ he hwɛɡa
bwa do Korowii nɛ.
20N chwerɛ webele fifraatoro
dɛ tɛɛ,
wejaala ne wejema lɔ a ta.
21A taa hɛɛ ba cheɡa dɛ́ jemɛ
kasinteŋ,
dɛ́ kpɔ waa aa ɛ kasinteŋ
dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa tomɛ.
22Bɛ he dɔŋ nyae waa koh
dɛ́ ɛɡro lɛ komɛl.
Bɛ o nɛɛ nya,
ásɛ dɛ bol waa bɔɔ kɔɔto.
23Korowii ɛɛ bol a ɡɛ nɛra la
waa tɛɛ ba,
ásɛ ɡɛ haa lɛɛ ba kwaa la,
ó lɛ le he be.
24He ne nɛn o baah aa dɛ di
kohona bɛ darame di.
He ne nɛn o baah aa
wola biɡri dii bɛ pɛ,
25ásɛ he ba hwelu
dɛ́ le a ta kahonɛ.
26Bɛ nɔn kpɔ ɛɡɛ tɔn ta tɛ
nomɛl,
kɛɛ dɛ di ajinamuu tɛo.
27Dɛ he ta komɛl bwa dɔe
dɛ́ kpɔ bɔ aa,
baa won lɛ he kalaŋ
haa dɛ chɔ o ta ɡba.
28Bɛ harɛ jwɛh
he naawa aa bilu la laa
kpɔ.
29Nɛn waa jemɛ nɔn toma
kɛrɛdɛ la,
koranar tomaa wɛɛ ɛ,
waa nɛnsale toma ɛ.

Title: SƐꞬLA 23
Content:
1Dɛ he ne nomonjen
dɛ ba kwaa dii yaa,
nyiŋi he waa bini kɛrɛdɛ,
2dɛ he ɛ kafonyini aa,
jemɛ he te lawa.
3Bɛ ɡel he pɛla do
o kondikondɛɛɡa la ta,
a ken ɛ ŋwɛnɛ bɛl waa kpɔ
neɡre.
4Bɛ kondɔɔh waa koh dɛ́ chɔɡ
he te,
ɡel a ɡɛ liire la,
dɛ́ jemɛ he te lawa.
5Kondɔɔh won hee kelo kɛŋɔ
komɛl yon ɡale he sie ta la,
a won ɛɛ kɛŋɔ kee kena
yon moɡɛ ó ir kaa la.
6Bɛ nɛn o tea bini aa kpela
kondikwaa ba di bwa,
bɛ ɡel he pɛla do
o kondikondɛɛɡa ta.
7Gɛ naate la liire aa doa la,
ɡɛɛ o ɡbaɡba do.
Wɛɛ ŋɔ he bee ŋɔ,
“Di he tea bwa.”
Kɛ dɛ o bambile bwa ne laa.
8Vaɡa haa vaɡa la, hɛɛ
chwɛɛroo,
ásɛ he wobosoma haa bola
la yon ɛ pɛɛpɛɛ.
9Bɛ waa bol ɡɛne be koh,
o dɛ lii waa aa lɔ a ta la
wesale.
10Bɛ saŋ la jwɛh waa chɔ le la
laa kpɔ,
bɛ bilalbii harɛ lɛ.
11Ba dɔ nomɛl waa cheɡɛ ba
habɔɔ,
onee Korowii, wɛɛ boloo
bɔe.
12Cheɡ deŋne no wa,
ásɛ dɛ hweli wa.
13Bɛ sie laa kpɔ bechala doe ta,
he kpɔ chweema dɛɛ tɛr
o deŋne aa, waa sewɛ.
14Dɛ he kpɔ chweema tɛr
o deŋne aa, o nyuu hɛɛ lɛ.
15N bie, dɛ he jemɛ wa aa,
n baah ɛɛ sɔɔh mɛɛ.
16Aa do n somee kɛ maa noa kɛ
he dɛ bol waa aa toɡra.
17Bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bɔweela ɛ,
ɡel Korowii duura swɛɛ
he siwi saŋ bɛlbwa.
18Wedɛɛɡa ane chɔ le kerekere
dɛ tɛɛ,
he hwɛɡa aa pɛɛ ta bwa.
19N bie, no dɛ́ che a ta jemɛ
wa,
ásɛ he sie chɔ harɛ
he soɡa bini.
20Bɛ sennyɔɔra nɛɛ ja,
he ne banɔ la baa dɛ di
kondikombala la bɛ pɛ.
21Sen nyɔe ne kondibala te,
nyae nee aa ba,
ɡɛɛ dom chɔe kohona ɡe ɛɛ
ba yakwane tɔe ne.
22Dɛɛ no he mɛɛ deŋna wa,
onee lolɛ,
he nya ɡe baa hwɛɛhraa,
bɛ on nyiŋi vah.
23Lawɛ kasinteŋ bini kpoŋe dɛ
bɛ kpɔ ta,
nyin wejema ne waa hwela
dɛ waa mun noe.
24Nɛn o wa aa toɡra mɛɛ sie dɛ
lɛ, nomɛlbwa waa lolɛ
biwejereme la,
sie dɛ lɛ o nɛ.
25Gel he nya ne he mɛɛ sie ɛɛ
lɛ, he nya te fanfa.
26N bie, cheɡ deŋne kɛrɛdɛ,
ásɛ dɛ kpɔ n da.
27Hanjwamane do kɛŋɔ bel,
haah waa le o jaa habɔɔ do
kɛŋɔ bɔluŋ.
28O kpɔ o te dɛɛ sɔh kɛŋɔ
ŋwɛɛ ken,
dɛ ɡel baala le ba haahna
habɔɔ dɛɛ ba o be.
O lawɛ ba nyuune dɛɛ lɔ
dɔŋa.
29Umee dɛɛ na waa kɛɛ dɛɛ wi
suna ɔ?
Umee lɔ wobobala ne
naɡra ta nɔ?
Umee ba do bol pɛɛpɛɛ ɔ?
Ume sibie swɛɛra ɔ?
30Nɛra baa soɡe sen mun dɛɛ
biɡri,
kɛɛ dɛɛ daɡɛ sen baa
koora a do kpeɡri la.
31Bɛ ɡel sen a nyɔe aa soma,
a sie swɛɛ dɛɛ wure numol
bini neɡre.
32A habɔɔ la,
a do kɛŋɔ domkpule
aa choɡe ken.
33Hɛɛ na musuwaa,
ásɛ he liire ɛ sakaa.
34He sie ɛɛ birii kɛŋɔ haa soɡe
ɡbera ta vil sie ken,
kɛɛ haa chɔ ɡbera bini
nehɛma ɛɛ lɔ la ken.
35Hɛɛ boloo ŋɔ,
“Ba lɔ mɛ, kɛ ba ta men
bol doe.”
Dɛ berɛ ŋɔ, “Ba lɔɔ mɛ,
kɛ maa jemɛ.
Saŋ besoo mɛɛ ba ira
dɛ́ ka nyin sen nyɔ jaɔ?”

Title: SƐꞬLA 24
Content:
1Bɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra bɔweela ɛ,
bɛ ɡel he pɛla lawɛ kɛ
he ne baa pɛo.
2Waa ba liire yon do a ta
laanee naɡre wa,
ba wobol ɡe ɛ bichɔɡwa.
3Wejema nee baa do dem,
asɛ waa mun noe ɡel wɛɛ
che.
4Wejema taa a che deene
aa lɔ dem bela la su
kondɛɛɡa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
5Nɛn o kwa aa chaahna
dɛ́ dɔ bokpeɡa kohona,
asɛ nɛn waa jemɛ wa ɛɛ di
kpeɡri.
6A chɛ kɛŋɔ hé maɡle he waa
kɛrɛdɛ mɔɔ dɛ́ yo laa.
Gɛɛ a do dɛ he dɔ jajaala
kɛrɛdɛ waraa, hɛɛ ba wona
yo le.
7Wejemwobol mun noe kpeɡri
tɛ ɡɛne kɛŋɔ ó won no a
mun.
Bwɛɛla chemo dɛɛ bol wa
aa, waa won ane bol.
8Nɛn waa dɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa
la, nɛnchɔɡee baa yerɔ.
9Gɛne wemaɡla bɛlbwa ɛ
wechɔɡa,
asɛ nɛn bɛlbwa ɡe hah
bammuɡli nɛn.
10Waa ba he nɛɛ dɛ he ta
wone che kiŋkiŋ naa,
dɛ he bokpeɡa aa kanɛ kpa.
11Lɛ nɛra baa dɛ́ ba bá kpoora
ba tepoŋ ne,
bɛ che nyiŋ ba ba serewe.
12Bɛ sie laa kpɔ waane ta,
dɛ́ ŋɔ he waane laa.
Korowiirii jemɛ bambile
bɛlbwa wa.
Wɛɛ bɔ bɛlbwa kemee ɡɛ
waa ɛa.
13N bie, tohnoo dɔ pɛla dɛ do
som,
anomanta, bɛ an vɛh.
14Jemɛ kɛŋɔ wejema wer tɛ he
wee, he dɔ wejema aa,
he dɔ hwɛɡa he soɡa bini
kerekere.
15Bɛ he te ɛ kɛŋɔ nɛnchɔɡa
yon vɔrɔwe vɔrɔwa,
dɛ́ ka bar nɛndɛɛɡa
deremi cheme, dɛ́ ŋwɛɛ ba
la.
16Waa pu nɛn o wa aa toɡra,
o chole kera anuanɛ naa,
o berɔ dɛɛ ir.
Kɛ dɛ wechɔɡa pu nɛnchɔɡe
te naa, o dɛ lɔ harɛ.
17Waa pu he dɔm aa,
bɛ ɡel he sie lɛ,
o lɔ harɛ naa, bɛ ɡel a do
he som.
18A ba ɡɛ naa, Korowii ɛɛ nae,
ásɛ dɛ laa o bandia kpɔ ɡɛ
nɛn la nɛ.
19Bɛ ɡel he baah di
wechɔɡ-ɛɛra we-ɛɛla wa,
bɛ ban bɔweela ɛ.
20Wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ta hwɛɡa bɛlbwa
dɔe kerekere,
wobɛlbwa toole o sie dawɛ
a ta.
21N bie, dɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii ne he
kooro,
he ne nɛra baa dɛ ɛɛ ba
deŋnekpeɡ
bɛ pɛ dɛ́ ɛ beŋkpoŋ.
22Wekpeɡa ane ɛɛ won piɡri le
Korowii kɛɛ kooro la be
dɛ ba.
Umee dɛ won jemɛ wahala
aa le ba bɛlbwa be
dɛ́ ba nɔ?
Wejerema waa ane ɡe ja
23Wejemwobol ane ɡee nɔ.
Nɛn siebɔr nyiŋa dɛ́ bol waa
dɛ́ pa bole ta aŋwɛnɛ ta ɛɛ.
24He pa boldɛɛɡe te bolchɔɡe
aa,
harɛre nɛra bwa dɛ́
taahnee dɛ́ haeh.
25He tɛr bolchɔɡe te deŋne aa,
wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ,
he dɔ sɔndɛɛɡe.
26He chaŋe nɛn waa aŋwɛnɛ ta
naa,
a dɛ baɡle kɛŋɔ he ne o
darame pɛo.
27Nyin koo haa dɛ di o ta mɔɔ
dɛɛ nyin bela haa kpɔ he
nyu bil.
28Bɛ waa haa wola he dɔŋ
nɛɛ nae la danseɛ di,
bɛ nyosone teŋe.
29Bɛ ba lii ŋɔ, “Gɛ waa ɛɛ mɛ la,
n ɡee ɛo anee,
kɛɛ mɛɛ tɔɔ a welee.”
30N fɛrɛ bɔhwaah bɛl koo nyoa,
n kpɔ ɡɛne bɛl daa koo ta.
31Jabalnadaŋɛ ne kpɔɡa lɛ koo
la bwa,
bwea waa kpɔa ma
danjwɛɛ baro la ɡe kuuɡi.
32N nyiŋi koo la jeiih ken,
dɛ lii waa kɛrɛdɛ,
dɛ kpɔ hweli wa.
33Chɔe tama, dom chuɡla tama,
nɔɔra fɔɔla dɛ́ so onɛ tama,
34he ne ŋɔe he ba jemɛ la,
dɛ nyaa piɡri kɛŋɔ ŋwɛɛ aa
kpoŋe dɔmkon dɛ́ ba che
he nɛ.

Title: SƐꞬLA 25
Content:
Solomɔn sɛɡla ane ja
1Solomɔn sɛɡla ane Juda Kooro Hɛsɛkea karakere aa nyiŋi a ta dɛ chwerɛɛ nɔ.
2Ya kpɔ duure dɛɛ tɛ Korowii
sɔeh waa kpɔ waane sɔh
yaa,
ɡɛɛ koranar ɡe dɔ duure
pila
baa pili waa dɛɛ nyiŋi a
bini.
3Gɛ haa wola won jemɛ
nyundua jaŋne,
ne harɛ bini luŋri la,
ɡɛɛ haa wola won jemɛ
kooro liire.
4Laa doŋa kpɔ suuɡapoŋ ta,
ásɛ nɛn waa jemɛ a toma
kpɔ kwaa kondɛɛɡe.
5Nɛnchɔɡa le kooro jwɛh aa,
o kora ɛɛ cheo, toɡra o wa
aa toɡra la wa.
6Bɛ he te ɡɔɔ kooro sie,
bɛ sobɔr nyin nɛnjena baah.
7A wer kɛŋɔ kooro la ŋɔ,
“Ba so n jwɛh,”
ɡwaa kɛŋɔ waa iri, dɛ kpɔ
he sobɔr tɛ nɛn waa
ɡwaale.
Waa he ɡbaɡba aa naa la,
8bɛ too dɛ́ kpɔ kaa kɔɔto,
ɡɛ laa dɛ he dɔŋ kaa di
danseɛ bɔe naa,
hɛɛ di sihiih.
9Dɛ he ne he dɔŋ dɔ waane aa,
he ne o ɡbo bola,
dɛ bɛ ɡel a le baŋ.
10A ba ɡɛ naa, baa bol he
bwara wechɔɡaa,
ásɛ nyanyini haa dɔa la
tonɛ.
11Wobol aa wera dɛ maɡre la,
do kɛŋɔ suuɡaswɛm baa
kpɔa
di suuɡapoŋ ɡwini ken.
12Nɛn waa dɛ no nɛn waa jemɛ
waa wejaala la,
a ɡwaa kwaa baa kpɔ
suuɡaswɛm tenten ɛa.
13Torome baa tomɔ o la
dɛ baa bol kasinteŋ nɛn
waa tomɔ be la,
do kɛŋɔ nee aa dɛ sɔɔh
baah,
kwaa koma saŋ bɔr aa
wɔba la ken.
14Nɛn waa baɡɛ nyoa kɛ wɛɛ tɛ
komɛlee waa wola tɛ la,
o do kɛŋɔ baama ne peu
aa wola bwaala ne ba ken.
15Bambile dɔe ne tahaah
won nomonjen liire bera,
ɡɛɛ a won wekpeɡa ɡe
sɔɔhna.
16He dɔ tooh naa, di anɔ la aa
maɡre he ne,
a kohona dii ɛɛ ɡeloo he dɔ
weela.
17Dɔŋ dem laŋa kohona dɛ peo,
a che a ta o berɛ haeh
kwara.
18Nɛn waa di dansewea
dɛɛ dawɛ o dɔŋ nɛɛ la,
o do kɛŋɔ ɡuli kɛɛ kere
kɛɛ hɛm waa nyɛɡa ken.
19Dɛ he dɔ waa dɛɛ hwɛɡɛ
he dam haa wola hwɛɡa
o nɛɛ dɔe yaa,
a do kɛŋɔ he nyen haa
wola won kpɔ chaŋe kwa,
kɛɛ he nakpala haa
wola won valɛ o ta.
20Nɛn waa aa puu o loo ku,
ba ɡo yela dɛ larawe o
bwara la,
o dɛ naa kɛŋɔ haa laa
o yal wur waa saŋ,
kɛɛ haa kpɔ tɛɛɡa aa dɛ we
do o ŋwɛr ta la.
21He dɔm chɔ lɔr aa,
tɛo kondikwaa ó di.
O ta nee dɔe dɛ́ nyɔ aa tɛo ane.
22He ɛ ken aa, sihiih dɛ ba
o kpoe o baŋa ɡole,
Korowii tɛɛ a kembɔr.
23Gɛ dɔŋ bwara waa bola
aa dɛ ba bandia ne la,
ɡɛɛ peu waa taa le bobɛl
dɛɛ ba bwaala nee ne la
do.
24He ɡbo soɡe saldoa
bɔ kɛ he ne
hannaɡrenyini aa pɛ dem.
25Gɛ he yon no amanesoma
le bojaŋ a do he som la,
ɡɛɛ nesɔn aa dɛ kpo nyɔɡre
la ɡe do.
26Dɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra kpɔ
o te tɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛraa,
a do kɛŋɔ haa kpɔ doŋa do
nee waa pala baa kaa ta
ken.
27Tooh kohona dii aa were,
ɡɛɛ aa wola were kɛ
he nyin sɔn kohona.
28Nɛn waa wola won bambile
lawɛ la,
o do kɛŋɔ bwɛjen baa ma
danjwɛɛ
baro o kuuɡi la ken.

Title: SƐꞬLA 26
Content:
1Gɛ ɡɛne aa wola kpɛɛra chɛɛ la,
ɡɛɛ dombwea kɛɛ bwaala
aa wola kwaa koma saŋ
hiaeh.
2Nyotaahna aa wola hen chɛɛ
la,
do kɛŋɔ jumbii aa dɛ ɡah
aa wola daa ta joŋi la ken.
3Chweema chɛ jaaɡɔ ne keeɡo,
ɡɛɛ ɡɛne chɛ lɔɔra.
4Bɛ he nyoa kpɔ do ɡɛne waa
ta,
ásɛ dɛ bɛ ba do kɛ on.
5Chaŋe ɡɛne o ɡɛnewaa ta,
ásɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ o ta
wejereme ɛɛ.
6He tomɛ ɡɛne aa,
he nakpalee dɛɛ sɔɔhne,
he bambile te aa hen sɔɔh.
7Gɛ boobi aa wola won valɛ
la,
ɡɛɛ ɡɛne aa wola jemɛ
sɛɡle.
8He kpɛɛ ɡɛne aa, waa jemɛ.
A do kɛŋɔ haa vɔwɛ bwe
ne taya tɔn pɛ,
he ta bwe laa, waa kaa.
9Gɛ sennyɔɔ aa wola won
laa sɔɔh kpɔ o nɔn ta la,
ɡɛɛ a do kpeɡri tɛ ɡɛne kɛ
ó won sɛɡle.
10Dɛ he bɔ ɡɛne waa
ba dɛ kaa o bobɛl paa aa,
dɛ a do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa ta
hɛma
ta bobɛlbwa, dɛ do nɛra
bola ken.
11Gɛ nyoate yon uɡe dɛ berɛ
kaa dia la,
ɡɛɛ ɡɛne teŋɛ dɛɛ ɛ
ɡɛnewa.
12Nɛn waa ɡɛna kohona la,
hwɛɡa lɔ o nɛɛ ɡwaa
nɛn waa dɛ lii kɛ o jemɛ
wa, kɛ o ɡe aa jemɛ.
13Bɔhwaahree yon ŋɔ,
“Nyujente lɔ ŋwɛnɛ ta,
o lɔ fɔɡbaahna.”
Anomanta, waa le.
14Gɛ ɡbera aa cheɡɛ
njinasoɔre ta dɛ ya dɛɛ tɔ
la,
ɡɛɛ bɔhwaah chɔ kalaŋ ta
dɛɛ beɡre o te.
15Nɛra bane bɔhwaah ɡwaa
ba nɛɛ kɛ bá won kpɔ
kondikwaa kwaraa la nyoa.
16Bɔhwaah dɛ lii o te
wejereme,
kɛŋɔ o ɡwaa nɛra banuanɛ
baa dɛ ba wona tɛ liidɛɛɡa.
17Nɛn waa kpɔ o nyoa
ɛɛ do nɛra waa
aa wola o waa ɛɛ ta la,
o do kɛŋɔ waa la fɔɡbaah,
dɛ ka lawɛ nyoate deŋne.
18Choɡla te waa dɛ ta hɛma
nii naa lɔ a nyoa dɛɛ kpoo
nɛra la,
19do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ neɡre o
dɔŋ
dɛ́ yon berɛ ŋɔ,
hɛlaa wɛɛ hɛlɛ.
20Gɛ nindaa hɔɔ tonaa,
nii yon dime la,
ɡɛɛ nɛn ŋwala ɡe toole
naa, naɡra toole.
21Gɛ hɔla aa dɔ nii,
damara ɡe ɡel nii ɛɛ hɔ
la,
ɡɛɛ naɡrenyini ɡe ɛɛ
ba naɡra ne.
22Nɛn ŋwala som, a do kɛŋɔ
kondikonsoma aa dɛ jo tea.
23Nɛn dɛ bol o dɔŋ bwara
wedɛɛɡe
kɛ dɛ dɔ o liichɔɡaa,
a do kɛŋɔ baa ɛ suuɡapoŋ
bɔle vii habɔɔ la.
24Nɛn o nyoa wobol aa soma,
kɛ dɛ dɔ liichɔɡa la dɛ́
neɡre nɛra.
25O wobol la dɛ do som,
kɛ bɛ on yarada,
liichɔɡa bwa soo siwii lɔ o
nyu bini.
26O ɛ o te kɛŋɔ ba bɛ on hah
aa,
o wechɔɡa ɛɛ le baŋee nɛra
bwa na.
27He kwi nafuɡe aa,
he ɡbaɡbaa dɛɛ le o bini.
He ɡbili bwe ŋɔ
he ta he dɔŋ nɛ aa,
wɛɛ berɔ ba he nɛ.
28Nyosonteŋni hah nɛra waa
teŋe nyosone dɛɛ dawɛ ba
nɛ,
ɡɛɛ neɡra wobol ɛɛ ba
wechɔɡa ɡbo ne.

Title: SƐꞬLA 27
Content:
1Bɛ waa haa ɛ kere kpɔ dɛɛ bol wa,
haa jemɛ ɡɛ tɔɔ aa dɛ ba he
pera.
2Bɛ he te kpɛɛ,
ɡel nɛra kpɛɛre.
3Bwe ne hɛŋle bwa tɔɡre te,
kɛ waa ɡɛne aa dɛ ba
a ne la ɡwaa a bwa.
4Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di
wɛɛ tɔ waa wel la,
o nyu bini kpeɡri dɛɛ chɔɡ
wa,
kɛ bɔweela te ɡwaalo.
5A wer kɛŋɔ he di nɛn
kasinteŋ nɛra baah.
A bɔ kɛŋɔ haa dɛ nyin o
wa,
he ta ɡelɛ o jemɛ.
6He damdɛɛɡe dii kasinteŋ bɔ,
kɛŋɔ he dɔm aa kpɔ nɔn
dawɛ he vam ta.
7Nɛn di kwaa vaɡɛ o tea aa,
o waane laa tooh wa,
ɡɛɛ nɛn lɔr aa dɛ kpoo la,
koŋkpela ɛɛ do o som.
8Gɛ jumbie yon ir le o kɔr ta
dɛ kaa la,
ɡɛɛ nɛn waa jo pua kaa
dɛ ɡel o dem la do.
9Konsɔɔhsoma sɔɔh ɡelɔ nɛn
sie ɛɛ lɛ,
ɡɛɛ dansom tenten ɡe liire
waa tɛɛ la do.
10Bɛ he chamenate kɛɛ
he mɛɛ chamenate chwa.
He dam waa bɛne la ɡwaa
lole waa lɔ bojaŋ,
anomanta, dɛ waane pui naa,
haa won la he lole be ŋɔ ó
chae.
11N bie, hweli waa dɛ jemɛ wa,
ásɛ n baŋa pa,
ń dɔ waa dɛ bol nɛra
baa dɛ ɛɛ mɛ nɛnsala la be.
12Nɛn waa dɔ nfɛrɛ la,
dɛ na waa aa lɔ sie
dɛɛ ba, dɛ yon ke o te.
Nɛn waa wola liire dɔe yon
so nyiŋi a ba diu.
13Lɛ nɛn waa cheɡɛ hɔɔh
kem nyoa la yal bil,
dɛ o di haah waa wola he
bini bɛl ɛɛ ajinamuu aa, lɛ
o yal bil.
14Dɛ he felo chɔmbibi dɛ kpɔ
takpeɡ chɔɔ he dɔŋ aa,
a dɛ berɛ chɛɡa tɛ nɛn haa
chɔɔro la.
15Hannaɡrenyini do kɛŋɔ,
bwaala aa dɛ wiri
waa wola ɡel bwa.
16Gɛ haa wola won kpoŋe peu,
kɛɛ noo a mwɛɛ nɔn ta la,
ɡɛɛ haa wola won larawe
a ɡɛ haah la ó ɡel naɡra.
17Gɛ buni aa dɛ sar buni la,
ɡɛɛ chamene tena hweli
waa dɛɛ le dɔŋa be.
18Dɛ he nyiŋi fiɡ daa ta kɛrɛdɛ
naa,
he dɔ o nɔna dɛɛ di,
ɡɛɛ dɛ bonɔɔ tomɛ o dɔɔ
kɛrɛdɛ naa, wɛɛ dɔ sɔn.
19Gɛ nɛn nyiŋi nee ta o yon
na ɡɛ o siebɔr aa doa la,
ɡɛɛ o liire ɡe ɛɛ baɡle
o nɛnsoo.
20Gɛ nɛwɛnyini pɛla kwa
aa wola tonɛ bwa la,
ɡɛɛ lalabwɛɛ ɡe aa wola su
bwa.
21Nii taa ba kpɔ suuɡapoŋ
ne suuɡaswɛm do dɛ́ jemɛ
kɛ a wer,
ɡɛɛ a che nɛn kpɛɛra ta,
baa jemɛ o nɛnsoo.
22Nɛn waa ɡɛna te, he lɔɔro
ɡɛ bɛlbwa kwara noo,
o ɡɛna ta lɔ o nɛ.
23Nyiŋi he kondɛɛra ta kɛrɛdɛ,
dɛɛ do sie a nɛ,
24dɛkalkɛŋɔ suuɡa dɔe aa ɡɛ
ka,
ɡɛɛ kooɡbɛrɛ aa wola le
chɔe
dɛɛ tɛ naanar saŋ bɛlbwa.
25Dɛ he kɛ kondɛɛra kondikwaa
cheɡ,
dɛ berɛ kɛ kpɔɡa aa lɔ
deŋɡarere ta,
mɔɔ anfala ɛɛ moɡaa,
26anee dɛ́ ɡel he dɔ yal tɔ le he
peera ta,
dɛ́ berɛ dɔ suuɡa le he
boohna ta yawɛ harɛ.
27Dɛ dɔ na-elnee kohona
dɛɛ he haah ne bii,
dɛ he toli, ba bwara do
wer.

Title: SƐꞬLA 28
Content:
1Nɛnchɔɡe dɛ chwa dɛ nomɛl aa on doŋi,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra
baah suu kɛŋɔ nyujente
ken.
2Harɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa lɔ o ta
la,
o koranaree dɛɛ warɛ.
Kɛ harɛ waa dɔ
nomonome baa dɔ wejema
la,
dɛ do kpeɡri dɛ́ che kiŋkiŋ.
3Kooro waa dɛ ɛ nyaara
hɔhɔrɔwa la,
do kɛŋɔ bwaala waa wola
komɛlbwa kwaa ken.
4Nɛra baa wola Mmara ta
teŋɛ la, dɛ kpɛɛ nɛnchɔɡa.
Kɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ
Mmara ta la, hah
nɛnchɔɡa.
5Nɛnchɔɡaa wola waa
aa ɛ kasinteŋ mun no,
kɛ nɛra baa dɛ tomɛ
Korowii te
dɛ́ no a mun kɛrɛdɛ.
6Nyaa o wa aa dɔ kasinteŋ la,
o bɔ suuɡa te o wa aa doŋa.
7Biwejeremee dɛɛ teŋɛ Mmara
ta,
kɛ onɔ la o ne nɛnsale aa
dɛ valɛ la te,
kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o mɛɛ.
8Nɛn waa dɛ kemɛ nɛra suuɡa,
dɛ lɛ a nee kohona dɛ dɔ
kondɔɔh la,
o lɛa dɛɛ tɛ nɛn waa dɛ na
nyaara sum.
9Dɛ he vɛh Mmara ta teŋa aa,
Korowii kii he wesoŋa.
10He neɡre nɛndɛɛɡe
dɛɛ kaa wechɔɡa ŋwɛnɛ ta
naa,
a dɛ di he ɡbaɡba.
Nɛn wobɛlbwa aa wola
toole o nɛɛ la, na som
kerekere.
11Suuɡa te dɛ lii o te wejereme,
kɛ nyaa waa jemɛ waa la
jemɛ ɡɛ naate aa doa.
12Nɛndɛɛɡa baa di nomonome
aa,
nomɛlbwa sie dɛ lɛ,
kɛ nomonchɔɡa balaa,
ɡɛɛ nomɛlbwa hɔrɔme.
13Nɛn waa dɛ tɔ o wechɔɡa ta
la aa wer do,
kɛ nɛn waa wona bol
o kwaa dɛ ɡel a ɛɛ la,
Korowii dɛ́ na o sum.
14Nɛn waa dɛ ɔmɛ
Korowii la, o na som,
kɛ deŋnekpeɡ te ɛɛ
ba na waa taeh.
15Nomonchɔɡe waa dɛ nyiŋi
nɛŋɡwɛɡra la,
o do kɛŋɔ nyujente
kɛɛ sisire yon dɛɛ kɔɡre,
dɛɛ nyin ola dɛ́ lawɛ la.
16Kooro waa wola liire dɔe,
o nyu bini do kpeɡri
laanee dɛɛ fiiɡi o nɛra,
kɛ onɔ la waa wola kafo
nyin la dɛ́ dɔ mkpajaŋ.
17Nɛn waa dɛ kpoo nɛra la,
o ɡbaɡba bɔɔ wɛɛ kwi,
bɛ on kah.
18He waa bini wer aa,
he dɛ dɔ he nyu,
kɛ dɛ he waa bini ta toɡraa,
he dɛ chole warane.
19Paa waa swɛɛ siwi
dɛɛ ɛ toma laanee,
dɛɛ dɔ kondikwaa kohona,
kɛ onɔ la waa teŋɛ
wesale ta la te dɛ nya.
20Nɛn waa dɛ bol kasinteŋ la,
o dɛ na som taeh,
kɛ nɛn o siwi aa swɛɛra
kɛ o dɔ kwaa warane la ne
wahalaa.
21Siebɔr nyiŋa dɛ́ pa bole aa
were,
kɛ bane dɛ che komɛl tama
waa dɔ di la ta,
dɛ yon ɛ wechɔɡa.
22Nɛn o siwi aa dɛ beɡre kwaa
dɔe ta la,
waa saŋ nyae aa ba o nɛɛ
la te lii.
23Nɛn waa bol waa baɡle
o dɔŋ o charɛ la,
o dɛ dɔ sɔndɛɛɡe
ɡwaa nɛn waa kpɔ
wobosoma dɛɛ neɡre o dɔŋ.
24Haa ŋwɛ he nya kɛɛ he mɛɛ
komɛl,
dɛ ŋɔ he ta ŋwɛɛ ɛɛ la,
dɛ henee ŋwɛɛ tenten.
25Nɛn waa dɛ nyin kɛ o ɡbo ɛɛ
dɔ la,
dɛ́ ba wahala ne,
kɛ nɛn waa kpɔ o te dawɛ
Korowii nɛɛ la soɡa bini dɛ
do wer.
26Nomɛlbwa waa kpɔ o te
ɛɛ dawɛ o ɡbaɡba liire ta la
ɡɛnɔ,
kɛ nɛn waa dɛ teŋɛ
wejerema waa ta
dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
27Nɛn waa dɛ cha nyaara la,
komɛlbwa aa on nya,
kɛ nɛn waa laa sie
dɛɛ kpɔ ba nɛɛ la,
dɛ́ dɔ nyotaahna taeh!
28Nomonchɔɡa baa di
kora aa, ɡɛɛ nɛra hɔrɔme,
ba le bela tenaa, dɛ nɛra
ba wa aa toɡra dɔ bɔr
dɛ di kora.

Title: SƐꞬLA 29
Content:
1Dɛ he dɛ ɛ lwɛmkpeɡ saŋ
bɛlbwa ba kaeh kahonaa,
he ne ba jara la,
dɛ he dɔ wa,
haa a nyoa tɛɛɡaa dɔ.
2Nɛndɛɛɡa baa di kora aa,
nomɛlbwa sie dɛ lɛ,
dɛ nɛnchɔɡa ɡe baa di aa,
nomɛlbwa dɛ hime.
3Nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin
wejema la,
o mɛɛ sie dɛ lɛ,
kɛ nɛn o ne haahna
baa dɛ bɔ jwamane nyoa
aa pɛa la,
dɛ he o kondɔɔh.
4Kooro waa dɛ di kasinteŋ la,
o ɡelɔ harɛ la wobɛlbwa ɛɛ
maɡre,
kɛ onɔ la o sie aa dɛ lɛ
kɛ baa yawɔ sen te dɛ
paɡre harɛ.
5Nɛn waa dɛ pa o dɔŋ la,
dɛ́ harɔ bel.
6Nɛnchɔɡe bɛlbwa wechɔɡaa
dɛɛ lawɔ,
kɛ nɛn o wa aa toɡra te,
silɛɛ ne hɛɡraa o bwa.
7Nɛn o wa aa toɡra la jemɛ
waa aa wera tɛ nyaa,
kɛ nɛnchɔɡe te waane laa
o wa.
8Wejeremee won waa larawa,
kɛ bammuɡli nɛn te won
waa ne bwɛjen ta bala.
9Dɛ wejereme kpɔ ɡɛne la
kɔɔto aa,
ɡɛne la dɛ mamɛ dɛ́ do
ɡbɔɡa, dɛ́ ba chɛɡa ne.
10Nɛra baa dɛ kpo nɛra
hah nɛn o wa aa dɔ
kasinteŋ,
dɛɛ nyin nɛra ba wa aa
toɡra dɛ́ kpo.
11Gɛnee dɛɛ baɡle o bandia
nɛra baah ta,
wejeremee dɔ bambile dɛ
won o te lawa.
12Kooro waa dɛ do deŋna
nyosone waa ta la,
o nomonome bwa dɛ ɛ
wechɔɡa.
13Nɛn waa nyaa ne nɛn
waa dɛ fiiɡi nyaa la te bwa
beŋkpoŋ,
Korowiirii tɛ bɛlbwa sie o
kpɔ dɛɛ na wa.
14Kooro waa bol nyaara waa
dɛɛ tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta la,
o kora dɛ́ che dɛɛ biɡri.
15Bechala deŋnetɛra wer
dɛɛ tɛo wejema,
kɛ he ta o nyu tɛo waa,
o kpɔ sihiih dɛɛ kpo o nya.
16Nɛnchɔɡa baa di kora aa,
wechɔɡaa dɛɛ warɛ,
nɛra ba wa aa toɡra ɛɛ so
lee, dɛ́ na ba harɛ lɔe.
17He do he bii kɛrɛdɛ naa,
ba ɡelɔ hɛɛ dɔ deŋnesɔɔhna
ne bambisɔɔhna.
18Harɛ o nɛra aa wola Korowii
waa kpɔe dawɛ ba nɛɛ la,
bɛlbwa dɛ ɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ nyin,
kɛ nɛra baa dɛ teŋɛ o Mmara
ta la, ba na som.
19Baa wobol ɡbo kpɔe dɛɛ do
bonɔɔ,
wɛɛ no a munii, kɛ o ken
aa sie do.
20Hwɛɡa lɔ ɡɛne nɛ,
dɛ ɡwaa nɛn waa dɛ bol
waa
waa wola lii mɔɔ.
21He ɡbɛɡbɛ he bonɔɔ le o
bechale saŋ aa,
a habɔɔ o dɛ ba bambichɔɡ
ne.
22Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di
warawara la,
dɛ ba naɡra ne.
Nɛn o baah aa dɛ di kohona
dɛ ba wechɔɡa ne taeh.
23He dɛ maŋkura he te naa,
harɛɛ hɛɛ lɔ,
kɛ he pwɛr he te naa,
he dɛ dɔ duure.
24He ne ŋwɛɛ dɛ bɔ aa,
he ta he nyu,
he bol kasinteŋ kɔɔto aa,
ba dɛ tɛr he deŋne,
he ta kasinteŋ bolɛ aa,
Korowii dɛ taahne.
25Nɛwɛnyini ɔma do kɛŋɔ bel
ken,
nomɛlbwa waa dɛ yarada
Korowii la,
dɛ́ dɔ o nyu.
26Korowiirii dɛɛ pa bole
aŋwɛnɛ ta,
ɡwaa kɛŋɔ nɛra ɡalɡa aa
dɛ nyin
kɛ koranar nyin ba waa la.
27Gɛ nɛndɛɛɡe aa hah nɛn
o wa aa wola kasinteŋ dɔe
la,
ɡɛɛ nɛnchɔɡe ɡe hah nɛn o
wa aa toɡra.

Title: SƐꞬLA 30
Content:
Waa aa le Aɡur be
1Waa aa le Jake bibaa Aɡur be laanee nɔ.
“Korowii kpɔ mɛ ta,
n ta lɛɛ dɔe.
2Dɛ n fa do kɛŋɔ kpɔɡ bini ol,
n ta nɛn liire dɔe.
3Dɛ n ta wejema hwele,
kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ Korowii Waa
Do Goroŋ la wa.
4Nomɛl la Korowii doa dɛ berɛ
ba kaa?
Umee lawɛ peu kpoŋe
o nɔmpaa bini kaɔ?
Umee ɡbaa nee aa lɔ harɛ ta
bwa do yal ta, kɛɛ umee
kpɔ jwɛhre bil harɛ nɔ ta
nyoa ɔ?
Umee jemɛ naate ɔ?
O sɔne ɛrɔɔ? O bie sɔne
ɛrɔɔ?
He jemɔ waa, baɡ mɛ!
5Korowii dɛ teŋɛ o nyobaɡa
ta.
O dɛ tɔ nomɛlbwa waa ba
o be ɡbemɡbe.
6Bɛ waa Korowii aa wola
bolɛ la kpɔ ja o waa ta,
ásɛ o ba kaeh dɛ́ yerɛ
nyosonteŋni.”
7Aɡur ŋɔ, “N Naa Korowii,
webele anɛɛ mɛɛ nyin
he be
mɔɔ dɛ́ sewɛ, bɛ men vɔmɛ.
8Lɛɛ mɛ le wesale ne nyosone
ta kwaraa,
bɛ ɡel ń nya kɛɛ dɛ́ dɔ
kondɔɔh kohona.
Tɛ mɛ anɔ la maa dɛɛ di
tɔpere bɛlbwa.
9Dɛ n dɔ kohona naa, mɛɛ soh
he waa,
dɛ́ ŋɔ, ‘Korowiirii ume o?’
N berɔ nya kwaraa ɡe aa,
ŋwɛɛ mɛɛ ba ŋwɛɛ
dɛ́ ɡel he sɔn chɔɡ.
10Bɛ bonɔɔ sɔn ba chɔɡ tɛ o
dɔɔ,
ásɛ o ba taahne á dɔe.
11Nɛra bane dɛ taah ba
mɛɛnanar,
baa andɛɛɡa sweerɛ dɛɛ tɛ
ba nyare.
12Ba dɛ lii kɛŋɔ wechɔɡa toole
ba nɛ,
kɛ dɛ ba senɛ wechɔɡa ta.
13Nɛra bane dɛ ɛ mbarafo,
dɛɛ nyiŋi nɛra nyubaahna.
14Nɛra bane dɔ kpeɡri dɛ kpɔ
dɛɛ fiiɡi nyaara ne
nɛŋɡwɛɡra,
dɛɛ lɛ kwa, a ɛ ŋwɛnɛ baa
kpɔa so,
dɛ́ chɔɡ ba le nɛra bini.
15A do kɛŋɔ kpanjeɡ aa dɔ
bihaahna banɛ,
a sɔne ‘Tɛ mɛ!’
Kombele atoro ane lole aa
vaɡɛ bwa,
naarɛte lole waa wola ŋɔ,
‘A maɡrɔ!’
16Anee nɔ, lalabwɛ ne hambara,
ne harɛ waa wola vaɡɛ dɛɛ
nyin ne,
dɛ nii aa dɛ lawɛ baa wola
won dima.
17Nɛn o siwi aa wola o mɛɛ
tɔɡɛ wɛɛ mamɔ,
dɛ berɛ nyiŋi o nya dɛɛ vah
la,
ɛɡreree dɛ́ foromi o sibie,
ásɛ kokosakire di o ola.
18Kombele atoro ane waa dɔ
nyokpoa kɛrɛdɛ n be,
naarɛte ɡe maa o mun no.
19Anee kɛŋɔ, ɡɛ kee aa dɛ ɡah
nyundua,
harɛkon won bwetal ta
kpɔe,
ɡbera won nee sie kpɔe,
asɛ baa ne haah yon dɛɛ
nyin dɔŋa la.
20Ŋwɛnɛ haah waa wola
kasinteŋ
dɔe tɛ o jaa, aa dɛ kpɔ o
taa nɔ.
O yon le o jaa habɔɔ ka kpɔ
banfale dɛ berɛ sɔ ne,
dɛ ŋɔ, ‘N ta wechɔɡa ɛɛ.’
21Webele atoro ane lole
yaa wola won kpoŋe,
naarɛte ɡe ɡɛ.
22Anee kɛŋɔ, yom waa bera di
kora,
ne ɡɛne waa dɔ kondikwa
kohona dɛ di.
23Ne haah nomɛlbwa aa wola
on nyin o berɛ ba dɔ jaa,
ne yomhaah waa lɛ haah
waa lɔ o sie tolo jaa.
24Kombele anaarɛ ane lɔ harɛ
nɔ ta,
dɛ do jeɡrejeɡre ken,
kɛ dɛ ɡe jemɛ waa taeh.
25Anee vaɡla, aa kpeɡe kɛ a
dɛ nyin
a kondikwaa hwel saŋ
cheɡ,
dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ kpa bwaala nee
saŋ.
26Kukubanere aa wola kpeɡe
nomanta,
a jemɛ waa dɛɛ chɔ
bwebɔɔne bini.
27Tontombɛ ta sitɔɔ dɔe,
kɛ a bwa pɛo dɛ ir dɛɛ kaa.
28Hɛɛ won lawɛ ɡer he nɔn ta,
kɛ koodemii hɛɛ nao.
29Kombele atoro ane lole a vala
do wer,
ɡɛɛ naarɛte ɡe do.
30Bɛlee puadɔɔ, o bwara
kpeɡri ɡwaa ola bwa,
waa komɛlbwa ɔmɛ kpɔɡ
baah,
31ne bombala,
ne jabala aa laa nyuune pa,
ne koranar ba nɛra aa bar ba
cheme.
32Dɛ he ɛ ɡɛne haa dɛɛ
maŋkura he te,
dɛɛ vɔrɔwe wechɔɡa aa,
ɡel dɛɛ lii wa.
33He lɔ sooma aa, noo dɛ le a
ta,
he lɔ he dɔŋ mee ta naa,
chal dɛ le,
ɡɛɛ he muɡli he dɔŋ
baah aa, hɛɛ ba naɡra ne.”

Title: SƐꞬLA 31
Content:
Waa aa le Kooro Lɛmoɛl be
1Waa aa hiah Kooro Lɛmoɛl, o nya bol baɡloo nɔ,
2“N bidɛɛɡe, n tea bini bie hen.
N baɡɛ Korowii nyoa,
dɛ lolɛ.
3Bɛ he bokpeɡa chɔɡ haahna
nɛ,
ba ɡelɔ koranar ɛɛ chɔɡ.
4Lɛmoɛl, a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ
koranar nyɔ seŋkpeɡa,
a ta chɛ kɛŋɔ ba pɛla do a
ta.
5A ɡelɔ baa soh mmarare aa
lɔ ba harɛre ta,
baa nyaara waa bolɛ dɛɛ
tɛɛ ba aŋwɛnɛ ta.
6Nɛn waa soɡe seo nyoa,
kɛɛ nɛn waa dɛ di suna
laanee chɛ kɛ o nyɔ
seŋkpeɡa.
7Banee chɛ kɛŋɔ ba nyɔa,
dɛ́ soh ba nyae ne suna baa
dɛ di.
8Kɛ he te chɛ kɛŋɔ he bol waa
dɛɛ tɛ nɛra baa wola wobol
jemɛ,
ne banɔ la baa wola
nomɛlbwa dɔe
bá bol ba waa tɛɛ ba
aŋwɛnɛ ta la.
9Bol waa dɛɛ tɛ a ɡɛ nɛra
ŋwɛnɛdɛɛɡe ta,
ásɛ dɛ ɛ nɛn waa bol waa
dɛɛ pa bole aŋwɛnɛ ta.”
Handɛɛɡe kpɛɛra
10Umee dɛ dɔ handɛɛɡe ɔ?
O dɔe kpeɡri ɡwaa
suuɡaswɛm
nɔnloɡa ne baŋa kwa.
11O jaa yarada bwa lɔ o nɛ,
waa ɡelɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ hiah
o jaa.
12O dɛ ɛ o jaa kɛrɛdɛ, waa on
wechɔɡa ɛ
o soɡa bini bwa.
13O swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ ta yabii
ba kpɔ sɔh yal o do wer
kɛrɛdɛ.
14O dɛ la bojaŋ dɛ ka kpɔ
kondikwa dɛɛ ba kɛŋɔ,
stiimae yon la bojaŋ ka kpɔ
bonadiire dɛɛ ba la.
15O felo dɛɛ ir chɔmbibii,
dɛɛ tɛ o dem tena
kondikwa,
dɛ́ berɛ baɡle o toli dem
toma bá ɛ.
16O dɛ nyin harɛ waa wera
dɛ́ yawɛ,
dɛ́ kpɔ o suuɡa yawɛ daa
dɛɛ du.
17O bwara kpeɡri o swɛɛ siwi
dɛɛ ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ.
18O dɛ na kɛŋɔ o bonadii dɔ
tɔnɔ,
dɛ ɛ toma wee kaa jo,
o yon choŋi kandea, waa
chɔ warane.
19O dɛ lawɛ jeremi dɛ́ ta yabi,
dɛ́ sɔh o ɡbaɡba yal.
20Waa o ɡbo kon nyin,
o dɛ ta tea dɛɛ tɛ nyaara
ne nɛŋɡwɛɡra kwa.
21Waa ɡelɛ waa ɛɛ kpo
o dem tena waa saŋ.
O dɛ tɔ ba yale.
22O ɡbaɡbaa dɛ́ nyarɛ bombore
dɛ́ kpɔ dɛɛ pa o chɔɔbɔr.
O dɛ li yadɛɛɡa bwa soo
siwi
a yoɡ aa kpeɡa.
23O jaa ɡe soɡe bwɛɛ
nomonome bini naa,
nomɛlbwa dɛ duuru.
24O dɛ sɔh yapondɛɛɡa ne
kirisore
dɛ yoɡ dɛɛ tɛ bonadiire.
25O bwara kpeɡri o waa dɔ
nyɛl,
o bwara aa on hwah,
o dɔ hwɛɡa saŋ bɛlbwa.
26O dɛ bol wejemwa,
dɛɛ baɡle waa aa ɛ
kasinteŋ.
27O dɛ do sie o dem tena nɛɛ
saŋ bɛlbwa,
o siwi ɛɛ swɛɛ wɛɛ nyin
kwaa aa hiah ba.
28O bii swee andɛɛɡa dɛɛ tɛo,
o jaa ɡe ɛɛ kpɛɛro.
29O jaa yon ŋɔ, “Handɛɛɡa lole
te,
kɛ he dɔŋ toole.”
30Tolwaa te dɛ neɡre nɛn, wer
ɡe ɛɛ tu,
kɛ haah waa dɛ ɔmɛ
Korowii la chɛ kpɛɛra.
31O chɛ kpɛɛra wobɛlbwa waa
ɛ ta,
ɡɛɛ a chɛ kɛŋɔ
ó dɔ duure nomɛlbwa be.

Title: WEJEREME TƆN NƆ BINI WAA BAꞬLA
Content:
Tɔn nɔ bini waa baɡla
Wejereme Tɔn nɔ, wejereme la dɛ baɡle o liire ɡɛ waa aa dɛ chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta wa. O nao kɛŋɔ a kpeɡri kɛ ya won no waane mun, a ta chɛ kɛ ya ŋɔ ya jemɛ wobɛlbwa. Nyiŋi nyu 8:17. Kasinteŋ, Korowii ɡboo jemɛ wobɛlbwa ka tonɛ, a chɛ kɛ yaa yaradao a bwa ta. Nyiŋi nyu 3:14. A ɡɛ ŋwɛnɛ nɔ ɡbosoo taa nɛn ɛɛ ba wona dɔ silɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ. Nyiŋi nyuune 12:1, 13—14.

Title: WEJEREME 1
Content:
Komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu
1Waa Wejereme bɛl, waa ɛ Kooro Devid bie dɛ di kora Jerusalam, aa bola laanee nɔ.
2“Komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu.
Wobɛlbwa ta mun dɔe.”
Wejereme laanee dɛɛ bol!
“Wobɛlbwa sese ta mun
dɔe.”
3Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ nɛn ɛɛ ba dɔe
dɛ́ le koeh bwa waa dɛ koh
harɛ nɔ ta nɔ?
4Nɛra dɛ sewɛ, baa lolɛ
banfala,
kɛ harɛ nɔ ta do ɡɛ waa
doa.
5Wee dɛ le dɛɛ chole,
dɛ́ berɛ ɛ warane ba kaa
bela waa dɛ le.
6Peu dɛ ta baa kaa weekaŋle
nyunduabɔr,
dɛ́ berɛ ta baa kaa
weekaŋle harɛbɔr,
o dɛ ta bar ɡɛ naa dɛ ba
cheme,
dɛ́ berɛ ba kaa o buɡ ta.
7Neerare bwa palɔ kaa jo mpo
ta,
kɛ waa su bwa.
A bwa berɔ dɛɛ kaa bela
aa lea,
dɛ́ palɛ ba kaa ja.
8Wobɛlbwa ɛ koeh tenten,
nɛn aa wola won bola
ka tonɛ.
Siwi aa won ɡel nyiŋa,
deŋne ɡe aa a noe ɡel.
9Waane a fa aa chiɡa ka la
ɛɛ berɔ chiɡ ja,
waa Korowii aa ɛa ɡe,
ɛɛ berɔ ɛ,
wobɛlbwa ta wefala
ɛɛ harɛ nɔ ta.
10Waane lole ásɛ nomɛl na dɛ́ ŋɔ,
“Anɔ te ɛ wefala aa?”
Akai, a bwa fa lole,
a lole saŋ la bwa mɔɔ ba
lolɛ yaa.
11Nomɛlbwa aa saŋ la baala
waa lii kpa,
hale banɔ la ba taa
dɛ ba ba lola,
nɛra baa lol ba, ba ɡe
habɔɔ la,
aa ba waa lii.
Wejema ɛ wepuu
12Men maa ɛ wejereme la, dɛ n fa ɛ Israel kooro dɛ so Jerusalam. 13N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ ń jemɛ, dɛ le n te cheɡ dɛ hweli waa bwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta. Na wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔa ba dawɛ ya nɛ! 14N na komɛlbwa nɛra aa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta, a bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
15Kon waa ɡola la,
baa won toɡro.
Kwaa toole naa, nɛn aa an
na dɛ́ kura.
16N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ, “N kpeɡo dɛ dɔ wejema ɡwaa kooro bɛlbwa waa tɔ n sie dɛ ba di kora Jerusalam. N hweli ɡɛ wejema ne liire dɔe aa doa, dɛ jema kɛrɛdɛ.” 17N siwi beɡrɔ n berɛ dɛɛ nyin ń jemɛ ɡɛ wejema ne ɡɛnewaa aa doa, dɛ na kɛ a bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
18Dɛkalkɛ, wejema kohona dɔe,
ne suna dii kohonaa
dɛɛ valɛ,
waa mun noe kohona
ɡe ne bambichɔɡaa.

Title: WEJEREME 2
Content:
Pɛlchɔɡa waa bɛlbwa ɛ wepuu
1N ɛ n liire kɛŋɔ mɛɛ teŋɛ pɛlchɔɡa waa taa, dɛ́ kpɔ daah n te na, dɛ́ na ɡɛ silɛɛ aa doa. Kɛ a bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu. 2N nao kɛŋɔ mama ɛ ɡɛnewa, pɛlchɔɡa ɡe aa wedɛɛɡa ne ba. 3N cheɡɛ n wejema ta dɛ ŋɔ mɛɛ nyɔ senee dɛ́ di n nyu. N liiro kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ nɛra ɛɛ ba wona di ba nyuune, tɔpera tama baa dɛ ba dii harɛ nɔ ta.
4N ɛ wejena taeh. N do deene dɛ parɛ daa kooni tɛ n te. 5Mɛɛ ɛ bodɛɛɡee dɛ́ du daa bwa soo siwi aa dɛ nɔnɛ. 6N kwi taama nee le bela palɛ kaa jo daa la mune, ásɛ a won kpeɡ kɛrɛdɛ. 7N yawɛ yoma baala ne haahna bwa, asɛ ba lolɛ ba bini bane ɡe n dem. N berɔ dɔ nae ne peera, dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa tɔ n sie dɛ so Jerusalam bwa. 8N lɛ suuɡapoŋa ne suuɡaswɛm kohona, ne kwaa a yoɡ aa kpeɡa dɛ le harɛre koranar baa lɔ n lɔɡa be. N dɔ haahna ne baala ɡe, ba ɡo yela dɛɛ lɛ n sie, asɛ n nyin haahna ɡe kohona. 9N baa ɛ nɛnjen kohona, dɛ ɡwaa nɛra baa tɔ n sie Jerusalam. Anɔ bwa habɔɔ, dɛ n ta dɔ wejema kohona.
10N ta n te laa kpɔ kwaa
n sie a dɛ lɛ a ta nɛ,
n vɛh wobɛlbwa n bambile
aa dɛ nyin.
N bambile lawɛ tomare
bwa maa ɛa,
anee ɛ kembɔr tɛ mɛ
a bwa ta.
11Kɛ maa kari waa
bwa maa ɛa,
ne kwaa maa koah
dɛ dɔ la,
dɛ komɛlbwa ɛ wepuu,
dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo
vii habɔɔ,
dɛ ɡel o bini ken,
komɛlbwa ta tɔnɔ dɔe
harɛ nɔ ta.
Wejema ne ɡɛna bwa ɛ wepuu
12Belaa n berɛ kpɔ liire,
dɛ nyiŋi ɡɛ wejema aa doa,
ne ɡɛ choɡla ne ɡɛnewaa
ɡe aa doa.
Bɔkwaa kooro waa baa chiɡ
o dɔŋ naa ta,
ɛɛ ba wona ɛ á ɡwaa anɔ la
sitɔte la aa ɛa ta nɔ?
13N nao kɛŋɔ wejema wer
ɡwaa ɡɛna,
ɡɛ bɔr chaahna aa do wer
ɡwaa biro la.
14Wejereme bɛlbwa dɛ na bela
waa dɛ kaa,
kɛ ɡɛne te, biro binii o do
dɛɛ ɡaaɡe,
waa jemɛ bela waa dɛ kaa.
Kɛ ane a bwa, n nao kɛŋɔ,
sewee chɔ le tɛ ba bwa.
15Belaa n lii kɛŋɔ,
“Waa aa pu ɡɛne la ɛɛ won
ba n ɡe nɛ.
Amɔ dɛ ɛrɛɛ n wejema
maa dɔa la dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ mɛ nɔ?”
Asɛ n ŋɔ,
“Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu,
a ta mun dɔe.”
16Baa wejerema ne ɡɛna bwa
waa liira ba,
baa soh ba bwa waa,
tɔpera a taa dɛ ba bala ta.
Gɛ ɡɛne aa sewɛ la,
ɡɛɛ wejereme ɡe ɛɛ
ba sewa.
Koeh ɛ wepuu
17A ɡelɔ n ta silɛɛ bɛlbwa n soɡa bini dɔe kpa, dɛkalkɛ wenaale ɡboo a kpɔ ba ta n nɛ. A bwa ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini ken. 18N sie ta kwaa maa ɛ toma dɛ nyina harɛ nɔ ta lɛɛ, dɛkalkɛ n dɛ ba a ɡela tɛ nomɛl waa ba di n kwa. 19Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kɛ naate ɛ wejereme kɛɛ ɡɛne ɔ? Kɛ onee dɛ́ di kpeɡri kondɔɔh maa koah, dɛ nyina cheɡ harɛ nɔ ta bwa ta. Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu. 20Anomanta, n bambile pa mun chɔɡ, koeh bwa maa koah harɛ nɔ ta la wa. 21Nɛn ɛɛ che o wejema ne o liire waa dɔa taa ɛ toma dɛ́ nyin kwa, dɛ́ ɡel a bwa habɔɔ tɛ nomɛl waa wola a toma ɛɛ. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu. 22Bɔkwaa nɛwɛnyini ɛɛ ba dɔe, dɛ́ le o koeh bwa waa swɛɛ siwi dɛɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta nɔ? 23Toma waa dɛ ɛ o soɡa bini bwa ɛ weweele ne suna dii ɡbo. Hale jwaana bwa, dɛ o ta dɛ lii wa, waa wola won chɔ. A nɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.
24Waa aa wera tɛ nɛwɛnyini bwaa kɛŋɔ, o di kondikwa dɛ́ nyɔ sen lɛ o sie, ásɛ o bwara sɔɔhno o toma waa ɛa ta. Anɔ ɡe kwaraa la, Korowii bee aa le, 25dɛkalkɛ dɛ o laa aa, umee dɛ́ won dɔ kondikwa di, dɛ́ lɛ o sie ɔ? 26Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɛ lɛ o sie wejema ne liire dɛ silɛɛ, kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ te, o ɡelɔ wɛɛ ɛ toma dɛɛ boa o kondɔɔh nyoa cheɡ tɛ nɛn o wa aa dɛ lɛ Korowii sie. Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

Title: WEJEREME 3
Content:
Komɛlbwa dɔ o saŋ
1Komɛlbwa dɔ o saŋ Korowii aa lea cheɡ,
asɛ wobɛlbwa ɡe dɔ
o tɔpere harɛ nɔ ta.
2Bie lola dɔ o tɔpere,
seo ɡe dɔ o tɔpere,
kwaa dui saŋ lole,
a fuɡra ɡe dɔ a saŋ,
3kpoe dɔ o tɔpere,
chaeh ɡe tɔpere do le,
danjwɛɛ taɡa dɛ́ ɡo saŋ
lole,
o kwaara dɛ́ ma ɡe saŋ
do le.
4Wii tɔpere lole,
mama ɡe dɔ o tɔpere,
suna dii tɔpere lole,
silɛɛ ne hɛɡra ɡe dɔ
a tɔpera,
5dɔŋa nyina dɔ a tɔpere,
dɔŋa bɛ nyina ɡe
dɔ a tɔpere,
dɔŋa ɡbaara dɛ́ pɛl
dɔ a tɔpere,
dɔŋa baah peɡra ɡe
tɔpere do le.
6Kwaa bɔr ɡaaɡa dɛ́ naa
dɔ a tɔpere,
a bɔr bɛ ɡaaɡa tɔpere
ɡe do le,
kwaa nyoa boara
tɔpere lole,
a pae dɛ́ viɡri ɡe
tɔpere do le,
7yal kɛɛra saŋ lole,
o tae dɛ́ pɛ saŋ ɡe do le,
nɛn hela dɛ́ so tɔpere lole,
tɔpere waa bol waa la ɡe
do le.
8Dɔŋa nyina dɔ a tɔpere,
dɔŋa haeh tɔpere ɡe do le,
laa yoi tɔpere lole,
deŋnesɔɔhna dɔe tɔpere
ɡe do le.
9Bɔkwaa nɛn waa dɛ ɛ toma, ɛɛ ba dɔe le o koeh waa dɛ koh ta nɔ? 10N na wekpeɡa Korowii aa kpɔa ba dawɛ nɛwɛnyina nɛ. 11O ɡelɔ komɛlbwa do wer o saŋ ta. O ɡelɔ ya jemɛ ya liire bini waa aa lole saŋ la, ne anɔ la aa chiɡ kerekere saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la, kɛ yaa won no waa bwa Korowii aa ɛa le mumpar kaa a jaɡa mun. 12Anomanta, n nao kɛŋɔ waa nɛwɛnyina aa won ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, yá ɡel ya sie lɛ dɛɛ ɛ wedɛɛɡa ya soɡa bini harɛ nɔ ta. 13Nomɛlbwa di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen, ásɛ o sie lɛ kwaa waa koah dɛ dɔ la ta, a ɛ Korowii koŋkɛɛla waa kpɔa kɛ yaa. 14N jemɔ kɛŋɔ komɛlbwa Korowii aa ɛ la, ɛɛ do lee saŋ bɛlbwa dɛɛ la. Nɛn aa won kpɔ ane ja kɛɛ dɛ́ laa ane kpɔ a ta. Korowiirii ɛa ɡɛ, ásɛ nɛwɛnyina kpɔ duure tɛo.
15Wobɛlbwa aa chiɡa ka la,
ne anɔ la aa chiɡ ɡe fa
chiɡo ka.
Korowiirii ɡela ɡɛ waa
la bwa berɛ dɛɛ chiɡ.
16N berɔ na waane harɛ nɔ ta ja,
nyubinikpeɡ chiɡ kasinteŋ
bole pae naa ta,
wechɔɡa ɡe chiɡ waa aa
toɡra naa ta.
17N lii n nyu bini ŋɔ,
“Korowii ɛɛ ba bol
nɛra ba wa aa toɡra,
ne nyubinikpeɡ tena
bwa waa dɛ́ pa ba bole,
dɛkalkɛ wobɛlbwa ɛɛ dɔ
o saŋee,
we-ɛɛla bɛlbwa ɡe
dɔ o tɔpere.”
18N berɔ lii ŋɔ, “Kɛ nɛwɛnyina te, Korowii daah ba dɛɛ na, dɛ́ ɡel bá jemɛ kɛŋɔ ba do kɛŋɔ ola ken. 19Webeŋkpoŋii chɔ le dɛ tɛ nɛwɛnyina ne ola bwa, ɡɛ bɛl aa sewɛ la, ɡɛɛ o dɔŋ ɡe ɛɛ ba sewa. Hweera beŋkpoŋii lɔ a bwa bini. Nɛwɛnyina ta ola ɡwaalɛ. Wobɛlbwa ɛ wepuu. 20Bobeŋkpoŋii Korowii kontaala bwa ɛɛ kaa. Teeraa Korowii kpɔ taa, anomanta, teera binii a bwa berɛ ɛɛ ba kaala. 21Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyina doma dɛ kaa nyundua, asɛ ola doma ɡe dɛɛ ka harɛ bini nɔ?”
22Anomanta, n nao kɛŋɔ waa nɛwɛnyini aa ɛ laanee kɛŋɔ, ó ɡel o sie lɛ toma waa ɛa dɛ dɔ kwaa la ta, dɛkalkɛ anee ɛ kembɔr aa chɛ kɛ ó dɔ. Umee dɛ́ won jemɛ o seo habɔɔ wa ɔ?

Title: WEJEREME 4
Content:
Fiiɡa ne koeh ne chamene nyae wa
1N berɔ nyiŋi dɛ na fiiɡa
nɛra aa dɛ fiiɡi ba dɔŋa
harɛ nɔ ta.
N na nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba
siniire,
kɛ nɛn toole dɛ́ larawe ba
bwara,
dɛkalkɛ, nɛra baa dɛ fiɡ ba la
nɔn taa kpeɡri ka di.
2Asɛ n bol ŋɔ, nɛra baa serewa
la, ba na som dɛ ɡwaa
banɔ la ba taa soɡe le.
3Kɛ nɛra baa wola ban lolɛ,
baa wola wechɔɡa bɛlbwa
harɛ nɔ ta nae mɔɔ la,
ba na som.
4Ate, n na kɛŋɔ toma nɛra aa dɛ ɛ dɛ́ dɔ kwaa bwa, le o dɔŋ bɛl komɛl waa dɔa, o na o siwi beɡre la ta. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
5Gɛnee yon fɔɔ o nɔɔra so ŋɔ,
waa tomaa ɛ,
lɔr ɛɛ kpoo ó sewɛ.
6He dɔ kondikwaa nɔndel di
deŋnesɔɔhna ta, ɡwaa haa
koah kohona,
dɛ dɔa nɔndela anɛ di.
A bwa ɛ wepuu,
kɛŋɔ nɛn waa dɛ loo vii
habɔɔ,
dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
7N berɔ na waane ɡe aa wola mun dɔe harɛ nɔ ta.
8Dɛ baa bɛl ɡboo soɡa,
o ta bibaa kɛɛ nime dɔe.
Dɛ tɔpere bɛlbwaa wɛɛ koh,
kɛ o siwi aa o kondɔɔh su.
Ate, o bɔɔ ŋɔ, “Ume waa mɛɛ
koh
maa wola won lɛ n sie
nɔɔ?”
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu,
bosɔɔhna aa wola toole
a ta.
9Banɛ wer ɡwaa beŋkpoŋ,
dɛkalkɛ ba nyoa ɛɛ won pɛ,
ásɛ ba ɛ toma kɛrɛdɛ,
dɛ́ dɔ ɡɛ baa dɛ nyin.
10Beŋkpoŋ baa chole aa,
o dɔŋ ɛɛ won chao ó ir.
Kɛ nɛn waa chole
o ta nɛn dɔe o lawɔ
ir la na wa!
11Nɛra banɛ pɛo chɔ aa,
ba dɛ wɔrɔbe dɔŋa bwara.
Kɛ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ ɡbo
aa won chɔ o
bwara wɔrɔbe.
12A lole kɛŋɔ nɛmbeŋkpoŋ bɛl
ɛɛ won yo, dɛ́ pɔ o dɔŋ nɛ,
kɛ ba pɛ nɛra banɛ naa,
baa won lɛ ba te.
Ŋwɛn baa pɛra atoro chae
kpeɡri.
13Bonɔɔ waa nyaa dɛ jemɛ waa la, ɡwaa kooro waa hwɛɛhra, dɛ ɡɛn waa wola jae no. 14A ɡɛ bonɔɔ la, ba ken lawɔ do dea mɔɔ o ba di kora, kɛɛ ba lolɔ nyaa bini o do o harɛ ta. 15N nao kɛŋɔ nɛra baa soɡe harɛ nɔ ta bwa, teŋɛ bonɔɔ baa lawɔ o ba chiɡ kooro naa ta la nɛ. 16Nɛra kooro aa dɛɛ di kora ba nɛɛ ta nyoa dɔe, kɛ dɛ o baa sewaa, nomɛlbwa sie aa o waa waa ɛa taa lɛ. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ nɛn aa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ, dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.

Title: WEJEREME 5
Content:
Kpɔ ɔmee tomɛ Korowii dɛɛ duuru
1He dɛ la Korowii Dea aa, nyiŋi he vala bini kɛrɛdɛ. Do sie no o waa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ́ ɡwaa ɡɛna saraha ba yon dɛɛ ɛ, baa wola jemɛ kɛ ba dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la.
2Dɛɛ lawɛ he nyoa,
he dɔ waane dɛ́ bol aa,
nyiŋi a bini kɛrɛdɛ
dɛ bɛ too,
dɛ́ bol baɡle Korowii.
Korowii te, nyundua o do,
asɛ he do harɛ,
anomanta, bɛ ɡel he wobol
do kan.
3Liire waraa ɡela nɛn ɛɛ dee
deera,
ɡɛɛ dɛ nɛn dɛ́ bol waa
kohona,
dɛ o ta nyiŋe kɛrɛdɛ naa,
wɛɛ bol ɡɛnewa.
4Saŋ bɛlbwa he dɛ baɡɛ Korowii nyoa aa, bɛ ɡel a biɡri he ɛ ɡɛ haa ŋɔa hɛɛ ɛo la, dɛkalkɛ Korowii sie aa nɛn waa ɡɛna waa wola o nyobaɡa ta teŋɛ nɛɛ lɛ. 5A wer kɛ nɛn ɡel nyoa baɡa, ɡwaa kɛ waa baɡɛ nyoa, dɛ vɛh a ta teŋa. 6Bɛ ɡel he nyoa wobol kaa he ne wechɔɡa ta, ásɛ dɛ ŋɔ sɔfo be ŋɔ, sibeɡra ta laa he baɡɛ nyoa. Bɛ ɡel Korowii baah di he nɛ he nyoa wobol wa, dɛ́ chɔɡ kwaa haa koah dɛ dɔ. 7Deera kohona ne wobol kohona ta mun dɔe. Anomanta, a chɛ kɛ hɛɛ ɔmɛ Korowii.
Kondɔɔh ɛ wepuu
8He na nomɛl waa nyaa, baa wola o waa bolɛ dɛɛ tɛo aŋwɛnɛ ta, dɛɛ fiiɡu harɛ la ta naa, bɛ ɡel á kpo he nyoa. Nomoa bɛlbwa lɔ o dɔŋ waa ɡwaalo lɔɡa, asɛ ba bwa habɔɔ, nomonome bane ɡe ɡwaa ba. 9Komɛlbwa aa le harɛ la ta la, nɛra baa lɔ o ta la bwaa dɛɛ dia, waa aa chɛ kooro laanee kɛŋɔ, wɛɛ nyiŋi harɛpare la ta, dɛkalkɛ o ɡe ɛɛ dɔ anee di kohona.
10Nomɛlbwa o sie aa beɡre
suuɡa
laa an dɔ kohona,
nomɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin
kondɔɔh kohona la sie aa
a ta lɛ.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, a do kɛŋɔ
nɛn waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ,
dɛ ɡel o bini la ken.
11Nɛn dɔ kondɔɔh kohona naa,
nɛra baa dɛ dia ɡe dɛ warɛ.
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ naate la ɛɛ ba
dɔe?
O sie ɡbo laa dɛɛ ba a ta
lɛɛ yaa?
12Tom-ɛɛ chɔe dɛ do o som,
hale o di kondikwaa tama
kɛɛ kohona noo.
Kɛ kondɔɔh kwaa waa dɔa
kohona nomanta,
waa won dom chɔ.
13N na wedoŋa ane ɡe harɛ nɔ ta,
nɛra yon pa ba kondɔɔh sɔh
kɛ aa ban cha,
14kɛ a yon che waane ta
bá paŋɛ ba kondɔɔh la,
ásɛ dɛ ba dɔ bibaala bane
kwaraa naa,
baa komɛlbwaa dɔ, dɛ́ kpɔ
ja ba.
15Ba lolɛ bie ba harɛ nɔ ta naa,
waa komɛlbwa ne ba,
ɡɛ tentenee o sewaa wɛɛ
ba kaala.
Waa won kpɔ komɛlbwa
waa koah dɔ harɛ nɔ ta
kaa.
16Waa aa teŋa nɔ ɡe ɛ wedoŋa kohona.
Gɛ baa lolɛ nɛn o ba harɛ nɔ
ta la,
ɡɛɛ wɛɛ kaalo.
Bɔkwa tɔnɔɔ wɛɛ ba dɔe,
o koeh waa dɛ koh pɛɛpɛɛ
ta nɔ?
17O soɡa bini bwa do kɛŋɔ
nɛn waa soɡe biro ta ken,
o liire chɔɡ,
dɛɛ na wenaale kohona
o baah di.
18Ate, n na kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ nɛn di kondikwa, dɛ́ nyɔ sen, ásɛ o sie lɛ koeh waa dɛ koh tɔpera tama, Korowii aa kpɔa tɛo harɛ nɔ ta. Waa aa chɔ le tɛo laanee la. 19Kɛ ane a bwa, dɛ Korowii tɛ nomɛl kondɔɔh dɛ ɡel o sie ɛɛ lɛ a ta, asɛ o jemɛ kɛŋɔ anee chɔ le tɛo waa, anee Korowii kpɔ kɛo. 20Korowii aa ɡela o dɔ silɛɛ nomanta, waa o tɔpera tama waa di harɛ nɔ ta waa liira ba.

Title: WEJEREME 6
Content:
1N berɔ na wechɔɡa ane harɛ nɔ ta, aa do tɔɡre kohona kɛŋɔ bone, dɛ dawɛ nɛra nɛ. 2Korowiirii dɛɛ tɛ nɛn kondɔɔh ne jirima, ɡɛ aa ɛ o bɛ komɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin nya o soɡa bini. Kɛ Korowii aa ɡel ó dɔa di, nɛmpɛɛ bɛlee yon berɛ ba kpɔ. Anɔ ta mun dɔe, a ɛ wedoŋa.
3Dɛ nomɛl soɡo biɡri dɛ dɔ bii lafa, kɛ o soɡa dɛ biɡri bwa habɔɔ, dɛ o ta wone dɔ silɛɛ o kondɔɔh waa dɔa ta, dɛ sewɛ ba huɡo kɛrɛdɛ naa, amɔ dɛ bie baa haro ta kwaraa ɡwaalo. 4A ta mun dɔe kɛŋɔ bá lolɛ a ɡɛ bie la, o waa dɛ le nɛra liire bini kwaraa, ásɛ ba soh o wa. 5A lole kɛŋɔ bie la ta wee nae kɛɛ dɛ jemɛ komɛlbwa te, kɛ o bwara sɔɔhno dɛ ɡwaa a ɡɛ nɛn la, 6hale ɡɛ nɛn waa dɔ kondɔɔh la soɡo bene kaɡboŋa anɛ kwaraa naa, silɛɛ bɛlbwa aa a taa do. Ane a bwa, bobeŋkpoŋii bie la ne nɛn la bwa ɛɛ kaa.
7Kondikwaa nɛn aa di waa
wɛɛ koh,
kɛ waa vaɡɛ bwa.
8Gwaala besoo wejereme
ɡwaa ɡɛne ɔ?
Dɛ nɛn nyao waa,
o jo nɛra bini naa,
o jemɛ ɡɛ waa dɛ lawɛ o te.
9A wer kɛ he sie lɛ anɔ la haa
dɔa ta,
ɡwaa anɔ la haa kpɔ sie
dawɛ kɛŋɔ hɛɛ dɔɔ ta.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu, dɛ do kɛ nɛn
waa dɛ loo vii habɔɔ,
dɛ ɡel o bini ken.
10Wobɛlbwa aa chiɡa saŋ la
dɔ sɔn,
asɛ ya jemɛ ɡɛ nɛwɛnyini
ɡe aa doa.
Ya jemɔ kɛŋɔ nomɛlbwa ne nɛn,
waa do kpeɡri ɡwaalo aa
won cheme.
11Nɛn wobol warɔ kohona naa,
aa mun kohona dɔ.
Ɛrɛɛ aa ba wona dɔ tɔnɔ tɛ
bɛlbwa nɔ?
12Dɛkalkɛ umee dɛ́ won jemɛ waa aa wera tɛ nɛn, ya tɔpera tama aa wola tɔnɔ dɔe dɛ teŋe baa kaa kɛ lileo nɔ ta nɔ? Umee dɛ́ won baɡle waa aa chiɡ harɛ nɔ ta o seo habɔɔ?

Title: WEJEREME 7
Content:
Wejema wa
1Sɔndɛɛɡe wer ɡwaa nosɔɔhsoma,
ɡɛɛ seo tɔpere ɡe do wer
ɡwaa lola tɔpere.
2A wer kɛŋɔ nɛn la lwe mun,
dɛ ɡwaa kɛ waa la bela baa
dɛ di kondikonjena,
dɛɛ lɛ ba sie,
dɛkalkɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ sewɔɔ.
A chɛ kɛ nomɛlbwa ɛɛ do
waa nɔ dɛɛɡɔ.
3Suna dii ɡwaa mama,
dɛkalkɛ suna dii ɡelɔ
yaa hweli waa aa wera.
4Wejereme soɡo waa,
o dɛ́ lii seo wa,
kɛ ɡɛne te, o sie dɛ́ lɛ
tɔpere bɛlbwa.
5Wejereme dɛ́ kaeh naa,
no o be,
ɡwaa kɛ ɡɛne aa dɛ ɡo yela
dɛɛ kpɛɛre.
6Gɛne mama do kɛŋɔ,
baa kpɔ sɔɔhne do nii ta
aa parame.
Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu.
7He ɛ wejereme dɛɛ faah
nɛra aa,
he do kɛŋɔ ɡɛne.
He sɛoh baa yawɛ sen ɡe aa,
nɛnchɔɡee hɛɛ ɛ.
8Komɛlbwa tona wer ɡwaa o
mumpar,
asɛ bambile lawa ɡe ɡwaa
kɛ haa dɛ ɛ mbarafo.
9Bɛ ɡel he baah ɛɛ di
warawara,
ɡɛnee lɛ o dɔŋ waa dɛɛ do
o bini.
10Bɛ ŋɔ, “Ɛrɛɛ saŋ la
wobɛlbwa do wer ɡwaa
fini nɔɔ?”
A ɛ ɡɛnewaa kɛ he bɔɔ ɡɛ.
11Wejema wer kɛŋɔ
haa dɔ kapɛrɛ kon bɛl
dɛɛ cha nɛra baa lɔ harɛ
nɔ ta.
12Wejema dɛ tɔ nɛn nɛ,
kɛŋɔ suuɡa aa won nɛn lɛɛ
la ken.
Wejema dɔe kohona ɛɛ won
ɡel naate la so sodɛɛɡa,
dɛ́ dɔ mkpa.
13Nyiŋi waa Korowii aa ɛa.
Umee dɛ́ won toɡre
kon waa ɡela o ɡoloo?
14Waane kaalɔ dɛɛ tɛɛ kɛrɛdɛ
naa, ɡel he sie lɛ,
kɛ dɛ wenaale bɛlee tenaa,
lii kɛŋɔ,
Korowiirii ba silɛɛ ne,
dɛ berɛ ba wenaale ɡe ne.
Anomanta, nomɛlbwa
aa won jemɛ ɡɛ aa chiɡu
kerekere.
15N soɡa maa soɡa aa wola mun dɔe nɔ, webele anɛ aa teŋa nɔɔ n na,
nɛn o wa aa toɡra dɛ́ sewɛ
o wedɛɛɡa ɛɛ wa,
ásɛ nyubinikpeɡ te so
dɛ́ biɡri o wechɔɡa ta.
16Bɛ ɛ kɛŋɔ he waa toɡrɔ
kohona,
kɛɛ he jemɛ waa kohona,
dɛ́ chɔɡ he te.
17Dɛɛ berɛ nyubinikpeɡ ɛɛ kohona,
dɛɛ berɛ ɡɛna ɡe kohona.
Ɛrɛɛ chɛ kɛ he sewɛ,
dɛ he saŋ ta tele mɔɔ nɔ?
18Lawɛ a bwa bini kpoŋe,
dɛ bɛ ɡel bɛlbwa le he nɔn
ta.
Naate waa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii
ɛɛ won le ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa
nyoa.
19Wejema ɛɛ won ɡel
nɛmbeŋkpoŋ di kpeɡri,
dɛ́ ɡwaa koranar fi baa lɔ
bwɛjen ta.
20Nɛn o wa aa toɡra beŋkpoŋ
kwaraa toole harɛ nɔ ta,
dɛɛ ɛ wa aa toɡra waa wola
wechɔɡa ɛ.
21Bɛ deŋne cheɡ dɛɛ no
waa bwa nɛra aa dɛ bol,
ɡɛ laa aa, hɛɛ ba noo
kɛŋɔ he bonɔɔ kwaraa
taahne,
22dɛkalkɛ he ɡbabir jemɔ
kɛŋɔ ɡɛɛ he taah nɛra bane.
23N cheɡɛ n wejema ta dɛ nyiŋi,
dɛ daah a bwa na dɛ ŋɔ,
“N siwi beɡrɔ kɛ
ń dɔ wejema,”
kɛ dɛ a berɔ ɡwaa n liire ta.
24Gɛ bɛlbwa wejema
aa doa bwa,
o bini luŋri kɛrɛdɛ,
o ta jaɡa dɔe,
dɛ do kpeɡri kɛŋɔ yá won
jemɛ a mun.
25Anomanta, n kpɔ n liire bwa
do a ta,
dɛ́ won jemɛ a mun,
dɛ́ nyiŋi wejema ne ŋwɛnɛ
aa cheɡɛ a ta waanee yon
dɛɛ ɛ,
dɛ́ na ɡɛnewaa aa lɔ
nyubinikpeɡ ne ɡɛna ta.
26N na waane aa dɛ we dɛ
ɡwaa seo,
haah bɛl do kɛŋɔ bel baa
dɛ harɔ.
O bambile do kɛ nafuɡe,
asɛ o nɔɔra do kɛŋɔ
jɔɡrɔre,
o kpɔ dɛɛ harɛ nɛra.
Wejereme bɛlbwa o wa aa
dɛ su Korowii siwi la,
ɛɛ won chwa le o nafuɡere
la ta,
kɛ ɡɛne te, wɛɛ lawɔɔ.
27Wejereme la ŋɔ,
“Hé na, waa maa naa
laanee nɔ,
n nyiŋi waane bini beŋkpoŋa
beŋkpoŋa,
dɛ jemɛ ŋwɛnɛ aa cheɡɛ
a ta waane yon dɛɛ ɛ.
28N taa dɛ nyiŋi a bini
n ta wobɛlbwa nae mɔɔ la,
babeŋkpoŋ o wa aa toɡra
ɡboo n na
nɛra kaɡboŋ bini,
kɛ haah o wa aa toɡra
beŋkpoŋ kwaraa toole
ba bini.
29Waa aa teŋa nɔɔ n hweli le
a ta,
Korowii fe ta nɛwɛnyina
bwa ba waa toɡre,
kɛ ba berɔ kpɔ ŋwɛnɛfale
ta dɛ chɔɡ ba te.”

Title: WEJEREME 8
Content:
1Umee ɛ wejereme ɔ?
Umee dɛ won baɡle waa
mun ɔ?
Wejema dɛ kwaa nɛn siebɔr,
dɛ ɡel wɛɛ dɔ silɛɛ.
Kooro duura wa
2Dɛ kooro bol wa aa, nyiŋi kɛrɛdɛ dɛ́ ɛ ɡɛ waa ŋɔa, dɛkalkɛ he ŋwɛɛrɔ baɡle Korowii a wa. 3Bɛ too ŋɔ hɛɛ le kooro sie kaa. Bɛ on deŋnekpeɡ ɛ, dɛkalkɛ wɛɛ won ɛɛ ɡɛ bɛlbwa waa dɛ nyin. 4Kooro aa dɛ di kpeɡri nomanta, dɛ o bol waa, umee dɛ́ won tɔŋlo wɔ?
5Nomɛlbwa waa no o waa
waa dɛ bol la,
aa wahalaa na,
kɛ wejereme te ɛɛ won jemɛ
saŋ waa wera ne ɡɛ waa ɛ.
6A lole kɛŋɔ nɛwɛnyini
wenaale ɡwaa o nɛɛ te,
kɛ wobɛlbwa dɔ saŋ waa
wera ne ŋwɛnɛ baa ɛa.
7Nomɛlbwa aa wola kere waa
jemɛ nɔ,
umee dɛ́ won baɡlo waa aa
dɛ ba bala ɔ?
8Nomɛlbwa ta kpeɡri dɔe o
doma nɛ,
nomɛlbwa aa jemɛ tɔpere
waa dɛ ba sewa.
Gɛ baa wola won lawɛ nɛn
le laa ta la,
ɡɛɛ wechɔɡa aa wola nɛra
baa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa bini le.
9N na a ɡɛ waa nɔ bwa, asɛ n lii waa baa dɛ ɛa harɛ nɔ ta bwa. Nɛra bane dɛ di kpeɡri, asɛ bane ɡe do ba lɔɡa ba bwara ɛɛ nyɛɡ. 10N berɔ na nyubinikpeɡ tena baa huɡ ba, kɛ nɛra le huɡribɔr bela ba naa, ba yon berɛ dɛɛ kpɛɛ ba bwɛjen la bini baa soɡa dɛ ɛ wechɔɡa la. Anɔ bwa ɡe ɛ wepuu.
11Nɛn ɛ wechɔɡa ba ta o deŋnetɛra kpɔe tɛo warane naa, nɛra dɛ dɔ liifala dɛ kpɔ dɛɛ ɛ wechɔɡa. 12A lole kɛŋɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛ ɛɛ won ɛ wechɔɡa kera lafa dɛ́ ta so biɡri. Kɛ n jemɔ kɛŋɔ nɛra baa dɛ ɔmɛ Korowii dɛɛ duuru la, wobɛlbwa ɛɛ do werii tɛɛ ba. 13Kɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra aa wola Korowii ɔmɛ nomanta, aa wer doe ba dɛ́ tɛɛ ba. Ba tɔpera aa jaŋnee do kɛŋɔ, lileo yon teŋe ba kaa la ken.
14Waane ɡe lole aa wola mun dɔe harɛ nɔ ta ja. Nɛra ba wa aa toɡra dɛ dɔ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra deŋnetɛra, asɛ wechɔɡ-ɛɛra ɡe ɛɛ dɔ kembɔr aa chɛ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra. Anɔ ɡe ɛ wepuu ja. 15Anomanta, n liiree kɛŋɔ a wer kɛ nɛwɛnyini di kondikwaa dɛ́ nyɔ sen lɛ o sie harɛ nɔ ta. Gɛɛ dɛ́ ɡel o dɔ silɛɛ o toma ne o tɔpera Korowii aa kpɔa tɛo o so harɛ nɔ ta bwa.
16N siwi beɡrɔ n nyiŋi ɡɛ wejema aa doa, dɛ na nɛwɛnyini koeh waa dɛ koh harɛ nɔ ta. N nao kɛŋɔ nɛn aa wone dɛɛ chɔ dom chɔɔ ne jwaana, 17asɛ n na waa Korowii aa ɛa bwa. Nomɛlbwa aa won jemɛ waa aa lɔ harɛ nɔ ta ka tonɛ bwa. Hale anɔ bwa habɔɔ, nɛwɛnyini ta wone jemɛ a mun. Wejereme waa ŋɔa o jemɔ kwaraa la, waa won jemɛ bwa.

Title: WEJEREME 9
Content:
Nyokala beŋkpoŋii chɔ le tɛ nomɛlbwa
1N lii anɔ bwa kɛrɛdɛ, dɛ na kɛŋɔ nɛra ba wa aa toɡra, ne wejerema waa baa dɛ ɛ bwa, lɔ Korowii nɔn ta.
